paite: Paul, Pathian deihdan a Khrist Jesu sawltak leh i unaupa Timothi in,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

paite: Kolossa a Khrist a misiangthoute leh unau muanhuaite kiang ah, Pathian i Pa kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: to the saints and faithful brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Nou a ding a thum gige in Pathian i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa kiang ah kipahthu ka gen uhi,
english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

paite: Khrist Jesu na gindan uh leh misiangthou tengteng tung a itna na neihdan uh ka zak tak ziak un.
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

paite: Huai bel nou a ding a lametna van a koihkholh a a-om ziak ahi. Huai lametna tanchin mah tuma in, tanchinhoih thutak na zata uhi.
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News,

paite: Huai tanchinhoih tuh khovel tengteng ah gah a akhan zel mah bang in na kiang uh ahong tung a, Pathian hehpihna na ngaihkhiak ua na zak ni ua kipan in, noumau ah leng gah in akhang zel hi.
english: which has come to you; even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;

paite: Huchibang in Epaphras i sikha hihpih ngaihtak lak a na zil bang un, amah kou sik in Khrist nasempa muanhuai ahi.
english: even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on our behalf,

paite: Ama'n Kha a na itna uh ahon hilh hi.
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

paite: Huaiziak in ka zak ni ua kipan kou leng noute a ding in thum leh nget ka tawp kei uhi; huchi a khalam pilna leh theihna tengteng a adeihlam theihna a hihdim a na hong omtheihna ding un.
english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

paite: Huan nasep hoih chiteng a gah a, Pathian theihna a khang a, ama kipah lam a Toupa a dia kilawm a na hintheihna ding un.
english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

paite: Kipahna toh kithuah thuakhatna leh kuhkalna nei ding in, ahatna thupi bang zel a hihhat in hong om un.
english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy;

paite: Vak a misiangthoute gouluahpih dia hon chingsak Pa kiang a kipahthu gen in.
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;

paite: Ama'n mial thuneihna lak a kipan hon suaktasak in, a Tapa ittak gam ah hon kaisakta hi.
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love;

paite: Amah ah i tatkhiakna leh khelhnate ngaihdamna i mu uhi.
english: in whom we have our redemption, TR adds “through his blood,” the forgiveness of our sins;

paite: Amah muh theih louh Pathian batpih, thilsiam tengteng a piang masapen ahi.
english: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

paite: Amah ah bangkim siam ahi a, van a omte leh lei a omte, muhtheihte leh muh theihlouhte, laltutphahte, thuneihnate, vaihawmnate leh thilhihtheihnate hitaleh bangkim ama siam ahi, amah a ding mah a siam ahi.
english: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him.

paite: Huan amah zaw bang teng om ma in leng a-om hi, amah ah bang teng adingkhawm chiat uhi.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

paite: Amah tuh pumpi, saptuam lutang ahi a; bangkim a tungnungpen ahong hihtheihna ding in abulpi, misi lak a kipan piang masapen ahi.
english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

paite: Amah ah Pathian taangchinna tengteng a om Pa deihlamtak ahi,
english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him;

paite: Ama kros sisan a lemna abawl in amah ah bangkim amah toh akilemsak a; amah ngei ah lei a thil omte leh van a thil omte leng amah toh akilemsakta hi.
english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth, or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

paite: Huan nou tuma lam in na lungsim uah amelma na hi ua, na thilhih gilou ua amah a kipan a khen a om na hi uhi, himahleh tu in ama'n amah toh hon kilemsakta a;
english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil works,

paite: asihna in apumpi ah amah toh noute ahon kilemsakta hi, ama a siangthou, gensiatbei leh mohsak theih louh a ahon dinsak theihna ding in,
english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without blemish and blameless before him,

paite: kingakna nei a kiptak a om a, tanchinhoih na zak ua lametna a kipan a suanmang a om lou a, ginna a na om gige peuhmah uleh; huai tanchinhoih van nuai a thilsiam tengteng lak a tangkoupih ahi a; kei Paul leng huai nna sem ding a bawl ka hi.
english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

paite: Nou ziak a tu a ka gimthuaknate ah ka kipak hi; huan apumpi ziak a Khrist in agimthuaknate ban zom zel ka hi; huai tuh Saptuam ahi.
english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly;

paite: Nou a ding a Pathian nasepna kei kiang a piak a om bang zel in huai saptuam nasempa ka hong hita; Pathian thu bukimtak a theisak ding in.
english: of which I was made a servant, according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,

paite: Huai Pathian thu tuh tangtawn leh akhang-akhang a kipan a thuguk kisel ahi; tu in bel misiangthoute kiang ah latsak in a-omta hi.
english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

paite: Amau kiang ah, Zentelte lak a huai thuguk thupina hauhsakna atamdan Pathian in theihsak a-ut him ahi; huai thuguk tuh Khrist noumau a om, thupina lametna pen ahi.
english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory;

paite: Michih Khrist a hoihkim a ka piaktheihna ding un michih hilh in, pilna chiteng a zilsak in, atanchin ka gen zel uhi.
english: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

paite: Huchibang ding in nakpitak a keimah a asepsak thahatna tengteng zang in theihtawp in ka sem zel hi.
english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

paite: Noumau leh Laodisia a omte leh sa a ka mel mu lou peuhmahte a ding in bangchibang a thupi in ahia noute a dia ka kisuk na theih uh ka ut hi.
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

paite: Pathian thuguk atheihtheih ua, theihsiamna theihchetna kim hauhna tengteng lam a, phankhawm a a-om ua, alungtangte uh lungmuang a a-omtheihna ding un;
english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

paite: pilna leh theihna gou chiteng amah Khrist ah selguk in a-om hi.
english: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.

paite: Kuamah in paukam siam a ahon khemzohlouhna ding un, huaite ka gen ahi.
english: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

paite: Sa in na kiang uah om kei mah leng, kipaktak a om in na kizendan uleh Khrist ginna a na kipdan uh thei in, kha in na kiang uah ka om hi.
english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist Jesu, Toupa na kipahpih bang un, amah ah om un.
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,

paite: Amah a zungkai leh lamtouh a om in, ahon zilsak bang un na ginna ua kiptak a om in, kipahthu genna hau in amah ah om un.
english: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

paite: Pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw kuapeuh in Khrist thu hilou, mihing thugousiah leh khovel thubulte bang in athupil uh leh khemna peuh in gallak in ahon la kha ding uhi.
english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.

paite: Amah ah Pathian taangchinna chiteng tuh pumpi nei in a-om gige hi.
english: For in him all the fullness of the Godhead dwells bodily,

paite: Amah ah hinna taangchinna na neita ngal ua; amah vaihawmna leh thuneihna tengteng lutang ahi.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;

paite: Amah ah zeksum, mihing khut a sum hilou, Khrist in abawl zeksumna ah na pianken khelhna uh suahkhia in zeksum na hita uhi.
english: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

paite: Baptisma a amah toh vui na hita ua, huai mah ah misi lak a kipan a Pathian nasep gintak ziak in amah toh kaihthoh na hi uhi.
english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

paite: Huan noute na tatleknate uleh na sa uh zeksumlouhna a si na hi ua, noumau ngei amah toh ahon hingsak in na tatlekna tengteng uh angaidamta hi.
english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

paite: I tatlekna tengteng hon ngaidam a, batna lai thupiak a gelh i tung ua om eimah hon dou gige anulmangta hi. Huai ngei kros a kilhlum in alamangta hi.
english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;

paite: Vaihawmna leh thuneihnate suankhia in, huaite kros a zou in alangtang in theihsakna in azangta hi.
english: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

paite: Huchi in nek-le-dawn thu ah hiam, ankuanglui leh kha thak thu ah leh Sabbath ni tan thu ah kuamah in hon dem kei hen.
english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

paite: Huaite thil hong tung ding lim ahi a, atak zaw Khrist ahi.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

paite: Kuamah in amau deih thu lel a thunuailutna leh angel biakna zang in, athil muhte uh pansan in, asalam lungsim ziak ua kisathei mawkmawk in, na kipahman uh hon suhsak kei hen.
english: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

paite: Lutang len tinten lou in a-om uhi. Amah a kipan in pumpi apum in aguhtuah leh thaguite a vak leh zopkhawm a om in, Pathian khansak bang zel in akhang hi.
english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

paite: Khovel thubulte Khrist kiang a na sihsan uleh, bang achia khovel a khosa bang a thupiakte lak a na kipelut na hi ua?
english: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

paite: Lawng ke'n, chiam ke'n, khoih ke'n, chihte,
mihingte thuchiam leh zilsakna huchibang thil tengteng zat kawm a mangthang ding hilou uhiam?
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

paite: Hiai thilte bawltawm biakna leh thunuailutna tak lou leh pumpi kisukgentheihna ah zaw hihtuak hileh akilawm na a, himahleh sa deihlam zuih khamna ah bangmah aphatuam kei hi.
english: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

paite: Huchi in Khrist toh kaihthohkhawm a na om tak man un, tunglam a Pathian taklam a tu Khrist omna a thil omte zong un.
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

paite: Tunglam a thil omte ah na lungsim uh nga un; lei a thil omte a nga lou in.
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

paite: Na sita ua, tu in na hinna uh Pathian ah Khrist toh sel in a-om hi.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

paite: Khrist i hinna uh ahong kilak chiang in nou leng amah kiang ah thupi in na kilak sam ding uhi.
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

paite: Huchi in noumau a lei lam thil deihna omte that un, kingaihna, nitna, hukna, utna gilou, huaihamna; huai milim biakna ahi.
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

paite: Huai thilte ziak in Pathian thangpaihna thumang lou tate tung ah atung nak ahi.
english: for which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

paite: Nou leng tuma lam a huai thilte a na khosak lai un, huaite ah na kalsuan uhi.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;

paite: Himahleh tu in nou leng hiai tengteng, hehna, thangpaihna, huatna, gensiatna, na kam ua pau zahmohte koihmang un.
english: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

paite: Mihing lui athilhih toh na suahkheta uh chih mu in, kuamah kizuausantuah kei un,
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

paite: mihing thak in na kivanta ngal ua; huai mihing thak asiampa batpih bang a theihna a siam thak in a-om lellel hi.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

paite: Huai ah Grik mi leh Juda mi, zeksum leh sum louh, melmak mite, Skithia mite, sikhate, noplente leng a-om kei; Khrist bangkim hi zaw in, bangkim ah a-om behlap lai hi.
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian mitel, misiangthou leh deihtakte bang in lainatna lungtang, migitna, kingaih-niamna, thunuailutna, thuakzohna in kivan un.
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

paite: Kuapeuh in kua tung ah leng thubuai nei hi le uchin, kithuakzou chiat in, kingaidamtuah unla, Toupa'n ahon ngaihdam tak bang in kingaidamtuah chiat un.
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

paite: Huan huai tengteng tung ah itna silhthuah un; huai in thil bangkim kituaktak in agakkhawm hi.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

paite: Huan Khrist khamuanna in na lungtang uah vai hawm hen, huai ding in pumpi khat a sap na hi ua, kipahna dan leng thei un.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

paite: Khrist thu a hauhna teng toh noumau ah dimsak kiihkeih un, pilna chiteng a kisinsak leh kihilhtuah a om in, kipahna lungtang toh Pathian kiang a phatna late, Pathian late, khalam late sa in om un.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

paite: Huan na hih peuhmah uh thugen ah leh thilhih ah amah ziak a Pa Pathian kiang a kipahthu gen kawm in Toupa Jesu min in hih vek un.
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

paite: Zite aw, Toupa ah akilawm hun bang zel in na pasalte uh kiang ah kiniamkhiak un.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

paite: Pasalte aw, na zite uh it unla, alak uah hanhat kei un.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

paite: Naupangte aw, bangkim ah na nu uleh na pate uh thu mang un, huai tuh Toupa pahtak lam ahi.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

paite: Pate aw, na tate uh hihnuak kei un, huchi lou in zaw alunglel kha ding uhi.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

paite: Sikhate aw, sa a na heutute uh thu bangkim ah mang un, mihing hihkipak lelte bang a mitmei nasem hilou in, lungtang sa khat a Toupa kihta kawm in,
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

paite: na hih peuhmah uh, mihing a ding bang a hih lou in, Toupa a ding zaw in kilawptak in hih un;
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

paite: Toupa a kipan in a-itna gouluah ding na mu ding uh chih thei in, Toupa Khrist nasem na hi uhi.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

paite: Thil diklou hihpa'n athil diklou hihman amu nawn ding hi; mi khentuamna a-om ngal kei hi.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

paite: Heutute aw, nou leng van ah heutupa na neih uh thei in, na sikhate uh tung ah adik atang leh akilawm hih un.
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

paite: Thum gige unla, kipahthu gen kawm in kiveng gige un.
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

paite: Khrist thuguk gen ding a Pathian in thu a dia kong a hon honsak theihna ding in kou leng hon thumsak un, huai thu ziak a hen a om ka hi.
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

paite: Ka gen ding bangtak a ka genkhiak theihna ding in.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

paite: Hun na neih sung un atam theipen sem zel unla, polam mite lak ah piltak in om un.
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

paite: Michih bangchibang a dawn ding hiam chih na theihna ding un na paukam suak uh chisoh, hehpihna hi gige hen.
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

paite: Toupa a unau ngaihtak, nasempa muanhuai, sikha hihpih Taikikas in ka tanchin tengteng nou ahon theisak ding hi.
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

paite: Hiai ziak in, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uleh, na lungtang uh ahon khamuan theihna ding in amah na kiang uah ka hon sawl hi;
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

paite: Onesimas, unau muanhuai leh ngaihtak noumau lak a mi mah toh ahong ding uhi. Amau hiai lam a thil omdan tengteng ahon theisak ding uhi.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

paite: Aristarkhas, ka hentakpihpa'n nou chibai ahon buk hi. Barnabas tupa Marka in leng chibai ahon buk hi, amah tungtang thu ah thupiakte na mu uh; na kiang ua ahong paileh na kipahpih un;
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received commandments, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

paite: Jesu, Justas achih un chibai nou ahon buk hi. Huaite zeksummi ahi ua, huaite kia Pathian lalgam thu lam ah ka seppih leh ahon khamuante ahi uhi.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for the Kingdom of God who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

paite: Epaphras noumau lak a mi mah, Khrist Jesu sikha in noute chibai ahon buk hi, ama'n Pathian deihlam photphot a piching leh gingta tinten a na dintheihna ding un, athumna ah noute a ding in akisuk gige hi.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

paite: Noumau a ding, Laodisia a omte a ding leh Hierapolis a omte a ding in phatuam angai mahmah chih ka theihpih hi.
english: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

paite: Luka, daktor ngaihtak leh Dema in chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.

paite: Laodisia khua a unau omte leh Nimphas leh a-inn a saptuamte chibai hon buksak un.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.

paite: Huan hiai laikhak na lak ua na sim nung un, Laodisia saptuamte lak ah leng simsak un; nou leng Laodisia a pen na na sim sam ding uhi.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

paite: Huan Arkippas kiang ah, "Nasepna Toupa a i muh pen tangtun ding in pilvang in," na chi un.
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

paite: Kei Paul in keimah khut ngei a hiai chibai bukna ka hon gelh ahi. Ka kolbulhte theigige un. Hehpihna na kiang uah om hen, Amen.
english: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoakim vaihawm akum thum kum in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong kuan in Jerusalem ahong um hi.
english: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Jerusalem, and besieged it.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N akhut ah Judah kumpipa Jehoakim apia a, Pathian in atui-um belsuan khenkhat toh; ama'n Shinar gam ah apathian inn ah huaite apua a; huchi in tui-um belsuante apathian sumkoihna inn ah alalutta hi.
english: The Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” ; and he carried them into the land of Shinar to the house of his god: and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god.

paite: Kumpipa'n amichilgehte heutupa Ashpenaz, Israel suante lak a kuate hiam, kumpi chite a kipan leh miliante a kipan hon pi ding in akiang ah thu agen hi.
english: The king spoke to Ashpenaz the master of his eunuchs, that he should bring in certain of the children of Israel, even of the seed royal and of the nobles;

paite: Tuailaite amau a gensiatna om lou, himahleh hoihtak a deihsakna tang leh pilna tengteng a siamtheihna leh pilna theihsiamna lungpilte, kumpipa inpi a dingh thei ding, huchibang mite; huchi a Kaldai laisiamna leh pau amaute asinsak theihna ding in.
english: youths in whom was no blemish, but well-favored, and skillful in all wisdom, and endowed with knowledge, and understanding science, and such as had ability to stand in the king’s palace; and that he should teach them the learning and the language of the Chaldeans.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n amau niteng tantuan ding in kumpipa an leh adawn uain a kipan in asehsak a, huchi a kum thum sung a kisinsiamsak a; huchi a huai hun abei chiang a kumpipa ma a adintheihna ding un.
english: The king appointed for them a daily portion of the king’s dainties, and of the wine which he drank, and that they should be nourished three years; that at its end they should stand before the king.

paite: Huchi in hiaite lak ah, Judah tate a kipan, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael leh Azariah a-om uhi.
english: Now among these were, of the children of Judah, Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.

paite: Michilgehte heutupa'n amaute min ding aphuahsak a; Daniel min ding in Belteshazzar; Hananiah min ding in Shadrak; Mishael min ding in Meshak leh Azariah min ding in Abednego aphuak hi.
english: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name of Belteshazzar; and to Hananiah, of Shadrach; and to Mishael, of Meshach; and to Azariah, of Abednego.

paite: Himahleh Daniel in kumpipa an hiam adawn uain hiam a kihihnit louh alungtang in atum tinten hi. Huaiziak in michilgeh heutupa kiang ah akihih nitlouhna ding in angenta hi.
english: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the king’s dainties, nor with the wine which he drank: therefore he requested of the prince of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in Daniel michilgehte heutupa mitmuh in deihsakna leh lainatna amusak hi.
english: Now God made Daniel to find kindness and compassion in the sight of the prince of the eunuchs.

paite: Huan michilgehte heutupa'n Daniel kiang ah, "Ka toupa kumpipa na an uleh na dawn uh seppa ka lau; bang ding in na khanvualpih uh tuailaite sang a na mel uh hoih lou zaw a hon mu ding ahia oi? Huchi in kumpipa lak ah ka lutang na lauthawngsak dia hia?" achi hi.
english: The prince of the eunuchs said to Daniel, I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and your drink: for why should he see your faces worse looking than the youths who are of your own age? so would you endanger my head with the king.

paite: Huchi in Daniel in sumkempa, michilgehte heutupa'n Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael leh Azariah tung a asehpa kiang ah,
english: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the prince of the eunuchs had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah:

paite: "Na sikhate ni sawm sung enkhia in, ka hon ngen ahi; nek ding in anteh-louhing leh dawn ding in tui hon pia uhen.
english: Test your servants, I beg you, ten days; and let them give us vegetables to eat, and water to drink.

paite: Huai chiang in na ma ah ka mel uleh amau kumpipa an ne tuailaite mel et hi hen; na muh bang in, na sikhate tung ah hih in," achi hi.
english: Then let our faces be looked on before you, and the face of the youths who eat of the king’s dainties; and as you see, deal with your servants.

paite: Huchi in amau thu angaikhia a, ni sawm sung a-enkhia hi.
english: So he listened to them in this matter, and proved them ten days.

paite: Ni sawm abei in tuailai kumpipa an nete tengteng sang in amel uh hoihzaw in akilang a, asa uh leng athauzaw hi.
english: At the end of ten days their faces appeared fairer, and they were fatter in flesh, than all the youths who ate of the king’s dainties.

paite: Huchi in sumkempa'n a-an uleh adawn ding uh uain alamang a, amaute kiang ah anteh-louhing ape zawta hi.
english: So the steward took away their dainties, and the wine that they should drink, and gave them pulse.

paite: Hiai tuailai lite ahih uleh Pathian in amaute kiang ah laisiamna leh pilna tengteng atheihna leh kivakna apia a; huchi in Daniel in mengmuhna leh mang tengteng ah theihsiamna anei hi.
english: Now as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and skill in all learning and wisdom: and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.

paite: Kumpipa'n amaute hon pilut ding achih nite abei in michilgehte heutupa'n amaute Nebukadnezzar ma ah ahon pi hi.
english: At the end of the days which the king had appointed for bringing them in, the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.

paite: Kumpipa'n amau ahoulimpih a; amau lak ah Daniel, Hananiah Mishael leh Azariah bang kuamah muh in a-omta kei hi; huaiziak in kumpipa ma ah adinghta uhi.
english: The king talked with them; and among them all was found none like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah: therefore stood they before the king.

paite: Huchi in pilna leh theihsiamna thu chiteng, amaute kumpipa'n adotte ah agamsung a om mitkhialdawi tawi leh bummi tengteng sang in amun sawm a hoihzaw in amaute amu hi.
english: In every matter of wisdom and understanding, concerning which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters who were in all his realm.

paite: Kumpipa Kura in kum khatna vai ahawm tanpha in Daniel apaisuaktou hi.
english: Daniel continued even to the first year of king Cyrus.

paite: Persia kumpipa Kura vaihawm kum thumna ah Daniel, amin Belteshazzar kiang ah thu khat ahong kihil hi; huan huai thu atak ahi a, kidouna thupi mahmah thu ahi; huchi in huai thu atheisiam a, mengmuhna theihsiamna anei hi.
english: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a great warfare: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

paite: Huai lai in kei, Daniel in nipikal pumpi kal thum ka suun hi.
english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

paite: Tanghou lim ka ne kei a; sa hi in uain hileh ka kam ah alut kei; nipikal thum tunkim masiah sathau ka kinilh kei himhim hi.
english: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine into my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

paite: Huan akha masapen ani sawmnih-le-li ni in, lui lian, Tigris pang ah ka dingh hi.
english: In the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,

paite: Ka dak a, ngai in, mi khat puanmalngat silh, akawngte Uphaz dangka-eng siang a gak ka mu hi.
english: I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold, a man clothed in linen, whose thighs were adorned with pure gold of Uphaz:

paite: Apumpi leng beril suang bang ahi a; amaitang khophia bang ahi; amitte meisel kuangpha abang a, abante leh akhepekte dal nawttet abang a; athugen ging mipi aw abang hi.
english: his body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches, and his arms and his feet like burnished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

paite: Huchi in kei, Daniel kia in hiai mengmuhna ka mu a; ka kiang a om mite'n lah huai mengmuhna amu ngal kei ua; himahleh atung uah nakpi a linna ahong tung a, kibu ding in ataikek uhi.
english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision; for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision; but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

paite: Huchi in kei kia a nutsiat in ka om a; hiai mengmuhna thupi ka muta hi; huchi in kei ah hatna a-om nawnta kei a; ka kilawmna kei ah siatna ahong suakta a; hatna ka neita kei hi.
english: So I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me; for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

paite: Hinapi in ka muh mipa aw ka za a; athute ka ngaihkhiak lai in, akhup in ka mai lei lam nga in nakpitak in ka ihmu hithit hi.
english: Yet heard I the voice of his words; and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I fallen into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

paite: Ngai in, khut in ahon khoih a; ka khuk leh ka khutpek leh ban ah hon len in ling kawmkawm lai ahon phong hi.
english: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Aw Daniel, nang nakpitak a-it a ompa, na kiang a ka thugente theisiam in dingtang in; na kiang a sawl a ompa ka hi," achi a; hiai thu ka kiang a agen lai in, ling kawm in ka dinghta hi.
english: He said to me, Daniel, you man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright; for am I now sent to you. When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Lau ke'n, Daniel, theisiam ding leh na Pathian ma a kiniamkhiak ding a, na lungtang na koihkip ni masapen a kipan, na thugente zak a omta ahi; na thugente ziak a hong ka hi.
english: Then he said to me, Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard: and I have come for your words’ sake.

paite: Himahleh Persia gam kumpipa'n ni sawmnih-le-khat kei ahon dal hi; himahleh ngai in, Persia kumpipa kiang ah hentang a ka om nilouh ziak in Mikael, angel lianpen kei hon panpih ding in ahong pai hi.
english: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me: and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

paite: Huchi in ni nanung lam chiang a na mite tung a hong tung ding bang ahia chih nang hon theisiamsak dia hong pai ka hi; mengmuhna tunung ni tampi a hong tung ding ahi lai hi," chi in.
english: Now I have come to make you understand what shall happen to your people in the latter days; for the vision is yet for many days:

paite: Huan hiai thute bang a ka kiang a ama'n thu agen khit in lei lam ah ka mai ka nga a, ka pau thei kei hi.
english: and when he had spoken to me according to these words, I set my face toward the ground, and was mute.

paite: Huan ngai in, mi khat mite tapate toh kibang in ka mukte ahon khoihsak a; ka kam ka a, thu ka gen a, ka ma a dingpa kiang ah, "Aw ka toupa, mengmuhna ziak in lungkhamnate ka tung ah hong kibung a, hatna ka neita kei.
english: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, my lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows are turned on me, and I retain no strength.

paite: Bangchi in ahia ka toupa sikha in ka toupa ahoulimpih theih ding? Kei ah lah thahatna a-om kei a, nak leng nak lah sim ka hi," ka chi hi.
english: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me, neither was there breath left in me.

paite: Huai lai in mi khat mihing toh kibang in ahon khoih nawn a, ahon hatsakta hi.
english: Then there touched me again one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me.

paite: Huan ama'n, "Aw nakpitak a it mipa, lau ke'n; na kiang ah muanna om hen, hattak in om in; ahi, hattak in om in," achi hi. Ama'n ka kiang a thu agen khit in, ka hatta hi, "Ka Toupa thugen heh, ka chi a; nang na hon hatsakta ngal a," chi in.
english: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid: peace be to you, be strong, yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na kiang a bang ding a hong pai ka hia chih na thei hia? Tu in Persia gam makaipa kidoupih ding in ka kik nawn ding; huchi a ka paikhiak chiang in, ngai in, Grik makaipa ahong pai ding hi,” achi hi.
english: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go forth, behold, the prince of Greece shall come.

paite: Himahleh thutak laibu sung a kigelh nang ka hon hilh ding; na makaipa Mikael chih louh kuamah hiaite kalh a kei hon doupih a-om kei.
english: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth: and there is none who holds with me against these, but Michael your prince.”

paite: Huan kei ka hihleh, Mid mi Darias akum khatna kum in, amah hihkip ding leh hihhat ding in ka dingh hi.
english: “As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.

paite: Huchi in thutak ka hon ensak ding hi. "Ngai in, Persia ah kumpipa thum ahong dingkhe lai ding ua; alina pen amaute tengteng sang in nakpitak in ahausazaw ding hi. Huchi a ahauhna ziak a ahong hat mahmah chiang in, Grik dou ding in mi tengteng atokthou ding hi.
english: Now will I show you the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and when he has grown strong through his riches, he shall stir up all against the realm of Greece.

paite: Huan kumpipa hattak ahong dingkhe ding a, thuneihna thupi toh vaihawm ding leh adeihdan a hih ding in.
english: A mighty king shall stand up, who shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

paite: Ahong dinkhiak chiang in agam akek ding a, van huih lite lam ah hawmzak ahi ding; amah suan hilou in vai ahawm ding a, himahleh ama'n thilhihtheihna anei kei ding; agam bohkhiak leh midangte kiang ah piak in a-om ding hi.
english: When he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others besides these.

paite: "Huchi in simlam kumpipa ahat ding a, asepaih heutu khat amah sang in ahatzaw ding a, gam anei ding a; avaihawmna thupi ahi ding.
english: The king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.

paite: Huan kum bangzah hiam nung in, akizomkhawm ding ua; simlam kumpipa tanu mallam kumpipa kiang ah kituahna bawl ding in ahong pai dia; himahleh hiai kizopna in hun sawt adaih kei ding; huai ni in amah veng mite leh apa leh amah kithuahpih pa leng piakkhiak in a-om ding hi.
english: At the end of years they shall join themselves together; and the daughter of the king of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the strength of her arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm; but she shall be given up, and those who brought her, and he who became the father of her, and he who strengthened her in those times.

paite: "Himahleh azung a kipan ahiang selnou mun ah mi khat ahong dingkhe ding a; huai tuh sepaih pawl kiang ah ahong pai dia; mallam kumpipa kulhpi sung ah alut dia; amaute dou in thil ahih ding a, avualzou ding hi.
english: But out of a shoot from her roots shall one stand up in his place, who shall come to the army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail.

paite: Huchi in apathiante u leng, amilim sunte uh toh, huan adangka leh dangka-eng tui-um belsuan hoihte uh toh, Aigupta ah ama'n asal in alakik ding a; huan mallam kumpipa a kipan kum bangzah hiam akidangkoih ding hi.
english: Also their gods, with their molten images, and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, shall he carry captive into Egypt; and he shall refrain some years from the king of the north.

paite: Huan simlam kumpipa gam ah ahong pai dia, himahleh ama gam lam ah akik nawn ding hi.
english: He shall come into the realm of the king of the south, but he shall return into his own land.

paite: Huchi in atapate'n adou ding ua; sepaih thupi tampi akaikhawm ding ua; huaite adimlet in ahong kuan ding ua, apaisuak ding uh; huan akik nawn ding ua, amah kulh tanpha hial in adou ding uhi.
english: His sons shall war, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces, which shall come on, and overflow, and pass through; and they shall return and war, even to his fortress.

paite: Huchi in simlam kumpipa aheh mahmah ding a, ahong kuankhe dia mallam kumpipa akidoupih ding hi. Mallam kumpipa'n sepaih atam a tam tungkhe mahleh mipite akhut a piak in a-om ding uhi.
english: The king of the south shall be moved with anger, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north; and he shall set forth a great multitude, and the multitude shall be given into his hand.

paite: Huan mipite pimang in a-om ding ua, alungtang sansak in a-om ding a; huchi in sing tampite apuksak ding a, himahleh avualzou kei ding hi.
english: The multitude shall be lifted up, and his heart shall be exalted; and he shall cast down tens of thousands, but he shall not prevail.

paite: "Huan mallam kumpipa ahong kik dia, ama sang a thupizaw mipi ahon tungkhe ding a; kum bangzah hiam nung in sepaihhon thupi leh van tampi toh ahong kuan ding hi.
english: The king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former; and he shall come on at the end of the times, even of years, with a great army and with much substance.

paite: Huan huai hunte ah simlam kumpipa dou in mi tampi adingkhe ding uh; na mite lak a hiamgam tate leng mengmuhna hihkip ding in ahong kidomkang ding ua; himahleh apuk ding uhi.
english: In those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the children of the violent among your people shall lift themselves up to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

paite: Huchibang in mallam kumpipa ahong kisa dia, panmun abawl dia, khopi kulh neite ala ding; simlam sepaihte leh amitelte'n leng anang kei ding ua, nanna ding in hatna leng a-om kei ding hi.
english: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city: and the forces of the south shall not stand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to stand.

paite: Himahleh amah dou dia hong paipa'n ama deihlam bang in ahih ding a, ama ah kuamah adingh kei ding; gam thupi ah adingh dia, akhut ah siatna a-om ding hi.
english: But he who comes against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him; and he shall stand in the glorious land, and in his hand shall be destruction.

paite: Agam pumpi thahatna toh hong pai atum tinten ding a, simlam kumpigam toh kizopna bawl ding in atanu akiang ah ape ding hi; himahleh athil sawm alohsam ding a, aphattuampih sam kei ding.
english: He shall set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions; and he shall perform them: and he shall give him the daughter of women, to corrupt her; but she shall not stand, neither be for him.

paite: "Hiai khit in tuikulh lam anga dia, gam tampite azou ding hi; himahleh gamdangmi sepaih heutu khat in amah azou dia, ami simmohna atawpsak ding; ahi, ami simmohna amah tung ah akibungsak ding hi.
english: After this shall he turn his face to the islands, and shall take many: but a prince shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; yes, moreover, he shall cause his reproach to turn on him.

paite: Huai hun chiang in ama gam kulhpi lam ah akik nawn dia; himahleh kisuipai in apuk dia, muh in a-om nawnta kei ding hi.
english: Then he shall turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he shall stumble and fall, and shall not be found.

paite: Huai hun chiang in ama mun ah mi khat ahong dingkhe dia, ama'n agamsung puahna ding in leiman khonpa gam thupi tan apalsuaksak dia; himahleh ni tam lou zoh in hehna leh kidouna hilou in hihsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: Then shall stand up in his place one who shall cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory; but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

paite: "Huan amun ah mizahpihhuai khat ahong dingkhe ding a, huai lalgam in zahtakna apiaklouhna pa uh; himahleh mite bit akisak lai un ahong pai dia, maitang phatna in gam ala ding hi.
english: In his place shall stand up a contemptible person, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom: but he shall come in time of security, and shall obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

paite: Huan sepaihhonte ama ah taihmang in a-om ding uh, thukhun heutupa tanpha tel in.
english: The overwhelming forces shall be overwhelmed from before him, and shall be broken; yes, also the prince of the covenant.

paite: Huchi in amah toh pankhawmna kibawl nung in lepchiahtak in thil ahih ding a; ahong kuantou dia, nam neuchik toh hong hat ding ahi.
english: After the treaty made with him he shall work deceitfully; for he shall come up, and shall become strong, with a small people.

paite: Gam khen a hausa mahmah namte abit lai pen un dou ding in akuantou dia, apipute'n ahihzoh louh uh ahon hihzou ding a, apipute'n leng ahih ngei louh uh alak uah samat leh gallakte leh vante ahawmzak dia, ahi, kulh nei khopite dou ding in aguksawm ding hi, himahleh hun khat kia adaih ding hi.
english: In time of security shall he come even on the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them prey, and spoil, and substance: yes, he shall devise his devices against the strongholds, even for a time.

paite: "Huan sepaih thupi toh simlam kumpipa dou ding in athilhihtheihna leh ahatna atokthou ding a; huchi in simlam kumpipa'n sepaih athupi a thupi leh hat in kidouna ah adouthuk ding hi. Himahleh ama siatna ding a aguk a thusawm ahih ziak in adingh zou kei ding hi.
english: He shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall war in battle with an exceeding great and mighty army; but he shall not stand; for they shall devise devices against him.

paite: Ahi, a-an nete'n amah ahihmang ding ua, asepaihte phiatmang in a-om ding uhi; huchi in tampi thah in apuk ding uhi.
english: Yes, they who eat of his dainties shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow; and many shall fall down slain.

paite: Kumpipa nihte ahih uleh gilou lungtang pu kawm in dohkan khat ah atukhawm ding ua, zuau in akikhemtuah ding uh. Himahleh hun tawp atung ding a sehsa ahih ziak in alohching kei ding uhi.
english: As for both these kings, their hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table: but it shall not prosper; for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.

paite: Huai hun chiang in simlam kumpipa tuh gallak thupi toh agam lam ah akik nawn dia; huchi in alungtang in thukhun siangthou adou ding; a-utut ahih ding a ama gam ngei ah akik nawn ding hi.
english: Then shall he return into his land with great substance; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do his pleasure, and return to his own land.

paite: "Hun sehsa ah akik nawn dia, simlam ah ahong pai dia; himahleh hun masa hiam hun nanung bang ahi kei ding hi.
english: At the time appointed he shall return, and come into the south; but it shall not be in the latter time as it was in the former.

paite: Amah dou dia Kittim longte hong pai ding ahih ziak in; huaiziak in adah ding a, akik nawn dia; thukhun siangthou dou in ahehna asungbo ding a a-utut ahih ding a; ahong kik nawn ngeingei dia, thukhun siangthou nungngatsante deihsakna alak ding hi.
english: For ships of Kittim shall come against him; therefore he shall be grieved, and shall return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and shall do his pleasure: he shall even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.

paite: Amah lam ah sepaihte apang ding ua, mun siangthou kulhpi mahmah abuahsak ding ua; halmang thillat gige ahihbei ding ua ahihgawp ding in kihhuai atungkhe ding uhi.
english: Forces shall stand on his part, and they shall profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and shall take away the continual burnt offering , and they shall set up the abomination that makes desolate.

paite: Huan thukhun nungngatsante maitang phatna in giloutak in, ama'n ahekkawi dia; himahleh mi a Pathian uh theite bel ahat ding ua, thilhih minthangpente ahih ding uhi.
english: Such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he pervert by flatteries; but the people who know their God shall be strong, and do exploits .

paite: Huchi in mite lak a theihsiamna neite, ni tampi sung, namsau leh meikuang, saltanna leh siatna ah puk mah le uh, mi tampi athuhilh ding uhi.
english: Those who are wise among the people shall instruct many; yet they shall fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by spoil, many days.

paite: Huan apuk chiang un, panpihna tawmchik angah ding ua, himahleh maitang phatnate toh mi tampi in amau apawlbawl ding uhi.
english: Now when they shall fall, they shall be helped with a little help; but many shall join themselves to them with flatteries.

paite: Alak ua theihsiamna neite lak a mi khenkhatte, amaute bawlhoih ding leh siangthousak ding leh amaute ngousak ding in, apuk ding uhi. Hun tawp tanpha; hun sehsa a ding ahih lai ziak in.
english: Some of those who are wise shall fall, to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end; because it is yet for the time appointed.

paite: "Huan kumpipa'n adeihlam bang in ahih dia; akiliansak ding a, pathian chiteng tung ah akikoih lian dia, pathiante' Pathian dem in thillamdangte agen ding hi; thangpaihna apichin matan alohching ding; atup tintensa ahih ding hi.
english: The king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvelous things against the God of gods; and he shall prosper until the indignation be accomplished; for that which is determined shall be done.

paite: Apipute pathiante leh numeite lunggulh leng azahtak kei dia, pathian leng azahtak kei ding; mi tengteng tung ah akiliansak ding hi.
english: Neither shall he regard the gods of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god; for he shall magnify himself above all.

paite: Himahleh ama'n kulhpite pathian apahtawi dia; api-le-pute theih ngei louh dangka-eng leh dangka leh suangmantamte leh thilthawnpiak manphate in amah abe ding hi.
english: But in his place shall he honor the god of fortresses; and a god whom his fathers didn’t know shall he honor with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

paite: Huan gamdang pathiante panpihna in kulh muanhuaipen pente asual ding a; kuapeuh amah hihna pomte kiang ah zahna lianzaw ape ding a, tampi tung a vaihawm ding in abawl dia, man nei in gam ahawm ding hi.
english: He shall deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god: whoever acknowledges him he will increase with glory; and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for a price.

paite: "Huan hun tawp chiang in simlam kumpipa'n amah akidoupih ding; mallam kumpipa amah dou ding in pingpei bang in, kangtalaite toh, sakol tungtuang mite toh, long tampi toh ahong kuan ding; huchi in gamte ah alut dia, adimlet dia apaisuak ding hi.
english: At the time of the end shall the king of the south contend with him; and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass through.

paite: Ama'n gam siangthoupen leng asim ding a, huchi in gam tampi zoh in a-om ding hi; himahleh Edom leh Moab leh Ammon tate hausapate akhut a kipan suahtaksak in a-om ding hi.
english: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown; but these shall be delivered out of his hand: Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

paite: Gam tampite tung ah akhut azan ding a; Aigupta gam asuakta kei ding hi.
english: He shall stretch forth his hand also on the countries; and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

paite: Himahleh dangka-eng leh dangka goute tung leh Aigupta thil manphate tengteng tung ah thilhihtheihna anei dia; huan Libia mite leh Ethiopia mite akalsuanna ah a-om ding uhi.
english: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt; and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.

paite: "Himahleh suahlam a kipan leh mallam a kipan a thuthang in amah ahihlau dia; thangpaihna thupi a mi tampi hihse ding leh hihmang ding in akuankhe ding hi.
english: But news out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him; and he shall go forth with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.

paite: Huan tuipi leh tang siangthou thupi kikal ah a-inpi puaninte akai ding a, himahleh amah abeina hong tung dia, kuamah in amah apanpih kei ding uh."
english: He shall plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Mikael, heutu thupi na mite tapate vengbittu ahong dingkhe ding hi. Leitung pianchil a kipan tu hun tanpha a om ngei nai lou, mangbat hun ahong tung ding hi, huai hun chiang in laibu sung a gelh a om a, muhkhiak a om na mite hutkhiak in a-om ding uh.
english: “At that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, everyone who shall be found written in the book.

paite: Huan alak ua mi tampi leitung a leivui a ihmute akhanglou ding ua, akhen tangtawn hinna tang ding in, akhen zumna leh tangtawn simmohna tang ding in.
english: Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

paite: Apilte vansin vakna bang in avak ding ua; mi tampi diktatna lam a heite tangtawn tangtawn in aksite bang in atang ding uhi.
english: Those who are wise shall shine as the brightness of the expanse; and those who turn many to righteousness as the stars forever and ever.

paite: Himahleh nang, Aw Daniel, hun tawp tan a ding in thute khakkhum bikbek inla, laibu bilh in; mi tampi avialtai ding ua, theihna apung ding.
english: But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run back and forth, and knowledge shall be increased.”

paite: Huai lai in kei, Daniel in ka en a, ngai in, midang nih, lui gei hiai lam pang ah khat, lui gei lang lam pang ah khat adingh uhi.
english: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.

paite: Huan khat in puanmalngat asilh a, luituite tung a ompa kiang ah, "Hiai thillamdangte tawpna ding bangchi a sawt hi ding ahia?" achi hi.
english: One said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?

paite: "Puanmalngat silh a, luituite tung a ompa'n van lam a akhut taklam leh akhut veilam liktou in, amah tangtawn a hingpa min a kichiam in hun khat, hunte leh hun kimkhat ahi ding achih ka zata hi; misiangthoute thilhihtheihna asuknen dimdem khit chiang un, hiai thil tengteng zoh ahi ding," chi in.
english: I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him who lives forever that it shall be for a time, times, and a half; and when they have made an end of breaking in pieces the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

paite: Huai ka za a, himahleh ka theisiam kei. Ke'n, "Aw ka Toupa, hiai thilte tawpna bang hi ding ahia?" ka chi hi.
english: I heard, but I didn’t understand: then I said, my lord, what shall be the issue of these things?

paite: Ama'n, "Pai in, Daniel; thute khakkhum bikbek ahita ua, hun tawp matan a bilh bikbek ahita hi,” achi hi.
english: He said, Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.

paite: Mi tampi akihihsiangthou ding ua, angou ding ua, akibawlhoih ding uh; himahleh giloute agilou sem ding ua; giloute lak a kuamah in atheisiam kei ding uh; himahleh apilte'n atheisiam ding uh.
english: Many shall purify themselves, and make themselves white, and be refined; but the wicked shall do wickedly; and none of the wicked shall understand; but those who are wise shall understand.

paite: Huchi in halmang thillat gige lakmang a om a, hihgawptu kihhuai tunkhiak a hong om ding hun a kipan, ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmkua a-om ding hi.
english: From the time that the continual burnt offering shall be taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there shall be one thousand two hundred ninety days.

paite: Ni sangkhat zathum sawmthum-le-nga ngak a, huai a hong paite'n nuam asa uhi.
english: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.

paite: Himahleh atawp matan nang zaw pai in; na khawl ding a, nang a dia piakna mun ah nite beina ah na goutan sang ding in na thoukhe ding hi.
english: But go you your way until the end; for you shall rest, and shall stand in your lot, at the end of the days.

paite: Nebukadnezzar vaihawm akum nih kum in Nebukadnezzar in mang anei a; alungsim abuai mahmah a, a-ihmutheita kei hi.
english: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

paite: Kumpipa'n mitkhialdawi tawite leh bum mite leh aisan mite leh Kaldai mite, kumpipa mang hilh ding a sap ding thu apia hi. Huchi in ahong lut ua kumpipa ma ah ahong dinghta uhi.
english: Then the king commanded to call the magicians, and the enchanters, and the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Mang ka nei a, huai mang thei ding in ka lungsim abuai mahmah hi,” achi hi.
english: The king said to them, I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.

paite: Kaldai mite'n kumpipa kiang ah Siria pau in, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in dam in; na sikhate na mang hilh in, ahilhchetna ka ensak ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Then spoke the Chaldeans to the king in the Syrian language, O king, live forever: tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Kaldai mite kiang ah, hiai thil kei a kipan apaikheta; mang leh ahilhchetna ka kiang a na hon theihsak kei ualeh atnen in na om ding ua, na innte uh ekvum asuak ding.
english: The king answered the Chaldeans, The thing is gone from me: if you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made a dunghill.

paite: Himahleh mang leh ahilhchetna na hon theihsak ualeh kei a kipan in thilpiakte leh kipahman leh nakpitak a zahtakna na mu ding uh; huaiziak in mang leh ahilhchetna hon ensak un,” achi hi.
english: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honor: therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.

paite: Anihveina ding in amau adawng ua, "Kumpipa'n mang hon hilh henla, kou ahilhchetna ka ensak ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They answered the second time and said, Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Kei a kipan hiai thil apaikheta chih na muh ziak un, hun hihsau tum na hi uh chih ka theitel hi.
english: The king answered, I know of a certainty that you would gain time, because you see the thing is gone from me.

paite: Himahleh mang ka kiang a na hon theihsak kei uleh, nou a ding in dan khat kia a-om; hun akikhen tan a, ka ma a thuzuau leh sia gelkhol na hih ziak un; huaiziak in mang hon hilh unla, ahilhchetna na hon ensak thei uh chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
english: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the time be changed: therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that you can show me its interpretation.

paite: Kaldai mite'n kumpipa adawng ua, "Kumpipa thudot ensak thei leitung ah kuamah a-om kei; kumpipa hiam, toupa hiam, vaihawmmi kuamah in mitkhialdawi tawi kuamah hiam, bummi kuamah hiam, Kaldai mi kuamah mah huchibang thu adot ngei louh ziak un.
english: The Chaldeans answered before the king, and said, There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler, has asked such a thing of any magician, or enchanter, or Chaldean.

paite: Kumpipa thil deih vangtak ahi, mihingte lak a sa a om lou pathiante chih louh ngal, midang kuamah in kumpipa ma ah huai a-ensak thei kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king, except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.

paite: Hiai ziak in kumpipa aheh mahmah a, athangpai tuntun a, Babulon mipil tengteng hihmang ding in thu apeta hi.
english: For this cause the king was angry and very furious, and commanded to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.

paite: Huchi in thupiak piakkhiak ahita a, mipilte thah ding ahong hita ua; Daniel leh alawmte thah ding in azong uhi.
english: So the decree went forth, and the wise men were to be slain; and they sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.

paite: Huchi in Daniel in kumpipa veng sepaih zaheutu Ariok, Babulon mipilte that ding a kuankhe pa kiang ah thuhilhna leh thupil toh dawnna akiksak hi.
english: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who was gone forth to kill the wise men of Babylon;

paite: Ariok kumpipa sepaih zaheutu adong a akiang ah, "Bangziak a kumpipa a kipan thupiak huchi tel a kin ahia?" achi hi. Huchi in Ariok in Daniel kiang ah athil omdan atheisak hi.
english: he answered Arioch the king’s captain, Why is the decree so urgent from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

paite: Daniel alut a, amah a dia hun sehsak ding in kumpipa angen hi, huchi a ahilhchetna kumpipa a-etsak theihna ding in.
english: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

paite: Huchi in Daniel a-inn ah apai a, Hananiah, Mishael, Azariah, alawmte kiang ah huai thil atheisakta hi.
english: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

paite: Huchi a amaute'n hiai thuguk tanchin a van Pathian zahngaihnate angettheihna ding un; huchi a Daniel leh alawmte Babulon a mipilte alakte toh amanthatlouhna ding un.
english: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his companions should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

paite: Huchi in zan mengmuhna ah Daniel kiang ah thuguk taklat in a-omta hi. Daniel in van Pathian aphat hi.
english: Then was the secret revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

paite: Daniel in adawng a: Tangtawn tangtawn in Pathian min phat in om hen; pilna leh hatna amah a ahi.
english: Daniel answered, Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

paite: Ama'n hunte leh hunbite ahih lamdang a; kumpipate asuankhia a, kumpipate atungkhia a; mipilte kiang ah pilna apia a, theihsiamna theite kiang ah theihna apia hi.
english: He changes the times and the seasons; he removes kings, and sets up kings; he gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding;

paite: Thil thukte leh thil gukte ataklang a, mial a om bang ahia chih athei a, akiang ah khovak a-om hi.
english: he reveals the deep and secret things; he knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

paite: Na tung ah ka kipak a, ka hon phat hi, Aw nang ka pipute Pathian, pilna leh hatna hon pepa, nang ka hon nget uh ka kiang ua hon theisakpa'n; kumpipa thu ka kiang uah na hon theisakta ngal a, chi in.
english: I thank you, and praise you, you God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king’s matter.

paite: Huaiziak in kumpipa'n Babulon mipilte hihse dia asehpa Ariok kiang ah Daniel ava hoh a, akiang ah, "Babilon mipilte hihmang ke'n; kumpipa ma ah hon pilut inla, kumpipa kiang ah ahilhchetna ka ensak ding," ava chi hi.
english: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon; he went and said thus to him: Don’t destroy the wise men of Babylon; bring me in before the king, and I will show to the king the interpretation.

paite: Huchi in Ariok in kintak in kumpipa ma ah Daniel apilut a, akiang ah, "Judah saltangte lak ah mi khat ka mu a, ama'n kumpipa kiang ah ahilhchetna atheisak ding," achi hi.
english: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said thus to him, I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah, who will make known to the king the interpretation.

paite: Kumpipa, amin Belteshazzar in adawng a Daniel kiang ah, "Mang ka neih na hon theisak thei in, ahilhchetna na hon theisak thei ding maw?" achi hi.
english: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?

paite: Daniel in kumpipa ma ah adawng a, "Thuguk kumpipa'n anget mipilte hi in, mitkhialdawi tawite hi in, bum mite hin in, aisan mite hitaleh, kumpipa kiang ah a-ensak thei kei ding uhi.
english: Daniel answered before the king, and said, The secret which the king has demanded can neither wise men, enchanters, magicians, nor soothsayers, show to the king;

paite: Himahleh van ah Pathian a-om a, ama'n thugukte ataklang hi; ni nanung lam a bang om ding ahia chih, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah atheisak hi. Na lupna tung a na lutang mengmuhna leh na mang hiaite ahi.
english: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days. Your dream, and the visions of your head on your bed, are these:

paite: "Nang na hihleh aw kumpipa na lupna tung ah na lungsim sung ah na ngaihtuahnate ahong om ua; tunung chiang a bang ahia hong om ding thu; huan amah thugukte na kiang a taklangpa'n bang ahia hong om ding na kiang ah atheisakta hi.
english: as for you, O king, your thoughts came into your mind on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what shall happen.

paite: Himahleh kei bel pilna mihing dangte sang a pilna ka neih tam zawk ziak a hiai thuguk ka kiang a taklat ahi kei a; himahleh ahilhchetna kumpipa kiang a theihsak ahihtheihna ding leh nang na lungtang ngaihtuahte na theihna ding ahi zaw hi.
english: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.

paite: "Aw kumpipa, ngai in, nang milim thupitak na muta hi. Hiai milim hattak mai, avakna thupi mahmah, na ma ah adingh a; amel a kihtakhuai mahmah hi.
english: You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its aspect was awesome.

paite: Hiai milim ahihleh alutang dangka-eng hoih ahi a, a-awm leh abante dangka, agil leh apheipite dal,
english: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its breast and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of brass,

paite: akhete sik, akhezungte sik leh tungman khenkhat kihel ahi.
english: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron, and part of clay.

paite: Suang khut a sek louh huai milim a khepek sik leh tungman deng a kitam nensak dimdem tan in na mu hi.
english: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.

paite: "Huchi in sik, tungman, dal, dangkate leh dangka-eng toh akitam nenkhawm vek ua, nipi buhphual a buhsi bang mai ahong hi ua; huchi in huih in huaite amutmang a, huai milim dengzan suangpi pen tang thupitak ahong suak a, leitung pumpi adimta hi.
english: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors; and the wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them: and the stone that struck the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

paite: Hiai mang ahi a; kumpipa ma ah ahilhchetna ka gen ding uhi.
english: This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.

paite: "Aw kumpipa, nang kumpipate' Kumpipa, van Pathian in akiang a gam leh thilhihtheihna, hatna leh thupinate a piakna na hi.
english: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, and the strength, and the glory;

paite: Koipeuh a mite tate atenna uah, gam a sate leh van a vasate na khut ah ahon pia hi; amau tengteng tung a vaihawm ding a abawl dangka-eng lutang na hi.
english: and wherever the children of men dwell, the animals of the field and the birds of the sky has he given into your hand, and has made you to rule over them all: you are the head of gold.

paite: Nang nung in nang sang a niamzaw gamdang khat ahong dingkhe ding; huchi in lalgam thumna dang, leitung tengteng a thunei ding in.
english: After you shall arise another kingdom inferior to you; and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

paite: Huan gam lina sik bang in ahat ding a, sik in akeknensak a thil tengteng anuaisiah bang in sik in hiaite tengteng adelhzan bang in, akeknensak in, adelhzan ding hi.
english: The fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, shall it break in pieces and crush.

paite: "Huan khepek leh khezung na muhte, akhen belvelmi tungman leh akhen sik ahihleh gam hawmzak ahi ding a; himahleh asung ah sik hatna a-om ding a, sik tungman toh helkhawm na muh bangtak in.
english: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, it shall be a divided kingdom; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

paite: Huan khepek khezungte, akhen sik leh akhen tungman pen ahihleh, huchibang in gam hatna chiang nei, kitapna chiang nei ahi ding hi.
english: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.

paite: Huan sik leh tungman kihel na muh pen ahihleh, mite chi toh amau akitok hel ding uh; himahleh sik leh tungman akigawm theih louh bang in akikawikip kei ding uhi.
english: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they shall not cling to one another, even as iron does not mingle with clay.

paite: "Huai kumpipate dam lai in van Pathian in gam suksiat a om ngei lou ding, athuneihna midang kiang a nutsiat a om ngei sam lou ding, ahon dingkhesak ding a; himahleh hiai gam tengteng akitam nensak ding a, ahihse vek ding, amah bel tangtawn in adingh ding hi.
english: In the days of those kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed, nor shall its sovereignty be left to another people; but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand forever.

paite: "Huchi in tang a kipan khut a sek louh suangpi ahong omkhia a, sik, dal, tungman, dangka leh dangka-engte a kitamsak dimdem na muh pen ahihleh; tunung chiang a bang ahia hong om ding kumpipa kiang ah Pathian thupi in atheisakta hi; mang omzia theihsa ahi a, akhiakna akichian hi,” achi hi.
english: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the brass, the clay, the silver, and the gold; the great God has made known to the king what shall happen hereafter: and the dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.

paite: Huaitak in Nebukadnezzar in amai a lei si in Daniel abia a, thillat leh gimnamtui akiang a lan ding in amaute thu apia hi.
english: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, and worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.

paite: Kumpipa'n Daniel adawng a, "Chihtaktak in na Pathian, pathiante' Pathian leh kumpipate' TOUPA leh thugukte taklangpa ahi; hiai thuguk taklang ding a hihtheihna na neih ziak in," achi hi.
english: The king answered to Daniel, and said, Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Daniel aliansak a, thilpiak tampi apia hi, Babulon bial pumpi a heutu leh Babulon mipilte tengteng tung a ukpipapen ding in abawlta hi.
english: Then the king made Daniel great, and gave him many great gifts, and made him to rule over the whole province of Babylon, and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.

paite: Daniel in Shadrak, Meshak, Abednego, Babulon bial thu leh la tung a koih ding in kumpipa kiang ah angen hi; himahleh Daniel bel kumpipa kongpi ah a-om hi.
english: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, over the affairs of the province of Babylon: but Daniel was in the gate of the king.

paite: kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in dangka-eng milim, tong sawmguk a sang, tong guk a lian abawl a; Babulon bial a Dura Phaizang ah adingsak hi.
english: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits, and its breadth six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.

paite: kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in bial heutute, vaihawm mite, ukpipate, thukhenmi, sumkemmi, thudotmi, dansiammi leh bial vaihawmmi tengteng akaikhawm a, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in adinkhiak milim kipahpihna bawlna a hong pai ding in mite asawlkhia hi.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the satraps, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

paite: Huchi in bial heutu vaihawmmi, ukpipa, thukhenmi, sumkemmi, thudotmi, dansiammi leh bial vaihawmmi tengteng kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in adinkhiaksak milim kipahpihna ah ahong kikhawm vek uhi; Nebukadnezzar dinkhiaksak milim ma ah adingh uhi.
english: Then the satraps, the deputies, and the governors, the judges, the treasurers, the counselors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together to the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

paite: Huaitak in tangkou ngaihtak in akikou a, "Na kiang ua thupiak ahi, Aw mite, namte, paute,
english: Then the herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, peoples, nations, and languages,

paite: pengkul, tamngai, kaihging, gosem, nawtging, tumging peng nih nei leh tumging chi chih ging na zak chiang un, puk unla, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in adinkhiaksak dangka-eng milim bia un.
english: that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up;

paite: Huan kuapeuh puk lou a beloute meipi kuang zuazua sung ah huai hun mah a paihlut ding ahi," achi hi.
english: and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

paite: Huaiziak in huai lai a mi tengteng in pengkul, tamngai, kaihging, gosem, nawtging leh tumging chi chih ging azak un, mi tengteng, namte, paute apuk ua, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in atunkhiak dangka-eng milim abia uhi.
english: Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.

paite: Huchih lai in Kaldai mi kuate hiam ahong pai nai ua, Juda tuailaite ahong hekta uhi.
english: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and brought accusation against the Jews.

paite: Adawng ua kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in dam in!
english: They answered Nebuchadnezzar the king, O king, live for ever.

paite: Aw kumpipa, nang thupiak na bawl a, mi chiteng in pengkul, tamngai, kaihging, gosem leh nawtging, tumging peng nih neite leh tumging chi chih azak chiang ua, apuk ding ua dangka-eng milim abiak ding uh chi in.
english: You, O king, have made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, shall fall down and worship the golden image;

paite: Kuapeuh puk lou a beloute meipi kuang zuazua ah paihlut ahi ding, chi in.
english: and whoever doesn’t fall down and worship shall be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.

paite: Babulon bial a thu leh la tung a na sehsa Juda kuate hiam a-om ua, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego. Hiai mite'n, Aw kumpipa, nang ahon limsak kei ua; na pathiante nna asem kei ua na dinkhiaksak dangka-eng milim leng abe sam kei uh," chi in.
english: There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego; these men, O king, have not respected you. They don’t serve your gods, nor worship the golden image which you have set up.

paite: Huchi in Nebukadnezzar heh leh thangpai in Shadrak, Meshak, Abednego hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. Then they brought these men before the king.

paite: Huchi in hiai mite kumpipa ma ah ahon pi ua, Nebukadnezzar in adong a, akiang uah, "Aw Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, ka pathian nna na sep louh ua, dangka-eng milim ka tunkhiak na biak louh uh, na tup mawng uh hia?" achi hi.
english: Nebuchadnezzar answered them, Is it on purpose, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you don’t serve my god, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?

paite: Tu in na kimansak unla chik hun peuh a pengkul, tamngai, kaihging, gosem, nawtging leh tumging peng nih nei leh tumging chi chih ging na zak chiang un puk unla milim ka tunkhiak bia un, hoihtak in; himahleh na biak kei ualeh meipi kuang zuazua sung ah huai hun mah in ahon paihlut ding uh; huchi in ka khut a kipan a nou hon hunkhe ding huai pathian kua hi ding ahia?
english: Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music to fall down and worship the image which I have made, well: but if you don’t worship, you shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that god that shall deliver you out of my hands?

paite: Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego in adawng ua kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw Nebukadnezzar, hiai thu ah ka hon dawn uh akiphamoh kei hi.
english: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
