paite: Huchibang ding ahihleh, Aw kumpipa, a-nna ka sep uh ka Pathian un meipi kuang zuazua a kipan koute ahon hunkhe thei hi, na khut a pan ahon hunkhe ding hi.
english: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace; and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.

paite: Huchi ahihkeileh leng, na thei in, Aw kumpipa, na pathiante nna ka sem kei ding ua, na dinkhiak dangka-eng milim leng ka be sam kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods, nor worship the golden image which you have set up.

paite: Huchi in Nebukadnezzar athangpai petmah a, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego tung ah amel putdan akikheng hial hi. Huaiziak in meipi asat ngeina sang a mun sagih a asatsak ding in thu apia hi.
english: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego: therefore he spoke, and commanded that they should heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.

paite: Huan asepaih pawl lak a om mihat kuate hiam Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego hen ding leh meipi kuang zuazua sung a paihlut ding in thu apia hi.
english: He commanded certain mighty men who were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.

paite: Huchi in hiai mite apuansilh lai uh, samul puanak toh, puanak kawnggak nei leh apuansilh dangte uh toh, meikuang zuazua lak ah apailutta uhi.
english: Then these men were bound in their pants, their tunics, and their mantles, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa thupiak akhawk mahmah ziak leh meipi asat mahmah ziak in huai mi Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego domte meikuang in ahul lumta hi.
english: Therefore because the king’s commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.

paite: Hiai mi thumte, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednegote, meipi kuang zuazua lak ah hensa in apuk uhi.
english: These three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.

paite: Huchih lai in Nebukadnezzar in lamdang asa mahmah a; kintak in athoukhia a; amah thudot mite kiang ah, "Mei lak ah mi thum hensa in i pailut uh ahi kei maw?" chi in agen hi. Amau adawng ua kumpipa kiang ah, "Dik mah e, kumpipa aw," achi uhi.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonished, and rose up in haste: he spoke and said to his counselors, Didn’t we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered the king, True, O king.

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "Ngai un, mi li phelsa a om, mei lak a vak in ka mu a, bangmah achi kei uh, ami lina melputdan Pathian tapa abang," achi hi.
english: He answered, Look, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they are unharmed; and the aspect of the fourth is like a son of the gods.

paite: Huchi in Nebukadnezzar meipi kuang zuazua gei chin ah ahong pai a; thu agen a, "Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, nou Pathian Tungnungpen sikhate, hong pawtkhia unla, hiai lam ah hong pai un," achi hi. Huchi in Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, mei lak a kipan in ahong pawtkhia uhi.
english: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace: he spoke and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, you servants of the Most High God, come forth, and come here. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego came forth out of the midst of the fire.

paite: Huan bial heutute, vaihawm mite, ukpipate leh kumpipa dan thei mite, omkhawmte'n hiai mite, mei in apumpi tung uah hihtheihna anei kei a, aluzang ua sam leng akangdang kei a, apuansilh uh leng alamdang kei a, meigim leng anam kei uh chih amu uhi.
english: The satraps, the deputies, and the governors, and the king’s counselors, being gathered together, saw these men, that the fire had no power on their bodies, nor was the hair of their head singed, neither were their pants changed, nor had the smell of fire passed on them.

paite: Nebukadnezzar in thu agen a, "Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego Pathian in a-angel sawl a, amah muang asikhate hunkhia a, kumpipa thu hihlamdang a, amau Pathian lou ngal pathian nna asep louh ua abiaklouhna ding ua apumpite uh pepa phat in om hen.
english: Nebuchadnezzar spoke and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent his angel, and delivered his servants who trusted in him, and have changed the king’s word, and have yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.

paite: "Huaiziak in thupiak ka bawl hi, michih, nam chih, pau chih, Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego Pathian gensiatna thil banghiam gente, atnen in a-om dia, a-innte uh ekvum a bawl ahi ding hi; hichibang a hunkhe thei pathian dang a-om louh ziak in," achi hi.
english: Therefore I make a decree, that every people, nation, and language, which speak anything evil against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill; because there is no other god who is able to deliver after this sort.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Shadrak, Meshak leh Abednego, Babulon bial ah akaisangsak hi.
english: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the province of Babylon.

paite: Kumpipa, Nebukadnezzar mite tengteng, namte leh paute, leitung pumpi a tengte kiang ah, na kiang uah lemna hihpun in om hen.
english: Nebuchadnezzar the king, to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.

paite: Tungnungpen Pathian in kei lam a abawl chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte etsak, kei a ding in hoih hi in ka ngaihtuah hi.
english: It has seemed good to me to show the signs and wonders that the Most High God has worked toward me.

paite: Achiamtehnate thupi hi na mahmah e; athillamdangte thilhihthei hi na mahmah uh e; agam tangtawn gam ahi a, avaihawmna akhang-akhang in a-om hi.
english: How great are his signs! and how mighty are his wonders! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion is from generation to generation.

paite: Kei Nebukadnezzar, ka insung ah ka khawl a, ka inpi sung ah ka lum hi.
english: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace.

paite: Hon lausak mang ka nei hi; ka lupna tung ah ngaihtuahnate leh ka lungtang mengmuhte'n hon hihbuai uhi.
english: I saw a dream which made me afraid; and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.

paite: Huaiziak in hilhchetna ka kiang a akitheihsak ding un, Babulon mipil tengteng ka ma a pi ding thupiak ka bawlta hi.
english: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.

paite: Huchi in mitkhialdawi tawite, bum mite, Kaldai mite leh aisan mite ahong pai ua; ama uah ka mang ka genta hi; himahleh ahilhchetna ka kiang ah ahon theisak thei kei uhi.
english: Then came in the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers; and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known to me its interpretation.

paite: Himahleh atawptawp in ka ma ah, Daniel amin ka pathian min dungzui a Belteshazzar hiven, amah a Pathian siangthoute kha a-omna ma ah mang ka genta hi.
english: But at the last Daniel came in before me, whose name was Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods: and I told the dream before him, saying,

paite: Aw Belteshazzar, mitkhialdawi tawite heutupa, nang ah, Pathian siangthoute kha a-om a, thuguk bangmah in nang ahon hihbuai kei chih ka theih ziak in ka mang a ka muh mengmuhte leh ahilhchetna hon hilh in, ka chi hi.
english: Belteshazzar, master of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no secret troubles you, tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation.

paite: Ka lupna tung a ka lutang mengmuhte hichibang ahiz: Ngai in, lei laizang ah sing khat ka mu a, huai sing sandan athupi mahmah hi.
english: Thus were the visions of my head on my bed: I saw, and behold, a tree in the midst of the earth; and its height was great.

paite: Huai sing akhangtou a, ahong hat a, asanna in van asuntou a, lei mong tengteng tanpha huai ah akimu hi.
english: The tree grew, and was strong, and its height reached to the sky, and its sight to the end of all the earth.

paite: Anahte ahoih un, agah pha mahmah a; huai ah mi tengteng a ding in an a-om hi; anuailim ah gamsate a-om ua, ahiangte ah van a vasate ateng ua, sa tengteng huai a kipan in akivak uhi.
english: The leaves of it were beautiful, and its fruit much, and in it was food for all: the animals of the field had shadow under it, and the birds of the sky lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.

paite: Ka lupna tung a ka lup in mengmuhte ka mu a, ngai in, van a kipan in vengmi siangthou khat ahong paisuk hi.
english: I saw in the visions of my head on my bed, and behold, a watcher and a holy one came down from the sky.

paite: Ngaihtak in akikou a, hichibang in achi a: "Sing phuk inla, ahiangte satkhia in, anahte singkhia inla, agah thehzak in; anuai a kipan gamsate leh ahiang a kipan vasate hawlmang in om uhen.
english: He cried aloud, and said thus, Cut down the tree, and cut off its branches, shake off its leaves, and scatter its fruit: let the animals get away from under it, and the fowls from its branches.

paite: Himahleh abulsum leh azungte zaw hawi in, sik leh dal gui a henkhawm in, gam a loupa nou lak ah nutsiat in om hen. Van daitui in kawt henla, atantuan lei a loupa lak a gamsate toh hi hen.
english: Nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field; and let it be wet with the dew of the sky: and let his portion be with the animals in the grass of the earth:

paite: Huan atung a hun sagih abei mateng mihing lungsim kikheng in akiang ah gamsa lungtang piak hi hen.
english: let his heart be changed from man’s, and let an animal’s heart be given to him; and let seven times pass over him.

paite: Tungnungpen in mite gam ah vai ahawm a, a-utna peuh kiang ah apia a, miniampente adingkhesak chih mihingte'n atheihna ding un veng mite'n agenkhia ua, misiangthoute'n apuangkhia uhi.
english: The sentence is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones; to the intent that the living may know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will, and sets up over it the lowest of men.

paite: "Hiai mang kei kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in ka man hi. Huan nang, Aw Belteshazzar, ahilhchetna genkhia in, ka gam a mipilte tengteng in ka kiang ah ahilhchetna ahon theisak thei kei ua; himahleh nang na hihthei, nang a pathian siangthoute kha a-om ziak in,” achi hi.
english: This dream I, king Nebuchadnezzar, have seen; and you, Belteshazzar, declare the interpretation, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able; for the spirit of the holy gods is in you.

paite: Daniel, amin Belteshazzar in, sawt lou kal lamdang asa a, angaihtuahnate'n amah apatausak hi. Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Belteshazzar, mang hiam ahilhchetna hiam in nang hon patausak kei hen," achi hi. Belteshazzar in adawng a, "Ka toupa, mang nang hon mudahte lam thu hi henla, ahilhchetna na galte lam thu hi zawleh maw.
english: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was stricken mute for a while, and his thoughts troubled him. The king answered, Belteshazzar, don’t let the dream, or the interpretation, trouble you. Belteshazzar answered, My lord, the dream be to those who hate you, and its interpretation to your adversaries.

paite: Na sing muh, hong khang a, hong hat a, asanna in van asuttouh a, hiai a kipan lei mong tengteng akimuhna;
english: The tree that you saw, which grew, and was strong, whose height reached to the sky, and its sight to all the earth;

paite: anahte hoih a, agah pha mahmah a, mi teng a dia an om a; huai nuai a gamsate teng ua, ahiang a van a vasate atenna uh,
english: whose leaves were beautiful, and its fruit much, and in it was food for all; under which the animals of the field lived, and on whose branches the birds of the sky had their habitation:

paite: Aw kumpipa, huai hong khang a, hong hat na muh, nangmah na hi; na thupina akhang in, van asun in, na vaihawmna lei mong tawp pha in ahi.
english: it is you, O king, that are grown and become strong; for your greatness is grown, and reaches to the sky, and your dominion to the end of the earth.

paite: Van a kipan a kumpipa'n vengmi siangthou hong paisuk amuh, Sing phuk inla, hihgawp in; himahleh abulsum leh azungte zaw hawi in, sik leh dal gui a henkhawm in gam a loupa nou lak ah van daitui in kawt henla, huan atantuan gamsate kiang ah hi in, atung a hun sagih abei matan, chih thu ahihleh;
english: Whereas the king saw a watcher and a holy one coming down from the sky, and saying, Cut down the tree, and destroy it; nevertheless leave the stump of its roots in the earth, even with a band of iron and brass, in the tender grass of the field, and let it be wet with the dew of the sky: and let his portion be with the animals of the field, until seven times pass over him;

paite: Aw kumpipa, ka toupa kumpipa tung a hong tung Tungnungpen thupiak ahilhchetna hiai ahi:
english: this is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king:

paite: Mite a kipan hawlkhiak in na om dia; gamsate kiang ah na khosa ding a, bawngtalte bang a loupa neksak in na om ding a; van daitui in na kawt ding a; na tung ah hun sagih abei ding; mite gam ah Tungnungpen in vai ahawm a; a-ututna kiang ah apia chih na theih matan.
english: that you shall be driven from men, and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field, and you shall be made to eat grass as oxen, and shall be wet with the dew of the sky, and seven times shall pass over you; until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.

paite: Huan sing bulsum leh azungte nutsiat ding a thupiak a om pen ahihleh; van Pathian in vaihawm petmah ahi chih na theih khit hun chiang in na gam nang kiang a piakkik ding genna ahi.
english: Whereas they commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree; your kingdom shall be sure to you, after that you shall have known that the heavens do rule.

paite: Aw kumpipa, huaiziak in ka hon thuhilh nang a ding in pom tuak leh tagahte kiang a zahngaihna etsakna in na thulimlouhnate tawpsan in; na lamzanna suksau a a-om khak zenzenleh," achi hi.
english: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you, and break off your sins by righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor; if there may be a lengthening of your tranquility.

paite: Hiai tengteng kumpipa Nebukadnezzar tung ah ahong tung hi.
english: All this came on the king Nebuchadnezzar.

paite: Kha sawm-le-nih abei in Babulon a kumpi Inpi sung ah avialvak hi.
english: At the end of twelve months he was walking in the royal palace of Babylon.

paite: Kumpipa'n thu agen a, hiai Babulon thupi, kumpipa tenna mun ding a, ka thilhihtheihna hatna leh ka thuneihna thupina ding a ka lam ahi kei maw? chi in.
english: The king spoke and said, Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for the royal dwelling place, by the might of my power and for the glory of my majesty?

paite: Kumpipa kam a thu a-om lai mahmah in, van a kipan aw ahong suakkhia a, "Aw kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, na kiang a thugen ahi; nang a kipan gam apaimangta hi.
english: While the word was in the king’s mouth, there fell a voice from the sky, saying, O king Nebuchadnezzar, to you it is spoken: The kingdom has departed from you:

paite: Tungnungpen in mite gam ah vai ahawm a, a-ututna kiang ah apia chih na theih matan, mihingte a kipan in hawlkhiak na hi ding a, na tenna gamsate kiang ah ahi ding; bawngtalte bang a loupa ne ding a bawl in na om dia; na tung ah hun sagih abei ding," achi hi.
english: and you shall be driven from men; and your dwelling shall be with the animals of the field; you shall be made to eat grass as oxen; and seven times shall pass over you; until you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever he will.

paite: Kintak in huai bang thil ahong tungta, mite a kipan hawlkhiak in a-om a; bawngtalte bang in loupa ane petmah hi; apumpi van daitui in akawt a; asam muvanlai multe ahong bang a, achinte vasate chinte ahong bangta hi.
english: The same hour was the thing fulfilled on Nebuchadnezzar: and he was driven from men, and ate grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until his hair was grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.

paite: Huan nite abei in kei Nebukad-nezzar in van lam ah ka mitte ka suantou a, ka theihtheihnate ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn a, huchi in Tungnungpen ka pahtawi hi; amah tangtawn a om gige phat in ka zahtak hi. Avaihawmna tangtawn vaihawmna ahi a, agam akhang-akhang in ahi, chi in;
english: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my understanding returned to me, and I blessed the Most High, and I praised and honored him who lives forever; for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom from generation to generation.

paite: Huan leitung a teng tengteng bangmah lou bang a ngaih ahi ua; huan van sepaih pawl leh leitung a teng tengtengte lak ah adeihlam bang in ahih zel a; kuamah in akhut alen thei un, akiang ah, "Bangziak a hih na hia?" achi thei kei uhi.
english: All the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing; and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth; and none can stay his hand, or ask him, What are you doing?

paite: Huai lai mah in ka theihtheihna ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn a; ka gam thupina, ka lalna leh hoihna ka kiang ah ahong kik a; ka midotte leh ka toupate'n kei ahong zong ua; huchi in ka gam ah kiptak in ka dingh a, kei a ding in thupina lian mahmah behlap in a-omta hi.
english: At the same time my understanding returned to me; and for the glory of my kingdom, my majesty and brightness returned to me; and my counselors and my lords sought to me; and I was established in my kingdom, and excellent greatness was added to me.

paite: Huchi in kei Nebukadnezzar in van Kumpipa phat a pahtawi in ka zahtak a; athilhih tengteng thutak ahi a, alampite vaihawmna ahi a, kisatheitak a omte ahihniam thei hi.
english: Now I, Nebuchadnezzar, praise and extol and honor the King of heaven; for all his works are truth, and his ways justice; and those who walk in pride he is able to abase.

paite: Belshazzar kumpipa'n atoupate lak a mi sangkhat a ding in ankuang thupitak abawl a, sangkhatte ma ah uain adawn hi.
english: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords, and drank wine before the thousand.

paite: Belshazzar in uain achep lai in, apa Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a om tempul a kipan a alak dangka-eng leh dangka tui-um belsuante kumpipa leh atoupate, azite leh ameite'n huaite a adawntheihna ding un hon la ding in thu apia hi.
english: Belshazzar, while he tasted the wine, commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which Nebuchadnezzar his father had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem; that the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, might drink from them.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem a om Pathian inn, tempul a kipan alakkhiak dangka-eng tui-um belsuante ahon la ua; kumpipa leh atoupate, azite leh ameite'n, huaite in adawn uhi.
english: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of God’s house which was at Jerusalem; and the king and his lords, his wives and his concubines, drank from them.

paite: Uain adawn ua, dangka-eng, dangka, dalsik, sing leh suang pathiante aphat uhi.
english: They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of brass, of iron, of wood, and of stone.

paite: Huai dak mah in mihing khutzungte ahong kilang guih a, kumpipa inpi baang pek tung, khawnvak koihna toh etdetna tak ahon gelh hi. Kumpipa'n laigelhtu khut bang tan hiam amu hi.
english: In the same hour came forth the fingers of a man’s hand, and wrote over against the lampstand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace: and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote.

paite: Huai lai in kumpipa mel ahong lamdang a, angaihtuahnate'n amah apatausakta hi; akhut akhe akipzouta kei a, akhukte akisat tuah nomnom uhi.
english: Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and his knees struck one against another.

paite: Bum mite, Kaldai mite leh aisan mite hon pi un chi in nakpitak in kumpipa akikou hi. Kumpipa'n thu agen a, Babulon mipilte kiang ah, "Kuapeuh in hiai laigelh sim a, ahilhchetna hon ensak, puan sandup silhsak ahi ding a; angawng kimvel in dangka-eng khainiang a-ok ding a; gamsung ah vaihawmmi thumna ahi ding," achi hi.
english: The king cried aloud to bring in the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers. The king spoke and said to the wise men of Babylon, Whoever shall read this writing, and show me its interpretation, shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about his neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa mipilte tengteng ahong lut ua; himahleh laigelh asim thei kei ua, ahilhchetna leng kumpipa atheisak thei kei uhi.
english: Then came in all the king’s wise men; but they could not read the writing, nor make known to the king the interpretation.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Belshazzar apatau mahmah a; amah ah amel ahong lamdang a; akhawnbawlte alungzing uhi.
english: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa leh khawn-bawlte thu ziak in ankuangluina insung ah kumpinu ahong lut hi; kumpinu'n thu agen a, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in hing in, na ngaihtuahnate'n hon patausak kei henla, na mel leng lamdang kei hen.
english: Now the queen by reason of the words of the king and his lords came into the banquet house: the queen spoke and said, O king, live forever; don’t let your thoughts trouble you, nor let your face be changed.

paite: Na gamsung a mi khat, amah a pathian siangthoute kha omna a-om a; na pa dam lai in vakna leh theihtheihna leh pilna, pathiante pilna bang, amah ah muh in a-om; kumpipa Nebukadnezzar, kumpipa, na pa'n, amah mitkhialdawi tawite leh bum mite, Kaldai mite leh aisan mite heutu in abawl hi.
english: There is a man in your kingdom, in whom is the spirit of the holy gods; and in the days of your father light and understanding and wisdom, like the wisdom of the gods, were found in him; and the king Nebuchadnezzar your father, the king, I say, your father, made him master of the magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and soothsayers;

paite: Lungsim hoihpen, theihna, theihtheihna, mangte hilhchetna, thugen haksa etsakna, ginlelhna hihvenna kumpipa'n Belteshazzar min asakpa, huai Daniel mah ah muh in a-om hi. Tu in Daniel sapsak in om henla, ama'n hilhchetna ensak hen," achi hi.
english: because an excellent spirit, and knowledge, and understanding, interpreting of dreams, and showing of dark sentences, and dissolving of doubts, were found in the same Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will show the interpretation.

paite: Huan kumpipa ma ah Daniel ahon pi ua, Kumpipa'n thu agen a Daniel kiang ah, "Daniel, ka pa'n Judah gam a kipan Judah salmat hon pilut na hi hia?
english: Then was Daniel brought in before the king. The king spoke and said to Daniel, Are you that Daniel, who are of the children of the captivity of Judah, whom the king my father brought out of Judah?

paite: Nang ah pathian kha a-om a, vakna leh theihtheihna leh pilna hoihpen nang ah muh in a-om chih na tanchin ka za hi.
english: I have heard of you, that the spirit of the gods is in you, and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom are found in you.

paite: Tu in ka ma ah mipilte, bum mite ahon pilut ua, hiai laigelh sim a, ahilhchetna ka kiang a theisak ding in; himahleh huai thil hilhchetna a-ensak thei kei uhi.
english: Now the wise men, the enchanters, have been brought in before me, that they should read this writing, and make known to me its interpretation; but they could not show the interpretation of the thing.

paite: Himahleh hilhchetnate na bawl thei a, ginlelhnate na bawlhoih thei chih na tanchin ka na za hi. Tu in laigelh na sim theih a, ahilhchetna na hon hilh theih leh puan sandup ka hon silhsak ding a; na ngawng kimvel in dangka-eng khi na ok ding a; gamsung ah vaihawmmi thumna na hi ding hi," achi hi.
english: But I have heard of you, that you can give interpretations, and dissolve doubts; now if you can read the writing, and make known to me its interpretation, you shall be clothed with purple, and have a chain of gold about your neck, and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom.

paite: Huchi in Daniel in adawng a kumpipa ma ah, "Na thilpiakte nangmah kiang ah hi zaw henla, na kipahmante midang kiang ah pe zaw in; ahi a, kumpipa kiang ah laigelh ka sim ding a, ahilhchetna amah ka theisak ding hi.
english: Then Daniel answered before the king, Let your gifts be to yourself, and give your rewards to another; nevertheless I will read the writing to the king, and make known to him the interpretation.

paite: Aw nang kumpipa, Tungnungpen Pathian in na pa Nebukadnezzar gam leh thupina, letna leh vaihawmna ahon pia hi.
english: You, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty:

paite: Huai amah apiak letna ziak in ama ah mi tengteng, namte, paute aling un alau ua; a-utut athat a, a-utut hinghawi in; a-utut akaithou a, a-utut asawnniam hi.
english: and because of the greatness that he gave him, all the peoples, nations, and languages trembled and feared before him: whom he would he killed, and whom he would he kept alive; and whom he would he raised up, and whom he would he put down.

paite: Himahleh alungtang ahong kisaktheih a, ki-uangsaktak a gamta a alungsim hihkhauh a a-om lai in, alaltutphah a kipan suan in a-om a, amah a kipan athupina alakheta hi.
english: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him:

paite: Huan mite tapate a kipan hawlkhiak in a-om a; huchi in alungtang gamsate a bang a bawl in a-om a; bawngtalte bang a loupa a vak in a-om a, apumpi van daitui in akawt a; Tungnungpen Pathian in mihing gam ah vai ahawm a, a-ututte atung ah adingkhesak chih ahon theih matan.
english: and he was driven from the sons of men, and his heart was made like the animals’, and his dwelling was with the wild donkeys; he was fed with grass like oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky; until he knew that the Most High God rules in the kingdom of men, and that he sets up over it whomever he will.

paite: "Huan nang atapa, Aw Belshazzar, hiai tengteng na theih in leng na lungtang na niamkhiak kei hi.
english: You, his son, Belshazzar, have not humbled your heart, though you knew all this,

paite: Himahleh van Toupa dem in na kihihsang a; amau na ma ah toupa inn a tui-um belsuante na lasak a; nang leh na toupate, na zite leh na meite'n, huaite in uain na dawn uh a; bangmah mu thei lou, za thei lou, theithei lou dangka leh dangka-eng, dal, sik, sing leh suang pathiante bia in na phat a; Pathian akhut a na hatna omna leh na lampite tengteng neipa na pahtawi zaw kei hi.
english: but have lifted up yourself against the Lord of heaven; and they have brought the vessels of his house before you, and you and your lords, your wives and your concubines, have drunk wine from them; and you have praised the gods of silver and gold, of brass, iron, wood, and stone, which don’t see, nor hear, nor know; and the God in whose hand your breath is, and whose are all your ways, you have not glorified.

paite: Huchi in amah a kipan huai khut banghiam tan sawl in ahong om a, hiai laigelh gelh in ahong omta hi.
english: Then was the part of the hand sent from before him, and this writing was inscribed.

paite: "Huan gelh a om laithu hiai ahi: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.
english: This is the writing that was inscribed: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN.

paite: Huai hilhchetna hiai ahi. MENE: Pathian in na gam asimta, abeisakta hi.
english: This is the interpretation of the thing: MENE; God has numbered your kingdom, and brought it to an end;

paite: TEKEL: bukna a buk in na om a, na chingzou kei hi.
english: TEKEL; you are weighed in the balances, and are found wanting.

paite: PERES: na gam hawm in a-om a, Mid mite leh Persia mite kiang ah piak ahita," achi hi.
english: PERES; your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians.

paite: Huchi in Belshazzar in thu apia a, dangka-eng khainiang angawng kimvel in a-oksak ua; gamsung a vaihawmmi athumna hi ding in amah tung ah thu apuang uhi.
english: Then commanded Belshazzar, and they clothed Daniel with purple, and put a chain of gold about his neck, and made proclamation concerning him, that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom.

paite: Huai zan mah in Kaldai kumpipa Belshazzar thah in a-om hi.
english: In that night Belshazzar the Chaldean King was slain.

paite: Mid mi Darias, kum sawmguk-le-nih a upa in gam atangta hi.
english: Darius the Mede received the kingdom, being about sixty-two years old.

paite: Darias in agam pumpi bial za-le-sawmnih omsuak ding bial heutu za-le-sawmnih gam tung ah akoih hi.
english: It pleased Darius to set over the kingdom one hundred twenty satraps, who should be throughout the whole kingdom;

paite: Huan amaute tung ah, heutu lian thum, huaite lak ah Daniel akhatna ahi a; huchi a hiai bial heutute'n huaite kiang a thu atut ua, kumpipa'n siatna aneihlouhna ding in.
english: and over them three presidents, of whom Daniel was one; that these satraps might give account to them, and that the king should have no damage.

paite: Huchi in hiai Daniel, amah a lungsim hoihpen a-om ziak in, heutu liante leh bial heutute tung ah akan-aval a bawl in a-om a; kumpipa'n gam pumpi tung ah amah koih ding angaihtuah hi.
english: Then this Daniel was distinguished above the presidents and the satraps, because an excellent spirit was in him; and the king thought to set him over the whole realm.

paite: Huai lai in heutu liante leh bial heutute'n gam thu ah Daniel demna ding azong uhi; himahleh amah miginom ahih ziak in thupatna ding in adiklouhna amu kei ua, amah ah diklouhna leh khelhna muh in a-om kei hi.
english: Then the presidents and the satraps sought to find occasion against Daniel as touching the kingdom; but they could find no occasion nor fault, because he was faithful, neither was there any error or fault found in him.

paite: Huchi in hiai mite'n, "Hiai Daniel demna ding bangmah i mu kei ding; a Pathian dan toh kisai a amah demna ding i muh kei ngalleh," akichi uhi.
english: Then these men said, We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel, except we find it against him concerning the law of his God.

paite: Huan hiai heutu liante leh bial heutute kumpipa kiang ah akikhawm ua, akiang ah hichibang in, "Kumpipa Darias aw, tangtawn in dam in!
english: Then these presidents and satraps assembled together to the king, and said thus to him, King Darius, live forever.

paite: Gam heutu lian tengteng, heutute leh bial heutute, dan thei mite leh ukpipate, kumpi dan thuseh bawlkhiak a, khamna khauhtak bawl ding in akikumkhawm uhi. Huchi in mi kuapeuh, nang chih louh, Aw kumpipa, ni sawmthum sung a pathian hiam mihing hiam lak a ngetna abawlleh, humpinelkai huangsung ah paihlut in a-om ding hi.
english: All the presidents of the kingdom, the deputies and the satraps, the counselors and the governors, have consulted together to establish a royal statute, and to make a strong decree, that whoever shall ask a petition of any god or man for thirty days, except of you, O king, he shall be cast into the den of lions.

paite: Tu in, Aw kumpipa, khamna hihkip inla, laigelh ah na min gelh in; huchi a Mid mite leh Persia mite dan bang a akihih lamdanlouhna ding in," achi uhi.
english: Now, O king, establish the decree, and sign the writing, that it not be changed, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Darias in laigelh leh khamna ah amin agelhta hi.
english: Therefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree.

paite: Daniel in laigelh ah min akigelhta chih atheih in a-insung ah alut a; adantan sung a atawlette Jerusalem lam a hon hi ve un, akhukdin a, ni khat in thumvei, huchi in athum a, amalam a ahih bang in, a Pathian ma ah kipahthu agen hi.
english: When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before.

paite: Huchi in hiai mite akikhawm ua, Daniel a Pathian ma a thu ngen leh thum in amu uhi.
english: Then these men assembled together, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.

paite: Huchi in ahong pai nai ua, kumpipa khamna tungtang kumpipa ma ah ahong genta uhi, "Aw kumpipa, nang chih louh michih kuapeuh in ni sawmthum sung a pathian hiam mihing hiam kiang a ngetna abawlleh humpinelkai huangsung ah paihlut ahi ding chih khamna ah na gelh ahi kei maw," achi uhi. Kumpipa'n, "Mid mite leh Persia mite dan lamdang thei lou bang in huai dan kip lai ahi," achi hi.
english: Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king’s decree: Haven’t you signed an decree, that every man who shall make petition to any god or man within thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? The king answered, The thing is true, according to the law of the Medes and Persians, which doesn’t alter.

paite: Huan amau adawng ua kumpipa ma ah, "Huai Daniel, Judah saltang tate lak a mi in nang leh na min gelhna khamna leng ahon limsak kei, Aw kumpipa, ni khat in thumvei ngetna abawl hi," achi uhi.
english: Then answered they and said before the king, That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t respect you, O king, nor the decree that you have signed, but makes his petition three times a day.

paite: Hiai thute azak in, kumpipa alungkim het kei a, amah suaktasak ding in Daniel tung ah alungtang anga a; amah hutkhiak tum in nitum tan asemgim hi.
english: Then the king, when he heard these words, was very displeased, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him; and he labored until the going down of the sun to rescue him.

paite: Huchi in hiai mite kumpipa kiang ah ahong kikhawm ua, kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw kumpipa, khamna hiam dan thuseh hiam kumpipa'n ahihkipsa hihlamdan theih ahih louh Mid mite leh Persia mite dan ahi chih thei in," achi uhi.
english: Then these men assembled together to the king, and said to the king, Know, O king, that it is a law of the Medes and Persians, that no decree nor statute which the king establishes may be changed.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n thu apia a, Daniel ahon pi ua, humpinelkai huangsung ah apailut uhi. Huan kumpipa'n thu agen a, Daniel kiang ah, "A-nna na sep gige na Pathian in ahon suaktasak ding," achi hi.
english: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. Now the king spoke and said to Daniel, Your God whom you serve continually, he will deliver you.

paite: Huan suang khat ahon la ua, huangsung gong ah akoih ua; kumpipa'n amah suaisawnna zungbuh leh atapate suaisawnna zungbuh in suai anamta hi; Daniel tungtang thu a bangmah hihlamdan theih ahihlouhna ding in.
english: A stone was brought, and laid on the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet of his lords; that nothing might be changed concerning Daniel.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa a-inpi ah apai a, an ngawl in, tumging leh nopbawlna khawlsak in azanhak a; amah lah a-ihmu thei kei hi.
english: Then the king went to his palace, and passed the night fasting; neither were instruments of music brought before him: and his sleep fled from him.

paite: Huchi in zingsang beltak in kumpipa athou a, humpinelkaite huangsung lam ah kintak in ava hoh hi.
english: Then the king arose very early in the morning, and went in haste to the den of lions.

paite: Huangsung lam a Daniel kiang a ahong pai nai lai in, kah aw in akikou a; kumpipa'n thu agen a, Daniel kiang ah, "Aw Daniel, Pathian hing sikha, a-nna na sep gige, na Pathian in humpinelkaite a kipan nang hon suaktasak thei hiam?" achi hi.
english: When he came near to the den to Daniel, he cried with a lamentable voice; the king spoke and said to Daniel, Daniel, servant of the living God, is your God, whom you serve continually, able to deliver you from the lions?

paite: Daniel in kumpipa kiang ah, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in hing in!
english: Then Daniel said to the king, O king, live forever.

paite: Ka Pathian in a-angel hon sawl a, humpinelkaite kam ahong chihsak a, ahon hihna kei uh; amah ma a keimah a hoihna muh a a-om ziak leh Aw kumpipa nangmah ma a leng gilou ka hih louh ziak in," achi hi.
english: My God has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not hurt me; because as before him innocence was found in me; and also before you, O king, have I done no hurt.

paite: Huchi in nakpitak in kumpipa akipak a, huangsung a kipan Daniel lakhe tou ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in huangsung a kipan in Daniel alakhe tou ua, a Pathian amuan ziak in atung ah bangmah natna akimu kei hi.
english: Then was the king exceeding glad, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n thu apia a, Daniel hekte huai mite ahon pi ua, humpinelkai huangsung ah apai ua, amau, azi leh tate uh; humpinelkaite'n amaute huangsung taw ahong tun ma un ana man ua, aguhte uh ahihnen vek uhi.
english: The king commanded, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions, them, their children, and their wives; and the lions mauled them, and broke all their bones in pieces, before they came to the bottom of the den.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Darias in mite tengteng, namte, paute leitung pumpi a tengte kiang ah lai agelh a, "Na kiang uah lemna hihpun in om hen!
english: Then king Darius wrote to all the peoples, nations, and languages, who dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.

paite: Ka gam seh thum tengteng ah Daniel Pathian ma ah mite aling un alau ding uh; Amah Pathian hing, tangtawn a omkip, agam hihsiat ahi ngei kei ding a; athuneihna a-omden ding hi, chi in thupiak ka bawl hi.
english: I make a decree, that in all the dominion of my kingdom men tremble and fear before the God of Daniel; for he is the living God, and steadfast forever, His kingdom that which shall not be destroyed; and his dominion shall be even to the end.

paite: Ama'n asuaktasak a, atankhia a, van leh lei ah chiamtehna leh thillamdangte ahih a; ama'n humpinelkaite thilhihtheihna a kipan in Daniel asuaktasak hi."
english: He delivers and rescues, and he works signs and wonders in heaven and in earth, who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.

paite: Huchibang in Darias vaihawm lai leh Persia mi Kura vaihawm lai in hiai Daniel alamzang mahmah hi.
english: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

paite: Babulon kumpipa Belshazzar kum khatna kum in Daniel in alupna tung a alup lai in mang anei a, alungsim ah mengmuh ahong kilang a, mang agelh a athute akim in agen hi.
english: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon Daniel had a dream and visions of his head on his bed: then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.

paite: Daniel in thu agen a, "Zan a ka mengmuhna ah, ngai in, van huih lite tuipi thupi tung a hong nungkhia un ka mu hi.
english: Daniel spoke and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the sky broke forth on the great sea.

paite: Huan tuipi a kipan sa thupi li, kibang lou chiat ahong paitou ua,
english: Four great animals came up from the sea, diverse one from another.

paite: akhatna humpinelkai abang a, muvanlai kha anei hi; huchi a ka et lai in akhate bohkhiak in a-om ua; lei a kipan phottouh a mihing bang a khe nih a dinsak a om in; akiang ah mihing lungsim piak in a-om hi.”
english: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings: I saw until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made to stand on two feet as a man; and a man’s heart was given to it.

paite: Huan ngai in, sa dang, anihna, vompi bang, apang langkhat tung ah photkang in a-om a; akamsung ah ahate kikal ah nakguh thum a-om a; hichibang in akiang ah hilh in a-om a, "Thou inla, sa tampi negai in," chi in.
english: Behold, another animal, a second, like a bear; and it was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth: and they said thus to it, Arise, devour much flesh.

paite: Hiai khit in ka en a, huan ngai in, sa dang khat, gialbem bang, anungzang a vasa bang a kha li nei ka mu hi. Huai gamsa in lu li anei a; akiang ah thuneihna piak in a-om hi.
english: After this I saw, and behold, another, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings of a bird; the animal had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

paite: Hiai khit in, zan mengmuhna in ka mu a, ngai in sa lina, lauhuai leh thilhihtheitak, nakpi mahmah a hat; sik ha lianpite nei in anegai in abotnen a; a-omlaite akhe in achil hi. Ama a gamsa om tengteng toh akibang kei; kii sawm anei hi.
english: After this I saw in the night visions, and, behold, a fourth animal, awesome and powerful, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth; it devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet: and it was diverse from all the animals that were before it; and it had ten horns.

paite: Kite ka ngaihtuah lai in, alak uah kii dang aneu khat hong poukhia a, huai ma ah huai kii masa thumte azung uah bohkhiak in a-om uh, hiai kineu ah mit, mihing mit bang leh kam thil thupite gen a-omta hi.
english: I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots: and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.

paite: Huchi a ka et lai in, laltutphah akikoih a, Tanglai Mipa'n alaltutphah aluahta hi; apu apuansilh vuk bang in angou a, samul siang bang in alu a sam angou hi; huai alaltutphah meikuang zuazua ahi a, huai akangtalai khete meikuang lai bang ahi.
english: I saw until thrones were placed, and one who was ancient of days sat: his clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool; his throne was fiery flames, and its wheels burning fire.

paite: Meikuang luipi hong pawt a ama a kipan ahong paikhia a, asang asangte'n amah nna asepsak uh; ama ah singkhat mun singkhat adingh ua; vaihawmna atungkhia ua, laibute ahong uhi.
english: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousands of thousands ministered to him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

paite: Huai kii in athugen thupite ziak in ka en nilouh hi. Huchi a ka et lai in, huai gamsa thah in ahong om a; apumpi hihsiat in ahong om a; meikuang a apaih dong uh ka en gige hi.
english: I saw at that time because of the voice of the great words which the horn spoke; I saw even until the animal was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.

paite: Huan sa dangte ahihleh athuneihna uh lakmang in a-om a; hun seh khat leh hun khat tan ahinna uh hihsau in a-om hi.
english: As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away: yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

paite: Zan mengmuhna in ka mu a, ngai in, van meipite toh mi khat mihing tapa toh kibang ahong pai a, Tanglai Mipa kiang mahmah ah ahong a, amah ama chin ah ahon pi uhi.
english: I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of the sky one like a son of man, and he came even to the ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

paite: Huan thuneihna, thupina leh gam piak in a-om a; huchi a mi tengteng, namte leh paute'n amah nna asepsak theihna ding un; athuneihna tangtawn thuneihna ahi a, amang kei ding, agam hihsiat in a-om kei ding hi.
english: There was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

paite: "Kei Daniel ahihleh ka sung ah ka lungsim adah a, ka lutang mengmuh in kei ahon patausak hi.
english: As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

paite: Akiangnai a dinghte lak a khat kiang ka zuan a, hiai tengteng thu ah thutak amah ka dongta hi. Huchi in huai thilte hilhchetna ka kiang ah ahon theisakta hi.
english: I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

paite: Hiai gamsa thupi lite etsak bel lei a hong dingkhe ding kumpipa lite ahi uhi.
english: These great animals, which are four, are four kings, who shall arise out of the earth.

paite: Himahleh Tungnungpen misiangthoute'n gam atang ding ua, tangtawn, tangtawn in, gam aneiden ding uhi," achi hi.
english: But the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.

paite: Huchi in sa lina, amaute tengteng toh kibang lou, kihtakhuai mahmah, ahate sik hi a, achinte dal, ne khin a, botnen a, a-omlaite akhepek a chil tungtang thutak theih ka ut hi.
english: Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth animal, which was diverse from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of brass; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;

paite: Huan kii sawmte aluzang a omte lak ah kii dang khat hong poukhia a, huai ma a kii thumte apukna; huai kii mitte nei leh kam nei a thil thupite gen a, alatdan a lawite sang a hat tuakzaw pen tanchin ka thei nuam hi.
english: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn which came up, and before which three fell, even that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spoke great things, whose look was more stout than its fellows.

paite: Huchi a ka etleh huai kii in misiangthoute dou in, gal abawl a,
english: I saw, and the same horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them;

paite: Tanglai Mipa'n Tungnungpen misiangthoute gum in thu akhen a, amau lalgam aneih masiah ua ding in amaute azouta hi.
english: until the ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

paite: Huchi in sa lina pen leitung ah gam lina ahi ding a, huai gam tengteng toh akibang kei ding a, leitung pumpi agai ding a, asikden dia, abotnen ding achi hi.
english: Thus he said, The fourth animal shall be a fourth kingdom on earth, which shall be diverse from all the kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

paite: Huan kii sawmte ahihleh, hiai gam a kipan in kumpipa sawm hong dingkhe dingte ahi ua; amau nung in adang khat; amasa toh akibang kei ding a, ama'n kumpipa thumte azou ding hi.
english: As for the ten horns, out of this kingdom shall ten kings arise: and another shall arise after them; and he shall be diverse from the former, and he shall put down three kings.

paite: Tungnungpen dem in agense ding a, misiangthoute anuaisiah ding hi; hunte leh dan khen ding angaihtuah dia; hun khat leh hunte leh hun kimkhat abei masiah misiangthoute akhut ah piak in a-om ding uhi.
english: He shall speak words against the Most High, and shall wear out the saints of the Most High; and he shall think to change the times and the law; and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.

paite: Huaite zoh in vaihawmna a-om ding a, athuneihna lakmang ahi ding a, atawp tan a hihgawp ding leh suksiat in a-om ding hi.
english: But the judgment shall be set, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.

paite: Huan leitung gam leh thuneihna leh van nuai pumpi nuai a gamte thupina, Tungnungpen misiangthoute kiang ah piak in a-om ding; agam tangtawn gam ahi a, avaihawmnate'n amah nna asepsak un athu amang ding uhi.
english: The kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole sky, shall be given to the people of the saints of the Most High: his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

paite: Hiai ah thu leh la tawpna a-om hi. Kei Daniel ahihleh ka ngaihtuahnate'n nakpi in hon hihbuai a, kei ah ka mel amual hi; himahleh ka lungtang in huai thu ka kem khinkhian hi.
english: Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts much troubled me, and my face was changed in me: but I kept the matter in my heart.

paite: Kumpipa Belshazzar vaihawm akum thumna kum in kei, Daniel kiang a amasa a kilang pen mah ahong kilat khit nung in mengmuhna ka kiang ah hong kilang nawn hi.
english: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.

paite: Ka mengmuhna ah hichi ahong hi a, Elam bial a Susa inpi ah ka om a; huan mengmuhna in Ulai lui kiang ah om in ka mu hi.
english: I saw in the vision; now it was so, that when I saw, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.

paite: Huchi in ka dakleh ngai in, huai lui gei ah belamtal khat kii nih nei adingh a, akii nihte asau uhi. Himahleh khat sang in adang pen asauzaw a, asauzaw pen ahong pou nanung pen ahi.
english: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

paite: Huai belamtal in akii a si ding in tumlam, mallam leh simlam nawt in ka mu hi; ama ah sate adingh thei kei ua, akhut a kipan suaktasak thei leng kuamah a-om kei uh; himahleh ama deihlam in ahih a ahong thupi hi.
english: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; and no animals could stand before him, neither was there any who could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.

paite: Huchi a ka ngaihtuah lai in, ngai in, leitung pumpi tawnsuak in tumlam a kipan in keltal khat lei sukha lou in ahong pai a, huai kel in amitte kikal ah kii minthang khat anei hi.
english: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

paite: Belamtal kii nih nei lui malam a dingh ka muh kiang ah ahong pai a, athilhihtheihna toh heh in amah adelhta hi.
english: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.

paite: Belamtal kiangchin ah ahong pai ka mu a, atung ah nakpitak in athangpaita a, belamtal aboh a, akii nihte ahihtan a; huchi in belamtal in amah adinna ding thahatna aneita kei hi. Lei ah asipuk a, amah achilzial a; akhut a kipan belamtal suaktasak ding kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns; and there was no power in the ram to stand before him; but he cast him down to the ground, and trampled on him; and there was none who could deliver the ram out of his hand.

paite: Nakpi mahmah in keltal akiliansakta a; huchi a ahat lai in, huai kii thupi akitan a; amun ah kii li minthang, van huih lite lam ah ahong suakkhetou uhi.
english: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.

paite: Huan huai kiite lak a kii neu thupi mahmah khat, simlam, suahlam leh gam kilawm lam nga in ahong khangkhia hi.
english: Out of one of them came forth a little horn, which grew exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land .

paite: Huchi in van sepaihte bang hial in ahong thupi mahmah a; aksihonte lak a khenkhatte lei ah apaikhesuk a, amau achil hi.
english: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and some of the army and of the stars it cast down to the ground, and trampled on them.

paite: Ahi, van sepaihte' TOUPA tung nangawn ah akiliansak a; amah a kipan in niteng halmang thillat alamang a, amun siangthou apaikhesuk hi.
english: Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

paite: Huan tatlekna ziak in halmang thillatte toh van sepaihte amah kiang ah piak in a-om ua; huchi in lei ah thutak apaikhia a, asep leh bawlte ah alohching hi.
english: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience; and it cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.

paite: Huchi in misiangthou khat in misiangthou dang khat kiang ah, "Hiai mengmuhna a kimu tatlekna mulkimhuai in niteng halmang thillat bang tan luahtou ding a, mun siangthoupen leh van sepaihte akhenuai a bang tan nuaisiah a omsak ding ahia," achih ka za hi.
english: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, How long shall be the vision concerning the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot?

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Nitaklam leh zinglam sangnih-le-zathum sung tan in; huai chiang in mun siangthoupen silsiang ahi ding hi," achi hi.
english: He said to me, To two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kei, Daniel in ka mengmuh lai in, theihchet ka na tum a; huchi in ka ma ah mihing kibatpih bang ahong dingh hi.
english: It happened, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, that I sought to understand it; and behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

paite: Huan Ulai luipiau kikal ah, mihing aw kikou in, "Gabriel, hiai mipa mengmuhna theichiansak in," achih ka za hi.
english: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.

paite: Huchibang in ka dinna mun naih in ahong pai a; huchi a ahong pai lai in, ka lauta a, ka mai in lei ka si hi; himahleh ama'n ka kiang ah, "Aw mihing tapa, mengmuh lah hun tawp a ding ahi a, theisiam in," achi hi.
english: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face: but he said to me, Understand, son of man; for the vision belongs to the time of the end.

paite: Huan kei ahon houpih lai in, lei lam nga in nakpitak in ka ihmuta a; himahleh ahon khoih a, ahon dingtangsak hi.
english: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me, and set me upright.

paite: Huan ama'n, "Ngai in, thangpaihna hun tawp lam a bang ahia hong om ding ka hon theisak ding; hun tawp sehsa a ding lah ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: He said, Behold, I will make you know what shall be in the latter time of the indignation; for it belongs to the appointed time of the end.

paite: "Belamtal na muh kii nih nei, Media leh Persia kumpipate ahi uh.
english: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.

paite: Huan huai keltal huham Grik kumpipa ahi; amitte kikal a om kii thupi kumpipa khatna ahi.
english: The rough male goat is the king of Greece: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

paite: Huan akitan pen mun luah kii lite ahihleh, huai nam a kipan in gam li hong dingkhe dingte ahi ua; himahleh amau bang in thilhihtheihna anei kei ding uh.
english: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.

paite: Huan agam vaihawm hun tawp na uah, talek mite ahong hat mahmah chiang un, kumpipa lauhuai melpu, zuau a khem siam khat adingkhe ding hi.
english: In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

paite: Huchi in athilhihtheihna ahat dia, himahleh amah mah thilhihtheihna hilou in; siatna lamdangtak atun dia, athilhih khempeuh alohching ding hi; huchi in mihatte leh misiangthoute ahihsegawp ding hi.
english: His power shall be mighty, but not by his own power; and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper and do his pleasure; and he shall destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.

paite: "Huan amah dan zui in khemna nasep ah alohching zel ding hi; huan alungtang akiliansak ding a, mi tampite bit akisak lai un ahihse ding a; kumpite Kumpi dou ding in akisa ding; himahleh mihing khut hilou in hihkhap in a-om ding hi.
english: Through his policy he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and in their security shall he destroy many: he shall also stand up against the prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

paite: Huan nitak lamte leh zingsang lamte toh kisai mengmuhna kigen adik ahi; himahleh ahong tung ding ni tampi a ding ahih lai ziak in hiai mengmuhna khak bikbek in," achi hi.
english: The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true: but seal up the vision; for it belongs to many days to come.

paite: Huchi in kei, Daniel ka sibup a; ni bangzah hiam ka china hi; ka thou a, kumpipa nna ka sem a hiai mengmuhna lamdang ka sa hi, himahleh kuamah in hiai atheisiam kei.
english: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick certain days; then I rose up, and did the king’s business: and I wondered at the vision, but none understood it.

paite: Media mi, Ahasueras tapa Darias, Kaldaite tung a kumpipa ding abawl, vaihawm akum khatna,
english: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans,

paite: avaihawm akum khatna kum in kei, Daniel in laibute a kipan Jerusalem hihsiatna in kum sawmsagih daih ding ahi chih zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung tanchin a kipan in ka theisiam hi.
english: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years about which the word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. came to Jeremiah the prophet, for the accomplishing of the desolations of Jerusalem, even seventy years.

paite: Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN lam ah ka mel ka koihkip a, thumna leh thilngette, an ngawlna leh sai-ip puan silh in, vut lak a tu in Toupa PATHIAN kiang ah ka ngen ngutngut hi.
english: I set my face to the Lord God, to seek by prayer and petitions, with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.

paite: Huan TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah ka thum a, thupha ka tawi hi, "Aw TOUPA, Pathian thupi leh mulkimhuai, nang hon it a na thupiakte zuite tung a thukhun leh zahngaihna vom;
english: I prayed to Yahweh my God, and made confession, and said, Oh, Lord, the great and dreadful God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments,

paite: ka na khialta ua, hoih loutak in ka gamtang ua, giloutak in ka na hihta ua, ka hel ua, na thuseh leh na vaihawmte ka na lehngatsanta uhi.
english: we have sinned, and have dealt perversely, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even turning aside from your precepts and from your ordinances;

paite: Ka kumpipate uh, ka vaihawmtute uleh ka pipute uh leh gam a mi tengteng kiang a na min a thugen, na sikha zawlneite thu leng ka na ngaikhe kei uhi.
english: neither have we listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

paite: Aw TOUPA, diktatna nang a ahi a, himahleh tuni bang in, kou a bel zahlakna leh buaina ahi; Judah a mite, Jerusalem a tengte, Israel tengteng, anai leh gamla a omte, na tung a atatlekna ziak un amaute gam tengteng ah delhzak in ka om uhi.
english: Lord, righteousness belongs to you, but to us confusion of face, as at this day; to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, who are near, and who are far off, through all the countries where you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka kumpipate, ka vaihawmte uh, ka pipute uh leh kou hon suangtute'n na tung a dikloutak a akhelh ziak un zahlakna in hon khuh hi.
english: Lord, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

paite: Amah tung ah na helta mah le ung zahngaihnate leh ngaihdamnate TOUPA ka Pathian uh a ahi.
english: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgiveness; for we have rebelled against him;

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw leh adante a om ding a asikha zawlneite zang a ka ma ua hon na koihsakte ka na mangta kei uhi.
english: neither have we obeyed the voice of Yahweh our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

paite: Ahi, Israel tengteng in na dan atatleksan ua, ahilou lam ah apial ua, na aw amanlouhna ding un; huaiziak in na tung a ka hihkhelhte ziak in Mosi, Pathian sikha dan sung a gelh a om kichiamna hamsia ka tung ah sunbuak in a-omta hi.
english: Yes, all Israel have transgressed your law, turning aside, that they should not obey your voice: therefore the curse and the oath written in the law of Moses the servant of God has been poured out on us; for we have sinned against him.

paite: "Huan koute demna leh ka tung ua vaihawmte demna thute leh ka tung ua siatna thupitak in ahihkip khinta hi; Jerusalem tung a kihih bang van nuai pumpi ah lah akihih ngei ngal kei a.
english: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, by bringing on us a great evil; for under the whole sky, such has not been done as has been done to Jerusalem.

paite: Mosi Dan sung a gelh ahih bang in, hiai siatna tengteng ka tung uah ahong tung hi; huchipi in leng ka thulimlouhnate uh kiheisan a, na thutak a theihkhen theihna ka neihtheihna ding un TOUPA ka Pathian uh deihsakna ka ngen nai kei lai uhi.
english: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us: yet have we not entreated the favor of Yahweh our God, that we should turn from our iniquities, and have discernment in your truth.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA ka Pathian uh athilhihte tengteng a adiktat gige man in, TOUPA'N thil hoih lou en gige in, ka tung uah ahon tungsakta hi; hinapi in kou lah a-aw ka na mangta kei uhi.
english: Therefore has Yahweh watched over the evil, and brought it on us; for Yahweh our God is righteous in all his works which he does, and we have not obeyed his voice.

paite: Huan tu in, Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, khut hattak a na mite Aigupta gam a kipan pikhepa leh tuni bang a minthanna kimuhpa, tuni bang in ka khialta ua, giloutak in ka na hihta uhi.
english: Now, Lord our God, who has brought your people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten yourself renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

paite: "Aw TOUPA, ka hon ngen ahi, na diktatna tengteng ziak in, na hehna leh thangpaihna, na khopi Jerusalem leh na tang siangthou a kipan kihei mangsak in; ka khelhnate uh ziak leh ka pipute uh thulimlouhna ziak in, Jerusalem leh na mite lah ka kim ka vel ua omte tengteng simmoh ahong hita uhi.
english: Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain; because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a reproach to all who are around us.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, Aw ka Pathian uh, na sikha thumna leh athilngette ngaikhia inla, TOUPA ziak in, asegawpsa na mun siangthou tung ah na mel vaksak in.
english: Now therefore, our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and to his petitions, and cause your face to shine on your sanctuary that is desolate, for the Lord’s sake.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, na bil hon doh inla, za in; na mitte hak inla, na min a kilou na khopi siatgawpnate en in; ka diktatna ziak un na ma a hiai ka thilngetnate uh lan ka hi ngal kei ua, na zahngaihna thupite ziak in ahi zaw hi.
english: My God, turn your ear, and hear; open your eyes, and see our desolations, and the city which is called by your name: for we do not present our petitions before you for our righteousness, but for your great mercies’ sake.

paite: Aw TOUPA, za in, Aw TOUPA ngaidam in, Aw TOUPA, ngaikhia inla hih in; hal ke'n; nangmah ziak mahmah in, Aw ka Pathian, na khopi leh na mite nang min pute ahi uhi," achi hi.
english: Lord, hear; Lord, forgive; Lord, listen and do; don’t defer, for your own sake, my God, because your city and your people are called by your name.

paite: Huchi a thu ka gen a, ka thum a, ka khelhna leh ka mi Israel khelhna thupha ka tawi a, TOUPA ka Pathian ma a ka Pathian tang siangthou a dingh a thilngetna ka piak lai in;
english: While I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before Yahweh my God for the holy mountain of my God;

paite: ahi, thumna a thu ka gen lai in, pasal Gabriel, achil a mengmuhna a ka muh pa, kintak a leng dia bawl a om in, nitaklam thillat hun ding in ahong khoih hi.
english: yes, while I was speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening offering.

paite: Huan ahon thuhilh a, ahon houpih a, "Aw Daniel, theihsiamna a siam mahmah a hon bawl ding in tu in ka hong paikhia hi," achi hi.
english: He instructed me, and talked with me, and said, Daniel, I am now come forth to give you wisdom and understanding.

paite: Na thilngetna kipat phet in adawnna piak ahi; nang hilh ding a hong pai ka hi, nakpitak a it lah na hi ngal a; huaiziak in thu ngaihtuah inla, mengmuhte theisiam in.
english: At the beginning of your petitions the commandment went forth, and I have come to tell you; for you are greatly beloved: therefore consider the matter, and understand the vision.

paite: "Na mite leh na khopi siangthou a ding in tatlekna hihbeina ding, khelhnate tawpsakna ding leh thulimlouhna a dia kilemna bawlna ding, tangtawn diktatna laklutna ding leh mengmuhte leh genkholhnate khakkhum bikbekna ding leh asiangthoupen thaunilhna ding in na tung ah nipikal sawmsagih hun seh leh thu piak ahi.
english: Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most holy.

paite: Huaiziak in thei inla, theisiam in, Jerusalem tungding nawn ding leh lam ding a thupiak apaikhiak a kipan sathau nilh a ompa, vaihawm tan in, nipikal sagih ahi ding; huan nipikal sawmguk-le-nih sung in hun haksa mahmahte akongzing leh bukna phaizang toh akilam nawn ding hi.
english: Know therefore and discern, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem to the Anointed One, “Anointed One” can also be translated “Messiah” (same as “Christ”). the prince, shall be seven weeks, and sixty-two weeks: it shall be built again, with street and moat, even in troubled times.

paite: "Nipikal sawmguk-le-nih khit chiang in sathau nilh a ompa satkhiak in a-om ding a, bangmah anei kei ding hi; huchi in ahong om ding vaihawmpa leh mite'n khopi leh mun siangthou ahihse ding ua; hun tawpna tui khang bang in ahong tung ding, huan atawp dong kidouna leh siatgawpnate om ding a guankholhsa ahita hi.
english: After the sixty-two weeks the Anointed One “Anointed One” can also be translated “Messiah” (same as “Christ”). shall be cut off, and shall have nothing: and the people of the prince who shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and its end shall be with a flood, and even to the end shall be war; desolations are determined.

paite: Huchi in nipikal khat a ding in tampi toh thukhun khauhtak abawl ding a; nipikal kimkhat a ding in kithoihna leh thillat atawpsak ding hi; mun siangthou ah mulkimhuai leh kihhuai atungkhe ding a; amah tung a tung dia guankholhsa hun tawp leh thangpaihna atung ah sunbuak ahih tan a-om ding hi,” achi hi.
english: He shall make a firm covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the offering to cease; and on the wing of abominations shall come one who makes desolate; and even to the full end, and that determined, shall wrath be poured out on the desolate.

paite: Paul, Pathian deihlam a Khrist Jesu sawltak in, misiangthou Ephesa a om Khrist Jesu a miginomte kiang ah:
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

paite: Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pathian phat in om hen. Ama'n van munte ah khalam vualzawlna chiteng in eite Khrist ah ahon vualzawlta hi.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;

paite: Amah mai a siangthou leh dembei a om ding a leitung pian ma a eite hon tel tak bang ngei in;
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without blemish before him in love;

paite: Ama'n adeih leh atup bangbang in, eite Jesu Khrist vang a atate hi ding in, itna ziak in hon sepkhol khinta hi.
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

paite: Huchi a it a ahon piak hehpihna thupi mahmah pahtawina i hihtheihna ding ahi.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely bestowed favor on us in the Beloved,

paite: Asisan ziak in amah ah tatkhiakna, ahehpihna hauhdan bang a i tatleknate ngaihdamna ngei i tangta ua,
english: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

paite: huai mah tuh ama'n eite lam ah pilna leh theihsiamna chiteng hon dimsakta a;
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

paite: athiltup Khrist a agelkhiak bangbang in adeihlam thuguk eite ahon theisakta hi.
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

paite: Huai adeihlam thilgel bel; hunbi ahong kim chiang a, thil tengteng, van a omte leh leitung a omte Khrist ah gawmkhawm a asuktuah vek ding ahi.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;

paite: Ama deihlam a lunggel bang a thil bangkim semkhepa tup bang ngei in, amah mah ah sehkholh a om in i gouluah ding i muta uhi.
english: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his will;

paite: Koute, Khrist a ana lamen masate, athupina pahtawina ding a hing ding in sehkholh in ka na om khinta uhi.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

paite: Huan noute'n thutak thu, na hotdamna tanchinhoih uh ngaikhia a na gintak nung un, amah ah chiamsa Kha Siangthou a chiamteh in na omta uhi;
english: in whom you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

paite: huai tuh, Pathian thupina ding a tatna kim i tan mateng a i gouluah ding tang ngei ding i hi chih khamkholhna ahi.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng Toupa Jesu a ginna na lak ua om leh misiangthoute tengteng tung a na itna uh ka zak in,
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,

paite: ka thumnate ah na min uh lou in nou ziak a kipahthu gen ka tawp kei hi;
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

paite: i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pathian, thupina Pa'n, amah theihna lam thu a pilna leh kilakna kha nou ahon piaktheihna ding in.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

paite: Huchi a na lungsim mitte uh hihvak a hong om a, ama'n nou ahon sapna lametna bang leh misiangthoute agouluah hauhsaknate na theihna ding un.
english: having the eyes of your hearts TR reads “understanding” instead of “hearts” enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

paite: Huan agingta eite athilhihtheihna thupina teh vual louh, huai a hatna thilhihtheihna toh asep bang zel in.
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

paite: Hiai thilhihtheihna bel misi lak a kipan a Khrist akaihthoh a, vanmun a, ataklam a atutsak hun a,
english: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

paite: lalnate, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate, vaihawmna tengteng tung leh tu khovel kia hilou a khovel hong tung ding nangawn a minsak chiteng tunglam pek ah akoih lai a azat mah ahi.
english: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

paite: Ama'n akhenuai ah bangkim akoih a, saptuam a bangkim tung a lutang in amah abawl a,
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

paite: huai saptuam apumpi ahi a, amah bangkim a bangkim hihdimpa taangchinna ahi.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

paite: Nou leng na tatlekna uleh na khelhnate uh ziak a si na hih lai un ahon hihhing hi.
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

paite: Huaite ah tuma lam in hiai khovel dan bang in, huihkhua a thuneipa, tua thumang lou tate sung a semlelpa kha deihdan in na khosa uhi.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience;

paite: Huai thumang lou tate lak ah eite leng tuma lam in sa duhgawlna hih in, i tak taksa utnate bang in i om vek ua, midangte mah bang in thangpaihna ta a piang i na hi uhi.
english: among whom we also all once lived in the lust of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

paite: Himahleh zahngaihna hau Pathian in, itna thupitak a hon it ziak in,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

paite: tatleknate ziak a si i hih lai in Khrist toh ahon hihhing a, hehpihna a hotdam na hita uhi.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ (by grace you have been saved),

paite: Khrist Jesu ah amah toh ahon kaithou a, van munte ah amah kiang ah ahon tukhawmsak hi.
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

paite: Huchi a hun hong tung dingte a, Khrist Jesu a i tung a migitna nei a, ahehpihna hauhdan a-etsak theihna ding in.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

paite: Hehpihna ziak a ginna tawn a hotdam na hi uhi; huai leng noumau a suak ahi kei a, Pathian thilthawnpiak ahi.
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

paite: Thilhih ziak ahi kei, huchi hi keileh mi'n asuang kha ding hi.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

paite: Thil hoih hih ding a Khrist Jesu a siam a om in, ama khutsuak i hi uhi; huai thil hoih hih i khosakna dan ding in Pathian in abawlkhol ahi.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

paite: Huaiziak in tuma lam a nou taksa a Zentelte, taksa khut a zeksum, achihte un zeksum louh hon chihte uh na hi uhi.
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision,” (in the flesh, made by hands);

paite: Huai lai in, Khrist lou in Israelte khua-le-tui toh kimidang in khovel ah lametna nei lou leh Pathian lou a om in, thuchiam thukhun lak ah mikhual in na om uh chih theigige un.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

paite: Tu'n bel, Khrist Jesu ah nou nidanglai a gamlapi a omte, Khrist sisan a hihnai in na hong omta uhi.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

paite: Amah i kilemna ahi; ama'n ei nihte khat a siam in i kikal a kimelmakna baang lai ahihchimta hi.
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of partition,

paite: Thusehte leh dan thupiakte asa a hihmang in; huchi a nihte amah a mihing thak khat a siam a kilemna abawltheihna ding in.
english: having abolished in the flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace;

paite: Huan kros ziak a nihte pumpi khat a Pathian toh hon kilemsakna ding in kimelmakna ahihbeita hi.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility thereby.

paite: Huan amah ahong pai in, nou gamlapi a omte kiang ah leh naichik a omte kiang ah leng lemna tanchinhoih ahilh sam hi.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

paite: Amah ziak in kha khat a Pa kiang luttheihna i nei tuaktuak uhi.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

paite: Huchi in tu'n zaw, zin-le-leng na hi nawnta kei ua, misiangthoute toh tualsung khat leh Pathian inkuanpihte na hita uhi.
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

paite: Khrist Jesu ngei aning a suang kiphamohpen hi in, sawltakte leh zawlneite suangphum tung a lam na hi ua,
