english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

paite: amah ah suanglep tuam chiat kituaktak a suktuah, Toupa ah tempul siangthou asuak hi.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

paite: Amah ngei ah nou leng, Kha a Pathian tenna ding a lepkhawm na hi uhi.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

paite: Hiai ziak in kei Paul, nou Zentelte ziak a Khrist Jesu hentapa in,
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

paite: noute a dia Pathian hehpihna nasepna piak a om ka hihdan na za thamta ding uhi.
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you;

paite: Huchi a kilakna tungtawn a Khrist thuguk ka kiang a theihsak a a-omdante; tuma a tomchik a ka gelh bang in.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

paite: Huai na sim un Khrist thuguk ka theihdan na thei ding uhi.
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;

paite: Tu hun a asawltak siangthoute leh azawlnei siangthoute kiang ah Kha theihsak a a-om bang in, tuma lam in mihing tate kiang ah theihsak in a-om ngei kei hi.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

paite: Huai thuguk hiai ahi, tanchinhoih ziak in Khrist Jesu ah, Zentelte gouluahpihte, pumpi hiangte leh thuchiam tanpihte ahi uhi.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

paite: Athilhihtheihna nasepdan bang a, Pathian hehpihna thawnpiak bang zel in huai tanchinhoih nasemtu ding a bawl ka hi.
english: of which I was made a servant, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

paite: Kei, misiangthou tengteng lak a neupen sang a neuzaw kiang ah, hiai hehpihna piak ahi, Khrist hauhsakna suikhiak vual louh Zentelte kiang a gen ding in;
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

paite: huan Pathian thil bangkim siampa a tangtawn a sel a na om, thuguk kisel bang ahia chih mi tengteng musak ding in,
english: and to make all men see what is the administration TR reads “fellowship” instead of “administration” of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ;

paite: Pathian pilna chiteng van munte a kumpi vaihawmte leh thuneihnate kiang a saptuamte zang a, tu hun a theihsak ahihna ding in.
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

paite: Hiai atangtawn thiltup dungzui a Toupa Khrist Jesu a atup leh sepdan ahi.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

paite: Khrist Jesu i gin ziak in amah mah ah maingalna leh kimuanna toh luttheihna i nei hi.
english: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

paite: Huchi in noute ziak a ka gimthuak ziak in lungke lou ding in ka hon ngen hi, huaite na thupina uh ahi.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

paite: Huaiziak in i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa ma ah ka khukdin hi,
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: lei leh van a inkuan chiteng min phuahkhiakna pa,
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

paite: athupina hauhdan bang zel a, ama Kha ziak a mihing sunglam a thilhihtheihna a hihhat a ahon omsak theihna ding in.
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;

paite: Huan na lungtang ua Khrist ginna a atentheihna ding in, a-itna a noute zungkai leh kingakna nei a na omtheihna ding un,
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

paite: misiangthou tengteng toh azatdan, asaudan, asandan leh athukdan theihchet theihna leh,
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

paite: Khrist itna theih phak louh, Pathian taangchinna chiteng bang a hihdim a na omtheihna ding un.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

paite: Huan eimah a sem zel thilhihtheihna bang in, i nget leh i ngaihtuah tengteng sang a thupizaw tham hihtheipa kiang ngei ah,
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

paite: tangtawn in suan tengteng tan in, saptuamte leh Khrist Jesu ah thupina om hen, Amen.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Huaiziak in noute sap a na omna uh toh kikhawm a khosa ding in kei Toupa a hentapa in ka hon ngen hi.
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

paite: Kingaihniamna leh migitna tengteng, kuhkalna toh, itna a kithuakzou chiat in,
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;

paite: lemna Kha a kipum khatna vom tinten ding in.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

paite: Ahon sapna pen lametna mun khat a sap na hih mah bang un pumpi khat leh Kha khat kia a-om hi.
english: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;

paite: Toupa khat, ginna khat, baptisma khat,
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

paite: bangkim Pathian leh Pa khat kia a om a; amah bangkim tung a om a, bangkim mu suak leh bangkim sung a om ahi.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.

paite: Himahleh Khrist thilpiak tehna bang zel in hehpihna i kiang chiat uah piak in a-om hi.
english: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

paite: "Huaiziak in ahi, tunglam a akahtouh lai in matte tampi api a, mihingte kiang ah leng thilpiakte apia,” achihna.
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.” Psalm 68:18

paite: Huchi in "Akahtou," chih lei mun nuainungpente bang a ahong suk masak phot keileh bangchi ahita dia le?
english: Now this, “He ascended,” what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

paite: Hong suk pen thil tengteng ahihdim theihna ding in, van tengteng tung pek a kahtoupa mah ahi.
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

paite: Huan khenkhatte sawltak hi ding in, khenkhatte zawlnei hi ding in, khenkhatte tanchinhoih gen ding in, khenkhatte pastor hi ding in, khenkhatte sinsaktu ding in apia hi.
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds or, pastors and teachers;

paite: Hiai tuh misiangthoute thopna ding, nasepna sepna ding, Khrist pumpi lamtouhna ding in.
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;

paite: Huai tuh ginna leh Pathian Ta theihna lam a thukituak a, piching a, Khrist taangchinna bang a i vek ua i om masiah a ding ahi.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;

paite: Huchi a mihingte diklouhna khemna bang a lepchiahpil a khem tawmtawm a om a, thuhilhna huih chiteng a alanglang a sep leh mutleng naupang i hih nawnlouhna ding un.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

paite: Itna a thutak gen a, bangkim a amah lupen, Khrist ngei a i khanlet zawkna ding uh ahi.
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;

paite: Amah a kipan pumpi tengteng kizopna chiteng sep ziak a lemtak a suktuah leh kizomkhawm a, hiang chih in sepdan ding bang asep chiang in pumpi akhang a itna ah amah-le-amah akilamtou hi.
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

paite: Tu in hiai Toupa ah ka hon theisak hi, Zentelte alungsim ginatlouhna uh pu a a-om bang un, na om nawn mahmah ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

paite: Amau alungtang uh khauh ziak a theihtheihna nei lou in Pathian hinna theihtheihna a pan posiah in a-om ua; atheihtheihna uh hihmial in a-om uhi.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;

paite: Akhenggawpta ua, siang lou chiteng hihna lam a huaiham in zautatna ah akipumpiak uhi.
english: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

paite: Himahleh nou zaw huchibang in Khrist thu na zil kei uhi!
english: But you did not learn Christ that way;

paite: Athu za a amah a thuhilh a om khin na hih peuhmah uleh, Jesu a thutak a om bang in,
english: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

paite: na pianken lui uh, na nidanglai hindan uh segawpsa suahkhia in,
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;

paite: na lungsim Kha uah athak in hong om unla,
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

paite: pianken thak, diktatna leh sianthouna a Pathian batpih a siam pen silh un.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

paite: Huchi in zuaugen tawpsan in, noumau inveng chiat kiang ah thudik gen un; khat-le-khat kihiangtuah chiat lah na hi ngal ua.
english: Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

paite: Heh unla, khelh zaw khial kei un; na hehna uh ni in tumpih kei hen.
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Psalm 4:4 Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

paite: Diabol leng mun awn sam kei un.
english: neither give place to the devil.

paite: Guta in gu nawn kei hen; tasam kiang a piak ding aneihtheihna ding in, akhut a thil hoih sem in gim zaw hen.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

paite: Thusia peuhmah na kam ua kipan in pawt kei hen; akhawkdan bang zel a bawlhoih ding in thuhoih peuhmah pawt zaw hen, angaikhete a ding a hehpihna ahong hihtheihna ding in.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for building up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

paite: Huan Pathian Kha Siangthou hihlungkham kei un, tatna ni a ding in amah ah chiamteh na hi uhi.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

paite: Khaatna bang, thangpaihna bang, hehna bang, hanna bang, gensiatnate leh gitlouh tupna chiteng toh tawpsan in om hen.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.

paite: Huan kihehpihtuah chiat a lainatna nei in om unla, Pathian in Khrist a nou ahon ngaihdam bang in, noumau leng kingaidamtuah chiat un.
english: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

paite: Huchi in ata deihtakte bang in Pathian omdan zuite hi un.
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

paite: Huan Khrist in hon it a, namtui ding a Pathian kiang a thilpiak ding leh kithoihna ding a i sik a akipiak bang in itna ah khosa un.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

paite: Misiangthou hita na hihman un kingaihna leh siang lou tengteng huaihamna toh, na lak uah lohkhak in om kei hen.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

paite: Zahmohte, thugina lou gente, chiamnuih thu nangawn huaite akilawm lou ahi; huaite gen sang in kipahthu gen zaw un.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.

paite: Kingaihhat leh mithanghuai leh mihuaiham in, mihuaiham zaw milim bemi ahi, Khrist leh Pathian lalgam ah gou tan ding anei kei uh chih na thei mahmah uhi.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

paite: Kuamah in thugina lou peuh in hon khem kei uhen; huai thilte ziak in Pathian thangpaihna thumang lou tate tung ah atung nak hi.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

paite: Huaiziak in amau kikoppih kei un.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

paite: Tuma in mial na hi ua, tu'n zaw Toupa ah vak na hong hita uhi; vak tate bang in om un;
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

paite: vak gah tuh hoihna, diktatna leh thutak tengteng ahi;
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

paite: huan Toupa ah akipah lam pomtak bang ahi hiam zong un.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

paite: Huan mial thilhih gah nei ngeiloute ah leng panna nei kei unla, pan nak sang in adiklouhdan uh theisak zaw un.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

paite: Aguk a athilhih nakte uh agen lel leng azumhuai hi.
english: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.

paite: Himahleh thil bangkim adiklouhdan muh theih a om tuh vak hihlat ahi nak hi; muh theih a om peuhmah vak ahi ngal a.
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

paite: Huaiziak in “Nang ihmu! Hak inla, misi lak a kipan thou in. Huchi in Khrist in vak hon pe ding," chih ahi.
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

paite: Huan mihaite bang a om lou in, mipilte bang a om zaw in, na omdan uah pilvang un;
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

paite: nite ahoih louh ziak in hun na neih sung un atam theipen sem un.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

paite: Huaiziak in hai nuam kei unla, Toupa deihlam bang ahia chih thei zaw un.
english: Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

paite: Uain kham in om kei un, huai ah kideklouhna a-om hi; Kha a dim in om zaw un,
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

paite: phatna late, Pathian late, khalam late a kihoupih chiat a Toupa kiang a na lungtang tengteng ua ging kilawm bawl leh la sa in,
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

paite: i Toupa Jesu Khrist min a, Pathian, Pa ngei kiang a bangkim tung a kipahthu gen gige in.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

paite: Khrist laudan siam in kiniamkhiak chiat un.
english: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.

paite: Zite aw, Toupa kiang a na kiniamkhiak bang un, noumau pasalte kiang ah kiniamkhiak un.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

paite: Khrist amah ngei pumpi hondampa hi a, saptuamte lutang ahih mah bang in zi lutang tuh pasal ahi.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

paite: Huchi in saptuamte Khrist kiang a akiniamkhiak bang un bangkim ah apasalte uh kiang ah zite kiniamkhiak uhen.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

paite: Pasalte aw, na zite uh it un, Khrist in saptuamte a-it a, asik ua akipiak bang in,
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;

paite: huchi a ama'n tui a sil a, thu a ahihsiangthou theihna ding in;
english: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

paite: huchi a saptuamte nin baang lou, vuai lou leh huchibang thil mawngmawng pu lou a, siangthou leh gensiatbei a om zaw a, saptuamte amah-le-amah thupitak a akipiak theihna ding in.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

paite: Huchibang in pasalte'n leng amau pumpi mah bang in amau zite a-it ding uh ahi. Ama zi itpa amah ki-it ahi.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

paite: Kuamah in ama sa mah aho ngei kei, Khrist in saptuamte avak a adeihthoh bang in, avak in adeihthoh zaw hi;
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;

paite: ama sa leh guh a pan a om, apumpi hiangte i hi ngal ua.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

paite: Huaiziak in pasal in anu leh apa paisan in azi alen tinten ding a, anih un sapum khat ahong hita ding uhi.
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.” Genesis 2:24

paite: Hiai thuguk athupi hi, himahleh ke'n zaw Khrist leh saptuamte toh kisai ahi ka gen.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh, nou lak a kuapeuh in amah a ki-it bang in azi it hen; zi mah in leng apasal zahtak ding in pilvang hen.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

paite: Naupangte aw, Toupa ah na nu leh pate uh thu mang un, huai tuh thil dik ahi ngal a.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

paite: "Na nu leh pa zahtak in," hiai thupiak chiam nei masapen ahi.
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

paite: "Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih dia, lei ah leng na damsawt ding hi."
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.” Deuteronomy 5:16

paite: Huan nou pate aw, na tate uh hihthangpai kei unla, Toupa thuzohna leh hilhna ah kem zaw un.
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

paite: Sikhate aw, Khrist thumang bang in laudan siam leh ling kawm in lungtang khat in sadan a na pute uh thumang un;
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

paite: Mihing kipaksakte maimah bang a mitmei kia veng lou in, Khrist sikha bang a lungtang a Pathian deihlam hih zaw in.
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

paite: Mihing nasem phet hilou in, Toupa nasem bang zaw a chitaktak kawm a nna sem in,
english: with good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men;

paite: michih sikha hi in noplen himahleh thil hoih ahih bang mah Toupa kiang a kipan in angei mah amu nawn ding uh chih thei in.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

paite: Nou heutute aw, huchibang in amau leh noumau heutupa van ah a-om chih leh ama'n mi deihsak tuam anei kei chih thei in vau lou in atung uah hih sam un.
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

paite: Atawp pen in, Toupa leh ahatna thagui ah thilhihtheihna nei in hong om un.
english: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

paite: Diabol khemnate na dou zohtheihna ding un Pathian galvan kim in kivan un.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

paite: I doute zaw sa leh sisan ahi kei ua, lalnate leh thuneihnate leh tu a om lel mial tung a khovel vaihawmte leh van munte a kha gilouhon omte ahi zaw uhi.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

paite: Huaiziak in ni hoih lou a na douzohna ding un leh na hihzoh vek nung ua leng na dintheihna ding un, Pathian galvan kim la un.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

paite: Na kawng uh thutak a gak in, diktatna awmphaw zang in,
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

paite: lemna tanchinhoih vanzat na khe ua bun in dingh un.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;

paite: Huaite ban ah ginna lum la unla, huai in migilou thal kuangthei tengteng na hihmit thei ding uhi.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

paite: Huan hotdamna lukhu leh Kha namsau, Pathian thu la unla;
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word from Greek rhema, which means spoken word of God;

paite: thumna leh ngetna chiteng in bangchik lai peuh in Kha ah thum un. Huai lam ah misiangthou tengteng a ding in phatuamngai leh ngen bilbel in limsak un.
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:

paite: Tanchinhoih thuguk hangsantak a theisak ding a, ka kam ka kat a, thu gensak a ka omtheihna ding in kei a ding in leng hon ngetsak un.
english: on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

paite: Ka gen ding bang hangsantak a ka gentheihna ding in, huai tanchinhoih palai khainiang bun ka hi.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

paite: Himahleh nou leng bangchibang in ka om hiam ka tanchin na theihtheihna ding un, Taikikas, Toupa a unau deihtak leh nasempa muanhuai in bangkim ahon theisak ding hi.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things;

paite: Huaiziak in amah na kiang uah ka hon sawl ahi, ka tanchin uh na theihna ding uleh ama'n na lungtang uh akhamuan theihna ding in.
english: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.

paite: Unaute kiang ah Pa Pathian leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan lemna leh ginna tel itna om hen.
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist tul lou a itte tengteng kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

paite: Paul, Jesu Khrist leh misi lak a kipan a kaithoupa, Pa Pathian ziak a sawltak, mihing sawlkhiak hilou, mihing vang a leng hi sam lou,
english: Paul, an apostle (not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead),

paite: leh ka kiang a unau om tengtengte'n, Galatia gam a saptuamte kiang ah:
english: and all the brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

paite: Pa Pathian leh i Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Ama'n i Pathian leh Pa deihdan in, tulai khovel giloutak lak a ahon suahtaksak theihna ding in i khelhnate a ding in amah mah ahong kipeta hi.
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

paite: Pathian kiang ah thupina tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Khrist hehpihna ziak a nou hon sampa huchi guih a tanchinhoih tuam lam a na kisuansan uh lamdang ka sa hi.
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”;

paite: Tanchinhoih dang om ahi kei a; noumau hon hihbuai in Khrist tanchinhoih hihlamdan ut kuate hiam a-om uh ahi zaw hi.
english: and there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

paite: Himahleh koumau hiam, van a kipan hong suk angel nangawn in leng, tanchinhoih na kiang ua ka gensa pen lou ngal uh tanchinhoih dang himhim hon na hilhta a-om uleh hamsiat in om uhen.
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

paite: Tuma a ka gen bang un, tua gen nawn ding ka hi. Tanchinhoih na muh pen lou ngal uh, tanchinhoih dang kuapeuh in nou ahon hilhleh hamsiat in om uhen.
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

paite: Ahihleh tu in mihing maipha hia ka zon, Pathian a? Ahihkeileh mihing ahi maw lungtaisak ka tup? Mihing ana lungtaisak lel hi taleng, Khrist sikha ka hi kei ding hi.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, ka tanchinhoih gen pen mihing a pan ahi kei chih ka hon theisak hi.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

paite: Mihing kiang a kipan a ka muh leng ahi kei, mi hon hilh leng ka hi sam kei, Jesu Khrist kilakna ziak amu ka hi zaw hi.
english: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

paite: Judate sabiakdan a nidanglai ka omdan na thei khinta ngal ua, huchi a Pathian saptuamte nakpitak a sawi in sukchimih ka na sawm gige hi.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.

paite: Huan ka pipute thugousiah tung a phatuam ka ngaih tuankhol ziak in Judate sabiakdan lam ah ka chipihte lak a ka khanvual tampite ka na khengta hi.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

paite: Ka nu gilsung a kipan a hon hihtuampa leh ahehpihna ziak a hon sampa Pathian in,
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me through his grace,

paite: Zentelte lak a ka hilhtheihna ding a, ama Tapa lungkimtak a keimah a akilaksak lai in, sa leh sisan toh kidong lou in,
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

paite: sawltak ka hih ma a sawltak ana hisate kiang a Jerusalem a hohtou tuan lou in, Arabia gam ah ka paimang pah a; huan Damaskas ah ka kik nawnta hi.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

paite: Kum thum abei nung in Kifas veh ding in Jerusalem ah ka va hohtou a, akiang ah ni sawm-le-nga ka taam hi.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

paite: Sawltak dangte, Toupa unau Jakob kia lou ngal kuamah ka mu kei hi.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord’s brother.

paite: Na kiang ua ka thugelhte ngai dih ua, Pathian mitmuh ah ka zuau kei hi.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

paite: Huai nung in Siria leh Silisia gamte ah ka pai hi.
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

paite: Judia gam a saptuam, Khrist a omte meltheih ka hi nai kei lai hi,
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

paite: "Tuma lam a khatvei ginna thu sukchimih tum a hon sawipa'n tu in huai thu agen zawta," chih mi gen kia aza uhi.
english: but they only heard: “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

paite: Huan keimah ziak in Pathian apahtawita uhi.
english: And they glorified God in me.

paite: Kum sawm-le-li abei nung in Titas mah leng pi in, Barnabas toh Jerusalem ah ka va hohtou nawn hi.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

paite: Kilakna ziak a va hohtou ka hi a, Zentelte kiang a tanchinhoih ka tangkoupih amau ka va hilh a; himahleh milian deuhte atuam in ka hilh a; huchi lou in zaw athawn a tai kha hiam ahihkeileh taithawnta ka hi kha ding hi.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

paite: Himahleh ka kiang a om Titas hial leng Grik mi himahleh zeksumsak teitei in a-om kei hi.
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

paite: Huai unau tak lou, aguk a pilut a omte, sal a ahon laktheihna ding ua Khrist Jesu a noplenna i neih uh enkhe ding a hong lutte ziak in ahi.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;

paite: Himahleh noute a dia huai tanchinhoih thutak a bittak a kep ahihtheihna ding in amau kiang ah mitphiat kal lel leng ka kipe himhim kei uhi.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

paite: Hihna deuh min nei mahmahte bangchibang hihna nei mah le uh kei a ding in alamdanna a-om kei hi. Pathian in kuamah akhentuam kei a; huai min nei mahmahte thugen in bangmah hon behlap kei hi.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important (whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man)—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

paite: Huchih nak sang in zeksumte kiang a tanchinhoih Peter kiang a kepsak a a-om bang in zeksumlouhte kiang a tanchinhoih kei kiang ah kepsak in a-om chih athei zaw uhi.
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcision, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcision

paite: Zeksumte sawltak hi ding a Peter a sempa mah in Zentelte sawltak hi ding in kei ah asem hi.
english: (for he who appointed Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision appointed me also to the Gentiles);

paite: Huan kei kiang a piak a om hehpihna amuh un, Jakob, Kifas, Johan, khuam muanhuai leh min neite'n amau bel zeksumte kiang a hoh ding leh kou Zentelte kiang a hoh ding in kei leh Barnabas kithuahna khut taklam hon pe zawta uhi.
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

paite: Gentheite ka theihgige lel uh adeih ua, huai mah hih ka tum tinten hi.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

paite: Huan Antiok a Peter ahong pai lai a demhuai mahmah a a-om ziak in amaitang ngei ah ka kalh hi.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

paite: Jakob kiang a kipan mi kuate hiam ahong pai ma un ama'n Zentelte kiang ah an ane zel a; himahleh ahong tuntak un zeksumte akihtak ziak in pang nawn lou in akikoihtuamta hi.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

paite: Juda dangte leng alepchiah chiat sam ua, huchi in Barnabas hilhial leng alepchiahna uah pimang in a-om zou hial hi.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

paite: Tanchinhoih thutak bang in a-om kei uh chih ka theih in avek ua ma ah Peter kiang ah, "Nang Juda mi na hi ngal a, Judate om bang a om lou in Zentelte om bang a na om zawkleh bangchidan ahia Judate om bang a Zentelte na omsak teitei nak?" ka chi hi.
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

paite: Ei zaw Zentel mikhialte hilou in, Juda mi him a piang i hi uhi.
english: “We, being Jews by nature, and not Gentile sinners,

paite: Himahleh dan thilhihte ziak in mi siamtang in a-om kei, Jesu Khrist ginna ziak in siamtang in a-om zaw uh chih i thei uhi; e'n leng dan thilhih ziak hilou in, Khrist ginna ziak a siamtang a i omtheihna ding in, Khrist Jesu i gingta hi; dan thilhihte ziak in mihing himhim siamtang a om lou ding uh ahi.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

paite: Ahihleh Khrist a siamtang a om tum kawmpi a eite mikhialte i na hih nakleh Khrist khelhna omsakpa hita ve maw le! Hilou hial!
english: But if, while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

paite: Ka thilhihsiatte ka lam nawn zel in zaw, talekpa ka hi chih ka kitheisak phet ahi ding hi.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

paite: Pathian lam a dia ka hong hintheihna ding in, kei zaw dan ziak in dan lam ah ka si khinta hi.
english: For I, through the law, died to the law, that I might live to God.

paite: Khrist toh kilhden in ka omta; himahleh ka hing ahi; keimah pen ka hita kei a, keimah ah Khrist ahing ahi zaw; tua sa a ka hin bel ginna a hing ka hi; Pathian Tapa, hon it a ka sik a kipepa pen ginna ah.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ living in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.

paite: Pathian hehpihna bangmah lou in ka bawl kei, dan ziak a diktatna a om in zaw Khrist athawn a si ahi kha ding hi.
english: I don’t make void the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

paite: Nou Galatia mihaite aw, kua'n hon bumhai amaizen a? Na mitmuh ngei ua Jesu Khrist kilhden a kichiantak a lahsak zaw hiven maw.
english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth among you as crucified?

paite: Hiai leltak ka hon dong ding; dan thilhihte ziak in hia Kha na muh uh, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak ziak un?
english: I just want to learn this from you. Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

paite: Hichi tel in na hai uh maw? Kha a pan khin ngal in, sa in na zou ding ua hia?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

paite: Thil huchi zahzah athawn a thuak na hi uh maw? Athawn taktak na hitaleh.
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

paite: Na kiang ua Kha hon pepa leh na lak ua thillamdang hihpa'n dan thilhihte ziak in hia ahih, na ngaihkhiak ua na gintak ziak un?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and works miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

paite: "Abraham in Pathian agingta a, huai ginna diktatna a simsak ahih tak mah bang in,"
english: Even as Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

paite: Huchi in thei un, ginna a omte Abram tate ahi uhi.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.

paite: Huan Laisiangthou in, "Pathian in ginna ziak in Zentelte siamtangsak ding in akisa chih theikhol in, nangmah ah namte vualzawlsak in a-om ding uh," chi in Abraham kiang ah tanchinhoih ana genkholta hi.
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.” Genesis 12:3; 18:18; 22:18

paite: Huchi in ginna a omte ginna mipa Abraham toh vualzawlsak in a-om sam nak uhi.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

paite: Dan thilhih a kinga peuhmahte hamse nuai ah a-om uhi, "Dan laibu a thugelh tengteng bang a hih gige lou peuhmah hamsiat in om hen," chi a gelh ahi.
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.” Deuteronomy 27:26

paite: Tu in Pathian mitmuh in kuamah dan a siamtang a-om kei, "Midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding,” chih ahih ziak in chih alang kilkel hi.
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.” Habakkuk 2:4

paite: Himahleh dan zaw ginna a kinga ahi kei; huchibang a hihpa huaite in ahing ding chih ahi zaw hi.
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.” Leviticus 18:5

paite: Eite sik in Khrist hamsiat in ahong om a, dan hamsia a kipan in ahon tankheta hi, "Sing a khailup peuhmah hamsiat hi hen," chih gelh ahih bang in.
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,” Deuteronomy 21:23

paite: Huchi a Abraham tung a vualzawlnate Khrist Jesu ziak a Zentelte tung ahong tun theih a, ginna ziak a chiam a om Kha pen i muhtheihna ding in.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

paite: Unaute aw, mihing hihdan in gen leng; mihing thukhun leltak leng, hihkipsa nung aphel kei ua, behlap leng abehlap ngei kei uhi.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.

paite: Abraham kiang ah leh achisuante kiang ah thuchiamte piak ana hi. Mi tampi tungthu gen bang in, "Chisuante kiang ah," achi kei a; mi khat tungthu gen bang in, "Nang chisuan kiang ah," achi zaw a, huai tuh Khrist ahi.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He doesn’t say, “To seeds,” as of many, but as of one, “To your seed,” Genesis 12:7; 13:15; 24:7 which is Christ.

paite: Huchi in hiai ka chi ahi; huai thuchiam bangmah lou suaksak a hihmang ding in, thukhun Pathian in ana hihkipsa, anung kum zali-le-sawmthum khit a hong om, dan in ahihmang thei kei hi.
english: Now I say this. A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

paite: Gouluah ding thu dan ziak ahihleh thuchiam ziak ahita kei ding a; himahleh Pathian in Abraham kiang ah thuchiam ziak in ahi ana piak.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

paite: Ahihkeileh bangchi thu a dan om ahia le? Chisuan thuchiamna ahong om masiah tatleknate ziak in behlap in a-om a, angelte zang a palai khut a hihkip ahi.
english: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

paite: Huan palai himhim mi khat lak ah palai ahi ngei kei hi; Pathian bel khat ahi.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

paite: Ahihkeileh dan in Pathian thuchiamte akalh hia? Kalh lou hial! Hihhing thei himhim dan piak a om na hitaleh, dan ziak in diktatna a-om ngei ding hi.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

paite: Himahleh Jesu Khrist gin ziak a thilchiam a gingtate kiang a piak ahihtheihna ding in Laisiangthou in khelhna nuai ah bangkim akhakkhum vekta hi.
english: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

paite: Himahleh ginna ahong tun ma in ginna hong kilang ding ah khakkhum in dan nuai a ven i na hi uhi.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

paite: Huchi in ginna ziak a siam i tantheihna ding in huai dan tuh Khrist hon chilpa ahi.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

paite: Himahleh ginna ahong tun in, hon chilpa nuai ah i omta kei uhi.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

paite: Khrist Jesu gin ziak in Pathian tate na hi vek uhi.
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

paite: Noute Khrist a baptis lut a omsate Khrist in na kithuamta uhi.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

paite: Huai ah Juda mi a-om kei a, Grik mi leng a-om kei; huai ah sikha a-om kei a, noplen leng a-om kei; huai ah pasal leh numei leng a-om kei hi. Khrist Jesu ah na vek un pum khat na hi uhi.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

paite: Huan Khrist a na hih uleh Abraham suan thuchiam bang a gouluah dingte na hi uhi.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to promise.

paite: Himahleh huchi in ka chi ahi, Gouluah dingpa bangkim tung ah toupa himahleh naupang ahih lai teng sikha toh bangmah in akilamdang kei;
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;

paite: apa hun seh ahong tun masiah achilpa leh akempa nuai ah a-om hi.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

paite: Huchibang in ei leng naupang i hih lai in, khovel thubulte nuai ah sikha in i om uhi.
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

paite: Himahleh ahunbi ahong kim in, Pathian in a Tapa, numei suan in, dan nuai a hong suak in ahon sawlkhia hi;
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

paite: ta hihna i muhtheihna ding leh dan nuai a omte tankhe ding in.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.

paite: Huan tate na hih ziak un Pathian in a Tapa Kha, "Abba, Pa,” chi a kikou in, i lungtang uah ahon sawl hi.
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Abba is a Greek spelling for the Aramaic word for “Father” or “Daddy” used in a familiar, respectful, and loving way. Father!”

paite: Huchi in sikha na hita kei ua, ta na hi zawta uhi; huan ta na hihleh Pathian vang a gouluah ding na hi uhi.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

paite: Hinapi, tuma Pathian na theih louh lai un, apiandan mawng ua pathian hilou hialte sikha na hi uhi.
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

paite: Himahleh tu a Pathian na hon theih nung un bel, ahihkeileh Pathian theihmi na hong hih nung un chih ding ahi zaw; thubul zawngkhal leh namanloute nuai a bangchidan a bawi a tan ut nawn na hi ua?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

paite: Nite, khate, hunte, kumte na tang zel ua.
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

paite: Na tung uah tha ka sengthawn kha ding chih ka lau hi.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

paite: Unaute aw, ka hon ngen ahi, keimah bang in om un, kei leng noumau bang in ka om a, ka bangmah na hihse kei uhi.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

paite: Tanchinhoih na kiang ua ka gen masakna pen ka sa hat louh ziak ahi chih na thei uhi.
english: but you know that because of weakness of the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

paite: Huan ka sa a nou a dia khemna om tuh na simmoh kei ua, na kih sam kei uh; Pathian angel bang leh Khrist Jesu bang hial in na hon pakta zaw uhi.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

paite: Vangpha na kisakna uh koi a omta ahia le? Hihtheih liai hileh na mit uh khelkhia in na hon pe khin ding uh chih ka hon theihpih ahi.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

paite: Thutak ka hon hilh ziak in na melma uh ka hong hita a hia?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

paite: Amau noute phatuamngaitak in, ahoih lam deih hilou napi in ahon zol ua; ahi, amau a dia phattuam na ngaih theihna ding ua koute a kipan posiah a hon omsak a-ut uhi.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

paite: Atup ahoih nakleh ahoih lam ah chik lai peuh in phatuamngaih gige ahoih hi, na kiang ua ka om lai kia hilou in.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

paite: Ka unaute aw, Khrist noumau a siam piching a a-om masiah nauvei in ka hon vei hi.
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

paite: Ahi, tulai in na kiang ua om a, ka awsuah hihlamdan ka ut theihdan; na tungthu uah ka mang abang ahi.
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

paite: Dan nuai a om utte aw, hon hilh un, dan in agen na thei kei ua hia?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

paite: Hichibang a gelh ahi: Abraham in tapa nih anei a, khat sikhanu toh khat noplennu toh ahi.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the free woman.

paite: Himahleh sikhanu lak a pen sadan in apiang a, noplennu lak a pen bel thuchiam ziak a piang ahi.
english: However, the son by the handmaid was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

paite: Huai thilte etsakna ahi, huai numeite thukhun nih ahi uh; khat Sinai Tang a sikha hi ding a ta neinu, Hagar ahi.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

paite: Huan Hagar bel Arabia gam a Sinai Tang ahi a, tulai a om Jerusalem toh kibang ahi, atate toh sikha in a-om uhi.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

paite: Tunglam Jerusalem bel noplen ahi; huai ngeingei eite nu ahi.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

paite: "Nang chiing, ta nei ngei lou, nuam in, nang, nauvei ngei lou, kikoukhia in; pasal neinu sang in lungzuangnu tate tamzaw ding ahi ngal a," chih gelh ahi.
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break forth and shout, you that don’t travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.” Isaiah 54:1

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, eite Isak bang in thuchiam tate i hi uhi.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

paite: Himahleh huai lai bang in tu in leng ahi; sadan a piang in Khadan a piang asawi ahi.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

paite: Himahleh Laisiangthou in bangchi in agen a? "Bawinu atapa toh hawlkhia un; bawinu tapa in noplennu tapa gou aluahpih louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: However what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the handmaid and her son, for the son of the handmaid will not inherit with the son of the free woman.” Genesis 21:10

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, bawinu tate i hi kei ua, noplennu tate i hi zaw uhi.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the free woman.

paite: Noplending in khrist in ahon suaktasakta, huaiziak in dingkip unla, bawi hakkol ah zaw lut nawn kei un.
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

paite: Ngai un kei Paul in na kiang ua ka gen, zek na sum uleh Khrist nou a ding in bangmah phattuamna hilou ding ahi.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

paite: Ahi a, dan thu tengteng zui ding a bate ana hi uh chih zeksumte tengteng kiang ah ka theisak nawn ahi.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

paite: Nou dan a siamtan tumte aw, Khrist toh kikhenta na hi ua, hehpihna na puksanta uhi.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

paite: Kou bel Kha ziak in ginna in diktatna lametna ka ngak uhi.
english: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

paite: Khrist Jesu ah zeksum bangmah aphatuam kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah aphatuam sam kei; itna a sem ginna bel aphatuam hi.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.

paite: Hoihtak in na tai uhi. Kua'n thutak zui lou ding a hon dal ahia?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

paite: Hiai khemna zaw nou hon sampa kiang a kipan ahi kei hi.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

paite: Silngou tawmchik in tanghou beupi azelsuak hi.
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

paite: Kei ngaihtuahna bang lou in na ngaihtuah lamdang tuan kei ding uh chih Toupa ah ka hon muang hi; himahleh nou hon hihbuaite, akua akua hita le uh vaihawmna atung ua kia pen athuak ding uh ahi.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

paite: Unaute aw, ke'n zeksum thu gen lailai ka hihleh, bangziak a sawi a om lailai ka hia? Huchibang ahih ngalleh kros kisuihna tuh hihmang ahita ding hi.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

paite: Nou hon hihbuaite satkhiak in om vanglak le uh ka deih ahi.
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

paite: Nou unaute aw, noplen ding a sap na hi ua; himahleh na noplenna uh sa a ding a lemtanna in zang kei unla, itna in akua akua a ding a kisepsakte hi zaw un.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

paite: Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi, chih thu kam khat ah dan thu tengteng kimsak in a-om hi.
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Leviticus 19:18

paite: Himahleh na kikeih ua, na kinektuah uleh na kinekgaihlouhna ding un pilvang un.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

paite: Huchi in hiai ka chi ahi, Kha ah om un, huchi in taksa utna na hihtangtung kei ding uhi.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

paite: Sa in Kha adou nak a, Kha in leng sa adou hi; thilhih na tupte uh na hihtheihlouhna ding un huaite akikalh uh ahi.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

paite: Himahleh Kha pi a na om uleh dan nuai ah na om kei uhi.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

paite: Huan sa thilhihte akilangchian hi, huaite hiaite ahi uh: angkawmna, kingaihna, thanghuaina, hukna,
english: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

paite: milim biakna, bumna, huatna, kinakna, hazatna, hehna, kilanna, omtuamna, gintuamna,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

paite: deihgohna, tualthahna, zukhamna, zumun uangtatna, huchibang thilhih chingte'n Pathian lalgam atang kei ding uh chi a tuma a ka hon hilhkholh mah bang in, ka hon hilhkhol ahi.
english: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.

paite: Kha gah ahihleh, itna, kipahna, lemna, thuaktheihna, migitna, hoihna, muanhuaina,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, or, faithfulness

paite: nunnemna, kidektheihnate ahi zaw uhi; huchibang kalh lam in dan himhim a-om kei hi.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

paite: Khrist Jesu a hitate'n sa, alunggulhna leh aduhgawlna toh akilhdenta uhi.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

paite: Kha a hing i hihleh kha mah ah i om ding uhi.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

paite: Kitawngtuah a, kihaza chiat in, i kikoihlian kei ding uhi.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

paite: Unaute aw, mi takhial bangpeuh ahih lai phawk a na omleh nou khamite aw, khemna ka tuak sam kha ding e, chi a kivenghoih kawm in, huai bang mi nunnemna lungsim toh tungding thak nawn un.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

paite: Na puakgikte uh kidawn chiat un, huchi in Khrist dan na zui uh ahi ding.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

paite: Mi bangmah hiloupi in mi liankuam a akibawlleh amah kikhem tawm lel ahi.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

paite: Michih in amah thilhih ki-enchian hen; huchi a midang toh kiteh a, ki-uangsak lou a, amah mah a suanhuai thil ahihtheihna ding in.
english: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.

paite: Michih in ama puak mah po ding ahi ngal a.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

paite: Thuhilh a ommi in thil hoih tengteng ahilhpa kiang ah pe sam hen.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

paite: Zekhem in om kei un; Pathian zaw khem a mawkbawl vual ahi kei; mi'n atuh peuh uh huai mah at nawn ngei ding ahih ziak un.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

paite: Amah salam a tuh in sa a om siatna a-at ding a, khalam a tuh in bel kha a kipan tangtawn hinna a-at ding hi.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

paite: Huchi in thil hoih hih chimtak kei ni; i lungkiak keileh ahuntak ah i at ngei ding uhi.
english: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.

paite: Huchi in lemtang hun i neihdan bang zel in mi tengteng tung ah thil hoih hih ni, ginna inkuanpihte lak a omte tung ah hi kholdiak hen.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

paite: Keimah khut mahmah a na kiang ua laimal gol pipi a ka gelh en un.
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

paite: Sa a mel kilawmsak utte peuhmah in zeksum a om ding in nou ahon sawl teitei nak uhi; bangmah dang ziak ahi kei, Khrist kros ziak a sawina athuaklouhna ding lel uh ahi.
english: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

paite: Zeksumte nangawn in leng dan azui tuan sam kei ua, na sa uah, suan ding aneihtheihna ding un na zek uh kisumleh chih a-ut lel uh ahi.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

paite: Ke'n zaw i Toupa Jesu Khrist kros lou ngal ka suan louh ding dan, huai kros ziak in khovel kei a ding in kilhden in a-om a, kei leng khovel a ding in kilhden in ka om hi.
english: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

paite: Siam thak nawnna lou zaw zeksum bangmah ahi kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah ahi sam kei hi.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

paite: Huai dan bang a om peuhmahte tung ah lemna leh zahngaihna, Israel' Pathian tung ngei ah om hen.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

paite: Tuban siah kuamah in hon hihbuai nawn kei hen; ka pumpi ah Jesu chiamtehnate ka pu ngal a.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

paite: Unaute aw, Toupa Jesu Khrist hehpihna na kha uah om hen. Amen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

paite: Atung in Pathian in lei leh vante asiam hi.
english: In the beginning God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” After “God,” the Hebrew has the two letters “Aleph Tav” (the first and last letters of the Hebrew alphabet) as a grammatical marker. created the heavens and the earth.

paite: Lei tuh lim leh mel nei lou in, avuak kia ahi a, tui thukpi tung mial in amial hi. Pathian Kha in tuite tung a-opkhum hi.
english: Now the earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep. God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

paite: Pathian in, "Vak om hen," achi a, huchi in vak ahong omta hi.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

paite: Pathian in vak a-en a, hoih asa hi. Huchi in Pathian in mial a pan vak akhenkheta hi.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

paite: Pathian in vak, "Sun" achi a, mial, "Zan" achi hi. Huchi in ani khatna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: God called the light “day,” and the darkness he called “night.” There was evening and there was morning, one day.

paite: Pathian in, "Tuite kikal ah vansin om henla, huai in tuite a pan tuite khenkhia hen," achi hi.
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

paite: Pathian in vansin abawl a, vansin tung a tui omte a pan vansin nuai a tui omte akhenkhia a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

paite: Pathian in vansin, "Van" achi hi. Huchi in ani nihna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: God called the expanse “sky.” There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

paite: Pathian in, "Van nuai a tuite mun khat ah omkhawm uh henla, gamkeu hong dawk hen," achi a; huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear”; and it was so.

paite: Pathian in gamkeu, "Lei" achi a; tui omkhawmte Tuipite achi hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas.” God saw that it was good.

paite: Pathian in, "Lei in loupate, anteh chi neite, thei sing lei a amau chi omdan ding bang zel a gah, agah sung a chi omte omsak hen," achi a, huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seed, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with its seed in it, on the earth”; and it was so.

paite: Huchi in lei in loupate, anteh amau chi omdan ding bang a chi neite, sing amau chi omdan ding bang a gah, agah sung a chi omte a-omsak hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with its seed in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

paite: Huchi in ani thumna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

paite: Pathian in, "Sun leh zan khenna ding in vansin ah tanvakte om uhenla, huaite chiamtehnate, hunbite, nite leh kumte theihna hi uhen.
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years;

paite: Lei tanvak ding in van a vansin ah vakte om uhen," achi a, huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of sky to give light on the earth”; and it was so.

paite: Pathian in tanvak thupi nih abawl a; tanvak thupizaw pen sun a vaihawm ding in, tanvak thupi louzaw pen zan a vaihawm ding in abawl hi. Aksite leng abawl hi.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

paite: Pathian in huaite lei tanvak ding in van a vansin ah akoih a;
english: God set them in the expanse of sky to give light to the earth,

paite: sun tung leh zan tung a vaihawm ding leh vak leh mial khen ding in. Huchi in Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

paite: Huchi in ani lina ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

paite: Pathian in, "Tuite'n thilsiam tang thei hinna neite tampi pawtsak uhenla, vasate leng leitung a vansin hawm heuhou ah leng uhen," achi hi.
english: God said, “Let the waters swarm with swarms of living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of sky.”

paite: Pathian in ngapi liante asiam a, ganhing tang thei chiteng tui in apawtsak a, amaute chi omdan ding bang leh kha nei vasa chiteng amaute chi omdan ding bang in asiam hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: God created the large sea creatures, and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

paite: Pathian in, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, tuipi tuite dimsak unla, vasate leng lei ah pung uhen," chi in avualzawl hi.
english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

paite: Huchi in ani ngana ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

paite: Pathian in, "Lei in ganhing amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in; gante, bokvak a pai ganhingte, gamsate, amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in pawtsak uhen," achi a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind”; and it was so.

paite: Pathian in gamsa amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in, gante amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in, lei a thil bokvak a paite tengteng amau chi omdan ding bang chiat in abawl hi. Pathian in huai a-en a, hoih asa hi.
english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

paite: Pathian in, "I kibatpih in, eimah bang in mihing i bawl dia, tuipi a ngasate tung ah, tung a leng vasate tung ah, gante tung ah leh leitung tengteng tung ah thu i neisak ding," achi hi.
english: God said, “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

paite: Pathian in ama kibatpih in mihing asiam a, akibatpih mah in ahi asiam; pasal leh numei asiamta hi.
english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

paite: Pathian in amaute avualzawl hi. Pathian mah in akiang uah, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, leitung luahdim unla, na thuthu un omsak un. Tuipi a ngasate tung ah, tung a leng vasate tung ah, thil hing leitung a bokvak a pai tengteng tung ah thu nei un," achi hi.
english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

paite: Pathian mah in, "Ngai un, leitung tengteng a anteh chi nei om teng leh sing chiteng, sing chi nei gah omnate, ka hon pia hi; na an ding uh ahi.
english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

paite: Lei a gamsa chiteng kiang ah, tung a leng vasa chiteng kiang ah, leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng kiang ah, hinna nei chiteng kiang ah a-an ding un loupa hing chiteng ka pia hi," achi a; huan huchibang ahong hita hi.
english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food”; and it was so.

paite: Pathian in athilsiam tengteng a-en a, ngai in, hoih asa mahmah hi. Huchi in ani gukna ah nitaklam a-om a, zinglam leng a-om hi.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

paite: Hiaite Noah tapa Shem, Ham leh Japheth suante ahi uh. Tuichim tun nung in tapate anei chiat uhi.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

paite: Japheth tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek leh Tiras ahi uh.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

paite: Gomer tapate: Ashkenaz, Riphath leh Togarmah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

paite: Javan tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim leh Dodanim ahi uh.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

paite: Huaite a kipan in Zentelte, amau pau leh amau nam dungzui zel in, amau chite omna tuikulh gam, amau gamte ah akikhenzak uhi.
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

paite: Ham tapate: Kush, Mizraim, Put leh Kanaan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

paite: Kush tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah leh Sabtekhah ahi uh. Raamah tapate: Sheba leh Dedan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

paite: Kush in tapa Nimrod anei hi. Amah leitung ah mihattak ahong hi panta hi.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.

paite: TOUPA ma ah sabengmi hattak ahi a; huaiziak in ahi, "TOUPA ma a sabet hattak Nimrod bang ahi," achih zel uh.
english: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “Like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh.”

paite: Alal patna Shinar gam a Babel khua, Erek khua, Akkad khua leh Shinar gam a Kalneh khua ahi uh.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

paite: Huai gam a kipan apawt a, Assuria gam ah alut a, Nineveh khua, Rehoboth-Ir khua leh Kalah khua asat hi.
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

paite: Nineveh leh Kalah kikal ah Resen khua asat a, huai Resen khua thupitak ahi.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (the same is the great city).

paite: Mizraim in Ludte, Anamte, Lehabte, Naphtuhte,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

paite: Pathruste leh Kasluhte, Philistiate leh Kaphtorte pawtna asuang hi.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

paite: Kanaan in tapa masa Zidon anei a, Heth leng anei lai a,
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

paite: Jebuste, Amorte, Girgaste;
english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

paite: Hivte, Arkate, Sinte;
english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

paite: Arvadte, Zemarte, Hamathte asuang; huai nung in Kanaan namte akithehzakta uhi.
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

paite: Kanaante gamgi Zidon a kipan Gerar, Gaza, Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboim leh Lasa khua tan ahi.
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon, as you go toward Gerar, to Gaza; as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, to Lasha.

paite: Huaite, anamte dungzui zel leh apaute, agamte leh anamte lak ua dungzui zel in Ham suante ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their languages, in their lands, in their nations.

paite: Shem, Eber ta tengteng suangpa, Japheth upa'n leng tate anei hi.
english: To Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.

paite: Shem tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud leh Aram ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

paite: Aram tapate: Uz, Hul, Gether leh Mash ahi uh.
english: The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

paite: Arpakshad in tapa Shelah anei a; Shelah in tapa Eber anei hi.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

paite: Eber in tapa nih anei a: khat min Peleg ahi a, adam lai a leitung akikhen ziak in; anau min Joktan ahi.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

paite: Joktan in tapa Almodad, Seleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah;
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

paite: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah;
Obal, Abimael, Sheba;
Ophir, Havilah leh Jobab anei a; huai tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

paite: Atenna uh Mesha a kipan suahlam tang Sephar tan ahi.
english: Their dwelling was from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

paite: Huaite Shem suante ahi ua; anamte dungzui zel leh apaute dungzui zel in, agamte ah leh achite dungzui zel in.
english: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their languages, in their lands, after their nations.

paite: Huaite Noah suan namte ahi ua, asuante uh dungzui zel in achite uh lak ah; tuichim tun nung in huaite a kipan ahi a; lei a chi chih khenkhiak ahi uhi.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations. Of these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.

paite: Huan lei a mi tengteng in khat leh paudan khat anei uhi.
english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, suahlam a kipan akisuan zel lai un, Shinar gam ah phaizang amu ua; huai ah atengta uhi.
english: It happened, as they traveled east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

paite: "Kisa un, teklei i bawl ding a, hoihtak in i hal ding," akichita uhi. Suang sik in teklei anei ua, suang hukna sik in longnai anei uhi.
english: They said one to another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

paite: "Kisa un, khopi i bawl ding a, avum in van sun ding in insang i bawl ding ua, i min i thangsak ding uh. Huchi lou in zaw leitung pumpi ah thehdalh in i om kha ding," achi uhi.
english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make ourselves a name, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

paite: Mite tate' khopi leh insang lam en ding in TOUPA ahohsuk hi.
english: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih ua, mite pum khat ahi ua, avek un lah pau khat anei ngal ua; hiai thil ahih pan uhi. Tu'n zaw athil hihtupte uh leng kham vual ahita kei ding.
english: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

paite: Kisa un, i va hohsuk ding ua, pau akitheihtuah louhna ding un, apau uh i va suk lamdangsak ding," akichi uhi.
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N amaute huai a pan leitung tengteng ah adalhsak hi. Huchi in akhopi bawl uh atawpsanta uhi.
english: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

paite: Huaiziak in amin Babel achi ua; TOUPA'N leitung tengteng ah amaute adalhsakta hi.
english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

paite: Hiaite Shem suante ahi uh. Shem kum zakhat a upa ahi a; tuichim tun nung kum nih nung in tapa Arpakshad anei hi.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem. Shem was one hundred years old and became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

paite: Arpakshad aneih nung in Shem kum zanga adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Arpakshad in kum sawmthum-le-nga ahih in tapa Shelah anei hi.
english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

paite: Shelah aneih nung in Arpakshad kum zali-le-thum adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Shelah in kum sawmthum ahih in tapa Eber anei hi.
english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber:

paite: Eber aneih nung in Shelah kum zali-le-thum adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: and Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Eber in kum sawmthum-le-li ahih in tapa Peleg anei hi.
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

paite: Peleg aneih nung in Eber kum zali-le-sawmthum adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Peleg in kum sawmthum ahih in tapa Reu anei hi.
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

paite: Reu aneih nung in Peleg kum zanih-le-kua adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Reu in kum sawmthum-le-nih ahih in, tapa Serug anei hi.
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

paite: Serug aneih nung in Reu kum zanih-le-sagih adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Serug in kum sawmthum ahih in tapa Nahor anei hi.
english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

paite: Nahor aneih nung in Serug kum zanih adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Nahor in kum sawmnih-le-kua ahih in tapa Terah anei hi.
english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

paite: Terah aneih nung in Nahor kum za-le-sawmkua adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Terah in kum sawmsagih ahih in tapate Abram, Nahor leh Haran anei hi.
english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

paite: Hiaite Terah suante ahi ua: Terah in tapa Abram, Nahor leh Haran anei a; Haran in tapa Lot anei hi.
