english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

paite: Haran ahihleh apianna gam, Kaldaite khua Ur ah, apa Terah ma in asi hi.
english: Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees.

paite: Abram leh Nahor in zi anei ua; Abram zi min Sarai ahi a, Nahor zi min Haran tanu Milkah ahi. Haran ahihleh Milkah pa leh Iskah pa ahi.
english: Abram and Nahor took wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran who was also the father of Iscah.

paite: Sarai achiing a; ta himhim anei kei.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

paite: Terah in atapa Abram, atapa Haran tapa Lot, amou, atapa Abram zi Sarai api a; Kanaan a hoh ding in Kaldaite khua Ur a kipan apawtkhekhawm uhi. Haran ahong tung ua, huai ah ateng uhi.
english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

paite: Terah damsung kum zanih-le-nga ahi a, Haran ah Terah asi hi.
english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Abram kiang ah, "Na khua a kipan leh na tanaute a kipan leh na pa inn a kipan pawt inla, ka hon etsak ding gam ah pai in.
english: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Get out of your country, and from your relatives, and from your father’s house, to the land that I will show you.

paite: Chi thupi mahmah in ka hon bawl dia, ka hon vualzawl ding a, na min ka hih thupi ding. Nang vualzawlna na hi ding hi.
english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

paite: "Nang hon vualzawl peuhmah ka vualzawl ding a, hon hamsiat peuhmah ka hamsiat ding. Nang ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who curses you. All of the families of the earth will be blessed in you.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang a agen bang in Abram akuankheta a; Lot in azui hi. Haran a kipan Abram apawt lai in kum sawmsagih-le-nga a upa ahi.
english: So Abram went, as Yahweh had spoken to him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed out of Haran.

paite: Abram in azi Sarai leh asang gampa' tapa Lot leh athil kaihkhawm tengteng uh leh Haran khua a, ami neih tengteng uh api a; Kanaan gam a teng ding in apawt ua; Kanaan gam atung uhi.
english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their substance that they had gathered, and the souls whom they had gotten in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. Into the land of Canaan they came.

paite: Abram huai gam a Shekem mun pha in, Moreh tosaw tan in apai zel hi. Huai lai in, huai gam ah Kanaante ateng uhi.
english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. The Canaanite was then in the land.

paite: Abram kiang ah TOUPA akilak a, "Na suante kiang ah hiai gam ka pe ding," achi hi. Huai ah akiang a kilak TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh hi.
english: Yahweh appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your seed or, offspring .” He built an altar there to Yahweh, who appeared to him.

paite: Huai a kipan Bethel suahlam a tanggam ah akisuan a, huai ah apuanin akai hi. Atumlam ah Bethel a-om a, asuahlam ah Ai khua a-om hi. Huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh nawn a, TOUPA min alou hi.
english: He left from there to the mountain on the east of Bethel, and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to Yahweh and called on the name of Yahweh.

paite: Sim gam lam zuan in Abram akisuan lai hi.
english: Abram traveled, going on still toward the South.

paite: Huai gam ah kial akia a; huai gam anak kial mahmah ziak in, Aigupta gam a om tadih ding in Abram apaisuk hi.
english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta gam lut ding a akisak lai un, azi Sarai kiang ah, "Ngai in, numei melhoihtak na hi, chih ka thei hi.
english: It happened, when he had come near to enter Egypt, that he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Aiguptate'n nang ahon muh chiang un, 'Hiai azi ahi,' achi ding ua; kei hon that in, nang ahon hawi ding uh.
english: It will happen, when the Egyptians will see you, that they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

paite: Nang ziak a hoihtak a ka omtheihna ding in leh nang vang a ka hintheihna ding in, hehpih in asanggamnu ka hi chi zel in," achi hi.
english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Aigupta a Abram alutleh, Aiguptate'n numei amu ua, amel hoih ana sa mahmah uhi.
english: It happened that when Abram had come into Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

paite: Pharaoh miliante'n leng amu ua, Pharaoh kiang ah ahoihdan agen uhi. Huchi in numei Pharaoh inn ah apilutta uhi.
english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

paite: Ama'n Sarai ziak in Abram hoihtak in abawl a; belamte, bawngte, sabengtungpate, sikhapate, sikhanute, sabengtungnute leh sangawngsaute aneihloh hial hi.
english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

paite: TOUPA'N Abram zi Sarai ziak in Pharaoh leh a-inkuante tung ah hipi khawktak atungsak hi.
english: Yahweh plagued Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

paite: Pharaoh in Abram asam a, "Ka tung a na thilhih bangchidan amai a? Na zi ahi chih bangziak a hon hilh lou na hia? Bangziak a, 'Ka sanggamnu ahi,' chi na hia?
english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

paite: Huaiziak akei maw, ka zi ding a ka na neih hial, huaiziak in, tu'n en in, na zi pi inla, paimang in," achi hi.
english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

paite: Pharaoh in atungthu ah mi kiang ah thu apia a, azi leh aneih tengteng toh asawlkhia hi.
english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they brought him on the way with his wife and all that he had.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan Abram pawt in simlam ah apaitou a, akiang ah azi, aneih tengteng leh Lot leng apaitou hi.
english: Abram went up out of Egypt: he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him, into the South.

paite: Abram tuh ganta, dangkate leh dangka-engte in ahausa mahmah hi.
english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

paite: Negev a kipan Bethel tan in apai zel a, Bethel leh Ai khua kikal atung a, achil a apuanin akaihna mun tanpha,
english: He went on his journeys from the South even to Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

paite: maitam adoh masakna mun mah ah Abram in TOUPA min alou hi.
english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the name of Yahweh.

paite: Lot leng Abram kiang a pai in, belamhonte, bawnghonte leh puaninte anei hi.
english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, and herds, and tents.

paite: A-omkhawmna ding un gam akichingta kei a; avan neih uh atam mahmah ziak in, a-omkhawm thei nawnta kei uhi.
english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together: for their substance was great, so that they could not live together.

paite: Abram ganpute leh Lot ganpute kikal ah kiselna ahong omta a; huai lai in huai gam ah Kanaante leh Perizte ateng uhi.
english: There was a strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock: and the Canaanite and the Perizzite lived in the land at that time.

paite: Abram in Lot kiang ah, "Hehpih in, nang leh kei kikal ah, na ganpute leh ka ganpute kikal ah leng kiselna om kei hen; unau lah i hi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between me and you, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen; for we are relatives.

paite: "Gam pumpi na ma ah a-om kei a hia? Hehpih in ka kiang a kipan tuam om mai in. Nang veilam a na paileh, kei taklam ah ka pai ding, ahihkeileh, nang taklam a na paileh, kei veilam ah ka pai ding," achi hi.
english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

paite: Lot adak a, Zoar kholam zuan in, Jordan Phaizang tengteng, TOUPA huan bang ahihkeileh Aigupta gam bang in, gam chih a tui tampi omna ahi chih athei hi: TOUPA'N Sodom leh Gomorrah ahihsiat ma lah ahi ngal a.
english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before Yahweh destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of Yahweh, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

paite: Lot in Jordan Phaizang tengteng atelta hi. Suahlam ah Lot akisuan a; huchi in akikhenta uhi.
english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves the one from the other.

paite: Kanaan gam ah Abram ateng a, phaizang khopite ah Lot ateng a, Sodom khua pha in apuanin akai hi.
english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

paite: Ahi a, Pathian mitmuh in Sodom mite nakpitak in hoih lou leh khial in a-om uhi.
english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against Yahweh.

paite: Akiang a kipan Lot a-om tuam nung in, TOUPA'N Abram kiang ah, "Dak inla, na omna a kipan mallam, simlam, suahlam leh tumlam en in.
english: Yahweh said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

paite: Na gam muh tengteng na kiang ah leh na suante kiang ah tangtawn a ding in ka hon pe ding.
english: for all the land which you see, I will give to you, and to your offspring forever.

paite: Na suante lei a leivui bang in ka bawl ding hi. Mi'n lei a leivui asim seng uleh, na suante leng sim seng ahi ding uh.
english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can number the dust of the earth, then your seed may also be numbered.

paite: Thou inla, gam dung leh vai palsuak in; na kiang a hon pe ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its breadth; for I will give it to you.”

paite: Abram in apuanin asuan a, Hebron a om Mamre tosaw kiang ah atengta a, huai ah TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh hi.
english: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to Yahweh.

paite: Huan Shinar kumpipa Amraphel, Ellasar kumpipa Ariok, Elam kumpipa Kedorla-omer, Goiim kumpipa Tidal dam lai in hichi ahong hi a;
english: It happened in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,

paite: amau Sodom kumpipa Bera asim uhi. Gomorrah kumpipa Birsha, Admah kumpipa Sinab, Zeboiim kumpipa Semeber, Bela kumpipa leng asim uhi, huai tuh Zoar ahi.
english: that they made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar).

paite: Hiai tengteng Siddim Phaizang ah apang uh, huai tuh Chi Tuipi ahi.
english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (the same is the Salt Sea).

paite: Kum sawm-le-nih sung Kedorla-omer nuai ah ana om ua, akum sawm-le-thumna in ahelta uhi.
english: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer, and in the thirteenth year, they rebelled.

paite: Akum sawm-le-lina ah Kedorla-omer leh akiang a kumpipa omte ahong ua, Asteroth-karnaim ah Rephaimte athat ua, Ham ah Zuzimte athat ua, Shaveh-kariathaim ah Emimte athat uh;
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

paite: a-omna Seir tang a El-paran gamdai zul a Horte omna tanpha in.
english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to Elparan, which is by the wilderness.

paite: Akik nawn ua, Enmishpat atung ua, huai ahihleh Kadesh ahi a, Amalekte gam a mi teng leh Amorte, Hazezon-tamar a tengte leng athat nawn uhi.
english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (the same is Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

paite: Sodom kumpipa, Gomorrah kumpipa, Admah kumpipa, Zeboiim kumpipa leh Bela (huai Zoar kichi) kumpipa apawt ua, Siddim Phaizang ah amau sual ding in apangta uhi.
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Admah, and the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (the same is Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim;

paite: Elam kumpipa Kedorla-omer, Goiim kumpipa Tidal, Shinar kumpipa Amraphelte, Ellasar kumpipa Ariok sual ding in, Kumpipa li in kumpipa nga asual uhi.
english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Tidal king of Goiim, and Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

paite: Longnai khuk in Siddim Phaizang adim a; Sodom leh Gomorrah kumpipate ataikekna lam uah, khenkhatte huai ah akia ua, akeloute tang ah ataitou uhi.
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and they fell there, and those who remained fled to the hills.

paite: Sodom leh Gomorrah mite sum tengteng leh anek ding tengteng uh la in apaita uhi.
english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

paite: Sodom a om Abram unaupa tapa, Lot leh aneih teng toh alaksak ua, apaita uhi.
english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

paite: Huai a pan suakta mi khat ahong pai a, Hebru mi Abram ahilh a, amah Amor mi Mamre tosaw kiang a teng ahi. Mamre ahihleh Eshkol leh Aner unaupih ahi a; huai mite Abram toh pangkhawm ahi uh.
english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. Now he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol, and brother of Aner; and these were allies of Abram.

paite: Abram in unaupa sal in api uh chih azaktak in, a-inn a piang, ama'n achilsiamsa mi zathum apikhia a, Dan khua pha in adelhta hi.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his trained men, born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, and pursued as far as Dan.

paite: Zan in amau sual ding in amah leh asikhate akihawmzak ua, azou ua Hobah pha in adelh uh; Hobah bel Damaskas mallam a om ahi.
english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

paite: Thil tengteng alakik nawn vek a, a-unaupa Lot leh aneih tengteng ban ah midang tengteng toh, numeite leng ahon pi nawn hi.
english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative, Lot, and his goods, and the women also, and the people.

paite: Kedorla-omer leh akiang a om kumpipate zou a, apaikik lam in Shaveh Phaizang (huai Kumpipa Phaizang kichi) ah Abram dawn ding in Sodom kumpipa ahohsuk hi.
english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him, after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

paite: Salem kumpipa Melkizedek in tanghou leh uain ahon tawi a; amah Pathian Tungnungpen siampu ahi.
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine: and he was priest of God Most High.

paite: Ama'n Abram avualzawl a, "Lei leh van neipa, Pathian Tungnungpen, Abram vualzawl in om hen.
english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth:

paite: Na melmate na khut a hon pepa, Pathian Tungnungpen phat in om hen," achi hi. Abram in amah bangkim a sawm- a-khat apia hi.
english: and blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

paite: Sodom kumpipa'n Abram kiang ah, "Mite hon pia inla, thilte zaw nang kineih in," achi hi.
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods to yourself.”

paite: Abram in Sodom kumpipa kiang ah, "Lei leh van neipa, TOUPA, Pathian Tungnungpen lam ah ka khut ka zakta hi.
english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to Yahweh, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

paite: Khauzang khat lel leng, khedap khau khat lel leng, na neih himhim ka la kei ding, huchi lou in zaw, Abram, kei hauhsaksak ahi, na chi kha ding," achi hi.
english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

paite: "Tangvalte nekmang leh ka mi tonpihte tantuan kia lou zaw ka la kei ding, Aner, Eshkol leh Mamrete'n atantuan uh la uhen," achi hi.
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

paite: Huai thilte nung in, "Abram, lau ke'n, kei na phaw leh na kipahman thupitak ka hi,” chi in Abram kiang ah mengmuhna in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: After these things the word of Yahweh came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

paite: Abram in, "Aw, Toupa PATHIAN, bang na hon pe dia, ta nei lou a ka om na mu a, ka goukempa lah Damaskas a Eliezer ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: Abram said, “Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

paite: Abram mah in, "Ngai in, chi lah na hon suahsak kei a; en in, ka inn a piang pen mah ka gouluahpa hong hi ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: Abram said, “Behold, to me you have given no seed: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

paite: "Ngai in, huai mi na gouluah ding ahi kei. Nangmah gil a hong gah ding ngei, na gouluah ahi zaw ding,” chi in akiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Behold, the word of Yahweh came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

paite: Amah inpua ah apikhia a, "Van lam en inla, aksite na simtheihleh sim him in," achi hi. Amah mah in akiang ah, "Na suante huchibang ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So shall your seed be.”

paite: Ama'n TOUPA agingta a, huchi in ama'n huai adiktatna in asehsakta hi.
english: He believed in Yahweh; and he reckoned it to him for righteousness.

paite: Akiang ah, "Hiai gam na luah ding a hon pe ding a Kaldaite khua Ur a kipan hon pikhia TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “I am Yahweh who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, ka luah ding chih, bangchi in ka theithei dia?" achi hi.
english: He said, “Lord Yahweh, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

paite: Ama'n, akiang ah, "Bawngla kum thum a upa, kelpi kum thum a upa, vakhu leh vapalnou hon la in," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

paite: Huai teng ahon la a, alaitak ah aphelkhap chiat a, aphel khat, aphel khat lam doh in akoih chiat a; vasate bel aphelkhap kei hi.
english: He brought him all of these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

paite: Sasial ne vasate'n saluangte tung abohsuk chiang un Abram in ana hawlkhe zel hi.
english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

paite: Ni tum ding a akisak lai in, Abram a-ihmu hithit hi. Ngai in, amial a mial, thil mulkimhuai petmah in amah hon khuh hi.
english: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

paite: Hiai thilte nung in Pathian in Abram kiang ah, "Na suante amau gam hilou ah mikhual in a-om ding ua, a-nna uh asepsak ding uh, chih teltak in thei in. Kum zali sung hihgentheih in a-om ding uh.
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your seed will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

paite: A-nna uh asepsak nam uh ka vaihawmkhum ding hi. Huai khit chiang in thil tampi nei in ahong paikhe ding uh.
english: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth,

paite: Nang na pipute kiang ah lungmuangtak in na pai ding a; na lu a kelsam pou vek in ahon vui ding uhi.
english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried in a good old age.

paite: Himahleh, Amorte khelhnate akim nai louh ziak in, suan lina ah hiai ah ahong pai nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni tum a, khua ahong mial in, ngai in, haltuina mei khu lunglung leh meisel kuang luahluah, huai sa kiphelkhapte kal a paipai ahong om hi.
english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace, and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

paite: Huai ni mah in TOUPA'N Abram toh thukhun bawl in, "Hiai gam, Aigupta lui a kipan lui lian, Euphrates Luipi pha in na suante kiang ah ka peta," achi hi.
english: In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “To your seed I have given this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

paite: Kente, Kenizte, Kadmonte,
english: the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

paite: Hitte, Perizte, Rephate,
english: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

paite: Amorte, Kanaante, Girgaste leh Jebuste toh leng ka pe lai hi, chi in Abram toh thu akhungta hi.
english: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

paite: Huan Abram zi, Sarai in ta aneihsak kei hi. Sarai in Aigupta mi sikhanu khat anei a, amin Hagar ahi.
english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a handmaid, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

paite: Sarai in Abram kiang ah, "Ngai dih ve, TOUPA'N lah ta ka neih hon phal lou a; hehpih in ka sikhanu kithuahpih in. Amah a pan tate ka neih khakleh,” achi hi. Huchi in Abram in Sarai thu azuita hi.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, Yahweh has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my handmaid. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

paite: Kanaan gam a Abram kum sawm a-om nung in, Abram zi Sarai in asikhanu Aigupta mi api a, apasal Abram kiang ah azi ding in apia hi.
english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her handmaid, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

paite: Hagar athei a, huan agaita hi. Agai chih akitheihtak in, api asimmoh maimah hi.
english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

paite: Sarai in Abram kiang ah, "Ka thil thuak amoh nang pua in. Ka sikhanu na kawi ding in ka hon pia a; agai chih akitheihtak in, hon simmoh maimah hi. TOUPA'N nang leh kei kikal ngaihtuah hen," achi hi.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my handmaid into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, I was despised in her eyes. Yahweh judge between me and you.”

paite: Abram in Sarai kiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhanu na khut a om ahi, nang pha na sak bang in atung ah hih in," achi hi. Sarai in ahihgentheih mahmah tak in ataimangsanta hi.
english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

paite: TOUPA angel in gamdai a tuikhuk kiang a, Shur zotna lampi a tuikhuk kiang ah ana mu hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain in the way to Shur.

paite: Akiang ah, "Hagar, Sarai sikhanu aw, koi a kipan hong pai a, koi a hoh dia kisa na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Ka pi Sarai kiang a kipan taimang ka hi,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s handmaid, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”

paite: TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Na pi kiang ah kik nawn inla, athuthu in om in," achi hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

paite: TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Na suante sim seng louh khop hial a tam in ka pungsak ding," achi nawn hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh said to her, “I will greatly multiply your seed, that they will not be numbered for multitude.”

paite: TOUPA angel mah in akiang ah, "Ngai in, nau na paita, tapa na nei ding a; TOUPA'N na gimthuakna azak ziak in amin Ishmael na sak ding ahi.
english: The angel of Yahweh said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because Yahweh has heard your affliction.

paite: Amah gam-sabiltung bang ahi ding a; michih adou ding a, michih in leng amah adou ding uh. Asanggamte a kipan atuam ten ding," achi nawn hi.
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposite all of his brothers.”

paite: Hagar in amah houpih TOUPA min, "Nang muthei Pathian na hi," chih asa hi. "Pathian mu a, hing lai ka hi maw?" achi ngal a.
english: She called the name of Yahweh who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

paite: Huaiziak in huai tuikhuk Beer-lahai-roi sak ahita. Ngai in, huai Kadesh leh Bered kho kikal a om ahi.
english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Beer Lahai Roi means “well of the one who lives and sees me.” Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

paite: Hagar in Abram tapa aneihsak a; Abram in atapa, Hagar in aneihsak min Ishmael asata hi.
english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

paite: Hagar in Abram a ding a Ishmael aneihsak lai in Abram kum sawmgiat-le-guk a upa ahi.
english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

paite: Abram kum sawmkua-le-kua a upa ahih in, Abram kiang ah TOUPA akilak a, akiang ah, "Kei Pathian Bangkim hihthei ka hi; ka ma ah pai inla, hoihkim in om in.
english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram, and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me, and be blameless.

paite: Nang toh i kal ah thu ka khung ding a, nakpitak in ka hon pungsak ding," achi hi.
english: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

paite: Abram abokkhup a; Pathian in amah ahoupih hi.
english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

paite: "Ngai in, ke'n zaw, na kiang ah ka thukhun ahi ka khun, nam tampite' Pa na hita ding.
english: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

paite: Na min leng Abram ahi nawnta kei ding a, na min Abraham ahi zawta ding; nam tampite' Pa ding a ka hon bawl tak ziak in.
english: Neither will your name any more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

paite: Nakpitak in ka hon chiphasak ding a, nang ah nam tampi ka bawl ding a, nang a kipan kumpipate ahong piangkhe ding uh.
english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

paite: "Kei leh nang leh na suante, suan sawnsawnte tan in leng ka thukhun nang a ding leh na nung a na suante a ding a, a Pathian uh hi ding in, tangtawn thukhun ding in ka hihkip ding hi.
english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your seed after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your seed after you.

paite: Na kiang ah leh na nung a na suante kiang ah mikhual na hihna gam, Kanaan gam tengteng, tangtawn gou ding un ka hon pe ding, kei a Pathian uh ka hi ding," achi hi.
english: I will give to you, and to your seed after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

paite: Pathian mah in Abraham kiang ah, "Nang ka thukhun na zui ding ahi. Na nung a na suante suan sawnsawnte tan in leng azui ding uhi.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you will keep my covenant, you and your seed after you throughout their generations.

paite: Hiai kei leh nang leh na suante kal a ka thukhun na zuih ding uh ahi. Na lak ua pasal peuhmah in zek asum ding ahi.
english: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your seed after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

paite: Na zekvun sa uh na sum ding ua, huai tuh nang toh i kal a thukhun chiamtehna ahi ding hi.
english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

paite: Na lak ua kuapeuh ni giat a upa, na suan sawnsawn tan un leng, na suan hi chitchiat lou leng na inn a piang hiam, mikhual kuapeuh a kipan dangka sum a na lei hiam leng, pasal peuhmah zek sum ding ahi.
english: He who is eight days old will be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your seed.

paite: Na inn a piang leh na dangka sum a na leite leng zeksum ngeingei ding ahi. Ka thukhun tangtawn thukhun ding in na sa ah a-omta ding hi.
english: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant will be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

paite: Pasal zeksum louh leh azekvun sa a zeksum a om lou, achipihte lak a kipan satkhiak ahi ding; ama'n ka thukhun hihsia ahi," achi nawn hi.
english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

paite: Pathian mah in, Abraham kiang ah, "Na zi Sarai, amin Sarai na chi nawnta kei ding a, amin Sarah ahi zawta ding hi.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah.

paite: Amah ka vualzawl ding a, huai lou leng amah ah tapa ka hon pe ding. Ahi, amah ka vualzawl ding a, namte nu ahita ding. Amah a kipan nam tuamtuam kumpipate ahong om ding uh," achi hi.
english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

paite: Abraham abokkhup a, anui a, alungsim in mi kum za a upa in ta anei ding maw? Sarah kum sawmkua a upa in ta anei ding maw? achi hi.
english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

paite: Abraham mah in Pathian kiang ah, "Na ma ah Ishmael om thei maileh aw," achi hi.
english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

paite: Pathian in, "Hilou e, na zi Sarah in tapa ahon neihsak taktak ding a; amin Isak na sak ding ahi. Ka thukhun, anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn thukhun ding in akiang ah ka hihkip ding.
english: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. Isaac means “he laughs.” I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his seed after him.

paite: Ishmael tungthu leng ka hon ngaihkhiaksak hi. Ngai in, amah ka vualzawlta a, chi tampi ka suangsak ding hi. Nakpitak in leng ka pungsak ding a, ama'n vaihawmmi sawm-le-nih asuang ding a, amah chi thupitak in ka bawl ding hi.
english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

paite: Himahleh ka thukhun, Sarah in kum nawn hichi hun a ahon neihsak ding Isak kiang ah ahi ka hihkip ding," achi hi.
english: But my covenant I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

paite: Akiang a thugen azoh in, Pathian in Abraham apaitouh santa hi.
english: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

paite: Abraham in atapa Ishmael leh a- inn a piang tengteng leh dangka sum a alei tengteng, Abraham inkuante lak a pasal peuhmah api a, Pathian in akiang a agen bang in, huai ni mah in azekvun uh asumsak chiat hi.
english: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money; every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

paite: Abraham zekvun asum lai in kum sawmkua-le-kua a upa ahi.
english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old, when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

paite: Atapa Ishmael azekvun asum lai un kum sawm-le-thum a upa ahi,
english: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

paite: Huai ni mah in Abraham leh atapa Ishmael zeksum ahita uh.
english: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

paite: A-inkuanpihte lak a pasal tengteng, a-inn a piangte leh mikhual a kipan dangka sum a aleite leng, amah toh zeksum ahi vekta uhi.
english: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money of a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

paite: Huan sun nisat laitak a puanin kongkhak bul a Abraham atut lai in, Mamre a tosaw kiang ah TOUPA ahong kilak hi.
english: Yahweh appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

paite: Abraham dak in a-en a, ngai in, akiang ah mi thum ana dingh uhi. Amuhtak in puanin kongkhak a kipan amaute tuak ding in ava tai a, lei lam ah akunsuk hi.
english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood opposite him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

paite: "Ka toupa na deihsakna ka tan theihleh hehpih in na sikha hon paikheng mahmah ke'n.
english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

paite: Tui tawmchik bek hon la uhenla, na khete uh sil unla, sing nuai ah khawl tadih un.
english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

paite: Tanghou tawmchik bek ka va la ding a, na lungtang uh halhsak un. Huai khit chiang in na pai zom zel na ding uh. Huai ding a na sikha kiang a hong pai na hi peuhmah ding uh," achi hi. Amau, "Na chih bang in va hih in," achi uhi.
english: I will get a morsel of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”

paite: Puanin sung a Sarah kiang ah Abraham ava lut pah a, "Tangbuang nel mahmah tehna thum bawl in, mek inla, tanghou pei in bawl in," achi hi.
english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three measures of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

paite: 7 Ganhon lam ah Abraham atai a, bawngnou hoihtak ava man a, asikha kiang ah apia a, ama'n abawl mengmeng hi.
english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

paite: Nawituidat, nawitui leh bawngnou sa kibawl ala a, ama uah ava luita hi. Amau anek sung teng uh, sing nuai ah akiang uah adingh nilouh hi.
english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Na zi Sarah koi a om ahia?" achi ua, "Ama'n pam a puanin ah," achi hi.
english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “See, in the tent.”

paite: Amaute'n, "Hun ahong chin nawn peuhpeuh chiang in na kiang ah ka hong nawn ngeingei ding uh. Ngai in, na zi Sarah in tapa anei ding," achi hi. Anung a puanin kongkhak bul a kipan Sarah in ana za hi.
english: He said, “I will certainly return to you when the season comes round. Behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

paite: Abraham leh Sarah upapi, tektak ahita ua; numei dan ngeina Sarah ah akam khin thamta hi.
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

paite: Sarah in tektak ka hih nung in nopsakna ka nei thei lai diam maw, ka toupa lah a-upata ngal a? chi in alungsim in anui hi.
english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

paite: TOUPA'N Abraham kiang ah, "Bang achia Sarah in, kei pitek in ta ka nei thei lai diam maw, chi a nui ahia?
english: Yahweh said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child, yet I am old?’

paite: TOUPA a ding in thil himhim haksa lua a-om a hia? Hun seh ahong tun chiang in, na kiang ah ka hong nawn ding a, Sarah in tapa anei ding," achi hi.
english: Is anything too hard for Yahweh? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes round, and Sarah will have a son.”

paite: Sarah in alauh ziak in, "Ka nui kei," chi in anial hi. Ama'n, "Zuau ahi, na nui tawk ve," achi hi.
english: Then Sarah denied, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

paite: Huai a kipan mite adingh ua, Sodom kholam a-en ua, amaute khakhe ding in akiang uah Abraham apai hi.
english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Ka thilhih ding Abraham ka iim diam aw;
english: Yahweh said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

paite: Abraham lah chi thupi leh thilhihtheitak ahong hi ngei ding a, amah ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl a om ding ahihdante?
english: since Abraham has surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

paite: Anung a atate leh a-inkuanpihte'n diktatna leh thudik a TOUPA lampi zui a, vaihawmna ding thu apiaktheihna ding in amah ka septa a; huchi a atungthu genpa TOUPA'N Abraham tung a atunsak theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of Yahweh, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that Yahweh may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

paite: TOUPA'N, “Sodom leh Gomorrah kalh a kikou thawmging anasa a, agitlouh mahmah ziak un.
english: Yahweh said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

paite: Tu in ka hohsuk ding a, akikou ging uh ka kiang a hong tung bangbang in ahih uhia, hih lou, ka en ding a, ahih kei uleh ka thei mai ding," achi hi.
english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

paite: Huai a kipan mite akihei ua, Sodom kholam azuanta uhi. Abraham bel TOUPA ma ah adingh lai hi.
english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before Yahweh.

paite: Abraham in ava naih a, “Mikhialte lak a midiktatte hihmangkhawm tel ding na hi maw?
english: Abraham drew near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

paite: Khosung ah midiktat sawmnga bek a-om kha ding uh e. Asung a midiktat sawmnga omte ziak in akhua hawi lou in na hihmang ding maw?
english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

paite: Nang hial in zaw migiloute bang a midiktatte a-om samna ding ua migiloute lak a midiktatte hihlup zaw na hih tel kei ding hi. Leitung pumpi Vaihawmpa in diktattak in ahih kei dia hia?" achi hi.
english: Be it far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

paite: TOUPA'N, “Sodom a midiktat sawmnga ka muhleh amau ziak in akho pumpi ka hawi ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare all the place for their sake.”

paite: Abraham in, "Ngai in, kei leivui leh meivu lel in Toupa ka hon houpih thei hi.
english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, who am but dust and ashes.

paite: Midiktat nga in sawmnga chingzou lou ahi kha ding e; nga achin louh ziak in kho pumpi na hihmang ding maw? chi in adawng hi. Ama'n sawmli-le-nga ka muhleh ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it, if I find forty-five there.”

paite: Ama'n amah ahoupih zel a, "Huai ah sawmli kia na mu ahi kha ding e," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawmli ziak in leng ka hihmang dah mai ding," achi hi.
english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa aw, heh ke'n, ka hon gen nawn lai ding. Huai ah sawmthum lel na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Huai a sawmthum leng ka muhleh ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it, if I find thirty there.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ngai in, Toupa ka hon houpih theita a, huai ah sawmnih kia na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawmnih ziak in leng ka hihmang kei ding," achi hi.
english: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”

paite: Ama'n, "Toupa aw, heh ke'n, khatvei kia ka hon gen lai ding. Huai ah sawm kia na mu ahi kha ding," achi hi. Ama'n, "Sawm ziak in leng ka hihmang kei ding,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”

paite: Abraham toh akihou khit un TOUPA apaita a; Abraham leng amun ah akik nawnta hi.
english: Yahweh went his way, as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

paite: Huan angel nih in nitaklam in Sodom khua aphasuk ua, Sodom khokulh kongkhak ah Lot ana tu hi. Lot in amaute ana mu a, va tuak ding in adingh a, amai a lei si in chibai abuk a,
english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

paite: "Ngai un, ka toupate aw, hehpih in na sikha inn ah hong lut phot unla, giak unla, na khete uh sil un. Na thou baih ding ua, na pai nawn na ding uh," achi hi. Huan amau, "Hilou e, kholak ah ka giak zaw ding uh," achi uhi.
english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please turn aside into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

paite: Himahleh ama'n nakpitak in akun a; akiang ah api a, huchi in a-inn ah alutta uhi. Ama'n meh abawlsak a, tanghou silngou soh louh akang a, aneta uhi.
english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

paite: Alup ma un khopi a mite, Sodom khomite, veng teng a mi tengteng, atek-akhang in a-inn ava umkimvel uhi.
english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

paite: Lot kiang ah, "Tuzan a na inn a hong lut mite koi a om uh ahia? Amau ka kithuahpih theihna ding un ka kiang uah hon pikhia in," ahong chi uhi.
english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

paite: Kongkhak bul ah akiang uah Lot ava pawt a, kongkhak akhak hi.
english: Lot went out to them to the door, and shut the door after him.

paite: "Ka unaute aw, hehpih in, hichi tel in gilou dah un.
english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

paite: Ngai un, pasal' kithuahpih ngei nai louh tanu nih ka nei hi. Hon hehpih unla, na kiang uah amaute ka hon pikhe ding a, hoih na sak bang un, atung uah na hih na ding uh. Hiai mite tung ah zaw bangmah hih mahmah kei un. Hiai ding a ka insung a hong lut lah ahi ngal ua," achi hi.
english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

paite: Amau, "Hon hon mai in," achi uhi. Amau mah in, “Hiai mi sop lai hiai a teng ding in ahong pem lut a, vaihawmpa a om maw atup vial. Tu'n amaute tung a hih sang in nang tung ah ka hihse zaw sem ding uh," achi uhi. Lot abohta ua, kongkhak hihse ding in hon naih uhi.
english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now will we deal worse with you, than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and drew near to break the door.

paite: Himahleh mite'n akhut uh agolhkhia ua, akiang uah insung ah Lot akailut ua, kongkhak akhak bikbek uhi.
english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

paite: Kongkhak bul a mite, aneu-alian mit atawsak ua, huchi in kongkhak amuzouta kei uh.
english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

paite: Mite'n Lot kiang ah, "Hiai mite lou hiai ah inkuanpih dang na nei hia? Na makpate, na tapate, na tanute leh khosung a na neih peuhmahte khua a kipan pikhia in.
english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whoever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

paite: TOUPA ma a, akikou husa uh anasat luat tak ziak in hiai khua hihmang ding ka hi uh. Hihmang ding in TOUPA'N hon sawl ahi," achi uhi.
english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown great before Yahweh that Yahweh has sent us to destroy it.”

paite: Lot apaikhia a, atanute kitenpih, amakpate kiang ah ava gen hi. "Thou unla, hiai khua a kipan pawtkhia un, TOUPA'N khua hihmang ding ahi,” achi hi. Himahleh amakpate ngaih in chiamnuih thu gen bang lel ahi.
english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city.” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

paite: Phalvak in angelte'n, "Thou inla, na zi leh hiai a na tanu nih omte pikhia in. Huchi lou in zaw hiai khua gawtna ah na mangkhawm kha ding uh," chi in Lot anohta uhi.
english: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife, and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

paite: Himahleh a-awltat mahmah lai a, TOUPA'N amah ahehpih ziak in, mite'n ama khut leh azi khut leh atanu nihte khutte manbet in apikhia ua, kho polam ah akoihta uhi.
english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, Yahweh being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

paite: Huan polam a apikhiak khit un, khat in akiang ah, "Na hinna ding in taikhia in; na nunglam nga ke'nla, phaizang himhim ah leng khawl ke'n. Huai tang sang ah suahtak san in, huchi lou in zaw na mangkhawm kha ding hi,” achi hi.
english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

paite: Himahleh Lot in akiang uah, "Ka toupate aw, huai zaw hi kei hen.
english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

paite: Ngai in, na sikha in na mitmuh in deihsakna atang a, ka hinna humbitna ding in zahngaihna thupi na hon musak lai hi. Himahleh huai tang sang ah zaw ka tai thei kei ding, thil hoih lou khat in hon pha in ka si kha ding hi.
english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

paite: Ngai in, hiai khua taina ding in anaipen a, kho neuchik leng ahi. Aw, huai ah, kho neuchik ahi kei a hia! Hon taisak zaw in, huchi in ka hing ding hi," achi hi.
english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

paite: Ama'n, akiang ah, "Ngai in, hiai thil tungtang ah leng ka hon mang, na kho gen ka hihmang dah ding.
english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

paite: Kin inla, huai ah tai in. Huai mun na tun mateng lah bangmah ka hihthei ngal kei a," achi hi. Huaiziak in huai kho min Zoar chih in a-omta hi.
english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar. Zoar means “little.”

paite: Zoar a Lot atun in leitung ah ni asuak khinta hi.
english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

paite: TOUPA'N Sodom leh Gomorrah kho tung ah van a TOUPA kiang a kipan mei leh kaat azusak hi.
english: Then Yahweh rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from Yahweh out of the sky.

paite: Huai khuate, phaizang tengteng, khua a mite tengteng leh leitung a thilpoute tengteng ahihmang vekta hi.
english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

paite: Himahleh Lot nung ah azi in nunglam a-en a, huchi in chikhuam ahong suakta hi.
english: But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

paite: TOUPA ma a adinna mun ah beltak in Abraham ahohtou hi.
english: Abraham got up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before Yahweh.

paite: Sodom leh Gomorrah kholam leh phaizang gam lam tengteng a-en hi. Ngai in, huai gam a meikhu, haltuina meikhu bang mai in akhutou ngoingoi hi.
english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and looked, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in phaizang khopite, Lot tenna mun ngei ahihman lai in, Pathian in Abraham atheigige a, manthatna lak a pan Lot asawlkhia hi.
english: It happened, when God destroyed the cities of the plain, that God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

paite: Zoar a kipan Lot apaitou a, tang ah ateng a, atanu nihte leng akiang ah ateng uhi. Zoar ah lah ateng ngam kei a, amah leh atanu nihte kohawm ah atengta uhi.
english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

paite: Huchi in atanu upazaw in anauzaw kiang ah, "I pa a-upata a, leitung tengteng dan bang a hon kithuahpih ding lei ah pasal khat leng a-om nawn kei hi.
english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man in the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

paite: Kisa in, i pa uain i dawnsak ding a, huchi a i pa chisuan bei lou a i bawltheihna ding in akiang ah i va lum ding," achi hi.
english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s seed.”

paite: Huai zan in apa uh uain adawnsakta uhi. A-upazaw alut a, apa kiang ah ava lum a; ama'n alup lam ana phawk kei a, athoh lam leng aphawk kei hi.
english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azing in a-upazaw in anaupangzaw kiang ah, "Ngai in, zan in ka pa kiang ah ka va lum a; tuzan in leng uain i dawnsak nawn ding a; nang va lut inla, huchi a i pa chisuan bei lou a i bawltheihna ding in akiang ah va lum in," achi hi.
english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let us make him drink wine again, tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s seed.”

paite: Huai zan in leng apa uh uain adawnsak nawn ua; anaupangzaw athou a, akiang ah ava lumta hi. Ama'n alup lam aphawk kei a, athoh lam leng aphawk kei hi.
english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

paite: Huchibang in Lot tanu nihte'n apa ua pan nau apai tuak uhi.
english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

paite: A-upazaw in tapa anei a, amin Moab asa a, huai mi tulai a Moabte suangpa ahi.
english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

paite: Anaupangzaw in leng tapa anei a, amin Ben-ammi asa a, huai mi tulai a Ammonte suangpa ahi.
english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

paite: Huan lei leh vante leh asung a om tengteng siam zoh ahita hi.
english: The heavens and the earth were finished, and all their vast array.

paite: Pathian in ani sagih ni in anasep azou a; huchi in ani sagih ni in anasep tengteng akhawlsanta hi.
english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

paite: Huai ni a Pathian in asiam leh abawl, anasep tengteng akhawlsan tak ziak in, Pathian in ani sagih ni vualzawl in, atangta hi.
english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work which he had created and made.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in lei leh vante asiam ni a, lei leh vante siam ahih ua akisuansawndan uh hiai bang ahi.
english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. God made the earth and the heavens.

paite: Leitung ah gamlak loupa himhim a-om nai kei a, sing-le-louhing leng apou nai kei hi. TOUPA Pathian in leitung ah vuah azusak nai kei a, lei let ding in mihing leng a-om nai kei hi.
english: No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

paite: Himahleh lei a pan tuihu ahong pawttou a, leitung tengteng anomsak hi.
english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in lei a leivui in mi abawl a, anakvangte ah hinna hu ahalut a; huai mi, hinna nei mihing ahong hita hi.
english: Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in suahlam a Eden ah huan abawl a; huai ah abawl pasal a-omsak hi.
english: Yahweh God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in lei a kipan sing mit hiptak leh nek tuak chiteng apousak hi. Hinna sing leh asia leh apha theihna sing leng huan laizang ah apousak hi.
english: Out of the ground Yahweh God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the middle of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

paite: Eden a pan huan nomsak ding in lui aluang paisuak a; huai a kipan akazak a, ka li ahong hita hi.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became four heads.

paite: Akhatna min Pishon ahi a, hiai Havilah gam tengteng kualkhum lui ahi a; huai dangka-eng omna ahi.
english: The name of the first is Pishon: this is the one which flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

paite: Huai gam a dangka-eng hoihtak ahi a, huai ah bedeli leh onik suang leng a-om hi.
english: and the gold of that land is good. There is aromatic resin and the onyx stone.

paite: Lui nihna min Gihon ahi a; huai lui in Kush gam tengteng akualkhum hi.
english: The name of the second river is Gihon: the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

paite: Lui thumna min Hiddekel ahi a; hiai Assuria gam suahlam a luang ahi. Lui lina bel Euphrates ahi.
english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel: this is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in pasal api a, Eden huan ah akem ding leh aveng ding in akoihta hi.
english: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in pasal kiang ah, "Huan a singgah chiteng na ut-ut na ne thei hi.
english: Yahweh God commanded the man, saying, “Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat;

paite: Asia leh apha theihna singgah bel na ne ding ahi kei. Na nekleh na nek ni mah in na si ngeingei ding hi," chỉ in thu apia hi.
english: but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it; for in the day that you eat of it you will surely die.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian in, "Pasal amah kia a-om ahoih kei. Amah panpihtu dia kilawm ka bawlsak ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh God said, “It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him a helper suitable for him.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian in leitung a kipan gamsa chiteng leh tung a leng vasa chiteng abawl hi. Amin ding ua bang sak ding ahia chih theihna ding in Adam kiang ah apikhawm hi. Ganhing chiteng amin uh Adam in ana phuah, huai amin uh ahi denta hi.
english: Out of the ground Yahweh God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature, that was its name.

paite: Adam in ganhing tengteng, tung a leng vasa tengteng leh gamsa chiteng min aphuak chiat hi. Himahleh Adam panpihtu ding muh in a-om kei hi.
english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper suitable for him.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in nuamtak in Adam a-ihmusak a, huchi in a-ihmuta a; anakguh khat alakhia a, alakkhiakna mun sa in adimsak hi.
english: Yahweh God caused a deep sleep to fall on the man, and he slept; and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

paite: TOUPA Pathian in Adam a pan alak nakguh a kipan in numei abawl a, Adam kiang ah apita hi.
english: He made the rib, which Yahweh God had taken from the man, into a woman, and brought her to the man.

paite: Adam in, "Hiai pen zaw ka guh a kipan guh, ka sa a kipan sa ahi. Pasal a kipan lakkhiak ahih ziak in, Numei, chih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

paite: Huaiziak in pasal in anu leh apa apaisan ding a, azi ah abelh ding. Huchi in sa khat ahong hita ding uh.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

paite: Adam leh azi vuaktang ahi tuak ua, azum tuan kei uhi.
english: They were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

paite: Huai a kipan Negeb gam lam zuan in Abraham akisuan a, Kadesh leh Shur kho kikal ah ateng a, Gerar ah hun bang tan hiam a-om tadih hi.
english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

paite: Abraham in azi Sarah, "Ka sanggamnu ahi,” achi hi. Gerar kumpipa Abimelek in mi asawl a, Sarah ava pisak hi.
english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

paite: Himahleh, zan in amanglam in Abimelek kiang ah Pathian ahong kilak a, akiang ah, "Ngai in, na numei pi ziak in misi leltak na hita, amah lah mi zi ahi ngal a," achi hi.
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken. For she is a man’s wife.”

paite: Abimelek in anaih nai tadih kei hi, "Toupa, nam diktat na that hial dia hia?"
english: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

paite: Amah mah in ka kiang ah, "Ka sanggamnu ahi," chi in; amah ngei in leng ka sanggampa ahi, achih behlap ngal a. "Lungtang hoihtak pu leh khut siangthoutak nei kawm a hiai bang ka hih ahi," achi hi.
english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister?’ She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ In the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands have I done this.”

paite: Pathian in amang in, "Ahi, hiai lungtang hoihtak pu kawm a na hih ahi chih ka thei, ke'n leng ka tung a na khelh ding ka hon kham hi. Huaiziak in amah na khoih ka phal louh ahi.
english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

paite: Tu in huai mi zi pekik in; amah lah zawlnei ahi ngal a. Ahon thumsak ding a, na dam ding. Na piakkik keileh, na si ngeingei ding chih thei in; nang leh na neih tengteng toh," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

paite: Abimelek beltak in athou a, asikha tengteng asam a, azak ding un huai thu tengteng ahilh a, mite'n alau mahmah uhi.
english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

paite: Abimelek in Abraham asam a, akiang ah, "Ka tung ua na thilhih bangchidan ahia oi? Bang lam ah ahia na tung a ka khelh a, kei leh ka lalgam tung a thil gilou thupitak na hon tut? Thil hih tuak louhtak ka tung ah na hihta," achi hi.
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

paite: Abimelek mah in Abraham kiang ah, "Bang na mu a, hichibang a thil hih na maizen a?" achi nawn hi.
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

paite: Abraham in, "Hiai khua a Pathian launa himhim om lou a, ka zi ziak in ahon that mai ding uh, chih ka ngaihtuah ziak a hiai bang a na gamtang mah ka hi.
english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

paite: Huai lou in ka sanggamnu leng ahi him a, ka pa tanu ahi a, ka nu tanu bel ahi kei. Himahleh amah ka zi ahong hita hi.
english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pathian in ka pa inn a kipan ahon vakvaihsak lai in akiang ah, 'Hiai na hehpihna ka tung a na lahsak ding ahi. Ka tunna peuh uah, ka sanggampa ahi hon chi zel in' ka chi him hi,” achi hi.
english: It happened, when God caused me to wander from my father’s house, that I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

paite: Abimelek in belamte, bawng-talte, sikhapate leh sikhanute pi in Abraham kiang ah apia a, azi Sarah leng apekikta hi.
english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

paite: Abimelek in, "En in, na ma ah ka gam zapi a-om, na utna peuh ah teng in," achi hi.
english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

paite: Sarah kiang ah, "En in, na sanggampa dangka sangkhat ka peta hi. Ngai in, na kiang a om tengteng leh nangmah a ding in amah na mit khuhna ahi ding. Hiai bang in amah taihilh in a-om hi."
english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

paite: Pathian kiang ah Abraham athum a, Pathian in Abimelek leh azi leh asikhanute adamsak nawn a, huchi in tate aneita uhi.
english: Abraham prayed to God. God healed Abimelech, and his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

paite: Abraham zi Sarah ziak in TOUPA'N Abimelek inkuante tengteng achiingsak vek ngal a.
english: For Yahweh had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N agensa bang in Sarah ava veh a, achiamsa bang in Sarah tung ah TOUPA'N ahihta hi.
english: Yahweh visited Sarah as he had said, and Yahweh did to Sarah as he had spoken.

paite: Sarah agai a, Pathian in akiang a agen hun seh bang in, atek nung in Abraham tapa aneihsakta hi.
english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

paite: Abraham in Sarah in aneihsak atapa min Isak asa hi.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac. Isaac means “He laughs.”

paite: Abraham in Pathian in akiang a thu apiak bang in atapa Isak ni giat achin in azek asumsak hi.
english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

paite: Atapa Isak apian lai in Abraham kum zakhat a upa ahita.
english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

paite: Sarah in, "Pathian in hon nuisakta; aza kha peuhmah in hon nuihpih ding uh," achi hi.
english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

paite: Amah mah in, "Sarah in naungekte apom ding, chih kua'n ahia Abraham kiang a gen thei ding? Atek nung in tapa ka neihsakta,” achi hi.
english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham, that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

paite: Naungek ahong khanglian a, nawinek atawpsakta uh. Isak nawinek atawpsak ni un, Abraham in ankuang thupitak alui hi.
english: The child grew, and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

paite: Aigupta mi Hagar tapa, Abraham a ding a aneihsak pen in Isak asimmohbawl lai Sarah in amu hi.
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

paite: Huaiziak in Abraham kiang ah, "Hiai sikhanu leh atapa delhkhia in. Hiai sikhanu tapa in ka tapa Isak gou aluahpih thei kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this handmaid and her son! For the son of this handmaid will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

paite: Hiai thu atapa mah toh kisai ahih ziak in Abraham ngaih in thil hoih loutak ahi.
english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in Abraham kiang ah, "Naupang tungtang thu leh na sikhanu tungtang thu na ngaih in thil hoih lou hi kei hen. Sarah in na kiang a thu agen tengteng zui in, Isak ah na suante kisim ding chih ahi ngal a,
english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your handmaid. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For from Isaac will your seed be called.

paite: Sikhanu tapa ah leng, na suan ahih ziak in, nam chih tham ngial ka bawl ding," achi hi.
english: I will also make a nation of the son of the handmaid, because he is your seed.”

paite: Beltak in Abraham athou a, tanghou leh tuithawl, tui a dim ala a, Hagar kiang a pia in, aliangkou ah asuan a, naupang toh asawlkhia hi. Apai a, Beer-sheba gamdai ah avakvakta hi.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a bottle of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

paite: Tuithawl a tui ahong beitak in, sawlbawk lim nuai khat ah naupang akoihta mai hi.
english: The water in the bottle was spent, and she cast the child under one of the shrubs.

paite: "Naupang si ding ka en ngam kei," achih ziak in gamla kuam, thal kap phakna ding ah, ava pai a, amazawn a tu in ngaihtak in akapta hi.
english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat over against him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

paite: Pathian in naupang aw aza a; Pathian angel in van a kipan Hagar asam a, akiang ah, "Bangchi na hia, Hagar? Lau ke'n, a-omna a naupang aw Pathian in aza hi.
english: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What ails you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

paite: Thou inla, naupang phong in, na khut in len in, amah nam thupitak a bawl ding ka hi," achi hi.
english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him in your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

paite: Pathian in amit ahihvaksak a, huan tuileh amuta hi. Huai ah ava pai a, tuithawl dim in tui adim a, naupang adawnsak hi.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the bottle with water, and gave the boy drink.

paite: Naupang kiang ah Pathian a-om a, ahong khanglian a; gamdai ah ateng zel a, thalkapmi ahong hita hi.
english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and became, as he grew up, an archer.

paite: Paran gamdai dai ah ateng a; Aigupta gam a kipan zi aguan hi.
english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai lai in Abimelek leh asepaih pawl a heutu Phikol in Abraham kiang ah, "Na thilhih peuh ah na kiang ah Pathian a-om.
english: It happened at that time, that Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

paite: Tu in hiai ah Pathian min lou inla, kei leh ka tapa leh ka tapa' tapa leng khem lou in, ka hon hehpih khit tak sa bang in kei leh na tenna gam hehpih thuk sam ding in ka kiang ah kichiam in," achi hi.
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

paite: Abraham in, “Ka kichiam ding," achi hi.
Abimelek sikhate'n tuileh asuhsak ziak un Abraham in Abimelek asal hi.
english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

paite: Abimelek in, “Hiai thilhih pen kua ahia, ka thei himhim kei. Nang lah na hon hilh ngal kei a, tuni ngal lou in ka za kha himhim kei," achi hi.
english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, neither did I hear of it, until today.”

paite: Abraham in belamte leh bawngtalte api a, Abimelek kiang ah apia a; anih un thu akhungta uhi.
english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

paite: Abraham in abelamhon lak a belamnou anu sagih akoihtuam hi.
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

paite: Abimelek in Abraham kiang ah, "Belamnou anu sagih atuam a na koih bang na chihna ahia?” achi hi.
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs which you have set by themselves mean?”

paite: Ama'n, "Hiai tuileh keimah leh ahi, chih na hon theihpihna ding in hiai belamnou anu sagih ka khut a kipan na lak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

paite: Huaiziak in huai mun Beer-sheba asa hi; huai a anih ua akichiam ziak un.
english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, Beersheba can mean “well of the oath” or “well of seven.” because they both swore there.

paite: Beer-sheba ah thu akhungta uh. Abimelek athou a, asepaih pawl heutu Philok toh Philistiate gam ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

paite: Abraham in Beer-sheba ah meilah sing asuan a, huai ah TOUPA, Tangtawn Pathian min alou hi.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and called there on the name of Yahweh, the Everlasting God.

paite: Philistiate gam ah Abraham sawtpi ataam hi.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

paite: Huai thilte nung in Pathian in Abraham a-enchian hi. Akiang ah, "Abraham," achi a; ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: It happened after these things, that God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Na tapa, na tapa neihsun, na ittak, Isak tonpih inla, Moriah gam ah pai in, huai ah ka hon hilh ding tang khat ah halmang thillat in amah lan in," achi hi.
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, whom you love, even Isaac, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there for a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

paite: Beltak in Abraham athou a, sabiltung abawl a, akiang ah atapa Isak toh sikha tangval nih atonpih hi. Haltum thillat a ding in sing a-ek a, athou a, Pathian in ahilhna mun lam ah apaita hi.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

paite: Ani thum ni in Abraham adak a, amun gamlapi a om amu hi.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

paite: Abraham in asikha tangvalte kiang ah, "Hiai ah sabiltung toh ana om un. Kei leh naupang huai pam ah ka va hoh ding ua; huai ah Pathian ka va be ding ua; na kiang uah ka hong kik nawn ding uh," achi hi.
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go yonder. We will worship, and come back to you.”

paite: Abraham in halmang thillatna ding sing ala a, atapa Isak aposak hi. Ama'n mei leh temta atawi a; anih un apaikhawm uhi.
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

paite: Isak in apa Abraham ahoupih a, "Pa," achi a, ama'n, "Bawi, hiai ah ka om,” achi hi. Ama'n, "En dih, mei leh sing a-om a; hileh leng halmang thillat ding belamnou lah koi ah?" achi hi.
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

paite: Abraham in, "Bawi, Pathian in amah a dia halmang thillat ding belamnou angaihtuah tawm ding hi," achi a; anih un apaikhawm zel uhi.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

paite: Pathian in ahilhna mun ava tungta ua, Abraham in huai ah maitam adoh a, sing chiangkhawm in, atapa Isak ahen a, maitam a sing tung ah alumsak hi.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

paite: Abraham in akhut alik a, atapa thahna ding temta ala hi.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

paite: TOUPA angel in van a kipan amah asam a, "Abraham, Abraham," achi a, ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n, "Naupang tung ah na khut kha ke'n. Amah bangmah loh ke'n. Na tapa, na neihsun mahmah leng kei a dia na it louh ziak in Pathian na lau chih tu in ka theita," achi hi.
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy, neither do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

paite: Abraham adak a, a-en a, ngai in, anunglam ah belampa, singbawk a akii awk ana om hi. Abraham in huai belampa ava man a, atapa sik in halmang thillat in alan zawta hi.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

paite: Abraham in huai mun min, "Jehovah Jireh," asa hi; tuni tan a, "TOUPA tang ah ngaihtuah hi na ve," achih zel bang un.
english: Abraham called the name of that place Yahweh Will Provide or, Yahweh-Jireh, or, Yahweh-Seeing . As it is said to this day, “On Yahweh’s mountain, it will be provided.”

paite: TOUPA angel in anihveina ding in van a kipan Abraham asam nawn hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

paite: "Hiai thil na hih ziak leh na tapa neihsun na it louh ziak in kei mahmah in ka kichiam hi.
english: and said, “I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

paite: K'on vualzawl ngeingei ding a, van a aksite zah leh tuipi piau a piaunel zah in na suante ka pungsak ngeingei ding. Na suante'n adoute uh kulh kongkhak atang ding uhi.
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your seed greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your seed will possess the gate of his enemies.

paite: Ka thu na man ziak in na suan ah leitung a nam chih vualzawl in a-om ding uh," achi hi.
english: In your seed will all the nations of the earth be blessed, because you have obeyed my voice.”

paite: Asikha tangvalte kiang ah Abraham akik nawn a, athou ua, Beer-sheba lam manoh in apai uhi. Beer-sheba ah Abraham ateng hi.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

paite: Hichi in huai thilte nung in Abraham kiang ah, "Ngai in, Milkah in leng na sanggampa Nahor tate aneihsakta ve," chi in Abraham ahilh uhi.
english: It happened after these things, that it was told Abraham, saying, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

paite: Ata masa Huz ahi a; asanggampa Buz ahi, Aram pa Kemuel;
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

paite: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph leh Bethuelte leng ahi uh,
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”
