english: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

paite: Joseph in apa leh asanggamte tenna abawlsak a, Pharaoh thupiak bang in Aigupta gam a hoihpenna mun ah, agou ding un Rameses gam apeta hi.
english: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

paite: Joseph in apa leh asanggamte leh apa' inkuanpih tengteng a-inkuan uh dungzui zel in nek ding apia a, avakta hi.
english: Joseph nourished his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

paite: Huai gam tengteng ah nek ding himhim a-omta kei a; kial lah a-uang semsem hi. Kial ziak in Aigupta leh Kanaan gam abahta hi.
english: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

paite: Joseph in abuh leina man uh, Aigupta gam leh Kanaan gam a dangka om tengteng akhawmsak vek hi. Joseph in huai dangka Pharaoh inn ah atawilut hi.
english: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

paite: Aigupta gam leh Kanaan gam a dangka tengteng azatbei khit un, Aigupta mi tengteng Joseph kiang ah ahong ua, "Nek ding hon pia in. Na ma a si maimah ding ka hi ding uam? Dangka lah a-om nawn ngal kei a," achi uhi.
english: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”

paite: Joseph in, "Na gantate uh hon pe mai un. Dangka a-om nawn keileh na ganta man un nek ding ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”

paite: Joseph kiang ah agantate uh ahon pi ua; Joseph in sakol man ding, belamhon man ding, bawnghon man ding leh sabiltung man ding in nek ding ana pe zel hi. Huai kum in aganta tengteng uh man in nek ding apia a, avak chiat hi.
english: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.

paite: Huai kum abei a, kum ahong thak nawn in akiang ah ahong nawn ua, "Ka dangka teng uh abei takdan ka toupa ka hon iim kei ding uh. Ka toupa'n ka gantate uh na neita hi. Ka toupa mitmuh in ka pumpi uh leh ka gam uh chih louh, bangmah ka nei nawn kei uh.
english: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.

paite: Bangziak a na mitmuh a kou leh ka gam uh mangthang maimah ding ahia? Koumau mah ka gam uh toh an in hon lei mai in. Koumau leh ka gam uh Pharaoh sikhate ka hi ding uh. Si lou a dam a ka omtheihna ding un leh gam asiatlouhna ding in buhchi hon pia in," achi uhi.
english: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”

paite: Huchi in Joseph in Pharaoh a ding in Aigupta gam tengteng aleisakta hi. Atung ua kial a-ot mahmah ziak in Aigupta mite'n lah alou uh azuak chiat uhi. Huchi in gam Pharaoh a ahi vekta hi.
english: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.

paite: Aigupta gamgi tawp khat lam a kipan khat lam tawp pha in khuate ah mite akisuansakta hi.
english: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.

paite: Siampute gam kia alei kei a, siampute'n Pharaoh a kipan tantuan anei ua, Pharaoh in apiak atantuan uh ane zel uhi. Huaiziak in agam uh azuak kei uhi.
english: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.

paite: Huai nung in, Joseph in mite kiang ah, "Ngai un, tuni in na gam uh leh noute Pharaoh a ding in ka hon leita hi. Hiai ah nou a ding in buhchi a-om, lei ah na ching ding uhi.
english: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

paite: Buh lak hun chiang in hichi ahi ding a; Pharaoh a ding in seh nga suah seh khat zel na pe ding ua, aseh li pen noumau a ahi ding. Lou a achi ding, noumau na inkuanpihte uh leh na tanu neu chikchikte uh nek ding ahi ding," achi hi.
english: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”

paite: Amau, "Nang ka hinna uh na humbitta. Ka toupa'n pha asakleh adeihsakna hon musak henla, Pharaoh sikhate ka hi ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”

paite: Huchi in Joseph in Pharaoh in seh nga suah seh khat amuh zel ding thu, Aigupta gam a ding in tuni tanpha in dan in abawlta hi. Siampute gam kia ahi, Pharaoh a hilou.
english: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.

paite: Israel in Aigupta gam a Goshen gam ah tenna abawlta a, huai ah akihih inbul a, chi tampi asuang a, nakpitak in apungta hi.
english: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

paite: Aigupta gam ah Jakob kum sawm-le-sagih ateng a, huchi in Jakob damsung kum zakhat sawmli-le-sagih ahi.
english: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.

paite: Israel sih hun ahong naita a; atapa Joseph asam a, akiang ah, "Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, hehpih in ka pheipi nuai ah na khut golh inla, ka tung ah ginom leh diktak in gamta in, hehpih in Aigupta gam ah hon vui mahmah ke'n.
english: The time drew near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,

paite: Hon suangtute kiang a ka ihmut hun chiang in, nang Aigupta gam a kipan na hon pokhe ding a, amaute vuina mun ah na hon vui zaw ding ahi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Na chih bang in ka hih ding," achi hi.
english: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” He said, “I will do as you have said.”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka kiang ah kichiam in," achi a; akiang ah akichiamta hi. Huchi in lupna lukhung si in Israel akunta hi.
english: He said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.

paite: Huan hiaite nung in hichi ahong hi a, Joseph kiangah, "Ngai in, na pa achi na,” achi uhi. Huchi in atapa nihte Manasseh leh Ephraim akiang ah atonpih hi.
english: It happened after these things, that someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

paite: Jakob kiang ah, "Ngai in, na tapa Joseph na kiang ah ahong hi," chi in ahilh uh. Israel akihalhsak a, lupna ah atutou hi.
english: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

paite: Jakob in Joseph kiang ah, "Pathian Bangkim hihthei, Kanaan gam a Luz ah ka kiang ah akilak a, ahon vualzawl hi.
english: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

paite: Ka kiang ah, chi tampi ka hon suangsak ding a, ka hon hihpung lai ding. Chi tuamtuam omkhawm in ka hon bawl ding. Hiai gam na nung a na suante kiang ah atangtawn gou ding un ka pe ding," ahon chi hi.
english: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your seed after you for an everlasting possession.’

paite: "Na tapa nihte, Aigupta gam a na neihte, kei' a ahi ua, Reuben leh Simeon mah bang in Ephraim leh Manasseh kei' a ahi ding uhi.
english: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

paite: Hiai mite nung a ta na neihte nang a ahi ding uh, agoutan uah asanggamte uh min akikoppih ding uh ahi.
english: Your issue, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

paite: Kei tungthu ahihleh, Padan gam a kipan ka hong pai lai in Kanaan gam ah lamkal ah Ephrath khua gamla kuam ahih lai in, ka kiang ah Rakil asi hi. Huai ah Ephrath kho lampi ah ka vuita, huai tuh Bethlehem khua ahi,” achi hi.
english: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there in the way to Ephrath (the same is Bethlehem).”

paite: Israel in Joseph tapate a-en a, "Hiaite kuate ahi ua?" achi hi.
english: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”

paite: Joseph in apa kiang ah, "Hiaite ka tapa, Pathian in ahon piakte ahi uh," achi hi. Ama'n, "Hehpih in ka kiang ah hon pi in, amau ka na vualzawl ding," achi hi.
english: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”

paite: Israel mit a-upat tak ziak in achiim nawn kei a, ama'n ana tawp a, ana pom hi.
english: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see. He brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

paite: Israel in Joseph kiang ah, "Na mel muh ka kilamen nawn kei a, himahleh, ngai in, Pathian in na suante mel nangawn ahon musakta," achi hi.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your seed also.”

paite: Joseph in amau apa khuk kal a kipan apikhia a, amai a lei si in akun hi.
english: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

paite: Joseph in anih un akai a, Ephraim pen akhut taklam in Israel khut veilam pang ah, Manasseh pen akhut veilam in Israel khut taklam pang a kai in apinai hi.
english: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.

paite: Israel in asawkkalh teitei a, akhut taklam in asawk a, Ephraim anaupangzaw lusip ah anga a; Manasseh bel ata masa ahi.
english: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

paite: Joseph avualzawl a, "Hon suangpa Abraham leh Isak om zelna Pathian, tuni tan a ka damsung tengteng hon vakpa Pathian,
english: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,

paite: thil hoih lou tengteng a kipan hon tanpa Angel in naupangte vualzawl hen. Ka min leh hon suangpa Abraham leh Isak min pu uhen. Khovel ah thupitak hi ding in hong pung uhen,” achi hi.
english: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.”

paite: Joseph in apa'n akhut taklam Ephraim lusip a angak amuh in alungkim kei hial a; apa khut Ephraim lusip a kipan Manasseh lusip a suan ding in apa khut suansak a sawm hi.
english: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

paite: Joseph in apa kiang ah, "Pa, hichibang ding ahi kei. Hiai ahi ta masa, na khut taklam a lusip ah nga zaw in," achi hi.
english: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father; for this is the firstborn; put your right hand on his head.”

paite: Himahleh, apa a-ut kei a, "Ka thei hi, ka tapa aw, ka thei hi. Amah leng nam gen tham in a-om ding a, amah leng athupi ding hi. Himahleh amah sang in anaupa athupizaw ding a, asuante leng chi tuamtuam tamtak ahong hi ding uh," achi hi.
english: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his seed will become a multitude of nations.”

paite: Huchi in Jakob in, "Nang ah Israel vualzawl ahi ding, Pathian in Ephraim leh Manasseh bang in hon bawl hen," chi in avualzawl hi. Huchibang in Manasseh ma ah Ephraim a-omsak hi.
english: He blessed them that day, saying, “In you will Israel bless, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.

paite: Israel mah in Joseph kiang ah, "Ngai in, si ding ka hita. Himahleh na kiang uah Pathian a-om ding a, nou hon suangtute gam ah ahon pilut nawn ding hi.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

paite: Huai lou leng, na sanggamte tantuan sang in tan khat ka hon pe tuan hi, ka namsau leh ka thalpeu a Amorte khut a kipan ka laksak pen," achi hi.
english: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”

paite: Huan Jakob in atapate asamkhawm a, hichibang in agen hi: "Ni nanungte a na tung ua thil hong tung dingte ka hon hilhtheihna ding in hong kikhawm un.
english: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

paite: "Nou Jakob tapate aw, hong kikhawm unla, ngaikhia un; na pa uh Israel thu ngai un.
english: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

paite: "Reuben, nang ka tapa masa, ka thilhihtheihna, ka hatna gah masapen na hi. Sanpenna leh thuneihpenna nang a ahi.
english: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength; excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

paite: Himahleh tui bang a kip lou na hi, tungnunpenna na nei kei ding; na pa lupnapi a na kal ziak in. Huai ah ka lupna a kal in na hihbuah hi.
english: Boiling over as water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

paite: "Simeon leh Levi unau ahi ua, anamsaute uh sisan suahna vanzat ahi.
english: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

paite: Ka kha aw, nang zaw akikupna uah va kigolh ke'n. Ka thupina, nang zaw akikhopna uah tel ke'n. Aheh un mi athat ua, agenhak un bawngtal thagui asattat uhi.
english: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

paite: Ahehna un hamsia dong hen, hangsantak ahi ngal ua. Athangpaihna un leng hamsia dong hen, hinsetak ahi ngal ua. Jakob ah amaute ka kikhensak ding a, Israel ah ka hihdalh ding hi.
english: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

paite: "Judah, nang na unaute'n ahon phat ding uh. Na doute ngawng ah na khut na nga ding a; na ma ah na tapate akun ding uh.
english: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

paite: Judah humpinelkai nou ahi. Ka tapa, na sa keih na paitouhsanta. Na kun a, humpinelkai bang in na bok a, humpinelkainu bang in na kualsuk hi. Kua'n ahia hon thousak ngam ding?
english: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

paite: Judah a kipan lalchiang amang kei ding, vaihawmpa chiang akhekal a kipan amang kei ding. Shiloh ahong pai mateng; mite'n ama thu amang ding uhi.
english: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. To him will the obedience of the peoples be.

paite: Grepgui ah asakolnou akhih ding a, asabiltungnou grepgui hoih chi ah akhih ding hi. Apuansilhte uain in asawp ding a, grep sisan in apuan asawp lai ding hi.
english: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine; he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

paite: Amitte uain in asan ding ua, ahate nawitui in angou ding uhi.
english: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

paite: "Tuipi gei ah Zebulun ateng ding a, longkhawlna luipiau ahi ding a; agamgi Zidon ah ahi ding.
english: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

paite: "Issakar zaw sabiltung hattak ahi a, van-gik nih kal a kual ahi.
english: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

paite: Khawl hoih in athei a, gam leng hoih in athei; huchi in van po ding in aliangzang aniamsak a, phutluih nasem in sikha in ahong omta hi.
english: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

paite: "Dan in Israel nam lak a khat bang in amite vai ahawmsak ding.
english: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

paite: Dan ahihleh lamlian gei a gul, lampi a gulgial, atung a tuangmi thalkiak ek khop a sakol khetul tu nakpa ahi ding.
english: Dan will be a serpent in the way, an adder in the path, That bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

paite: "AW TOUPA, na hotdamna ka ngak gige hi.
english: I have waited for your salvation, Yahweh.

paite: "Gal in Gad asual ding a, himahleh ama'n akhetul lam uah amaute asual zaw ding hi.
english: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

paite: "Asher, anek ahoih ding a, kumpi nekte apiangsak ding hi.
english: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will yield royal dainties.

paite: "Naphtali, zukpi khah ahi. Thuhoih pipi agen zel hi.
english: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

paite: "Joseph hiang gah nuamtak ahi, tuikhuk kiang a hiang gah nuamtak; ahiang nawnsawnte'n baang atuam uhi.
english: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

paite: Thalkap mite'n nakpitak in amah ahihgenthei ua, akap ua, asimmoh uhi.
english: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecute him:

paite: Himahleh, amah thalpeu khauhtak in a-om gige a, abanthate Jakob' Pathian Mihatpa hatsak; belamchingmi, Israel suangpi a pan ahi.
english: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

paite: Na pa Pathian, nang hon panpih dingpa, Bangkim hihtheipa, tunglam van vualzawlnate, nuailam a om gige tui thuktak vualzawlnate, nawite leh sul vualzawlnate, nangmah hon vualzawl dingpa ngei hihhat in na om hi.
english: even by the God of your father, who will help you; by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

paite: Na pa vualzawlnate hon suangtute vualzawlna sang in tangtawn mualte tawpkhawk pha in athupizawta hi. Hiaite Joseph lutung ah a-om ding a, asanggamte a kipan hihtuam a ompa lusip ah a-om ding hi.
english: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of your ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

paite: "Benjamin ngia duhgawl bang in, zingsang in asa matte ane ding a, nitaklam in agallak ahawm ding," achi hi.
english: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the spoil.”

paite: Huaite tengteng Israel nam sawm-le-nihte ahi uh. Huai thute leng amaute vualzawlna akiang ua apa uh thugen ahi. Vualzawlna atan ding gun bang zel un avualzawl chiat hi.
english: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his blessing.

paite: Ama'n atapate thugou asiah a, akiang uah, "Ka chipihte kiang a pi a om ding ka hita. Hit mi Ephron lou a kokhuk a kei hon suangtute kiang ah hon vui un.
english: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

paite: Kanaan gam a Mamre ma a Makpelah lou a kokhuk, Abraham in kivuina mun ding a Hit mi Ephron a kipan alou toh alei ah.
english: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

paite: Huai ah Abraham leh azi Sarah avui ua; huai ah Isak leh azi Rebekah avui ua; huai mah ah Leah ka vui hi.
english: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

paite: Alou leh asung a kokhuk om Hit suante a kipan alei ahi,” achi hi.
english: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

paite: Jakob in atapate kiang a thugou asiah khit in akhete lupna ah angatou a, akha akhahta a, achipihte kiang ah pi in a-om samta hi.
english: When Jacob made an end of charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the spirit, and was gathered to his people.

paite: Hiai Adam suante khangthubu ahi. Pathian in mihing asiam ni in Pathian batpih in amah abawl hi.
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

paite: Pasal leh numei in amaute asiam a; avualzawl a, siam a a-om ni un amin uh Adam asa hi.
english: He created them male and female, and blessed them, and called their name “Adam,” “Adam” and “Man” are spelled with the exact same consonants in Hebrew, so this can be correctly translated either way. in the day when they were created.

paite: Adam in kum za-le-sawmthum ahih in amah mah bang, akibatpih ngei tapa anei a; amin Seth asa hi.
english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

paite: Seth aneih nung in Adam kum zagiat adam lai a; tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Adam damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-sawmthum ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

paite: Seth in kum za-le-nga ahih in, tapa Enosh anei hi.
english: Seth lived one hundred five years, and became the father of Enosh.

paite: Enosh aneih nung in Seth kum zagiat-le-sagih adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Seth damsung tengteng kum zakua sawm-le-nih ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

paite: Enosh in kum sawmkua ahih in tapa Kenan anei hi.
english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

paite: Kenan aneih nung in Enosh kum zagiat sawm-le-nga adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan, eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Enosh damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-nga ahi a, huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

paite: Kenan in kum sawmsagih ahih in, tapa Mahalalel anei hi.
english: Kenan lived seventy years, and became the father of Mahalalel.

paite: Mahalalel aneih nung in Kenan kum zagiat-le-sawmli adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of sons and daughters

paite: Kenan damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-sawm ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
english: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

paite: Mahalalel kum sawmguk-le-nga ahih in tapa Jared anei hi.
english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and became the father of Jared.

paite: Jared aneih nung in Mahalalel kum zagiat-le-sawmthum adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Mahalalel damsung tengteng kum zagiat sawmkua-le-nga ahi a, huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

paite: Jared in kum zakhat sawmguk-le-nih ahih in tapa Enok anei hi.
english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, and became the father of Enoch.

paite: Enok aneih nung in Jared kum zagiat adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Jared damsung tengteng kum zakua sawmguk-le-nih ahi a, huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

paite: Enok in kum sawmguk-le-nga ahih in, tapa Methuselah anei hi.
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, and became the father of Methuselah.

paite: Methuselah aneih nung in Enok kum zathum sung Pathian toh atonkhawm ua, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Enoch walked with God after he became the father of Methuselah three hundred years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Enok damsung tengteng kum zathum sawmguk-le-nga ahi.
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

paite: Pathian toh Enok atonkhawm ua, amah a-omta kei a; Pathian in alata hi.
english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.

paite: Methuselah in kum zakhat sawmgiat-le-sagih ahih in tapa Lamekh anei hi.
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, and became the father of Lamech.

paite: Lamekh aneih nung in Methuselah kum zasagih sawmgiat-le-nih adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Methuselah damsung tengteng kum zakua sawmguk-le-kua ahi a, huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

paite: Lamekh in kum zakhat sawmgiat-le-nih ahih in tapa anei hi.
english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of a son,

paite: "Hiai ngei in TOUPA hamsiatkhum leitung ziak a i nasepna leh khut a i sepgimna ah hon lungmuan ding," chi in amin Noah asa hi.
english: and he named him Noah, saying, “This same will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, because of the ground which Yahweh has cursed.”

paite: Noah aneih nung in Lamekh kum zanga sawmkua-le-nga adam lai a, tanute leh tapate anei lai hi.
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of sons and daughters.

paite: Lamekh damsung tengteng kum zasagih sawmsagih-le-sagih ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

paite: Noah kum zanga a upa ahi. Noah in Shem, Ham leh Japheth anei hi.
english: Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

paite: Huan Joseph in apa mai asi a, akah a, atawp hi.
english: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

paite: Joseph in asikha damdawi siamte apa luang muat thei lou a bawl ding in thu apia hi. Huchi in damdawisiamte'n Israel luang muat thei lou in abawl uhi.
english: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

paite: Aluang bawlna in ni sawmli azang ua; muat thei lou a bawlna ding a ni hiai zah lut zel mah ahi. Ni sawmsagih sung teng Aiguptate'n amah asuun uhi.
english: Forty days were fulfilled for him, for that is how many the days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for him for seventy days.

paite: Amah asuun nite uh abei nung in, Joseph in Pharaoh inkuante ahoupih a, "Na mitmuh ua deihsakna ka tanleh hehpih in Pharaoh bil a zak ding in, 'Ka pa'n, ngai in, si ding ka hita.
english: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to the house of Pharaoh, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

paite: Kanaan gam a ka han ding a ka tohsa ngei ah na hon vui ding ahi,' chi in ahon kichiamsak hi. Huaiziak in tu in hehpih in ka pa hon potousak inla, hon va vuisak in. Huchi in ka hong pai nawn ding, achi, chi in hon gensak un," achi hi.
english: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”

paite: Pharaoh in, "Ahon kichiamsak bang in na pa va potou ve," achi hi.
english: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”

paite: Joseph, apa vui ding in ava hohtou hi. Pharaoh sikha teng, a-inkuan lak a upate leh Aigupta gam upate tengteng leh,
english: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

paite: Joseph inkuanpih tengteng leh asanggamte leh apa inkuanpihte, akiang ah ava hohtou uhi. Ataneu chikchikte uleh abelamhonte uleh abawnghonte kia uh Goshen gam ah anusia uhi.
english: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

paite: Akiang uah kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite leng ahohtou ua, pawlching petmah ahi uh.
english: There went up with him both chariots and horsemen. It was a very great company.

paite: Jordan lui gal a Atad phual atung ua, huai ah nakpitak in akah ua, ni sagih sung apa suunna anei uhi.
english: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

paite: Hiai gammi Kanaante'n, Atad phual a ami suun uh amuh un, “Hiai Aiguptate misi suunna thupitak ahi," achi uhi. Huaiziak in huai mun Abel- mizraim asa ua, huai Jordan lui gal a om ahi.
english: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

paite: Atapate'n athupiak bang in ahihsak uhi.
english: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,

paite: Atapate'n Kanaan gam ah azawnglut ua, Abraham in kivuina mun ding a, Hit mi Ephron a kipan alou toh aleikhawm Mamre ma a Makpelah lou a kokhuk ah avuita uhi.
english: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, for a possession of a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, before Mamre.

paite: Apa avui khit in Joseph leh asanggamte leh apa vui ding a amah toh hohtou tengteng Aigupta gam ah akik nawnta uhi.
english: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

paite: Joseph sanggamte'n apa uh sita ahi chih amuh un, "Joseph in ahon mudah ding a, atung a i thilhihkhelh tengteng phu i tung uah akim in ahon la kha ding e,” achi uhi.
english: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all of the evil which we did to him.”

paite: Joseph kiang a hilh ding in mi asawl ua, "Na pa'n asih ma in hichi in thu apia hi.
english: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

paite: Joseph kiang ah, 'Hehpih in na sanggamte tatlekna leh agitlouhna uh ngaidam in. Na tung ah thil hoih lou ahihta ngal ua. Tu in hehpih in na pa Pathian sikhate tatlekna ngaidam in,' achi, chi in va gen un," achi hi. Akiang a agentak un Joseph akap hi.
english: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

paite: Asanggamte leng ava hoh ua, ama ah abokkhup chiat ua, "Ngai in, na sikhate ka hi uh," achi uhi.
english: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

paite: Joseph in akiang uah, "Lau kei un. Pathian sik a om ka hi a hia?
english: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

paite: 20 Nou zaw ka tung ah thil gilou hih lungsim na pu ua; himahleh tuni in mi tampi hing leh dam a humbitna ding a thil hoih suahsak Pathian lungsim ahi zaw hi.
english: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save many people alive.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in lau kei un. Nou leh na taneu chikchikte uh ka hon vak ding," achi hi. Huchi in amau alungmuan a, kamsiamtak in ahoupih hi.
english: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will nourish you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

paite: Joseph, amah leh apa inkuanpihte toh Aigupta gam ah ateng ua, Joseph kum za-le-sawmkhat adam hi.
english: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

paite: Joseph in Ephraim ta, tusawn thum chiang amu hi. Manasseh tapa Makir tate leng Joseph phei tung a khanglian ngen ahi uh.
english: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

paite: Joseph in asanggamte kiang ah, "Si ding ka hita hi. Himahleh Pathian in ahong veh ngeingei ding a, hiai gam a kipan hon pikhia in, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a kichiam a, piak ding achiamsa gam ah ahon pitou ding," achi hi.
english: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

paite: Joseph in Israel suante akichiamsak a, "Pathian in ahong veh ngeingei ding a, hiai a kipan ka guhte na potou ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”

paite: Huchi in Joseph kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi. Aluang muat thei lou ding in abawl ua, Aigupta gam ah hankuang sung ah akoih uhi.
english: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, leitung a mite ahong pun ua, tanute ahon neih un,
english: It happened, when men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

paite: Pathian tapate'n mite tanute melhoih in amu ua; adeihlam chiat uh zi in anei uhi.
english: that God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took for themselves wives of all that they chose.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Ka Kha in tangtawn in mi asual nilouh kei ding, amah lah sa ahi ngal a, himahleh kum za-le-sawmnih adam ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; yet will his days be one hundred twenty years.”

paite: Huai hun lai in lei ah miliante a-om ua; huai nung in leng Pathian tapate'n mite tanute thei a, amau toh tate aneih zel lai un, huaite mah nidanglai a mihat, miminthangte ahi uhi.
english: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters. They bore children to them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

paite: TOUPA'N lei ah mite gitlouhdan nasa ahi chih leh alungtang lunggeldan uh gilou ngen ahi ngitnget chih amu hi.
english: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

paite: Leitung a mi abawl ziak in TOUPA akisik a, lunggimna in aneihloh hi.
english: Yahweh was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Leitung a kipan ka misiam ka hihmang mai ding. Mite, sate, ganhingte leh tung a leng vasate tan in; ka bawl ziak in ka kisik," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground; man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky; for I am sorry that I have made them.”

paite: Noah in bel TOUPA mitmuh in deihsakna atang hi.
english: But Noah found favor in Yahweh’s eyes.

paite: Noah suan hiaite ahi uh: Noah midik ahi a, adam tonpihte lak ah gensiatbei ahi a; Pathian toh Noah atonkhawm uhi.
english: This is the history of the generations of Noah. Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

paite: Noah in tapa thum Shem, Ham leh Japheth anei hi.
english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

paite: Pathian' mitmuh in lei asia a, hiamgamna in lei adim khin hi.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

paite: Huan Pathian in lei a-en a, ngai in, asegawp a; sa tengteng in leitung ah a-omdan uh ahihse khinta uhi.
english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

paite: Pathian in Noah kiang ah, "Sa tengteng beina ka ma ah ahong tungta; amaute ziak in hiamgamna in leitung adim khinta ngal a. Ngai in, leitung toh amau ka hihmang ding.
english: God said to Noah, “The end of all flesh has come before me, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them with the earth.

paite: Nang a ding in meilah sing in long bawl inla; long ah dantante na bawl ding ahi. Asunglam leh apolam meilah nai in na zut vek ding hi.
english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

paite: Hiai na bawldan ding ahi. Long dunglam tong zathum hi henla, availam tong sawmnga hi henla, asanlam tong sawmthum hi hen.
english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship will be three hundred cubits, its breadth fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

paite: Long ah tohlet na bawl ding a, atunglam tong khat chiang a na zoh ding ahi. Apang ah long kongkhak na bawl ding a; chial nuainung leh chial nihna leh chial thumna nei in na bawl ding ahi.
english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

paite: Ngai in, kei mahmah in, sa tengteng hinna hatna pai khempeuh, van nuai a kipan hihmangthang ding in leitung ah tuichim ka tungsak ding a; lei a thil chih omte asi vek ding uh.
english: I, even I, do bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is in the earth will die.

paite: Himahleh nang toh ka thukhun ka kipsak ding a, long ah na lut ding ahi. Nang na lut ding a, na tapate leh na zi leh na tapate' zite leng na kiang ah alut ding uh ahi.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

paite: Sa tengteng a thil hing chiteng lak a kipan, chi chih nihnih in, na kiang ah hinsak ding in long ah na pilut ding ahi. Amaute anu leh apa zel ahi ding uhi.
english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

paite: Vasate amau chi omdan bang chiat in, gante amau chi omdan bang chiat in, chỉ chih nihnih in na hinsak ding in na kiang ah ahong pai ding uh ahi.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort shall come to you, to keep them alive.

paite: Nek theih an chi tuamtuam kaikhawm inla, na kiang ah koih in. Nang leh amaute a ding in an ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: Take with you of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

paite: Huchibang in Noah in ahih a; Pathian in akiang a thu apiak tengteng ahi bangbang in ahihta hi.
english: Thus Noah did. According to all that God commanded him, so he did.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Noah kiang ah, "Nang leh na inkuanpih tengteng long ah lutta un. Nang zaw hiai khang a ka ma ah midiktat na hih ka hon mu hi.
english: Yahweh said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

paite: Sa siang chiteng lak ah anu leh apa, kop sagih zel; sa siang lou lak ah anu leh apa chiat toh kop nih zel, na kiang ah na pi ding ahi.
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

paite: Tung a leng vasa lak ah leng, anu leh apa chiat, kop sagih zel in; leitung a chi khah ding a hinsak ding in.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

paite: Ni sagih in asam lai a, huai khit chiang in leitung ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung vuah ka zusak ding a; ka bawl thil hing chiteng leitung a kipan ka hihmang ding," achi hi.
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. Every living thing that I have made, I will destroy from the surface of the ground.”

paite: Noah in TOUPA'N akiang a thu apiak tengteng ahi bangbang in ahihta hi.
english: Noah did everything that Yahweh commanded him.

paite: Leitung a tuichim ahong tun lai in, Noah kum zaguk a upa ahita hi.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

paite: Tuichim atun ding ziak in long ah Noah alut a, atapate leh azi leh atapate' zite leng akiang ah alut chiat uhi.
english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the waters of the flood.

paite: Sa siang lak ah leng, sa siang lou lak ah leng, vasa lak ah leng, leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng lak ah leng,
english: Clean animals, animals that are not clean, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

paite: Pathian in Noah kiang a thu apiak bang in, anu leh apa chiat, akopkop in, Noah kiang ah long ah alut uhi.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

paite: Huan ni sagih nung in leitung ah tuichim atungta hi.
english: It happened after the seven days, that the waters of the flood came on the earth.

paite: Noah kum zaguk ahih kum, akha nihna, ani sawm-le-sagih ni in, huai ni mah in tui thuk zapi nak tengteng ahong puakzak a, van tohlette leng hong kihongta uhi.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on the same day all the fountains of the great deep were burst open, and the sky’s windows were opened.

paite: Ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung teng leitung ah vuahpi azuta hi.
english: The rain was on the earth forty days and forty nights.

paite: Huai ni mah in long ah Noah leh Noah tapate Shem, Ham, Japheth leh Noah zi alut ua, atapate zi thumte leng akiang ah alut uhi.
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship;

paite: Amaute alut ua, sa chiteng amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, ganhing leitung a bokvak a pai chiteng amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, vasa chiteng, amau chi omdan dungzui zel in, vasa chiteng, kha nei chiteng leng alut uhi.
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

paite: Sa tengteng hinna hatna pai himhimte, akopkop in Noah kiang ah long ah alut uhi.
english: They went to Noah into the ship, by pairs of all flesh with the breath of life in them.

paite: Alutte Pathian in akiang a thu apiak bang in, sa tengteng lak a anu leh apa zel in alut uhi. Huchi in TOUPA'N amah akhakkhumta hi.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; and Yahweh shut him in.

paite: Leitung ah ni sawmli sung teng tuichim atung a; tui ahong khang a, long alam a, leitung ah adomkangta hi.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

paite: Tui ahong om zuazua a, leitung ah akhan in ahong khang a, tui tung ah long akilam hi.
english: The waters prevailed, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

paite: Leitung ah tui nakpi in ahong om zuazua a; van nuai a tang sang tengtengte atum khin vekta hi.
english: The waters prevailed exceedingly on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

paite: Tong sawm-le-nga hial a sang in tui ahong om a; tangte tupmang in a-omta uhi.
english: The waters prevailed fifteen cubits upward, and the mountains were covered.

paite: Lei a tang thei sa chiteng, vasate, gante, gamsate, ganhing lei a bokvak a pai chitengte, michih tengte toh asi khin vek uhi.
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

paite: Anak ua hinna kha hatna omna tengteng, gam a om tengteng asi khin vek uhi.
english: All in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, of all that was on the dry land, died.

paite: Leitung a thil hing chiteng omte, mite, gante, ganhingte, tung a leng vasate toh hihmang in a-om ua; lei a kipan hihman in a-omta ua, long sung a om Noah leh akiang a omte kia hawi in a-om uhi.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

paite: Ni za-le-sawmnga sung teng leitung ah tui avung hi.
english: The waters prevailed on the earth one hundred fifty days.

paite: Huan Pathian in Noah leh long sung a akiang a thil hing chiteng leh ganta om tengteng atheigige a; Pathian in leitung ah huih anungsak a, tui ahong dai panta hi.
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

paite: Tui thukpi nakte leh van tohlette hong kikhakta ua, van a kipan vuah leng theusak ahita.
english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

paite: Lei a kipan tui akiam giaigiai a; ni za-le-sawmnga nung in tui hong tawm deuhta a,
english: The waters receded from the earth continually. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters decreased.

paite: akha sagihna ani sawm-le-sagih ni in Ararat tang ah long ahong kinga hi.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

paite: Akha sawmna tan in tui akiam giaigiai zel a; akha sawmna ani khat ni in mualvumte akimuta hi.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were seen.

paite: Ni sawmli nung in hichi ahong hi a, Noah in abawl long tohlet ahongta hi.
english: It happened at the end of forty days, that Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

paite: Va-ak khat akhahkhia a, leitung a kipan tui akan khit masiah huai va-ak avial lenlen hi.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

paite: Leitung ah tui atawmta hia, tawm nai lou, chih theihna ding in vakhu khat akhahkhe nawn hi.
english: He sent out a dove from him, to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

paite: Himahleh vakhu in tukna ding himhim amu kei a, akiang ah long ah akik nawn a; tui lah leitung pumpi ah a-om lai ngal a. Polam ah akhut agolhkhia a, long sung ah akiang ah ana lalut nawn hi.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned to him into the ship; for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

paite: Ni sagih dang angak lai a; long a kipan vakhu akhahkhe nawn hi.
english: He stayed yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

paite: Nitaklam in akiang ah vakhu ahong lut nawn a; ngai in, amuk in olive nah khat ahon tuah hi. Noah in leitung ah tui atawmta chih atheita hi.
english: The dove came back to him at evening, and, behold, in her mouth was an olive leaf plucked off. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

paite: Ni sagih dang angak nawn a; vakhu akhahkhe nawn a; akiang ah hong kik nawn kei hi.
english: He stayed yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akum zaguk-le-khatna, akha khatna, ani khat ni in, leitung a kipan tui akangta hi. Noah in long khuhna akoihsuan a, a-en a; ngai in, leitung ahulta hi.
english: It happened in the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dried.

paite: Akha nihna ani sawmnih-le-sagih ni in leitung ahulta hi.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

paite: Pathian in Noah kiang ah thu agen a;
"Long a kipan nang pawt inla, na zi leh na tapate leh na tapate zite leng na kiang ah pawt uhen.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, and your wife, and your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

paite: Sa tengteng lak a thil hing chiteng na ompihte, vasate, gante, leitung a bokvak a pai ganhing chitengte toh na kiang ah pikhia in, leitung a chiphatak a chi tampi suang a ahong puntheihna ding un," achi hi.
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

paite: Noah apawt a, atapate leh azi leh atapate zite leng akiang ah apawt uhi.
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

paite: Sa chiteng, ganhing chiteng, vasa chiteng, leitung a tang thei peuhmahte amau chi omdan dungzui zel in long a kipan apawtta uhi.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

paite: Noah in TOUPA a ding in maitam adoh a; sa siang chiteng lak leh vasa siang chiteng lak a kipan ala a, maitam ah halmang pumpiaknate alanta hi.
english: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

paite: TOUPA'N huai gim namtui aza a; TOUPA'N alungsim in, "Mite ziak in leitung ka hamsiat nawn kei ding, mite lungsim ngaihtuahnate lah tuailai ahih a kipan gilou ahi ngal ua. Tua ka gawt bang in thil hing chiteng leng ka gawt nawn kei ding.
english: Yahweh smelled the pleasant aroma. Yahweh said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake, because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I ever again strike everything living, as I have done.

paite: "Leitung a-om lai teng buhtuh leh buhlakte, khovot leh kholumte, nipi leh phalbite, sun leh zante abei kei ding," achi hi.
english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night shall not cease.”

paite: Huan Pathian in Noah leh atapate avualzawl a, akiang uah, "Chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, lei hon luahdim un.
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth.

paite: Leitung a sa chiteng leh tung a leng vasa chiteng in nou kihtakna leh lauhna anei ding uh. Hiaite leh lei a bokvak a pai tengteng leh tuipi a ngasa tengteng na khut ua piak ahita uhi.
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that the ground teems with, and all the fish of the sea are delivered into your hand.

paite: Thil hing tang thei chitengte nou a ding in nek ding ahi ding ua; anteh hing ka hon piak bang in bangkim ka hon pe vek hi.
english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As the green herb, I have given everything to you.

paite: Himahleh sa, ahinna sisan toh zaw na nekhawm ding uh ahi kei.
english: But flesh with its life, its blood, you shall not eat.

paite: Na hinna sisan phu ka la ngeingei ding. Sa chiteng lak ah ka la ding a; mi lak ah leng. Michih asanggamte uh lak ah, mite hinna phu ka la chiat ding.
english: I will surely require your blood of your lives. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

paite: "Mi sisan suahmi kuapeuh, huai mi mah in ama sisan asuah ding, Pathian batpih a mihing bawl ahi ngal a.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

paite: "Nou chi tampi suang in hong pung unla, ta leh nau tampi nei unla, leitung ah hong pung un," achi hi.
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”

paite: Pathian in Noah kiang leh akiang a om atapate kiang ah,
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

paite: "Ngai un, kei mahmah in na kiang uah leh na nung ua na suante uh kiang ah leng ka thukhun ka hihkip hi.
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

paite: Na kiang ua om thil hing chiteng, na ompih uh vasate, gante, na ompih uh lei a sa chitengte kiang ah leng; long a kipan hong pawt tengteng, lei a sa chiteng kiang nangawn ah.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

paite: Na kiang uah ka thukhun ka hihkip ding; sa tengteng leng tuichim a hihman in a-om nawn kei ding ua; lei hihse ding in tuichim atung nawn kei ding," achi hi.
english: I will establish my covenant with you: all flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood, neither will there ever again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

paite: Pathian mah in, "Kei leh nou leh na kiang ua thil hing chiteng omte kal a, suan tawp nei lou a omte a ding in, hiai ka thukhun chiamtehna ahi ding hi.
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

paite: Meipi ah ka sakhituihup ka zamsak a, huai kei leh lei kal a thukhun chiamtehna ding ahi.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be for a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, leitung a meipi ka kaisak in meipi ah sakhituihup akimu ding hi.
english: It will happen, when I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

paite: Kei leh nou leh sa tengteng lak a thil hing chitengte kal a, ka thukhun om ka theigige ding. Sa tengteng hihmang ding in tui alet nawn kei ding hi.
english: and I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

paite: Meipi a sakhituihup azam chiang in, Pathian leh leitung a sa om tengteng lak a thil hing chiteng kal a tangtawn thukhun om ka theihgige theihna ding in ka en zel ding," achi hi.
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

paite: Pathian mah in Noah kiang ah, "Hiai kei leh leitung a sa om tengteng kal a ka thukhun hihkip chiamtehna ahi," achi nawn hi.
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

paite: Noah tapa long a kipan pawtte Shem, Ham leh Japheth ahi uhi (Kanaan pa Ham ahi).
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

paite: Hiai mi thumte Noah tapate ahi ua, amaute a kipan pawtte'n leitung pumpi azelsuak uhi.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these, the whole earth was populated.

paite: Louneimi in Noah ahong om pan a, grephuan abawl hi.
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

paite: Uain adawn a, akham a; apuanin ah alumkhialta hi.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

paite: Kanaan pa Ham in apa lumkhial amu a, inpua a om a-unau nihte ava hilh hi.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

paite: Shem leh Japheth in puan ala ua, aliang ua kizawn in anung pai ua, apa uh lumkhial ava khuh uhi. Amai uh lehlam nga in apa uh lumkhial amu kei uhi.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

paite: Noah, uain kham ahong halh a, atung a atapa naupangpen in ahihdan ahon theita hi.
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

paite: "Kanaan hamsiat in om hen. Asanggamte sikhate sikha ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be servant of servants to his brothers.”

paite: "Shem TOUPA Pathian phat in om hen. Asikha in Kanaan om hen.
english: He said, “Blessed be Yahweh, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

paite: Pathian in Japheth hihlian henla, Asikha in Kanaan om hen,” achi lai hi.
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

paite: Tuichim tun nung in Noah kum zathum-le-sawmnga adam hi.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

paite: Noah damsung tengteng kum zakua-le-sawmnga ahi a; huchi in asita hi.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, then he died.

paite: Puakgik zawlnei Habakkuk in amuh;
english: The oracle which Habakkuk the prophet saw.

paite: Aw TOUPA, kei bang tan kikou a, nang hon za lou ding na hia? Hiamgamna thu ah na kiang ah ka kikoukhia a, nang lah na hon dawng nuam kei hi.
english: Yahweh, “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?

paite: Bangziak a thulimlouhna hon musak a, ginatlouhna hon ensak na hia? Lohna leh hiamgamna lah ka ma ah a-om ngal ua; kilanna a-om a, kinakna a-om hi.
english: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.

paite: Huaiziak in dan a ze-ol a, vaihawmna akuankhe ngei kei; giloute'n lah diktatte a-umsuak vek ua; huaiziak in vaihawmna pawtkhia hekkawi in a-om hi.
english: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice goes forth perverted.

paite: Namte lak en unla, thei un, lamdangtak in lamdang sa unla; noute hun sung in nna khat ka sem ding, huai hon hilh mah le uh na gingta nuam kei ding uhi.
english: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days, which you will not believe though it is told you.

paite: Ngai un, Kaldaite ka bawlkhia hi, huai nam hiamgam leh ngongtat; huaite'n amau tenna mun hilou tang ding in lei vailam khaktan in apai uh.
english: For, behold, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the breadth of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.

paite: Amulkimhuai un alauhuai ua; avaihawmna uh leh athuneihna uh amau ngei a kipan apawtkhia hi.
english: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.

paite: Asakolte uh leng gialbemte sang in akinzaw ua, nitaklam ngiate sang in alauhuaizaw uh; asakol tungtuang mite uh akiphalh ua; ahi, gamlapi a kipan asakol tungtuang mite uh ahong pai ua; negai ding a kinoh muvanlai bang in aleng uhi.
english: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.

paite: Hiamgam ding in avek un ahong ua; suahlam huih bang in kilawptak in amailam uh en in atai ua; piaunel bang in salte akaikhawm uhi.
english: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face the desert. He gathers prisoners like sand.

paite: Ahi, amaute'n kumpipate anuihsan ua, amau a ding in thuneite nuihzatna ahi uhi; kulh muanhuai chiteng anuihsan ua; leivui a vum a, alak zel ziak un.
english: Yes, he scoffs at kings, and princes are a derision to him. He laughs at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen ramp, and takes it.

paite: Huai chiang in huih bang in apaisuak ding ua, mailam anawt zel ding ua, athahatna uh Pathian a neite gilou mohtansak ahi uhi.
english: Then he sweeps by like the wind, and goes on. He is indeed guilty, whose strength is his god.”

paite: Aw TOUPA ka Pathian, ka Mi Siangthou, tangtawn a kipan na hi kei a hia? Ka si kei ding uh, Aw TOUPA, vaihawm ding in amah na hihkipta hi. Nang, Aw suangpi, bawldik ding in amau na tungkheta hi.
english: Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed him for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.

paite: Gilou muhna ding a nang mit chiimzaw, hoihlouhna ensim thei lou, bang ding a lepchiahtak a thilbawlte mu a, gilou in ama sang a diktatzaw mi anawmvalh lai a dai maimah na hia?
english: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously, and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,

paite: Mite tuipi ngasate bang, atung ua vaihawmtu nei lou leh bokvak ganhingte bang a bawl maimah na hi.
english: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

paite: Ngakuai in avek un akhaikhe tou a, alen in amau aman a, amaute alenpi a huaikhawm a om in nuamsa in akipak uhi.
english: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net, and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.

paite: Huaiziak in len a ding in kithoihna alan ua, alenpi ua ding in gimlim ahal hi; amaute ziak a atan uh hoih a, asa uh atam ziak in.
english: Therefore he sacrifices to his net, and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious, and his food is good.

paite: Huaiziak in amau lente hihvuak a, namte hihse gige tel ding ahi uh maw?
english: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?

paite: Ka galvenna ah ka dingh dia, insang ah ka pang ding a, ka kiang a bang ahia agen chih thei ding in leh ka phunna tungtang bangchi in ka dawng dia chih thei ding in ka ngak ding hi.
english: I will stand at my watch, and set myself on the ramparts, and will look out to see what he will say to me, and what I will answer concerning my complaint.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N kei ahon dawng a, mengmuh pen gelh inla, asim peuhmah atai theihna ding in, suangpekte ah kichiantak in gelh in.
english: Yahweh answered me, “Write the vision, and make it plain on tablets, that he who runs may read it.

paite: Mengmuh lah hun sehsa a ding ahi lai a, atawplam ah akinoh a, azuau kei ding; om tadih mahleh, ngak in; ahong tun ding ziak in, azekai kei ding hi.
english: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, and it hurries toward the end, and won’t prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it; because it will surely come. It won’t delay.

paite: Ngai in, akha kiliansak amah midiklou ahi, himahleh midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding hi.
english: Behold, his soul is puffed up. It is not upright in him, but the righteous will live by his faith.

paite: Ahi, uain in lepchiahtak in a-omsak a, miki-uangsak, om kinken lou ahi; gawtmun bang a adeih hihlian, sihna bang ahi a, suklungkim theih ahi kei, nam tengteng amah ah akaikhawm zaw a, atung ah mipite tengteng asekhawm hi.
english: Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous. A haughty man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. , and he is like death, and can’t be satisfied, but gathers to himself all nations, and heaps to himself all peoples.

paite: Hiaite tengteng in amah dem in gentehna agen un, amah demna paunak enghouna hiai bang a gen in, "Amah a lou hihpungpa tung agik!" Bang tan? chi in agen kei ding ua hia! Bang tan thil khamna zang a kihih inbulpa;
english: Won’t all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, ‘Woe to him who increases that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?’

paite: na leibatnate thakhat a hong thoukhia a, nang hon hihbuai ding a hong khanglou lou ding uhia? Nang amaute a ding a gallak suak ding hilou na hi maw?
english: Won’t your debtors rise up suddenly, and wake up those who make you tremble, and you will be their victim?

paite: Nam tampi na loh ziak in, mipi akhosuaksunte tengteng in nang ahon lok ding ua; mite sisan ziak in leh gam tung, khopi tung leh asung a teng tengteng tung a hiamgam na hihna ziak in.
english: Because you have plundered many nations, all the remnant of the peoples will plunder you, because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to the city and to all who dwell in it.

paite: "Tunglam sang a abu asehtheihna ding leh gilou khut a kipan tatkhiak a-omtheihna ding a, a-inn a dia punna gilou mumi tung agik!"
english: Woe to him who gets an evil gain for his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the hand of evil!

paite: Mi tampi satkhia in, na hinna tung a khial in na inkote tung ah zumhuaina na zong ahi.
english: You have devised shame to your house, by cutting off many peoples, and have sinned against your soul.

paite: Baang a kipan suang akikoukhe ding a, sing a kipan inkam in dawng ding ahih ziak in.
english: For the stone will cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the woodwork will answer it.

paite: "Sisan a khua lam a, khopi gitlouhna a dingsakmi tung agik!"
english: Woe to him who builds a town with blood, and establishes a city by iniquity!

paite: Ngai in, mite sepgimna mei a khul ding singkhuah bang leh namte kisukgimna uh bangmah lou a suah ding sepaihte' TOUPA thilgelsa ahi kei maw?
english: Behold, isn’t it of Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

paite: Tuite'n tuipi akhuh bang in, TOUPA thupina theihna a leitung pumpi dim ding ahih ziak in.
english: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.

paite: A-inveng dawn ding pia a, huai a gu hel a, avuaktanna uh a-ettheihna ding a, amah khamsak lai mi tung agik hi!
english: “Woe to him who gives his neighbor drink, pouring your inflaming wine until they are drunk, so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

paite: Thupina deihna in zumhuaina in na dim a; nang leng dawn inla, zeksumloupa bang in om in; TOUPA khut taklam nang lam ngatsak ahi ding a, na thupina tung ah zumhuaina hoih lou a-om ding hi.
english: You are filled with shame, and not glory. You will also drink, and be exposed! The cup of Yahweh’s right hand will come around to you, and disgrace will cover your glory.

paite: Lebanon tung a hiamgam hihna in nang ahon khuh ding a, gamsate siatna in nang ahon lausak ding; gam tung, khopi leh asung a teng tengteng tung a hiamgam a mite sisan na suah ziak in.
english: For the violence done to Lebanon will overwhelm you, and the destruction of the animals, which made them afraid; because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, to every city and to those who dwell in them.

paite: A gelhmi in agelh, milim gelh; milim sun, zuaute sinsakpa, milim pau thei lou bawl ding a, huai a anasep bang phatuam ahia?
english: “What value does the engraved image have, that its maker has engraved it; the molten image, even the teacher of lies, that he who fashions its form trusts in it, to make mute idols?

paite: Sing kiang a, Halh in; suang pau thei lou kiang a, Thou in, chimi tung agik hi! Ngai in dangka-eng leh dangka a luan milim, amah ah nakna om lou in asinsak thei diam?
english: Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in its midst.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA atempul siangthou ah a-om a; ama ah leitung pumpi dai sipsip hen.
english: But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”

paite: Zawlnei Habakkuk thumna, Sigionoth toh kituak a bawl
english: A prayer of Habakkuk, the prophet, set to victorious music.

paite: Aw TOUPA, na tanchin agen uh ka za a, ka lau hi. Aw TOUPA, kumte lak ah nasep hihhalh in, kumte lak ah kitheisak in; thangpaihna zahngaihna theigige in.
english: Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the midst of the years. In the midst of the years make it known. In wrath, you remember mercy.

paite: eman a kipan in Pathian ahong pai a, Paran tang a kipan in Mi Siangthou, Selah Athupina in vante atuam a, amah phatna in leitung adim hi.
english: God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.

paite: Amah thupina vak bang ahi a; akhut a pan nizung ahong suakkhia hi; athilhihtheihna huai ah akhuh hi.
english: His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his hand, where his power is hidden.

paite: Ama ah hipi apai a, akhepekte ah suangkuangthei kuang apaikheta hi.
english: Plague went before him, and pestilence followed his feet.

paite: Adingh a, lei alingsak a; amu a, namte ahawlzak hi; tangtawn tangte hihdalh in a-omta ua, tangtawn mualte akun ua, apaina nidang a bang ahi.
english: He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.

paite: Kushan puaninte gimthuak in ka mu a; Midian gam mite alinggawp uhi.
english: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction. The dwellings of the land of Midian trembled.

paite: Luite tung a TOUPA lungkim lou ahi diam aw? Luite tung a na hehna om hia ahihkeileh tuipi tung a na thangpaihna, na sakolte tung a na tuanna leh hotdamna na kangtalaite tung a na tuanna?
english: Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode on your horses, on your chariots of salvation?

paite: Na thalpeu avuak petmah a bawl ahi; namte kiang ah kichiamnate thutak ahi uh, Selah Luite'n lei akhangkhamsak hi.
english: You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. Selah. You split the earth with rivers.

paite: Tangte'n nang ahon mu ua, alau uh; tui khang in akheng a, tui thuk in a-aw asuah a, tungsang ah khutte aliktou hi.
english: The mountains saw you, and were afraid. The storm of waters passed by. The deep roared and lifted up its hands on high.

paite: A-omna uah ni leh kha adingh kinken ua; apai bang un na thalte vak ah, na teipi te zolzol in avak uhi.
english: The sun and moon stood still in the sky, at the light of your arrows as they went, at the shining of your glittering spear.

paite: Heh in gam na palsuak petmah a, thangpai in namte na chil hi.
english: You marched through the land in wrath. You threshed the nations in anger.

paite: Na mipite hondam ding in na kuankhia a, na thaunilh hotdamna ding in; giloute inn a kipan lutang na hihliam a; ngawng chiang pha hial in suangphum na hihse vek. Selah
english: You went forth for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of your anointed. You crushed the head of the land of wickedness. You stripped them head to foot. Selah.

paite: Agalhatte lutang amah chiangte ngei in na sun a; kei hon dalhsak ding in pingpei bang in ahong pai uhi; nuam asakna uh gentheite aguk a ne khin ding in ahi.
english: You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.

paite: Na sakolte in tuipi leh tui hatte sunvumte na chil hi.
english: You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.

paite: Ka za a, ka gilpi akising a, ka kam a awte aling pupulh a; ka guhte ah muatna ahong lut a, ka mun ah ka linggawp hi; buai ni a amah sim dia hong kuan mite dou ding a ahong paitouh chiang a ka linlouhna ding in, dai dide in ka ngak ding hi.
english: I heard, and my body trembled. My lips quivered at the voice. Rottenness enters into my bones, and I tremble in my place, because I must wait quietly for the day of trouble, for the coming up of the people who invade us.

paite: Theipi kung pak pha lou in, grep guite ah agah om lou in; olive sepgimna vuaksuak in, loute'n nek ding piangsak lou in; huang a pan ganhonte satkhiak a om in, huangsung ah ganta omta kei mahleh;
english: For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food; the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls:

paite: huchipi in leng TOUPA ah ka kipak ding a, ka hotdamna Pathian ah ka nuam ding hi.
english: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!

paite: Jehovah, TOUPA, ka hatna ahi, ka khepekte zukpi khe bang in abawl a, ka mun sangte ah ahon vaksak ding hi. Lapu lian a ding, tumging guineite a sak ding.
english: Yahweh, the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” , is my strength. He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and enables me to go in high places. For the music director, on my stringed instruments.

paite: Kumpipa Darias vaihawm akum nihna, akha gukna, huai kha ani khat ni in, Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kiang leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kiang ah zawlnei Haggai a kipan TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, the Word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. came by Haggai, the prophet, to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,

paite: Hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N thu agen, "Hiai mite'n, eite i kisak a TOUPA' inn lam hun ahi kei," achi uh.
english: “This is what Yahweh of Armies says: These people say, ‘The time hasn’t yet come, the time for Yahweh’s house to be built.’”

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Haggai a kipan in TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Then the Word of Yahweh came by Haggai, the prophet, saying,

paite: "Hiai inn kigawpsa a om a, nou a dia na intung dalneite ua na ten hun uh ahi maw?" chi in.
english: “Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your paneled houses, while this house lies waste?

paite: Huaiziak in tu in sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Na lampite uh ngaihtuah un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore this is what Yahweh of Armies says: Consider your ways.

paite: Tampi na tuh ua, tawmchik na la uh; na ne ua, himahleh na vah kei uh; na dawn ua, himahleh na dawnkham zou kei uh; na kisilh ua, himahleh kuamah na lum kei uh; loh mu in iptaw vangsa a koih ding in loh amu hi, chi in.
english: You have sown much, and bring in little. You eat, but you don’t have enough. You drink, but you aren’t filled with drink. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm, and he who earns wages earns wages to put them into a bag with holes in it.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na lampite uh ngaihtuah un.
english: This is what Yahweh of Armies says: “Consider your ways.

paite: Tang ah hohtou unla, sing va la un, inn lam unla; huai ah ka kipak ding a, hih thupi in ka om ding," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Go up to the mountain, bring wood, and build the house. I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified,” says Yahweh.

paite: Tampi na lamen ua, ngai un, tawmchik ahong hi hi; inn na hon tut chiang un, ka na mutmang hi. Bangziak in? Sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Michih noumau inn tuam ah na tai chiat ua, kei inn pen kisegawp a a-om ziak in.
english: “You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says Yahweh of Armies, “Because of my house that lies waste, while each of you is busy with his own house.

paite: Huaiziak in noute ziak in van in adaitui akhou a, lei in agah akhou hi.
english: Therefore for your sake the heavens withhold the dew, and the earth withholds its fruit.

paite: Huchi in gam, tang, buh leh uain, sathau leh lei a pan piangkhia thil peuhmah, mi, ganhon leh khut nasep tengteng tung ah keuna ka samta hi.
english: I called for a drought on the land, on the mountains, on the grain, on the new wine, on the oil, on that which the ground brings forth, on men, on livestock, and on all the labor of the hands.”

paite: Huchi in Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel leh siampu lianpen Jehozadak tapa Joshua in mikho-suaksunte tengteng toh TOUPA a Pathian uh aw leh TOUPA a Pathian un asawl, zawlnei Haggai thute amang ua; huan mite'n TOUPA alau taktak uhi.
english: Then Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of Yahweh, their God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , and the words of Haggai, the prophet, as Yahweh, their God, had sent him; and the people feared Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thukhah in TOUPA sawltak Haggai in mite kiang ah thu agen a, TOUPA'N, "Na kiang uah ka om, achi," chi in.
english: Then Haggai, Yahweh’s messenger, spoke Yahweh’s message to the people, saying, “I am with you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kha leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kha leh mikhosuaksunte tengteng kha TOUPA'N atokthou a; akuan ua sepaihte' TOUPA, a Pathian uh inn ah nna asemta uh;
