english: Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and worked on the house of Yahweh of Armies, their God,

paite: huai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni, akha gukna, kumpipa Darias vaihawm kum nihna in.
english: in the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

paite: Akha sagihna, huai kha ani sawmnih-le-khatna in, zawlnei Haggai a kipan TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
english: In the seventh month, in the twenty-first day of the month, the Word of Yahweh came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

paite: "Judah ukpipa Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel kiang ah leh siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa Joshua kiang leh mikhosuaksunte kiang ah tu'n thu gen in," chi in.
english: “Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

paite: Tuma a athupina a hiai inn mu, na lak uah kua na om lai ua? Huan tu in bangchibang in na mu ua? Na mitmuh un bangmah lou bang ahi maw? chi in.
english: ‘Who is left among you who saw this house in its former glory? How do you see it now? Isn’t it in your eyes as nothing?

paite: Himahleh, Zerubbabel aw, hattak in om in, TOUPA'N achi, Joshua, siampu lian, Jehozadak tapa aw, hattak in om in; nou gam a mite tengteng aw, hattak in om unla, nna sem un, TOUPA'N achi; na kiang ua ka om ziak in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: Yet now be strong, Zerubbabel,’ says Yahweh. ‘Be strong, Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest. Be strong, all you people of the land,’ says Yahweh, ‘and work, for I am with you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan a na hong paikhiak lai ua na kiang ua thu ka khun a, na lak ua ka kha a-om gige dan theigige un; lau kei un.
english: This is the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, and my Spirit lived among you. ‘Don’t be afraid.’

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a: Khatvei lai, sawt lou kal in, vante, leitung leh tuipi, gamhulte tan in ka sing ding hi.
english: For this is what Yahweh of Armies says: ‘Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the dry land;

paite: Nam tengteng ka sing ding a, huchi in nam tengteng thil deihte ahong tung ding, huchi in thupina in hiai inn ka dimsak ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: and I will shake all nations. The precious things of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Dangka kei a ahi, dangka-eng kei a ahi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine,’ says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Hiai inn thupina nanung, amasa sang in athupizaw ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: hiai lai mun ah muanna ka pe ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: ‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place will I give peace,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

paite: Darias akum nihna, akha kuana ani sawmnih-le-lina in, zawlnei Haggai a kipan in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: In the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the Word of Yahweh came by Haggai the prophet, saying,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Tu in dan lam thu a siampute dong un;
english: “Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

paite: mi'n apuansilh puanten ah sa siangthou lou leh apuanten in tanghou hiam, meh hiam, uain hiam, sa hiam sukha taleh, siangthou ahi lai diam?" chi in. Siampute'n, "li" chi in adawng uhi.
english: ‘If someone carries holy meat in the fold of his garment, and with his fold touches bread, stew, wine, oil, or any food, will it become holy?’” The priests answered, “No.”

paite: Haggai in, "Misi luang ziak a minin in hiaite abangpeuh khoih kha taleh siang in a-om diam?" achi hi. Siampute'n adawng ua, "Siang lou in a-om ding," achi uhi.
english: Then Haggai said, “If one who is unclean by reason of a dead body touch any of these, will it be unclean?” The priests answered, “It will be unclean.”

paite: Haggai in adawng a, "TOUPA'N, huchibang in hiai mite leh huchibang in hiai nam ka ma ah ahi uh; huchibang in akhutte uh nasep chiteng; leh huai lai a athillat uh asiang kei, achi,” chi in.
english: Then Haggai answered, “‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me,’ says Yahweh; ‘and so is every work of their hands. That which they offer there is unclean.

paite: Huchi in tu in, ka hon ngen ahi, tuni a kipan leh abanban in, TOUPA tempul a suang akichian ma in ngaihtuah un;
english: Now, please consider from this day and backward, before a stone was laid on a stone in Yahweh’s temple.

paite: mi'n tehna sawmnih kivum ahong muh lai, huai nite a-om nungsiah, sawmkhat kia a-om hi; bawm sawmnga a dimkhe ding a mi'n uain thau ahon muh lai in, sawmnih kia a-om hi.
english: Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat to draw out fifty, there were only twenty.

paite: Na khut nasepte tengteng uah keuna leh kawt luatna leh gial in ka hon gawt a; huchipi in leng kei lam na hong nga kei uh, TOUPA'N achi.
english: I struck you with blight, mildew, and hail in all the work of your hands; yet you didn’t turn to me,’ says Yahweh.

paite: Tuni a kipan leh abanban in ngaihtuah un, TOUPA tempul suangphum akiphum ni a kipan, akha kuana ani sawmnih-le-li ni a kipan, ngaihtuah un.
english: ‘Consider, please, from this day and backward, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, since the day that the foundation of Yahweh’s temple was laid, consider it.

paite: Buhpang ah haichi a-om lai hia? Ahi, grepgui, theipi kung, theibuhfai, olive sing ahong suak kei lai a; tuni a kipan in ka hon vualzawl ding hi.
english: Is the seed yet in the barn? Yes, the vine, the fig tree, the pomegranate, and the olive tree haven’t brought forth. From this day will I bless you.’”

paite: Huai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni in Haggai kiang ah anihveina in TOUPA thu ahong tung hi:
english: The Word of Yahweh came the second time to Haggai in the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,

paite: Judah ukpipa Zerubbabel kiang ah, "Van leh lei ka sing ding a,
english: “Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying, ‘I will shake the heavens and the earth.

paite: lalgam leh laltutphahte ka lumlet ding a, namte, lalgamte hatna ka hihse ding a, kangtalaite leh huai a tuangte ka pai ding; huchi in sakolte leh atung ua tuang mite ahong kum ding uh, michih a-unau namsau in satlum ding achi, chi in thu gen in.
english: I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms. I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations. I will overthrow the chariots, and those who ride in them. The horses and their riders will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, Aw Zerubbabel, ka sikha, Shealtiel tapa, ka hon la ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, suainamna in ka hon bawl ding, TOUPA'N, achi; nang ka hon telta ngal a," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: In that day, says Yahweh of Armies, will I take you, Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel,’ says Yahweh, ‘and will make you as a signet, for I have chosen you,’ says Yahweh of Armies.”

paite: Pathian, nidanglai api-le-pute kiang a seh tampi leh lam chiteng a zawlneite zang a thu na genpa'n,
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

paite: tu hun nanung ah eite kiang ah a Tapa in thu ahon genta hi. Huai mi bangkim gouluahpa ding in asiam a, huai mi mah in khovel asiam hi.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

paite: Amah ah athupina vak leh atak batpih leh ama thilhihtheihna a bangkim tungdingpa hi in, i khelhnate sianna abawl khit nung in tunglam a thupina khut taklam ah ava tuta hi.
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself made purification for our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

paite: Angelte sang a min ngaihzaw amuh bang in amaute sang a tungnungzaw tham ana hi him hi.
english: having become so much better than the angels, as he has inherited a more excellent name than they have.

paite: Angelte lak ah kua kiang ah hiai thute agen ngei a? "Nang zaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia," chih leh "Amah a ding in Pa ka hi dia, amah kei a ding in Tapa ahi ding,"
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today have I become your father?” Psalm 2:7 and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?” 2 Samuel 7:14; 1 Chronicles 17:13

paite: Huan ata neihsun khovel a apilut lai in, “Pathian angelte tengteng in leng amah chibai buk uhen," achi hi.
english: Again, when he brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

paite: Huan angelte tungtang thu ah, Ama'n zaw a-angelte huih in asuaksak a, anasemte leng meikuang in asuaksak chi in agen hi.
english: Of the angels he says, “Who makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.” Psalm 104:4

paite: Tapa tungthu ah bel, "Pathian aw, na laltutphah tangtawn in a-om ding hi; dikna kumpi chiang leng na gam kumpi chiang ahi, chi in agen hi.
english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

paite: Diktatna na it a, tatlekna na hua a; huaiziak in Pathian, na Pathian in na lawmte sang in nang kipahna thau ahon nilh hi."
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.” Psalm 45:6-7

paite: Huan nang, "Toupa'n, atung in leilung kingakna na phum khin a, vante leng na khutsuak ahi;
english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

paite: Huaite ahong mangthang ding ua, nang bel om tawntung ding na hi; huaite tengteng puansilh bang in ahong lui ding ua,
english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

paite: Puan bang in na zial ding a, puansilh bang lel in ahong lamdangta ding a; nang bel angeingei na hiden a, na kumte leng amang kei ding," chi in.
english: As a mantle, you will roll them up, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years will not fail.” Psalm 102:25-27

paite: Himahleh angelte akua pen kiang ah ahia hiai agen ngei? "Na melmate na khepek ngakna a ka bawl masiah ka taklam ah tu in, chih.”
english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?” Psalm 110:1

paite: Angelte tengteng nasepna khate, hotdamna gouluah dingte a dia nasem ding a sawlkhiak ahi kei ua hia?
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

paite: Dan bel thil hoih hong om ding lim kia ahih ziak in, ataktak lohkhiakna nei lou in, kum teng a kithoihna ngeingei alat zelte un, abe ding a hong paite bangchi mah in abukimsak thei ngei kei hi.
english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

paite: Huchi hi keileh lat tawp thamta lou ding uhia? Abemite khatvei a hihsiangthou pah hileh khelhna kitheihna anei nawn kei ding uhi.
english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshippers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

paite: Himahleh huai kithoihna ah kum teng in khelhnate theih nawnna ahong om nak hi.
english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

paite: Bawngtal leh kelte sisan in khelhnate lamang theivual ahi kei hi.
english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

paite: Huchi a khovel a Khrist ahong lut lai in; "Kithoihna leh thillat na deih kei a, kei a ding in pumpi na hon bawlsak zaw hi."
english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire, but you prepared a body for me;

paite: Halmang a pumpiaknate leh khelhna ding a kithoihnate ah kipahna himhim na nei kei hi.
english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

paite: Huaitak in ke'n, "Pathian aw, Ngai in, laibuzial a ka tungthu gelh ahih bang in na deihlam hih ding in ka hong pai," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’” Psalm 40:6-8

paite: Atung ah, "Kithoihnate, thillatte, halmang pumpiaknate, khelhna ding a kithoihnate dan bang a lat ahih ziak in na deih kei a, amaute ah kipahna na nei sam kei," achi hi.
english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

paite: Huaitak in ama'n, "Ngai in, Pathian aw, na deihlam hih ding in ka hong pai," achita hi. Anihna atunding theihna ding in amasapen alamangta hi.
english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

paite: Huai deihlam in Jesu Khrist pumpi khatvei thu a setdet ding a alat tak ziak in, hihsiangthou in i omta hi.
english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

paite: Huan siampu tengteng in kawl a nisuak sim a nna sem in, khelhnate bangchik mah a hihmang thei lou kithoihna ngeingei lan gige in adingh uhi.
english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and often offering the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

paite: Amah bel tangtawn a ding akhelhnate a dia kithoihna khat kia alat nung in, "Pathian taklam ah ava tu zawta hi."
english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God;

paite: Huai nungsiah, "Amelmate akhepek ngakna a siam ahih masiah uh angak nilouh hi."
english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

paite: Huchi in khatvei thillat in hihsiangthousate tangtawn a ding in ahih bukimta hi.
english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

paite: Huan Kha Siangthou in eite ahon theihpih sam a, amasa in hiai bang in agen hi,
english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

paite: "Huai nite khit chiang in akiang ua ka thukhun ding hiaite ahi, Toupa'n achi; alungtang uah ka thupiakte ka koih dia, alungsim uah ka gelh nalai ding chi a agen khit in,
english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them: ‘After those days,’ says the Lord, ‘I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;’” Jeremiah 31:33 then he says,

paite: akhelhnate uh leh atatleknate uh ka theigige nawnta kei ding," achi hi.
english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.” Jeremiah 31:34

paite: Huchi in khelhna ngaihdam ahih nung in khelhna a ding in thillat a-om nawnta kei hi.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, Jesu sisan ziak a mun siangthou a lutngamna nei in,
english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

paite: lampi thak leh hing tawn a puanzak sung a luttheihna, ama pumpi tawn in i nei uhi.
english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

paite: Pathian inkuante tung a siampu thupitak i neih ziak in,
english: and having a great priest over God’s house,

paite: i lungtang a sia-le-pha theihna siang lou a pan thehsiang a om in leh i pumpi leng tui siang a sil a om in, ginna a theihchetna kim nei in lungtang diktak mah pu in amah i naih ding uhi.
english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having our body washed with pure water,

paite: I lamet thugin ling lou in i pomkip ding uh, thuchiampa amuanhuai hi.
english: let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

paite: Huan itna leh thil hoih hih a kitokthou ding in i kingaihtuah ding uhi.
english: Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

paite: Khenkhatte hihdan bang a i kikhopnate uh tawpsan lou in, kihanthawn chiat ni; ni hong nai hulhul a na theih un kihanthawntuah sem un.
english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.

paite: Thutak theihna kim i tan nung a thil i hihkhelh teitei in zaw, khelhnate a dia kithoihna a-om tak louh ziak in,
english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

paite: Vaihawmna lauhuai mulkimhuaitak, dou mite kangmang ding thangpaihna mei maban a nei in i om zawta ding hi.
english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

paite: Mosi Dan khawk saloumi, "Theihpihtu mi nih hiam thum hiam nuai ah, zahngaihna bei in asi zel uhi."
english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

paite: Pathian Tapa sikden a, thukhun sisan amah hihsianthouna pen thil namai a bawl a, hehpihna Kha hihvuimi, huai mi sang a bangchi phet a gawtna thupizaw thuak tak in na sep uhiam?
english: How much worse punishment, do you think, will he be judged worthy of, who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

paite: "Phulakna himhim keimah lak ding ahi, keima'n ka thuk ding chih leh Toupa'n amite vai ahawmsak ding," chi nawnpa lah i thei ngal uhi.
english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me,” says the Lord, “I will repay.” Deuteronomy 32:35 Again, “The Lord will judge his people.” Deuteronomy 32:36; Psalm 135:14

paite: Pathian hing khut a puk thil mulkimhuaitak ahi.
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

paite: Himahleh tuma lam a hihvak a na om nung ua thuakna buaina thupitak na thuak lai nite uh thei nawn un;
english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;

paite: kong khat ah zaw muhsit leh haksatna thuak in etnop a bawl in na om ua, kong khat ah lah huchibang a bawl a omte thuakpihte na hong hi uhi.
english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions; and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

paite: Kolbunte na lainat ua, gou hoihzaw leh a-omden ding noumau in na neih uh kithei in na van hon laksakte uh leng kipaktak in na na thuakzou behlap uhi.
english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

paite: Huchi in kipahman piak thupitak ngahna ding na ginna uh paimang kei un.
english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

paite: Pathian deihlam na hih nung un thilchiam na muhtheihna ding un kuhkalna na kiphamoh uhi.
english: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

paite: Sawt lou nung chiang a hong pai dingpa, hong pai ding ahi, sawt ahal nawn kei ding hi.
english: “In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.

paite: "Tu in ka midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding; anungtolhleh bel ka kha in amah ah kipahna anei kei ding," chih ahi ngal a.
english: But the righteous will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.” Habakkuk 2:3-4

paite: Himahleh eite zaw mangthang ding a nungtolh pawl a pang i hi kei ua; hinna humbit ding a ginna nei pawl a pang i hi zaw uhi.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

paite: Ginna tuh thil lamette om ngei a theihtelna leh thil muhlouhte theihchetna ahi.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

paite: Huai ah nidanglai upate'n phat aloh uhi.
english: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.

paite: Ginna in khovelte Pathian thu a suktuah ahita chih i thei ua, huchi in thil muhtheihte leng thil langtheite a siam ahi kei hi.
english: By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

paite: Ginna in Abel in Kain sang in Pathian kiang ah kithoihna hoihzaw alan a, huaiziak in midik hihna amu chih Pathian in athilpiakte apomna ah atheisak hi; huai ginna ziak mah in ama'n sih nung nangawn in thu agen lai hi.
english: By faith, Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

paite: Ginna in Enok leng sihna chiam lou ding in lakmang in a-om a; Pathian in alakmang ziak in muh theih ahita kei a; lakmang a a-om ma in Pathian pahtak lam mi ahi chih theihsakna amu khinta hi.
english: By faith, Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

paite: Himahleh ginna lou in amah pahtak lam mi hih vual ahi kei; Pathian kiang a hong pai in, amah a-om chih leh azong mite lohchingsakpa ahi chih gin ding ahi.
english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

paite: Ginna in Noah thil muh nailouhte lam thu ah Pathian hilh a om in, Pathian laudan siam in a-inkuan hotdamna ding in long abawl a; huai in khovel siam louh atangsakta hi, ginna ziak adiktatna gouluahpa ahita hi.
english: By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, or, reverence prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

paite: Ginna in Abraham sap a a-om lai in agouluah ding mun a lut ding in paikhiakna ding thu amuta hi; apaina ding lam thei lou in apaikheta hi.
english: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

paite: Ginna in gam chiam ah mi gam a taam bang in ana taam nilouh a, thuchiam kikhat gouluahpih ding Isak leh Jakobte toh puanin ah a-om uhi.
english: By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

paite: Khopi suangphum nei, Pathian gel leh lam angak nilouh hi.
english: For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

paite: Ginna in Sarah ngei in leng a chiampa muanhuai asak ziak in, atek nung in chi paitheihna amu hi.
english: By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

paite: Huchi in pasal khat amah lah misi bang mai a kipan, "Van a aksite bang a tam, tuipiau a piaunel bang a sim zoh louh suangtu," ahong suakta uhi.
english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

paite: Hiai mi tengtengte'n thilchiamte tang khin hilou in, himahleh huaite gamlapi a kipan galmuh a na kipahpih hi zaw in, lei ah zaw khualzin leh mikhual lel ahi uh chih kitheigige in ginna nei in amaute asita uhi.
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen TR adds “and being convinced of” them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

paite: Huchibang a thu na gente'n amau gam ding azong uh chih ahihlang mahmah uhi.
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

paite: Apawtsan gam uh lunggulh hi le uh bel kik nawnna hunlem mu mahmah ding ahi uhi.
english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

paite: Himahleh tu'n bel gam hoihzaw huai van a om pen deih ahi ua; huchi in Pathian a Pathian uh chih a om azum kei a; amau ding in khopi khat abawlsak hi.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

paite: Ginna in Abraham tuh ze-et a om in, Isak alan a; huan thuchiamte kipaktak a sangpa'n atapa neihsun alan hi,
english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son;

paite: huai lah, "Isak ah na suante akiminloh ding," achih pen ahi.
english: even he to whom it was said, “In Isaac will your seed be called”; Genesis 21:12

paite: Pathian in misi lak a kipan nangawn kaithou thei in asep a; huchi in gentehna dan a gen in amah misi lak a kipan mu nawn ahi ngei hi.
english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

paite: Ginna in Isak in thil hong tung dingte thu ah Jakob leh Esau avualzawl hi.
english: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

paite: Ginna in Jakob in asih ding kuan in Joseph tate avualzawl tuaktuak a, "Achiangkhun dawn a kingai in Pathian abia hi."
english: By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

paite: Ginna in Joseph in asih ding kuan in, Israel suante pawt ding thu agen a; aguhte vui ding tungtang thu apia hi.
english: By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave instructions concerning his bones.

paite: Ginna in Mosi apian lai in, naungek melhoihtak ahi achih ziak un kha thum sung anu leh apate sel in a-om a; kumpipa thupiak leng alau kei uhi.
english: By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

paite: Ginna in Mosi in ahong pichin nung in Pharaoh tanu tapa a kiloh a-ut kei a;
english: By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

paite: sawt lou kal a dia khelhna nopna kipahpih sang in Pathian mite toh sukgentheih thuak atel zawta hi.
english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;

paite: Khrist amuhsitna uh Aigupta gam goute sang a hauhsakna thupizaw in angai a; kipahman piak ding a-et zel ziak in.
english: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

paite: Ginna in kumpipa thangpaihna lau lou in Aigupta gam apaisan a, muh theih louh pa amuh ziak in athuak teitei hi.
english: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

paite: Ginna in Paikan Ankuangluina leh sisan thehna abawl a, ta masa hihmangthangpa'n amaute akhoihlouhna ding in.
english: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

paite: Ginna in gam hul a pai bang in Tuipi San akan ua, Aiguptate'n tua bang a hih atum sam ua, tui ah akelum uhi.
english: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

paite: Ginna in Jeriko khokulh ni sagih a-um nung un achimta hi.
english: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.

paite: Ginna in Rahab kizuaknu, gingloute lak ah amangthangkhawm kei, enkhete iim nei lou a ana pahtak ziak in.
english: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

paite: Huan bang ka gen nalai dia? Gideon thute, Barak thute, Samson, Jepthah leh David thute, Samuel thute, zawlneite thute gen ni chi lehang hun in hon daih lou ding ahi.
english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;

paite: Huai mite'n ginna in gam ala ua, thudik a vaihawm azong ua, thuchiamte atang ua, humpinelkai kamte achihsak uhi.
english: who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions, Daniel 6:22-23

paite: Mei thilhihtheihna ahihmit ua, namsau hiam nangawn apel ua, hatlouhna a kipan hattak a bawl in a-om ua, kidouna ah mihat minthang ana hi ua, namdang kidou pawlte ataikeksak uhi.
english: quenched the power of fire, Daniel 3:1-30 escaped the edge of the sword, 1 Kings 19:1-3; 2 Kings 6:31-7:20 from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

paite: Numeite'n amisite uh thounawn amu ua; khenkhatte gimthuaksak in a-om ua, thohnawnna hoihzaw atantheihna ding un khahkhiakna adeih kei uhi.
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. 1 Kings 17:17-23; 2 Kings 4:32-37 Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

paite: Midangte'n leng nuihza bawlna leh vuak athuak ua, ahi, huai lou leng, kolbut leh hentakna atuak uhi.
english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

paite: Suang a den in a-om ua, sing-atna a attan in a-om ua, khemna atuak ua, namsau a satlup in a-om ua; belam vun leh kel vun silh in avakvai ua; gentheitak a gimthuak a sawi in a-om uhi.
english: They were stoned. 2 Chronicles 24:20-21 They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. Jeremiah 26:20-23; 1 Kings 19:10 They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated

paite: Khovel amau tenna tak hilou mite, gamdai mun, mual tung, phaizang leh kawlhawm ah avial vakvak uhi.
english: (of whom the world was not worthy), wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

paite: Ahi a, hiaite tengteng in ginna ziak in phat na loh khin mah le uh thilchiam pen atang kei uh;
english: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

paite: Pathian in eite a dia thil hoihzaw muhkholh aneih ziak a, ei tel lou a amaute hihbukim a a-omlouhna ding ziak uh ahi.
english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

paite: Huaiziak in huchi tel a theihpihte, meipi thupi umsuak a i om thei in, hon hihnok peuhmah leh khelhna eimah a belhte koihmang ni, huan i ma ua kitaitehna ding om ah kuhkaltak in tai ni.
english: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

paite: Jesu, i ginna siampa leh hihkippa, ama a kipahna om ziak a zahlaknate ngaineu a kros a thuakpa, Pathian laltutphah taklam a tupa, amah lam en in.
english: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

paite: Na khalam ua na bah ua, na lungkiaklouhna ding un, mikhialte a pan a huchibang a selkalhna thuakpa ngaihtuah un.
english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

paite: Khelhna dou in sisan suak hial in na pang nai kei uhi; hanthawnna thu, tate taihilh bang a nou hon taihilhna na mangngilhta uhi.
english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;

paite: "Ka ta, Toupa sawina ngaineu ke'nla, ataihilh a na om in leng lungke sam ke'n;
english: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

paite: Toupa'n a-itte asawi nak a, ta akipahpih avo nak hi,” chi in.
english: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.” Proverbs 3:11-12

paite: Na thuak uh zaw noumau a ding ahi; tate tung a hih bang in Pathian in na tung uah ahih a; pa sawi louh ta kua a-om ngei a?
english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

paite: Ta chihna teng loh a sawina loh lou a na om un bel, tatak hilou in, sawn na hi ua akei dia.
english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.

paite: Huai lou leng eite hon sawi ding, sa ah pate i nei uhi, huaite lah zahtak ngal hang a; huai sang a thupizaw in, i hinna ding in, khate Pa thuthu in i om kei ding ua hia?
english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?

paite: Amau zaw ni sawt louchik, hoih asak bang zel un ahon sawi ua, ama'n bel asianthouna i tantheihna ding in, i hoihna ding in ahon sawi zaw hi.
english: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

paite: Sawina himhim thuak lai in kipahhuai in alang kei a khasiathuai in alang zaw hi, himahleh anung in huchi a sawizawt a omte ding in diktatna gah khamuanhuaitak asuahsak zel hi.
english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.

paite: Huchi in khut kaikhete leh khut zawte liktou un;
english: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees, Isaiah 35:3

paite: huan khebai kilawisak lou a, hihdam a a-om zawkna ding in, na khete uh a ding in lamtang bawl un.
english: and make straight paths for your feet, Proverbs 4:26 so that which is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

paite: Mi tengteng toh kituahna leh sianthouna delh un, huai sianthouna lou in kuamah in Toupa amu kei ding uhi;
english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

paite: Pilvangtak in en un, huchi lou in zaw Pathian hehpihna ngah zou lou kuahiam a-om ding a, khaatna zung banghiam hong sel a nou hon hihbuai in, huai in mi tampi hihnit in a-om ding uhi;
english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;

paite: kingaihhat hiam, Esau bang a Pathian zahloumi hiam ahong om kha ding hi. Ama'n ata masa hihna an khatvei nek in akhawngta hi.
english: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

paite: Huai nung in vualzawlna gouluah a-ut in, khitui ke kawm in phatuamngaitak in zong mahleh, kisikna hun amuh louh ziak in paih in a-omta chih na thei uhi.
english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

paite: Nou zaw tang khoih theih, mei a kangte, meivomte, mialte, huihpite,
english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

paite: pengkul ginnate, thugen ging omnate tung na hi kei ua; huai ging zate'n thudang akiang ua gen nawn lou ding in angen uhi.
english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

paite: "Gamsa nangawn in huai tang akhoih aleh suang a denlup in a-om ding," ahi chih thupiak pen athuak thei kei uhi.
english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned TR adds “or shot with an arrow” [see Exodus 19:12-13] ”; Exodus 19:12-13

paite: Athil muh peuhmah uh akihtakhuai mahmah ziak in Mosi in, "Ka lau a, ka nak lin mahmah,” achi hial hi.
english: and so fearful was the appearance, that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.” Deuteronomy 9:19

paite: Himahleh Zion tang, Pathian hing khopi, van lam Jerusalem, sim zoh louh angel hon khawmpite,
english: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

paite: ta masa van a min tuang saptuam hon kiang, Pathian, mi tengteng ngaihtuahpa kiang bang, midiktat hih hoihkim kha kiang leh,
english: to the general assembly and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

paite: Jesu thukhun thak palai kiang, sisan theh, Abel sisan sang a thuhoihzaw genpa kiang tung na hi zaw uhi.
english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, Jeremiah 31:31 and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

paite: Thugenpa na deih kei kha ding uh, pilvang un. Lei a amaute taihilhpa adeih louh ua bawn, gimthuakna apelh louh ngal un, eite, van a kipan a hon taihilhpa kiheisante'n i pel kei sem ding uhi.
english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

paite: Huai hun in aw in lei ahihling a, "Himahleh tu'n zaw, khatvei lei kia hilou in, van leng ka hihling nawn ding chi in akichiam zawta hi."
english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.” Haggai 2:6

paite: Khatvei ka hihling nawn ding chih in, thil lingloute a-om dettheihna ding in, thil lingtheite thilsiamte bang phet in, suanmang in a-om ding chih theisak ahi.
english: This phrase, “Yet once more,” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

paite: Huchi in hihlin vual louh gam i tan ziak in, hehpihna i nei ding ua, huaiziak in zah leh laudan siam kawm in, Pathian pahtak lam nna i sem thei ding uhi.
english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

paite: Pathian zaw mikatmang hat mei ahi.
english: for our God is a consuming fire. Deuteronomy 4:24

paite: Unau ki-itna om zel hen.
Mikhualte tung ah itna suah ding mangngilh kei un; huchibang hih in khenkhat in theiloupi in angelte azintun uhi.
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

paite: Hen a omte hen hi sam bang in theigige unla; gimthuakte sa a om sam na hih ziak un theigige un.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

paite: Mi tengteng lak ah kitenna pahtawi in om henla, lupna leng hihbuah louh in om hen; kingaite leh angkawmte tung a Pathian in vaihawm ding ahi.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

paite: Na lungsim putdan uh dangka deihtakna pang lou hi hen; na thil neihsun tung uah lungkim un; amah mah in, "Bangchik mah in ka hon don lou kei ding a, pai leng ka hon paisan kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.” Deuteronomy 31:6

paite: Huchi in hangsantak in, "Toupa hon panpihpa ahi, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia?" i chi uhi.
english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?” Psalm 118:6-7

paite: Noute hon heu, Pathian thu hon hilhte, theigige unla, a-omdan ua thilsuakte ngaihtuah in a-omdan uh ching un.
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

paite: Jesu Khrist tuh zan, tuni leh tangtawn in angeingei in a-om gige hi.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

paite: Kisinsakna tuamtuam leh thugin lamdangte mutleng in om kei un; lungtang hehpihna a hihkip a om ahoih ngal a, nek dingte bang a hihkip a om lou in; huchibang lam lungkhamte'n huaite ah phattuamna amu tuan kei uhi.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

paite: Eite'n maitam khat, biakbuk nasemte'n anek theihlouhna mun i nei hi.
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

paite: Gan sisan, siampu lianpen in mun siangthou a khelhna a dia lan a alutpih zel luangte dainawl ah ahal uhi.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp. Leviticus 16:27

paite: Huchi in Jesu in leng amah sisan mahmah a mite ahihsianthouna ding in kulh kongkhak polam ah ana thuakta hi.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

paite: Huchi in amah amuhsitna uh pu in dainawl ah akiang lam ah i paikhe ding uhi.
english: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

paite: Hiai lai ah zaw khomun kip i nei ngal kei ua, kho hong om ding i zong uh ahi zaw hi.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

paite: Huchi in amah vang in phatna kithoihna Pathian kiang ah i lan gige ding uh, amin gupna mukte gah ahih ziak in.
english: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God Psalm 50:23 continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

paite: Himahleh thil hihhoih leh thilphal mangngilh kei un; huai bang kithoihna tung ah Pathian alungkim mahmah hi.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

paite: Nou hon heutute thu mang unla, athuthu un om un, anasepte uh tanchin gen nawn ding a, na khate uh ching a hon veng ahi uhi, lungkham kawm hilou in, kipaktak in semsak un; huchi lou in zaw nou a ding a khawk ahi zaw ding hi.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

paite: Hon thumsak un; bangkim a diktattak a om a, sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei ka hi uh chih diktak in ka kithei uhi.
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

paite: Huan kintak a na kiang ua sawl nawn a ka omtheihna ding in, huai ding in ka hon ngen nawn sem hi.
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

paite: Tu in, lemna Pathian, tangtawn thukhun sisan ziak a misi lak a kipan a, i Toupa Jesu, belamchingpa thupitak, kaithou nawnpa'n,
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

paite: amitmuh a akipah lam peuhmah Jesu Khrist ziak in eimah a sem in, adeihlam hih ding in thil hoih chiteng lam ah nou hon hihkim hen; Jesu Khrist kiang ah thupina tangtawn in om hen. Amen.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Himahleh unaute aw, ka hon ngen ahi, hanthawn thuhilhna ngaithei teitei un; na kiang uah thu tomchik ka gelh uhi.
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

paite: I unaupa Timothi apawtsakta uh chih na thei un; ahong pai baihleh, amah toh nou ka hong mu ding uhi.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

paite: Nou hon heute tengteng leh misiangthoute tengteng chibai hon buksak un. Itali gam a mite'n chibai ahon buk uhi.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

paite: Na vek ua kiang ah hehpihna om hen, Amen.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

paite: Huaiziak in bil a i zakte phatuamngaitak in i khawk sa nawn sem ding uh, huchi lou in zaw i tolhmangsan kha zenzen ding uhi.
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

paite: Angelte zang a thugen nangawn akip a, tatlekna leh thumanlouhna chiteng in thukna diktathuaitak amuh zel ngal un,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense;

paite: huchi tel a hotdamna thupi ngeingaih kei leng bangchi in ahia i suahtak theih mahmah ding? Huai hotdamna thu atung a Toupa zang a gen khit ahi a, azate'n hon na hihkipsak uhi.
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard;

paite: Pathian in leng chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte leh thilhihtheihna chiteng toh, ama deih bang zel in Kha Siangthou thilhawmte toh, amaute atheihpih hi.
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

paite: Khovel hong om ding a tanchin i gen uh, angelte nuai ah akoih kei hi.
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

paite: Himahleh mi kuahiam in koi lai hiam ah hiai thu gen in atheisak hi, "Mihing bang atel a, na theihgige? Mihing tapa leng bang ahia, na veh nak?”
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

paite: "Amah angelte sang a nuaizaw zek in na bawl a; thupina leh pahtawina na khusak a, na khutsuak tung ah heutu in na bawl hi,
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor. TR adds “and set him over the works of your hands”

paite: akhenuai ah bangkim na koih a," chi in. Huchi in bangkim anuai a akoih ziak in anuai a koih louh bangmah anei kei hi. Himahleh tu'n ah zaw bangkim anuai a om in i mu nai tadih kei uhi.
english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” Psalm 8:4-6 For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t see all things subjected to him, yet.

paite: Himahleh Jesu, angelte sang a niamzaw deuh a abawl takdih tuh, sihna thuak in thupina leh pahtawina khuksak a om in i mu zaw, huchi a Pathian hehpihna ziak a michih a ding a sihna acheptheihna ding in.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

paite: Amah a ding leh amah ziak a bangkim omsakpa'n tapa tampi thupina a pilut a, athuakna ziak a amaute hotdamna makaipa bukim hih amah a dia kilawm him ahi.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

paite: Hihsiangthoupa leh hihsiang-thoute avek un mi khat a pawt ahi uh. Huaiziak in ama'n amaute unaute, chih azum kei hi.
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” ,

paite: "Ka unaute kiang ah na min ka gen dia; omkhawmte lak ah la sa in ka hon phat ding,” chi in.
english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. In the midst of the congregation I will sing your praise.” Psalm 22:22

paite: Huan "Amah ah ka muanna ka nga dia, achi nawn hi. Huan en dih ua, kei leh Pathian hon piak tate," achi nawn lai hi.
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Isaiah 8:17 Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.” Isaiah 8:18

paite: Huchi in naupangte sa leh sisan tangte ahih chiat ziak un, amah ngei in huai bangmah atang sam hi; asihna a sihna thuneipa, diabol, ahihmanthat theihna ding leh,
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

paite: sih kihtak ziak a damsung sikha a omte tengteng asuahtaksak theihna ding un.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

paite: Ahitak in, ama'n apanpih zelte zaw angelte ahi kei ua, Abraham suante apanpih zaw ahi.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the seed of Abraham.

paite: Huchi in mite a ding a khelhna thupha tawina bawlsak ding in, Pathian lam a siampu lianpen, milainat thei leh muanhuaitak ahihtheihna ding in, bangkim a-unaute bang a hong om amah a ding in akiphamoh him ahi.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

paite: Amah ngei in khemna tuak a, ana thuak tak ziak in khemna tuakte apanpih thei ahi.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

paite: Huchi in unau siangthou, van sapna tanpihte aw, i thugin toh kisai a Sawltak leh Siampu Lian, Jesu ngaihtuah un;
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;

paite: Pathian inkuante tengteng lak a Mosi amuanhuai mah bang a, amah seppa lak a muanhuaipa.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

paite: Inn sung a papen a-inkuante sang a apahtawi zawk bang un, amah Mosi sang a thupi zawk semna mu dia kilawm a seh ahita hi.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who built the house has more honor than the house.

paite: Inkuan chih in papen kuahiam anei chiat ngal ua; bangkim pa pen bel Pathian ahi.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

paite: Huan huai nung a thugen lai dingte theihsakna ding in, Mosi Pathian inkuante tengteng lak a nasempa in zaw amuanhuai ngei hi.
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

paite: Khrist bel Pathian inkuante tung a Tapa in amuanhuai hi. Atawp tan a i kingakna a, i lametna ziak a kipahna, kiptak a i vomhoih photleh, eite a-inkuanpihte i hi uhi.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

paite: Huchi in Kha Siangthou gen bang in, “Tuni a a-aw na zak chiang un,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

paite: Gamdai a ze-etna ni a ahel bang un, na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un;
english: don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

paite: huai lai ah na pi-le-pute un hon ze-et in ahon khem ua, kum sawmli sung a ka thilhihte amu uhi.
english: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my works for forty years.

paite: Huchi in huai suante tung ah ka lung hita kei a, 'Alungtang un angaihtuah khial gige ua, ka lampite leng athei kei uh,' ka chi hi.
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways;’

paite: Ka thangpaihna a ka kichiam bang in ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh," chi in.
english: as I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’” Psalm 95:7-11

paite: Unaute aw pilvang un, huchi lou in zaw Pathian hing tawpsan ding in na lak uah kuapeuh sung ah ginlouhna lungtang gilou ahong om kha ding hi.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

paite: "Tuni," achih lai un niteng in kihanthawntuah zaw un, huchi a na lak ua mi kuamah khelhna khemhat ziak a hihkhauh a na omlouhna ding un.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

paite: I kingakna kipatna pen atawp tan a kiptak a i vomhoih photleh Khrist a tan neite i hita uhi.
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:

paite: "Tuni in a-aw na zak chiang un ahel lai bang un, na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un," akichih lai teng.
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.” Psalm 95:7-8

paite: Ahihleh kuate ahi ua thei napi a helte? Aigupta a kipan a Mosi pipawt tengteng hilou uhia?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn’t all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?

paite: Kuate tung ah ahia, kum sawmli sung alunghih louh? Hihkhialte aluang uh gamdai a pukmangte tung ah hilou hia?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

paite: Thumangloute kiang ah kia lou ngal kua kiang ah ahia akhawlna a lut lou ding a akichiam?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

paite: Huchi in ginlahna ziak in alut theita kei uh chih i thei uhi.
english: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.

paite: Huaiziak in i lau ding uh, huchi lou in zaw akhawlna a lutna thuchiam om lai napi, na lak ua kuapeuh ching lou in na om kha zenzen ding uh.
english: Let us fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

paite: Amau kiang a gen ahih bang in tanchinhoih i kiang ua gen ahi ngal a; himahleh athuzak uh amaute'n aphattuampih kei uh, azate toh ginna a akizom louh ziak un.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

paite: Ei gingta khinte huai khawlna ah i lut lellel uhi, "Ka thangpaihna a ka kichiam bang in ka khawlna ah alut kei hial ding uh," achih bang in; leilung pian tung a kipan ama nnate sep zoh hita mahleh.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest”; Psalm 95:11 although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

paite: Koi lai mun hiam ah ni sagih ni thu hichibang in agen hi: "Huan ani sagih ni in Pathian in anasep tengteng akhawlsanta," chi in.
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works”; Genesis 2:2

paite: Huan hiai mun ah, "Ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh," achi nawn hi.
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.” Psalm 95:11

paite: Huchi in ni dang a tanchinhoih za masate thuman louh ziak in lut kei mah le uh, khenkhatte huai khawlna a alutna ding ua thuchiam a-om lai ziak a lut lai ding a-om uhi.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter therein, and they to whom the good news was before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,

paite: Hun sawttak nung in David ah ama a kigensa bang in bang ni hiam aseptuan nawn hi. "Tuni a aw na zak chiang un na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un," chi in.
english: he again defines a certain day, today, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.” Psalm 95:7-8

paite: Joshua in amaute na khawlsakta hileh zaw, huai nung in ni tuam dang thu gen angai kei ding hi.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

paite: Huchi in Pathian mite a ding in Sabbath khawlna a-om lai hi.
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

paite: Pathian in ama nasepte akhawlsan bang in, akhawlna a lut khinsa mi'n leng anasepte akhawlsan samta hi.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

paite: Huchi in kuamah huai thumanlouhna bang a om a i puklouhna ding un huai khawlna a lut ding in phatuam i ngai ding uhi.
english: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

paite: Pathian thu ahing a, thil ahihthei a, namsau hiamtuah bangchibang sang in ahiam a, hinna leh kha, guhlawi leh guhngek tuamkhen hel khop in asun thei a, lungtang a ngaihtuah leh tupte athei pah thei hi.
english: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

paite: Huaiziak in thilsiam peuhmah ama mitmuh a lang lou himhim a-om kei; i tanchin tutna dingpa mitmuh ah bangkim vuaktang leh kihongsa ahi.
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

paite: Hichi in van munte a paisuak khinsa siampu lianpen thupitak, Jesu Pathian Tapa, i neih ziak in i thugin i pomkip ding uhi.
english: Having then a great high priest, who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold tightly to our confession.

paite: Siampu Lianpen i hat louh kitheihnate hon theihpih pha lou nei i hi kei ua; eimah bang a lam tuamtuam a khemna tuaksa, khelh bel khial lou, nei i hi zaw uhi.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

paite: Huchi in zahngaihna i muhtheihna ding leh huh i poimoh chiang a huhna hehpihna i ngah theihna ding in, hehpihna laltutphah hangtak in i naih ding uhi.
english: Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.

paite: Siampu Lianpen peuhmah mihingte sik-le-tang akhelhnate ziak a thilpiak leh kithoihnate Pathian kiang a lankhawm ding a mihing lak a kipan telkhiak leh mihingte a dia Pathian seh ahi uhi.
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

paite: Huaite'n amau ngei leng hatlouhna a tuam a om sam ahih ziak un, bangmah theiloute leh lamhaihte tung ah zahngaihna anei thei uhi.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

paite: Huaiziaktak in mite a ding a alatsak bang un, amau a ding ngei leng khelhnate ziak in lan lou thei lou ahi uhi.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

paite: Huan huai pahtawina Aaron bang a Pathian sap ahih ngal kei uleh kuamah amau akipe ngei kei uhi.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

paite: Huchibang in Khrist leng siampu lianpen a bawl ding in amah akihih thupi kei a, "Nang zaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia hi," chi a akiang a genpa'n ahih thupizawta hi.
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.” Psalm 2:7

paite: Mun dang a agen bang in; "Nang zaw, Melkizedek omdan bang a tangtawn siampu na hi,” achi hi.
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.” Psalm 110:4

paite: Ama'n sa aput lai nite in, sihna lak a amah hondam theipa kiang ah nakpitak a kikou leh khitui ke kawm in thumnate leh ngetnate alan a, akihtakdan asiam zel ziak in ngaihkhiak in a-om hi.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

paite: Tapa hilhial himahleh athilthuakte ah thuman azil hi.
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

paite: Huchi in hihbukim a hong om in, athumang peuhmahte a ding in tangtawn a hotdamna bulpi ahong hita hi.
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

paite: Melkizedek omdan bang a siampu lianpen in Pathian in abawlta hi.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

paite: Huai mi tanchin ahihleh gen ding tampi i nei ua, genchet leng ahaksa; na bil uh angon tak ziak in.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

paite: Ahun thu ngaihtuah in zaw heutu hi khinta hial le uchin kilawm hiven, Pathian thubulte hilh kiphamoh nawn na hi ve ua, an gum hilou nawitui kiphamoh na hong hita uhi;
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the oracles of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

paite: nawitui ne peuhmah in diktatna thu ah theihna anei kei ua, naungek ahih ziak un.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

paite: An gum piching a ding ahi, huaite'n azat gige ziak un sia-le-pha theichian ding in atheihtheihnate uh asin zongsangta uhi.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

paite: Huchi in Khrist thubulte gen nawn lou in pichin lam i manoh ding uh; thilhih sisate kisikna, Pathian lam a ginna,
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let us press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

paite: baptisma leh khutngak leh misi thohnawnna leh tangtawn vaihawmna lam thuhilhnate suangphum phum nawn lou in.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

paite: Pathian in pha asakleh huai bang i hih ngei ding uhi.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

paite: Khatvei hihvak a om khin a, van thilpiak chiamta, Kha Siangthou dong khin a,
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

paite: Pathian thuhoihna leh hun hong om ding a thilhihtheihnate chiam khin hinapi,
english: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,

paite: ginna akihei mangsan ualeh huchibang mite zaw akisikna ding ua bawl thak theih ahi kei uhi; Pathian Tapa amau a ding a kilhlum tuan nawn a selphou ahih ziak un.
english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

paite: Lou, atung ua vuahtui ke gige na dawn khin a, huai khohsak a ompa a dia nek theih anteh-louhing hon suah pen in Pathian vualzawlna atang hi.
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it, and brings forth a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

paite: Himahleh loulingnei leh khaulingnei asuah nak in bel aphatuam kei a; hamsiat in a-om ding a, atawpna halmang ahi ding hi.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

paite: Himahleh deihtakte aw, huchibang thu gen mah leng nou zaw huai thilte sang a hoihzaw hotdamna toh kizui thilte nei na hih uh ka muang uhi.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

paite: Amin ziak a itna a nna na sep uleh misiangthoute nna na sepsak uh na latsak uh leh tutan a leng nasep lai uh mangngilh ding in Pathian mitak lou ahi kei hi.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

paite: Himahleh atawp tan a lametna theihchetna kim mu ding in na thanop ngeingei bang un thanop suah gige chiat le uchin ka chi uhi.
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

paite: Huchi in na kithadahsak kei ding ua, ginna leh kuhkalna ziak a thuchiamte gouluah khin khawngte entonte na hi zaw ding uhi.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherited the promises.

paite: Pathian in Abraham kiang a thu achiam lai in, amah sang a thupizaw lou a akichiam theih louh ziak in, amah-le-amah kilou in akichiam hi.
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by none greater, he swore by himself,

paite: Taktak in ka hon vualzawl ngeingei ding a, hih leng ka hon hihpung ding chi in akichiamta hi.
english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.” Genesis 22:17

paite: Huchi in kuhkaltak a athuakkhiak nung in, thilchiam amuta hi.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

paite: Mihingte zaw asang ua thupizawte min lou in akichiam ua; akiselna chiteng uah leng hihkipna ding in kichiam tuh thutawp ahi.
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in athiltup hihlamdan tuan theihlouhdan nakpi mahmah a theihsak ut in thuchiam gouluah dingte kiang ah kichiamna apalaisak hi.
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;

paite: Pathian thugen zuauthei vual ahihlouhna ah thil kikhek lamdang thei lou nihte ziak in, i ma a lametna koih lenkip ding a bitna ding a amah delhte'n hanthawnna thupitak i neihtheihna ding in ahi.
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

paite: Huai lametna hinna sikkip in i nei ua, muanhuai leh kiptak ahi, huai lametna puanzak sung ah leng alutta hi.
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil;

paite: I ma a na paita Jesu, mun siangthoupen ah i makaipa a alut tak man in Melkizedek omdan bang in eite a ding in tangtawn a siampu lianpen ana hita hi.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

paite: Abraham in kumpipate athah zoh a hong kiklam na dawn a vualzawlpa, hiai "Melkizedek, Salem kumpipa, Tungnungpen Siampu," ahi a,
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

paite: Abraham in, “Bangkim ah sawm-a-khat," apia hi. Amin khiakna genchian in amasapen in, "Diktatna Kumpipa," azom nawn in, "Salem Kumpipa," ahi nawn a, huai tuh "Lemna Kumpipa," chihna ahi.
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace;

paite: Amah pa nei lou, nu nei lou, khangthu nei lou, om pat ni nei lou hin tawp ni leng nei sam lou in, Pathian Tapa bang a siam tangtawn a siampu hi gige ahi zaw hi.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

paite: Huchi in suangtu, Abraham in agallak hoih peuhmah lak a sawm-a-khat apiakna pa, huai mipa thupidan ngaihtuah un.
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best spoils.

paite: Levi suante lak a siampu nna tang peuhmah in dan bang in mite lak ah sawm-a-khat lak ding thu a-unaute uh lak ah amu uhi, huaite Abraham khal a pawt hi sam mah le uh leng.
english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

paite: Himahleh alak ua asuante suikhawmsak sam louhpa'n Abraham lak ah sawm-a-khat ala a, thuchiamte kempa avualzawlta hi.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

paite: Himahleh sel vual louh in aneuzaw tuh alianzaw vualzawlsak in a-om hi.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

paite: Huan hiai ah mihing si zelte'n sawm-a-khat amu ua, huai ah bel, ahing gige pen chi a athu atheisak in amu zaw hi.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

paite: Levi, sawm-a-khat la zelpa nangawn in Abraham khut ah sawm-a-khat apeta, chih theih ahi;
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

paite: Melkizedek in ana dawn lai in apa khal ah a-om lai hi.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

paite: Huchi in Levite'n siampu hihna ziak a bukimna muhtheihna hileh huai nuai ah mite'n dan thu ana mu ngal ua, Aaron omdan bang hilou a Melkizedek omdan bang a siampu dang hong om, bang kiphamoh ding ahia?
english: Now if there were perfection through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

paite: Siampu hihna ahong kilamdan ziak in dan leng hihlamdan sam ahong kiphamoh hi.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

paite: Hiai a thugenpa nam tuam ahi ngal a, huai namte lak a akuamah maitam ah agamtang ngei kei uhi.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

paite: I Toupa, Judah nam lak a hong suak ahi chih akichian hi; huai nam thu ah Mosi in siampute lam thu bangmah agen kei hi.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

paite: Melkizedek bang a tangtawn siampu dang hong suahna in nakpitak in i thugen achiangsak nawn sem hi;
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

paite: amah khangthu dan leh dan thupiak ziak a siampu hilou in, hin tawp nei lou leh thilhihtheihna bang zaw in siampu ahong hi.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life:

paite: "Nang zaw, Melkizedek omdan bang a tangtawn siampu na hi," chih theihsak ahi.
english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.” Psalm 110:4

paite: Ahat louh leh aphattuamlouhna ziak in thupiak om masa paihkhiak ahi.
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

paite: Dan in bangmah ahih bukim louh ziak in Pathian in lametna hoihzaw hon lalut in huai pansan in amah i naih theita uhi.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

paite: Huan kichiamna tel lou a amah siampu a bawl ahi kei hi;
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

paite: siampu dangte ahihleh kichiam lou a siampu a bawl ahi ua; Jesu bel, nang zaw tangtawn siampu na hi chi in Toupa akichiam hi, ka khelkik kei ding chi a akiang a genpa khut ah akichiam hi.
english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’” Psalm 110:4

paite: Huchitak a thupi in Jesu thukhun hoihzaw hihkippa ahong hita hi.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.

paite: Huan siampu tampi ana om tak ziak bel amaute asi zel ua, kuamah omden thei lou ahih ziak uh ahi.
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

paite: Hiai mi bel tangtawn a omden ahih ziak in, asiampu hihna khen theih vual louh aneizaw hi.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

paite: Huchi in amah tawn a Pathian kiang a hong paite atawp dong in ahondam thei hi, amaute thumsak a tangtawn a ahin gige ziak in ahi.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

paite: Huchibang siampu lianpen, misiangthou, poikhoih lou, nin baang lou, khialte lak a om tuam, vante sang a tungnungzaw a siam eite a ahong hita hi.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

paite: Ama'n siampu lianpen dangte lat bang in, niteng in ama khelhna a ding kithoihna lan masa phot in, huai nung a mite khelhna kithoihna alat akiphamoh kei hi; amah akilat laitak in setdet ding in khatvei ana lan khinta hi.
english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

paite: Dan in mihing hatlouhna neite, siampu lianpen ding in asep a; himahleh tua kichiam thu, dan nung a hong om in, Tapa mahmah tangtawn siampu ding a hihkim khitsa asep zawta hi.
english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath which came after the law appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

paite: Huchi in i thugente lak a poimohpen hiai ahi; vanmun a Thupipen laltutphah taklam a va tu siampu lianpen neite i hi uhi.
english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this. We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

paite: Amah mun siangthou leh biakbuk taktak, mihing lam hilou, Toupa lam zaw a nasempa i nei uhi.
english: a servant of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

paite: Siampu lian peuhmahte thilpiak leh kithoihnate lan ding a seh ahi ua; huchi in hiai siampu lianpen in banghiam bek lat ding neih akiphamoh hi.
english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

paite: Amah leitung a om lai hileh zaw, dan bang zel a thilpiakte lan ding om khinta ahih ziak un, siampu hilou ding ahi.
english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law;

paite: Amaute'n van lam thilte etsakna leh aliim in nna asem uhi. Mosi biakbuk lam dia akisak lai in Pathian hilh a om in, "Tang tung a etton ding ka hon etsak bang a biakbuk lam ding in pilvang in," achi hi.
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.” Exodus 25:40

paite: Tu in bel thuchiam hoihzaw tung a kinga thukhun hoihzaw a dia nasem palai ahih bang in, nasepna hoihzaw ana tangta hi.
english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

paite: Thukhun masa dembei na hileh, anihna hong om kul lou ding ahi.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

paite: Amaute dem in hiai thute agen hi, "Ngai in, nite ahong tung dek, Toupa'n achi, huai ni chiang in Israel inkuante leh Judah inkuante kiang ah thukhun thak ka bawl ding,"
english: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days come,” says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

paite: "Api-le-pute uh Aigupta gam a kipan pikhe ding a akhut ka let ni a akiang ua ka khun bang hilou in; ka thukhun ah a-om gige kei uhi, huchi in amau ka limsakta kei,” Toupa'n achi hi.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers, in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

paite: "Huai ni zoh chiang in Israel inkuante kiang a thu ka khun ding hiaite ahi, Toupa'n achi; alungsim uah ka thupiakte ka koih dia, alungtang uah ka gelh nalai dia, huan amau a ding in Pathian ka hi dia, kei a ding in amaute ka mite ahi ding uhi.
english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel. After those days,” says the Lord; “I will put my laws into their mind, I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

paite: Huan michih in Toupa thei in, chi in ama inveng leh ama unau athuhilhta kei ding uhi; aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in avek un ahon thei chiat ding uhi.
english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen, TR reads “neighbor” instead of “fellow citizen” and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

paite: Atatleknate uah ka zahngai dia, akhelhnate uh leng ka theigige nawnta kei ding," chi in.
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.” Jeremiah 31:31-34

paite: Thukhun thak chi a agen ziak in amasa zat nawn louh ding in aluisakta hi. Huchi in aluita a, zat tak louh mang pah thei ahita hi.
english: In that he says, “A new covenant,” he has made the first old. But that which is becoming old and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

paite: Huchi in thukhun masa in leng Pathian nasepna a zuih ding thukhun leh lei lam mun siangthou leng anei hi.
english: Now indeed even the first TR adds “tabernacle” covenant had ordinances of divine service, and an earthly sanctuary.

paite: Biakbuk alam ua, pindan tuah masak ah khawnvak koihna mung, dohkan leh tanghou koihna a-om hi; huai tuh Mun Siangthou achi uhi.
