english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lampstand, the table, and the show bread; which is called the Holy Place.

paite: Puanzak nihna ban ah biakbuk, Mun Siangthoupen achih uh a-om hi.
english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

paite: Huai sung ah dangka-eng gimlim halna bawm leh thukhun bawm dangka-eng a kiluan a-om a, huai thukhun bawm sung ah Manna omna dangka-eng bel, Aaron chiang sel leh thukhun gelhna suangpek a-om hi.
english: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

paite: Atunglam ah zahngaihna tutphah liah in, thupina cherubte a-om ua; huaite tu in zaw akim sipsip in i gen thei kei ding uh.
english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

paite: Huai thilte huchibang a bawl ana hi ua, siampute'n Pathian nna sem in, biakbuk tuah masak ah alut zel uhi.
english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

paite: Pindan sungnungpen ah bel siampu lianpen kia, kum teng in khatvei sisan tawi in alut a; ama khelhna a ding leh mite khelhna a ding in alan zel hi.
english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for the errors of the people.

paite: Kha Siangthou in hon theihsak nop bel, biakbuk masa adin lai teng Mun Siangthou a luttheihna lampi akilang nai tadih kei, achihna ahi.
english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing;

paite: Biakbuk a thilpiak leh kithoihna kilan zelte'n abemite sia-le-pha theihna asiangsak thei kei chih tu hun a eite hon etsakna ahi.
english: which is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshipper perfect;

paite: Huaite nek-le-dawn, kisilna dan tuamtuamte, ataktak bawlhoihna hong tun ma a kizang salam thilte ahi.
english: being only (with meats and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

paite: Himahleh Khrist bel thil hoih hong om dingte siampu lianpen ding a hong pai in, khut a lam louh biakbuk thupizaw leh bukimzaw sung ah alut hi, huai tuh thilsiamte lak a ahi kei chihna ahi,
english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

paite: ama'n ei a ding a tangtawn tatkhiakna ngah khin in, kelte leh bawngtalte sisan hilou, ama sisan mahmah tawi in khatvei a setdet ding in mun siangthou sung ah alutta hi.
english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

paite: Kel leh bawngtalte sisan leh bawngla vu, minin tung a theh in bawn sa siang khop a ahihsiangthouleh,
english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh:

paite: Khrist, tangtawn Kha ziak a gensiatbei a Pathian kiang a kilan sisan in, Pathian hing nasem ding in na sia-le-pha theihna uh thilhih sisa a pan nak hihsiangthou na tel in chia!
english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

paite: Hiai ziak in amah thukhun thak palai ahong hi a, sapte'n tangtawn a gouluah ding thuchiam atantheihna ding un thukhun masa nuai a tatleknate lak a kipan hon tankhe ding in amah ahong sita, chihna ahi.
english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

paite: Thusiah omna peuh ah asiahmi sihna leng a-om teitei ding ahi.
english: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

paite: Mi asih nung un thusiah in thu anei nak hi, asiahmi adam lai teng bel thu anei kei hi.
english: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

paite: Huchi in thukhun masa leng sisan lou in ahihkip kei uhi.
english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

paite: Dan thupiak peuhmah Mosi in mipi tengteng kiang a apuan nung in, bawngnoute leh kelte sisan tui, samulkhau sandup leh hissop in ala a, laibu leh mipi tengteng atheh a,
english: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

paite: huai Pathian in na kiang ua anamkip thukhun sisan ahi, chi in.
english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.” Exodus 24:8

paite: Huai lou leng biakbuk leh nasepna van tengteng huchi mah bang in sisan in atheh hi.
english: Moreover he sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

paite: Huan dan in sisan a bangkim hihsiangthou angiat bang in, sisan suak lou in ngaihdamna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

paite: Huai thilte van a om batpih laksawnte huaite a hihsiangthou a-om ding him uh ahi; van thil taktakte bel huai sang a kithoihna hoihzawte a hihsiangthou a-om ding ahi.
english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

paite: Khrist khut a lam mun siangthou, atak batpih ah alut ngal kei a; tu'n ah bel Pathian ma ah i sik ua dingh ding in van ah alut zawta hi.
english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

paite: Himahleh kum teng a siampu lian, ama sisan toh hilou, sisan tawi kawm a mun siangthou a alut zihzeh bang a, amah kilan ding a van a lut ahi kei;
english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

paite: huchi hi keileh leilung pian tung a kipan tamveipi athuakta ding hi; himahleh tulai hun tawp ah amah kithoihna pansan a khelhna hihmang ding in khatvei a setdet ding in amah ahong kilangta hi.
english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

paite: Huan mihing a ding in khatvei sih seh ahi, huai nung in vaihawmna a-om ding hi;
english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

paite: huchi mah bang in Khrist leng mi tampi khelhnate paipih ding a khatvei lat khit a om in, hotdamna mu ding a amah ngakte kiang ah khelhna pang lou in anihveina ah ahong lang nawn ding hi.
english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, Isaiah 53:13 will appear a second time, without sin, to those who are eagerly waiting for him for salvation.

paite: Judah kumpipate, Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah leh Israel kumpipa, Joas tapa Jeroboam dam lai a, Beeri tapa Hosia kiang a hong tung TOUPA thu ahi.
english: The word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. that came to Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.

paite: Hosia zang a TOUPA'N thu agen masak lai in, Hosia kiang ah TOUPA'N, "Kuan inla, na zi ding in kizuakmi pi inla, kizuakmi tate nei in; gam in lah TOUPA paisan in kizuakna nakpitak in ahihta ngal a," achi hi.
english: When Yahweh spoke at first by Hosea, Yahweh said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in akuan a Diblaim tanu Gomer api a; ahong gai a, tapa aneihsak hi.
english: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Amin Jezreel sa in; sawt lou nung chiang a, Jehu inkote tung a Jezreel sisan phuba la ding ka hi, Israel inkote lalgam ka tawpsak ding hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, Jezreel Phaizang ah Israel thalpeu ka kitansak ding," achi hi.
english: It will happen in that day that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

paite: Huan agai nawn a, tanu anei hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Amin ding in Lo-ruhamah sa in; amaute bangchi mah a ngaidam ding in, Israel inkote tung ah zahngaihna ka neih nawn louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: She conceived again, and bore a daughter. Then he said to him, “Call her name Lo-Ruhamah Lo-Ruhamah means “not loved.” ; for I will no longer have mercy on the house of Israel, that I should in any way pardon them.

paite: "Himahleh Judah inkote tung ah zahngaihna ka nei ding a, TOUPA a Pathian un amaute ka hondam ding a, thalpeu, namsau, kidouna, sakol, sakol tungtuang mite in amaute ka hondam kei ding hi," achi hi.
english: But I will have mercy on the house of Judah, and will save them by Yahweh their God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , and will not save them by bow, sword, battle, horses, or horsemen.”

paite: Huan Lo-ruhamah nawi angolhsak zoh in, agai nawn a, tapa anei hi.
english: Now when she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.

paite: Pathian in, "Amin ding in Lo-ammi sa in; ka mite na hih louh ua, na Pathian uh ka hih louh ding ziak in," achi hi.
english: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi Lo-Ammi means “not my people” ; for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.

paite: Hinapi in Israel suante zah tuipi piaunel, teh theih louh, sim theih louh bang ahi ding; akiang ua, "Ka mite na hi kei uh," chih a a-omna mun uah, hichi ahi ding a, "Pathian hing tate na hi uh," akiang ua chih ahi ding hi.
english: Yet the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea, which can’t be measured nor numbered; and it will come to pass that, in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘sons of the living God.’

paite: Huchi in Judah suante leh Israel suante kaihkhawm ahi ding ua, amaute a ding in lu khat akiguan ding ua, gam a kipan a kuantou ding; Jezreel ni thupi ding ahi.
english: The children of Judah and the children of Israel will be gathered together, and they will appoint themselves one head, and will go up from the land; for great will be the day of Jezreel.

paite: Israel in gahtam asuah zel, grepgui pha ahi; agahtam mahmah dungzui in amaitamte apungsak; agam hoihna dungzui in milim kilawm taktak abawl uhi.
english: Israel is a luxuriant vine that puts forth his fruit. According to the abundance of his fruit he has multiplied his altars. As their land has prospered, they have adorned their sacred stones.

paite: Alungtang uh akikhen a; huchi in mohtansak in a-om ding uh; amaitamte uh asat ding a, akhuamte uh alok ding hi.
english: Their heart is divided. Now they will be found guilty. He will demolish their altars. He will destroy their sacred stones.

paite: Kumpipa i nei kei uh; TOUPA i kihta kei ua; kumpipa leng, ei a ding in bang ahihthei dia, tu in achi ding uhi.
english: Surely now they will say, “We have no king; for we don’t fear Yahweh; and the king, what can he do for us?”

paite: Thukhunte bawlna a zuau a kichiam in, thute agen ua; huaiziak in lou lehsa a namtul bang in thukhenna apoukhe ding hi.
english: They make promises, swearing falsely in making covenants. Therefore judgment springs up like poisonous weeds in the furrows of the field.

paite: Beth-aven bawngnoute ziak in Samaria a tengte'n alau ding ua; huai mite'n siampu atung a kipakte asuun ding uh, huai bawngnou ziak in thupina amah a kipan apaimang tak ziak in.
english: The inhabitants of Samaria will be in terror for the calves of Beth Aven; for its people will mourn over it, Along with its priests who rejoiced over it, for its glory, because it has departed from it.

paite: Kumpipa Jareb kiang a thilpiak ding a Assuria lam a puak ahi lai ding a, Ephraim in zahlakna amu dia, Israel amah pilna ah azahlak ding hi.
english: It also will be carried to Assyria for a present to a great king. Ephraim will receive shame, and Israel will be ashamed of his own counsel.

paite: Samaria bel tui tung a tuiphuan bang in akumpipa satkhiak ahi.
english: Samaria and her king float away, like a twig on the water.

paite: Aven mun sangte leng, Israel khelhna hihsiat ahi ding, amaitam tung uah ling leh loulingnei ahong poutou ding a; tangte kiang ah, "Hon khuh un; mualte kiang ah hon pukkhum un," achi ding uhi.
english: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle will come up on their altars. They will tell the mountains, “Cover us!” and the hills, “Fall on us!”

paite: Aw Israel, Gibeah nite a kipan na khialta a; huai ah adingh ua; Gibeah thulimlouhna tate tung a kidouna in amaute aphaklouhna ding in.
english: “Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they remained. The battle against the children of iniquity doesn’t overtake them in Gibeah.

paite: Amaute ka sawi ding ka deihlam ahi; atatlekna uh thuah nih ziak a taihilh ahih hun chiang un, amaute dou ding in mite akikhawm ding uh.
english: When it is my desire, I will chastise them; and the nations will be gathered against them, when they are bound to their two transgressions.

paite: Huan Ephraim bawngla chilsiamsa, buh-le-bal chilkhiak ut ahi; himahleh angawng kilawm tung ah hakkol ka bat dia, Ephraim tung ah tungtuangmi ka koih ding; Judah in lei alet dia, Jakob in asai anawn ding.
english: Ephraim is a trained heifer that loves to thresh; so I will put a yoke on her beautiful neck. I will set a rider on Ephraim. Judah will plow. Jacob will break his clods.

paite: Diktatna ah kituh unla, zahngaihna bang zel in at un, na leileh lei uh satkham un; ahong pai a na tung ua diktatna ahon zuksak matan, TOUPA zon hun ahi.
english: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek Yahweh, until he comes and rains righteousness on you.

paite: Gitlouhna lei na let ua, thulimlouhna na lata uh; zuaugenna gah na neta ua; na lampi ah, na mihatte ah na muangta uhi.
english: You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped iniquity. You have eaten the fruit of lies, for you trusted in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.

paite: Huaiziak in na mite lak ah buaina ahong pawt ding a, na kulhte uh loh in a-om ding hi, kidou lai a Salman in Beth-arbel aluh bang in; atate toh anu paih nen in a-om uhi.
english: Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed Beth Arbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.

paite: Huchibang mah in na gitlouh mahmah ziak in Bethel in na tung ah ahih ding; nuaisiah in Israel kumpipa satkhiak siang in a-omta ding hi.
english: So Bethel will do to you because of your great wickedness. At daybreak the king of Israel will be destroyed.

paite: Israel naupang ahih lai in, amah ka it a, Aigupta a kipan ka tapa ka samkhia hi.
english: “When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

paite: Amaute asap chiang un, amau a kipan apai gamla sem ua, Baal kiang ah akithoih ua, lim bawltawmte kiang ah gimlim ahal uhi.
english: They called to them, so they went from them. They sacrificed to the Baals, and burned incense to engraved images.

paite: Hinapi in Ephraim pai ka kisinsak a; ka ban in amau ka pom a; himahleh amaute'n ka hihdam ahih lam uh athei kei uhi.
english: Yet I taught Ephraim to walk. I took them by his arms; but they didn’t know that I healed them.

paite: Mihing khaute leh itna gui in amau ka kai a, amaute a ding in amuk tung uleh amuk nuai ua kibat hakkol ka lakkhiaksak a, ama uah an ka lui hi.
english: I drew them with cords of a man, with ties of love; and I was to them like those who lift up the yoke on their necks; and I bent down to him and I fed him.

paite: Aigupta gam ah akik nawn kei ding a; himahleh Assuria mi akumpipa ahi ding, kik nawn anial ziak un.
english: “They won’t return into the land of Egypt; but the Assyrian will be their king, because they refused to repent.

paite: Huan akhopite tung ah namsau lik in a-om dia, asiktawnte ahul in, anegai ding, athuhilhte uh ngei ziak in.
english: The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.

paite: Huchi in ka mite'n kei a kipan nungtawn atum tinten uh; amah tungsang a ompa sam mah le uh, kuamah in amah aliansak kei ding uh.
english: My people are determined to turn from me. Though they call to the Most High, he certainly won’t exalt them.

paite: Ephraim, bangchi in ka hon tawpsan dia? Israel, bangchi in ka hon tankhe dia? Admah bang in bangchi in ka hon bawl dia? Zeboim bang in bangchi in ka hon koih dia? Ka sung ah ka lungtang akilumlet a, ka lainatnate toh akuangkhawm hi.
english: “How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I make you like Zeboiim? My heart is turned within me, my compassion is aroused.

paite: Ka hehna mahmah ka suahkhesak kei ding a, Ephraim hihse ding in ka kihei kei ding; mihing hilou in, Pathian ka hi a, nang lak a Mi Siangthou, khopi sung ah ka lut kei ding hi.
english: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger. I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of you; and I will not come in wrath.

paite: Amau TOUPA deihdan in a-om ding ua; amah humpinelkai bang in ahumham ding a, amah ahumham chiang in, tumlam a kipan tate ling kawm in ahong pai ding uhi.
english: They will walk after Yahweh, who will roar like a lion; for he will roar, and the children will come trembling from the west.

paite: Aigupta a kipan a vasa bang in ling kawm in ahong pai ding ua, Assuria gam a kipan a vakhu bang in; a-innte ua teng ding in amau ka bawl ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: They will come trembling like a bird out of Egypt, and like a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will settle them in their houses,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ephraim in zuauthu in leh Israel inkuan in khemna in kei ahon umsuak a; himahleh Judah bel Pathian toh vai ahawm lai a, misiangthoute toh aginom lai hi.
english: Ephraim surrounds me with falsehood, and the house of Israel with deceit. Judah still strays from God, and is unfaithful to the Holy One.

paite: Ephraim huih in akivak a, suahlam huih azui; zuaute leh siatgawpna apungsak gige a; Assuria toh thukhun abawl ua, Aigupta gam ah sathau puaklut in a-om hi.
english: Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.

paite: TOUPA'N leng Judah akiselpih a, alampite bang in Jakob agawt ding; athilhihte bang in amah athuk ding hi.
english: Yahweh also has a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his deeds he will repay him.

paite: Sul ah a-unaupa akhetul in aman a; apichin in Pathian ah thilhihtheihna anei hi.
english: In the womb he took his brother by the heel; and in his manhood he contended with God.

paite: Ahi, angel tung ah thilhihtheihna anei a, avualzouta a; akap a, akiang ah zahngaihna angen hi; Bethel ah amah amu a, huai ah kou ahon houpih hi.
english: Indeed, he struggled with the angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication to him. He found him at Bethel, and there he spoke with us,

paite: TOUPA mahmah, sepaihte' Pathian, TOUPA theihgigena ahi.
english: even Yahweh, the God of Armies; Yahweh is his name of renown!

paite: Huaiziak in nang na Pathian lam nga in; zahngaihna leh vaihawmna kem in, na Pathian ngak nilouh in.
english: Therefore turn to your God. Keep kindness and justice, and wait continually for your God.

paite: Amah Kanaan mi ahi, akhut ah khemna buknate a-om; nuaisiah a-utlam ahi.
english: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.

paite: Ephraim in, "Taktak in ka hong hauta a, hauhsakna ka kimuhkhiakta hi; ka sepgimna tengteng ah thulimlouhna thilhih-khelhna kei ah bangmah amu kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Ephraim said, “Surely I have become rich, I have found myself wealth. In all my wealth they won’t find in me any iniquity that is sin.”

paite: Himahleh Aigupta gam a kipan kei TOUPA na Pathian ka hi; ankuanglui thupi lai nite bang in, puaninte a teng ding in nang ka hon bawl lai ding hi.
english: “But I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt. I will yet again make you dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.

paite: Zawlneite kiang ah leng thu ka genta a, mengmuhnate ka tamsakta hi; zawlneite nasepna zang in kibatpihte ka zangta hi.
english: I have also spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions; and by the ministry of the prophets I have used parables.

paite: Gilead thulimlouhna ahi hia? Bangmah lou ahi vek uh; Gilgal ah bawngtalte in akithoih ua; amaitamte uh loukaihna a leivup bang in a-om uh.
english: If Gilead is wicked, surely they are worthless. In Gilgal they sacrifice bulls. Indeed, their altars are like heaps in the furrows of the field.

paite: Aram lou a Jakob atailut bang in, Israel in zi loh ding in nna asem, zi loh ding in belamhon aching hi.
english: Jacob fled into the country of Aram, and Israel served to get a wife, and for a wife he tended flocks and herds.

paite: Aigupta a kipan zawlnei in TOUPA'N Israel apikhia a, zawlnei a hawi in a-om hi.
english: By a prophet Yahweh brought Israel up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was preserved.

paite: Nakpi mahmah in Ephraim in TOUPA ahehsak a; huaiziak in amah tung ah asisan nutsiat in a-om ding, amah gensiatna TOUPA'N akiang lam ah akiksak nawn ding hi.
english: Ephraim has bitterly provoked anger. Therefore his blood will be left on him, and his Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” will repay his contempt.

paite: Ephraim in thu agen lai in, midangte aling ua; Israel ah amah-le-amah akiliansak; himahleh Baal milim bia in, asita hi.
english: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling. He exalted himself in Israel, but when he became guilty in Baal, he died.

paite: Huchi in akhial semsem ua, adangka un milim sun abawl ua, amau theihtheihna dungzui a milimte mahmah avek ua khutsiam mite nasep; kithoih mite'n bawngnoute tawp uhen! chi in huaite tungthu agen uhi.
english: Now they sin more and more, and have made themselves molten images of their silver, even idols according to their own understanding, all of them the work of the craftsmen. They say of them, ‘They offer human sacrifice and kiss the calves.’

paite: Huaiziak in zingsang meipi, daitui hulmang pah bang, phual a kipan a pingpei lak a buhsi bang a mutleng leh meikhu suahna a kipan a meikhu bang ahi ding uhi.
english: Therefore they will be like the morning mist, and like the dew that passes away early, like the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing floor, and like the smoke out of the chimney.

paite: Hinapi in kei Aigupta gam a kipan TOUPA na Pathian ka hi; kei lou ngal pathian na thei kei ding, kei chih louh hondampa a-om kei hi.
english: “Yet I am Yahweh your God from the land of Egypt; and you shall acknowledge no god but me, and besides me there is no savior.

paite: Gamdai ah ka hon theita a, khokhalna gam ah.
english: I knew you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

paite: Aloupa hing nou mitmet mun uh bang in, amaute hihdim in a-om ua; hihdim in a-om ua, huan alungtang uh hihlet in a-om; huaiziak in kei ahon mangngilhta uhi.
english: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted. Therefore they have forgotten me.

paite: Huaiziak in amaute a ding in humpinelkai bang ka hi a; gialbem bang in lampi kiang ah ka tang ding hi.
english: Therefore I am like a lion to them. Like a leopard, I will lurk by the path.

paite: Vompi anoute suun bang in amaute ka maituah ding a, alungtang ua kipan alap uh ka kaikhe ding; huai ah humpinelkai bang in amaute ka ne bei ding; gamsa bang in amaute ka botnen ding hi.
english: I will meet them like a bear that is bereaved of her cubs, and will tear the covering of their heart. There I will devour them like a lioness. The wild animal will tear them.

paite: Aw Israel, na panpihpa dou a, kei na hon dou, na siatna ahi.
english: You are destroyed, Israel, because you are against me, against your help.

paite: Na khopi tengteng a nang hon hondam ding na kumpipa tua koi a om ahia? Kumpipa leh heutute hon pi un, na chihnate uh, na vaihawmte uh koi ah?
english: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? And your judges, of whom you said, ‘Give me a king and princes?’

paite: Hehngoh in kumpipa ka hon pia a, hehngoh in amah ka lamangta hi.
english: I have given you a king in my anger, and have taken him away in my wrath.

paite: Ephraim thulimlouhna koih hoih in a-om a, akhelhna chiamtehna akoih in a-om hi.
english: The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.

paite: Numei nauvei lungkhamna atung ah ahong tung ding; tapa pil lou suang ahi a, naupian hun tungta a, amun a a-omom ding ahita ngal kei a.
english: The sorrows of a travailing woman will come on him. He is an unwise son; for when it is time, he doesn’t come to the opening of the womb.

paite: Han thilhihtheihna a kipan amaute ka tan ding a; sihna a kipan amaute ka tan ding; Aw sihna, na gu koi ah a-om ua? Aw han, na hihsiatna koi ah a-om a? Ka mit a kipan kisikna sel ahi ding hi.
english: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. . I will redeem them from death! Death, where are your plagues? Sheol, where is your destruction? “Compassion will be hidden from my eyes.

paite: A-unaute lak ah gahpha mahleh, suahlam huih ahong kuan dia, gamdai a kipan TOUPA huih ahong nung dia, atui nak ahong keu dia, aluikhuk akang vek ding; bel kipahhuai tengteng a agou loh in a-om ding hi.
english: Though he is fruitful among his brothers, an east wind will come, the breath of Yahweh coming up from the wilderness; and his spring will become dry, and his fountain will be dried up. He will plunder the storehouse of treasure.

paite: Samaria in amoh apo ding; a Pathian tung ah ahel a; namsau in apuk ding ua; anaungekte uh paihgawp in a-om ding uh, nau toh kithuah a numeite uh dawt pailet in a-om ding uhi.
english: Samaria will bear her guilt; for she has rebelled against her God. They will fall by the sword. Their infants will be dashed in pieces, and their pregnant women will be ripped open.”

paite: Aw Israel, TOUPA na Pathian kiang ah kik nawn in, na thulimlouhna ah na pukta hi.
english: Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.

paite: Thupha tawi inla, TOUPA kiang ah kik nawn in, "Thulimlouhna tengteng lamang inla, ahehpihna in na sang in; huchi in ka mukte uh thillat bawngtalte bang in ka pe ding uh," akiang ah chi in.
english: Take words with you, and return to Yahweh. Tell him, “Forgive all our sins, and accept that which is good: so we offer our lips like bulls.

paite: Assuria in ahondam kei dia; sakolte tung ah i tuang kei ding uh; i khut ua i bawlte kiang uah, pathiante na hi uh, i chi nawn kei ding hi; nang ah pabeite'n zahngaihna amu uhi.
english: Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for in you the fatherless finds mercy.”

paite: Aginomlouhna uh ka hihdam ding a, amaute athawn in ka it ding, kei a kipan in ka hehna lah akiheimangta ngal a.
english: “I will heal their waywardness. I will love them freely; for my anger is turned away from him.

paite: Israel lak ah daitui bang ka hi ding, lili pak bang in apaklun dia, Lebanon sing bang in zungkip akakhesuk ding hi.
english: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.

paite: Ahiangte abawkpha dia, akilawmna olive sing bang ahi dia, agim Lebanon bang ahi ding hi.
english: His branches will spread, and his beauty will be like the olive tree, and his fragrance like Lebanon.

paite: Alimnuai a tengte ahong kik nawn ding ua, buh-le-bal bang in ahong hing thak ding ua, grepgui bang in apaklun ding; agim Lebanon uain bang ahi ding.
english: Men will dwell in his shade. They will revive like the grain, and blossom like the vine. Their fragrance will be like the wine of Lebanon.

paite: Milimte bang ding ka chi nawnta dia? Ephraim in achi ding hi. Ka dawng khin a, amah ka limsak ding, meilah sing hing bang ka hi a; kei a kipan na gah muh ahi.
english: Ephraim, what have I to do any more with idols? I answer, and will take care of him. I am like a green fir tree; from me your fruit is found.”

paite: Kua ahia pil a, hiai thilte theithei ding? Pilvang a amaute thei ding? TOUPA lampite adik a, huaite ah midiktat a-om ding a; himahleh talekte huai ah apuk ding uhi.
english: Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are right, and the righteous walk in them; But the rebellious stumble in them.

paite: Na sanggampa Ammi kiang ah, "Ka mite na hi," chi inla, na sanggamnute uh Ruhamah kiang ah, "Zahngaihna na tangta," chi in gen in.
english: “Say to your brothers, ‘My people!’ ‘Ammi’ in Hebrew and to your sisters, ‘My loved one!’ ‘Ruhamah’ in Hebrew

paite: Na nu uh genpih un, genpih un; ka zi ahi kei a, apasal ka hi sam kei hi; amuhna a kipan akizuaknate leh anawi kikal a kipan a-angkawmnate koihmang hen.
english: Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her prostitution from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw vuaktang in ka omsak in, apian ni bang in ka koih in, gamdai bang in ka bawl in, gamkeu bang in ka koih in, dangtakna in amah ka that kha ding hi.
english: Lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.

paite: Ahi, atate tung ah zahngaihna ka nei kei ding a; kizuak tate ahih ding ziak un.
english: Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy; for they are children of unfaithfulness;

paite: Anu uh kizuak ahih ziak in; amaute painu'n zumhuaitak in ahihta hi, "Ka tanghou leh ka tui, ka samul leh ka pat, ka sathau leh ka dawn ding hon pia, ka itte ka delh ding," achih ziak in.
english: For their mother has played the prostitute. She who conceived them has done shamefully; for she said, ‘I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.’

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, ling in alampi ka dal dia, amah dal ding in dai ka kai dia, huchi in alampite amu kei ding hi.
english: Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.

paite: Huchi in a-itte anungzuih ding a, himahleh apha kei ding; amaute azong ding a, himahleh amu kei ding, "Ka pai dia ka pasal masapen kiang ah ka kik ding; huai chiang in tu sang in kei a ding in ahoihzaw ding," achi ding hi.
english: She will follow after her lovers, but she won’t overtake them; and she will seek them, but won’t find them. Then she will say, ‘I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.’

paite: "Abuh-le-bal, uain, sathau ka piak leh adangka leh adangka-eng, Baal a dia azat uh, ka hihpunsak chih atheih louh ziak un.
english: For she did not know that I gave her the grain, the new wine, and the oil, and multiplied to her silver and gold, which they used for Baal.

paite: Huaiziak in buh-le-bal alak hun in ka la nawn ding, ka uain atun hun in, avuaktanna khuhna ding ka samul leh ka pat ka botkhe ding hi.
english: Therefore I will take back my grain in its time, and my new wine in its season, and will pluck away my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.

paite: Huchi in tu'n ama itte muh in azahlakna ka mukhe ding a, ka khut a kipan kuamah in amah atankhe kei ding hi.
english: Now I will uncover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and no one will deliver her out of my hand.

paite: Avualnopna tengteng ka tawpsak ding a, a-ankuangluite, akha thak, a Sabbathte leh akhawmpi kulmut tengteng.
english: I will also cause all her celebrations to cease: her feasts, her new moons, her Sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies.

paite: Hiaite ka kipahman ka itte'n kei hon piak uh ahi, achihna, agrep guite leh atheipi kungte ka hihse vek ding huchi in gammang in ka bawl ding a, gamsate'n huaite ane ding uh.
english: I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees, about which she has said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers have given me; and I will make them a forest,’ and the animals of the field shall eat them.

paite: Baalim ni, huai agimlim hal nite amah tung ah ka kan ding a; abilbahte leh asuangmantamte a kizem a, a-it azuih a, kei ahon mangngilh ziak in,” TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will visit on her the days of the Baals, to which she burned incense, when she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and went after her lovers, and forgot me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, amah ka khim ding a, gamdai ah ka tonpih ding a, akiang ah lungmuanhuaitak in thu ka gen ding hi.
english: “Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak tenderly to her.

paite: Huan huai a kipan in agrephuante amah ka pe ding a, lametna kongkhak ding in Akor Phaizang; huan atuailai nite bang in, Aigupta gam a kipan a ahong pawtkhiak lai ni bang in huai ah ama'n la asa ding hi.
english: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding hi, Baalte na hon chi nawnta kei dia, Ishi na hon chita ding hi," TOUPA'N achi.
english: It will be in that day,” says Yahweh, “that you will call me ‘my husband,’ and no longer call me ‘my master.’

paite: Akam a kipan Baalim minte ka lamangta ding a, amin uh genkhiak ahih nawn tak louh ding ziak un.
english: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, gamsate, van vasate, lei a bokvak a pai thilte toh amaute a ding in thukhun ka bawl ding; thalpeu leh namsau leh kidouna gam a kipan ka hihmangta ding a, galmuangtak in amau ka kualsak ding hi.
english: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.

paite: Huan kei a ding in tangtawn in nang ka hon khamta ding; ahi, diktatna leh vaihawmna leh, itna siamna leh zahngaihna in kei a ding in nang ka hon kham ding hi.
english: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.

paite: Ginomna in kei a ding in ka hon kham ding a; TOUPA na thei ding.
english: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding a, ka dawng ding, vante ka dawng ding a, amau lei adawng ding uh, TOUPA'N achi.
english: It will happen in that day, I will respond,” says Yahweh, “I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;

paite: Lei in buh-le-bal leh uain leh, sathau in adawng ding a, Amau Jezreel adawng ding uhi.
english: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.

paite: Huan lei ah kei a ding in amah ka tuh ding a; zahngaihna tanglounu tung ah zahngaihna ka musak ding; ka mite hiloute kiang ah, "Ka mite na hi uh," ka chi ding a; amau, "Ka Pathian na hi," ahon chi ding uhi.
english: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, ‘You are my people;’ and they will say, ‘My God!’”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Kuan inla, alawm in alunggulh tuntun numei, angkawmnu, pathian dangte lam nga in, grep beu gamte it mah le uh, TOUPA'N Israel suante a-it bang in it nawn in," ahon chi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as Yahweh loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins.”

paite: Huchi in kei a ding in amah dangka shekel sawm-le-nga leh barli buh homer khat leh barli buh homer kimkhat in ka leita hi.
english: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer 1 homer is about 220 litres or 6 bushels and a half of barley.

paite: Akiang ah, "Kei a ding in ni tampi na om nilouh ding; kizuak in na om nawn kei dia, mi kuamah zi na hi kei ding; huchibang in kei leng nang lam ah ka om ding," ka chi hi.
english: I said to her, “You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you.”

paite: Israel suante bel kumpi nei lou, vaihawmmi om lou, kithoihna nei lou, khuam siangthou lou, siampu puanak lou leh pathiante lou in ni tampi a-om nilouh ding uhi.
english: For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, and without prince, and without sacrifice, and without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.

paite: Huai nung chiang in Israel suante ahong kik nawn ding ua, TOUPA, a Pathian uh leh David akumpipa uh azong ding uhi; ni nanungte ah TOUPA kiang ah ahoihna zuan in lau kawm in ahong pai ding uhi.
english: Afterward the children of Israel shall return, and seek Yahweh their God, and David their king, and shall come with trembling to Yahweh and to his blessings in the last days.

paite: Nou Israel suante, TOUPA thu za un, "Gamsung a thutak hiam, zahngaihna hiam, Pathian theihna a-om louh ziak in, TOUPA'N gam a tengte akinakpih hi.
english: Hear the word of Yahweh, you children of Israel; for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.

paite: Kichiam leh ginna hihsiat, thah, guktak leh angkawm hih chih ngal louh bangmah a-om kei hi; akitungkhia ua, sisan akisuah zialzial uhi.
english: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.

paite: Huaiziak in gam adah ding a, asung a tengte leh gamsate leh tungleng vasate abah ding ua, ahi, tuipi ngasate tengteng amangthang ding uh," achi hi.
english: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells therein will waste away. all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.

paite: "Hinapi in kuamah in sual kei henla, kuamah in sal kei heh; na mite lah siampu kisualpihte bang ahi ngal ua.
english: “Yet let no man bring a charge, neither let any man accuse; For your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.

paite: Huan sun in na kisui ding a, nang toh zawlnei leng zan in akisui ding uhi; huchi in na nu ka hihse ding hi.
english: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.

paite: Ka mite theihna taksap ziak in hihsiat in a-om ua; theihna na deih louh ziak in, ke'n leng, kei a dia siampu na hihlouhna ding in ka hon sam kei ding; na Pathian dan na mangngilhta chih thei in, ke'n leng na suante ka mangngilh ding hi.
english: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God’s law, I will also forget your children.

paite: "Ahong pun bang zel un, ka tung ah thil ahihkhial uhi; athupina uh zumna in ka khek ding hi.
english: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.

paite: Ka mite khelhna kivakna in anei ua, athulimlouhna uah alungtang uh akoihkip uhi.
english: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

paite: Huan mipite hi in siampute akibang ua, atatdante uh ziak in amaute ka gawt ding a, athilhihte uah kipahman ka pe ding hi.
english: It will be, like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.

paite: Ane ding ua, akham kei ding uh; akizuak ding ua, apung kei ding uh; TOUPA lam a pilvan ding a-awlmoh louh ziak un."
english: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned giving to Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N "Kizuakna leh uain leh uain thak in theihtheihna alamang hi!" achi hi.
english: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.

paite: Ka mite'n amilimte uh thu adong ua, akiang uah achiangkhun un thu agenkhia uhi; angkawmna kha in amaute takhialsak in, a Pathian uh nuai a kipan angkawm in a-omta uh.
english: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.

paite: Tang sangte tung ah akithoih ua, mualte tung leh tosaw singte leh ahiang singte leh nai nei singte nuai ah, huai nuailim ahoih ziak in, gimlim ahal uh; huaiziak in na tanute un kizuakna ahih ua, na moute un kizuakna ahih ua; na moute un angkawmna ahih uhi.
english: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks and poplars and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.

paite: Na tanute un akizuak chiang un ka gawt kei ding a, na zite un ang a kawm chiang un leng ka gawt kei ding; pasalte kizuakna apaizak ua, tempul a kizuakte kiang ah akithoih uh; huchi in theihna nei lou mite nuaisiah in a-om ding uhi.
english: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.

paite: Nang Israel in, kizuakna hih mah leteh, Judah ahihleh moh kei hen, Gilgal ah hong pai kei unla, Beth-aven ah leng hohtou sam kei un, "TOUPA ahin bang in," chi in leng kichiam kei un.
english: “Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth Aven, nor swear, ‘As Yahweh lives.’

paite: Bawngla genhak bang in, Israel genhaktak in akibawl a; mun za a belamnou bang in tu in TOUPA'N amaute avak ding hi.
english: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will Yahweh feed them like a lamb in a meadow.

paite: Ephraim milimte toh akizom a; a-omom in om hen.
english: Ephraim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!

paite: Adawnkham nung un leng kizuak in a-om lailai ua, thupina sang in zumhuaina a-it tuntun uhi.
english: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.

paite: Huih in akha in amaute amutmang ding a, akithoihna ziak un azum ding uhi.
english: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.

paite: Nou siampute aw, hiai za un, nou Israel inkote aw, ngaikhia un, kumpipa inkote aw, bildoh un, na tung ua vaihawmna hong tung ding ahi; Mizpah a thang leh Tabor tung a lenthang na hi khinta uhi.
english: “Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.

paite: Mithahna lam ah thukpi in akihelta ua; himahleh amaute tengteng thuhilhpa ka hi.
english: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I discipline all of them.

paite: Ephraim ka thei a, Israel ka lak ah sel in a-om kei; Ephraim aw, tu in, kizuak in na omta a, Israel abuahta hi.
english: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Ephraim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.

paite: Athilbawlte un a Pathian kiang lam angasak kei ding hi; asung uah kizuakna kha a-om a, TOUPA athei kei uhi.
english: Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God; for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don’t know Yahweh.

paite: Israel kisaktheihna in amai ah atheihpih a; huaiziak in athulimlouhna uah Israel leh Ephraim akisuipuk ding ua, Judah leng amaute toh apukkhawm ding hi.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Ephraim will stumble in their iniquity. Judah also will stumble with them.

paite: TOUPA zong ding in abawnghonte uh leh abelamhonte uh toh akuan ding ua; himahleh amah amu kei ding uh; amau a kipan in akihemkheta hi.
english: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahweh; but they won’t find him. He has withdrawn himself from them.

paite: TOUPA tung ah lepchiahtak in agamta ua; ta lamdangte anei ua; tu in aloute uh toh kha thak in amau anegai ding hi.
english: They are unfaithful to Yahweh; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.

paite: Gibeah ah na pengkul binei uh mut unla, Ramah ah pengkul; Beth-aven ah ngaihtak in kikou un; aw Benjamin, ka hon zui uhi.
english: “Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beth Aven, behind you, Benjamin!

paite: Salhna ni in Ephraim asegawp ding a; ahong om ngeingei ding Israel namte lak ah ka theisakta hi.
english: Ephraim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.

paite: Judah heutute zaw gamgi chiamtehna lamangte bang ahi uh; tui bang in atung uah ka hehna ka sungbo ding hi.
english: The princes of Judah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.

paite: Epraim nuaisiah in a-om, vaihawmna ah delhkhum in a-om, thupiak zui a om alungkim ziak in.
english: Ephraim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment; Because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.

paite: Huaiziak in Ephraim a ding in puannget leh Judah inkote a ding in siatna ka hi ding hi.
english: Therefore I am to Ephraim like a moth, and to the house of Judah like rottenness.

paite: Ephraim in achinatna amuh a, Judah in aliamna amuh chiang in, huchi in Assuria kiang ah Ephraim ahoh a, kumpipa Jareb kiang ah asawl a; himahleh nang ahon hihdam thei kei a, na liamna leng ahihdam thei sam kei hi.
english: “When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his wound, Then Ephraim went to Assyria, and sent to king Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.

paite: Ephraim a ding a humpinelkai bang leh Judah inkote a ding a humpinelkai lun lai bang ka hih ziak in; kei, kei mahmah in, ka botnen ding a ka paimang ding; ka pomang ding a; honkhe ding kuamah a-om kei ding hi.
english: For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.

paite: Atatkhelhna uh thupha atawi ua, ka mel azon masiah uh, ka pai dia ka mun ah ka kik nawn ding; agimthuakna uah chihtaktak in kei ahon zong ding uhi.
english: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly.”

paite: Hong un, TOUPA kiang ah i kik ding uh; ama'n ahon botkekta a, ahon damsak ding ziak in, ahon sat a, ahon tuam ding hi.
english: “Come, and let us return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind up our wounds.

paite: Ni nih nung in ama'n ahon hihhalh ding; ani thum ni in ahon kaithou ding a, ama ah i hing ding uhi.
english: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.

paite: Huan thei ni, TOUPA thei ding in zuitou pek ni; zingsang a khua avak ngeingei bang in leh vuah, lei kawtsak vuah nanung bang in i kiang uah ahong pai ding chih theihsa ahi.
english: Let us acknowledge Yahweh. Let us press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.”

paite: Aw Ephraim, bang ka hon chih dia? Aw Judah, bang ka hon loh dia? Na hoihna lah zingsang meipi bang leh daitui zulmang pah bang ahi.
english: “Ephraim, what shall I do to you? Judah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.

paite: Huaiziak in zawlneite in amaute ka heuhta; ka kam a thute in amaute ka thatta; na vaihawmnate khovak paikhe pah bang ahi.
english: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.

paite: Kithoihna hilou in, zahngaihna ka deih a; halmang thillat sang in Pathian theihna ka deih hi.
english: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

paite: Himahleh Adam bang in thukhun ah atalek ua; huai ah lepchiahtak in ka tung ah ahih uhi.
english: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me, there.

paite: Gilead thulim lou sepna khopi ahi a, sisan a hihnit in a-om hi.
english: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.

paite: Suamhat pawlte'n mi aguktan bang un, siampu pawlte'n Shekem zotna lampi ah tual athat uh; ahi, kilawm lou ahihta uhi.
english: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a man, so the company of priests murder in the way toward Shechem, committing shameful crimes.

paite: Israel inkote ah thil mulkimhuai ka muta a; huai ah Ephraim ah kizuakna muh in a-om a, Israel abuahgawpta hi.
english: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Ephraim. Israel is defiled.

paite: Huai lou in, Aw Judah, ka mite saltang ka pi nawn chiang in, nang a ding in buhlak ding sehsa a-om hi.
english: “Also, Judah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.

paite: Israel ka sukdam chiang in, huai chang in Ephraim thulimlouhna muhkhiak ahi, Samaria gitlouhna toh; zuauthei ahi ngal ua; gutate'n inn aluh ua, apolam ah suamhatte'n mite asuam uhi.
english: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Samaria; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.

paite: Agitlouhna tengteng uh ka theigige chih alungtangte un angaihtuah kei uh; tu in amau thilhihte ngei in amaute ahihbuai hi; tuate ka mai ma ah a-om uhi.
english: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.

paite: Agitlouhna un akumpipa uh akipaksak ua, azuau un aheutute uh.
english: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

paite: Avek un angkawmte ahi uh; thuk sa gige, tanghou kangmi in tangbuang mekman silngou in azelhsuah masiah mei sawn kul lou thuk bang ahi.
english: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.

paite: I kumpipa uh ankuanglui ni in heutute uain sa in amau leh amau akichinasak ua; simmoh hatte toh akhut azankhia uhi.
english: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.

paite: Alungtang uh thukkhuk sa bang ahi a, mite zuau in abuk ua, zankhua in ahehna uh a-am a, zingsang in meikuang bang in akuangkhia hi.
english: For they have prepared their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their baker sleeps all the night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

paite: Thuk bang in asa vek ua, avaihawmte uh anegai uh; akumpipa tengteng uh apukta uh; kei lam a hong patau kuamah a-om kei uhi.
english: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.

paite: Ephraim, mite lak ah akidiah a; lumleh louh tanghou beu ahi.
english: Ephraim, he mixes himself among the nations. Ephraim is a pancake not turned over.

paite: Mikhualte'n ahatna agai ua, ama'n athei kei; ahi, alutung koi lailai hiam a samkang a-om lam athei kei hi.
english: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn’t realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn’t realize it.

paite: Huan Israel kisaktheihna amel ah alang hi; TOUPA a Pathian lam ah akihei kei ua, hiai tengteng ziak in, amah azong tuan kei uh.
english: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven’t returned to Yahweh their God, nor sought him, for all this.

paite: Ephraim vakhu hai bang, theihsiamna bei ahi; Aigupta lam ah asam ua, Assuria kiang ah apai uhi.
english: “Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

paite: Apai chiang un, atung uah len ka zak ding; van a vasate bang in amaute ka kaikhesuk ding a; a-omkhopna uh azaksa bang un ka sawi ding.
english: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

paite: Atung uh agik hi! Kei a kipan ataimang ziak un, atung uah siatna atung hi, keimah tung ah atalekta ua; amaute tankhe ut mah leng, ka siatna ding in zuau agengen uhi.
english: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

paite: Alungtang uh toh ka kiang ah akap kei ua, alupna tung uah akap zosop uh; buh-le-bal leh uain zong in akikaikhawm ua, ka tung ah ahel uhi.
english: They haven’t cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.

paite: Akhut uh sinsak in hatsakta mah leng, ka siatna ding in angaihtuah uhi.
english: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot evil against me.

paite: Akik ua, himahleh tungsang a ompa kiang ah ahi kei; thalpeu gilou bang ahi uh; alei hehna ziak in namsau in aheutute uh apuk ding uh; Aigupta gam ah hiai nuihsan a a-omna uh ahi ding hi.
english: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Egypt.

paite: Na kam ah pengkul bulh in, muvanlai bang in TOUPA inkote dou ding in ahong hi; ka thukhun tung a atatlek ua, ka dan a atatlek ziak un.
english: “Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over Yahweh’s house, because they have broken my covenant, and rebelled against my law.

paite: Ka Pathian, kou Israel in ka hon thei uh, chi in kei lam ah akikoukhe ding uhi.
english: They cry to me, ‘My God, we Israel acknowledge you!’

paite: Israel in ahoih anawlkhin a; melma in amah adelh ding hi.
english: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.

paite: Kumpipate atungkhia ua, himahleh kei thu in bel ahi kei; heutute abawl ua, ke'n ka thei kei; satkhiak a a-omtheihna ding un adangka uleh adangka-eng un milimte abawl uhi.
english: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn’t approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.

paite: Aw Samaria, na bawngnou milim in hon satkheta; amaute tung ah ka hehna asou; poi khoih lou a bang tan om zou ding uh ahia?
english: Let Samaria throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?

paite: Bawngnou milim Israel a kipan in ahi a; nasem mite'n abawlkhiak uh ahi, huai Pathian ahi kei, ahi, Samaria bawngnou milim akitamzan ding hi.
english: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no God; indeed, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

paite: Huih atuh ua pingpei a-at ua, buh-le-bal ding lai anei kei; avui in an asuah kei hi; huchi ahihleh suah hen, mikhualte'n anawmvalh khin ding uhi.
english: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.

paite: Israel nawmvalh in a-om, kipahna omlouhna bel bang in tu in namte lak ah a-om uhi.
english: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.

paite: Gam sabiltung tang-om bang in, Assuria zuan in apaitou uhi; Ephraim in it mite aguaita hi.
english: For they have gone up to Assyria, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has hired lovers for himself.

paite: Ahi, namte lak ah kizuak mah le uh, amaute ka kaikhawm ding; heutute kumpipa dangte puakgik ziak in alungkham ding uhi.
english: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.

paite: Khial ding a Ephraim in maitam apunsak ziak in, amah a ding in maitamte khelhna ding ahi.
english: Because Ephraim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.

paite: Amah a ding in ka dante singkhat in gelh mah leng, thillamdang bang a sim in a-om uhi.
english: I wrote for him the many things of my law; but they were regarded as a strange thing.

paite: Ka thillatte kithoihna thu ahihleh, sa in akithoih ua ane uh; himahleh TOUPA'N huaite asang kei hi; tu in agitnatlouhna uh atheigige ding a, akhelhnate un aveh ding; Aigupta ah akik ding uhi.
english: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it; But Yahweh doesn’t accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Egypt.

paite: Israel in amah bawlpa amangngilha, mun sangte alamta hi; himahleh akhopite tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, huai a kulhpite akangtum ding uhi.
english: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Judah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses.”

paite: Aw Israel, midangte bang in nuamsa in kipak ke'n; Pathian taisan in kizuak in na om khinta ngal a, phual tung teng ah kizuakman na itta hi.
english: Don’t rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.

paite: Phual leh uain suknate'n amaute avak kei ding a, uain thak in amah azuausan ding hi.
english: The threshing floor and the winepress won’t feed them, and the new wine will fail her.

paite: TOUPA gam ah ateng kei ding ua; himahleh Ephraim Aigupta ah akik ding, Assuria ah an siang lou ane ding uhi.
english: They won’t dwell in Yahweh’s land; but Ephraim will return to Egypt, and they will eat unclean food in Assyria.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah uain thillatte asungkhe kei ding ua, amah a ding in lungkimhuai ahi sam kei ding uh; akithoihnate uh amau a ding in sisuun mite tanghou bang ahi ding; huai ne tengteng hihnit in a-om ding uh; atanghou uh agilkialna uh a ding ahi; TOUPA insung ah ahong pai kei ding hi.
english: They won’t pour out wine offerings to Yahweh, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into the house of Yahweh.

paite: Kikhawmpi chikleh TOUPA ankuanglui ni in bang na hih ding ua?
english: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of Yahweh?

paite: Ngai un, Assuria ah apai ding uh; Aigupta in amaute akhawm ding, Memphis in amaute avui ding. Dangka a bawl agou manphate uh lahou in akhuh ding; apuaninte uah lingte a-om ding hi.
english: For, behold, they have gone away from destruction. Egypt will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.

paite: Vehna nite ahong tung, thukna nite ahong tung; Israel in athei ding hi; zawlnei mihai a seh ahi a, khamite leng mihai ahi, na ginatlouhna atam mahmah ziak in leh muhdahna athupi ziak in.
english: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the man who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.

paite: Ephraim galvilmi Pathian toh a-om hi; zawlnei tungtang ahihleh alampi tengteng ah thangkampa thang a-om a, muhdahna Pathian inn ah a-om hi.
english: A prophet watches over Ephraim with my God. A fowler’s snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.

paite: Gibeah nite a bang in, nakpi in amau leh amau akihihsia ua; athulimlouhna uh atheigige ding a, akhelhnate uh agawt ding hi.
english: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.

paite: Gamdai a grepte bang in Israel ka mu a; theipi kung ahun masapen lai a min masa bang in na pipute uh ka muta hi. Himahleh Baal-peor ah ahong ua, thil zumhuai lam ah akipumpiak ua, athil deihte uh bang in amaute kihhuai ahong hita uhi.
english: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.

paite: Ephraim ahihleh, vasa bang in athupina uh alengmang ding a; nau pianna, nau paina leh nau neihna himhim a-om kei ding hi.
english: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, none with child, and no conception.

paite: Atate uh khoilian mah le uh, amau ka suunsak ding a, piching a hawi in a-om kei ding hi; ahi, amaute ka nutsiat hun chiang in atung uah tunggikna a-om ding hi.
english: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a man shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!

paite: Ephraim, Tura ka muhsa bang in, mun nuam a phuh in a-om; himahleh Ephraim in atate tualthatmi kiang ah ahon pikhe ding hi.
english: I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre, planted in a pleasant place; but Ephraim will bring out his children to the murderer.

paite: Aw TOUPA amau pia in; bang na pe dia? Sul naupai thei lou leh nawizu nei lou pia in.
english: Give them—Yahweh what will you give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

paite: Agitlouhna tengteng uh Gilgal ah a-om a; huai ah amaute ka mudahta hi; athilhihte uh gitlouh ziak in ka inn a kipan amau ka delhkhe ding a; ka it nawn kei ding; aheutute tengteng uh mihel ahi uhi.
english: “All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds I will drive them out of my house! I will love them no more. All their princes are rebels.

paite: Ephraim sat in a-om, azung uh akeu, gah asuang kei ding uh; tate suang mah le uh, asulgah it uh ka that ding hi.
english: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they bring forth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”

paite: Ka Pathian in amaute apaimang ding a, amah angaihkhiak louh ziak un; huchi in namte lak ah vakvai in a-om ding uhi.
english: My God will cast them away, because they did not listen to him; and they will be wanderers among the nations.

paite: Amoz tapa Isai in Judah kumpipa Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiahte vaihawm lai a, Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu a kilakna amuh thu.
english: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

paite: "Vante aw, ngaikhia unla, lei aw, bildoh in, TOUPA'N thu agen hi: Tapate ka khoi a, ka khangliansak a, himahleh ka tung ah ahel uhi.
english: Hear, heavens, and listen, earth; for Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. has spoken: “I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

paite: Bawngtal in aneitu athei a, sabiltung in leng apu anpiakna athei; Israelte'n ahihleh athei kei uh, ka mite'n angaihtuah kei uh," chi in.
english: The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know, my people don’t consider.”

paite: Ah! Nam gilou thulimlouhna gikpi po mite, thil hoih lou hihte, gamtat hoihloupi a gamtate ahi ua; TOUPA apaisan ua, Israelte Mi Siangthou amusit ua, kihihtuam in anungtolhta uh.
english: Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have forsaken Yahweh. They have despised the Holy One of Israel. They are estranged and backward.

paite: Bang achia hel semsem a, vuak a om lailai na hi ua oi? Lutang apum in achi ana a, lungtang leng apum in agimta.
english: Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

paite: Khepek nuai a kipan lutang pha in dam lai himhim a-om kei; chikeh, vuak sidup ek, meima naila ngen ahi; huaite lah amekbing kei ua, tuam leng atuam sam kei ua, sathau leng anuh kei uhi.
english: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t been closed, neither bandaged, neither soothed with oil.

paite: Na gam uh loih in a-om khinta; na khuate uh mei in akang khinta; na gam uh gamdang mite'n na mitmuh un anei khin ua, gamdang mite hihsiat bang in ase khinta hi.
english: Your country is desolate. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers devour your land in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

paite: Zion tanu grephuan a buk bang leh tangmai huan a buk bang leh khopi umbichilh bang in loih in a-omta hi.
english: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a field of melons, like a besieged city.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N khosuaksun tawmchik hon na sitsak lou hileh Sodom bang in i om khin ding ua, Gomorrah bang in i om khinta ding uhi.
english: Unless Yahweh of Armies had left to us a very small remnant, we would have been as Sodom; we would have been like Gomorrah.

paite: Sodom vaihawmte aw, TOUPA thu za un; Gomorrah mite aw, i Pathian dan thu ah bildoh un.
english: Hear the word of Yahweh, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , you people of Gomorrah!

paite: TOUPA'N, "Huai zahzah a na kithoihna uh kei a dia bang ahia athamatna om? Belamtal halmang alatte leh gan vak thaute thau in ahon nimta; bawngtalte leh belamnoute leh kelpate sisan ah leng ka kipak kei, achi hi.
english: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?,” says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed animals. I don’t delight in the blood of bulls, or of lambs, or of male goats.

paite: Ka ma a kilak ding a na hong pai un, ka huangsung intual sik ding kua'n ahon phut a?
english: When you come to appear before me, who has required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

paite: Thilpiak bangmah loute hon tawi nawn kei un; banghiam gimlim kei a ding in thilkihhuaipi ahi; kha thakte, Sabbathte, khawmpite na kichialkhawmte mawkmawk uh ka iplah mahmah; kikhopna thupitak leng thulimlouhna ahi.
english: Bring no more vain offerings. Incense is an abomination to me; new moons, Sabbaths, and convocations: I can’t bear with evil assemblies.

paite: Na kha thakte uleh hunbi nei a na ankuangluinate uh ka lungsim in ahua hi; kei a ding in tunggikna ahi; ka thuak chimta hi.
english: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts. They are a burden to me. I am weary of bearing them.

paite: "Huchi in na khut uh na zak chiang un leng ka mit ka hon humsan dia; ahi, tamveipi na thum chiang un leng ka ngaikhe kei ding; na khutte uh lah sisan in adim ngal a.
english: When you spread forth your hands, I will hide my eyes from you. Yes, when you make many prayers, I will not hear. Your hands are full of blood.

paite: Kisil unla, kihihsiang un; ka mitmuh phak louh ding in na thilhih giloute uh koihmang unla; gilou hih tawpta un.
english: Wash yourselves, make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.

paite: Thil hoih hih kisinta unla; vaihawmna diktat zong un, nuaisiahna thuakte panpih unla, pa neiloute vai hawmsak unla, meithai thu gensak un," achi hi.
english: Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Judge the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Hong pai un, ngaihtuah khawm dih ve ni! Na khelhnate uh san-au bang in om mahleh, vuk bang in angou ding; sandup bang in san khin mahleh belam mul bang in a-om ding.
english: “Come now, and let us reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

paite: Gennoptak leh thumang a na om uleh, na gam thil hoihte uh na ne ding uh.
english: If you are willing and obedient, you shall eat the good of the land;

paite: Himahleh na ut kei ua na hel uleh bel, namsau nek khit in na om ding uh; TOUPA kam in huai agenta hi," achi hi.
english: but if you refuse and rebel, you shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”

paite: Bangchidan ahia khopi muanhuaitak kizuak ahong suah maimah, vaihawm diktatna a dim nu hisek hi a! Amah ah diktatna a-om sek a, tu'n lah tualthat mite a-om hi!
english: How the faithful city has become a prostitute! She was full of justice; righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.

paite: Na dangka eksia ahong hita, na uain lah tui toh hel ahita.
english: Your silver has become dross, your wine mixed with water.

paite: Na miliante mihelhat, gutate lawmte ahi uh; michih in golhna adeih ua, thilpiak adelh nak uhi; pa neiloute ahawmsak sek kei ua, meithaite makhua khualna leng akiang uh atung ngei sam kei hi.
english: Your princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves. Everyone loves bribes, and follows after rewards. They don’t judge the fatherless, neither does the cause of the widow come to them.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA, Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israelte Mihat in hichi in achi! "Aw le! Hon doute tung ah ka hehna ka tangtungsak dia, ka melmate tung ah phu ka la ding.
english: Therefore the Lord, The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: “Ah, I will get relief from my adversaries, and avenge myself of my enemies;

paite: Huchi in na tung ah ka khut ka kha ding a, na eksia siang sipsip in ka hihmang ding, na sikgawm tengteng ka lamang vek ding.
english: and I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.

paite: Huan na sung a vaihawmtute atung a la-om bang un ka omsak nawn ding a, na sung a lemthei mite amasapen a a-om bang un ka omsak lai ding hi. Huai khit chiang in, diktatna khopi, khopi muanhuai, ahon chi ding uhi,” achi hi.
english: I will restore your judges as at the first, and your counselors as at the beginning. Afterward you shall be called ‘The city of righteousness, a faithful town.’

paite: "Zion vaihawmna diktat a hotkhiak ahita ding a, asung a mi piangthak nawnte leng diktatna a hotkhiak ahi ding uhi.
english: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

paite: Himahleh mihelte leh mikhialte hihsiatna akituak in a-om ding a, TOUPA paisan mite leng hihman in a-om ding uhi.
english: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and those who forsake Yahweh shall be consumed.

paite: "Na tosaw deih mahmahte uh azumpihta ding ua, na huan telte uh ziak in zaktatak in na om ding uhi.
english: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired, and you shall be confounded for the gardens that you have chosen.

paite: Tosaw nah vuaite leh huan tui mu lou bang phet na hi ding hi.
english: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades, and as a garden that has no water.

paite: Huchi in mihattak ziza zial bang ahita ding a, anasep mei-ek bang ahi ding; huchi in akang tuaktuak ding ua; kuamah in aphelh kei ding uh," chi in.
english: The strong will be like tinder, and his work like a spark. They will both burn together, and no one will quench them.”

paite: Hoih loutak a thupukna bawlte leh dikloutak a gelh mite tung agik hi!
english: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees;

paite: Meithaite tan ding gallak a laksak a-omtheihna ding uleh, pa neiloute thil laksak bang a abawltheihna ding un, nei zouloute vaihawmna diktat tangsak lou ding leh ka mite lak a gentheite muh ding mawngmawng laksak tumte!
english: to deprive the needy from justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their spoil, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

paite: Huchi in gawtna ni ahong tun chiang leh gamlapi a kipan huihpi ahong tun chiang in, bang na hih ding ua oi? Panpihna ngen ding in kua kiang ah na taita ding ua? Na thupina uh koi ah na nuseta ding ua?
english: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?

paite: Hentate lak ah akun ding ua, thahte lak ah apuk ding uh, hiaite lel atan uh ahita ding hi. Huchi ahih in leng ahehna adai tuan kei a, akhut alik lailai hi.
english: They will only bow down under the prisoners, and will fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

paite: TOUPA'N "Kisa in, Assuria mi, ka hehna khetbuk, ka lungkimlouhna chiangkhun tawi!
english: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!

paite: Gallak la ding leh thil laksak la ding leh kongzing buannawi bang a ngap ding in amah zaw Pathian zah lou nam dou ding in ka sawl ding a, ka hehna mite sual ding in thu ka pe ding hi,” achi hi.
english: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me will I give him a command to take the spoil and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

paite: Himahleh ama'n huchibang a tup ahi kei a, huchibang zaw alungsim in leng angaihtuah sam kei; nam tam petmah a tam hihsiat leh hihmanthat ahi, lungsim a aneih zawk.
english: However he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.

paite: "Ka miliante tengteng kumpipa ahi vek kei ua hia?
english: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?

paite: Kalno khua Karkhemish khua bang hita lou ahi maw? Hamath khua Arpad khua bang hita lou ahi maw? Samaria khua Damaskas khua bang hita lou ahi maw?
english: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”

paite: Ka khut in milimte gam, Jerusalem khua leh Samaria khuate sang a milim bawltawm hoihzaw neite leng, azongkheta uhi.
english: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

paite: Samaria leh amilimte tung a ka hihtak bang in Jerusalem leh amilimte tung ah ka hih kei dia hia?"
english: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

paite: Huchi ahih ziak in hichi ahi ding a, "Toupa'n Zion tang leh Jerusalem khosung a anasep ding tengteng asep khit hun chiang in Assuria kumpipa lungsim ki-otsakna gah leh amit kisathei thupina ka gawt ding," achi hi.
english: Therefore it will happen that, when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his haughty looks.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka khut hatna in ka hihta hi, ka pilna toh in; ka kizen ngal a; chi chih gamgite lah ka suan a, avaihawmna uh lah ka sut a, laltutphah a tute mihangsan hih bang in ka kaikhia hi.
english: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding: and I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.

paite: Ka khut in chi chih hauhsaknate lah vasabu bang in azongkhia a; mi'n vasa tui api loihsansa ala uh bang in leitung pumpi ka la khin vekta hi; khazap hiam, kam ka hiam ham himhim leng a-om kei uhi," achi vial ngal a.
english: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, have I gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”

paite: Heipi in thil ehna ding a azangmi akisaktheihsan dia hia? Sing-atna in atmi anuaisiah dia hia? Khetbuk in adom mite alik zosop diam aw, chiangkhun in sing hilou alik zomah bang phet ahi.
english: Should an axe brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Ami thaute lak ah gawnna asawl ding a; athupina nuai ah meikuang lai lel bang in mei toh in a-om ding.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.

paite: Huan Israelte vakna mei ahong hi ding a, amaute Mi Siangthou mah leng meikuang ahi ding; huai in ni khat thu in louling neite leh khaulingneite kangsak in ahihmangthang ding.
english: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

paite: Agammang leh alei hoih mun thupina leng, kha leh sa nangawn in, ahihmang ding; huchi in chiamtehna tawi pen kia hun lai bang ahi ding.
english: He will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.

paite: Agammang a sing om zek laite naupang gelh tham phet a tawm ahita ding," achi hi.
english: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Israelte khosuaksunte leh Jakob inkuanpihte lak a khosuaksunte'n amaute thatpa ah akinga nawnta kei ding ua; TOUPA Israelte Mi Siangthou, chihtaktak in amuangzawta ding uhi.
english: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.

paite: Akhosuaksunte, Jakob khosuaksunte, Pathian hattak kiang ah akik nawn ding uh.
english: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.

paite: Na mi Israelte tuipi piaunel zah himah le uh, akhosuaksunte kia akik nawn ding uhi; diktatna luanletna suksiatna tung ding avaihawm puk ahi.
