english: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

paite: Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA, tawpna, tawpna tung ngei ding a vaihawm puk, gam tengteng laizang ah abawl ding hi.
english: For the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, in the midst of all the earth.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Zion a om ka mite aw, Aigupta gam a ahih bang un khetbuk a nou hon vua in achiangkhun na tung uah lik mahleh, Assuria mi kihta kei un.
english: Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, says “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.

paite: Sawt louchik nung in ka lungkimlouhna ahong bei dia, ka hehna leng amaute hihmanthatna ding in hei in a-omta ding hi.
english: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”

paite: Oreb suangpi a Midiante athah lai bang un sepaihte' TOUPA'N amah sual ding in zepna apei ding a; achiang lah tuipi tunglam ah a-om ding a Aigupta gam a apei bang in apei ding hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, puakgik na liangzang a kipan lakmang in a-om ding a, ahakkol leng na ngawng a kipan lakmang in a-om lai ding hi; thaunilh ziak in hakkol hihsiat in a-omta ding,” chi in.
english: It will happen in that day, that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.

paite: Rimmon a kipan Aiath khua atungta, Migron ah apaisuakta; Mikmash ah avan akoihta hi.
english: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.

paite: Guam ah atumta uh; Geba ah agiakta uh; Ramah khuate alingling ua; Saul, Gibeah khote ataimangta uh.
english: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.

paite: Gallim tanu aw! Na aw in ngaihtak in kikou in; Laish a khua aw! Ngaikhia in; Anathoth aw, hehpihhuai na lawmlawm chia!
english: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!

paite: Madmenah khote taimang in a-omta uh; Gebim a omte taimang tum in akidelh ding uhi.
english: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

paite: Tuni mah in Nob ah ataam dia; Zion tanu tang, Jerusalem mual pawng akhut asinkhum hi.
english: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

paite: Ngai dih, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, thil mulkimhuaitak in ahiangte asatkhe ding a, sang pipite phuk in a-om ding a, adawktuamte leng gawiniam in a-om ding hi.
english: Behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.

paite: Sik in gamnuai sing sahte aphuk ding a, Lebanon sidar singte mithupi puk in apuk zuazua ding uhi.
english: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.

paite: Jesse bul a kipan in selnou ahong pawt ding a, azungte a kipan in ahiang hong khangkhe ding hi.
english: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.

paite: Huan TOUPA kha pilna leh theihtheihna kha, lemtheihna leh hatna kha theihna leh TOUPA launa kha atung ah atu ding hi.
english: The Spirit of Yahweh will rest on him: the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in akipahna uh TOUPA launa ah ahi ding. Amit a amuh bang in vai ahawm kei ding a, abil a azak bang in leng ataihilh sam kei ding hi.
english: His delight will be in the fear of Yahweh. He will not judge by the sight of his eyes, neither decide by the hearing of his ears;

paite: Diktattak in gentheite vai ahawmsak zaw ding a, lei a mi thunuailutte a ding in khentuam nei lou in ataihilhsak lai ding hi; akam a khetbuk in lei akhen ding a, amuk a hu in migilou-saloute athat ding.
english: but with righteousness he will judge the poor, and decide with equity for the humble of the earth. He will strike the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips he will kill the wicked.

paite: Diktatna akawnggak ahi ding a, ginomna ataigakna ahi ding hi.
english: Righteousness will be the belt of his waist, and faithfulness the belt of his waist.

paite: Huchi in ngia leh belamnou a-omkhawm ding ua, kelnou toh gialbem abokkhawm ding uh, bawngnou leh humpinelkai tuailai leh gan vak thaute a-omkhawm ding ua; naupangnou in api zungzung ding hi.
english: The wolf will live with the lamb, and the leopard will lie down with the young goat; The calf, the young lion, and the fattened calf together; and a little child will lead them.

paite: Bawng leh vompi agamtakhawm ding ua; anoute uh abokkhawm tiptep ding uhi; huan humpinelkai in bawngtal bang in buhpawl ane ding hi.
english: The cow and the bear will graze. Their young ones will lie down together. The lion will eat straw like the ox.

paite: Nau nawitui ne lai thangtom ko gei ah a-om hiathiat ding a, nau nawitui nek tawpsa in guldekpak ko gei ah akhut anga ding.
english: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.

paite: Ka tang siangthou ah kihihnat a-omta kei ding a, kihihsiat leng a-om nawn kei ding, tuipite tui a adim gige bang in, TOUPA theihna in leitung adim ding hi.
english: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth will be full of the knowledge of Yahweh, as the waters cover the sea.

paite: Huan huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Jesse zung michih chiamtehna ding in a-om ding a, amah mahmah namte'n adong ding ua, akhawlna mun athupi ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Toupa'n asi val khosuaksun amite, Assuria gam a kipan, Aigupta gam a kipan, Pathros gam a kipan, Kush gam a kipan, Elam gam a kipan, Shinar gam a kipan leh Hamath a kipan leh tuipi tuikulh gam a kipan, ala nawn ding a, anihveina ding in akhut azak nawn ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

paite: Huchi in namte a ding in chiamtehna atakkhe ding a, Israel delhkhiakte apikhawm ding a, Judah dalhte kawlmong li a kipan apikhawm ding.
english: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

paite: Huchi in Ephraimte hazatna abeita ding a, Judahte hihbuai mite hihmanthat in a-omta ding uh; Ephraimte'n Judahte ahaza nawnta kei ding ua, Judahte'n leng Ephraimte ahihbuai nawn kei ding uh.
english: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.

paite: Huchi in amaute tumlam ah Philistiate liangzang ah lengsuk in ava tuang ding ua; suahlam mite alokkhawm ding uh; Edom leh Moabte tung ah akhut uh akha ding ua, Ammon suante'n athu uh amangta ding uh.
english: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.

paite: TOUPA'N Aigupta Tuipi lei ahihse vek ding a, Luipi leng ahuih sa huthut in akhut asinkhum ding a, luita sagihte a bawl hial in avo ding a, mite khepek leng kawt lou in apai galkah ding.
english: Yahweh will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam a kipan apaitouh ni ua Israelte a ding a lamlian ahong om bang in, akhosuaksun amite a ding in Assuria gam a kipan in lamlian ahong om ding hi.
english: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichibang in na chi ding hi, "TOUPA aw, kipahthu ka hon hilh hi; ka tung ah na hehta mah lechin, na hehna lah adaita, na hon khamuan hi.
english: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian hon hondampa ahi a; ka gingta ding a, lau in ka om kei ding; TOUPA Jehovah ka hatna leh ka la ahi, hon hondampa ahi," chi in.
english: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”

paite: Huaiziak in hotdamna tuikhuk a pan nuam in tui na tawi ding uh.
english: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.

paite: Huai ni in huchi in na chi ding hi. "TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh unla, amin lou un, athilhihte michih lak ah theisak unla, amin pahtawi in a-om chih gen un.
english: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name. Declare his doings among the peoples. Proclaim that his name is exalted!

paite: TOUPA pahtawi in la sa un; ama'n thil hoihpente ahihta hi; huai leitung ah theih in om hen.
english: Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!

paite: Zion a omte aw, ngaihtak in kikou unla, kikou vengvung un, Israelte Mi Siangthou na lak ua om lah athupi ngal a," chi in.
english: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion; for the Holy One of Israel is great in the midst of you!”

paite: Babulon kho puakgik Amoz tapa Isai in amuh thu.
english: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw:

paite: Miliante kongpite a aluttheihna ding un tang sang mai velvul ah chiamtehna takkhia unla, ngaihtak in amau sam unla, khut in hihdan ding hilh un.
english: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

paite: Kei mahmah in ka misehte thu ka peta, ahi, ka mihattak, ka mi kinuamsakte, ka hehna tangtungsak ding in ka samta hi.
english: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

paite: Tang a mipi husa, mipi atam a tam husa bang mahmah! Namte' lalgam a mi omkhawmte chiak vengvung husa! Sepaihte' TOUPA'N galsual ding a sepaihte kaikhawm ei ve.
english: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! Yahweh of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.

paite: Amaute, TOUPA leh alungkimlouhna vanzat, gam gamlapi a kipan, kawlmong tawpna mahmah a kipan in gam tengteng hihse ding in ahong pai uhi.
english: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Yahweh, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

paite: Mau tuaituai un, TOUPA ni anaita hi. Bangkim hihthei a kipan siatna ahong tung bang in ahong tung ding hi.
english: Wail; for the day of Yahweh is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.

paite: Huaiziak in khut tengteng ahat kei ding a, mihing lungtang chiteng leng azulmang ding.
english: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.

paite: Huchi in alau ding ua; damlouhna leh lungkimlouhnate'n amaute aman ding a; numei nauvei bang mai in achi uh ana ding; lamdang kisatuah in a-om chiat ding uh; amelte uh meikuang mel bang ahi ding.
english: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.

paite: Ngai in, gam hihse ding leh huai lai a mikhialte asung a kipan a hihmangthang ding in TOUPA ni thupitak, thangpaihna leh hehna thupitak toh, ahong tung ding hi.
english: Behold, the day of Yahweh comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.

paite: Van aksite leh aksi munkipte un avakna uh asuaksak kei ding ua; ni lah asuah lai in mialsak in a-om ding a, kha in leng avakna avaksak kei ding hi.
english: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going forth, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.

paite: Huan khovel agitlouhna ziak in ka gawt ding a, migilou-saloute athulimlouhna ziak un ka gawt sam ding. Mikisathei paukhauh lah ka tawpsak ding a, mikihtakhuai kisaktheihna ka niamsak lai ding hi.
english: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the haughtiness of the terrible.

paite: Mi dangka-eng siangthou sang a leng manphazaw in ka bawl ding a, mihing mahmah lah Ophir dangka-eng siangthou sang a leng manphazaw in ka bawl ding.
english: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.

paite: Huchi in tung a van ka kisingsak ding a, sepaihte' TOUPA hehna ziak in, ahehna ni thupitak ni in, lei leng a-omna mun kisuan tham in linsak in a-om ding.
english: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the wrath of Yahweh of Armies, and in the day of his fierce anger.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, sakhi delh ek bang leh belam kuamah hawlkhawm louh bang in michih amau chipihte lam chiat anga ding ua, michih amau gam lam chiat ah ataimang ding uh.
english: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle, and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.

paite: Muh a om peuhmah dawt pailet in a-om ding a, huan, mat a om peuhmah namsau a satpaih in a-om ding.
english: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.

paite: Anaungekte uh leng amitmuh un zan dimdem khop a leitual satna a zat in a-om ding uh; a-innte uh loh in a-om dia, azite uh leng mawksual in a-om ding uh.
english: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.

paite: Ngai in, Mediate amau sual ding in ka tokthou ding a, huaite'n dangka alimsak kei ding ua, dangka-eng leng akipahpih sam kei ding uh.
english: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.

paite: Athalpeute un tangvalte azansak ding a; gil a gahte hehpihna himhim anei kei ding uh; amit un naupangte ahawi kei ding uh.
english: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.

paite: Huan Babilon, gam chih thupina, Kaldaite kisaktheihpih thil hoihtak, Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah asukman lai bang in a-om ding uh.
english: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

paite: Chik mah chiang in leng huai ah mi a-om nawnta kei ding uh, suan om lai siah in leng asung a om a-om sam kei ding. Arab mite'n huai ah apuaninte uh akai kei ding ua; belamchingte'n huai ah abelamhonte uh akualsak kei ding uh.
english: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.

paite: Gamdai a gamsate huai ah a-om ding ua; a-innte uh simbute inn in adim ding a; vasa ngawngsaute huai ah ateng ding ua, sathakte huai ah amawl leklek ding uhi.
english: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.

paite: A-insangte uah ngiate aham ding ua, sihalte leng a-inpi nuam mahmahte uah aham ding uh; huan, agawt hun ding atung dekta a, anite leng suksau in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Wolves will cry in their castles, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.

paite: "TOUPA'N Jakobte tung ah zahngaihna anei ding a, Israelte tel in amau gam ngeingei ah a-omsak ding hi; huan, gamdang mite'n amau azui ding ua, Jakob inkuanpihte alenkip ding uhi.
english: For Yahweh will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.

paite: Huchi in michih in amau api ding ua, amun ding uh atun ding uhi; huchi in Israel inkuanpihte'n TOUPA gam ah amau salpa leh salnu in anei ding ua; amau sal a nei mite sal in ahon man ding ua; amaute simmohte tung ah vai ahon hawm ding uhi.
english: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in Yahweh’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

paite: "Huan na lungkhamna a kipan, na buaina a kipan leh nasep haksa pipi ahon sepsakna ua kipan in TOUPA'N nang ahon khawlsak ni chiang in hichi ahi ding hi.
english: It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,

paite: Hiai pau-el thu Babulon kumpipa kikoukhum in na gen ding. Bangchidan ahia, simmoh hatpa daita na e! Bangchidan ahia, dangka-eng khopi daita na tel e!
english: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”

paite: TOUPA'N migilou-salou chiangkhun ahihtanta, vaihawmte lalchiang.
english: Yahweh has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,

paite: Michih heh kawm a vo zialzial zel, thangpai kawm a kuamah kham ngei louh sawina a namte vai hawmsak zel.
english: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that none restrained.

paite: Lei pumpi akhawl a, adai vungvung a; thakhat in la asakhe guih uh.
english: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out song.

paite: Ahi, na tungthu ziak in meilahte anuam ua, Lebanon tang a sidar singte toh. Hihniam a na om nungsiah phukpaitu ding himhim ka kiang uah ahong tou ngei nawn kei uh," chi in.
english: Yes, the fir trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”

paite: "Nuailam a kipan Sheol nang hon dawn ding in, nangmah ziak in abuai lutlut hi; misi, lei a makai tengteng nangmah ziak in atokthou a; namte kumpipa tengteng alaltutphah ua kipan akaidinghta hi.
english: Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the dead for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.

paite: Huai tengteng in nangmah bia in, na kiang ah huchi in agen ding uh. Nang leng kou bang a hat lou na hita maw?
english: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”

paite: Na thupi mahmahna Sheol a pikhiaksuk ahita, na kaihging lunglungte toh; tangtel na nuai ah aphah ua, than in nang ahon khuhta uhi,” chi in.
english: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. , with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.

paite: "Sun Aksi aw, Zingsang lam tapa, bangchidan ahia van a kipan na kiak tak maimah! Namte hihpukpa, bangchidan ahia lei a satkhiaksuk a na om maimah!
english: How you have fallen from heaven, morning star, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!

paite: Na lungtang in, van ah ka kah ding a, Pathian aksite tunglam ah ka laltutphah ka tawisang ding; huan, kikhopna tang, mal tawp a om ah, ka tu ding a;
english: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!

paite: meipi sang a sang ah ka kah ding a; Tungnungpen bang mai in ka om ding, na chi nak vial a.
english: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”

paite: Himahleh, Sheol ah, kokhuk tawp ah, pikhiaksuk a om ding na hi ngal a.
english: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. , to the depths of the pit.

paite: "Ahon mu peuh in ahon lim-et ding ua, hiai mi maw lei hihling a, gam chih kisingsak a,
english: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms;

paite: Khovel gamdai bang a bawl a, akhua omte hihmang a, asalte a-inn lam ua pai dia pawtsak ngei lou? chi in na tanchin asut ding uhi.
english: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities; who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”

paite: "Namte kumpipa tengteng, avek un, amau inn chiat uah thupitak in a-ihmu uh.
english: All the kings of the nations, sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.

paite: Nang bel ahun lou a piang kihhuaitak bang in leh gal thah, namsau a sut pailet, kokhuk a thante lak a paisukte puansilh bang in na han a kipan gamlapi ah paihkhiak in na om zawta hi; luang sikden bang mai in.
english: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.

paite: Na gam na hihsiat a, na khua na tuite na thah ziak in alak ua vui in nang zaw na om kei ding hi. Thil hoih lou hih mite suante min tangtawn in alou ngei kei ding uh.
english: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The seed of evildoers will not be named forever.

paite: Akisak ua, lei aneih ua, leitung khopi a adimsaklouhna ding un, apipute uh khelhna ziak in atate uh thah ding ngaihtuah un," chi in.
english: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.

paite: Huan "Amaute sual ding in ka kisa ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, Babulon a kipan min leh akhosuaksunte leh tapa leh tapa' tapa ka hihmang ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I will rise up against them,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says Yahweh.

paite: Sakuh a ding in gou in ka bawl ding a, dilte ah leng ka bawl ding; hihmanna munphiah in ka phiat lai ding," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichibang a gen in akichiamta, "Pel lou in ka ngaihtuah bangtak in ahong tung ding; ka seh bangtak in leng a-om ding.
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

paite: Ka gam ah Assuria mi ka hihse ding a, ka tangte ah ka chil-ek ding achih bang in; huai hun chiang in ahakkol uh amau a kipan amangta ding a, apuakgik uh aliangzang ua kipan in amang sam ding hi.
english: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.

paite: Huai ahi, leitung pumpi a thuseh, huai mah ahi, nam chih tung a khut zak.
english: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

paite: Sepaihte' ToUPA'N asepta ngal a, kua'n asut dia? Akhut zak in a-omta, kua'n alaksak nawn dia?" chi in.
english: For Yahweh of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”

paite: Kumpipa Ahaz sih kum in hiai puakgik ahong omta.
english: This burden was in the year that king Ahaz died.

paite: Philistia gam pumpi aw, nangmah vuakna chiang akitan tak ziak in kipak ke'n; gul zung a kipan in guldekpak apawt ding a, agah gul kuang leng thei ahong hi ding hi.
english: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.

paite: Migenthei ta masate'n ane un ata ding ua, mitagahte leng bittak in a-om ding uh; nang a zung bel kial in ka that ding a, nang akhosuaksunte thah in a-om ding uh.
english: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.

paite: Kongkhak aw, mau tuaituai in; khopi aw, kikou in; Philistia aw, na pum in na zulmang khinta; mallam a kipan in lah meikhu ahong pawt ngal a, ahun seh uah tuantual himhim a-om ngei kei uhi.
english: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

paite: Philistia nam palaite bangchibang in i dawng ding ua? TOUPA'N Zion lah atungding a, amite lak a gentheite'n bitna amu uh, i chi ding uhi.
english: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That Yahweh has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.

paite: Moab gam puakgik. Zan khat thu in Moab gam a Ar khua suksiat in a-om a, bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta hi; zan khat thu in Moab gam a Kir khua suksiat in a-om a, bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta hi.
english: The burden of Moab: for in a night, Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing; for in a night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to nothing.

paite: Dibon tanu, mun sangte a kap ding in ahohtouta a; Moabte'n Nebo leh Medeba akahkhum ua, alu tengteng uh agiau vek a, akhamul teng uh leng met in a-om vek hi.
english: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.

paite: Akongzingte uah sai-ip puan ateng ua; a-intungte uah leh akholak uah michih nakpi in amau tuaituai uhi.
english: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.

paite: Heshbonte leng akikou ua, Elealehte toh; Jahaz kholam in leng a-aw uh aza uh; huaiziak in Moabte galvan a kivante ngaihtak in akikou ua; ahinna uh asung uah aling hi.
english: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.

paite: Moabte ziak in ka lungtang akikou a; amihoihte uh Zoar leh Eglath-shelishijah khuate ah atai ua; Luhith tou ah kap kawm in apaitou ua; Horonaim lampi ah siatna kikou in akikoukhia uhi.
english: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for in the way of Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.

paite: Nimrim tuite hihsiat a om ding ahi; loupa avuai khinta; loupa selnoute avuai a, thil hing a-omta kei hi.
english: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.

paite: Huaiziak in asum neihsunte uleh akoih hoihte uh Muisum Lui gal akaimangpih uhi.
english: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.

paite: Moab gamgi kim ah kikou husa athang ngal a; amau tuaituai husa Eglaim khua atungta; amau tuaituai husa Beer-elim khua atungta hi.
english: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab; its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.

paite: Dimon tuite sisan in adim vek ngal a; Dimon tung ah thil thupi sem tungsak ding ka hi, Moabte lak a taikhete tung ah leh huai gam a khosuaksunte tung ah humpinelkai ka tungsak ding hi.
english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.

paite: Gam vaihawmmi a ding in belamnoute Sela khua gamdai a om a kipan in Zion tanu tang ah khak un.
english: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.

paite: Huchi in vasa abu a kipan dalh a lengleng bang in Arnon lui kainate ah Moab tanute a-om ding uhi.
english: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

paite: Thu hon hilh inla, vai hon hawmsak in; na lim sun lai in zan bang in bawl inla; delhkhiakte sel in; taimangte mansak ke'n.
english: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the midst of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!

paite: Moab lak a mi delhkhiak a omte na kiang ah om uhen; amau a ding in hihsemi mel a kipan bukna mun hi hen; lepgumi lah bangmah lou a bawl in a-omta ngal a, hihsiatna adaita a, nuaisiahnate gam a kipan hihmanthat in a-omta uhi.
english: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortioner is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.

paite: Huchi in laltutphah hehpihna a hihkip in a-om ding a, huai tung ah, David puanin ah, mi khat, vaihawm in, vaihawmna diktat zong in, thil diktat kintak a hihpah in, chihtaktak in atu ding hi.
english: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

paite: Moabte kisaktheihna thu, akisathei mahmah uh chih, ka za ua; asuahngaldan uleh, akisaktheihdan uleh, ahehdan thu uh; aki-otsaknate uh bangmah ahi kei hi.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.

paite: Huaiziak in Moab tung ah Moab amau tuaituai ding a, michih a mau tuaituai ding; Kir-hareseth grep beu khase tuntun in na kah ding uhi.
english: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.

paite: Heshbon loute lah atul khinta a, Sibmah grepgui toh, namte toupate'n akung hoih tata akitansak phengphung ua; Jazer kho tanpha in azam ua, gamdai ah azamlut ua; ahiangte azamdalh sengsung ua, tuipi ah azam galkahta uhi.
english: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.

paite: Huaiziak in Sibmah grepgui Jazer kah in ka kah ding a; Heshbon leh Elealeh aw, ka khitui in ka hon buak ding; na nipi gahte tung leh na buh tung ah kisual kikou husa aketa ngal a.
english: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.

paite: Kipahna laksak in a-omta, lou hoihtak a kipan in leng nopna laksak in a-omta a; grephuan ah lasak himhim a-omta kei ding a, husa nop tuak himhim leng a-om nawn sam kei ding; grep sukna khukte ah chil a sukmi himhim in uain achilkheta kei ding uh; grep la a kikou ka daisakta hi.
english: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.

paite: Huaiziak in ka gilte lah Moab hehpihna in pekging bang in aging a, ka gilsung lah Kir-hareseth hehpihna in pekging bang in aging lai hi.
english: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, Moab akilat chiang in mun sang akihihgim a, thum ding a ama Mun Siangthou a ahong pai chiang in avuaksuak ding hi.
english: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.

paite: Huaite Moab tungthu TOUPA'N tuma a agen ahi.
english: This is the word that Yahweh spoke concerning Moab in time past.

paite: Tu in bel TOUPA'N, kilohmi kum sim a kum thum sung in Moab, thupina, amipi tampitakte nangawn in, muhsithuai a omsak in a-om ding a; akhosuaksunte tawmchik mahmah, gen tham louh ahi ding uh, chi in agenta hi.
english: But now Yahweh has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”

paite: Damaskas kho puakgik. Ngai in, Damaskas khopi hi nawn lou ding a lakmang ahita, huchi in inn chimsia koihkhawm lel ahita ding hi.
english: The burden of Damascus: “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.

paite: Aroer khote taisan in a-omta; belamhonte omna ding ahi mai ding, huaite lah a-om ngei ding ua, kuamah in alausak kei ding uh.
english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

paite: Ephraim a kipan kulhpi amang ding a, Damaskas a kipan gam amang ding, Siria gam a khosuaksunte leng amang ding uh; Israel suante thupina bang lel in a-om ding uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jakob thupina hihgawn in a-om ding a, asa thauna leng ahong gawngta ding hi.
english: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.

paite: Huchi in buh la pan buh alak a, avuite alak bang mai ahi ding a, ahi, Rephaim phaizang ah mi'n buh maihkhakte atom bang mai uh ahi ding hi.
english: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: Himahleh, olive singgah loh khit a azikpi dawn a gah nih hiam thum hiam om lai bang leh singgah hiang hoih li hiam nga hiam a-om sek bang in, maih khak top ding a-om lai ding, TOUPA Pathian in achi hi.
english: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi'n a Bawlpa uh lam a-enta ding ua, amitte un Israelte Mi Siangthou azahtakta ding uh.
english: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Maitam, amau khutsuakte lam a-en nawnta kei ding ua, amau khut a bawl Asherim hiam, gimlim maitamte hiam azahtak nawnta kei ding uhi.
english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherim, or the incense altars.

paite: Huai ni chiang in akhopi kiptakte uh gammang leh tang vum a mun taisansa, Israel suante ma a ataisansa bang uh, ahi ding; huchi in munloih ahita ding hi.
english: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

paite: Nang hon hondampa Pathian na mangngilh a, na hatna Suangpi lah na theigige kei hi; huaiziak in singkung kilawm taktakte na suan ding a, asung ah hiang tuamte na vut paisuak ding hi.
english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.

paite: Na suan ni in na khangsak a, zingsang in thil chi lah na paksak a; himahleh agahloh lah lungngaihna leh natna thupitak ni in amang hi.
english: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

paite: Ah! Mipi tampi ging zuazua, tuipite ging zuazua bang a ging zuazuate leh namte husa ging hawhaw, tui thupitakte ging hawhaw bang a ging hawhawte na tung uh agik hi!
english: Ah, the uproar of many peoples, who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations, that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

paite: Namte lah tuipi tampi ging hawhaw bang in aging hawhaw ding ua; himahleh ama'n ataihilh ding a, huchi in gamlapi ah ataimang ding ua, tang a buhsi huih mut bang leh leivui huihpi mutleng lunglung bang in delh in a-om ding uhi.
english: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

paite: Nitaklam in, ngai in, thil mulkimhuaitak a-om a; huan, khovak ma in lah a-om nawn kei uh. Huai gallak a hon laksak mite tan ahi a, hon guksak mite tuam leng ahi hi.
english: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.

paite: Ethiopia gam khen a lui gal a om, akhazap ging hawhaw gam tung agik hi.
english: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

paite: Tuipi ah, tui tung a tolh longte ah palaite sawlpa! Misawl hattakte aw, nam sang zehzoh mam hethot kiang ah, apawt tung ua kipan tutan a mi kihtakhuaitakte kiang ah, hoh un; nam in gam ahawm ua, apalpuk uhi, agam uh luite'n ahawmzak hi.
english: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”

paite: Khovel a om tengteng leh lei a tengte aw, tangte a chiamtehna atakkhiak chiang un en un; pengkul amut chiang un ngaikhia un.
english: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi, "Ka om kinken ding a, ka omna ah ka en gige ding a; nisat lai a kholum huthut bang leh buhlak kholum lai a daitui mei bang in," chi in.
english: For Yahweh said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”

paite: Grep loh hun ma a, apak abei a, apak grep puam a ahong om chiang in, ahiangnoute theikung attanna temta in a-attan sin ngal a, ahiang zam dalhte lamang in asattan lai ding hi.
english: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.

paite: Huaite tang a vasa sa ne chite a ding in, lei a sate a ding in nutsiat in a-om ding uh; huchi in vasa sa ne chite'n amaute nipi sung in ane ding ua, lei a sa tengteng in phalbi sung in ane ding uhi.
english: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will summer on them, and all the animals of the earth will winter on them.

paite: Huai hun chiang in, sepaihte' TOUPA min omna mun, Zion tang ah, sepaihte' TOUPA kiang a piak ding in mi sang zehzoh nam, mam pekpokte'n, kipahman ahon tawi ding ua; nam ahih ua kipan kihtakhuaitak leh pau tuam nei ahi uhi. Huai nam in gam ahawm zel ua, apalpuk behlap lai ua, agam uh lah luite'n ahawmzak hi.
english: In that time, a present will be brought to Yahweh of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Yahweh of Armies, Mount Zion.

paite: Aigupta gam puakgik. Ngai in, TOUPA meipi hattak tung a tuang in, Aigupta gam ahong tungta, Aigupta gam milimte ama ah aling vonvon ding ua, Aiguptate lungtang lah asung uah azulmang mai ding hi.
english: The burden of Egypt: “Behold, Yahweh rides on a swift cloud, and comes to Egypt. The idols of Egypt will tremble at his presence; and the heart of Egypt will melt in its midst.

paite: Aigupta mite Aigupta mite mah sual ding in ka tokthou ding a; huchi in michih in amau unau sual in michih in amau invengte sual in, akidou ding uh; khua leh khua akidou ding ua, gam leh gam akidou ding uhi.
english: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

paite: Huchi in Aiguptate kha asung uah bangmah lou a bawl in a-om ding a; athusawm uh ka hihse ding; huchi in milimte leh bumsiamte thu adong ding uhi.
english: The spirit of Egypt will fail in its midst. I will destroy its counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.

paite: Aigupta mite heutu tatsetak khut ah ka pekhe ding a; huchi in kumpipa hangsan in atung uah vai ahawmta ding, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Tuipi tuite akang ding ua, luite luangmang in akangtatta ding.
english: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.

paite: Luite anamsia ua; Aigupta gam tui luangte akiam hiaihiai ding ua, akangtat ding a; phailuangte leh tui loupate avuai khin ding uh.
english: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.

paite: Nile lui kiang a Nile lui gei mahmah a, gantatna pawnte leh Nile lui kiang a thil chin tengtengte ahong keu vek ding a, taihmang in a-om ding a, a-om nawn kei ding hi.
english: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

paite: Ngaman mite leng akap ding ua, Nile lui a ngakuai khaimi tengteng in a-awm uh akitum ding ua, tui a lenpi zakte athadahgawpta ding uhi.
english: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.

paite: Huai lou in leng ziza hiahsiang khoih mite leh puanngou gan mite azahlak ding uhi.
english: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.

paite: Akingakna pipen hihzan in a-om ding a, kiloh mite alungkham ding uh.
english: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.

paite: Zoan a miliante ahai ding ua, Pharaoh mipilpente lemtheihnasa lemtheihna bang lel ahong hita. Pharaoh kiang ah, mipil tapa, nidanglai kumpipate tapa ka hi, bangchidan a chi sek na hi ua?
english: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?”

paite: Na mipilte koi a om ahi ua? Amau hon hilh pah ngal uhen; Aigupta gam tung a thil tung ding, sepaihte' TOUPA sehte, thei uhen.
english: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what Yahweh of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.

paite: Zoan a vaihawm miliante mihai ahong hita ua, Memphis a vaihawm miliante khem in a-omta uh; Aigupta namte ning a suangte'n Aiguptate avakmangsakta hi.
english: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, who are the cornerstone of her tribes.

paite: TOUPA'N Aiguptate lak ah phengphitna kha a-omsakta; huchi in zukhammi aluak a ahoi doidoi bang in Aiguptate anasep chiteng uah apaikawisakta uhi.
english: Yahweh has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the midst of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.

paite: Aiguptate a ding in lutang in hiam, mei in hiam, tumnah hiang in hiam, pumpeng in hiam a sepsak theih a-om nawnta kei ding hi.
english: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Aigupta numeite bang ahi ding ua; Sepaihte' TOUPA khut sin atung ua akisin ziak in aling un alau ding uhi.
english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Yahweh of Armies, which he shakes over them.

paite: Judah gam a omte Aiguptate a ding in mulkimhuaitak ahong hita ding ua, amin uh alohna peuh uah akihta ding ua, amau tung atung ding sepaihte' TOUPA thuhilhna ziak in.
english: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of Yahweh of Armies, which he determines against it.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Kanaante pau a pau leh sepaihte' TOUPA kiang ah kichiamna thuchiam sekte, Aigupta gamsung ah kho nga a-om ding a; khat tuh Ni Khopi achi ding uhi.
english: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

paite: Huai ni chiang in Aigupta laitak ah TOUPA a ding in maitam a-om ding a, agamgi ah TOUPA a ding in suangphuh a-om ding hi.
english: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.

paite: Huai Aigupta gam a sepaihte' TOUPA a ding in chiamtehna leh theihna ahi ding; nuaisiahte ziak in TOUPA asam ding uhi, huchi in ama'n hondampa leh humbitpa asawl ding a, ama'n amaute ahunkhe ding hi.
english: It will be for a sign and for a witness to Yahweh of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to Yahweh because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA tuh Aiguptate theih ahita ding a, Aigupta mite'n huai ni chiang in TOUPA atheita ding uh; ahi, kithoihna leh thilpiak in abe ding ua, TOUPA kiang ah thu achiam ding ua, atangtun lai ding uhi.
english: Yahweh will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know Yahweh in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to Yahweh, and will perform it.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Aiguptate avo ding a, avo ding a, ahihdam lai ding; huchi in TOUPA kiang ah akik nawn ding ua, ama'n angetnate za in amaute ahihdam ding hi.
english: Yahweh will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to Yahweh, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Aigupta gam a kipan in Assuria gam pha in lamlian a-om ding a; huchi in Assuria mite Aigupta gam ah ahoh ding uh; Aigupta leng Assuria gam ah ahoh ding uh. Aigupta mite'n Assuria mite toh Pathian abekhawmta ding uhi.
english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Israelte Aiguptate leh Assuriate toh athumna ahi ding ua, lei laizangtak ah vualzawlna ahi ding uh.
english: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, ka mi Aiguptate leh ka khutsuak Assuriate leh ka goutan Israelte vualzawl in om uhen, chi in avualzawl hi.
english: because Yahweh of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”

paite: Amoz tapa Isai in Judah leh Jerusalem tungtang thu amuh:
english: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

paite: Ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA' inn omna tang tuh tang lian tungte ah hihkip in a-om ding a, mual neu chikchikte tung ah leng tawisan in a-om ding; huai ah nam chihte ahoh ding uhi.
english: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of Yahweh’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be raised above the hills; and all nations shall flow to it.

paite: Huan chi tampite ahoh ding ua, "Hong pai unla, TOUPA tang ah, Jakob' Pathian inn ah, i hohtou ding uh; ama'n alampite tanchinte ahon sinsak ding a, alampite ah i pai ding," achi ding uh. Zion a kipan in dan thu ahong pawt ding a, Jerusalem a pan TOUPA thu ahong pawt ding hi.
english: Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion the law shall go forth, and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in ama'n namte lak ah vai ahawm ding a, chi tampitak leng ataihilh ding; atemsaute uh leilehna mukzum ding in asek ding uh; namdang in namdang tung ah namsau alikta kei ding a, kidoudan leng asin kei ding uhi.
english: He will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

paite: Jakob inkuanpihte aw, hong pai un TOUPA vak ah i khosa ding uh.
english: House of Jacob, come, and let us walk in the light of Yahweh.

paite: Suahlam a kipan dan hong pawtta a, ana dim ua, Philistiate bang a aisan siamte ahih ua, gamdang mite tate toh khut akilet ziak un, na mi, Jakob inkuanpihte na paisanta hi.
english: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob, because they are filled from the east, with those who practice divination like the Philistines, and they clasp hands with the children of foreigners.

paite: Agam uh dangka leh dangka-eng in adim a, asumte uh lah sim seng vual ahi kei; agam uh sakol in adim a, akangtalaite uh lah sim seng vual ahi kei hi.
english: Their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures. Their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

paite: Agam uh milim in adim a; akhut ua asepkhiak uh, akhutzungte ua abawl uh, abesek uhi.
english: Their land also is full of idols. They worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

paite: Mineute hihniam in a-om ua, miliante leng niamsak in a-om uh; huaiziak in amau ngaidam ke'n.
english: Man is brought low, and mankind is humbled; therefore don’t forgive them.

paite: TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan suangpi ah lut unla, leivui ah kibu un.
english: Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.

paite: Mihing kideihnate hihniam in a-om ding a, mite kisaktheihna niamsak in a-om ding, huai ni in TOUPA kia tawisan in a-om ding hi.
english: The lofty looks of man will be brought low, the haughtiness of men will be bowed down, and Yahweh alone will be exalted in that day.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA ni lah kingaisang leh kisathei tengteng tung ah leh tawisang a om tengteng tung a om ding ahi ngal a; huchi in niamsak in a-om ding uh.
english: For there will be a day of Yahweh of Armies for all that is proud and haughty, and for all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low:

paite: Lebanon tang a sidar sing sang pipite leh tawisang a om tengteng tung ah, Bashan gam a tosaw tengteng tung ah,
english: For all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, for all the oaks of Bashan,

paite: tang lian sang pipite tung ah, tang neu tawisang a om tengteng tung ah,
english: For all the high mountains, for all the hills that are lifted up,

paite: insang sang pipite tung ah, kulhbaang tengteng tung ah,
english: For every lofty tower, for every fortified wall,

paite: Tarshish long lian tengteng tung ah, thil lim deihhuai tengteng tung ah leng ahong om ding hi.
english: For all the ships of Tarshish, and for all pleasant imagery.

paite: Mihing kideihnate hihniam in a-om ding a, mite kisaktheihna niamsak in a-om ding. Huai ni in TOUPA kia tawisang in a-om ding.
english: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be exalted in that day.

paite: Milimte amang vengveng ding hi.
english: The idols shall utterly pass away.

paite: Huan lei nak pipi a lingsak ding a athoh hun chiang in, TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan in mite suangpi hawmte leh lei kohawmte ah alut ding uhi.
english: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

paite: Huai ni in mite'n adangka milimte uleh adangka-eng milimte uh, biak ding a abawlsak uh, buite leh bakte kiang ah apai ding uh.
english: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for themselves to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

paite: Lei nak pipi a lingsak ding a athoh hun chiang in, TOUPA kihtakhuaina a kipan leh akilawmna thupina a kipan in, suangpi hawmte leh kawl suangpi hawmte ah alut ding uhi.
english: To go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty, when he arises to shake the earth mightily.

paite: Anak vang ua hu om mihing muan tawpsanta un; bang lam ah ahia muantak ahih mahmah uh?
english: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?

paite: Assuria kumpipa Sargon sawl Tartan Ashdod ah ahong a, Ashdod khua asual a, alak kum in;
english: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

paite: TOUPA'N Amoz tapa Isai kam in, "Kuan inla, na kawng a sai-ip puan phel inla, na khe a na khedap koih in," chi in agen hi. Huchi in huchibang in ahih a, vuaktang leh khevuak in apaipai hi.
english: at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your shoes from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N, "Ka sikha Isai Aiguptate tung ah leh Ethiopiate tung ah chiamtehna leh thillamdang ding a kum thum sung vuaktang leh khevuak a apai bang in,
english: Yahweh said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Aigupta matte leh Ethiopia salte, aneu leh alian in, vuaktang leh khevuak in leh taw dawk in Aiguptate zahlakna ding in apimang ding.
english: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

paite: Huchi in alamet pen uh Ethiopiate leh athupina pen uh Aiguptate ziak in mangbangtak leh zahlaktak in a-omta ding uhi.
english: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

paite: Huchi in huai ni chiang in hiai tuipi gei a mi in, 'Ngai in, i lamet pen, Assuria kumpipa lak a hon humbit ding a, ahon panpihpa ding a i taina uh lah hichi ahita a, eite bangchi in i suakta ding ua? achi ding uh," " achi hi.
english: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”

paite: Tuipi gamdai puakgik. Sim gam a pingpei apaisuak bang in gamdai a kipan in, gam lauhuaipi a kipan in ahong hi.
english: The burden of the wilderness of the sea. As whirlwinds in the South sweep through, it comes from the wilderness, from an awesome land.

paite: Kilakna thu khauhtak ka kiang ah theihsak ahita; lepchiahtak a hihmi in lepchiahtak in ahih a, lokmi in alok hi. Elamte aw, paitou un, Mediate aw, umbichilh un; athumna tengteng uh ka daisakta hi.
english: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.

paite: Huaiziak in ka kawng natna thupitak in adim a, numei nauvei natna bang a natna in ahon manta; bil a za thei lou khop in na ka thuak a; kho mu thei lou khop in ka mangbang hi.
english: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have taken hold on me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I so am dismayed that I can’t see.

paite: Ka lungtang aha huaihuai a, thil mulkimhuaitak in ahon hihlau a; nitak ninem ka na ngaklah sek, kei a ding in linna ahong suakta.
english: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.

paite: Dohkan abawlkhol ua, galvengmi avengsak ua, ne in adawn ua; miliante aw, thou unla, lum sathau nuh un.
english: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!

paite: Toupa'n ka kiang ah huchi in agen hi, "Kuan inla, galvengmi vengsak in, ama'n athil muh gen hen;
english: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.

paite: Sepaih apawlte, sakol tungtuang akopkop a paite sabiltung pawlte, sangawngsau pawlte, amuh chiang in pilvangtak in angaikhe kilkel ding," chi in.
english: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”

paite: Huan amah humpinelkai bang in akikou a, "TOUPA aw, sun in galven buk tung ah ka dingh a, zankhua in ka venna ah na hon omsak gige a;
english: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.

paite: ngai in, hiai lai ah mihing pawl, sakol tungtuang akopkop a pai ahong uh," chi in. Amah mah in, "Babilon apukta, apukta, amilim bawltawmte tengteng uh lei ah hihzan in a-omta," chi in adawng hi.
english: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.

paite: Aw ka buh vuaksa, ka phual a buh; sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian a kipan a ka zak na kiang ua pulak ka hi.
english: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.

paite: Dumah puakgik. Mi'n Seir tang a kipan in ahon sam ua, "Galvengpa zan bangchi ahita a? Galvengpa, zan bangchi ahita a?" chi in.
english: The burden of Dumah. One calls to me out of Seir, “Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?”

paite: Galvengpa'n, "Zingsang hi ding ahita, zan leng; na dot nop uleh dong un; kihei nawn unla, hong pai un,” achi hi.
english: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”

paite: Arabia gam tung a puakgik. Dedante khualzin pawlchihte aw, Arabia gam a gamnuai ah na giak ding uh.
english: The burden on Arabia. In the forest in Arabia you will lodge, you caravans of Dedanites.

paite: Dangtak kiang ah tui ahon tawi ding ua, Tema gam a omte'n a-an un taimangte ana dawn uhi.
english: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.

paite: Amau lah namsaute a kipan, namsau dohsa a kipan leh thalpeu laisa a kipan leh kidouna thupitak a kipan ataimang uhi.
english: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.

paite: Toupa'n lah huchi in ka kiang ah achi ngal a, "Kilohmi kum sim a kum khat sung in Kedarte thupina tengteng amang khin ding hi.
english: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,

paite: Thalkapmi, Kedar suante lak a mihattak omsunte, tawmchik ahi ding uh; TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, huai agenta hi," chi in.
english: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for Yahweh, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”

paite: Mengmuhna Phaizang puakgik Bang na chi ua amai, intung a na kaltouh vek uh?
english: The burden of the valley of vision. What ails you now, that you have all gone up to the housetops?

paite: Aw kikou husa a dim, khopi chiak vengvung, kho kipaktak, na sung a athahte uh namsau a thah ahi kei ua, kidouna a si leng ahi sam kei uh.
english: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

paite: Na vaihawmmi tengteng ataimang chiat ua, thalkap mite gak in a-om ua, gamlapi a kipan a hong taimangte.
english: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n, "Hon en lou in lehlam en un, nakpi in ka kap ding; ka mite tanu gallak a alak thu uah hon nem vanglak dah un," ka chi hi.
english: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

paite: Toupa, sepaihte' PATHIAN a kipan in mengmuhna phaizang ah buaina, sikdenna leh mangbatna ni lah ahi ngal a; kulhpi baang hihsiatna leh tangte sapna.
english: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”

paite: Huchi in Elamte'n thalbawm atawi ua, mihing tuanna kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite toh; Kir in lum alakhia hi.
english: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, na phaizang hoihpente lah kangtalai in adimta a, sakol tungtuang mite lah kulh kongkhak bul ah akiphu noinoi uh. Huan Judahte khuhna alamang hi.
english: It happened that your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

paite: Judahte khuhna alamangta. Huchi in huai ni in gammang inn a galthuamna lam na enta uhi.
english: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

paite: David khopi kulhpi siatnate leng na en ua, atam chih na thei uh; huchi in dil khangnungzaw tuite na luangkhawmsak uhi.
english: You saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.

paite: Jerusalem innte na sim ua, kulhpi bang bawlhoihna ding in innte na phel uhi.
english: You numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.

paite: Dil luitui omna ding in kulhpi nih kikal ah tui chinkhawmna na bawl ua; himahleh huai hihmi lam na en kei ua, nidanglai a ana bawlpa na limsak het kei uhi.
english: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who purposed it long ago.

paite: Huai ni in Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, kap ding leh awm kitum ding leh lu giausak ding leh sai-ip puan teng ding in asam a;
english: In that day, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, called to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth:

paite: himahleh, ngai in, nopna leh kipahnate, bawng thahna leh belam thahnate, sa nekna leh uain dawnnate a-om zawta a, ne ni, dawn ni, zingchiang a si ding i hi ngal ua, achi uhi.
english: and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”

paite: Huchi in sepaihte' TOUPA tuh ka bil ah akilak a, "Pel lou in hiai khelhna na sih masiah uh na lak uah silsiang ahita kei ding, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: Yahweh of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N, hichi in achi, "Kuan inla, hiai sumkempa kiang ah, Shebna, inn tung a heutu a om kiang ngeingei ah, hoh in.
english: Thus says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

paite: Akiang ah huchi in gen in: Hiai a bang hih na hia? Hiai ah kua na nei a, hiai a han na khuak vial? Amah a ding in sangpi a ahan akhuak a, amah a dia suangpi a omna abawl vial!
english: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA'N nang apaih in ahon pai ek ding, mihat in apaih bang in; ahi, atun in nang ahon tun ding hi.
english: Behold, Yahweh will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

paite: Pel lou in ama'n nang lum bang in ahon pei ding a, gam zapi ah ahon vawklut ding a; huai ah na si ding a, huai lai mah ah, nang, na pu insung zahlaksakpa, na thupina kangtalaite a-om ding hi.
english: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you shame of your lord’s house.

paite: Na nasepna a kipan ka hon delhkhe ding a, ama'n heutu na hihna a kipan ahon kaikhesuk ding hi.
english: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.

paite: "Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, ka sikha Eliakim, Hilkiah tapa ka sam ding a; amah na puanaktual ka silhsak ding a,
english: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,

paite: na kawnggak in ka hihhat ding a na vaihawmna amah khut ah ka kemsak ding. Huchi in Jerusalem a omte a ding in leh Judah inkuanpihte a ding in pa ahi ding.
english: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

paite: Huan David inkuanpihte chabi aliangzang ah ka koih ding a; ama'n ahong ding a, kuamah in akhak kei ding uh; akhak ding a kuamah in ahong kei ding uh.
english: I will lay the key of the house of David on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.

paite: Amah kilhna mun kiptak a akilh ngiungeu bang un, ka hihkip ngiungeu ding a; huchi in amah apa inkuanpihte a ding in laltutphah thupi mahmah ahi ding hi.
english: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

paite: "Amah ah apa inkuanpihte thupina tengteng abang vek ding ua, atate leh asuante, tui-um belsuan neu chiteng, belhbu tui-um belsuan a kipan tui koihna tui-um belsuan tengteng tan in.
english: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.

paite: Huai ni in kilhna, mun kiptak a kilh ngiungeu a om in anangzou kei ding a; satkhiak a om in, aketa ding a, atung a thil gik om lah hihmanthat in a-omta ding a; TOUPA'N huai lah agenta ngal a, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi," chi in.
english: “In that day,” says Yahweh of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down, and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for Yahweh has spoken it.”

paite: Tura kho puakgik. Tarshish longpite aw, mau tuaituai un; innte om lou khop leh lutna ding om lou khop a hihsiat in a-omta hi; huai lah Kittim gam a kipan in akiang uah hihlat in a-om hi.
english: The burden of Tyre. Howl, you ships of Tarshish! For it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in. From the land of Kittim it is revealed to them.

paite: Tuikulh a omte aw, dai sipsip un; Sidon kho sumsin tuipi a paite'n ahon kiningchinsak uh.
english: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

paite: Shihor a pan buhchi tuipite tung ah hon pua a, Nile lui a buh, apunna hi a, namte sumsinna mun ahi hi.
english: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.

paite: Sidon aw, zum in; tuipi kulhpi in thu agenta ngal a, "Nau ka vei ngei kei a, ka nei ngei sam kei, tangval lah ka vak ngei sam kei a, nungak leng ka khangliansak ngei sam kei hi,” chi in.
english: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor brought forth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”

paite: Thuthang Aigupta gam atun hun chiang in Tura thuthang anak vei mahmah ding uhi.
english: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.

paite: Tarshish ah va hoh unla; Tuikulh a omte aw, mau tuaituai un.
english: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!

paite: Hiai maw na kho kipak uh, upat a upa, akhe in gamlapi a om ding a api sek?
english: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?

paite: Lallukhu khusaktu khua Tura tung ah kua'n ahia hiai tung ding a sep? Huai lai a sumsin mite lah miliante ahi ua, huai lai a sumsin mite lah lei a mizahtakhuaite ahi uhi.
english: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honorable of the earth?

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, thupina tengteng kisaktheihna nawngkaisak ding leh lei a mizahtakhuai tengteng muhsithuai a omsak ding in asep hi.
english: Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

paite: Tarshish tanu aw, Nile lui bang in na gam ah luanglet in; na kawnggakna himhim lah a-omta kei hi.
english: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.

paite: Tuipi tung ah akhut azak a, gamte alingsak a; TOUPA'N Kanaan gam tungtang ah thu apia a, akulhte hihse ding in.
english: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. Yahweh has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.

paite: Ama'n, "Sidon tanu nungak aw, mi nuaisiah, nuam na sa nawn kei ding; thou inla, Kittim gam ah galkah in; huai ah leng khawlna himhim na mu tuan kei ding hi," achi hi.
english: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”

paite: En in, Kaldaite gam; hiai mite a-omta kei uh; Assuria mi in gamdai a gamsate a ding in asepta hi; a-insangte uh alam ua, huai a inpite ahihmang ua, inn sia in abawlta.
english: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people was not. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.

paite: Tarshish longpite aw, mau tuaituai un; na kulhte uh hihsiat in a-omta hi.
english: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, Tura khua, kumpipa khat kum sim a, kum sawmsagih sung mangngilh in a-om ding; kum sawmsagih abei nung in kizuak la a agen bang un Tura kho tung ah ahong tung ding.
english: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.

paite: Nang kizuak mite mangngilhsa nung, kaihging la inla, kho kim ah vak in, kaihging kai inla, theih a na om nawn theihna ding in la tampi sa in.
english: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.

paite: Huan kum sawmsagih abei nung in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N Tura apha ding a, huchi in huai minu aloh delh in a-om nawn ding a, leitung a khovel lalgam tengteng lak ah kizuak in a-om ding.
english: It will happen after the end of seventy years that Yahweh will visit Tyre, and she shall return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.

paite: Asum muhkhiak leh aloh TOUPA a ding in siangthou ahi ding; huai lah kholkhawm in hiam, koihkhawm in hiam a-om kei ding a, asum muhkhiak TOUPA ma a omte a ding in ahi ding a, niang-le-tai a anek ding uleh, puansilh thupitak aneihtheihna ding uh ahi.
english: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before Yahweh, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA' lei a-awngsak in asesak ding a, alumlet ding a, a-omte adalhsak ding hi.
english: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

paite: Huan vantang tung a om bang in siampu tung ah leng a-om ding; sikhapa tung a om bang in apu tung ah leng a-om ding; sikhanu tung a om bang in api tung ah leng a-om ding; aleimi tung a om bang in, akhawngmi tung ah leng a-om ding; leitawisakmi tung a om bang in, leitawimi tung ah leng a-om ding; apung delh a leitawisakmi tung a om bang in, akiang a apung pemi tung ah leng a-om ding.
english: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.

paite: Leitung awnsak keuhkeuh in leh hihsiat dimdem in a-om ding; TOUPA'N achita hi.
english: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.

paite: Leitung akap in atul a, khovel abah in atul a, leitung a mi tungnungte abah uhi.
english: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.

paite: A-om mite nuai ah leitung abuah khinta; dante ah atalek ua, thupiakte hihlamdang a, tangtawn thukhun a atatlek ziak un.
english: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

paite: Huaiziak in hamsiat in leitung ane khin a, a-om mite lah siam louh tansak in a-omta uh; huaiziak in lei a om mite lah akanglum ua, mi tawmchik kia a-om lai uh.
english: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

paite: Uain thak akap a, grepgui abah a, lungtang nuamte tengteng amau uhi.
english: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.

paite: Khuangtate kipahna adai a, kaihging nuamsa ging adaita.
english: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.

paite: Lasa kawm in uain adawn kei ding uh; adawn mite a ding in zu akha mahmah ding.
english: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

paite: Buaina khopi chipsak in a-omta; kuamah alutlouhna ding un inn chih khak in a-omta.
english: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

paite: Uain ziak in kongzingte ah kah husa a-om a; nopna tengteng mialsak in a-om a, hiai gam nopna amangta.
english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.

paite: Khopi ah siatna nutsiat in a-om a, akulh kongkhak vuaksiat in a-omta.
english: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

paite: Lei laitak ah michih lak ah huchi in a-om ding hi, olive sing vuak nung a gah a-om lai bang in leh grep loh nung a maih khak grep loh ding a-om lai bang in.
english: For it will be so in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

paite: Huaite'n a-aw uh asuah ding ua, akikou ding uh; TOUPA thupina ziak in tuipi a kipan in ngaihtak in akikou ding uh.
english: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA tuh Suahlam ah pahtawi un. TOUPA, Israel' Pathian min mahmah, tuipi tuikulh gamte ah pahtawi un.
english: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!

paite: Kawlmong tawp a lasak i za, Midiktatte kiang ah thupina om hen, chih la. Himahleh, ke'n bel, "Ka gawng huaihuai a, ka gawng huaihuai a, ka tung agik hi! Lepchiahtak a gamta mite'n lepchiahtak in thil ahih ua; ahi, lepchiahtak a gamta mite'n lepchiahtak in ahih uhi, ka chi hi.
english: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.

paite: Leitung a tengte aw, lauhuainate, kokhukte, thangte na tung ah a-om hi.
english: Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabitant the earth.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahi ding a, lauhuai husa a kipan a taipa kokhuk ah ake ding a; kokhuk sung a kipan a pawtkhetoumi thang ah a-awk ding; tunglam a tohlette lah hon in a-om ngal a, lei kingaknate aling hi.
english: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the midst of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

paite: Leitung akitamgawp vek a, leitung hihman in a-om vek a, nakpitak in leitung aling hi.
english: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.

paite: Mi zukham bang in leitung ahoi dongdong ding a, biakbuk hawt bang in akihot ding; atatlekna lah atung ah giktak in a-om ding a, huchi in apuk ding a, athounawnta kei ding hi.
english: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.

paite: "Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N tunglam a mi tungnung pawl lian pipite a gawt ding, leitung a leitung kumpipate toh.
english: It shall happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

paite: Hentate kokhuk a pikhawm a a-om bang un huaite pikhawm in a-om ding ua, suangkul a khum in a-om ding uh, ni sawttak nung in gawt in a-om ding uh.
english: They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.

paite: Huai hun chiang in tung a khapi zumtak in a-om ding a, tung a nisa zahlaktak in a-om ding; sepaihte TOUPA lah Zion tang leh Jerusalem ah leh a-upate ma ah, thupitak a kumpi a om ding ahi ngal a."
english: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders will be glory.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ka Pathian na hi a; ka hon pahtawi ding, na min ka phat ding; thillamdangtak, nidanglai a vaihawmte, ginomtak leh thutak in na hih ngal a.
