english: Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.

paite: Khopite leivum in na suaksak a; akulhte uh leng na hihsia hi; gamdang mite kumpipa' inn leng khopi hi nawn lou in na bawl ngal a; chikchiang mah a lam in a-om nawnta kei ding.
english: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.

paite: Huaiziak in mihat mahmahte'n ahon pahtawi ding ua, nam kihtakhuai mahmah khopi in ahon kihta ding uhi.
english: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.

paite: Mikihtakhuaite hu huihpi in baang asawn ok-ok lai bang a ahong om chiang in, nang zaw migenthei a ding in bukna, tagah mangbang lai a ding in bukna, huihpi lak a kihumbitna, nisa liahna na hi ngal a.
english: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.

paite: Mun keu a kholum na daihsak zel bang in, gamdang mite husa na daisak hi; kholum meiliah a daihsak a a-om bang in, milauhuaite thawm daihsak ahi ding.
english: As the heat in a dry place will you bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.

paite: Huan hiai tang ah sepaihte' TOUPA'N michih a ding in thil thaute, uain todat toh kidiah, thil thau mahmah guhngek a dim, uain todat toh kidiah hoihtak a khitsiang in ankuang alui ding hi.
english: In this mountain, Yahweh of Armies will make all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of choice wines, of fat things full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.

paite: Huan khuhna mi tengteng tung a khiak, puanzak nam chih tung a kizak, hiai tang ah ahihse ding hi.
english: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

paite: Sihna avalh denta, Toupa PATHIAN in mi tengteng mai a kipan khitui anulsiang ding a; amite minsiatna lah leitung luah tengteng a kipan in alamang ding; TOUPA'N huai achita hi.
english: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord Yahweh will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for Yahweh has spoken it.

paite: Huai ni in, “Ngai un, hiai i Pathian ahi; amah i ngakngak ua, huchi in ahon hondam ding; hiai TOUPA ahi; amah i ngakngak ua; ahotdamna ah i kipak in i nuam ding uh," achi ding uhi.
english: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is Yahweh! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”

paite: Hiai tang ah TOUPA khut a kinga ding a, Moab, buhpawl ek kua a sikden a a-om sek bang in, amah mun ah sikden a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: For in this mountain the hand of Yahweh will rest. Moab will be trodden down in his place, even like straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

paite: Huchi in tuiliaumi in liau ding a tui akhuat bang in, huai lak ah akhut azakkhe ding a; akisaktheihna lah akhut lepchiahna toh in TOUPA'N akoihniam ding.
english: He will spread out his hands in its midst, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.

paite: Huan na kulhbaangte insang kulhpi hihchim in, akoihniam a, lei ah leivui pha hial in apuksakta hi.
english: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Judahte gam ah hiai la asa ding uh. Khopi kiptak i nei ua; ama'n hotdamna kulhbaangte leh kulhpite a ding in asep ding hi.
english: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and bulwarks.

paite: Nam diktat thutak zui nam a luttheihna ding in kulh kongkhakte hong un.
english: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.

paite: Na tung a lungsim ngami, nangmah ahon muan ziak in, muanna kim in na kem ding.
english: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.

paite: TOUPA tangtawn in muang un; TOUPA, Jehovah ah lah tangtawn suangpi a-om ngal a.
english: Trust in Yahweh forever; for in Yah, Yahweh, is an everlasting Rock.

paite: Ama'n sangpi a omte ahihniam a khopi sangpi mah; akoihniam a, lei pha in akoihniam a, leivui pha hial in apuksak hi.
english: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city. He lays it low. He lays it low even to the ground. He brings it even to the dust.

paite: Khe in asikden ding; gentheite khe leh tagahte kalsuan in.
english: The foot shall tread it down; Even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.”

paite: Midiktat lampi lah dikna ahi a; nang lungtang diktat pu in midiktat lampi na hihmam sek a.
english: The way of the just is uprightness. You who are upright make the path of the righteous level.

paite: Ahi, TOUPA aw, na vaihawmna lampi ah ka hon ngak uhi; kou hinna deih zaw na min loh leh nangmah theihgigena ahi.
english: Yes, in the way of your judgments, Yahweh, have we waited for you. Your name and your renown are the desire of our soul.

paite: Zan chiang in ka hinna in nangmah ahon ngai a; ahi, zingkhang in ka sung a ka kha om in ka hon zong ding hi; na vaihawmnate leitung a ahong om chiang in khovel a omte'n diktatna lah asin zel ngal ua.
english: With my soul have I desired you in the night. Yes, with my spirit within me will I seek you earnestly; for when your judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

paite: Mithulim lou deihsak in om mahleh, diktatna asin tuan sam kei ding; dikna gam ah dikloutak in ahih ding hi. TOUPA thupina amu tuan kei ding.
english: Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal wrongfully, and will not see Yahweh’s majesty.

paite: TOUPA, na khut zak in a-om a, himahleh amau amu tuan kei ua; himahleh mite a dia na phatuamngaihna amu ding ua, azum ding uh; ahi, nang hon doute mei in akangmang ding hi.
english: Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed. Yes, fire will consume your adversaries.

paite: TOUPA nang lemna na hon sehsak ding; nang ka nasep tengteng uh na hon sepsak hi.
english: Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also worked all our works for us.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw, nang kia hilou in kumpipa dangte'n leng ka tung uah thu anei khinta ua, himahleh na min kia ka louta ding uh.
english: Yahweh our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us, but by you only will we make mention of your name.

paite: Amau lah asita uh a, ahing nawn kei ding uh; amangta ua, athounawn kei ding uh; huaiziak in nang amaute gawt in na hihsia a, atheihgigena teng uh leng na hihmangta hi.
english: The dead shall not live. The deceased shall not rise. Therefore have you visited and destroyed them, and caused all memory of them to perish.

paite: Hiai nam na pungsakta a, TOUPA aw, hiai nam na pungsak a; nang pahtawi in na omta; hiai gam a gamgite na hihlian hi.
english: You have increased the nation, O Yahweh. You have increased the nation! You are glorified! You have enlarged all the borders of the land.

paite: TOUPA, adah lai un ahon zong ua, amau na thunun chiang in athum zel uhi.
english: Yahweh, in trouble they have visited you. They poured out a prayer when your chastening was on them.

paite: Numei naupai, neih hun naita bang in; TOUPA aw, kou na ma ah ka om uhi.
english: Like as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery, is in pain and cries out in her pangs; so we have been before you, Yahweh.

paite: Nau ka pai ua, ka na ua, huih bang lel ka nei uh; lei ah lah tatkhiakna lam himhim ka ngah kei ua; khovel a omte lah apuk sam kei uhi.
english: We have been with child. We have been in pain. We gave birth, it seems, only to wind. We have not worked any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

paite: Na misite ahing nawn ding ua; ka misi luang toh athounawn ding uh. Leivui a omte aw, halh unla, nuamtak in la sa un; na daituite khovak daitui bang ahi a, lei in misite apaikhe ding hi, chih.
english: Your dead shall live. My dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, you who dwell in the dust; for your dew is like the dew of herbs, and the earth will cast forth the dead.

paite: Kisa un, ka mite aw, na dantan sungte ah lut unla, na kongkhakte uh kikhakkhum un; lung hihlouhna aven masiah sawt lou sung kibu un.
english: Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA, agitlouhna ziak ua lei a omte gawt ding in a-omna a kipan ahong pawtkhe ding a; lei mah in asisan ahihlang dia, ami athahte uh akhuhta kei ding hi.
english: For, behold, Yahweh comes forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA'N, anamsau hoihtak a hiam, lianpi, muanhuaitak in, leviathan gulpi hattak leh leviathan gulpi kivial ngeingoi agawt ding a, tuipi a dragon om leng athat ding hi.
english: In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.

paite: Huai ni chiang in, uain grephuan khat, huai pahtawi in la sa un.
english: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!

paite: Kei TOUPA lah avengpa ka hi a; mitphiat kal teng in tui ka buak ding a, kuamah in akhoihlouhna ding un sun leh zan in ka veng ding.
english: I, Yahweh, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.

paite: Kei ah hehna a-om kei hi; loulingnei leh khaulingneite'n hon dou in hon sual le u aw! Amau sual ding in ka kuan ding a, mun khat ah ka halkhawm ding hi.
english: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.

paite: Ahihkeileh, hon kileppihna ding in ka hatna len hen; ahi, hon kileppih hen.
english: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”

paite: Hun hong tung ding ah Jakobte'n zung akha ding ua; Israelte'n zung akha ding ua; Israelte apakmum un apakpalh ding uh; huchi in leitung gah in adimsak ding uhi.
english: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

paite: Amah vote avuak bang in amah avo sam a hia? Ahihkeileh, amah thatte thahna bang in amah thah in a-om a hia?
english: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?

paite: Amah na paimangsak lai in ahun lel in amah na sel a; suahlam huih nun ni in ahu thupitak in amah amutlengta hi.
english: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai in Jakobte thulimlouhna silsiang ahi ding a, hiai akhelhna uh paimangpihna gah ngen ahi; Asherim hiam, gimlim maitamte hiam ding nawn lou ding khop in maitam suang tengteng suangpak den khap bang in abawl uhi.
english: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherim and the incense altars shall rise no more.

paite: Khua kulhpi nei lah alungzuang a, omna nutsiat leh paisan, gamdai bang ahi; huai ah bawngnou ata ding a, huai lai mah ah akual ding a, aselte ane ding.
english: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.

paite: Ahiangte lah avuai chiang un khiah in a-om ding a; numeite ahong pai ding ua ahal ding uh; amau lah theihtheihna himhim neiloumi ahi ngal ua; huaiziak in amaute bawlpa'n atung uah zahngaihna anei kei ding a, amaute sutuahpa'n amaute deihsakna himhim anei kei ding hi.
english: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N, Euphrates Luipi akuang dim a luang zoizoi a kipan in, Aigupta luita pha in, agah asatkhe ding a, huchi in Israel suante aw, khatkhat a pikhawm in na om ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day, that Yahweh will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, pengkul lianpi amut ding ua; Assuria gam a mangthang dekdekte leh Aigupta gam a delhkhiak a omte ahong pai ding ua; Jerusalem a tang siangthou ah TOUPA abe ding uhi.
english: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship Yahweh in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

paite: Ephraimte azukhamhatte kisaktheihna lallukhu tung leh akilawmna uh thupi pak vul lel laitak, uain thazoh a omte phaizang hausatak lutang tung a omte atung uh agik hi!
english: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA'N mihat thilhihtheitak anei a; ama'n, gial thupitak ke phuakphuak, huihpi thilhihse lemlum bang leh tui lian thupi let zuazua bang mai in, lei ah apai ek ding.
english: Behold, the Lord has a mighty and strong one. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.

paite: Ephraimte zukhamhatte kisaktheihna lallukhu lah sikden in a-om ding a;
english: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.

paite: akilawmna uh thupi pak vul laitak, phaizang hausatak lutang tung a om, nipi ma a theipi min masapen, a-enmi in amuh a, akhut a a-omtak a anek khit sek bang ahi ding hi.
english: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer; which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.

paite: Huai ni chiang in sepaihte' TOUPA tuh, thupina lallukhu leh kilawmna lukhute, amikhosuaksunte a ding in ahi ding;
english: In that day, Yahweh of Armies will become a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the residue of his people;

paite: Vaihawm dia tu a ding in vaihawmna khate, kulh kongkhak bul a hon sualte nangkik mite a ding in hatna ahi ding.
english: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.

paite: Himahleh huaite leng uain ziak in akipekpek ua, zu ziak in ahoihoi ua; siampute leh zawlneite leng zu ziak in akipekpek ua, uain valh khit in a-om ua, zu ziak in ahoihoi ua; kilakna thute ah akipekpek ua, vaihawmna thu ah ahoihoi uhi.
english: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.

paite: Mun siang mahmah om lou khop in dohkan tengteng lah luak leh thilnin in adim hi.
english: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.

paite: Ama'n theihna lam a kua ahia asinsak ding? Thukhah leng ama'n kua ahia atheihsak sin laitei? Nawinek tawptungte leh nawi neksak nawnlouhte ahi ding uam?
english: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

paite: Thuhilhna tung a thuhilhna, thuhilhna tung a thuhilhna chiantouh; dan tung a dan, dan tung a dan chiantouh; hiai ah tawmchik, huai ah tawmchik chih ngenta ahih ziak in.
english: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.

paite: Ahi, muk lamdang pumi zang in, pau tuam in hiai mite kiang ah thu agen zawta ding.
english: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language;

paite: Hiai lah khawlna ahi a, atawlte khawlsak un; hiai lah kihihhalhna ahi, achihte; himahleh amau angaikhe nuam kei ua.
english: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to weary”; and “This is the refreshing”; yet they would not hear.

paite: Huaiziak in apai ua, athal a apuk ua, akitapgawp ua, thang a a-awk ua, mat a a-omtheihna ding un, TOUPA thu amaute a ding in, thuzohna thu tung a thuzohna thu chiantouh, thuzohna thu tung a thuzohna thu chiantouh, dan tung a dan chiantouh; dan tung a dan chiantouh; hiai ah tawmchik huai ah tawmchik chih ngen a ahi mai ding hi.
english: Therefore the word of Yahweh will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.

paite: Huaiziak in mi muhsithatte aw, hiai mite, Jerusalem a omte, vai hawmsakte aw, TOUPA thu za un.
english: Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:

paite: Sihna toh thu i khungta, Sheol ah thu i kichiamta; vuakna tui lian a luansuak hun chiang in lei pha in zaw aluang kei ding; zuauthute i kihumbitna ding in i zang ua, zuau nuai ah lah i buta ngal ua, na chih ziak un.
english: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. are we in agreement. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi ding, "Ngai in, suang, suang ettelsa, akil a suang manphatak phumkip mahmah, Zion ah suangphum ding in ka lem hi; agingtami zaw akin kei ding.
english: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.

paite: "Vaihawmna diktat a tansakna khau ding in ka zang ding a, diktatna lah a-ulum khai ding in ka zang ding a, gial in kihumbitna zuauthute aphiatmang vek ding a, tuite'n lah bukna atum ding.
english: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.

paite: Huan sihna toh na thukhun uh akiphel ding a, Sheol toh na chiam uh leng apiching kei ding, vuakna tui lian aluansuak hun chiang in. Huai hun chiang in sikden in na om ding uhi.
english: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.

paite: Aluansuak peuhmah chiang in nou ahon la zel dia; zingsang teng, sun leh zan in, aluangsuak ding a; thukhah omdan theihsiam lah thil mulkimhuai ngen ahi ding," chi in.
english: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”

paite: Lupna lah khekhuanna ding in atom lo zen a, puanthuah lah lukhuhna ding in aneu lua hi.
english: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.

paite: Anasep, anasep lamdang aseptheihna ding leh athilhih, athilhih lamdang azuihtheihna ding in, TOUPA Perazim tang a athou bang in athou sin ngal a, Gibeon Phaizang a aheh bang in aheh sin hi.
english: For Yahweh will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.

paite: Huchi in mi muhsit chingte hi nawn kei un, huchi lou in zaw na kolbutte uh muanhuaitak in abawl kha ding uh; tawpna, tawpna tung ngei ding a seh, leitung pumpi tung a atunsak ding. Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA a kipan in ka za hi.
english: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, on the whole earth.

paite: Bildoh unla, ka aw za un; ngaikhia unla, ka thugen za un.
english: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!

paite: Leilet mi in chi thehna ding in lei tatlak lou in alet ngei ahia? Aleikhalte tatlak lou in akhenkham in ahihzan ngei a hia?
english: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?

paite: Atung a tohtam khit in mohurite athehdalh kei a hia? Zirate leng atheh kei a hia? Buhte avual in, huit buhte leng amun sehsa ah, vaibuhte leng anawlzul ah atuh sek kei a hia?
english: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?

paite: A Pathian in lah amah diktak in athuzoh in asinsak ngal a.
english: For his God instructs him in right judgment, and teaches him.

paite: Mohuri lah buhchilna khawl in achil ngei ngal kei ua, zira tung ah leng kangtalai khe atuksak ngei kei uh; mohuri zaw chiang in akhen ua, zira leng khetbuk in akhen zaw sek uhi.
english: For the dill are not threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.

paite: Tanghou bawlna buh gawizan in a-om a, ama'n tangtawn in avo kei ding a, akangtalai khe leh asakolte'n dalhsak mahleh, agawizansak ngei kei hi.
english: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.

paite: Huaite leng sepaihte' TOUPA, lemtheihna a mi lamdang mahmah leh pilna a mihoih mahmah a kipan a pawt ahi.
english: This also comes forth from Yahweh of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

paite: Ariel, Ariel, David puanin kaihna mun! Kum ah kum gawm inla; ankuangluinate hong tung nawn hen.
english: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;

paite: Huai hun chiang in Ariel ka lungzingsak ding a, huchi in suunna leh kahna a-om ding; huan amah kei a ding in Ariel bang ahi ding.
english: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth or, Ariel .

paite: Huan nangmah sual tum in na kim ah ka hon giahkhum ding a, nangmah sual ding in umsuakna insangte ka bawl ding.
english: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.

paite: Huchi in puksak in na om ding a, lei nuai a kipan in thu na gen ding a, na aw lah leivui lak ah awlawl in agingkhe ding; na aw dawi aisan siam zawl aw bang in lei nuai a kipan in apawt ding hi, na pau leivui lak a kipan in ahong pawt siausiau ding hi.
english: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.

paite: Himahleh nang hon dou mipite zaw leivui nel mahmah bang in a-om ding uh, mikihtakhuai mipite leng buhsi mangthang sekte bang in a-om ding uh; ahi, huai mitphiat kal lou in ahong om guih ding hi.
english: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N van-gingte, zinlingte, ging thupi mahmahte, pingpeite, huihpite, leh hulmang thei mei in ahong veh ding hi.
english: She will be visited by Yahweh of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.

paite: Huchi in Ariel dou nam tengteng mipite, amah leh a-insang sualmi tengteng leh amah hihlungzingte tengteng, ihmu mang bang lel ahi ding uh, zan a kilakna bang lel.
english: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.

paite: Mi gilkial in mang aneih in an ane a, himahleh akhanglou a abah lai in tui aduh lai bang ahi ding hi; Zion tang sual, nam chih leh mipite, huai bang ahi ding uhi.
english: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.

paite: Dingh kinken unla, lamdang sa un, kituam unla, mittaw in om un; akham ua, himahleh uain ziak ahi kei; ahoihoi ua, himahleh zu ziak ahi kei.
english: Pause and wonder! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.

paite: TOUPA'N ihmut limna kha na tung uah asungbua a, zawlneite na mit uh amitsisak a, na lu uh, mutheite, akhuhta ngal a.
english: For Yahweh has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep, and has closed your eyes, the prophets; and he has covered your heads, the seers.

paite: Huchi in kilakna himhim nou a ding in laibu bilhkhum bikbek bang ahita, mite'n laisiammi kiang ah, hehpih in huai sim in, chi in apia ua, ama'n, ka sim thei kei, bilhkhum bikbek ahi, achi a;
english: All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying, “Read this, please”; and he says, “I can’t, for it is sealed:”

paite: Huan laibu tuh laisiamloumi kiang ah, "Hehpih in hiai sim in, chi in apia ua, ama'n, laisiam ka hi kei," achi hi.
english: and the book is delivered to one who is not educated, saying, “Read this, please”; and he says, “I can’t read.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA, “Hiai mite'n ahong naih ua, akam un leh amuk un ahon pahtawi ua, himahleh alungtang uh kei a kipan in agamla a, ahon launa uleh mihingte thupiak min asinsak lel uh ahi.
english: The Lord said, “Because this people draws near with their mouth and with their lips to honor me, but they have removed their heart far from me, and their fear of me is a commandment of men which has been taught;

paite: Hiai mite lak ah thillamdang ka hihbehlap ding, thillamdang, thillamdang mahmah; huchi in amipilte uh pilna amang ding a, ami teite uh teina sel in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvelous work among this people, even a marvelous work and a wonder; and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.”

paite: Athusawm uh TOUPA lak a sel ding a thuktak zong mite tung agik hi! Athilhihte uh lah mial nuai ah a-om a, kua'n ahon mu dia? Kua'n ahon thei dia? achi uhi.
english: Woe to those who deeply hide their counsel from Yahweh, and whose works are in the dark, and who say, “Who sees us?” and “Who knows us?”

paite: Thilte na lumlet vek uh! Belvelpa bellei bang lel a seh in a-om sin a hia? Thil bawl in abawlpa tung ah, ama hon bawl ka hi sam a, achih? Ahihkeileh, thil suktuah a om in asutuahpa tungthu ah, theihna himhim anei kei, achih?
english: You turn things upside down! Should the potter be thought to be like clay; that the thing made should say about him who made it, “He didn’t make me”; or the thing formed say of him who formed it, “He has no understanding?”

paite: Sawt louchik nung in ahi ka hia, Lebanon lei hoihtak mun a suahsak in a-om sin a, lei hoihtak mun lah gammang a seh a a-om sin?
english: Isn’t it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will be regarded as a forest?

paite: Huai ni in nangongte'n laibu thute abil un aza ding ua, mittawte'n mial nuai leh mial lak a kipan in amu ding uhi.
english: In that day, the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and out of darkness.

paite: Thunuailutte'n leng TOUPA ah anopna uh akhangsakta ding ua, mihingte lak a gentheite Israelte Mi Siangthou ah akipakta ding uh.
english: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Milauhuai bangmah lou a bawl ahita a, misimmoh hat adaita, thulimlouhna ngaklah tengteng hihmanthat in a-omta uhi.
english: For the ruthless is brought to nothing, and the scoffer ceases, and all those who are alert to do evil are cut off—

paite: Huaite'n thu in mite thil hihkhial in abawl ua, kulh kongpi ah taihilhmi awkna ding in thang akam ua, midiktat bangmah lou in anawlkhin uhi.
english: who cause a person to be indicted by a word, and lay a snare for the arbiter in the gate, and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA, Abraham tan pen, Jakob inkote tungthu ah hichi in achi: Jakobte zaw tu in azahlakta kei ding ua, amai uh amual nawn sam kei ding.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob: “Jacob shall no longer be ashamed, neither shall his face grow pale.

paite: Ata uh, ka khutsuakte, alak ua amuh un, ka min asiangthousak zawta ding uh; ahi, Jakobte Mi Siangthou asiangthousak ding ua, Israel' Pathian lah akihta ding uhi.
english: But when he sees his children, the work of my hands, in the midst of him, they will sanctify my name. Yes, they will sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and will stand in awe of the God of Israel.

paite: Kha a vakmangte'n leng ahon theisiamta ding ua miphunhatte'n sinsak thu asinta ding uhi.
english: They also who err in spirit will come to understanding, and those who grumble will receive instruction.”

paite: Ngai dih ua, Toupa Sepaihte’ PATHIAN in Jerusalem a kipan leh Judah a kipan amuanpi uleh achiang uh, amuanpi uh an tengteng leh amuanpi uh tui tengteng, alaksak hi.
english: For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

paite: Mihat leh kidousiamte toh; vaihawmmi leh zawlnei leh aisan siam leh upate toh;
english: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

paite: sawmnga heutu leh mizahtakhuai leh lemthei mi leh khutsiam leh thugensiamte toh.
english: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

paite: Huchi in amiliante uh hi ding in naupangte ka pe ding a, naungekte'n atung uah vai ahawm ding uh.
english: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

paite: Huchi in mite nuaisiah in a-om ding ua, michih kinuaisiah in a-om ding uh, michih amau invengte toh kinuaisiah in a-om ding uh; naupang upa tung ah kisatheitak in a-om ding ua, mithulimloupi nangawn mizahtakhuai tung ah kisatheitak in a-om ding.
english: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the base against the honorable.

paite: Mi'n apa inn a-unau len in, "Nang silh-le-ten na nei a, ka vaihawmtu un om inla, hiai siatna na khut ah om heh," achih chiang in.
english: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

paite: Huai chiang in amah apau khe ding a, "Kei zaw bawlhoihtu in ka om kei ding hi; ka inn ah nek ding a-om kei a, silh-le-ten leng a-om kei; mite vaihawmpa in na hon bawl kei ding," chi in.
english: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

paite: Athupina mit vuisak ding a apau uleh athilhihte uh TOUPA dou lam ahih ziak in Jerusalem ase khin a, Judahte apuk khinta uhi.
english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Yahweh, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

paite: Amel latdan in amau ahek tawm a; akhelhna uh Sodom bangtak in alangsak ua, a-iim kei uh. Atung uh agik e! Thil hoih lou in akithuk tawm ngal ua.
english: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

paite: Midiktat thu ah ahoih ding uhi, chi un; athilhih gahte uh lah ane sin ngal ua.
english: Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.

paite: Migiloute tung agik hi! Lah ase sin ngal ua; akhut ua thilhih thukna akiang ua piak ahih ding ziak in.
english: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.

paite: Ka mite zaw, amau nuaisiahtute naupangte ahita ua, numeite'n atung uah vai ahawmta uhi. Ka mite aw, nou hon pite'n ahon pikhial ua, na paina lamte ahihse sek uhi.
english: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

paite: TOUPA genpih ding in ahong dingkhia a, mite vaihawm ding in ahong dinghta hi.
english: Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

paite: TOUPA'N a mi upate tung ah leh amau miliante tung ah vai ahawm ding: TOUPA Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Noute na hi uh grephuan negaite; na innte uah ahi mitagahte a kipan a sumlakte a-om;
english: Yahweh will enter into judgment with the elders of his people, and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The spoil of the poor is in your houses.

paite: bang achia ahia ka mite na at ua, tagahte mai na gawizan uh?" Toupa, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi hi.
english: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huai lou in TOUPA'N, "Zion tanute kisatheitak a a-om ua, dak vuauvuau leh mi en loplop in apai ua, apai un apai lohloh ua, akhete uh asuan ging thuapthuap ziak un.
english: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking to trip as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

paite: Toupa'n Zion tanute luzang ah meima khem a-omsak ding a, TOUPA'N azahmohte uh leng adawksak ding," achi hi.
english: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”

paite: Huai ni chiang in Toupa'n akizepna hoihnate uh alaksak ding a, khebulhte, len lukhute, hakkolte;
english: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

paite: bilbah kai ngiahngiahte, taute, kikhuhna puante;
english: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

paite: lutang puante, khebulh khainiangte, kawng a tente, gimlim bawmte, kikaunate;
english: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume bottles, the charms,

paite: minsawnna zungbuhte, nakbulhte;
english: the signet rings, the nose rings,

paite: ankuangluina vante, puanaktualte, puansilhte, kawlzalte;
english: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

paite: limlangte, puanmalngatte, dialte, kituamhoihna puante.
english: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

paite: Thaunamtui sik in thilmuat a-om ding; kawnggak sik in khauzen a-om ding; sam mam sik in talkolh a-om ding; puan kilawmtak sik in sai-ip puan a-om ding; melhoih sik in meikang pawn a-om ding hi.
english: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

paite: Namsau in na mite vatpaih ahi ding ua, na mihat mahmahte kidouna ah apuk ding uh.
english: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

paite: Akulh kongkhakte ah awm kitum in akap ding ua; ahawm a nutsiat ahi ding ua, lei ah atu ding hi.
english: Her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall be desolate and sit on the ground.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Ta helhatte atung uh agik hi! Huaite'n mi adong ua, kei lah hon dong kei uh, akhelhna tung ua khelhna abehlapna ding un, khuhna in akhuh ua, ka kha thu in lah akhuh tuan kei uh.
english: “Woe to the rebellious children,” says Yahweh, “who take counsel, but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my Spirit, that they may add sin to sin,

paite: Pharaoh hatna a kihatsak ding in leh Aigupta lim bel ding a ka kam dong tuan lou in Aigupta gam a paisuk tum in akuan uhi.
english: who set out to go down into Egypt, and have not asked my advice; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to take refuge in the shadow of Egypt!

paite: Huaiziak in Pharaoh hatna noute zahlakna ahita ding a, Aigupta lim na belh uh lah na maizumna uh ahita ding.
english: Therefore the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and the refuge in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

paite: Amiliante lah Zoan ah a-om ua, apalaite Hanes khua atungta ngal uhi.
english: For their princes are at Zoan, and their ambassadors have come to Hanes.

paite: Amau a dia phattuamna himhim nei lou mi, huhna hilou, phattuamna neimi leng hilou, maizumna leh minsiatna hi zawte, avek un azumpih ding uh," achi hi.
english: They shall all be ashamed because of a people that can’t profit them, that are not a help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.”

paite: Sim gam a sate puakgik, buaina leh lunglauna gam, humpinelkainu leh humpinelkaipa, guldekpak leh gul kuang lengthei pawtna, asum uh sabiltungnou tungte ah, agou uh sangawngsau nungvumte ah posak in, amau a dia phattuamna nei lou mite kiang a piak ding in, apaiton dapdap uhi.
english: The burden of the animals of the South. Through the land of trouble and anguish, of the lioness and the lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they carry their riches on the shoulders of young donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to an unprofitable people.

paite: Aigupta in lah phatuam loutak leh panna nei loutak in apanpih zel ngal a; huaiziak in ahi, amah, Rahab tu kinkennu, ka chih.
english: For Egypt helps in vain, and to no purpose; therefore have I called her Rahab who sits still.

paite: Tu in pai inla, huaite ama ua laigelhna pek ah gelh inla, laibu ah leng gelh in, tunung a tangtawn dong a ding ahihtheihna ding in.
english: Now go, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, that it may be for the time to come forever and ever.

paite: Huaite lah mihelhatte, ta zuautheite, ta TOUPA dan ngaikhe nuamloute ahi ngal ua.
english: For it is a rebellious people, lying children, children who will not hear the law of Yahweh;

paite: Mutheite kiang a, “Mu kei un," zawlneite kiang a, "Thil dikte hon hilhkhol kei un, thil nuam lam ka kiang uah gen un, khemna thu gen un, khemna thu genkhol un.
english: who tell the seers, “Don’t see!” and to the prophets, “Don’t prophesy to us right things. Tell us pleasant things. Prophesy deceits.

paite: Lampi lou ah pai un, lamsik ah pial un, Israelte Mi Siangthou ka ma ua kipan hihmang un," chi ngitngette.
english: Get out of the way. Turn aside from the path. Cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.”

paite: "Huaiziak in Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi, hiai thu na muhsit ziak un leh nuaisiahna leh phengphitna na muan ua, atung ua na kingak ziak un.
english: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel, “Because you despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and rely on it;

paite: Hiai thulimlouhna noute a ding in suangbaang sangpi se lai, chim dekdek, puak eng ong, thakhat a mitphialkal lou a segawp ding bang ahi ding hi.
english: therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes suddenly in an instant.

paite: Huchi in belvelmi bel akitap gawpsak bang un, hawi om het lou a keknen in, athemnen lak ah belpei thuk a mei lakna ding hiam tuikhuk a tui dipna ding om lou khop in, akitam nensak ding," chi in.
english: He will break it as a potter’s vessel is broken, breaking it in pieces without sparing, so that there won’t be found among the broken piece a piece good enough to take fire from the hearth, or to dip up water out of the cistern.”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN, Israelte Mi Siangthou in hichi in achi, "Kik nawn a khawl in hotdam in na om ding ua; muangtak a omna ah leh ginna omna ah na hatna uh a-om ding, chi in; himahleh nou na ut kei uhi.
english: For thus said the Lord Yahweh, the Holy One of Israel, “You will be saved in returning and rest. Your strength will be in quietness and in confidence.” You refused,

paite: Hilou e, sakol tung a tuang in i tai zozot ding uh," na chi zosop ua, huaiziak in na tai zozot ngei ding uh. "Thil hattak tung ah i tuang ding, na chi ua; huaiziak in nou hon delh ding lah hattak ahi ding uh."
english: but you said, “No, for we will flee on horses”; therefore you will flee; and, “We will ride on the swift”; therefore those who pursue you will be swift.

paite: Mi khat phawn in sangkhat ataikek ding ua; mi nga phawn in na taikek ding uh; atawp in mualvum a puankhai khai bang leh tang tung a chiamtehna om bang a nutsiat in na om ding uhi.
english: One thousand will flee at the threat of one. At the threat of five, you will flee until you are left like a beacon on the top of a mountain, and like a banner on a hill.

paite: Huaiziak in noute TOUPA'N ahon hehpih theihna ding in ahon ngak ding a, huaiziak in noute tung a zahngaihna asuahtheihna ding in pahtawi in a-om ding hi; TOUPA lah vaihawm diktatna Pathian ahi ngal a; amah ngakte tengteng in nuam asa uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh will wait, that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be exalted, that he may have mercy on you, for Yahweh is a God of justice. Blessed are all those who wait for him.

paite: Mite Jerusalem a Zion ah om ding ahi ngal ua; na kap nawn kei ding uh; na kahna husa uah ama'n ahon hehpih mahmah ding a; azaktak in ahon dawng ding hi.
english: For the people will dwell in Zion at Jerusalem. You will weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the voice of your cry. When he hears you, he will answer you.

paite: TOUPA lungkhamna tanghou leh haksatna tui hon pe mahleh, nou hon sinsak mite akibu nawn kei ding ua, na mit un nou hon sinsak mite amu zawta ding hi.
english: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your teachers won’t be hidden anymore, but your eyes will see your teachers;

paite: Huan taklam a na pial un hiam, veilam a na pial un hiam, na bil un na nunglam uah, "Hiai alampi ahi, hiai ah pai un," chi in thu azata ding hi.
english: and when you turn to the right hand, and when you turn to the left, your ears will hear a voice behind you, saying, “This is the way. Walk in it.”

paite: Na dangka uh milim bawl dangka chi a zepna leh na dangka-eng uh, milim sun dangka-eng tui a luanna na buahsak ding ua; thilnin bang in na paita ding ua, akiang ah, "Paimang in!" na chi ding uh.
english: You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”

paite: Huchi in ama'n na buhchi uh lei a na tuh ding uh a ding in vuahtui ape ding a; lei a thilpoute leng an ding in ape ding, huai lah hoihtak pungtak ahi ding; huai ni chiang in gantatna mun zapi ah na gantate uh ata ding ua,
english: He will give the rain for your seed, with which you will sow the ground; and bread of the increase of the ground will be rich and plentiful. In that day, your livestock will feed in large pastures.

paite: bawngtal leh sabengtungnou lei lette'n an chisoh, ninluahna leh phazah a hihsiangsa ane ding uh.
english: The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory provender, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

paite: Kithahna thupitak ni a galvenna singte achip ni in, tang sang teng ah leh mualvum sang teng ah luipite leh luite tui luang ahong om ding.
english: There shall be brooks and streams of water on every lofty mountain and on every high hill in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.

paite: Huai lou leng TOUPA'N amite kihehna atuam a, aliamna ma uh adamsak ni chiang in, khavak nivak pha in a-omta ding a, nisa vak amun sagih in, ni sagih vakpha in a-omta ding hi.
english: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times brighter, like the light of seven days, in the day that Yahweh binds up the fracture of his people, and heals the wound they were struck with.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA min, ahehna kuang zuazua in, meikhu sahtak a zamtou lak ah, gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai hi; amukte lung hihlouhna in adim a, alei thil katmang hat mei bang ahi.
english: Behold, the name of Yahweh comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke. His lips are full of indignation, and his tongue is as a devouring fire.

paite: Ahu lah, manna lohpi a namte sep ding in, lui ngawng chiang pha hial a akuang a let bang ahi; michih kam ah pikhelhsakna kaihgingna khau a-om ding.
english: His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction; and a bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

paite: Zan a zehtan siangthou a zeh atan lai ua la asak bang un, la asa ding ua; TOUPA tang a Israelte' Suangpi kiang tung ding a tamngai toh apai lai ua lungtang nopsakna anei bang un lungtang nopsakna leng anei ding uhi.
english: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute to come to Yahweh’s mountain, to Israel’s Rock.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N a-aw thupitak akizasakta ding a, ahehna thupitak leh thil katmang ching meikuang in, ahuihpi leh vuahpi leh gial in, akhut khakdan a-ensakta ding.
english: Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and the flame of a devouring fire, with a blast, storm, and hailstones.

paite: TOUPA aw ziak in Assuria mi, khetbuk a mi khen nakpa, kitapzansak a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: For through the voice of Yahweh the Assyrian will be dismayed. He will strike him with his rod.

paite: Amah lah chiangkhun sehsa a TOUPA'N azep peuhmah chiang in khuangtate leh kaihgingte toh azep ding a; achiang lik a kisualnate ah amau asual ding.
english: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles, brandishing weapons.

paite: Tophet khat lah tuma a na bawlkholhsa ahi ngal a; ahi, kumpipa a ding in bawlzoh siang ahi a; thutak zatak in abawl a; athil sekkhawm mei leh sing tamtak ahi a; TOUPA hu, kat luiluang bang in, akangsak zuazua hi.
english: For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. Yahweh’s breath, like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.

paite: Aigupta gam a panpihna zong ding a hohsuk a, sakolte tung muang a, atam ziak ua kangtalaite leh ahat mahmah ziak ua sakol tungtuang mite muang a Israelte Mi Siangthou lam en lou a, TOUPA leng dongloute zaw atung uh agik hi!
english: Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, and rely on horses, and trust in chariots because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very strong, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel, and they don’t seek Yahweh!

paite: Dong kei mah le uh amah leng piltak ahi, thil hoih lou ahon tungsak ding a, athute akhel nawn kei ding, thil hoih lou hih mite inkuan sual ding in athou zaw ding a, khialte panpihna dou ding in athou ding hi.
english: Yet he also is wise, and will bring disaster, and will not call back his words, but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of those who work iniquity.

paite: Aigupta mite zaw, Pathian ahi kei ua, mi leltak ahi uh; huchi in TOUPA'N akhut azak hun chiang in apanpihtu pen apai ekek ding a, apanpih pen leng apuk ding a, avek un amangthangkhawm ding uhi.
english: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When Yahweh stretches out his hand, both he who helps shall stumble, and he who is helped shall fall, and they all shall be consumed together.

paite: TOUPA'N lah huchi in ka kiang ah achi ngal a, "Humpinelkai leh humpinelkai lun lai in sa akham lai in belamchingmi tamtak amah sual ding in sapkhiak in om mah le uh, a-aw uh alau kei ding ua, abil ap ziak ua akihtak tuan louh ding bang in, sepaihte' TOUPA zaw Zion tang ah amual tung a sual ding in ahong paisuk ding hi."
english: For thus says Yahweh to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called together against him, will not be dismayed at their voice, nor abase himself for their noise, so Yahweh of Armies will come down to fight on Mount Zion and on its heights.

paite: Vasate abu tung ua alenlen bang un sepaihte' TOUPA'N Jerusalem aveng ding; veng in atankhe ding a, apaikan in ahumbit ding hi.
english: As birds hovering, so Yahweh of Armies will protect Jerusalem. He will protect and deliver it. He will pass over and preserve it.”

paite: "Israel suante aw, nakpitak a na helsansa lam uh nga nawnta un.
english: Return to him from whom you have deeply revolted, children of Israel.

paite: Huai ni in michih in amau dangka milimte, amau dangka-eng milimte, khelhna ding a amau khut a na kibawltawmte uh lah apaimang ding ua.
english: For in that day everyone shall cast away his idols of silver and his idols of gold—sin which your own hands have made for you.

paite: Huai hun chiang in Assuria mi bel, mi namsau a puksak hilou in, namsau a puksak hilou in, namsau hihpuk in a-om ding a; namsau mite a hilou in, amah agai ding; huan, namsau lak a kipan ataimang ding a, atangvalte lah siahliaumi ahong hita ding uhi.
english: “The Assyrian will fall by the sword, not of man; and the sword, not of mankind, shall devour him. He will flee from the sword, and his young men will become subject to forced labor.

paite: Huchi in asuangpi lah thil mulkimhuai ziak in amang ding a, amiliante lah chiamtehna ziak in abuaita ding, chỉ in TOUPA, ameikuang Zion a om leh, ahaltuina mei Jerusalem a om in," achi hi.
english: His rock will pass away by reason of terror, and his princes will be afraid of the banner,” says Yahweh, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.

paite: Ngai in, kumpipa khat diktattak in kumpipa in atu ding a, miliante'n vaihawmna diktak in vai ahawm ding uh.
english: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in justice.

paite: Huchi in mi khat huihpi lak a bukna mun bang, vuahpi lak a bitna mun, mun keu a tui luangte bang, gam tultak a suangpi lianpi nuamsatak bang ahi ding hi.
english: A man shall be as a hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the storm, as streams of water in a dry place, as the shade of a large rock in a weary land.

paite: Huchi in amute mit amial kei ding a, azate bil in angaikhe ding.
english: The eyes of those who see will not be dim, and the ears of those who hear will listen.

paite: Mingongtatte lungtang in theihna thu atheisiam ding a, dang-awkte lei teltak in apau thei ding hi.
english: The heart of the rash will understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers will be ready to speak plainly.

paite: Migilou mithilphal achi nawnta kei ding uh, milepchiah misiam achi nawn kei ding uh.
english: The fool will no longer be called noble, nor the scoundrel be highly respected.

paite: Pathian zahlouhna thilhih ding leh TOUPA hekna dia thudiklou gen ding, gilkialte sung hawmsak ding leh dangtakte dawn ding hihmang ding in, migilou in lah gitlouhna thu agen dia, alungtang in thil ahihkhial ding hi.
english: For the fool will speak folly, and his heart will work iniquity, to practice profanity, and to utter error against Yahweh, To make empty the soul of the hungry, and to cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.

paite: Milepchiah vante zaw hoih lou ahi a; tagahte'n thudik agen un leng migentheite zuauthu a hihmang ding in, ama'n lah thil gilou hih angaihtuah zel hi.
english: The ways of the scoundrel are evil. He devises wicked devices to destroy the humble with lying words, even when the needy speaks right.

paite: Mithilphal bel thilphal in thil liante angaihtuah a; huchi in thilphal lam thilte ah a-om gige ding hi.
english: But the noble devises noble things; and he will continue in noble things.

paite: Numei mawk omte aw, thou unla, ka aw ngaikhia un; tanu pilvangloute aw ka thugen ah bildoh un.
english: Rise up, you women who are at ease! Hear my voice! You careless daughters, give ear to my speech!

paite: Numei pilvangloute aw, kum khat leh ni bangzah hiam nung in na buaita ding uh; grep loh ding lah a-om ngal kei ding a, grep lohkhawm ding ah leng bangmah asuak sam kei ding hi.
english: For days beyond a year you will be troubled, you careless women; for the vintage shall fail. The harvest won’t come.

paite: Numei mawk omte aw, ling un; mipilvangloute aw, buaitak in om un; kisuah unla, vuaktang in kibawl unla, na kawng uah sai-ip puan teng un.
english: Tremble, you women who are at ease! Be troubled, you careless ones! Strip yourselves, make yourselves naked, and put sackcloth on your waist.

paite: Lou deihte ziak leh grep guigah nuamte ziak in a-awm uh atumtum ding uhi.
english: Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.

paite: Ka mite gam loulingnei leh khaulingnei in nopsakna inn tengteng leh nopsakhuai khopi tengteng tung ah abuak ding hi.
english: Thorns and briars will come up on my people’s land; yes, on all the houses of joy in the joyous city.

paite: Kumpipa' inn paisan a om ding ahi ngal a; amual pawng leh agalvenbuk tangtawn kohawm ding leh gam sabiltung kipahnate, ganhon tatna munte ahi ding.
english: For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens forever, a delight for wild donkeys, a pasture of flocks;

paite: Tunglam a kipan akha ka tung ua sunbuak a a-om a, gamdai lei hoihtak mun asuah a, lei hoihtak mun lah gammang bang a sim ahih mateng.
english: Until the Spirit is poured on us from on high, and the wilderness becomes a fruitful field, and the fruitful field is considered a forest.

paite: Huai hun chiang in vaihawm diktatna gamdai ah ateng ding a, diktatna lei hoihtak mun ah a-om ding.
english: Then justice will dwell in the wilderness; and righteousness will remain in the fruitful field.

paite: Huan diktatna nasep kituahna ahi ding a, diktatna a thilpawt lah tangtawn a muangtak a omna leh kitheihchetna ahi ding.
english: The work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.

paite: Huchi in ka mite bel galmuang a omna ah leh inkiptak leh khawlna mun muanhuaite a-omta ding uhi.
english: My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places.

paite: Himahleh gammang bel hihpuk ding in gial ake ding a; khopi hihniam in a-om ding hi.
english: Though hail flattens the forest, and the city is leveled completely.

paite: Tui luanna piau achi theh zel, bawngtal leh sabiltung khah zelte aw, nuam na sa uhi.
english: Blessed are you who sow beside all waters, who send out the feet of the ox and the donkey.

paite: Nang loh tuak ngeiloupi, alok a pang, lepchiahtak a bawl tuak ngeiloupi, lepchiahtak a pang, na tung agik hi. Mi loh na tawp hun chiang in nang leng loh na tuak sam ding hi; lepchiahtak a na hih khit chiang in, na tung ah lepchiahtak in ahih ding uhi.
english: Woe to you who destroy, but you weren’t destroyed; and who betray, but nobody betrayed you! When you have finished destroying, you will be destroyed; and when you have made an end of betrayal, you will be betrayed.

paite: TOUPA aw, hon hehpih in; ka hon ngak nilouh uhi; zingsang teng in ka ban uh hong hi inla, buai hun chiang in leng hon hondampa hong hi in.
english: Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.

paite: Lum vengvung husa in michih ataimangta ua; nang na kisak hial chiang in namte hihdalh in a-om uhi.
english: At the noise of the thunder, the peoples have fled. When you lift yourself up, the nations are scattered.

paite: Na sum uh gallak a lak ding lung in thil anek dundun bang in nekgaih in a-om ding; khaupete atawm duamduam uh bang in amaute sum tung ah atawm duamduam ding uhi.
english: Your spoil will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.

paite: Tunglam ah TOUPA tawisang in a-omta hi; ama'n Zion vaihawm diktak leh diktatna in adimsakta hi.
english: Yahweh is exalted, for he dwells on high. He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness.

paite: Na damsung in omkipna a-om ding a, hotdamna, pilna, theihna a-om kikeih ding; TOUPA launa tuh agou ahi.
english: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.

paite: Ngai in, apasalphate uh polam ah akikou ua; kituahna palaite akap hawhaw uhi.
english: Behold, their valiant ones cry outside; the ambassadors of peace weep bitterly.

paite: Lamliante amualta ua, mizin vialvakte a-om nawn kei uh; ama'n thukhun abohsia a, khuate amusit a, mi khawk asa kei hi.
english: The highways are desolate. The traveling man ceases. The covenant is broken. He has despised the cities. He doesn’t respect man.

paite: Gam akap in agim a; Lebanon azum in avuai a; Sharon gamdai bang ahita; Bashan leh Karmel in anah uh asingkhia uhi.
english: The land mourns and languishes. Lebanon is confounded and withers away. Sharon is like a desert, and Bashan and Carmel are stripped bare.

paite: TOUPA'N, "Tu'n ka thou ding a, tu'n ka kisa ding a, tu'n tawisang in ka omta ding.
english: “Now I will arise,” says Yahweh; “Now I will lift myself up. Now I will be exalted.

paite: Lou keu naupai in na pai ding ua, buhpawl na suang ding uh; na hu uh noumau kangmang ding mei ahi.
english: You will conceive chaff. You will bring forth stubble. Your breath is a fire that will devour you.

paite: Michih lah chinai suang hal bang, loulingnei vatsa mei a apaih bang uh, achi ding uh," achi hi.
english: The peoples will be like the burning of lime, like thorns that are cut down and burned in the fire.

paite: Gamlapi a omte aw, ka thilhih bil in za un; naichik a omte aw, ka thilhihtheihdan thei un.
english: Hear, you who are far off, what I have done; and, you who are near, acknowledge my might.”

paite: Zion a migilou omte'n alau ua; Pathian zah lou mite linna in amanta hi. I lak ua kua ahia thil katmang ching mei kiang a om ding? I lak uah kua ahia tangtawn a kang zoizoi kiang a om ding?
english: The sinners in Zion are afraid. Trembling has seized the godless ones. Who among us can live with the devouring fire? Who among us can live with everlasting burning?

paite: Diktattak a om a, diktak a genmi; nuaisiahnate punna himhim bangmah a ngai lou a, golhna la nuam lou abil hum a, gilou himhim en nuam lou a mitsi zel.
english: He who walks righteously, and speaks blamelessly; He who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands, refusing to take a bribe, who stops his ears from hearing of blood, and shuts his eyes from looking at evil—

paite: Huai mi tunglam ah a-om ding a; akidalna mun sang suangpi kidalnate ahi ding; akiang ah a-an piak ahi ding a, atuite a-om ngeingei ding hi.
english: he will dwell on high. His place of defense will be the fortress of rocks. His bread will be supplied. His waters will be sure.

paite: Na mite'n kumpipa akilawmna in amu ding a, gam kiphalh zatak ahon en ding uhi.
english: Your eyes will see the king in his beauty. They will see a distant land.

paite: Asimmi koi a omta ahia? Siahliau tehmi koi a-omta ahia? Galven insangte simmi koi a omta ahia? chi in na lungtang in thil mulkimhuai mahmah na ngaihtuah ding.
english: Your heart will meditate on the terror. Where is he who counted? Where is he who weighed? Where is he who counted the towers?

paite: Mihangtak, pau giltak na theihtheih louh a pau mite, pau tuam na theihsiam louh a pau mite, na mu nawnta kei ding.
english: You will no longer see the fierce people, a people of a deep speech that you can’t comprehend, with a strange language that you can’t understand.

paite: I zehtanna khopi Zion en dih; na mit in Jerusalem omna muanhuaitak, puanin chik mah chiang a leng suan louh ding, kaihgakna khet chik mah chiang a leng boh louh ding, akaihna khau himhim kitat lou ding bang, amu ding hi.
english: Look at Zion, the city of our appointed festivals. Your eyes will see Jerusalem, a quiet habitation, a tent that won’t be removed. Its stakes will never be plucked up, nor will any of its cords be broken.

paite: Huai ah TOUPA, lui za pipi leh luitate omna mun, thupitak in i kiang uah a-om zaw ding; huai tui tung ah kidouna long lianpi kalhna chiang neite apai kei ding a, long lian thupitak in leng akheng sam kei ding hi.
english: But there Yahweh will be with us in majesty, a place of broad rivers and streams, in which no galley with oars will go, neither will any gallant ship pass by there.

paite: TOUPA lah i vaihawmpa ahi a, TOUPA lah dan hon pepa ahi a, TOUPA lah i kumpipa ahi; ama'n ahon hondam ding hi.
english: For Yahweh is our judge. Yahweh is our lawgiver. Yahweh is our king. He will save us.

paite: Na khaute kolsak in a-om ding a; apuanzak peu bul uh akipsak thei kei ua, puanzak lah azak thei kei uh; huaitak in gallak sum tampi hawm in a-om a; khebaite'n leng gallak sum alata uhi.
english: Your rigging is untied. They couldn’t strengthen the foot of their mast. They couldn’t spread the sail. Then the prey of a great spoil was divided. The lame took the prey.

paite: Huai khua a mi om in, ka chi ana, achi kei ding a, asung a mite khelhna ngaihdam in a-om ding uhi.
english: The inhabitant won’t say, “I am sick.” The people who dwell therein will be forgiven their iniquity.

paite: Nou namte aw, bil a za ding in hong nai un; michihte aw, ngaikhia un; leitung leh asung a om tengteng in bil in za uhen; khovel leh asung a pan pawt tengteng toh.
english: Come near, you nations, to hear! Listen, you peoples. Let the earth and all it contains hear; the world, and everything that comes from it.

paite: TOUPA'N nam chiteng tung a lungkimlouhna nei in asepaihte uh tengteng tung ah lah hehna anei ngal a; amau ahihmang vek a, thah ding in apeta hi.
english: For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has given them over for slaughter.

paite: Alak ua thah a omte paihkhiak in a-om ding ua, aluang namsia uh apaitou vutvut ding a, tangte asisan ua zulsak in a-om ding uhi.
english: Their slain will also be cast out, and the stench of their dead bodies will come up; and the mountains will melt in their blood.

paite: Van a omte tengteng hihman in a-om ding ua, laibuzial kizial bang in van zial in a-om ding a, a-omte tengteng, grepgui a kipan a nahvuai apulh bang in leh theipi kung a kipan a nahvuai apulh bang in avuai khin un apulh vek ding uhi.
english: All of the army of the sky will be dissolved. The sky will be rolled up like a scroll, and all its armies will fade away, as a leaf fades from off a vine or a fig tree.

paite: Ka namsau in van ah taitak in adawnta ngal a, ngai in, huai vaihawm ding in Edomte tung ah leh ka hamsiat mite tung ah ake ding.
english: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.

paite: TOUPA namsau sisan in atai ding a, thauna a thausak in a-omta, belamnoute leh kelte sisan in, belampa gilthaute in. TOUPA'N Bozrah ah kithoihna anei a, Edom gam ah leng thahna thupitak anei hi.
english: Yahweh’s sword is filled with blood. It is covered with fat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams; for Yahweh has a sacrifice in Bozrah, And a great slaughter in the land of Edom.

paite: Gam bawngtalte leng kituak in satpaih in a-om ding ua, bawngtalte toh, agam un sisan akham ding a, aleivui uh thauna a thausak in a-om ding.
english: The wild oxen will come down with them, and the young bulls with the mighty bulls; and their land will be drunken with blood, and their dust made greasy with fat.

paite: TOUPA phulak ni lah ahita ngal a, Zion selna lam thu athukna kum.
english: For Yahweh has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.

paite: Aluituite longnai dia suahsak in a-om ding a, leivuite mei leh kaat asuak ding a, agam longnai kang asuak ding hi.
english: Its streams will be turned into pitch, its dust into sulfur, And its land will become burning pitch.

paite: Sun leh zan in mihsak ahi kei ding a; ameikhu lah tangtawn in atungkah ding a; suan om lai siah asia in a-om nilouh ding a; tangtawn in leng kuamah in angap kei ding uhi.
english: It won’t be quenched night nor day. Its smoke will go up forever. From generation to generation, it will lie waste. No one will pass through it forever and ever.

paite: Tuivagik leh sakuh in huai gam atang ding ua; simbu leh va-ak huai ah ateng ding uh; siatna khau leh siatgawpna ulum atung ah akhai ding hi.
english: But the pelican and the porcupine will possess it. The owl and the raven will dwell in it. He will stretch the line of confusion over it, and the plumb line of emptiness.

paite: Amihoihte uh gam uk ding in asam ding ua, himahleh huai ah kuamah sap ding a-om kei ding uh; amilian tengteng uh bangmah ahi kei ding uh.
english: They shall call its nobles to the kingdom, but none shall be there; and all its princes shall be nothing.

paite: Akumpipa uh inn ah louling neite apou ding a, akulhpi sung uah dailing leh lingnok apou ding; sehalte tenna ding leh vasa ngawngsaute a ding in inn um sung intual ahi ding hi.
english: Thorns will come up in its palaces, nettles and thistles in its fortresses; and it will be a habitation of jackals, a court for ostriches.

paite: Huan gamdai a, gamsate ngiate toh akituak ding ua, sathak in alawm asam ding; ahi, zan thil lauhuaipi in huai ah omna abawl ding a, amah a ding in khawlna mun ding amu ding hi.
english: The wild animals of the desert will meet with the wolves, and the wild goat will cry to his fellow. Yes, the night creature literally, lilith, which could also be a night demon or night monster shall settle there, and shall find herself a place of rest.

paite: Huai ah simbu thupi in bu abawl ding a, atui dia, akeuh ding a, a-opkhawm ding; ahi, huai ah mute koppih nei chiat in a-omkhawm ding uhi.
english: The arrow snake will make her nest there, and lay, hatch, and gather under her shade. Yes, the kites will be gathered there, every one with her mate.

paite: TOUPA laibu ah zong unla, sim un; huaite lak ah khat leng kim lou a-om kei ding a, khat leng koppih nei lou a-om kei ding; amah kam ngei in thu apia a, akha ngei in huaite apikhawmta hi.
english: Search in the book of Yahweh, and read: not one of these will be missing. none will lack her mate. For my mouth has commanded, and his Spirit has gathered them.

paite: Ama'n lah amaute a ding in ai asansak a, akhut a khau a teh in huai gam ahawmsak chiat a; tangtawn in anei ding ua, suan om lai teng huai ah a-om ding uhi.
english: He has cast the lot for them, and his hand has divided it to them with a measuring line. They shall possess it forever. From generation to generation they will dwell in it.

paite: Gamdai leh phaksap gam akipak ding a; gamkeu in nuamsa in pawn pak bang in apak ding.
english: The wilderness and the dry land will be glad. The desert will rejoice and blossom like a rose.

paite: Apaklun ding a, kipaktak leh la sa in nuam asa ding hi. Lebanon thupina akiang ah piak ahi ding, Karmel leh Sharon kilawmna toh; TOUPA thupina amu ding ua, i Pathian kilawmna toh.
english: It will blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing. Lebanon’s glory Lebanon will be given to it, the excellence of Carmel and Sharon. They will see Yahweh’s glory, the excellence of our God.

paite: Khut hatloute hatsak unla, khukzawte kipsak un.
english: Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the feeble knees.

paite: Lungtang dawilokte kiang ah, "Hattak in om unla, lau kei un! Ngai un, na Pathian uh phulakna toh, a Pathian thukna toh, ahong pai ding a, hon hondam ding," chi un.
english: Tell those who have a fearful heart, “Be strong. Don’t be afraid. Behold, your God will come with vengeance, God’s retribution. He will come and save you.

paite: Huai hun chiang in mittawte mit hahsak in a-om ding a, nangongte bil hihvak in a-om ding.
english: Then the eyes of the blind will be opened, and the ears of the deaf will be unstopped.

paite: Huai hun chiang in khebaite sakhi bang in atawm ding ua, pau theiloute lei in nuamsatak in la asa ding uh; gamdaite ah tuite ahong phulkhe ding ua, gamkeute ah luita tui ahong phulkhe biabia ding uhi.
english: Then the lame man will leap like a deer, and the tongue of the mute will sing; for waters will break out in the wilderness, and streams in the desert.

paite: Huchi in piaunel sa mahmah munte dil ahong suak ding a, lei dangtak mahmah tui nak ahong suak ding; sehalte tenna a, alupna uah, loupa, maute leh sikhapat toh a-om ding.
english: The burning sand will become a pool, and the thirsty ground springs of water. Grass with reeds and rushes will be in the habitation of jackals, where they lay.

paite: Huan huai ah lamlian a-om ding a, kongpi toh, huai Sianthouna Lampi achi ding uh; mithanghuai in lampi atawn kei ding, himahleh huai mite a ding in ahi zaw ding; mi vialzinte, ahi, mihaite leng, huai ah amang kei ding uhi.
english: A highway will be there, a road, and it will be called The Holy Way. The unclean shall not pass over it, but it will be for those who walk in the Way. Wicked fools will not go there.

paite: Humpinelkai himhim huai ah a-om kei ding a, sa hing ne himhim huai ah apaitou sam kei ding uh, muh phak in leng a-om kei ding ua, himahleh tatsate bel huai ah apaitou ding uh.
english: No lion will be there, nor will any ravenous animal go up on it. They will not be found there; but the redeemed will walk there.

paite: TOUPA tatsate akik nawn ding ua, lasa kawm in Zion atung ding uh, tangtawn a kipahna alutung uah a-omta ding a; nopsakna leh kipahna angah ding ua, lungkhamna leh thumna amang ding hi.
english: The Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads. They will obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing will flee away.”

paite: Kumpipa Hezekiah akum sawm-le-li kum in hichi ahong hi a, Assuria gam kumpipa Sennakerib tuh Judah gam a kulh nei khua tengteng sim ding in ava hohtou a alata hi.
english: Now it happened in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria attacked all of the fortified cities of Judah, and captured them.

paite: Assuria kumpipa'n Lakish a kipan Jerusalem a kumpipa Hezekiah kiang ah sepaihhon tampipi toh Rabshakeh asawl hi. Huan dil saknung tuilakna kiang a Puansawpmi Loubuk lamlian ah adingh hi.
english: The king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to king Hezekiah with a large army. He stood by the aqueduct from the upper pool in the fuller’s field highway.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Shebna, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joah akiang ah ahong suk uhi.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder came out to him.

paite: Huan Rabshakeh in akiang uah, "Hezekiah kiang ah huchi in gen un, 'Kumpipa thupitak Assuria kumpipa in hichi in achi: Na muanna kingakna bang ahi mai a?'
english: Rabshakeh said to them, “Now tell Hezekiah, ‘Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, “What confidence is this in which you trust?

paite: Kidouna ding a na lemtheihna leh na hatna zaw thu lel ahi, ka chi. Kua muang a, ka tung a hel na himai a?
english: I say that your counsel and strength for the war are only vain words. Now in whom do you trust, that you have rebelled against me?

paite: Ngai in, hiai sialluang chiangkhun kitan Aiguptate muang na hi ve; huai mi na muanleh, na khut ah asun ding hi. Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh ah zaw amah muangte tung ah huchibang ahi.”
english: Behold, you trust in the staff of this bruised reed, even in Egypt, which if a man leans on it, it will go into his hand and pierce it. So is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who trust in him.

paite: Ahihkeileh, ka kiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian uh ahi ka muan uh," na chihleh, amah pen Hezekiah in Judahte kiang ah leh Jerusalem kiang ah, "Hiai maitam ma ah kia na biak ding uh ahi," chi a, amun sangte leh amaitamte lakmangsakpa hilou hia?
english: But if you tell me, ‘We trust in Yahweh our God,’ isn’t that he whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar?’”

paite: Huchi in hehpih in, ka pu Assuria kumpipa kiang ah thu chiam in, huchi in ke'n sakol sangnih ka hon pe ding, nang atung ua tuang dingte na muh theih peuh dingleh.
english: Now therefore, please make a pledge to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.

paite: Bangchi in kangtalaite leh sakol tungtuang mite thu ah Aiguptate tung a na muanna nga a, ka pu sikha neupente lak a heutu khat leng na nan zoh ding?
english: How then can you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

paite: Huan hiai hihse ding a sim ding in TOUPA pang lou a hong paitou ka hi a hia? TOUPA'N, ka kiang ah, "Huai gam sim ding in hohtou inla, hihsia in, ahon chi, chi un," achi hi.
english: Have I come up now without Yahweh against this land to destroy it? Yahweh said to me, “Go up against this land, and destroy it.”’”

paite: Eliakim leh Shebna leh Joahte'n, Rabshakeh kiang ah, "Hehpih in na sikhate Siria pau in hon houpih in; huai ka theithei ngal ua; kulhbaang tung a mite zak in Judah pau in hon houpih nawn ke'n," achi uhi.
english: Then Eliakim, Shebna and Joah said to Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; and don’t speak to us in the Jews’ language in the hearing of the people who are on the wall.”

paite: Himahleh Rabshakeh in, "Ka pu in na pu kiang kia ah leh nang kiang ah hiai thu gen ding in ahon sawl a hia? Kulhbaang tung a tute, noute toh amau ek ne ding leh amau zun dawn dingte kiang ah, ahon sawl ahi zaw kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me only to your master and to you, to speak these words, and not to the men who sit on the wall, who will eat their own dung and drink their own urine with you?”

paite: Huchi in Rabshakeh adingh a, Judah pau in ngaihtak in akikou a, "Kumpipa thupi Assuria kumpipa thute ngaikhia un.
english: Then Rabshakeh stood, and called out with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!

paite: Kumpipa'n hichi in achi, 'Hezekiah khem in om nuam dah un; ama'n lah ahon humbit thei kei ding hi.
english: Thus says the king, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you.

paite: Hezekiah in, TOUPA'N pel lou in hon humbit ding; hiai khopi zaw Assuria kumpipa khut a piak in a-om kei ding, chi in thu gen mahleh, Hezekiah gen ziak in TOUPA muang nuam tuan dah un.' "
english: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahweh, saying, “Yahweh will surely deliver us. This city won’t be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.”’

paite: Hezekiah thu ngaikhe kei un; Assuria kumpipa'n lah hichi in achi ngal a, "Thilpiak in hon kituahpih unla, ka kiang ah hong paikhia un; michih in agrepgui a pan leh michih in atheipi kung a pan ne chiat unla, michih in atuikhuk a pan tui dawn chiat un.
english: Don’t listen to Hezekiah, for thus says the king of Assyria, ‘Make your peace with me, and come out to me; and each of you eat from his vine, and each one from his fig tree, and each one of you drink the waters of his own cistern;

paite: Ka hong pai a, noumau gam bang a buh leh uain omna gam, tanghou leh grephuante omna gam a ka hon paipih matan.
english: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and new wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

paite: TOUPA'N hon humbit ding, chi a, Hezekiah in ahon khem khakleh pilvang un. Namte pathiante'n Assuria kumpipa khut a pan agam uh ahumbit ngei ua hia?
english: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, “Yahweh will deliver us.” Have any of the gods of the nations delivered their lands from the hand of the king of Assyria?

paite: Hamath leh Arpahte pathiante koi a om ahita ua? Sepharvaimte pathiante koi a om ahita ua? Huai Samaria khua kei a kipan in ahumbitta ua ahia?
english: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria from my hand?

paite: Huai gam pathian tengteng lak a kuate'n ahia kei a kipan agam uh ahumbit uh? TOUPA'N Jerusalem khua kei a kipan in ahumbit mahmah ding maw? chi in," achi hi.
english: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’”

paite: Amau bel adai dide ua, "Thu khat lel in leng adawng kei uh; kumpipa thupiak, amau dawng kei un," chih ahi ngal a.
english: But they remained silent, and said nothing in reply, for the king’s commandment was, “Don’t answer him.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Hilkiah tapa Eliakim, laigelhmi Shebna, tanchin gelhmi Asaph tapa Joahte'n a uansilh uh botkek in Hezekiah kiang ah ahong pai ua, Rabshakeh thugente ahilh uhi.
english: Then Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kumpipa Hezekiah in huai azaktak in apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh a, TOUPA' inn ah alutta hi.
english: It happened, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into Yahweh’s house.

paite: A-inkuanpihte tung a heutu a om Eliakim leh laigelhmi Shebna leh siampute upate sai-ip puan silh in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai kiang ah asawl hi.
english: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

paite: Amau akiang ah, Hezekiah in hichi in achi, "Tuni mangbatna leh muhsitna ni ahi; naupangte lah apian hun uh ahita a, amau piangsak ding in hatna lah a-om nawn kei.
english: They said to him, “Thus says Hezekiah, ‘This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the birth, and there is no strength to bring forth.
