paite: Huan lei tuh meikuang ahi, pumpi hiangte lak a gitlouhna lumpi, pumpi avek a ninsak a, mihing kisuansawndan pianphungpi kangsak ahi; huai lei mah in gawtmun mei toh apeh hi.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna. or, Hell

paite: Sa chi chih, vasa chi chih, ganhing chi chih tuipi ate khoizual theih ahi ua, mite khoizual in a-om uhi.
english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and thing in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind.

paite: Himahleh lei zaw kuamah in akhoizual thei kei uhi; sihna gu a dim gilou om kinken thei lou ahi.
english: But nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

paite: Huai lei in Pa Pathian i phat ua; huai mah in Pathian bang a bawl mihingte i hamsiat uhi.
english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who are made in the image of God.

paite: Kam khat a kipan in phatna leh hamsia apawt nak hi. Ka unaute aw, huchibang ding hilou ahi.
english: Out of the same mouth comes forth blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

paite: Tuikhuk khat in nak khat mah a kipan in tui lim leh lim lou asuaksak zel a hia?
english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

paite: Ka unaute aw, theipi kung ah olive thei agah thei a hia? Ahihkeileh grepgui ah theipi agah thei a hia? Huchibang in chikhuk in tui al lou asuaksak thei sam kei hi.
english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

paite: Na lak uah kua apil in, thu atheithei a? Thunuailut leh piltak in athilhihte omdan hoih in ensak hen.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

paite: Himahleh na lungtang uah hazatna thupitak leh kidemna na neih uleh thudik zuausan kei un.
english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

paite: Huai bang pilna zaw tunglam a kipan a hong paisuk ahi kei a, lei lam thil, khamitlouhna leh dawi lam thil a kipan ahi zaw hi.
english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

paite: Hazatna leh kidemna omna ah buaina leh thilhihkhelhna chiteng a-om hi.
english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

paite: Tunglam a kipan pilna bel, atung in asiangthou phot a, huai khit in kituah a-ut a, anunnem a, achihnuam a, zahngaihna leh gah hoih in adim a, khentuam anei kei a, alepchiah kei hi.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

paite: Huan diktatna gah zaw lemna bawlmi in lemna a atuh ahi.
english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

paite: Na lak ua kidounate leh kinaknate koi a kipan hong suak ahi ua? Hiaite na pumpi hiangte ua kidouna bawl nak, na nopsak utna ua kipan a hong suakkhete ahi kei ua hia?
english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

paite: Na lunggulh ua, na nei tuan kei ua, huchi in tual na that uh. Na eng ua, na ngah thei tuan kei ua, huchi in na kidou ua, gal na bawl uh. Na nget louh ziak un, na nei kei uh.
english: You lust, and don’t have. You kill, covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

paite: Na ngen ua, na nget diklouh ziak un na ngah kei uh, na nopsak bawlna ding lel ua zat na tup ziak un.
english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it for your pleasures.

paite: Nou angkawm hatte aw, khovel lawm hihna zaw Pathian melma hihna ahi chih na thei kei ua hia? Huaiziak in khovel lawm hih ut peuhmah Pathian melma in akibawl nak hi.
english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

paite: Ahihkeileh eimah a teng Kha in, "Haza khop hial in ahon deih chih Laisiangthou in agen bangmah lou in na ngaihtuah ua hia?"
english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

paite: Himahleh ama'n hehpihna tamsem ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in Laisiangthou in, "Pathian in mikisatheite adou a, kingaineute bel hehpihna ape nak hi," achih.
english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Proverbs 3:34

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian ah kitulut un. Diabol dou un, hileh noute ahon taimangsan ding hi.
english: Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

paite: Pathian naih unla, huchi in ama'n ahon naih ding. Khialte aw, na khut uh silsiang un; lungsim thuah neite aw, na lungtang uh hihsiangthou un.
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

paite: Lungkham unla, suun unla, kapkhia un. Na nuih uh suunna suak henla, na lungnopna uh lungngaihna suak hen.
english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

paite: Toupa mitmuh in kingaineu un, huchi in ahon hihlian ding hi.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

paite: Unaute aw, kigensetuah kei un. Kuapeuh in a-unau agensiat hiam vai ahawmkhumleh, dan gensia a vaihawmkhum ahi; dan na gensiatleh dan zuimi na hi kei a, vaihawmpa na hi zaw hi.
english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

paite: Dan pepa leh vaihawmpa, amah hondam theipa leh hihmang theipa khat lel a-om hi; nang na vengte vaihawmkhum kua kisa na hia?
english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

paite: Tu'n ah noute'n ngai un, "Tuni hiam zingchiang hiam in, huai khopi ah i hoh ding ua, huai ah kum khat i va taam ding ua, i sumsin ding ua, punna i mu ding," chite aw.
english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

paite: Zingchiang a bang hong om ding ahia chih na thei kei uhi. Na hinna uh bang ahia? Tuimei sawt lou kal a hong dawk a, mang nawn lel bang na hi uhi.
english: Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.

paite: Huchi in "Toupa'n pha asakleh i dam dia, hiai hiam, huai hiam i hih ding," na chih ding uh ahi.
english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

paite: Himahleh na ki-otsaknate uh na suang zaw ua, huai bang suanna tengteng gilou ahi.
english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

paite: Huchi in kuapeuh thil hoih ding thei a hih tuan lou zaw amah a ding in khelhna ahi.
english: To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

paite: Mihausate aw, ngai dih uh, na tung ua gimthuakna hong tung ding ziak a kap in, mau tuaituai un.
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

paite: Na goute uh aseta a, na puante uh leikha in ne khinta hi.
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

paite: Na dangka-eng uleh na dangkate uh atui-ek khinta hi; huan atui-ek uh nou hon theihpihtu ahi ding ua, meikang bang in na taksa uh akangse zou ding hi.
english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you, and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

paite: Ngai un, na lou ua buh at a kilohte loh amau khem a na piak louh uh akikou ua, buh atte mangbang kikou aw Sepaihte' Toupa bil ah alutta hi.
english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies Greek: Sabaoth (for Hebrew: Tze’va’ot) .

paite: Khovel ah nuamsatak leh noptaltak in na hing ua, na thah ni bang un na lungtang uh na taisak uhi.
english: You have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

paite: Midiktat, nou hon douloute siam louh tangsak in na that uhi.
english: You have condemned, you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, Toupa hong pai mateng kuhkaltak in om un. Ngai un, louneimi in vuahtui ke masa leh nanung amuh mateng leigah hoihtak angak zel hi.
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

paite: Nou leng kuhkaltak in om un; na lungtang uh hihkip un; Toupa hong paina ding anaita hi.
english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

paite: Unaute aw, siam louh tang a na omlouhna ding un, kiphunkhum kei un; ngai un, kongkhak bul ah vaihawmpa adingh hi.
english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

paite: Unaute aw, Toupa min a thugenmi zawlneite thuakdan leh akuhkaldan uh zuih ding in nei un.
english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

paite: Ngai un, athuak mite tuh nuamsa i chi uhi; Job kuhkaldan na zata ua, Toupa'n atawp a ahihdan leh Toupa hehpihna a adimdan leh azahngaih theihdan leng na mu uhi.
english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

paite: Himahleh ka unaute aw, bang teng tung ah, kichiam kei un; van lou in hiam, lei lou in hiam, thil dang himhim lou in hiam kichiam kei un, hiamhleh "hi" na chih uh "hi" henla, "hilou" na chih uh "hilou" hi hen; huchi lou in zaw siam louh tang in na om kha ding uhi.
english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear, neither by heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes,” and your “no,” “no”; so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy. TR reads “under judgment” instead of “into hypocrisy”

paite: Na lak uah thil hoih lou thuak a-om uhia? Thum uhen. Kipak a om uhia? Phatna la sa uhen.
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

paite: Na lak uah damlou a-om uhia? Saptuam Upa samsak uhenla, ama'n Toupa min a sathau nilh in atung ah thum hen.
english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord,

paite: Huan ginna a thumna in damlou adam ding a, Toupa'n amah akaithou ding; thil ahihkhelh takleh ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

paite: Huchi in hihdam a na omtheihna ding un, na khelhnate uh thupha kitawituah unla, kithumsaktuah un. Midiktat thumna in thil thupitak ahih zel hi.
english: Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

paite: Elijah leng eimah piandan bang pu mihing ahi a, vuah zuklouhna ding in phatuamngaitak in athum a, kum thum leh kha guk sung teng leitung ah vuah azu kei hi.
english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

paite: Athum nawn a, van in vuah azusak a, lei in agahte ahon suah hi.
english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth brought forth its fruit.

paite: Ka unaute aw, na lak ua mi kuapeuh thutak a kipan in pialmang henla kuahiam in pikik nawnleh,
english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth, and someone turns him back,

paite: mikhial alamhaihna a kipan a kiheisakpa'n sihna a kipan akha ahondam ding a, khelhna tampi akhuhsak lai ding chih kithei hen.
english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death, and will cover a multitude of sins.

paite: Benjamin gam a Anathoth a siampute lak a mi Hilkiah tapa Jeremiah thute:
english: The words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:

paite: Judah Kumpipa, Ammon tapa Josiah hun lai, avaihawm akum sawm-le-thumna ah akiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: to whom the word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. came in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign.

paite: Judah kumpipa, Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm lai in leng ahong tung a; Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Zedekiah akum sawm-le-khatna tawp, Jerusalem sal a pi akha ngana tan in.
english: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, to the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: Now the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: "Gilsung a ka hon bawl ma in ka hon thei a, sul a kipan a na pawtkhiak ma in leng ka hon koihtuam a, namte kiang a zawlnei hi ding in ka hon sep khin," chi in.
english: “Before I formed you in the belly, I knew you. Before you came forth out of the womb, I sanctified you. I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Eh, Toupa PATHIAN, ngai dih, thu ka gensiam kei, ka naupang ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh! Behold, I don’t know how to speak; for I am a child.”

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Ka naupang, chi ke'n, ka hon sawlna peuhmah kiang ah na hoh ding a, ka hon thupiak peuhmah na gen ding ahi.
english: But Yahweh said to me, “Don’t say, ‘I am a child;’ for to whoever I shall send you, you shall go, and whatever I shall command you, you shall speak.

paite: Amaute lau ke'nla, nang hon hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om hi," chi in.
english: Don’t be afraid because of them; for I am with you to deliver you,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ahon sawk a, ka kam akhoih a, TOUPA'N ka kiang ah,
english: Then Yahweh put forth his hand, and touched my mouth; and Yahweh said to me, “Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

paite: "Ngai in, na kam ah ka thute ka koihta, en dih, namte leh kumpipa gamte tung ah, botkhe ding, phel ding, hihse ding, paikhe ding, bawlhoih ding leh dingkhesak ding in tuni in ka hon koih na hi," achi hi.
english: Behold, I have this day set you over the nations and over the kingdoms, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.”

paite: Huai lou leng ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, "Jeremiah, bang na mu?" achi hi. Ke'n, “Vaisuaklu singhiang ka mu," ka chi hi.
english: Moreover the word of Yahweh came to me, saying, “Jeremiah, what do you see?” I said, “I see a branch of an almond tree.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Na mu kha mahmah ve; ka thu tangtun ding in ka kigalging gige ahi," achi hi.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “You have seen well; for I watch over my word to perform it.”

paite: Huan anihveina ding in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a, "Bang na mu a?" chi in. Ke'n bel, "Bel sou bolhbolh, agong mallam nga ka mu," ka chi hi.
english: The word of Yahweh came to me the second time, saying, “What do you see?” I said, “I see a boiling caldron; and it is tipping away from the north.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Gam a tengte tung ah mallam a kipan thil hoih lou ahong tung ding.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, “Out of the north evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.

paite: Ngai dih, mallam kumpipa gam nam tengteng ka sam ding; chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ahong pai ding ua, Jerusalem kongpi lutna ah, akimvel kulhbaang tengteng chin ah leh Judah khopi teng ah alaltutphah uh atung chiat ding uh.
english: For, behold, I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north,” says Yahweh; “and they shall come, and they shall each set his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all its walls all around, and against all the cities of Judah.

paite: Hon paisan in, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, amau khutsuak mah abia ua; hiai athulimlouhna teng tungtang ua ka thugelte ka puang ding hi.
english: I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness, in that they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, and worshiped the works of their own hands.

paite: Huaiziak in puan teng inla, thou inla, ka hon thupiak teng akiang uah va gen in; ama uah lunglel ke'n, huchi lou in zaw ama uah ka hon lunglelsak kha ding hi.
english: “You therefore put your belt on your waist, arise, and speak to them all that I command you. Don’t be dismayed at them, lest I dismay you before them.

paite: Ngai in, tuni in nang, agam pumpite, Judah kumpipate, aheutute, asiampute leh agam mipite dou in khopi kulh a um leh sik khuam leh dalsik khuam in ka hon bawl ahi.
english: For, behold, I have made you this day a fortified city, and an iron pillar, and bronze walls, against the whole land, against the kings of Judah, against its princes, against its priests, and against the people of the land.

paite: Hon sual ding ua, himahleh ahon zou kei ding uh; hon hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om hi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: They will fight against you; but they will not prevail against you; for I am with you,” says Yahweh, “to deliver you.”

paite: Aw, Israel inkote aw, na kiang ua TOUPA thugen ngaikhia un,
english: Hear the word which Yahweh speaks to you, house of Israel!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Namte omdan ching kei unla, van a chiamtehnate ziak in leng lunglau sam kei un; huaite ah namte lunglau in a-om nak uhi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, “Don’t learn the way of the nations, and don’t be dismayed at the signs of the sky; for the nations are dismayed at them.

paite: Mite dante bangmah lou ahi ngal a, Gamnuai ah sing aphuk ua, heipi a mikhutsiam khut in asep ahi.
english: For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman with the axe.

paite: Dangkasik leh dangka-eng in azem ua, atatlouhna ding in sikkilhna leh sek in akilh uh.
english: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it not move.

paite: Tangmai huan a vasa lauh ding milim bang ahi ua, apau thei kei uh. Amau apai theih louh ziak un, puak suan akiphamoh sek uh; amaute lau kei un, thil sia ahihthei kei ua, thil hoih leng ahihthei sam kei uh.
english: They are like a palm tree, of turned work, and don’t speak: they must be carried, because they can’t go. Don’t be afraid of them; for they can’t do evil, neither is it in them to do good.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang bang kuamah a-om kei ua, na thupi a, na min hatna in athanglian hi.
english: There is none like you, Yahweh; you are great, and your name is great in might.

paite: Aw namte Kumpipa, kua'n ahia hon kihta lou ding? Huai lah na tuakzou him ngal a. Namte mipil tengteng lakte ah, alalgam lak uah leng, nang bang mahmah a-om kei uh.
english: Who should not fear you, King of the nations? For it appertains to you; because among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their royal estate, there is none like you.

paite: Amau khawksak nei lou mihai ahi ua, manna bei sing milimte sinsak ahi uhi.
english: But they are together brutish and foolish: the instruction of idols! it is but a stock.

paite: Tarshish a kipan dangkasik sek ahon la ua, Uphaz a kipan dangka-eng, mikhutsiam bawl, dangka-eng sekmi khutsuak, puansilh dumpuang leh sandup, mikhutsiam khutsuak vek ahi uhi.
english: There is silver beaten into plates, which is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the artificer and of the hands of the goldsmith; blue and purple for their clothing; they are all the work of skillful men.

paite: TOUPA bel Pathian tak ahi, Pathian hing tangtawn Kumpipa ahi, aheh in lei aling a, namte'n ahehna anangzou kei uh.
english: But Yahweh is the true God; he is the living God, and an everlasting King: at his wrath the earth trembles, and the nations are not able to withstand his indignation.

paite: Akiang ua hichibang a na chih ding uh ahi: Pathian, lei leh van bawl hiloupi lei a kipan amangthang ding ua, van nuai a kipan amang vek ding uh.
english: You shall say this to them: The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, these shall perish from the earth, and from under the heavens.

paite: Athilhihtheihna in lei abawl a, apilna in khovel atungding a, alemtheihna in van akaipalh hi.
english: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens:

paite: A-aw asuah chiang in, van ah tui aging honhon a, kawlmong a kipan meipi akahtousak a, vuah zukna ding in khua aphesak a, agoubawm a kipan huih anungsak hi.
english: when he utters his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasuries.

paite: Michih amawl ua, theihna anei kei uh, dangka-eng sekmi in alimsek azumpih a, amilim sun lah zuau lel ahi a, amau ah hinna leng a-om kei hi.
english: Every man has become brutish and without knowledge; every goldsmith is disappointed by his engraved image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

paite: Bangmah lou ahi ua, khemna nasep lel, agawt hun chiang un amang ding uh.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

paite: Jakob tantuan bel hichibang ahi kei, thil tengteng bul ahi ngal a; Israel agouluah nam ahi a, amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Israel is the tribe of his inheritance: Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Aw nang, um a om lellel in, lei a kipan na puanthuah lakhawm in,
english: Gather up your wares out of the land, you who live under siege.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, tu in gam a tengte ka singkhe ding, aphawk tham un ka hihgenthei ding."
english: For thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this time, and will distress them, that they may feel it.

paite: Ka natna ziak in ka tung agik hi, ka liamna ana a, himahleh, "Hiai hial haksatna ahi, ka thuak mai ding ahi," ka chi.
english: Woe is me because of my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is my grief, and I must bear it.

paite: Ka puanin aseta, ka khau tengteng akitat vek a, ka kiang a kipan ka tate apawt ua, a-om nawn kei uh; ka puanin kaipalh ding a- omta kei uh, ka puanzak hon lepsak ding.
english: My tent is destroyed, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth from me, and they are no more: there is none to spread my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

paite: Belamching mite amawl ua, TOUPA thudotdan athei kei uh; huaiziak in alamzang kei ua, abelamhonte uh adalhzak khinta.
english: For the shepherds are become brutish, and have not inquired of Yahweh: therefore they have not prospered, and all their flocks are scattered.

paite: Ngai un, mallam a pan husa ahong tung, buaina thupi mahmah, Judah khopite hihgawp in, sehal tenna ding a suaksak ding in.
english: The voice of news, behold, it comes, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Judah a desolation, a dwelling place of jackals.

paite: Aw TOUPA, mihing omdan bel, amah thu lel ahi kei chih ka theita hi; mihing akalsuante ama kipi hilou hi.
english: Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man who walks to direct his steps.

paite: Aw TOUPA, hon thunun inla, ahun lel in, heh lou in, huchi lou in zaw na hon hihmang kha ding hi.
english: Yahweh, correct me, but in measure: not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing.

paite: Nang hon thei ngeiloute tung leh na min lou ngei lou namte tung ah na hehna bungkhia in; Jakob ane khin ua, ahi, ane khin ua, anemang ua, atenna gam ahihsia uhi.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, and on the families that don’t call on your name: for they have devoured Jacob, yes, they have devoured him and consumed him, and have laid waste his habitation.

paite: Jeremiah kiang a Jeremiah TOUPA thu hong tung:
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: Hiai thukhunte ngaikhia unla, Judah mite leh Jerusalem a tengte kiang ah gen un.
english: Hear the words of this covenant, and speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

paite: Nang akiang uah, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Hiai thukhun thute ngaikhe loumi hamsethuak in om hen.
english: and say to them, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: Cursed is the man who doesn’t hear the words of this covenant,

paite: Huai bel na pipute uh, Aigupta gam, sik haltuina kipan a ka pikhiak ni a, ka paukam suak mang unla, thu ka hon piak tengteng hih un, chi a ka thupiak tak ahi; huchi in ka mite na hi ding ua, kei na Pathian uh ka hi ding;
english: which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so you shall be my people, and I will be your God;

paite: Na pipute uh kiang a khuaizu leh nawitui a luang gam kichiam a piak ka chiamtak ka tangtun theihna ding in tuni a a-om bang in, hichi in achi: Huan ke'n, “Amen, Aw TOUPA," chi in ka dawng hi.
english: that I may establish the oath which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as at this day. Then answered I, and said, Amen, Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Judah khopite ah leh Jerusalem kholakte ah hiai thu tengteng puang inla: Hiai thukhunte ngaikhia unla, zui un.
english: Yahweh said to me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear the words of this covenant, and do them.

paite: Na pipute un Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak ni a kipan tutan in ka paukam suak mang un, chi in ka theisak sek hi.
english: For I earnestly protested to your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even to this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

paite: Himahleh amang kei ua, bil adoh kei ua, michih, amau lungtang gilou bang zel in a-om zaw uhi. Huaiziak in hiai thukhun thu, hih ding a thu ka piak, ahih louh tengteng uh atung uah ka hon tungsakta ahi,” achi a.
english: Yet they didn’t obey, nor turn their ear, but walked everyone in the stubbornness of their evil heart: therefore I brought on them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do, but they didn’t do them.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Judah mite leh Jerusalem a tengte lak ah phialgukna a-om.
english: Yahweh said to me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Apipute uh, ka thu ngaikhe nuamloute thulimlouhna lam ah akilehhei nawn ua; pathian dangte nna sem ding in akuan ua; Israel inkote leh Judah inkote'n apipute uh kiang a ka thukhun bawl pen ahihseta uh."
english: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, who refused to hear my words; and they are gone after other gods to serve them: the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, atung uah thil hoih lou, apelh het louh ding uh ka hon tungsak ding; ahon sam ding ua, himahleh ka ngaikhe kei ding."
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will bring evil on them, which they shall not be able to escape; and they shall cry to me, but I will not listen to them.

paite: Huan Judah khopite leh Jerusalem a tengte'n pathian, akiang ua gimlim ahal seknate uh asam ding ua, himahleh abuai hun chiang un huaite'n amau ahumbit het kei ding hi.
english: Then shall the cities of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem go and cry to the gods to which they offer incense: but they will not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

paite: Aw Judah, na pathiante na khopi zah ahi ngal ua; thil zumhuaitak, Baal kiang a gimlim halna ding maitam hial leng Jerusalem kongzing zah in na dingsakta hi.
english: For according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have you set up altars to the shameful thing, even altars to burn incense to Baal.

paite: Huaiziak in hiaite thumsak ke'nla, amau a ding in ngetna hiam aw hiam suah sam ke'n; abuai hun chiang ua ahon sap uleh ka ngaikhe kei ding hi.
english: Therefore don’t pray for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them; for I will not hear them in the time that they cry to me because of their trouble.

paite: Thilkihhuai hih kawm in, ka deih mahmah in ka inn ah tantuam bang ahia aneih? Thu kichiamte leh Setan in na siatna ding uh ahon pelsak thei ding ahia? Na suang thei ua hia?
english: What has my beloved to do in my house, since she has worked lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from you? when you do evil, then you rejoice.

paite: TOUPA'N na min ding in olive sing hing, gah hoih kilawmpi, ahon chi a, lum honhon in atung ah mei atoh a, ahiangte leng akitan khinta.
english: Yahweh called your name, A green olive tree, beautiful with goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he has kindled fire on it, and its branches are broken.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, nang hon phutpa'n, Israel inkote leh Judah inkote khelhna, Baal kiang a gimlim lan a, hon hehsak thil uh, amau a dia asepkhiak tung ua thil hoih lou ding thu na tung ah apuangkheta hi.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, who planted you, has pronounced evil against you, because of the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah, which they have worked for themselves in provoking me to anger by offering incense to Baal.

paite: TOUPA'N hon theisak a, ka theita; huchi in nang mahmah in athilhihte uh na hon kawkmuhta.
english: Yahweh gave me knowledge of it, and I knew it: then you showed me their doings.

paite: "Kei bel belamnou nunnemtak, goh ding a pi bang ka hi, sing pen agah toh, hihse ni e, mihing gam a kipan amah zaw i hihmang vengveng ding uh, amin mawngmawng theih ahihlouhna ding in, chi a ka tung a athil sawm uh ka na thei het kei.”
english: But I was like a gentle lamb that is led to the slaughter; and I didn’t know that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with its fruit, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

paite: Himahleh, aw sepaihte' TOUPA, diktak a vaihawmpa, sunggil lam leh lungtang entelpa, atung ua na phulak hon musak in, ka tungthu lah na kiang ah ka hon kemsak hi, chi in.
english: But, Yahweh of Armies, who judges righteously, who tests the heart and the mind, I shall see your vengeance on them; for to you have I revealed my cause.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA'N Anathoth mi, na hinna zongpa, "Ka khut ua na sihlouhna ding in TOUPA min in thu gen ke'n," chi mite tungtang ah hichi in achi:
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning the men of Anathoth, who seek your life, saying, You shall not prophesy in the name of Yahweh, that you not die by our hand;

paite: "Ngai un, amau ka gawt ding a, tangvalte namsau in asi ding ua, atanute uh, atapate uh kial in asi ding uh;
english: therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine;

paite: khosuak kuamah a-om kei ding uh; Anathoth mite tung ah thil hoih lou ka tun dek ngal a; agawtna kum ding uh atun hun chiang in."
english: and there shall be no remnant to them: for I will bring evil on the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

paite: Aw TOUPA, na kiang a ka phun in leng, nang zaw na dik nilouh a; himahleh ka vuina thu pen ka gen ding hi. Bangchi in ahia mithulimloute lam alamzan zel uh? Bangchi in ahia khemhat peuhmah nuamsa a a-om nak uh?
english: You are righteous, Yahweh, when I contend with you; yet I would reason the cause with you: why does the way of the wicked prosper? why are all they at ease who deal very treacherously?

paite: Amau na phut a, ahi, zung akaita ua, akhang ua, ahi, gah asuahta uhi; amuk un hon naih ua, asunggil un hon gamlat uhi.
english: You have planted them, yes, they have taken root; they grow, yes, they bring forth fruit: you are near in their mouth, and far from their heart.

paite: Aw TOUPA kei bel na hon thei a, na hon mu a, nang lam ah ka lungtang na entel sek a, amaute goh ding belam bang mai in kaikhia inla, agohna ni ding uh sep in.
english: But you, Yahweh, know me; you see me, and try my heart toward you: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

paite: Gam in bang tan ahia asuun ding a, anteh louhingte avuai ding uh? Ateng mite thulim louh ziak in gamsate amang khin ua, vasate leng, "I hun nanung uh amu kei ding uh," achih ziak un.
english: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? for the wickedness of those who dwell therein, the animals are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our latter end.

paite: "Khe a pai mite toh na kitaiteh a, nang ahon bahsak khit uleh bangchi in sakolte na kitaitehpih thei dia? Muanna gam ah bittak in om lechin leng, Jordan gammang ah bangchi in na hih dia?
english: If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? and though in a land of peace you are secure, yet how will you do in the pride of the Jordan?

paite: Na unaute, na pa inkuante ngei in, amau nang ahon khemta ngal ua; amau nang hon delh in ngaihtak in ahon sam ua, thuhoihtak gen mah le uh taksang himhim ke'n."
english: For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; even they have cried aloud after you: don’t believe them, though they speak beautiful words to you.

paite: "Ka inn-le-lou paisan in ka gouluah ding ka paimangta; ka hinna in a-it mahmah nu, amelma kiang ah ka peta hi.
english: I have forsaken my house, I have cast off my heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

paite: Ka gouluah ding gamnuai humpinelkai bang ahong hita, ka siatna ding in a-aw asuah a, huaiziak in ka mudah ahi.
english: My heritage has become to me as a lion in the forest: she has uttered her voice against me; therefore I have hated her.

paite: Ka gouluah ding kei a ding in sasial ne vasa gial ahi hia? Sasial ne vasate'n akimvel in asual ua hia? Gamsa teng va kaikhawm unla, nek bei ding in hon pi un.
english: Is my heritage to me as a speckled bird of prey? are the birds of prey against her all around? Go, assemble all the animals of the field, bring them to devour.

paite: "Belamchingmi tampi in ka grephuan ahihsia ua, ka tan asikden ua, ka tantuan nuam mahmah mai gamdai gam segawp asuaksakta uh.
english: Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

paite: Gamsia in abawlta ua, asegawp a, ka kiang ah avui hi, agam pumpi asegawp a, himahleh kuamah in adonsak kei uh.
english: They have made it a desolation; it mourns to me, being desolate; the whole land is made desolate, because no man lays it to heart.

paite: Gamdai a tang giau tengteng ah, hihse mite ahong tungta ua, gam tawp khat lam a kipan leh khat lam pha in TOUPA namsau in lah anebeita a, muanna nei himhim a-omta kei uh.
english: Destroyers have come on all the bare heights in the wilderness; for the sword of Yahweh devours from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh has peace.

paite: Buhchi atuh ua, ling ala ua, akihihgimgawp ua, punna lah a-om tuan kei, TOUPA heh mahmah ziak in gah na suahte uh na zumpih ding uh."
english: They have sown wheat, and have reaped thorns; they have put themselves to pain, and profit nothing: and you shall be ashamed of your fruits, because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.

paite: Ka mi Israel kiang a gouluah ding a ka piak khoihsemi, ka inveng giloute tengteng tungtang ah TOUPA'N hichibang in achi: "Ngai un, agam ua kipan ka botkhe ding a, alak ua kipan Judah inkote ka phawikhe ding.
english: Thus says Yahweh against all my evil neighbors, who touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit: behold, I will pluck them up from off their land, and will pluck up the house of Judah from among them.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka bohkhiak nung in amau ka hehpih nawn ding a, michih gouluah ding leh michih ama gam mah ah ka hon pi ding.
english: It shall happen, after that I have plucked them up, I will return and have compassion on them; and I will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Baal kiang a ka mite kichiam a asinsak mah bang un, ka min a, 'TOUPA ahin a ahin sung', chi a kichiam a akisin ua, ka mite omdan ngenteltak a asin uleh ka mite lak ah ka dingkhesak ding.
english: It shall happen, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, As Yahweh lives; even as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built up in the midst of my people.

paite: Himahleh angaihkhiak kei ualeh huai nam aboh in ka botkhe ding a, ka hihse ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But if they will not hear, then will I pluck up that nation, plucking up and destroying it, says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Puanmalngat kawnggak lei inla, kawtsak lou in gak in."
english: Thus says Yahweh to me, Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thu bangbang in kawnggak ka lei a, ka gakta hi.
english: So I bought a belt according to the word of Yahweh, and put it on my waist.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
english: The word of Yahweh came to me the second time, saying,

paite: "Na kawnggak lei, huai na kawng a om pen la in, thou inla, Euphrates Luipi zuan inla, huai a suangheng kal ah sel in," chi in.
english: Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N thu hon piak bang in ka kuan a, Euphrates Luipi chin ah ka selta hi.
english: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as Yahweh commanded me.

paite: Ni tampi nung in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, Euphrates Luipi zuan inla, kawnggak ka hon selsak lakhia in," achi hi.
english: It happened after many days, that Yahweh said to me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.

paite: Huchi in Euphrates Luipi ah ka hohta a, ka thai a, ka selna a kipan kawnggak ka pholhkhia hi. Huan ngai dih, kawnggak ana ngot khin vek a; bangmah ding in leng aphatuamta kei hi.
english: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Then the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: hichi mah bang in Judah kisathei pipi leh Jerusalem ki-otsakna mahmahte ka hihse dek hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, In this way I will mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

paite: Hiai nam giloute, ka thute ngaikhe nuam lou a, amau lungsim genhak zui a pathian dangte' nna sem leh be ding a delh mite kawnggak bangmah ding a phatuam lou bang ahi ding uh.
english: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and are gone after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.

paite: Kawnggakmi kawng a abelh gige bang in Israel inkote pumpi leh Judah inko pumpi ka mite, ka minthanna, ka kilawmna leh ka thupina ahong hihtheihna ding ua ka kiang a belh gige ding a ka bawl ahi uhi; himahleh alimsak kei uh.
english: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so have I caused to cling to me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, says Yahweh; that they may be to me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

paite: Hiai thu akiang ua na gen ding ahi: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Thawl chiteng uain in adim ding," chi in. Huan amaute'n na kiang ah, "Thawl chiteng uain in adim ding chih ka theih louh uh ahi maw?" achi ding uh.
english: Therefore you shall speak to them this word: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall tell you, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

paite: Huchi in akiang uah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, hiai gam a teng tengteng, David tutphah a tu kumpipate, siampute, zawlneite leh Jerusalem a teng tengtengte zukhamna in ka dimsak ding.
english: Then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

paite: Amau ka kiphusak ding a, pate atate uh toh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; amau ka hihmanlouhna ding khop in ka hehpih in hiam ka hawi in hiam ka zahngai kei hial ding."
english: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, says Yahweh: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have compassion, that I should not destroy them.

paite: Ngaikhia unla, bildoh un; kisathei kei un, TOUPA'N thu akhahta hi.
english: Hear, and give ear; don’t be proud; for Yahweh has spoken.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh pahtawi unla, mialna atunsak ma a khomui tung ate na khe uh akipal ma in, vak na lamet laitak un mial asuaksak a, mial bikbek ding in abawl ding hi.
english: Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it gross darkness.

paite: Himahleh na ngaihkhiak kei uleh na kisaktheihna uh ziak in mundai ah ka kap nilouh ding a, ka khitui leng nakpitak in aluang gige ding; TOUPA belamhon sal a kaih ahih ziak un.
english: But if you will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret for your pride; and my eye shall weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because Yahweh’s flock is taken captive.

paite: Kumpipa leh anu kiang ah, "Niam tut un, na lukhute uh aketa hi, na lallukhu thupi uh," chi in.
english: Say to the king and to the queen mother, Humble yourselves, sit down; for your headdresses have come down, even the crown of your glory.

paite: Sim khopite abing khin a, kuamah hon vual louh in; Judah tengteng sal in atang ua, avek un atang khin uhi.
english: The cities of the South are shut up, and there is none to open them: Judah is carried away captive, all of it; it is wholly carried away captive.

paite: Na mit uh daktou unla, mallam a kipan ahong kuan en un. Na belamhon neih koi ah, huai na belamhon deihhuaitak?
english: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north: where is the flock that was given you, your beautiful flock?

paite: Nangmah in lawm ding a na bawlte na tung a akoih hun chiang un bangchi in na chi dia? Numei nauvei bang mai in na na sa ngial kei ding maw?
english: What will you say, when he shall set over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? shall not sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?

paite: Bangziak in ahia hiaite ka tung a ahong tun? Chi sim na hihleh, na thulimlouhna ziak in ahi na nik lem ahih a na vuaktanna akimuh.
english: If you say in your heart, Why are these things come on me? for the greatness of your iniquity are your skirts uncovered, and your heels suffer violence.

paite: Ethiopia mivom in avun ahihlamdang in gialbem in azia asel thei a hia? Huchi ahihleh nou thil gilou hihhatsekte'n leng thil hoih hihthei na ve uteh!
english: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.

paite: Gamdai huih in buhsi amutleng bang mai in amau ka dalhsak ding.
english: Therefore will I scatter them, as the stubble that passes away, by the wind of the wilderness.

paite: Hiai na tantuan, na tuam dia ka hon sehsak ahi, na hon mangngilh a, zuau a na kingak ziak in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me, says Yahweh; because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

paite: Huchi in kei mahmah in na mai khuh hial in na nik ka hon lemsak ding a, na zumhuaina adawk ding hi.
english: Therefore will I also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame shall appear.

paite: Gamlak a mualte a na angkawmnate, na huk kikou husate, na kiphalgaih thupidante, huai na thilhih kihhuaite ka muta. Aw Jerusalem, na tung agik hi; hihsiang na hih ma bang tan hi ding ahia?
english: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries, and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean; how long shall it yet be?

paite: Khokheng tungtang a Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung;
english: The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought.

paite: Judah in asuun a, akulh kongpite angui; lei ah puan vom khu in akun ua, Jerusalem kah ging atungkah.
english: Judah mourns, and its gates languish, they sit in black on the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

paite: Amilalte'n asikhate uh tui atawisak ua, tuichin azuan ua, tui amu kei uh, tuibel hawm in akik ua; abeidong ua, gen ding athei kei ua, alu uh akhuh uhi.
english: Their nobles send their little ones to the waters: they come to the cisterns, and find no water; they return with their vessels empty; they are disappointed and confounded, and cover their heads.

paite: Gam pum a vuahtui a-om louh ziak in lei akhang a, lei let mite alungdong ua, alu uh akhuh uh.
english: Because of the ground which is cracked, because no rain has been in the land, the plowmen are disappointed, they cover their heads.

paite: Ahi, zukpi in leng loubuk ah nou anei a, louhing a-om louh ziak in ataisan hi.
english: Yes, the hind also in the field calves, and forsakes her young, because there is no grass.

paite: Gam sabiltungte mualvum ah adingh ua, sehal bang in huihkhua ngai in anak huhu ua; nek ding loupa om louh ziak in amit uh amial dundun hi.
english: The wild donkeys stand on the bare heights, they pant for air like jackals; their eyes fail, because there is no herbage.

paite: Ka thulimlouhna un hon hek mahleh na min ziak in aw TOUPA hong kuan in; ka puknate uh lah atamta ngal a, na tung mahmah ah thil ka na hihkhial uhi.
english: Though our iniquities testify against us, work for your name’s sake, Yahweh; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you.

paite: Aw nang Israelte lamet, mangbat lai a hondampa, bangziak a hiai gam a mikhual bang zen a zan khat giak a zin bang lel a om na hia?
english: You hope of Israel, its Savior in the time of trouble, why should you be as a foreigner in the land, and as a wayfaring man who turns aside to stay for a night?

paite: Bangziak a mi lungkegawp bang phet leh pasalpha hondam thei lou bang lel a om na hia? Himahleh nang zaw, aw TOUPA, ka lak uah na om lai a, na min ka pu ua, hon paisan ke'n.
english: Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, Yahweh, are in the midst of us, and we are called by your name; don’t leave us.

paite: TOUPA'N hiai mite tungtang ah hichi in achi: Vakmang a-ut nak ua, akalsuan uh akidek kei uh; huchi in TOUPA'N amau apom kei a, athulimlouhna uh atheigigeta ding a, akhelhna uh agawt ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh to this people, Even so have they loved to wander; they have not refrained their feet: therefore Yahweh does not accept them; now he will remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Hiai mite hoihna ding ngetsak ke'n.
english: Yahweh said to me, Don’t pray for this people for their good.

paite: An ngawl mah le uh akikou uh ka ngaikhe kei ding a, halmang leh buh-le-bal thillat lan mah le uh ka dawng kei ding; namsau, kial, hipi in amau ka hihmang zaw ding," achi hi.
english: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and meal offering, I will not accept them; but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

paite: Ke'n, "Eh, Toupa PATHIAN, ngai dih, akiang uah zawlneite'n, 'Namsau na tuak kei ding ua, kial leng na thuak kei ding uh, hiai mun ah muan mahmahna ka hon pe zaw ding hi, achi sek ngal ua,' " ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, Ah, Lord Yahweh! behold, the prophets tell them, You shall not see the sword, neither shall you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Zawlneite'n ka min a zuau gen zel ahi ve ua le; amau ka sawl kei a, thu ka khak kei a, ka houpih sam kei hi. Thil amuh kholhlouhte uh, aisan bangmah a pangloute leh alungsim dohate uh hon hilh ahi ve ua," achi hi.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name; I didn’t send them, neither have I commanded them, neither spoke I to them: they prophesy to you a lying vision, and divination, and a thing of nothing, and the deceit of their own heart.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ka sawl louh a ka min lou a, 'Hiai gam ah kial leh namsau atung kei ding,' chi a zawlnei thugen genmi, huai zawlneite namsau leh kial in amangthang ding uh.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name, and I didn’t send them, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land: By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

paite: Huan athugenna uh nam leng kial leh namsau ziak in Jerusalem kongzing ah paihkhiak ahi ding ua, atanute uh atapate uh toh, vuimi himhim anei kei ding uh. Athulimlouhna uh amau tung ah ka sung dek ngal a."
english: The people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them—them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness on them.

paite: Huan akiang ua hiai thu na gen ding ahi: "Sun leh zan in ka khitui luang hen, hul himhim kei hen, ka mi, ka tanu nungak siangthou in nakpi a liamna atuak hi, khutkhak na mahmah toh.
english: You shall say this word to them, Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease; for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous wound.

paite: Gam a ka pawtleh, maizen, namsau a thahte! Khopi a ka lutleh, maizen, kialpi a misi! Gam chih ah zawlneite, siampute avakvai chiat ua, adan mahmah athei kei uh," chi in.
english: If I go forth into the field, then, behold, the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then, behold, those who are sick with famine! for both the prophet and the priest go about in the land, and have no knowledge.

paite: Judah paikhe siang na hi hiam? Zion kih na hi maw? Kou a dia hihdamna om lou bikbek a bangziak a hon thuaksak na hia? Muanna ka zong ua, hoihna bangmah ahong tung kei; hihdamna hun ding leng, ngai dih buaina lel.
english: Have you utterly rejected Judah? has your soul loathed Zion? why have you struck us, and there is no healing for us? We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka thulimlouhdan uh ka kitheihmohbawl kei uhi, ka pipute uh ginatlouhna toh, na tung ah ka hihkhialta uhi.
english: We acknowledge, Yahweh, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against you.

paite: Na min ziak in hon musit ke'n, na laltutphah thupi minsesak ke'nla, ka kiang ua na thukhun theigige in hihse ke'n.
english: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake; do not disgrace the throne of your glory: remember, don’t break your covenant with us.

paite: Namdangte pathiante lak ah vuah zusak thei a-om uhia? Ahihleh, van in vuahpi atungsak thei hia? Aw TOUPA ka Pathian uh, huai pen nang na hi kei maw? Hiai thil tengteng na hih ahi a, ka lamet uh nang na hi.
english: Are there any among the vanities of the nations that can cause rain? or can the sky give showers? Aren’t you he, Yahweh our God? therefore we will wait for you; for you have made all these things.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Mosi leh Samuel ka ma ah hong dingh mah le uh, ka lungsim hiai mite lam anga tuan kei ding. Ka muh phak louh ah delhkhia inla, paimang uhen!
english: Then Yahweh said to me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind would not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

paite: Huan koi ah ka pai ding ua chi a nang a hon dot uleh hichi in akiang uah na chi ding hi. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Sihna a si dingte, sihna ah; namsau thuak dingte, namsau ah; kial thuak dingte, kial ah; saltang dingte, saltanna ah.
english: It shall happen, when they tell you, Where shall we go forth? Then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh: Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for captivity, to captivity.

paite: Thil li ka sehsak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; that ding in namsau, keizan ding in ui, ne khin leh hihmang ding in tung leng vasate leh gam sahangte.
english: I will appoint over them four kinds, says Yahweh: the sword to kill, and the dogs to tear, and the birds of the sky, and the animals of the earth, to devour and to destroy.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah tapa Manasseh in Jerusalem a athilhih ziak in lei kumpipa gam tengteng lak a vial sepsep ding in ka bawl ding.
english: I will cause them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh, the son of Hezekiah, king of Judah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

paite: "Kua'n ahon hehpih dia aw Jerusalem? Kua'n hon lungkhampih dia? Na omdan dong ding in kua alampial dia oi?
english: For who will have pity on you, Jerusalem? or who will bemoan you? or who will turn aside to ask of your welfare?

paite: Nang na hon paikhia a, na nungtawn tawn a," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. "Huchi in kisik ka chimtak a, na tung ah ka khut ka lika, ka hon hihmang hi.
english: You have rejected me, says Yahweh, you have gone backward: therefore have I stretched out my hand against you, and destroyed you; I am weary with repenting.

paite: Gam pumpi a kulh kongpite ah kizapna in amau ka zap a, ta bei in ka bawl a, ka mite ka hihmang a; a-omdan uh akiheisan louh ziak un.
english: I have winnowed them with a fan in the gates of the land; I have bereaved them of children, I have destroyed my people; they didn’t return from their ways.

paite: Tuipi piaunel sang a tam in ameithaite uh ka pungsak ding a, suntang lai in tangvalte siatna ding in atung uah lokmi ka tungsak a, mangbatna leh thil mulkimhuai ka tungsak guih hi.
english: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas; I have brought on them against the mother of the young men a destroyer at noonday: I have caused anguish and terrors to fall on her suddenly.

paite: Sagih suangnu abahgawp a; akha akhahta; sun ahih lai in ani aketa, zahlak in alungbuai a; huan akhosuaksunte, amelmate uh khut ah namsau a thah ding in ka pe ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: She who has borne seven languishes; she has given up the spirit; her sun is gone down while it was yet day; she has been disappointed and confounded: and their residue will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, says Yahweh.

paite: "Nu ei, gam pumpi a kituahlouhna mi leh kikalhna mi a na hon na suan ka tung gik hi na tel e! Ka leitawisak kei a, mite'n leng ahon leitawisak kei uh; himahleh avek un hamsia ahon loh uhi.
english: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not lent, neither have men lent to me; yet everyone of them curses me.

paite: TOUPA'N, chihtak ngial in thil hoih a ding in ka hon hihkip ding; chihtak ngial in siatna ni leh haksatna ni in melma na kiang ah khut ka dohsak ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said, Most certainly I will strengthen you for good; most certainly I will cause the enemy to make supplication to you in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

paite: Sik in mallam sik leh ngen akitansak thei dia hia?
english: Can one break iron, even iron from the north, and brass?

paite: "Gam pumpi a na khelhna tengteng ziak in na hauhsakna leh na goute, aman bei in gallak ding in ka pe ding.
english: Your substance and your treasures will I give for a spoil without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

paite: Na theih ngei louh gam ah na melmate nna ka hon semsak ding. Ka heh ziak a na tung a mei ampha ding akuangkheta hi," achi hi.
english: I will make them to pass with your enemies into a land which you don’t know; for a fire is kindled in my anger, which shall burn on you.

paite: Nang na thei hi, aw TOUPA, hon theigige inla, hong veh in, hon simmohte tung ah phuba hon laksak in. Na dohzohna ke'n manthat loh kei leng; nang ziak a minsiat thuak ka hi chih thei in.
english: Yahweh, you know; remember me, and visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors; don’t take me away in your longsuffering: know that for your sake I have suffered reproach.

paite: Na thute hihlat ahia, ka ne a, na thute kei a ding in kipahna leh ka lungtang nopna ahi; aw TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, na min lah ka puta ngal ua.
english: Your words were found, and I ate them; and your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart: for I am called by your name, Yahweh, God of Armies.

paite: Nopbawl mite lak ah ka tel kei a, ka kipahpih sam kei; nang khut ziak in ka tu tuam a, lungkimlouhna in na hon dimsak hi.
english: I didn’t sit in the assembly of those who make merry, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of your hand; for you have filled me with indignation.

paite: Bangziak a ka natna dai thei lou a, ka liamna damthei lou ahia, hihdam ut lou bang mai a? Ka tung ah phaizang khemhat tui kang sekte bang na hi ding a hia?
english: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? Will you indeed be to me as a deceitful brook, as waters that fail?

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kiheileh angei ka hon bangsak ding, ka ma ah na dingh nawn ding. Thil gina lou a kipan thil manpha ngen na genkhiakleh keimah kam bang na hi ding. Amau nang lam hong nga uhenla, nang bel amau lam na nga ding ahi kei.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh, If you return, then will I bring you again, that you may stand before me; and if you take forth the precious from the vile, you shall be as my mouth: they shall return to you, but you shall not return to them.

paite: Hiai mite lak ah ngen kulhbaang in ka hon bawl ding a, ahon sual ding ua, himahleh ahon zou kei ding uh, nang hon hondam ding leh hunkhe ding in na kiang ah ka om ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will make you to this people a fortified bronze wall; and they shall fight against you, but they shall not prevail against you; for I am with you to save you and to deliver you, says Yahweh.

paite: Migiloute khut a kipan ka hon hunkhe ding a, mi lauhuaite khut a kipan ka hon pawtkhesak ding.
english: I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: The word of Yahweh came also to me, saying,

paite: "Zi na nei ding ahi kei a, hiai mun ah tanu tapate leng na nei ding ahi sam kei," chi in.
english: You shall not take a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters, in this place.

paite: Tanu tapa hiai mun a piangte leh hiai gam a nu leh pa amaute suangte tungtang TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: For thus says Yahweh concerning the sons and concerning the daughters who are born in this place, and concerning their mothers who bore them, and concerning their fathers who became their father in this land:

paite: "Hipi in asi ding ua, kuamah vui louh leh kuamah suun louh in a-om ding uh; leitung ekvut bang lel ahi ding uh. Namsaute, kialte in amangthang ding ua, aluangte uh tungleng vasate leh gamsate an ahi ding hi.
english: They shall die grievous deaths: they shall not be lamented, neither shall they be buried; they shall be as dung on the surface of the ground; and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their dead bodies shall be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Lusuunna inn ah lut ke'nla, suun ding in hoh ke'nla, amaute kah ke'n; hiai mite lak a kipan ka lungmuanna ka hawkta ngal a, zahngaihna leh lainatnate toh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For thus says Yahweh, Don’t enter into the house of mourning, neither go to lament, neither bemoan them; for I have taken away my peace from this people, says Yahweh, even loving kindness and tender mercies.

paite: Hiai gam ah milian leh mineu a si ding ua; vui ahi kei ding ua; kuama'n asuun kei ding ua, aki-at un akimetgiau loh kei ding uh.
english: Both great and small shall die in this land; they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them;

paite: Lusuun mite amisi ngaih uh lungmuan ding in kuamah in nek ding alui kei ding ua, anu uh hiam apa uh hiam ziak in leng nepna nou dawn ding kuamah in atun kei ding uhi.
english: neither shall men break bread for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

paite: Huan ne leh dawn ding in alak ua tu ding in ankuangluina inn ah na lut ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not go into the house of feasting to sit with them, to eat and to drink.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi ngal a: "Ngai dih ua, na mitmuh un, na damsung un mou awte, mouneipa awte, nopsakna husate, kipahna gingte hiai mun ah ka daisak ding."
english: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place, before your eyes and in your days, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.

paite: Hiai thu tengteng hiai mite kiang a na hilh hun chiang in amau, "Bangziak in ahia TOUPA'N ka tung ua hichitak a thil hoih lou ahon genkhiak? Bang ahia ka thulimlouhna uh? TOUPA ka Pathian uh tung a ka thilhihkhelh bang ahia?" ahon chih uleh,
english: It shall happen, when you shall show this people all these words, and they shall tell you, Why has Yahweh pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against Yahweh our God?

paite: hichi in na chi ding hi: "Na pipute un ahon paisan ziak uh ahi, pathian dangte adelh ua, a-nna uh asem ua, abia ua, ahon paisan ua, ka dan azui kei ua;
english: Then you shall tell them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, says Yahweh, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshiped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

paite: huan noute'n na pipute uh sang a lek lua in na hih ua, ngai un, michih in noumau lungtang gilou paupeng na zui ua, kei na hon ngaikhe kei uh.
english: and you have done evil more than your fathers; for, behold, you walk every one after the stubbornness of his evil heart, so that you don’t listen to me:

paite: Huaiziak in ka gam a kipan noute leh na pipute un leng na theih ngei louh uh gam ah ka hon delhkhe ding, huai ah sun leh zan in pathian dangte nna na sem ding ua, deihsakna ka hon lak dek ngal kei a," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: therefore will I cast you forth out of this land into the land that you have not known, neither you nor your fathers; and there you shall serve other gods day and night; for I will show you no favor.

paite: Huchi in ngai dih ua, nite ahong tung dek hi, TOUPA thupawt in achi, "Israel suante Aigupta gam a kipan a pikhepa ahin a ahin sung, chita lou in,
english: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that it shall no more be said, As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

paite: mallam gam leh adelhzakna gam tengteng a kipan a Israel suante pikhepa TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, achi zawta ding uh," apipute uh kiang a ka piak, amau gam mahmah ah lah ka pikik nawn ding hi.
english: but, As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north, and from all the countries where he had driven them. I will bring them again into their land that I gave to their fathers.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, ngamanmi tampi ka thukhak ding a, amau aman ding ua; huai khit in gamvakmi tampi ka thukhak ding a, tang chiteng leh mual chiteng a kipan amaute abengkhe ding ua, suangpi heng kal a kipan in leng.
english: Behold, I will send for many fishermen, says Yahweh, and they shall fish them up; and afterward I will send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the clefts of the rocks.

paite: A-omdan tengteng uah lah ka mit atu nilouh ngal a; kei a kipan sel in a-om kei ua, athulimlouhna uh leng ka mit a kipan sel in a-om sam kei hi.
english: For my eyes are on all their ways; they are not hidden from my face, neither is their iniquity concealed from my eyes.

paite: Huchi in athilkihhuai luangte ua ka gam ahihnit ualeh akihhuaina ua ka goutan gam adimsak ziak un athulimlouhna uh leh akhelhna uh azahnih in ka thuk ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: First I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double, because they have polluted my land with the carcasses of their detestable things, and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.

paite: Aw TOUPA, ka hatna leh ka kulhpi, mangbat ni a ka kihumbitna, kawlmong a kipan in namte ahong pai ding ua: "Ka pipute un zuau, thil gina lou, punna nei hilou kia lou ngal bangmah gouluah in anei kei uh.
english: Yahweh, my strength, and my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, to you shall the nations come from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Our fathers have inherited nothing but lies, vanity and things in which there is no profit.

paite: Mi'n pathiante akibawlsak thei ua hia? Huaite pathian ahi sam ua,” achi ding uh.
english: Shall a man make to himself gods, which yet are no gods?

paite: "Huaiziak in ngai dih ua, tutung in amau ka theisak peuhmah ding; ka khut leh ka thilhihtheihna ka theisak ding, ka min TOUPA ahi chih athei ding uh."
english: Therefore behold, I will cause them to know, this once will I cause them to know my hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is Yahweh.

paite: Judah khelhna sik laigelhna leh suangmantam hiam mukzum a gelh ahi; alungtang pek ua khuak in a-om a, amaitam uahte leng;
english: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is engraved on the tablet of their heart, and on the horns of your altars;

paite: sing hing bul leh mual pawngte ah atate un amaitamte uleh a Asherahte uh atheigige ngal ua.
english: while their children remember their altars and their Asherim by the green trees on the high hills.

paite: Aw nang gam a ka tang, gam dung tawn a na khelhna ziak in na sum leh na gou tengteng, na mun sangte toh gallak ding in ka pe ding hi.
english: My mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures for a spoil, and your high places, because of sin, throughout all your borders.

paite: Huai na tantuam ka hon piak na tan ding a, na gam theih ngeih louh ah na melmate nna ka hon semsak ding, ka hehna mei, tangtawn a kang ding lah na mut kuangta ngal ua.
english: You, even of yourself, shall discontinue from your heritage that I gave you; and I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you don’t know: for you have kindled a fire in my anger which shall burn forever.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mihing muang a, mihing bantha hatna muang a, TOUPA lehngatsan lungtang neimi hamsethuak in om hen.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Cursed is the man who trusts in man, and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart departs from Yahweh.

paite: Gamdai a loupa keu gaw bang ahi a, thil hoih pawt ding amu kei ding. Gamdai gamkeu, chi gam, kuamah luah louh ah ateng zaw ding hi.
english: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good comes, but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, a salt land and not inhabited.

paite: TOUPA muangmi, alametpen TOUPA hi in nuam asa hi.
english: Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose trust Yahweh is.

paite: Tui kiang a sing suan, lui gei a zungkai, kholum hong tung ding patau lou, anahte hing gige, khokhen kum khawk sa lou, gah suan kikhelsak tuan lou bang ahi ding hi.
english: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, who spreads out its roots by the river, and shall not fear when heat comes, but its leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

paite: Lungtang bel thil tengteng sang in khemhat pen, hoih lou pumlum ahi a; kua'n ahia theithei ding?
english: The heart is deceitful above all things, and it is exceedingly corrupt: who can know it?

paite: Kei TOUPA bel michih a-omdan bang zel uleh athilhih gah bang zel a pe ding a lungsim enkhepa, lungtang enchianpa ka hi.
english: I, Yahweh, search the mind, I try the heart, even to give every man according to his ways, according to the fruit of his doings.

paite: Mi, kilawm lou a hong hau bel vengkeng, ama tuiloupi keuhsak dia op bang ahi, adam lai ngei in amah atuansan ding ua, atawp in mihai ahong himai ding.
english: As the partridge that sits on eggs which she has not laid, so is he who gets riches, and not by right; in the midst of his days they shall leave him, and at his end he shall be a fool.

paite: Ka mun siangthou omna bel laltutphah thupi mahmah, atung a kipan a tawisang a om ahi.
english: A glorious throne, set on high from the beginning, is the place of our sanctuary.

paite: Aw TOUPA Israel lamet, nang hon paisan mi tengteng azahlak ding uh; kei hon lehngatsan mite lei a leivui a gelh bang lel ahi ding uh, TOUPA hinna tuikhuk pen lah apaisanta ngal ua.
english: Yahweh, the hope of Israel, all who forsake you shall be disappointed. Those who depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahweh, the spring of living waters.

paite: Aw TOUPA hon hihdam inla, huchi in ka dam ding a, hon humbit lechin, huchi in ka bit ding, ka phat gige nang na hi.
english: Heal me, O Yahweh, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for you are my praise.

paite: "Ngai in, ka kiang ah, TOUPA thu koi ah? Hong tung leh ake," achi sek uh.
english: Behold, they tell me, Where is the word of Yahweh? let it come now.

paite: Thil hoih lou tungsak ding ka hon phut kei a, siatna ni lah ka deih het kei chih na thei hi; ka kam a thupawt lah na maima a om ahi ngal a.
english: As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you; neither have I desired the woeful day; you know: that which came out of my lips was before your face.

paite: Kei a ding in kihtakhuai hi ke'nla, mangbat ni a ka kihumbitna na hi.
english: Don’t be a terror to me: you are my refuge in the day of evil.

paite: Hon simmohte zahlak uhenla, kei bel zahlak kei leng; amau bel lungzing uhenla, kei bel lungzing kei leng; mangbat ni atung uah tun inla, nakpi in amaute hihmang in.
english: Let them be disappointed who persecute me, but let not me be disappointed; let them be dismayed, but don’t let me be dismayed; bring on them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: Kuan inla, Judah kumpipate lutna zel leh pawtna zel, mipite tate kongpi ah leh Jerusalem kongpite tengteng ah va dingh inla;
english: Thus said Yahweh to me: Go, and stand in the gate of the children of the people, through which the kings of Judah come in, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

paite: akiang uah, "Nou Judah kumpipate, Judah tengtengte, Jerusalem a teng tengteng hiai kongpi a lut sekte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un."
english: and tell them, Hear the word of Yahweh, you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na hinna uh pilvang mahmah dih ua, Sabbath ni in puak nei kei unla, Jerusalem kulh kongpi ah lutpih sam kei un.
english: Thus says Yahweh, Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

paite: Huan Sabbath ni in na inn ua kipan puak na pokhe ding uh ahi kei a, nna na sem ding uh ahi sam kei; na pipute uh kiang a ka thupiak bang in Sabbath na tang siangthou zaw ding uh ahi.
english: neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day holy, neither do any work: but make the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

paite: Amau zaw angaikhe kei ua, bil adoh kei ua; thununna azak ua atanlouhna ding un akigenhaksak zaw uhi."
english: But they didn’t listen, neither turn their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, and might not receive instruction.

paite: TOUPA thupawt in hichi in achi: "Khawksatak a na hon ngaihkhiak ua, Sabbath ni a hiai khopi a kongpi a thil na puaklut louh ua,
english: It shall happen, if you diligently listen to me, says Yahweh, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but to make the Sabbath day holy, to do no work therein;

paite: nna na sep louh ua Sabbath na tan siangthou uleh, hiai khopi kongpi ah leh heutute, David tutphah a tu dingte kangtalaite leh sakolte ah tuang in ahong lut ding ua, amau leh amiliante uh Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte toh; huchi in hiai khopi ah mi atengdenta ding uh.
english: then shall there enter in by the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall remain forever.

paite: Judah khopi leh Jerusalem kim a kipan, Benjamin gam a kipan, gam niam gam a kipan, tanggam a kipan leh Sim gam a kipan in ahong pai ding ua, halmang thillat leh kithoihnate buh-le-bal thillat leh gimlimte, kipahna kithoihnate TOUPA inn ah ahon tawi ding uh.
english: They shall come from the cities of Judah, and from the places around Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the lowland, and from the hill country, and from the South, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meal offerings, and frankincense, and bringing sacrifices of thanksgiving, to the house of Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh Sabbath tang siangthou ding leh Sabbath ni a puak neih louh leh Jerusalem kulh kongpi a lutpih louh ding thu ah na hon ngaihkhiak kei uleh akulh kongpite ah mei ka pawtsak ding a, Jerusalem kumpipa' inn te akangbei ding a, amit kei ding hi."
english: But if you will not listen to me to make the Sabbath day holy, and not to bear a burden and enter in at the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

paite: TOUPA a kipan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung in hichi in achi:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, belvelmi inn ah hohsuk inla, huai ah ka thute ka hon theisak ding," achi hi.
english: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.

paite: Huchi in belvelmi inn ah ka hohsukta a, abel bawlna khawl ah nna asem hi.
english: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and behold, he was making a work on the wheels.

paite: Tung a bel abawl lai ahong hoih keileh belvelmi'n hoih asak bang in bel dang ding in abawl nawn zel hi.
english: When the vessel that he made of the clay was marred in the hand of the potter, he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

paite: Huchi in ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a,
english: Then the word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: "Aw Israel inkote aw, hiai belvelmi hih bang in nou ka hon hihthei kei a hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ngai dih ua, belvelmi khut a tungman bang lel in ka khut ah na om uhi, aw Israel inkote aw,"
english: House of Israel, can’t I do with you as this potter? says Yahweh. Behold, as the clay in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, house of Israel.

paite: Chik lai in leng nam hiamgam hiam tungtang thu ah, ka hon dokkhe ding, ka hon phel ding a, ka hon hihse ding, chi in na gen mah leng,
english: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up and to break down and to destroy it;

paite: Huai nam in atungthu ka gen ziak a athil hoih lou hih alehngatsan leh atung a thil hoih lou hih ka tup ka kikhelsak ding.
english: if that nation, concerning which I have spoken, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do to them.

paite: Huan chik lai in leng nam hiamgam tungtang thu ah, ka hon bawl ding a, ka hon dingsak ding, chi a na gen hi leng zong,
english: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

paite: ka paukam suak ngaikhe lou a ka mitmuh a thil hoih lou ahihleh ama a ding in thil hoih hih ka tup ka kikhelsak sam ding.
english: if they do that which is evil in my sight, that they not obey my voice, then I will repent of the good, with which I said I would benefit them.

paite: Huaiziak in Judah mite leh Jerusalem a tengte kiang ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, na tung uah thil hoih lou ka ngaihtuah a, nou ka hon sawm lai na hi uh, michih in a-omdan hoih lou uh lehngatsan uhenla, na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh bawlpha un," va chi peuhmah in.
english: Now therefore, speak to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return you now everyone from his evil way, and amend your ways and your doings.

paite: Himahleh amau zaw, "Kilawm kei e! Koumau phasak bangbang in ka om ding ua, michih koumau lungtang gilou genhak bang zel in ka om ding uh," achi sek uhi.
english: But they say, It is in vain; for we will walk after our own devices, and we will do everyone after the stubbornness of his evil heart.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Namdangte dong him dih ua, hichibang mahmah kua'n athei a? Nungak siangthou Israel in thil lauhuai mahmah ahihta.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Ask now among the nations, who has heard such things; the virgin of Israel has done a very horrible thing.

paite: Lebanon vuk in amualvum anuse ngei a hia? Gamla a kipan a tui vot hong luangsukte akangtat ngei a hia?
