english: Shall the snow of Lebanon fail from the rock of the field? Shall the cold waters that flow down from afar be dried up?

paite: Ka mite'n ahon mangngilh ua, bangmah lou phet kiang ah gimlim ahal ua, huaite'n atuma lam lampi ua kipan akisuisak a, lampi pen hilou lamkhem lam azui uh;
english: For my people have forgotten me, they have burned incense to false gods; and they have been made to stumble in their ways, in the ancient paths, to walk in byways, in a way not built up;

paite: agam uh hihsiatgawp ahi dia, tangtawn a enghou ding; kivialleh min lamdang sa in alu uh asing ding ua.
english: to make their land an astonishment, and a perpetual hissing; everyone who passes thereby shall be astonished, and shake his head.

paite: Suahlam huihpi bang in melma ma ah ka thehzak ding, avangtah ni un ka mel hilou, ka dek ka musak ding hi.
english: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will show them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

paite: Huan amau, "Kisa un, Jeremiah i sawm ding uh, siampu a kipan dan adai kei ding a, mipil a kipan thudot adai sam kei ding, zawlnei a kipan thu adai kei ding hi. Kisa un, i gensegawp ding ua, athu i limsak kei ding," achi uhi.
english: Then they said, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

paite: Hon limsak inla, aw TOUPA ka hon ngetna thu limsak in.
english: Give heed to me, Yahweh, and listen to the voice of those who contend with me.

paite: Thil hoih a gilou dit ahi dia hia? Amau lah ka kha a ding in kokhuk atou ngal ua. Amau a kipan a na hehna heimang ding leh amau a dia thil hoih gen ding a na ma a ka din sek theigige in.
english: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have dug a pit for my soul. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.

paite: Huchi in atate uh kialpi kiang ah pekhia inla, namsau hatna kiang ah pia in; huan azite uh ta nei lou in, meithai uhen; apasalte uh hipi in si uhenla, atangvalte uh leng kidouna ah namsau in si uhen.
english: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and give them over to the power of the sword; and let their wives become childless, and widows; and let their men be slain of death, and their young men struck of the sword in battle.

paite: Sim mite akiang uh na tunsak guih lai in a-inn ua kipan kap husa thangkhia hen; kei a ding in kokhuk atou ngal ua, ka khe awkna ding in thang akam uhi.
english: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when you shall bring a troop suddenly on them; for they have dug a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

paite: Himahleh nang, aw TOUPA kei hon that ding a ahon sawmna tengteng uh na thei hi; athulimlouhna uh ngaidam ke'nla, na mitmuh in akhelhna uh thaimang sam ke'n. Na ma ah kipuk uhenla, na heh ni in amaute soisa in.
english: Yet, Yahweh, you know all their counsel against me to kill me; don’t forgive their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from your sight; but let them be overthrown before you; deal you with them in the time of your anger.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Kuan unla, belvelmi leibel va lei un; mipite upate leh siampu lak alupate pi inla;
english: Thus said Yahweh, Go, and buy a potter’s earthen bottle, and take some of the elders of the people, and of the elders of the priests;

paite: belvelmi kongpi lutna chin a Ben Hinnom Phaizang ah hoh inla, huai ah na kiang a thu ka hon hilh ding na puang ding hi.
english: and go forth to the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the gate Harsith, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell you;

paite: Hichi in na chi ding hi, "Judah kumpipate leh Jerusalem a tengte aw, TOUPA thu za un." Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, hiai mun ah aza peuhmah bil am khop hial a thil hoih lou ka hon tun ding hi.
english: and say, Hear the word of Yahweh, kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears shall tingle.

paite: Mite'n ahon paisan ua, hiai mun ahihnin un, amau leh apate uh leh Judah Kumpipate'n leng atheih ngei nai het louh uh, pathian dangte kiang ah gimlim ahal ziak uleh hiai mun mihoih sisan a adimsak ziak un leh Baal kiang a halmang thillat ding a atate uh ahalna ding ua Baal mun sangte alamkhiak ziak un;
english: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it to other gods, that they didn’t know, they and their fathers and the kings of Judah; and have filled this place with the blood of innocents,

paite: Huai zaw ka thupiak ahi kei a, gen leng ka gen sam kei a, ka lungsim ah leng a-om ngei kei hi.
english: and have built the high places of Baal, to burn their sons in the fire for burnt offerings to Baal; which I didn’t command, nor spoke it, neither came it into my mind:

paite: Huaiziak in ngai dih, nite ahong tung ding," TOUPA thupawt in achi; huai nite chiang in hiai mun Tophet chih ahita kei ding a, Ben Hinnom Phaizang chih ahi sam kei ding; kithahna Phaizang chih ahi zawta ding.
english: therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that this place shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of Slaughter.

paite: Huan hiai mun ah Judah leh Jerusalem thiltupte ka vuaksuaksak ding a; amau pen namsau in amelmate uh ma ah leh ahinna uh lak tum mite khut ah ka puksak ding; aluangte uh tung a leng vasate leh lei a gamsate an ding in ka pe ding.
english: I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hand of those who seek their life: and their dead bodies will I give to be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth.

paite: Huchi in hiai khopi lamdangsak ding leh enghou ding in ka bawl ding a, avialpai peuh in siatna atuahte ziak in lamdang asa ding ua, a-enghou lai ding uhi.
english: I will make this city an astonishment, and a hissing; everyone who passes thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all its plagues.

paite: Atanute uleh atapate uh sa ka nesak ding a; amelmate uh leh ahinna uh lak tum mite'n a-um ua amangbatsak hun chiang un kuapeuh in a-invengte uh sa ane ding uh.
english: I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters; and they shall eat everyone the flesh of his friend, in the siege and in the distress, with which their enemies, and those who seek their life, shall distress them.

paite: Huan na paipihte mitmuh in bel na hihtam ding a, akiang uah huchi in na chi ding.
english: Then you shall break the bottle in the sight of the men who go with you,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hichi mah bang in hiai mite leh hiai khua ka hihtam ding; mi'n belvelmi bel akitapsak a, bawlhoih nawn vual ahih louh bang in Tophet ah avui ding uh; vuina ding mun dang a-om louh ziak in.
english: and shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that can’t be made whole again; and they shall bury in Topheth, until there is no place to bury.

paite: Huchi hial in hiai mun ka bawl ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; hichi mah bang in hiai khua Tophet bang a bawl hial in, asung a tengte tung ah leng ka hih ding;
english: Thus will I do to this place, says Yahweh, and to its inhabitants, even making this city as Topheth:

paite: Jerusalem innte leh Judah kumpipate innte, inn chiteng mahmah atung a van lam thilte kiang a gimlim halkhitna tengteng leh pathian dangte kiang a dawn ding thillat butkhiaknasa tengtengte Tophet mun bang hial a hihnit ahi ding hi.
english: and the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, shall be as the place of Topheth, even all the houses on whose roofs they have burned incense to all the army of the sky, and have poured out drink offerings to other gods.

paite: Huan Jeremiah bel, TOUPA'N thugen ding a asawlna mun Tophet a kipan in ahong pai a; TOUPA' inn um sung ah adingh a, mipi tengteng kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth, where Yahweh had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of Yahweh’s house, and said to all the people:

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, thil hoih lou ka gen tengteng hiai khopi leh akho dang tengteng ah ka hon tungsak ding; ka thu ngaikhe lou ding a alungtang uh akhauhsak ziak un."
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring on this city and on all its towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it; because they have made their neck stiff, that they may not hear my words.

paite: Ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a, hichi in achi:
english: The word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: "Kuan inla, Jerusalem zak in kikou in, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, 'Na tuailai a na migitdante, kikham lai a na hon itdante ka theigige hi; gamdai a khoh louh gam a na hon zuihdan bang.
english: “Go, and cry in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, ‘Thus says Yahweh, “I remember for you the kindness of your youth, the love of your weddings; how you went after me in the wilderness, in a land that was not sown.

paite: Israel bel TOUPA a dia hihsiangthou, agahpung masa ahi, amah negaimi peuhmah amoh ding a, atung uah siatna ahong tung ding,’ " chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Israel was holiness to Yahweh, the first fruits of his increase. All who devour him shall be held guilty. Evil shall come on them,”’ says Yahweh.”

paite: Aw Jakob inkote leh Israel inkote tengteng aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un;
english: Hear the word of Yahweh, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Na pipute un kei ah diktatlouhna bang ahia amuh uh, kei a kipan gamlapi ah avakmang ua, bangmah loul delh a, ana ki-otsak uh?
english: Thus says Yahweh, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked after vanity, and are become vain?

paite: 'TOUPA, Aigupta gam a kipan hon pikhia a, gamdai, gamkeu, kokhuk mun, sihna limliap leh gamkeu mun, kuamah paisuak ngeilouhna, kuamah omlouhna mun a hon pi paisuakpa koi a om ahia? achi kei uh.
english: Neither did they say, ‘Where is Yahweh who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who led us through the wilderness, through a land of deserts and of pits, through a land of drought and of the shadow of death, through a land that none passed through, and where no man lived?’

paite: Gam hoihtak ah, agah leh hoihna ne ding in, ka hon pilut a, himahleh na lut uleh ka gam na hihnin ua, ka goutan thilkihhuai in na bawl uh.
english: I brought you into a plentiful land, to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination.

paite: Siampute'n, 'TOUPA koi a om ahia?' achi kei ua, Dan zang mite'n ahon thei sam kei uh, vaihawmte ka tung ah ahel ua, zawlneite'n Baal min in thu agen ua, thil phatuam lou dingte adelh uh."
english: The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and walked after things that do not profit.

paite: "Huchi in ka hon langbawl ding a, na tate uh ta nawnte leng ka langbawl lailai ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Therefore I will yet contend with you,” says Yahweh, “and I will contend with your children’s children.

paite: Kittim tuikulh ah va hoh unla, en un, Kedar ah mi sawl unla, chiktak in ngaihtuah un, hichibang thil a-om ngeina hiam chih theihna ding in.
english: For pass over to the islands of Kittim, and see; and send to Kedar, and consider diligently; and see if there has been such a thing.

paite: Namte'n apathian uh akheng uhia, pathiantak hiloupi leng? Ka mite'n bel athupina uh, thil phatuam loutak in akhek uh.
english: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which does not profit.

paite: "Aw vante, lamdang sa unla, hon mulkimsak henla, mau tuaituai un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Be astonished, you heavens, at this, and be horribly afraid. Be very desolate,” says Yahweh.

paite: Ka mite'n thil nih ahihkhial uhi: kei, hinna tuikhuk ahon paisan ua, tui ching thei lou ding tuivungte atoukhia uhi.
english: “For my people have committed two evils: they have forsaken me, the spring of living waters, and cut them out cisterns, broken cisterns, that can hold no water.

paite: Israel sikha ahi hia? Sikha mawng a piang hia? Bangziak a nuaisiah a om ahia?
english: Is Israel a servant? Is he a native-born slave? Why has he become a prey?

paite: Humpinelkai tuailaite'n hamkhum in, atung ah aw asuah ua, agam ahihgawp khinta uh, akhopite leng luahmi nei lou in akangsiang khin hi.
english: The young lions have roared at him, and yelled. They have made his land waste. His cities are burned up, without inhabitant.

paite: Memphis mi leh Tahpanhes mite'n, na luzang agiausak khinta uh.
english: The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian in lampi a ahon pi lai a, na taimangsan ziak in, huai na tung a na tunsak ahi kei maw?
english: “Haven’t you procured this to yourself, in that you have forsaken Yahweh your God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , when he led you by the way?

paite: Nile tui dawn ding a Aigupta lampi na zuih, nang ding a bang aphatuam a? Luipi tui dawn ding a Assuria lampi na zuih, nang ding in bang aphatuam a?
english: Now what have you to do in the way to Egypt, to drink the waters of the Shihor? Or what have you to do in the way to Assyria, to drink the waters of the River?

paite: Na thulimlouhna in hon thuaksak ding a, na nungkinna in nang ahon sal ding hi; hon launa nei lou TOUPA na Pathian na paisan a, thil giloutak leh kha mahmah ahi na hih, na theikhia inla, mu telta in, chih, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Your own wickedness shall correct you, and your backsliding shall reprove you. Know therefore and see that it is an evil thing and a bitter, that you have forsaken Yahweh your God, and that my fear is not in you,” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Nidanglai a pan na hakkol hihtan in, na khaute leng na hihtatta hi, 'Na nna ka sem nawn kei ding,' na chi a, mual sangte, singbawk nuai ah na kizuak hi.
english: “For of old time I have broken your yoke, and burst your bonds; and you said, ‘I will not serve;’ for on every high hill and under every green tree you bowed yourself, playing the prostitute.

paite: Chi dik zang in grepgui hoih mahmah ka hon phut a, bangchidan a kikheng a, kei a dia grep tak lou hong suakta na hia?
english: Yet I had planted you a noble vine, wholly a right seed. How then have you turned into the degenerate branches of a foreign vine to me?

paite: Tangal in kisil in sahbon tampi zang mah lechin, na thulimlouhna ka mitmuh in adawk teitei, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: 'Ka kihihnin sam a, Baalte ka delh sam a, bang achia chi thei na hia, phaizang kuak a na omdante en inla, na thilhihsate thei in; sangawngsaula huk diang ngongngong na hi vele.
english: “How can you say, ‘I am not defiled. I have not gone after the Baals’? See your way in the valley. Know what you have done. You are a swift dromedary traversing her ways;

paite: Gam sabiltung gamdai a om, ahuk lai a dak uau-uau a dik vutvut bang; a-utna kua'n ahia dalzou ding? Azongmi kihihgim nuam dah hen, ahun in amu na ding uh.
english: a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that snuffs up the wind in her desire. When she is in heat, who can turn her away? All those who seek her will not weary themselves. In her month, they will find her.

paite: Na khe ah khedap bun lou in om ke'nla, na dang leng hul kei heh; nang bel, lamet abeita, pau tuam mite ka ngai a, amau ka delh ding,' na chi hi.
english: “Withhold your foot from being unshod, and your throat from thirst. But you said, ‘It is in vain. No, for I have loved strangers, and I will go after them.’

paite: "Guta aphawk ua azum bang in, Israel inkote azumta uh, amau, akumpipate uh, aheutute uh, asiampute uh, azawlneite uh leng.
english: As the thief is ashamed when he is found, so is the house of Israel ashamed; they, their kings, their princes, and their priests, and their prophets;

paite: Singbul kiang a, 'Ka pa na hi,' chi a, suangbul kiang a, 'Kei hon suangtu na hi,' chi mite; masuan lou in adekkhuk sah uh ahon suan zaw ua, amangbat hun un bel, 'Thou in, hon hondam tanla,' achi ding uh, na pathian, huai na bawlte koi a om ahita ua?
english: who tell wood, ‘You are my father;’ and a stone, ‘You have brought me out:’ for they have turned their back to me, and not their face; but in the time of their trouble they will say, ‘Arise, and save us.’

paite: "Amau thou zaw uhenla, na mangbat lai in ahon hondam thei khamoh ding uhia; aw Judah, na pathiante bel na khopite zah mah ahi ve ua oi!
english: “But where are your gods that you have made for yourselves? Let them arise, if they can save you in the time of your trouble: for according to the number of your cities are your gods, Judah.

paite: Bangziak a ka tung a vui nak? Na vek un ka tung ah thil na hihkhial ngal ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Why will you contend with me? You all have transgressed against me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Na tate uh ka khen a, aphatuam kei, ahoih loh tuan kei uh; humpinelkai duhgawl bang mai in, noumau namsau in na zawlneite uh ane khin uhi.
english: “I have struck your children in vain. They received no correction. Your own sword has devoured your prophets, like a destroying lion.

paite: Aw khangthakte aw, TOUPA thu thei un, Israel a ding in gamdai gam bang ka hi maw? Mial sah meuhmouh gam ka hi maw? Ka mite'n bangdia, ka pawt kichianta ua, ka hong kik nawn kei ding uh, chi uh ahia?
english: Generation, consider the word of Yahweh. Have I been a wilderness to Israel? Or a land of thick darkness? Why do my people say, ‘We have broken loose. We will come to you no more?’

paite: Nungak siangthou in akizephoihnate amangngilh thei in, mouthak in akivatna amangngilh thei ding maw? Ka mite'n ni sim seng louh sung in ahon na mangngilhta uhi.
english: “Can a virgin forget her ornaments, or a bride her attire? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without number.

paite: Deihtakmi muhtheihna ding in na omdan ngentel na chia! Numei gilou kiang ah leng na omdan na sinsakta ve.
english: How well you prepare your way to seek love! Therefore you have taught even the wicked women your ways.

paite: Na nikte ah leng migenthei poi khoihloute hinna sisan alang a; na inn abuluh lai khutmat ahi kei uhi.
english: Also the blood of the souls of the innocent poor is found in your skirts. You did not find them breaking in; but it is because of all these things.

paite: "Ka moh kei a, kei a kipan ahehna lakmang ahi, na chi nawn ngal a, ngai in, 'Ka gilou kei hi,' na chih ziak in, na tungthu ka ngaihtuah ding.
english: “Yet you said, ‘I am innocent. Surely his anger has turned away from me.’ “Behold, I will judge you, because you say, ‘I have not sinned.’

paite: Na omdan kheng mengmeng a, bangziak a vialvak vak na hia? Assuria na zumpih mah bang in, Aigupta leng na zumpih lai ding hi.
english: Why do you go about so much to change your way? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.

paite: Na khutte lukhuk in akiang ua pan na pawtkhe nawn dia, TOUPA'N lah na muannate apaikheta ngal a, amau ah na lamzang kei ding hi."
english: From there also you shall go forth, with your hands on your head; for Yahweh has rejected those in whom you trust, and you shall not prosper with them.

paite: Huan Immer tapa, TOUPA' inn a heutupa pen, siampu Pashur in Jeremiah in huai zawlnei thugente agen chih ana za hi.
english: Now Pashhur, the son of Immer the priest, who was chief officer in the house of Yahweh, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

paite: Huchi in Pashur in zawlnei Jeremiah akhen a, TOUPA' inn a Benjamin Kongpi saknung a koltanna ah atangsak a.
english: Then Pashhur struck Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper gate of Benjamin, which was in the house of Yahweh.

paite: Azing in Pashur in Jeremiah akhahkhia a, huan Jeremiah in akiang ah TOUPA'N na min ding in Pashur achi kei a, Magermissabib ahon chi zaw hi.
english: It happened on the next day, that Pashhur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then Jeremiah said to him, Yahweh has not called your name Pashhur, but Magormissabib.

paite: TOUPA'N lah hichi in achi ngal a: "Ngai in, nang a ding leh na lawmte tengteng a ding in kihtak in ka hon bawl ding; amau amelmate uh namsau in apuk ding ua, nang zaw na mit in na en lel ding. Judahte tengteng Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe vek ding; ama'n Babulon ah sal in api ding a, namsau in athat ding hi.
english: For thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself, and to all your friends; and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall see it; and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive to Babylon, and shall kill them with the sword.

paite: Huai ban ah, khopi hauhna tengteng, asepkhiak tengteng, athil manpha tengteng leh Judah kumpipate gou tengteng amelmate uh khut ah ka pe ding a, amau alok ding ua, aman ding ua, Babulon ah api ding uh.
english: Moreover I will give all the riches of this city, and all its gains, and all the precious things of it, yes, all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies; and they shall make them a prey, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

paite: Huan nang Pashur, na insung a om tengtengte toh sal ah na tang ding ua; Babulon ah na pai tei ding; huai ah na si ding a, huai ah vui in na om ding a, nang leh na lawm zuauthu na hilhsekte tengteng toh," achi hi.
english: You, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house shall go into captivity; and you shall come to Babylon, and there you shall die, and there you shall be buried, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely.

paite: Aw TOUPA, nang na hon khem a, khem a om ka hita ve, nang zaw kei sang in na hat a, na hon zou a; nitum in nuihsan ka hita, mi kuapeuh in ahon nuihsan uhi.
english: Yahweh, you have persuaded me, and I was persuaded; you are stronger than I, and have prevailed: I am become a laughing-stock all the day, every one mocks me.

paite: Thu ka gen peuhmah chiang in, ka kikoukhia a, hiamgamna leh siatna, chi in ka kikou; TOUPA thu bel kei a ding in, nitum a dem leh muhsit lohna kia ahi.
english: For as often as I speak, I cry out; I cry, Violence and destruction! because the word of Yahweh is made a reproach to me, and a derision, all the day.

paite: Amah ka kan kei ding a, amin in leng thu ka gen nawn sam kei ding, chi mah leng, ka guh sung a meikuang kikhum khin bang mai in ka lungtang sung ah a-om a, ka pai kinken zou kei a, ka phazou mahmah kei hi.
english: If I say, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name, then there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I am weary with forbearing, and I can’t.

paite: Mi tampi aguk phun uh ka za; kil chih ah lauhuai a-om, hek unla, i hekkhawm ding uh, chi in. Ka lawmte ka puk ding tang gigete'n, "Khem in a-om kha dia, i zou ding, atung ah phu i la kha ding," achi uhi.
english: For I have heard the defaming of many, terror on every side. Denounce, and we will denounce him, say all my familiar friends, those who watch for my fall; perhaps he will be persuaded, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA mihangsan kihtakhuai mahmah bang in ka kiang ah a-om a, hon simmohte apuk ding ua, ahon zou kei ding uh. Zahlaktak in a-om ding ua, alohchin sin louh ziak un. Tangtawn a aminsiatna uh mangngilh in a-om kei ding.
english: But Yahweh is with me as an awesome mighty one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail; they shall be utterly disappointed, because they have not dealt wisely, even with an everlasting dishonor which shall never be forgotten.

paite: Aw sepaihte' TOUPA, midiktatte enchianpa, lungtang leh lungsim mu paisuakpa, atung ua na phulak hon musak dih ve, ka tungtang thu ka hon kemsakta hi.
english: But, Yahweh of Armies, who tests the righteous, who sees the heart and the mind, let me see your vengeance on them; for to you have I revealed my cause.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah la sa unla, TOUPA phat un; thil gilou hih mite khut a kipan panpih deihte hinna ahumbitta hi.
english: Sing to Yahweh, praise Yahweh; for he has delivered the soul of the needy from the hand of evildoers.

paite: Ka piankhiak ni hamsethuak in om hen, ka nu'n ahon piansak ni vualzawl in om dah hen.
english: Cursed is the day in which I was born: don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.

paite: Ka pa kiang a, "Tapa na neita," chih thu hon tun a, hong kipaksakmi pen hamsethuak in om hen.
english: Cursed is the man who brought news to my father, saying, A boy is born to you; making him very glad.

paite: Huai mi, TOUPA'N hehpih het lou a asukgawp khuate bang in om hen, zingsang lam in kikou husa za henla, sun ahih chiang in galdou husa;
english: Let that man be as the cities which Yahweh overthrew, and didn’t repent: and let him hear a cry in the morning, and shouting at noontime;

paite: sul sung a ahon hihlup louh ziak in; huchi hihleh ka nu ka han himai ding hi a, asul in tangtawn a hon pai ding hiven.
english: because he didn’t kill me from the womb; and so my mother would have been my grave, and her womb always great.

paite: Bangziak a sul a kipan hong pawt chitchiat ka hia, semgim leh lungkham a om ding a zahlak mawngmawng a ka damsung nite zang ding in?
english: Why came I forth out of the womb to see labor and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

paite: Kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang a Malkijah tapa Pashur leh siampu Maaseiah tapa Zephaniah asawl lai a Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA a kipan a thu hong tung ahi,
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

paite: "Babilon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in ahon dou a, TOUPA'N athilhih thupitak ahih sek bang in ahon huh nuam in, akiksak nawn mai kha diam chih TOUPA hon dotsak dih ve," chi in.
english: Please inquire of Yahweh for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us: perhaps Yahweh will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in akiang uah, Zedekiah kiang ah hichibang in va gen un; Israel' Pathian, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Then Jeremiah said to them, You shall tell Zedekiah:

paite: "Ngai in, Babulon kumpipa leh Kaldai mi, kulh pua a nang hon umbichilhpa na douna galvan zat ka kiksak ding ahi; hiai khopi sung ah amaute ka pikhawm ding.
english: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you, without the walls; and I will gather them into the midst of this city.

paite: Kei mahmah in leng heh leh lungkim lou mahmah leh thangpaitak in ban zak a ban thahat zang in nang ka hon dou ding.
english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation.

paite: Hiai khua a teng mihingte leh gante ka that ding a, hipi in asi ding uh."
english: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal: they shall die of a great pestilence.

paite: Huai nung in, TOUPA thupawt in achi, "Kumpipa Zedekiah leh anungzuite leh midang hiai khua a hipi leh namsau leh kial a siloute, Babulon kumpipa leh amelmate uh khut leh amau thah tum mite khut ah ka pe ding. Namsau hiam in athat ding a, ahehpih het kei ding, ahawi het kei ding a, azahngai sam kei ding."
english: Afterward, says Yahweh, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, even such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life: and he shall strike them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

paite: Huan hiai mipite kiang ah huchi in va gen in; TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, sihna lampi leh hinna lampi ka hon koihsak hi.
english: To this people you shall say, Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

paite: Hiai khopi sung a om namsau in hiam kial in hiam hipi in hiam asi ding uh; Kaldai mite nou hon umbichilhpa kiang a pawt a kipete bel ahing ding uh, ahinna uh kidouna kipahman ahi ding hi.
english: He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he who goes out, and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be to him for a prey.

paite: Hiai khopi hoihna ding hilou, asiatna ding ka tum bilbel ahi; Babulon kumpipa khut a piak ahi ding a, ama'n mei in ahal ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good, says Yahweh: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

paite: Judah kumpipa inkote tungtang thu ah; TOUPA thu ngaikhia un,
english: Touching the house of the king of Judah, hear the word of Yahweh:

paite: Aw David inkote aw! TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Zingsang in vai diktak in hawm unla, simmohmi khut a kipan loh thuakmi hunkhia un, huchi lou in zaw ka hehna mei bang in apawt ding a, kuamah phelh vual louh ding in akang dia, na thilhih giloute uh ziak in."
english: House of David, thus says Yahweh, Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, phaizang zang a tengte aw, nou phaizang zang suangpi a teng a, 'Kuate ahia i omna ua hong lut ding?' chite aw, nou ka hon lang ding hi. TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain, says Yahweh; you that say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

paite: Na thilhih uh gah bang zel in ka hon gawt ding a, agam gammang ah mei ka khah ding a, akim tengteng akangmang ding," TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says Yahweh; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all that is around her.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Judah kumpipa' inn ah hohsuk inla, hiai thu va gen in.
english: Thus said Yahweh: Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and speak there this word,

paite: 'Aw Judah kumpipa, David tutphah tung a tu, nang leh na nungzuite leh na mi hiai kongkhak a lutte toh, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un,' " chi in;
english: Say, Hear the word of Yahweh, king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people who enter in by these gates.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Diktak leh hoihtak in vai hawm unla; simmohmi khut a kipan loh thuakmi hunkhia unla; mikhualte, pa neiloute leh meithai tung ah diklouhna hiam hiamgamna hiam ching kei un; hiai mun ah mihoih sisan leng suah sam kei un.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Execute justice and righteousness, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence, to the foreigner, the fatherless, nor the widow; neither shed innocent blood in this place.

paite: Hiai thu zui ngei hi le uchin zaw, David tutphah tung a kumpipate kangtalaite leh sakolte tung a tuang in, amaute, anungzuite uh leh amite uh hiai na inn kongkhakte ua lut ngeingei ding uh hiven.
english: For if you do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

paite: Himahleh hiai thute na ngaihkhiak kei uleh, hiai inn asegawp ding a, chi in kei-le-kei kilou in ka kichiam ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself, says Yahweh, that this house shall become a desolation.

paite: TOUPA'N Judah kumpipa inkuan tungtang thu hichibang in agen hi: " 'Nang zaw kei a ding in Gilead bang, Lebanon mualvum bang na hi, hinapi in gamdai ka hon suaksak ding; luahmi om lou khopi bang mai in.
english: For thus says Yahweh concerning the house of the king of Judah: You are Gilead to me, the head of Lebanon. Yet surely I will make you a wilderness, cities which are not inhabited.

paite: Nang hihmang dingte, galvan nei chiat in, ka bawlkhol ding a; na sidar sing telte aphuk ding ua, mei ah akhul ding uh."
english: I will prepare destroyers against you, everyone with his weapons; and they shall cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

paite: " ‘Huan nam tampite'n hiai khopi apal paisuak ding ua, michih in amau invengte kiang ah "TOUPA'N hiai khopi thupi mahmah bangziak a hichitak a hih hi ding ahia eita?" achi ding uh.
english: Many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbor, Why has Yahweh done thus to this great city?

paite: A Pathian uh TOUPA thukhun alehngatsan ua pathian dangte abiak ua, a-nna asep ziak uh ahi, chi in adawng ding uh.’ "
english: Then they shall answer, Because they forsook the covenant of Yahweh their God, and worshiped other gods, and served them.

paite: Misi kah kei unla, suun sam kei un; paimangmi bel nakpi mahmah in kah un, ahong kik nawn kei ding a, apianna gam amuh nawn louh ding ziak in.
english: Don’t weep for the dead, neither bemoan him; but weep bitterly for him who goes away; for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

paite: Judah kumpipa Shallum, Josiah sik a vaihawmpa, hiai mun a kipan paikheta tungtang thu bel TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Hiai ah ahong kik nawnta kei ding.
english: For thus says Yahweh touching Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned instead of Josiah his father, and who went forth out of this place: He shall not return there any more.

paite: Sal a apina mun uah, huai mah ah asi ding a, hiai gam amu nawnta kei ding."
english: But in the place where they have led him captive, there shall he die, and he shall see this land no more.

paite: "Diktatlouhna a inn lam a, diklouhna a dantan tungnungte bawlmi, athawn a amah invengte tha zang, loh pe nuam lou mite tung agik hi;
english: Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his rooms by injustice; who uses his neighbor’s service without wages, and doesn’t give him his hire;

paite: 'Inn thupi mahmah ka kilam ding a, dantan tungnung zapite nei inn, tohlette ka hong ding a, sidar sing in ka thuapsuak ding a, zesan ka nuh ding,' chimi tung mah.
english: who says, I will build me a wide house and spacious rooms, and cuts him out windows; and it is ceiling with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

paite: Sidar sing a na ten ziak in, kumpipa kisa na hi maw! Na pa'n ne in adawn a, diktak in vai ahawm kei maw? Huai amah a ding in ahoih ahi.
english: Shall you reign, because you strive to excel in cedar? Didn’t your father eat and drink, and do justice and righteousness? then it was well with him.

paite: Migenthei leh tasamte vai ahawmsak a, huai ahoih ahi. Hiaitak na hon theihdan ding ahi maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well. Wasn’t this to know me? says Yahweh.

paite: 'Himahleh na huaihamte a ding in, mihoih sisan suahna ding, nuaisiahna ding leh hiamgamna ding lel in na mit leh na lungsim na pu ahi.' "
english: But your eyes and your heart are not but for your covetousness, and for shedding innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.

paite: Huaiziak in Judahte kumpipa Jehoiakim, Josiah tapa tungthu bel TOUPA'N hichi in agen a; " 'Aw ka unaupa,' chi in hiam, 'Aw ka sanggampa,' chi in hiam amah asuun kei ding ua, 'Aw toupa,' chi in hiam, 'Aw thupipen,' chi in hiam amah asuun sam kei ding uh.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah: they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! They shall not lament for him, saying Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

paite: Jerusalem kulh polam a lotkhiak a, paih in, sabiltung vui in avui ding uh.
english: He shall be buried with the burial of a donkey, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

paite: Lebanon ah paitou inla, kikou in, Bashan ah na aw suah inla, Abarim a pan in kikou in, na itte tengteng amangthangta ua.
english: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from Abarim; for all your lovers are destroyed.

paite: Na lohchin in na kiang ah thu ka gen a, nang lah ka ngaikhe kei ding, na chi a, ka kamsuak ngaihkhiak louh na tuailai kipan in hiai na omdan ahi.
english: I spoke to you in your prosperity; but you said, I will not hear. This has been your way from your youth, that you didn’t obey my voice.

paite: Na belampute tengteng uh huih in akivak ding ua, na mi itte sal in atang ding ua, nang leng gitlouhna tengteng ziak in zahlaktak leh mangbangtak in na om ngei ding hi.
english: The wind shall feed all your shepherds, and your lovers shall go into captivity: surely then you will be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.

paite: Aw Lebanon tang a teng, sidar sing lak a buseptu na tung a natna atun a na hong hehpihhuai ding dan mai zaw! numei nauvei na bang mai in."
english: Inhabitant of Lebanon, who makes your nest in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied you will be when pangs come on you, the pain as of a woman in travail!

paite: Ahin a ka hin sung, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; Judah kumpipa Koniah, Jehoiakim tapa bel ka khut taklam a sawnna zungbuh himah lechin, huai a kipan ka hon botkhe ngeingei ding.
english: As I live, says Yahweh, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet on my right hand, yet would I pluck you there;

paite: Thah ding a nang hon zongmi khut ah, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah leh Kaldaite khut ah ngeingei nang ka hon pe ding hi.
english: and I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, and into the hand of them of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

paite: Na pianna hilou gamdang ah nang leh na nu nang hon suangtu ka hon paikhe ding a, huai ah na si ding uh.
english: I will cast you out, and your mother who bore you, into another country, where you were not born; and there you will die.

paite: Alungsim ua kik nawn a-utna mahmah gam uah akik nawn kei ding uh.
english: But to the land whereunto their soul longs to return, there shall they not return.

paite: Hiai Koniah pen bel kitamgawp, simmohhuai ahi kei a hia? Bel asung a lungkimna omlouhna ahi kei maw? Bangziak a amah leh asuante paihkhiak a gam atheih ngei louh ua paihkhiak a a-om uh?
english: Is this man Coniah a despised broken vessel? is he a vessel in which none delights? why are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into the land which they don’t know?

paite: Aw, gam, gam, gam, TOUPA thu ngai in,
english: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Hiai mi ta nei lou, adamsung a lohching lou ding mi ahi, asuante kuamah lohching a, David tutphah tung a tu ding leh Judah gam a vaihawm nawn ding a-om kei ding uh, chi in gelh in.
english: Thus says Yahweh, Write you this man childless, a man who shall not prosper in his days; for no more shall a man of his seed prosper, sitting on the throne of David, and ruling in Judah.

paite: “Agantatna mun a belam hihmangthang a dalhzaksak belamching mite atung uh agik hi!" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA Israel' Pathian in ka mite chingpa belamching mite tungtang thu ah hichi in achi: "Ka ganhonte na dalhsak ua, na delhmang ua, na veh kei uh, ngai un, na thilhih uh gilou ziak in nou ka hong veh ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, against the shepherds who feed my people: You have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them; behold, I will visit on you the evil of your doings, says Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka ganhon khosuaksunte ka delhzakna gam tengteng a kipan ka pikhawm nawn ding a, ahuangsung uah ka hawlkhawm ding a, gah nuam mahmah ahi ding ua, apung ding uh.
english: I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all the countries where I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and multiply.

paite: Amaute limsak ding, amaute a ding in belamchingmi ka koih ding a, alau nawnta kei ding ua, kuamah amang nawn kei ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will set up shepherds over them, who shall feed them; and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall any be lacking, says Yahweh.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, David a ding in Hiang diktat ka suahsak hun ding ahong tung dekta hi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; amah kumpipa in atu ding a, piltak in agamta ding a, gam pumpi ah dikna leh diktatna atangtungsak ding.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will raise to David a righteous Branch, and he shall reign as king and deal wisely, and shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.

paite: Ahun sung in Judah hotdam ahi ding a, Israel bittak in a-om ding. Huai amin ding a asak ding uh hiai ahi, "TOUPA i diktatna uh ahi," chih.
english: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely; and this is his name by which he shall be called: Yahweh our righteousness.

paite: "Huaiziak in ngai dih ua, ahun atung sinta," TOUPA thupawt in achi hi. Israel mite, "Aigupta gam a kipan a hon pikhepa TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, chi nawn lou in.
english: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that they shall no more say, As Yahweh lives, who brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;

paite: Mallam gam leh adelhzakna gam tengteng a kipan Israel inkote suante pikhia a, pikik nawnpa TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, achi zawta ding uhi.” Huchi in amau gam ngei ah ateng ding uh.
english: but, As Yahweh lives, who brought up and who led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had driven them. They shall dwell in their own land.

paite: Zawlneite tungtang thu pen, ka sung ah ka lungtang apuakkham hi, ka guh teng aling a, zukham bang mai ka hi, zu in azelh zoh mi bang mai in, TOUPA ziak leh athu siangthou ziak in.
english: Concerning the prophets. My heart within me is broken, all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahweh, and because of his holy words.

paite: Gam angkawm in adim a, hamsia ziak in gam in asuun a, gamdai louhing munte akeu khinta; alampi uh agilou a, ahatna uh adik kei hi.
english: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourns; the pastures of the wilderness are dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;

paite: Zawlneite leh siampute'n Pathian khawk asa kei ua, ka insung mahmah ah leng akhelhna uh ka mu.
english: for both prophet and priest are profane; yes, in my house have I found their wickedness, says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in amaute a ding in apaina lampi uh, zan khomial lampi nal bang ahi ding a, huai ah delh in a-om ding ua atolhpuk ding ua, atung uah thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding a, amau gawtna hun, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: Therefore their way shall be to them as slippery places in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein; for I will bring evil on them, even the year of their visitation, says Yahweh.

paite: Samaria zawlneite tung ah kihhuai ka mu, Baal lou in thu agen ua, Israelte apimang uhi.
english: I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied by Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.

paite: Jerusalem a zawlneite tung ah thil mulkimhuai ka mu, ang a kawm ua, zuau in agamta ua, thil gilou hihte khut ahatsak ua, kuamah in agitlouh uh kisik atup louh loh uhi; kei a ding in Sodom a mite bang ahong hi vek ua, akhosung a mite tengteng leng Gomorrah a mite bang hial in.
english: In the prophets of Jerusalem also I have seen a horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies; and they strengthen the hands of evildoers, so that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them become to me as Sodom, and its inhabitants as Gomorrah.

paite: Huaiziak in zawlnei hon tungtang thu ah sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih ua, gamsai in ka vak ding a, thil kha ka dawnsak ding; Jerusalem a zawlneite kiang a kipan in gam pumpi ah Pathian poisaklouhna lah apawtta ngal a.”
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies concerning the prophets: Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall; for from the prophets of Jerusalem is ungodliness gone forth into all the land.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Zawlnei na kiang ua thugente thu ngaikhe kei un; bangmah lou ahon sinsak ua, TOUPA kam a kipan hilou amau lungsim geltawmte agen uhi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you: they teach you vanity; they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA thu musit mite kiang ah, 'Nang ding in ahoih ding,' achi vial ua; amau deihlam engtat a hih teitei mite kiang ah, 'Thil hoih lou bangmah na tung ah ahong tung kei ding, " achi uh.
english: They say continually to those who despise me, Yahweh has said, You shall have peace; and to everyone who walks in the stubbornness of his own heart they say, No evil shall come on you.

paite: TOUPA thugelna ah kua apang ngei a, athu sang a thei ding kua ahia om? Ahihleh athu pen kua'n ahia limsak a ngaikhia om?
english: For who has stood in the council of Yahweh, that he should perceive and hear his word? who has marked my word, and heard it?

paite: Ngai dih ua, TOUPA huihpi, hehna apawtta, ahi, pingpei huihpi; migiloute lutang anuai ding.
english: Behold, the storm of Yahweh, his wrath, has gone forth. Yes, a whirling storm. It shall burst on the head of the wicked.

paite: TOUPA hehna amawk kik kei ding, alungsim a atup tinten atangtungsak a, ahih khit phot masiah; ni nanung lam ah na hon theichian ding uh.
english: The anger of Yahweh shall not return, until he has executed, and until he have performed the intents of his heart: in the latter days you shall understand it perfectly.

paite: Zawlneite bel ka sawl louhpi in atai ua, akiang ua thu ka gen louh in leng thu agen uh.
english: I sent not these prophets, yet they ran: I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.

paite: Ka thugelna a om tei hi le uh zaw, ka mite kiang a ka thu puang ding hi ve un, athilhihdiklou ua kipan lehngatsak ding hi ve un.
english: But if they had stood in my council, then had they caused my people to hear my words, and had turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

paite: Gamlapi a om Pathian hilou in, Pathian nai gige ka hi kei a hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Am I a God at hand, says Yahweh, and not a God afar off?

paite: Mun kisel ah ka muh theih louh dia kibu thei mi a-om ua hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Lei leh van ah ka dim ahi kei maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Can any hide himself in secret places so that I shall not see him? says Yahweh. Don’t I fill heaven and earth? says Yahweh.

paite: "Mang ka nei, mang ka nei, chi a ka min a zuaugen zawlneite thugen ka zata hi."
english: I have heard what the prophets have said, who prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

paite: Zawlnei zuaugente, amau lungtang kikhem tawm a thu sek mite lungtang ah hiai bang tan ahia a-om ding?
english: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets who prophesy lies, even the prophets of the deceit of their own heart?

paite: Amau bel a-invengte uh kiang ah amang uh ahilh ua ka mite ka min mangngilhsak atum ua, apate un Baal ziak a ka min amangngilh khit bang un,
english: who think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name for Baal.

paite: zawlnei mang nei in amang gen hen aw, ka thuneimi in ka thutak diktak in gen hen. Buhpawl leh buhtang in kibatna bang anei ua? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: The prophet who has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he who has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the straw to the wheat? says Yahweh.

paite: Ka thu mei bang ahi kei maw, sek suang seknenna bang? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Isn’t my word like fire? says Yahweh; and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, zawlnei hon, ka thu kiguksak tuah sekte ka dou ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahweh, who steal my words everyone from his neighbor.

paite: Ngai dih ua, zawlnei amah dangnalsak a, TOUPA'N achi, chisekte ka dou ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahweh, who use their tongues, and say, He says.

paite: Ngai dih ua, mang zuau leltak gen a, hilh a, azuauthute uh leh aki-otsakna thuginaloute uh ziak a ka mite pimang zawlneite ka dou ahi, TOUPA thupawt in achi; ka sawl ngal kei a, thu lah ka pe kei a, hiai mipite aloh taksak kei ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Behold, I am against those who prophesy lying dreams, says Yahweh, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their vain boasting: yet I didn’t send them, nor commanded them; neither do they profit this people at all, says Yahweh.

paite: Hiai mipite lak a mi kuahiam, zawlnei kuahiam in, siampu kuahiam in, "TOUPA puakgik bang ahia?" chỉ a ahon dot leh hichi in na dawng ding hi, "Noumau mah puakgik pen na hi uh, ka hon paimang ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: When this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask you, saying, What is the burden of Yahweh? Then you shall tell them, What burden! I will cast you off, says Yahweh.

paite: Zawlnei hiam, siampu hiam, mi kuahiam, TOUPA puakgik, chi a-om uleh, huai mi leh a-inkote ka gawt ding.
english: As for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, who shall say, The burden of Yahweh, I will even punish that man and his house.

paite: Huchi in mi kuapeuh in a-invengpa kiang ah leh kuapeuh in a-unaupa kiang ah TOUPA'N bangchi in adawng a, TOUPA'N bang agen a? chi in na kidong ding uh.
english: You shall say everyone to his neighbor, and everyone to his brother, What has Yahweh answered? and, What has Yahweh spoken?

paite: TOUPA puakgik na lou kha nawn kei ding ua, mi kuapeuh amah mah thugen apuakgik ahi ding hi. Pathian hing, sepaihte' TOUPA, i Pathian thu uh lah na lehbulh khinta ngal ua.
english: You shall mention the burden of Yahweh no more: for every man’s own word shall be his burden; for you have perverted the words of the living God, of Yahweh of Armies our God.

paite: Zawlnei kiang ah, "TOUPA'N bangchi in nang ahon dawng a? TOUPA'N bang ahia agen?" na chi ding.
english: You shall say to the prophet, What has Yahweh answered you? and, What has Yahweh spoken?

paite: Huan "TOUPA puakgik, na chih peuhmah uleh, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: TOUPA puakgik na chi ding uh ahi kei," chi a ka hon sawl a, TOUPA puakgik chi a thu na gen ziak in;
english: But if you say, The burden of Yahweh; therefore thus says Yahweh: Because you say this word, The burden of Yahweh, and I have sent to you, saying, You shall not say, The burden of Yahweh;

paite: huchi in ngai un, "Ka hon mangngilh keuhkeuh ding a, noute leh hiai khopi na kiang uleh na pate uh kiang a ka na piaksa toh ka hon paimang ding hi.
english: therefore, behold, I will utterly forget you, and I will cast you off, and the city that I gave to you and to your fathers, away from my presence:

paite: Huan tangtawn demsiatna leh zahlak nilouhna mangngilh vual louh na tung uah ka hon tun ding hi."
english: and I will bring an everlasting reproach on you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judahte kumpipa Jekoniah, Jehoiakim tapa leh Judah heutute, mikhutsiamte leh siksek mite toh Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon sal dia api nung in, TOUPA'N hiai mengmuhna ahon ensak a, ngai dih, theipi bawm nih TOUPA tempul ma ah akitung hi.
english: Yahweh showed me, and behold, two baskets of figs set before Yahweh’s temple, after that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the craftsmen and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

paite: Bawm khat ah theipi hoihtak, theipi min masa bangtak a-om a; bawm dang ah bel theipi hoih lou, nek tak louh khop a sia a-om hi.
english: One basket had very good figs, like the figs that are first-ripe; and the other basket had very bad figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Bang ahia na muh, Jeremiah?" achi a. Ke'n, "Theipi, theipi hoih, hoih mahmah; leh ahoih lou, nek tak louh khop a sia," ka chi hi.
english: Then Yahweh said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: The word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Judah saltangte, Kaldaite gam a athahna ding ua ka sawlkhiakte, hiai theipi hoih bang in ka en ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: Like these good figs, so will I regard the captives of Judah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans, for good.

paite: Ahoihna ding un atung uah ka mit ka tusak ding a, hiai gam ah ka pikik nawn ding; amau ka dingsak ding a, ka phel kei ding; ka suan ding a, ka botkhe kei ding.
english: For I will set my eyes on them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka hi chih na hon theihna ding in lungtang ka hon pe ding a; ka mite ahi ding ua, a Pathian uh ka hi ding; alungtang tengteng uh toh ka kiang ah ahong kik ding uhi."
english: I will give them a heart to know me, that I am Yahweh: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God; for they shall return to me with their whole heart.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Theipi sia, nek tak louh khop a sia bang in Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh aheutute uh leh Jerusalem a nituang hiai gam a omlaite leh Aigupta gam a tengte, ka lehngatsan ding hi.
english: As the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, they are so bad, surely thus says Yahweh, So will I give up Zedekiah the king of Judah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, who remain in this land, and those who dwell in the land of Egypt,

paite: Haksatak a leitung gam teng lak ah sep leng ding in, ka delhmangnate gensiat leh tehpih leh tai leh hamsiatkhum hi ding in ka tawpsan ding.
english: I will even give them up to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth for evil; to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places where I shall drive them.

paite: Amau leh apate uh kiang a ka piak gam a kipan valh khit ahih tanpha un alak uah namsau, kial leh hii ka sawl ding hi."
english: I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, until they be consumed from off the land that I gave to them and to their fathers.

paite: Judahte kumpipa, Jehoiakim, Josiah tapa kum lina a Judah mite tengteng tungtang a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung; huai hun bel Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kum khatna ahi a,
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah (the same was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon),

paite: huai thu zawlnei Jeremiah in Judah mi tengteng leh Jerusalem a om tengtengte kiang a agen ahi.
english: which Jeremiah the prophet spoke to all the people of Judah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:

paite: Kum sawmnih-le-thum sung, Judahte kumpipa Josiah, Ammon tapa kum sawm-le-thumna a kipan tutan in, TOUPA thu ahong tung zel a, phalvak a thou in na kiang uah ka gengen a, himahleh na ngaikhe kei uh.
english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah, even to this day, these twenty-three years, the word of Yahweh has come to me, and I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; but you have not listened.

paite: TOUPA'N na kiang uah anasemmi zawlneite tengteng asawl a, phalvak a thou in asawl a, himahleh na ngaikhe kei ua, thei ding in na bil uh na doh sam kei uh.
english: Yahweh has sent to you all his servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them (but you have not listened, nor inclined your ear to hear)

paite: Huai, zawlneite'n, "Michih noumau lampi gilou a kipan hong kik unla, TOUPA'N na kiang ua leh na pipute uh kiang a nidanglai a kipan tangtawn a ding a nou ahon piak gam ah teng un.
english: saying, Return now everyone from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahweh has given to you and to your fathers, from of old and even forevermore;

paite: Pathian dangte kiang ah a-nna uh sem ding leh amaute be ding leh na khut nasep ua kei hon lungkim lousak ding in hoh kei un; huchi in ka hon hihna kei ding hi," achi uh.
english: and don’t go after other gods to serve them or worship them, and don’t provoke me to anger with the work of your hands; and I will do you no harm.

paite: Himahleh nou ding a hoih lou ding a na khut nasep ua hon hehsak ding in na hon ngaikhe kei uh, TOUPA'N achi.
english: Yet you have not listened to me, says Yahweh; that you may provoke me to anger with the work of your hands to your own hurt.

paite: "Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ka thu na ngaihkhiak louh ziak un, ngai dih ua,
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies: Because you have not heard my words,

paite: mallam nam tengteng ka thukhak ding a, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi. Ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leng ka thukhak ding a, amaute hiai gam leh asung a omte leh hiai kim a nam om tengteng sual ding in ka hon pi ding; ka hihmang sipsip ding a, lamdangsak ding leh enghou ding leh segawp nilouh ding in ka bawl ding.
english: behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says Yahweh, and I will send to Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations around; and I will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and a hissing, and perpetual desolations.

paite: Huan akiang ua kipan nopsakna husa leh kipahna husate, mouneipa aw leh mou awte, buhgawi husa ging leh khawnvak vakte ka lamang ding hi.
english: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the lamp.

paite: Hiai avek in ase ding a, lamdangsak ahi ding a; hiai namte'n Babulon kumpipa nna kum sawmsagih asem ding uh.
english: This whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

paite: Huan kum sawmsagih aman hun chiang in Babulon kumpipa leh huai nam, Kaldaite gam, agitlouhna uh ziak in ka gawt ding a; tangtawn in ka segawpsak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: It shall happen, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, says Yahweh, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans; and I will make it desolate forever.

paite: Huai gam tung ah ka thu atung ua ka gen tengteng, Jeremiah in namte tung a agen, hiai laibu a gelhsa tengteng ka tungsak ding hi.
english: I will bring on that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

paite: Nam tuamtuam leh kumpipa thupitakte'n amaute'n nna akisep un, amau mahmah in leng amau nna ahon sepsak ding uhi.
english: For many nations and great kings shall make bondservants of them, even of them; and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the work of their hands.

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in ka kiang ah hichi in achi: "Ka khut a hiai hehna uain nou la inla, ka hon sawlna ding nam chih dawnsak in.
english: For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to me: take this cup of the wine of wrath at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.

paite: Adawn ding ua, ahoi dongdong ding ua, ahai ding ua, akiang ua ka sawl ding namsau ziak in," chi in.
english: They shall drink, and reel back and forth, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA khut a kipan nou ka la a, TOUPA'N hon sawlna nam chih ka dawnsak hi.
english: Then took I the cup at Yahweh’s hand, and made all the nations to drink, to whom Yahweh had sent me:

paite: Jerusalem leh Judah khopite, huai kumpipate leh heutute, siatgawpnate, lamdangsakte, enghou dingte, hamsiatte tang ding in, tua a-omdan bang uh;
english: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, and its kings, and its princes, to make them a desolation, an astonishment, a hissing, and a curse, as it is this day;

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh leh asikhate, aheutute leh ami tengtengte;
english: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, and his princes, and all his people;

paite: Amau lak a mikitokpolh tengteng; Uz gam a kumpipa teng; Philistia gam a kumpipa tengteng, Ashkelon leh Gaza leh Ekron leh Ashdod khosuaksunte;
english: and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of the Uz, and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ashkelon, and Gaza, and Ekron, and the remnant of Ashdod;

paite: Edom leh Moab leh Ammon suante;
english: Edom, and Moab, and the children of Ammon;

paite: Tura kumpipa tengteng leh Sidon kumpipate leh tuipi gei kumpipate;
english: and all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Sidon, and the kings of the isle which is beyond the sea;

paite: Dedan leh Tema leh Buz leh abaksam uh met a omte tengteng;
english: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, and all who have the corners of their beard cut off;

paite: Arabia kumpipa tengteng, Gamdai a teng nam kihelte kumpipate;
english: and all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people who dwell in the wilderness;

paite: Zimri kumpipa tengteng; Elam kumpipa tengteng; Media kumpipa tengteng;
english: and all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;

paite: Mallam kumpipa tengteng, agamla leh anai a mi akizom zel in; leitung a kumpi om tengteng in adawn khit chiang in Seshak kumpipa'n adawn ding hi.
english: and all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world, which are on the surface of the earth: and the king of Sheshach shall drink after them.

paite: Huan akiang uah sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Dawn unla, kham un, lau unla, kipuk in thoutou nawn kei un; na lak ua namsau ka sawl ding ziak in," chi in.
english: You shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more, because of the sword which I will send among you.

paite: Huan na khut a nou pen dawn ding a alak nop kei uleh huchi in na chi ding; sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na dawn ngeingei ding uh ahi!
english: It shall be, if they refuse to take the cup at your hand to drink, then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: You shall surely drink.

paite: Ka min tam khopi ah thil hoih lou ka hih pan a, noute gawt louh hial in na om ding uh maw? Gawt louh in na om kei ding ua; lei a teng tengteng tung ah namsau ka samkhe ding," chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For, behold, I begin to work evil at the city which is called by my name; and should you be utterly unpunished? You shall not be unpunished; for I will call for a sword on all the inhabitants of the earth, says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huaiziak in atung ah hiaite gen inla, akiang uah huchi in chi in: "TOUPA mun sang a kipan in athum ding, atenna siangthou a kipan a-aw asuah ding, ahuang tung ah nakpi in athum ding; grep suk mite bang in akikou ding, lei luahte teng tung ah.
english: Therefore prophesy you against them all these words, and tell them, Yahweh will roar from on high, and utter his voice from his holy habitation; he will mightily roar against his fold; he will give a shout, as those who tread grapes, against all the inhabitants of the earth.

paite: Lei tawp pha in husa athangkik ding a, TOUPA'N namte alang a, sa tengteng tung ah vai ahawm ding, namsau kiang ah migilou ape ding," TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: A noise shall come even to the end of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with the nations; he will enter into judgment with all flesh: as for the wicked, he will give them to the sword, says Yahweh.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, thil hoih lou in nam chih ahon nuai ding hi, huihpi hat mahmah lei mun tawp a kipan in ahong kuan ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, Behold, evil shall go forth from nation to nation, and a great storm shall be raised up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA thahte'n lei tawp a kipan in lei tawp pha in akhak ding ua; suun louh leh khop louh leh vui louh in a-om ding ua; leitung a eklei lel ahi maimah ding uh.
english: The slain of Yahweh shall be at that day from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth: they shall not be lamented, neither gathered, nor buried; they shall be dung on the surface of the ground.

paite: "Belamching mite aw kikou tuaituai unla, kap un, nou belamhon lak a makaite aw, kitung buatbuat un, thah a na om ni uleh na dalhzak nite uh ahong tung petmahta hi. Bel deihhuai bang in na puk ding uh.
english: Wail, you shepherds, and cry; and wallow in dust, you principal of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are fully come, and you shall fall like a goodly vessel.

paite: Belamching mite'n taimangna lampi anei kei ding ua, belamhon lak a makaite'n leng pelhna lampi anei kei ding uh.
english: The shepherds shall have no way to flee, nor the principal of the flock to escape.

paite: Belamching mite kah husa, belamhon lak a makaite mau ging toh, TOUPA'N atatna mun uh asuksiat lel ziak in.
english: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the principal of the flock! for Yahweh lays waste their pasture.

paite: Huang muanhuaite daihsak sipsip in a-omta uh, TOUPA heh mahmah ziak in.
english: The peaceable folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.

paite: Abukna pawtsanta, humpinelkai bang in, nuaisiahna namsau lauhuai ziak leh aheh mahmah ziak in agam uh ase khinta hi."
english: He has left his covert, as the lion; for their land has become an astonishment because of the fierceness of the oppression, and because of his fierce anger.

paite: Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim in vaihawm apat tung in hiai thu TOUPA kiang a kipan ahong tung hi:
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word from Yahweh, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "TOUPA' inn huangsung ah dingh inla, Judah khopi tengteng Pathian be ding a TOUPA' inn a hong paite kiang ah akiang ua gen ding a thu ka hon piak tengteng khat lel leng iim lou in gen vek in.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Stand in the court of Yahweh’s house, and speak to all the cities of Judah, which come to worship in Yahweh’s house, all the words that I command you to speak to them; don’t diminish a word.

paite: Michih in a-omdan gilou uh paisan in angaikhe zenzen khamoh ding uhia, athilhih gilou uh ziak a atung ua thil hoih lou hih ka tup ka khektheihna ding in."
english: It may be they will listen, and turn every man from his evil way; that I may repent me of the evil which I purpose to do to them because of the evil of their doings.

paite: Nang akiang uah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Na hon ngaihkhiak louh ua, ka dan na ma ua ka koih na zuih louh ua,
english: You shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh: If you will not listen to me, to walk in my law, which I have set before you,

paite: zingsangpi a thou a amau na kiang ua ka sawl ka nasemmi zawlnei thu na limsak kei uleh;
english: to listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them, but you have not listened;

paite: hiai inn Shiloh bang in ka bawl ding a, leitung a nam tengtengte hamsia thuak ding in ka bawl ding," na chi ding hi.
english: then will I make this house like Shiloh, and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth.

paite: Huan siampute, zawlneite leh mipi tengteng in TOUPA' inn a Jeremiah in hiai thu agen angaikhia uhi.
english: The priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng kiang a gen ding a TOUPA'N apiak teng agen khit in, siampute, zawlneite leh mipi tengteng in amah amanta ua, "Si peuhmah niteh!"
english: It happened, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking all that Yahweh had commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the prophets and all the people laid hold on him, saying, You shall surely die.

paite: Bangziak a TOUPA min lou a, "Hiai inn Shiloh bang ahi ding, hiai khopi luahmi om lou in asegawp ding, chi a gen na hia?" achi ua, Huchi in TOUPA' inn a mipi tengteng in Jeremiah aboh lutlut uhi.
english: Why have you prophesied in the name of Yahweh, saying, This house shall be like Shiloh, and this city shall be desolate, without inhabitant? All the people were gathered to Jeremiah in the house of Yahweh.

paite: Judah heutute'n hiai thu azak un, kumpipa' inn a kipan in TOUPA' inn lutna TOUPA' inn Kongpi Thak ah atu uhi.
english: When the princes of Judah heard these things, they came up from the king’s house to the house of Yahweh; and they sat in the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huchi in siampute leh zawlneite'n heutute leh mipi tengteng kiang ah, "Hiai mi si tak ahi, khopi siat ding thu, na bil ua na zak bang un agenkhol ngal a," achi uhi.
english: Then spoke the priests and the prophets to the princes and to all the people, saying, This man is worthy of death; for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.

paite: Huan heutute leh mipi tengteng kiang ah Jeremiah in, "Na thu ngaihkhiak khitsate uh bang in hiai inn leh hiai khopi siat ding thu gen ding in TOUPA'N kei hon sawl ahi.
english: Then spoke Jeremiah to all the princes and to all the people, saying, Yahweh sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city all the words that you have heard.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na omdan uleh na gamtatdan uh bawlhoih unla, TOUPA na Pathian uh thu mang un; huchi in TOUPA'N na tung ua thil hoih lou tung ding aphuankhiaksa akikhelsak thei ding hi.
english: Now therefore amend your ways and your doings, and obey the voice of Yahweh your God; and Yahweh will repent him of the evil that he has pronounced against you.

paite: Kei ka hihleh, na khut ua om ka hi. Dik leh hoih na chih bang un hon bawl un.
english: But as for me, behold, I am in your hand: do with me as is good and right in your eyes.

paite: Na hon thah uleh, noumau leh hiai khopi leh khua-le-tuite tung ah mihoih sisan na tungsak ding uh chih thei mai un; adiktak in na bil ua hiai thute gen dia TOUPA'N na kiang ua hon sawl ka hi," achi hi.
english: Only know for certain that, if you put me to death, you will bring innocent blood on yourselves, and on this city, and on its inhabitants; for of a truth Yahweh has sent me to you to speak all these words in your ears.

paite: Huchi in heutute leh mipite'n, siampute leh zawlneite kiang ah, "Hiai mi asih ding ahi kei, TOUPA i Pathian min a i kiang ua thu gen ahi,” achi uhi.
english: Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the prophets: This man is not worthy of death; for he has spoken to us in the name of Yahweh our God.

paite: Huan huai gam Upa kuate hiam ahong dingh ua, mipi omkhawmte kiang ah,
english: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land, and spoke to all the assembly of the people, saying,

paite: "Mikah, Moreseth mi'n Judah kumpipa Hezekiah vaihawm lai in thu agen a, Judah mi tengteng kiang ah, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Lou bang in Zion leh ahi ding a, Jerusalem thil se omkhawm asuak ding, tang a inn gammang mun sang bang ahi ding," achi hi.
english: Micah the Morashtite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah; and he spoke to all the people of Judah, saying, Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Zion shall be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.

paite: Judah kumpipa Hezekiah leh Judahte tengteng in amah athat uhia? TOUPA lau in TOUPA deihsakna angen ua, TOUPA'N atung ua thil hoih lou tung ding apuan akikhelsak ahi kei maw? E'n zaw i tung ua thil hoih lou tungsak ding i hi ve ua! achi hi.
english: Did Hezekiah king of Judah and all Judah put him to death? Didn’t he fear Yahweh, and entreat the favor of Yahweh, and Yahweh relented of the disaster which he had pronounced against them? Thus should we commit great evil against our own souls.

paite: Huan midang, TOUPA min a thugen Keriath-jearim mi Shemaiah tapa Uriah mah leng a-om a, Jeremiah thugen tengteng mah bang in hiai gam leh khopi siat ding thu agen hi.
english: There was also a man who prophesied in the name of Yahweh, Uriah the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath Jearim; and he prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah:

paite: Kumpipa Jehoiakim leh amithupite leh heutute'n azak un kumpipa'n hihlup atum a; himahleh Uriah in azak in alau a, ataimang a, Aigupta gam ah apaita hi.
english: and when Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men, and all the princes, heard his words, the king sought to put him to death; but when Uriah heard it, he was afraid, and fled, and went into Egypt:

paite: Kumpipa Jehoiakim in Akbor tapa Elnathan leh midangte toh Aigupta gam ah mi asawl hi.
english: and Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt, Elnathan the son of Achbor, and certain men with him, into Egypt;

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam a kipan in Uriah apikhia ua, kumpipa Jehoiakim kiang ah ahon pi ua, huai in namsau in athat a, aluang vantang han ah apailut ua, achi uhi.
english: and they fetched forth Uriah out of Egypt, and brought him to Jehoiakim the king, who killed him with the sword, and cast his dead body into the graves of the common people.

paite: Himahleh Shaphan tapa Ahikam in Jeremiah agum a, huchi in hihlup ding in mipite kiang ah piak ahita kei hi.
english: But the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah, that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death.

paite: Judah Kumpipa Josiah tapa Zedekiah, vaihawm apat tung lai in, TOUPA kiang a kipan in hiai thu ahong tung hi.
english: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, came this word to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi: Hakkolte leh akhaute bawl inla, na ngawng ah bat in.
english: Thus says Yahweh to me: Make bonds and bars, and put them on your neck;

paite: Huan Edom kumpipa, Moab kumpipa, Ammon mite kumpipa, Tura kumpipa, Sidon kumpipa kiang ah kumpipa Zedekiah kiang a amisawl, Jerusalem a hong paite khut ah khak in.
english: and send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the children of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hand of the messengers who come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah;

paite: Hiai thute apute uh kiang ah gensak in; hichi in Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi: huchi in na pute uh kiang a na gen ding uh ahi:
english: and give them a command to their masters, saying, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, You shall tell your masters:

paite: "Ka thilhihtheihna thupitak leh ka ban zak in leitung, mihingte leh leitung a sate toh ka bawl vek a, piak tuak ka chihte kiang ah ka pia hi.
english: I have made the earth, the men and the animals that are on the surface of the earth, by my great power and by my outstretched arm; and I give it to whom it seems right to me.

paite: Tu in leng ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah hiai gam tengteng ka pe khinta hi, gamsate leng amah nna sem ding in ka pe lai hi.
english: Now have I given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant; and the animals of the field also have I given him to serve him.

paite: Amah gam huntak atun ma in nam tengteng in amah leh atapate leh atapa tate nna asem ding ua, huai nung in bel nam tampite leh kumpipa thupi mahmahte'n amah sikha ding in abawl ding uh."
english: All the nations shall serve him, and his son, and his son’s son, until the time of his own land come: and then many nations and great kings shall make him their bondservant.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hakkol po nuam lou leh a-nna sem nuam lou nam leh lalna gam namsau leh kial leh hipi a amah khut a ka hihman vek masiah amau ka gawt zel ding.
english: It shall happen, that the nation and the kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, that nation will I punish, says Yahweh, with the sword, and with the famine, and with the pestilence, until I have consumed them by his hand.

paite: Noute'n zaw na zawlneite uh, na aisan siamte uh; na mangte uh, na bumsiamte uh, na kiang ua, "Babilon kumpipa nna na sem kei ding uh," chi a gen mite ngaikhe kei un.
english: But as for you, don’t you listen to your prophets, nor to your diviners, nor to your dreams, nor to your soothsayers, nor to your sorcerers, who speak to you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon:

paite: "Na gam ua kipan a gamlapi a pimang a na omtheihna ding un, na kiang uah zuauthu agenkhol uh ahi; ka hon delhkhiak a na manthatna ding un.
english: for they prophesy a lie to you, to remove you far from your land, and that I should drive you out, and you should perish.

paite: Himahleh Babulon kumpipa hakkol pua a, nna sem nuam namte bel agam ngei uah ka omsak ding a, lei alet ding uh, huai ah ateng gige ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But the nation that shall bring their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, that nation will I let remain in their own land, says Yahweh; and they shall till it, and dwell therein.

paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kiang ah hiai thu tengteng bang zel in ka gen a, "Babilon kumpipa hakkol pua unla, amah leh amite nna sem unla, hing un!
english: I spoke to Zedekiah king of Judah according to all these words, saying, Bring your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
