paite: Babulon kumpipa nna sem nuam lou namte tungtang TOUPA'N agensa bang in bangziak a namsaute, kialte, hipite a nang leh na mite si ding na hi ua?
english: Why will you die, you and your people, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, as Yahweh has spoken concerning the nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?

paite: Zawlnei na kiang ua, Babulon kumpipa nna sem kei un, chite thu ngaikhe kei un; na kiang ua zuauthu gen lel ahi ngal ua.
english: Don’t listen to the words of the prophets who speak to you, saying, You shall not serve the king of Babylon; for they prophesy a lie to you.

paite: Ka sawl ahi kei ua, ka min sial in zuauthu agen nak ua, nou leh na kiang ua thugen zawlneite ka delhkhia a, na manthat theihna ding un," TOUPA'N achi.
english: For I have not sent them, says Yahweh, but they prophesy falsely in my name; that I may drive you out, and that you may perish, you, and the prophets who prophesy to you.

paite: Siampute leh hiai mipite tengteng kiang ah leng ka gen sam a; TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na kiang ua zawlnei thugen, "Ngai un, TOUPA' inn a belsuante Babulon a kipan inn hon tut ahi pah ding hi," chi mite thu ngaikhe kei un, na kiang uah zuau agen uhi.
english: Also I spoke to the priests and to all this people, saying, Thus says Yahweh: Don’t listen to the words of your prophets who prophesy to you, saying, Behold, the vessels of Yahweh’s house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon; for they prophesy a lie to you.

paite: Amaute ngaikhe het kei un; Babulon kumpipa nna sem unla, hing un; bang ding in hiai khopi akisegawp dia?
english: Don’t listen to them; serve the king of Babylon, and live: why should this city become a desolation?

paite: Himahleh zawlnei ahih ua, TOUPA thu akiang ua om mah ahihleh TOUPA' inn leh Judah kumpipa' inn leh Jerusalem a belsuan nutsiat a omlaite Babulon a tut ahihlouhna ding in sepaihte' TOUPA kiang ah ngen uhen.
english: But if they be prophets, and if the word of Yahweh be with them, let them now make intercession to Yahweh of Armies, that the vessels which are left in the house of Yahweh, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem, don’t go to Babylon.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, khuam sangte, dal tuipangte, kingaknate leh hiai khopi a belsuan nutsiat a omsunte,
english: For thus says Yahweh of Armies concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the residue of the vessels that are left in this city,

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tapa, Jekoniah leh Judah leh Jerusalem a mihoih tengteng Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon sal a dia api lai a alak val tungtang thu huchi in agen hi.
english: which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon didn’t take, when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, from Jerusalem to Babylon, and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem;

paite: Ahi, sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in TOUPA' inn leh Judah kumpipa' inn leh Jerusalem a belsuan nutsiat a om lai tungtang thu agen ahi;
english: yes, thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, concerning the vessels that are left in the house of Yahweh, and in the house of the king of Judah, and at Jerusalem:

paite: Babulon ah lakmang ahi ding ua, amaute ka hong veh masiah huai ah a-om nilouh ding uh; amau ka latou nawn ding a, hiai mun ah ka koih nawn ding a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: They shall be carried to Babylon, and there shall they be, until the day that I visit them, says Yahweh; then will I bring them up, and restore them to this place.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, huai kum mah in, Judah kumpipa Zedekiah, vaihawm pat tunglam, akum lina, akha ngana ah zawlnei Hananiah, Azzur tapa Gibeon min siampute leh mipi tengteng ma ah, TOUPA' inn ah hon houpih hi.
english: It happened the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spoke to me in the house of Yahweh, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Babilon kumpipa hakkol ka hihtanta.
english: Thus speaks Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon.

paite: Kum nih sung vengveng in TOUPA' inn a belsuan Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in hiai mun a kipan a alak a, Babulon tan a apaipih tengteng, hiai mun mahmah ah ka hon tun nawn vek ding.
english: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of Yahweh’s house, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place, and carried to Babylon:

paite: Hiai mun ah Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tapa, Jekoniah leh Babulon a hoh Judah saltang tengteng ka pikik nawn ding; Babulon kumpipa hakkol lah hihtan ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi," chi in.
english: and I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, with all the captives of Judah, who went to Babylon, says Yahweh; for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon.

paite: Huan zawlnei Jeremiah in siampute leh TOUPA' inn a ding mipi tengteng ma ah zawlnei Hananiah kiang ah,
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah in the presence of the priests, and in the presence of all the people who stood in the house of Yahweh,

paite: Zawlnei Jeremiah ngei in, "Amen, TOUPA'N huchibang in hih ngei hen; TOUPA' inn a belsuante leh saltanna a mi tengteng Babulon a kipan hiai mun a hon tun ding a na gen TOUPA'N hih ngei hen.
english: even the prophet Jeremiah said, Amen: Yahweh do so; Yahweh perform your words which you have prophesied, to bring again the vessels of Yahweh’s house, and all them of the captivity, from Babylon to this place.

paite: Himahleh mipi tengteng leh na bil a ka thugen ngaikhia in.
english: Nevertheless hear you now this word that I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people:

paite: Kei leh nang ma a nidang a zawlneite'n gam tampi tung ah leh lalna gam thupi pite tung ah kidounate, thil hoihloute leh hipi thute agen sek uh.
english: The prophets who have been before me and before you of old prophesied against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.

paite: Zawlnei muanna thugenmi thugen ahong tun hun chiang in, huai zawlnei pen TOUPA'N asawl ngei ahi, chih akithei mai ding," achi hi.
english: The prophet who prophesies of peace, when the word of the prophet shall happen, then shall the prophet be known, that Yahweh has truly sent him.

paite: Huan zawlnei Hananiah in hakkol, zawlnei Jeremiah puak ala a, ahihtan hi.
english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the bar from off the prophet Jeremiah’s neck, and broke it.

paite: Mipi tengteng ma ah Hananiah in, Hichi in TOUPA'N achi: "Hichibang ngei in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hakkol kum nih sung vingveng in nam tengteng ngawng a kipan ka hihtan ding, achi hi." Huchi in zawlnei Jeremiah in apaisanta hi.
english: Hananiah spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus says Yahweh: Even so will I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon within two full years from off the neck of all the nations. The prophet Jeremiah went his way.

paite: Huan zawlnei Hananiah in zawlnei Jeremiah ngawng a kipan hakkol ahihtan nung in Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Then the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the bar from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Kuan inla, Hananiah kiang ah huchi in va chi in. Hichi in TOUPA'N achi: "Sing hakkol na hihtan a, atang in sik hakkol na bawlsak zaw ahi.
english: Go, and tell Hananiah, saying, Thus says Yahweh: You have broken the bars of wood; but you have made in their place bars of iron.

paite: Hichi in Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi ngal a, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar nna aseptheihna ding un hiai nam tengteng sik hakkol ka posak ding ahi; amah nna asem ding uh; gamnuai a gamsate leng amah ka pe lai ahi," chi in.
english: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all these nations, that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and they shall serve him: and I have given him the animals of the field also.

paite: Huan zawlnei Jeremiah in zawlnei Hananiah kiang ah, "Ngai in, Hananiah, TOUPA'N nang ahon sawl peuhmah kei hi; hiai mite zuau na muangsak lel ahi zaw."
english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, Hear now, Hananiah: Yahweh has not sent you; but you make this people to trust in a lie.

paite: Huaiziak in huchi in TOUPA'N achi: "Ngai dih, leitung a kipan ka hon hihmang vengveng ding; TOUPA tung a helna thu na gen ziak in tukum mahmah in na si ding," achi hi.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will send you away from off the surface of the earth: this year you shall die, because you have spoken rebellion against Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in huai kum mah, akha sagihna ah zawlnei Hananiah asita hi.
english: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.

paite: Zawlnei Jeremiah in Jerusalem a kipan a saltang upate, siampute, zawlneite, midangte, Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon a api khit, akhosuaksunte kiang a alaikhak thu hiai ahi:
english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people, whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,

paite: Kumpipa Jekoniahte, kumpinute, michilgehte, Judah leh Jerusalem heutute, mikhutsiamte, siksek mite Jerusalem apaikhiak nung ua;
english: (after that Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths, had departed from Jerusalem),

paite: Shaphan tapa, Elasah leh Hilkiah tapa, Gemariahte khut ah akhak hi; amaute bel Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in Babulon gam a Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang a asawlte ahi uh.
english: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon), saying,

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N saltang tengteng, Jerusalem a kipan Babulon sal dia ka pisaksate kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, to all the captivity, whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:

paite: Inn lam unla, huai ah teng un, huan bawl unla, agah ne un, zi nei unla, tanute tapate nei un.
english: Build houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat their fruit.

paite: Na tapate uh zi neisak unla, na tanute uh pasal neisak unla, tanu tapa aneihtheihna ding un; huai ah va pung unla, kiam lam nawt kei un;
english: Take wives, and father sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; and multiply there, and don’t be diminished.

paite: sal dia ka hon tansakna khopi hoihna ding zong unla, TOUPA kiang ah ngetsak un; ama hoihna ah nou leng hoihna na mu ding uhi.
english: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to Yahweh for it; for in its peace you shall have peace.

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na lak ua zawlneite leh aisan siamte'n hon khem kei uhenla, amang mat uh leng ngaikhe sam kei un.
english: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Don’t let your prophets who are in the midst of you, and your diviners, deceive you; neither listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

paite: Ka min sial in zuauthu na kiang ah agen uhi; kei sawl ahi kei uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name: I have not sent them, says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, Babulon a ding in kum sawmsagih achin chiang in ka hong veh ding a, na kiang ua ka thuchiam hoihtak ka tungsak ding, hiai mun ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding.
english: For thus says Yahweh, After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

paite: Nou lam a ka lungsim putdan ka kithei hi, na hun nanung tawp ua lametna leh tunung hon pe ding in thil hoih lou hilou in hoihna ngaihtuah ka hi.
english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, says Yahweh, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

paite: Huan na hon kan ding ua, ka kiang ah na hong thum ding ua, ka hon ngaikhe ding hi.
english: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

paite: Na hon zong ding ua, na lungtang tengteng ua na hon zon hun chiang un na hon mu ding uh.
english: You shall seek me, and find me, when you shall search for me with all your heart.

paite: Huchi in na hon muh un ka om ding, TOUPA thupawt in achi, "Na vangphatnate uh ka tungding nawn ding a, nam tengteng lak a ka hon dalhsakna mun a kipan ka hon pikhawm nawn ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; sal dia ka hon matsakna mun ngei ah ka hon tungsak nawn ding," chi in.
english: I will be found by you, says Yahweh, and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you, says Yahweh; and I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.

paite: "TOUPA'N Babulon gam ah leng zawlnei ahon bawlsak," na chi uhi.
english: Because you have said, Yahweh has raised us up prophets in Babylon;

paite: TOUPA'N David tutphah ah kumpipa tungtang thu leh hiai khopi a teng mipi tengteng, sal dia pi tel louh, na unaute uh tungtang thu ah hichi in achi:
english: thus says Yahweh concerning the king who sits on the throne of David, and concerning all the people who dwell in this city, your brothers who haven’t gone forth with you into captivity;

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, atung uah namsau, kial leh hipi in ka delhzui ding a, theipi hut, ahoih louh mahmah ziak a nek tuak het lou bang mai in ka bawl ding.
english: thus says Yahweh of Armies; Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like vile figs, that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.

paite: Namsau, kial, hipi in ka delhzui ding a, leitung alalna gam tengteng thil mulkimhuaitak in ka bawl ding a, amau ka dalhsakna nam tengteng lak ah hamsethuak ding in, lamdangsak chiat ding in, hamsiatkhum, selphou leh gensiat hi ding in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, and an astonishment, and a hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations where I have driven them;

paite: Phalvak a thou a ka nasem, zawlnei zang a ka thu na kiang ua ka hon tut khawk asak louh ziak un. TOUPA thupawt in achi; na ngaikhe nuam ngal kei ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: because they have not listened to my words, says Yahweh, with which I sent to them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear, says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in nou Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon a ka sawl, saltang tengteng aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un.
english: Hear therefore the word of Yahweh, all you of the captivity, whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

paite: "Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Kolaiah tapa, Ahab leh Maaseiah tapa, Zedekiah ka min sial a na kiang ua zuauthu gen mite tungtang thu ah hichi in achi: Ngai un, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah ka mansak ding hi; na mitmuh ngei un athat ding;
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he shall kill them before your eyes;

paite: Amau thu ah Babulon gam a Judah saltang tengteng in, Babulon kumpipa'n mei a a-em Zedekiah leh Ahab bang mai in TOUPA'N na tung ah hih hen, chih hamse lohna in aneihloh ding uh.
english: and of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, Yahweh make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

paite: Israel gam ah thil haihuaitak ahih ua, invengte uh zite ang a kawm ua, ka min sial in ka thupiak louh zuauthu agen ziak un; kei atheipa leh atheihpihpa ka hi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: because they have worked folly in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I didn’t command them; and I am he who knows, and am witness, says Yahweh.

paite: Nehelam mi, Shemaiah tungtang thu ah nang hichi a na gen ding ahi.
english: Concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying,

paite: Israel' Pathian, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Jerusalem mipi tengtengte kiang ah nangmah min mahmah in lai na khak hi.
english: Thus speaks Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, saying, Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N siampu Jehoiada sik in siampu ding in nang ahon bawl a, TOUPA inkemmi na hi ua, mihai, zawlnei kichi peuhte kemte, sikkolte na butsak ding ahi.
english: Yahweh has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in the house of Yahweh, for every man who is mad, and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.

paite: Huchi in bangziak a Anathoth a mi Jeremiah, na kiang ua zawlnei kichi na taihilh louh uh?
english: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,

paite: Babulon gam ah i kiang uah, "Saltanna ding asawt ding a, inn lam unla, hiai ah teng un, huan bawl unla, agah ne un, chih thu ahon khak hi," chi in.
english: because he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, The captivity is long: build houses, and dwell in them; and plant gardens, and eat their fruit?

paite: Huan siampu Zephaniah in huai laikhak zawlnei Jeremiah zak in asim hi.
english: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tungta.
english: Then came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Saltangte tengteng kiang ah, Nehelam mi Shemaiah tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N huchi in achi: Ka sawl het louh in Shemaiah in na kiang uah thu agen a, zuauthu nou ahon gingtasak a,
english: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus says Yahweh concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn’t send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie;

paite: huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai un, Nehelam mi Shemaiah leh asuante ka gawt ding a, hiai mite lak ah mi khat lel leng anei kei ding, ka mite a ding a thil hoih ka hih ding amu kei ding; TOUPA tung ah helna thu agen ziak in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in khak in achi hi.
english: therefore thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed; he shall not have a man to dwell among this people, neither shall he see the good that I will do to my people, says Yahweh, because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh.

paite: Mi'n zi ma henla, amah a pan paikhia in pasal dang neileh, ama'n aneikik nawn diam? Agam in nitloh hial lou ding hia? chih a-om. Nang bel tangval tampi kiang ah na hukmang in, huchipi in ka kiang ah na hong kik nawn ding maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and become another man’s, will he return to her again?’ Wouldn’t that land be greatly polluted? But you have played the prostitute with many lovers; yet return again to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Tang giau viauvuau lam ah na mitte lengtousak inla, en in, ahon kithuahpihlouhna mun koi ah? Gamdai a Arabia mi bang mai in amau ngak in lampi geite ah na tu nilouh sek, na hukna leh na thulimlouhnate in gam na hihnin khinta hi.
english: “Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat for them by the ways, as an Arabian in the wilderness. You have polluted the land with your prostitution and with your wickedness.

paite: Huaiziak in vuah zuksak ahi kei a, vuah nanung leng azu sam kei; mihuk talpuak in na pua, na zum het kei hi.
english: Therefore the showers have been withheld, and there has been no latter rain; yet you have a prostitute’s forehead, you refused to be ashamed.

paite: Ka pa, ka tuailai a hon pipa na hi, chi in tua kipan in na sam kei ding maw?
english: Will you not from this time cry to me, ‘My Father, you are the guide of my youth?’

paite: Na heh tawntung ding a hia? Athangpaihna a omden ding ahia? Ngai in, huchibang in na pau ngei a, himahleh agilou theipen in thil na hih hi
english: “‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he keep it to the end?’ Behold, you have spoken and have done evil things, and have had your way.”

paite: Huai lou leng Josiah vaihawm lai in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi, "Nungkinhat Israel thilhih na mu hia? Tang sang chih a kuantou a, singbawk chih nuaite a ahukna thil ahihte?
english: Moreover, Yahweh said to me in the days of Josiah the king, “Have you seen that which backsliding Israel has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every green tree, and there has played the prostitute.

paite: Huan ke'n bel hiai thil tengteng ahih nung in ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn ding, ka chi a; himahleh ahong kik tuan kei; huchi in asanggamnu, khemhat Judah in amu samta hi.
english: I said after she had done all these things, ‘She will return to me;’ but she didn’t return; and her treacherous sister Judah saw it.

paite: Ama'n nungkinhat Israel a-angkawm ziak a ka mak a, makna lai ka piak amuh in leng asanggamnu, khemhat Judah in alau tuan kei, huchih nak sang in ava hoh a, hukna thil ava hihteita hi.
english: I saw, when, for this very cause that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a bill of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, didn’t fear; but she also went and played the prostitute.

paite: Huan ahuk mawkmawk zenhouh ziak in gam ahihnin khinta a; singbul, suangbul kiang ah ang akawmta hi.
english: It happened through the lightness of her prostitution, that the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with stocks.

paite: Huchipi in leng asanggamnu, khemhat Judah lungtangtak a ka kiang a hong kik lou in azuaulel in ahong kik a," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Yet for all this her treacherous sister, Judah, has not returned to me with her whole heart, but only in pretense,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N ka kiang ah hichi in achi, "Nungkinhat Israel in asanggamnu, khemhat Judah sang in diktatzaw in akihihlang a.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Backsliding Israel has shown herself more righteous than treacherous Judah.

paite: Kuan inla, hiai thu mallam ah va puang in; Nungkinhat Israel hong kik in," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Heh melpu in ka hon en kei ding a, zahngaitheitak ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, ka heh tawntung kei ding hi.
english: Go, and proclaim these words toward the north, and say, ‘Return, you backsliding Israel,’ says Yahweh; ‘I will not look in anger on you; for I am merciful,’ says Yahweh. ‘I will not keep anger forever.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian tung a na helnate, singbawk nuai a pau tuam mite kiang a na kiphal gaihnate, ka paukam suak na manlouhnate a na thulimlouhna ah thupha tawi in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Only acknowledge your iniquity, that you have transgressed against Yahweh your God, and have scattered your ways to the strangers under every green tree, and you have not obeyed my voice,’ says Yahweh.”

paite: Aw nungkinhat tate aw, hong kik un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Nou hon honpa ka hi ngal a, na lak ua kipan khopi a mi khat, inkuan a mi nih ka hon la ding a, Zion ah ka hon pi ding hi.
english: “Return, backsliding children,” says Yahweh; “for I am a husband to you. I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you to Zion.

paite: Ka lung toh kituak belamchingte ka hon pe ding a, amau theihna leh theihsiamnate in noute ahon vak ding uhi.
english: I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who shall feed you with knowledge and understanding.

paite: Huchi in na hong tam ua, gam a na hong pun chiang un, huai ni chiang in amau, TOUPA thukhun bawm, achi ngei nawn kei ding uh; alungsim uah alut kei ding a, theih leng atheigige sam kei ding uh; akhelah nawn kei ding ua, abawl nawn kei ding uh.
english: It shall come to pass, when you are multiplied and increased in the land, in those days,” says Yahweh, “they shall say no more, ‘The ark of the covenant of Yahweh!’ neither shall it come to mind; neither shall they remember it; neither shall they miss it; neither shall it be made any more.

paite: Huai nung in Jerusalem bel TOUPA laltutphah achi ding ua, huai ah nam tengteng TOUPA min in Jerusalem ah ahong paikhawm ding uh; alungtang gilou khauhna uh bang in apaita kei ding uh.
english: At that time they shall call Jerusalem ‘The throne of Yahweh;’ and all the nations shall be gathered to it, to the name of Yahweh, to Jerusalem. Neither shall they walk any more after the stubbornness of their evil heart.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Judah inkote Israel inkote toh a-omkhawm ding ua, mallam gam a kipan in, na pipute uh kiang a gouluah ding a ka piak gam ah, ahong pawtkhe ding uh.
english: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel, and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I gave for an inheritance to your fathers.

paite: Ke'n bel, "Nam chih lak a gouluah ding hoihpen, gam nuamtak hon pia in, tate lak a hon koih ka utdan! Ka pa, chi a na hon sap a, na hon zuihna a kipan na pialmang kei ding, chih ka na um hi.
english: “But I said, ‘How I would put you among the children, and give you a pleasant land, a goodly heritage of the armies of the nations!’ and I said, ‘You shall call me “My Father,” and shall not turn away from following me.’

paite: Zi khemhat pasal ang kawmsan bang in, Aw Israel inkote aw, hon khem na hita ve ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “Surely as a wife treacherously departs from her husband, so you have dealt treacherously with me, house of Israel,” says Yahweh.

paite: Tang giau velvul tung ah husa a-om hi, Israel suante kap leh thil ngen husa, TOUPA Pathian amangngilh ua, a-omdan uh ahihgawp ziak un.
english: A voice is heard on the bare heights, the weeping and the petitions of the children of Israel; because they have perverted their way, they have forgotten Yahweh their God.

paite: Anungkin hat tate aw, hong kik unla, na nungkin seknate uh ka hihdam ding hi; en dih, na kiang ah ka hong pai uhi, nang TOUPA ka Pathian uh na hi.
english: Return, you backsliding children, I will heal your backsliding. “Behold, we have come to you; for you are Yahweh our God.

paite: "Mualte a hotdamna lamet athawn ahi, tang tung a husa chiak vengvungte; Israel hotdamna zaw TOUPA i Pathian kia ah ahi a-om.
english: Truly in vain is help from the hills, the tumult on the mountains. Truly the salvation of Israel is in Yahweh our God.

paite: Himahleh huai thilkihhuai mahmah in i tuailai a kipan i pipute'n tha asukbeina uh anebeita hi; abelamhonte uh, aganhonte uh, atanute uh, atapate uh tan in.
english: But the shameful thing has devoured the labor of our fathers from our youth, their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.

paite: Zum in lum ni e, i zahlakna in hon khuh heh; TOUPA i Pathian tung ah thil i hihkhial ua, ei leh i pipute'n i tuailai a kipan tuni tan in TOUPA i Pathian paukam i mang kei uhi."
english: Let us lie down in our shame, and let our confusion cover us; for we have sinned against Yahweh our God, we and our fathers, from our youth even to this day. We have not obeyed the voice of Yahweh our God.”

paite: Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA a kipan thu ahong tung a;
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na kiang a thu ka gen tengteng laibu ah gelh in," chi in.
english: Thus speaks Yahweh, the God of Israel, saying, Write all the words that I have spoken to you in a book.

paite: Ngai in, Israel leh Judah, ka mite omdan ka kikhelsakna ding nite ahong tung lellel hi; gam, apipute uh kiang a ka piak ah ka pikik nawn ding a, aluahta ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in TOUPA'N achi.
english: For, behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will turn again the captivity of my people Israel and Judah, says Yahweh; and I will cause them to return to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they shall possess it.

paite: Huan Judah leh Israel tungtang thu a TOUPA thugen hiaite ahi:
english: These are the words that Yahweh spoke concerning Israel and concerning Judah.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Lauhthawnna husa ka za uh, muanna hilou, launa kikou husa.
english: For thus says Yahweh: We have heard a voice of trembling, of fear, and not of peace.

paite: Dong vialvial unla, en vialvial dih ua, pasal in nau avei thei hia? Bangziak a numei nauvei bang zen a, pasalte'n atai uh adep chiat ua, amelte uh ahong molh khit?
english: Ask now, and see whether a man does travail with child: why do I see every man with his hands on his waist, as a woman in travail, and all faces are turned into paleness?

paite: Maizen aw! Huai ni thupi hina mai e, akibatpih mahmah a-om kei, Jakob mangbat ni ahi mah ngut hi, himahleh hotkhiak in a-om ding.
english: Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it: it is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he shall be saved out of it.

paite: Huai ni in hichi ahi ding a, ahakkol puak ka hihtan ding a, akhau leng ka kitatsak ding; pau tuam mite'n amah nasempa ding in azang ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: It shall come to pass in that day, says Yahweh of Armies, that I will break his yoke from off your neck, and will burst your bonds; and strangers shall no more make him their bondservant;

paite: TOUPA a Pathian uh leh akumpipa uh hi ding a ka tunding ding David nna asem zaw ding uhi.
english: but they shall serve Yahweh their God, and David their king, whom I will raise up to them.

paite: Huaiziak in aw ka nasempa Jakob aw, lau het ke'n aw, Israel aw, lunglel het ke'n, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ngai in, gamlapi a kipan in ka hong hunkhe ding a, asaltanna ua kipan na suante ngei, huan Jakob akik nawn ding a, kuamah in alausak ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: Therefore don’t you be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh; neither be dismayed, Israel: for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

paite: Nang hon hun ding in na kiang ah ka om gige ngal a, ka hon dalhsakna nam tengteng, ka beisak ding a, nang bel beisak lou in; ahun lel in ka hon gawt ding a, gawt louh in na pawt het kei ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For I am with you, says Yahweh, to save you: for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have scattered you, but I will not make a full end of you; but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, na liamna hihdam theih ahi kei a, na meima athupi hi.
english: For thus says Yahweh, Your hurt is incurable, and your wound grievous.

paite: Nang hon panpih ding a-om kei ua, na damna ding damdawi a-om sam kei hi.
english: There is none to plead your cause, that you may be bound up: you have no healing medicines.

paite: Nang hon itte'n ahon mangngilhta ua, hon limsakta kei uh; melma liamna in ka hon liamsak a, dawm lou in ka hon gawt hi, na thulimlouhna athupi a, na thilhih giloute apun ziak in.
english: All your lovers have forgotten you; they don’t seek you: for I have wounded you with the wound of an enemy, with the chastisement of a cruel one, for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased.

paite: Bangziak a na liam ziak a kap na hia? Na liamna hihdam theih ahi kei, na thulimlouhna athupi a, na thilhihkhelhte apun ziak in, hiai thilte na tung a hih ka hi.
english: Why do you cry for your hurt? Your pain is incurable: for the greatness of your iniquity, because your sins were increased, I have done these things to you.

paite: Himahleh nang hon negaite, nekgaih in a-om ding ua, na melmate michih, sal dia pi in a-om ding uh, nang hon lokte loh in a-om ding ua, gallak a hon late gallak in ka la ding hi.
english: Therefore all those who devour you shall be devoured; and all your adversaries, everyone of them, shall go into captivity; and those who despoil you shall be a spoil, and all who prey on you will I give for a prey.

paite: Ka hon damsak nawn ding a, na liamnate ka hihdam ding; TOUPA thupawt in achi; delhkhiak, ahon chi ua, kuamah limsak louh Zion ahi, ahon chih ziak un.
english: For I will restore health to you, and I will heal you of your wounds, says Yahweh; because they have called you an outcast, saying, It is Zion, whom no man seeks after.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Ngai in, Jakob puanin saltangte ka lehhei ding a, atenna munte ka zahngaihsak ding a, a-omna mual ngei ah akhopi lam ahi ding a, akumpipa' inn a-omdan ngei in adingh nawn ding.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I will turn again the captivity of Jacob’s tents, and have compassion on his dwelling places; and the city shall be built on its own hill, and the palace shall be inhabited in its own way.

paite: Kipahthu Genna leh nopsakna husa, huaite a pan ahong pawtkhe ding a, Mite ka pungsak ding a, atawm kei ding uh, amau ka hih thupi ding a, aneu kei ding uh.
english: Out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of those who make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

paite: Atate uh leng nidanglai bang in a-om ding ua, ka ma ah a-omkhopna uh akip ding a; amaute nuaisiah mite peuhmah ka gawt ding hi.
english: Their children also shall be as before, and their congregation shall be established before me; and I will punish all who oppress them.

paite: Aheutupa uh amau mi mah ahi ding a, avaihawmpa uh amau lak a hong pawt mah ahi ding; ahon naih ding a, amah ka bawl dia, ama'n ahon naih ding; kua ahia amah thu a hon naih ngam ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Their prince shall be of themselves, and their ruler shall proceed from their midst; and I will cause him to draw near, and he shall approach to me: for who is he who has had boldness to approach to me? says Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka mite na hi ding ua, kei na Pathian uh ka hi ding."
english: You shall be my people, and I will be your God.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA huihpi, ahehna huihpi hat mahmah apawtkheta a; migiloute lu anuai ek ding hi.
english: Behold, the storm of Yahweh, his wrath, has gone forth, a sweeping storm: it shall burst on the head of the wicked.

paite: Alungtang tupnate tangtun a ahih khit masiah, TOUPA hehna lauhuai mahmah akikhel kei ding; ni nanungte ah na hon theisiam ding uhi.
english: The fierce anger of Yahweh will not return, until he has executed, and until he has performed the intentions of his heart. In the latter days you will understand it.

paite: "Huai hun chiang in kei Israel inkuante Pathian ka hi ding a, amaute leng ka mite ahi ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: At that time, says Yahweh, will I be the God of all the families of Israel, and they shall be my people.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Namsau thah valte, gamdai gam a ka khawl tawldamsak lai in hehpihna amu ua, Israel mahmah ka tawldamsak lai in.
english: Thus says Yahweh, The people who were left of the sword found favor in the wilderness; even Israel, when I went to cause him to rest.

paite: Nidang a ka kiang a TOUPA hong kilang in, hichi in achi: Ahi, it tawp lou in ka hon it a, huaiziak in lainatna in ka hon kai hi.
english: Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love: therefore with loving kindness have I drawn you.

paite: K'on dingh thaksak ding, nungak siangthou Israel aw, dingh in kipsak na hong hi ding a, na khuangte toh kizem in na om nawn ding a, nopsak lai lamna munte ah na tel ding hi.
english: Again will I build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Israel: again you shall be adorned with your tambourines, and shall go forth in the dances of those who make merry.

paite: Samaria tang dung tawn in grephuante na bawl ding a, teng mite'n aching ding ua, agahte ane ding uhi.
english: Again you shall plant vineyards on the mountains of Samaria; the planters shall plant, and shall enjoy its fruit.

paite: Ephraim tanggamte ah, ching mite kikou ni atung ding hi. Thou un, Zion ah i hoh ding uh, TOUPA i Pathian uh kiang ah," chi in.
english: For there shall be a day, that the watchmen on the hills of Ephraim shall cry, Arise, and let us go up to Zion to Yahweh our God.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Jakob a ding in nuam in la sa unla, nam thupipen a ding in kikoukhia un, puang unla, pahtawi unla, "TOUPA Israel khosuaksun, na mite hondam in,' chi un.
english: For thus says Yahweh, Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout for the chief of the nations: publish, praise, and say, Yahweh, save your people, the remnant of Israel.

paite: Ngai un, mal gam a kipan ka hon pi ding, kawlmong tawp a kipan ka kaikhawm ding, mittaw, khebai, numei naupaite, nauvei lelte toh, mipi tampitak ahong tungkhawm ding uh.
english: Behold, I will bring them from the north country, and gather them from the uttermost parts of the earth, along with the blind and the lame, the woman with child and her who travails with child together: a great company shall they return here.

paite: Khitui toh ahong pai ding ua, khamuangtak in ka pi ding, tui luang lamte ah ka vaksak ding a, akisuihlouhna ding uh lamtangte ah; Israel a ding in pa ka hi a, Ephraim bel ka tachil ahi.
english: They shall come with weeping; and with petitions will I lead them: I will cause them to walk by rivers of waters, in a straight way in which they shall not stumble; for I am a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn.

paite: Aw namte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia unla, tui gei gam gamlapi ah puang unla, Israel dalhsakpa'n apikhawm nawn ding a, Belamchingpa'n abelamte akep bang in akem ding chi in.
english: Hear the word of Yahweh, you nations, and declare it in the islands afar off; and say, He who scattered Israel will gather him, and keep him, as shepherd does his flock.

paite: Jakob bel TOUPA'N atankhia a, asang a hat a pan ahunkheta hi.
english: For Yahweh has ransomed Jacob, and redeemed him from the hand of him who was stronger than he.

paite: Zion vum ah lasa in ahong pai ding ua, TOUPA hoihna ah akipak ding ua, buhte, uainte, thaute, belam leh ganhon noute tungte ah akipak ding uh; ahinna uh tui avak huan bang ahi ding a, tangtawn in alungkham nawn kei ding uh.
english: They shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, and to the new wine, and to the oil, and to the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all.

paite: Huan nungak siangthoute kipak a lam in anuam ding ua, tangvalte leng atek-akhang in anuam ding ua, alusuunna uh kipahna ka suaksak in ka khamuan ding, adahna ua pan ka kipaksak ding.
english: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, and the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy, and will comfort them, and make them rejoice from their sorrow.

paite: Siampute hinna thau in ka taisak ding a, ka hoihna in ka mite leng atai ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ramah ah husa aza ua, misi ngai a kap huphup, Rakil in atate akah a, atate a-om nawn louh ziak in akhamuan theih kei hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh: A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation, and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children; she refuses to be comforted for her children, because they are no more.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Kap lou ding in na aw dek inla, na khitui hul hen, na thilhih in kipahman anei ding chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Gal gam a kipan in ahong pai nawn ding uhi.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Refrain your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears; for your work shall be rewarded, says Yahweh; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy.

paite: Na hun tawp lam a ding in lametna a-om a, amau gam ah na tate ahong kik nawn ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: There is hope for your latter end, says Yahweh; and your children shall come again to their own border.

paite: Ephraim kah leh mauna ka za hi, nang na hon gawt a, bawngtaltuai sawi bang mai in sawi ka hi a, na kiang ah hon kiksak inla, ka kik ding hi, TOUPA ka Pathian na hi ngal a.
english: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself thus, You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf: turn me, and I shall be turned; for you are Yahweh my God.

paite: N'on kiksak khit nung in ka kisika, na hon thuzoh nung in ka pheipi ka beng a, ka zum a, ahi, ka tuailai minsiat thuak in ka am ahai hi,” achi hi.
english: Surely after that I was turned, I repented; and after that I was instructed, I struck on my thigh: I was ashamed, yes, even confounded, because I bore the reproach of my youth.

paite: Ephraim, ka tapa deihtak, ka nau deihtak ahih ziak hia amah ka thunun teng a ka lungtang a aten tinten nak? Huchi in ka lungtang in amah alainat sek a, atung ah zah ka ngai ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Is Ephraim my dear son? is he a darling child? for as often as I speak against him, I do earnestly remember him still: therefore my heart yearns for him; I will surely have mercy on him, says Yahweh.

paite: Lampi chiamtehna kibawl inla, nang a ding in lampi kawkmuhna phut in, na va pawtna lam lampi, lampi pen lam ngei chiamteh tinten in; aw nungak siangthou Israel, hong kik nawn in, na khopi ngei ah.
english: Set up road signs, make guideposts; set your heart toward the highway, even the way by which you went: turn again, virgin of Israel, turn again to these your cities.

paite: Aw, nang tanu nungtawn, bang tan ahia na vialvak vak ding? TOUPA'N lei ah thil thak asiamta a, numei in pasal ahum zawta hi.
english: How long will you go here and there, you backsliding daughter? for Yahweh has created a new thing in the earth: a woman shall encompass a man.

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Asaltanna ua kipan ka pikik hun chiang in Judah gam leh akhopite ah hichibang paukam azang nawn ding uh; "Aw, diktatna tenna mun, Aw tang siangthou, TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen," chih.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Yet again shall they use this speech in the land of Judah and in its cities, when I shall bring again their captivity: Yahweh bless you, habitation of righteousness, mountain of holiness.

paite: Huai ah Judahte leh akhopi uah mi tengteng atengkhawm ding ua, lounei mite leh ganvul mite toh.
english: Judah and all its cities shall dwell therein together, the farmers, and those who go about with flocks.

paite: Mibahte ka taisakta a, milungkham peuhmahte leng ka hihhalhta hi.
english: For I have satiated the weary soul, and every sorrowful soul have I replenished.

paite: Huchi in ka hong halh a, ka nga vialvial a, mang hoihtak ana hi.
english: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.

paite: Ngai dih, nite ahong tung ding hi, Israel inkote leh Judah inkote ah mihing chi leh gan chi ka tuh ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man, and with the seed of animal.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, amau botkhia a, hihzan leh paikhia a, hihmang a, hihgim ding a ka tan bang in amau ding hoihsak ding leh tungding ding in ka enkhe nawn ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: It shall happen that, like as I have watched over them to pluck up and to break down and to overthrow and to destroy and to afflict, so will I watch over them to build and to plant, says Yahweh.

paite: Huai nite in, "Pate'n grep thuk ane ua, atate uh ha azau a, achi nawn ngei kei ding uh."
english: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.

paite: Michih in amau gitlouhna asihpih zaw ding ua, grep thuk ne peuhmah ha azau ding hi.
english: But everyone shall die for his own iniquity: every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth shall be set on edge.

paite: Ngai dih, nite ahong tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; huai nite ah Israel inkote leh Judah inkote kiang ah thukhun thak ka bawl ding.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah:

paite: Apipute uh Aigupta gam a kipan a pikhe ding a akhut uh ka let ni a ka thukhun bang hilou in, amaute a dia apasal uh ka hih in leng ka thukhun abohsia ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; which my covenant they broke, although I was a husband to them, says Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni khit chiang a Israel inkote kiang a ka thukhun ding bel hiai ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; asunggil uah ka dan ka koih ding a, alungtang uah ka gelh lai ding a, kei a Pathian uh ka hi ding a, amau ka mite ahi ding uh;
english: But this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, says Yahweh: I will put my law in their inward parts, and in their heart will I write it; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people:

paite: Kuamah in, "TOUPA thei in, chi in amau invengte leh amau unau ahilh kei ding ua; aneupen a kipan in alianpen tan in avek un ahon thei chiat ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, "Abohsiatna uh ka ngaidam ding a, akhelhna uh leng ka theigige kei ding," chi in.
english: and they shall teach no more every man his neighbor, and every man his brother, saying, Know Yahweh; for they shall all know me, from their least to their greatest, says Yahweh: for I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin will I remember no more.

paite: Hichi in TOUPA, sun vaksak ding a ni pepa, kha leh aksite a dia dante sehsak a, zan vaksak ding a pepa, tuikihotte ging honhon ding a tuipi tokthoupa'n achi hi; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who stirs up the sea, so that its waves roar; Yahweh of Armies is his name:

paite: "Hiai dansehte ka ma a kipan amanleh Israel suante ka ma a kipan in nam hih atawp den sam ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: If these ordinances depart from before me, says Yahweh, then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me forever.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Tunglam van teh theih ahih a, lei kingaknate zonkhiak theih ahihleh Israel suante athilhihsate uh ziak in ka paimang sam ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Thus says Yahweh: If heaven above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath, then will I also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done, says Yahweh.

paite: "Ngai in, nite ahong tung lellel hi, Hananel insung a kipan in kulh ning kongpi tan in TOUPA a ding in khopi lamkhiak ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that the city shall be built to Yahweh from the tower of Hananel to the gate of the corner.

paite: Atehna khau bel Gareb mual tan in tangtak in apai zinzen ding a, Goath lam ah akawi ding hi.
english: The measuring line shall go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and shall turn about to Goah.

paite: Misi luang leh vut paihna phaizang pumpi leh gamlak tengteng, Kidron lui phaizang tan in, suahlam pang Sakol Kongpi ning tan TOUPA ding a tan ding ahi; huai tuh chikchiang mah a hihzak leh phelsiat ahi nawn kei ding hi."
english: The whole valley of the dead bodies and of the ashes, and all the fields to the brook Kidron, to the corner of the horse gate toward the east, shall be holy to Yahweh; it shall not be plucked up, nor thrown down any more forever.

paite: Judah Kumpipa Zedekiah akum sawmna, huai tuh Nebukadnezzar akum sawm-le-giatna ahi, Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.

paite: Huai in Babulon kumpipa sepaihhon in Jerusalem a-um ua; huan Judah kumpipa' inn ngakmi huangsung ah zawlnei Jeremiah atang hi.
english: Now at that time the king of Babylon’s army was besieging Jerusalem; and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the guard, which was in the king of Judah’s house.

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in, "Bangdia, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Ngai in, hiai khopi Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe ding a ala ding;
english: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Why do you prophesy, and say, Thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leng Kaldai mite khut a kipan apawt kei ding, Babulon kumpipa khut a matsak in a-om zaw ding a, kimaituah in akihoupih ding ua, amit ngei in amel amu ding;
english: and Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall see his eyes;

paite: Zedekiah bel Babulon gam ah api ding a, amah ka veh mateng huai ah a-om nilouh ding; Kaldaite dou mah le uchin na lohching kei ding uh?" " chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: and he shall bring Zedekiah to Babylon, and he shall be there until I visit him, says Yahweh: though you fight with the Chaldeans, you shall not prosper?

paite: Huan Jeremiah in, ka kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
english: Jeremiah said, The word of Yahweh came to me, saying,

paite: Ngai in, na paneu Shallum tapa Hanamel in Anathoth a ka lou nang a ding in lei in, "Gouluah thei na hih ziak in na hon leisak ding ahi chi in na kiang ah ahong pai ding," chi in.
english: Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle shall come to you, saying, Buy my field that is in Anathoth; for the right of redemption is yours to buy it.

paite: Huchi in ka paneu tapa Hanamel in, "Anathoth a ka lou hon leisak tanla, gouluah thei na hih ziak in na tat ding ahi, nang a ding in lei mai in," achi a. Huchi in hiai TOUPA thu ahi chih ka theita hi.
english: So Hanamel my uncle’s son came to me in the court of the guard according to the word of Yahweh, and said to me, Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, which is in the land of Benjamin; for the right of inheritance is yours, and the redemption is yours; buy it for yourself. Then I knew that this was the word of Yahweh.

paite: Huan ka paneu tapa Hanamel Anathoth a lou ka leita a, dangka ka buksak a, adangkasik shekel sawmsagih tak ahi.
english: I bought the field that was in Anathoth of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.

paite: Huchi in lai ka gelh a, ka hilh a, theihpihmi ka sam a, dangka pen bukna ah ka khai a.
english: I subscribed the deed, and sealed it, and called witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.

paite: Kileina lai akileidan leh a-omdan gelhna bilh leh bilhlouhte ka la a.
english: So I took the deed of the purchase, both that which was sealed, containing the terms and conditions, and that which was open;

paite: Huan ka paneu tapa Hanamel mitmuh in leh theihpihmi kileina amin tuang teite mitmuh in leh ngakmi huangsung a Juda tute tengteng ma ah Mahseiah tapa Neriah tapa Baruk ka pia hi.
english: and I delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, in the presence of Hanamel my uncle’s son, and in the presence of the witnesses who subscribed the deed of the purchase, before all the Jews who sat in the court of the guard.

paite: Baruk bel ama uah thu ka pia a, Israel' Pathian sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: I commanded Baruch before them, saying,

paite: "Hiai lai, kileina lai, bilhlouhte la inla, a-om sawttheihna ding in leibel ah koih in.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Take these deeds, this deed of the purchase which is sealed, and this deed which is open, and put them in an earthen vessel; that they may continue many days.

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a; hiai gam ah innte, loute, grephuante mite'n ahon lei nawn ding uh," chi in.
english: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Houses and fields and vineyards shall yet again be bought in this land.

paite: Huan Neriah tapa Baruk kiang ah aleina lai ka piak nung in TOUPA kiang ah ka thum hi.
english: Now after I had delivered the deed of the purchase to Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed to Yahweh, saying,

paite: Aw Toupa PATHIAN, ngai in, na thilhihtheihna thupi leh na khut zak in lei leh van na bawl a; nang a ding in thilhih haksa lua a-om het kei hi.
english: Ah Lord Yahweh! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and by your outstretched arm; there is nothing too hard for you,

paite: Sang tampite kiang ah hehpihna na musak sek a, pate thulimlouhna anung ua atate uh tung ah na thuk a; aw Pathian thupi leh thilhihthei; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi;
english: who show loving kindness to thousands, and recompense the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them; the great, the mighty God, Yahweh of Armies is his name;

paite: thilgel siamtak, thilhihtheitak, mihing tate omdan tengteng muchianpa;
english: great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open on all the ways of the sons of men, to give everyone according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:

paite: michih a-omdan uleh athilhih uh bang a thukpa; Aigupta gam a chiamtehnate leh thillamdang hihpa, tuni tan a Israel leh midang lak a hih zelpa, tuni bang mahmah a min kibawlpa.
english: who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even to this day, both in Israel and among other men; and made yourself a name, as in this day;

paite: Na mi Israelte, Aigupta gam a kipan chiamtehnate, thillamdangte, khut hat leh ban zak leh thil mulkimhuai thupitak in na pikhia hi.
english: and brought forth your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;

paite: Hiai khuaizu leh nawitui a luang gam apipute uh kiang a kichiam a piak na chiam na peta a;
english: and gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;

paite: ahong lut ua, aluah vek ua, himahleh na paukam taksang lou in, na dan azui kei uh; hih ding a na piakte ahih kei ua, huaiziak in hiai thil hoih lou tengteng atung uah na tungsak hi.
english: and they came in, and possessed it, but they didn’t obey your voice, neither walked in your law; they have done nothing of all that you commanded them to do: therefore you have caused all this evil to come on them.

paite: En dih, khopi lakna ding a panmun leivupte ahong omta ve; namsaute, kialte, hipite ziak in khopi leng asimmi Kaldaite khut ah piak ahita; na gensa ahong tungta; en dih, na muta hi.
english: Behold, the mounds, they have come to the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans who fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence; and what you have spoken has happened; and behold, you see it.

paite: Ahi a lah, Aw Toupa PATHIAN, nang ka kiang ah, "Na sum in lou lei inla, thu thei mite sam in; khopi bel Kaldaite khut a piak ahita, na chi," achi hi.
english: You have said to me, Lord Yahweh, Buy the field for money, and call witnesses; whereas the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi:
english: Then came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "Ngai in, kei TOUPA sa nei tengteng Pathian ka hi, kei a ding in haksa lua a-om a hia? chi in.
english: Behold, I am Yahweh, the God of all flesh: is there anything too hard for me?

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in hiai khopi Kaldaite khut ah leh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah ka pe ding a, ala ding hi.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:

paite: Huchi in hiai khopi simmi Kaldaite ahong pai ding ua, hiai khopi ahal ding ua, akang ding, hon hehsak ding a Baal kiang a gimlim latna, pathian dangte kiang a dawn ding lat butkhiakna inn tung nei inn tengteng toh.
english: and the Chaldeans, who fight against this city, shall come and set this city on fire, and burn it, with the houses, on whose roofs they have offered incense to Baal, and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

paite: Israel suante leh Judah tate'n atuailai chik ua kipan in ka mitmuh in thil hoih lou ngen ahih uh; Israel suante'n akhut nasepte un ahon hehsak phet uhi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only that which was evil in my sight from their youth; for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, says Yahweh.

paite: Hiai a khopi alam tung ua kipan tutan in hon hehsaktu leh hon thangpaisaktu ahi nilouh ngal a; ka ma a kipan ka hihman vengveng theihna ding in; Israel suante leh Judah tate hon hehsak ding a athil hoih lou hihsate tengteng uh ziak in,
english: For this city has been to me a provocation of my anger and of my wrath from the day that they built it even to this day; that I should remove it from before my face,

paite: amau, akumpipate uh, aheutute uh, asiampute uh, azawlneite uh, Judah mite Jerusalem luah mite tengteng toh.
english: because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

paite: Kei lam hong nga lou in adeksah uh ahon ngat ua, tawlnga lou hial in sinsakta mah leng, sinsakna lasawn ding in angeingaih kei uhi.
english: They have turned to me the back, and not the face: and though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not listened to receive instruction.

paite: Ka min tuanna inn hihthanghuai ding in akihhuainate uh akoih zaw uhi.
english: But they set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

paite: Ben Hinnom Phaizang a Baal biakna mun sangte alamkhia ua, atanute uh, atapate uh Molek kiang a mei a apaihna ding un, Judahte thil gilou hihsak ding a hiai kihhuai ahih uh ka thupiak ahi het kei hi, ka lungsim ah leng alut ngei kei hi.
english: They built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through fire to Molech; which I didn’t command them, neither did it come into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.

paite: "Huaiziak in tu in zaw TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, 'Hiai khopi, namsau, kial leh hipi in Babulon kumpipa khut ah piak ahita, na chih nak uh thu ah hichi in achi':
english: Now therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, concerning this city, about which you say, It is given into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence:

paite: Ngai dih, ka hehna, ka lung hihlouhna, ka thangpaihna thupi mahmahte a amau ka delh manna gam teng a kipan ka pikhawm ding a, hiai mun ka hon tun ding a, bittak in ka omsakta ding.
english: Behold, I will gather them out of all the countries, where I have driven them in my anger, and in my wrath, and in great indignation; and I will bring them again to this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:

paite: Huchi in ka mite ahi ding ua, kei amaute Pathian ka hi ding.
english: and they shall be my people, and I will be their God:

paite: Tangtawn a ahon lauhdet theihna ding un lungtang kibang leh omdan kibang ka bawlsak ding; amau leh anung ua atate uh hoihna ding in.
english: and I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and of their children after them:

paite: Akiang uah tangtawn thukhun ka bawl ding a, amau lehngatsan lou in, ahon launa ka hih gige ding; ahon kiheisanlouhna ding un alungtangte uah ahon lauhna uh ka koih ding.
english: and I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good; and I will put my fear in their hearts, that they may not depart from me.

paite: Ahi, ahoihna uh hih ka kipah lam ahi ding a, ka lungtang tengteng in hiai gam ah ka phut ngeingei ding.
english: Yes, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai mite tung a thil hoih lou thupi mahmah ka tut bangtak in amaute kiang a thil hoih ka chiam tengtengte ka tungsak ngeingei ding.
english: For thus says Yahweh: Like as I have brought all this great evil on this people, so will I bring on them all the good that I have promised them.

paite: Gam kisegawp, Kaldaite khut a piaksa, mi leh sa om nawn lou, na chih gam uah loute akilei nawn ding uhi.
english: Fields shall be bought in this land, about which you say, It is desolate, without man or animal; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

paite: Benjamin gamte ah, Jerusalem khopi kim munte ah, Judah gam khopite leh simlam khopite ah mite'n dangka in lou alei ding ua, leina lai agelh ding ua, abilh ding ua, theihpih mite asam ding uhi; a-omdan uh ka hei ding hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi."
english: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe the deeds, and seal them, and call witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the hill country, and in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South: for I will cause their captivity to return, says Yahweh.

paite: Huan Jeremiah kiang ah, vengmi huangsung a khum a a-om lai in, anihveina ding in TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn hi.
english: Moreover the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah the second time, while he was yet shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

paite: Lei bawlpa TOUPA, kip ding a bawlpa TOUPA'N, amin TOUPA ahi, chi in achi:
english: Thus says Yahweh who does it, Yahweh who forms it to establish it; Yahweh is his name:

paite: Hon sam lechin, ka hon dawng ding a, thil thupi leh thil kisel na theih ngei louh ka hon ensak ding.
english: Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great things, and difficult, which you don’t know.

paite: Israel' Pathian TOUPA'N hiai khopi innte leh Judah kumpipa' inn te, namsau leh leivupte lak a venna bawl ding a aphelsiat uh tungtang thu ah hichi in achi:
english: For thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, which are broken down to make a defense against the mounds and against the sword;

paite: Kaldaite sual ding in amau ahong kuan ua, ka hehna leh thangpaihna a ka thah luangte in adimsak zaw ding uh, agitlouhna tengteng ziak un hiai khopi lak ah ka mel ka na sel hi.
english: while men come to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the dead bodies of men, whom I have killed in my anger and in my wrath, and for all whose wickedness I have hidden my face from this city:

paite: Ngai in, damna leh hihdamna ka hon tun ding a, ka hon damsak ding; muanna leh bitna kiptak ka hon musak ding.
english: Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.

paite: Judah omdan leh Israel omdan ka hei ding a, atung a ka dinsak bang in ka dingsak nawn ding.
english: I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return, and will build them, as at the first.

paite: Huan athulimlouhna uh, ka tung a athilhihkhelhna lak ua kipan ka sawpsiang ding a, athulimlouhna uh, ka tung a athilhihkhelhna uleh ka tung a atatleknate tengteng uh ka ngaidam ding.
english: I will cleanse them from all their iniquity, by which they have sinned against me; and I will pardon all their iniquities, by which they have sinned against me, and by which they have transgressed against me.

paite: Huchi in hiai khopi lei a nam tengteng, amau a dia ka hihhoih tengteng mu mite ma ah kei a ding in nopna, pahtawina leh thupina ahi ding a; hoihna muanna atung ua ka tut tengteng ziak in lau in aling ding uhi.
english: This city shall be to me for a name of joy, for a praise and for a glory, before all the nations of the earth, which shall hear all the good that I do to them, and shall fear and tremble for all the good and for all the peace that I procure to it.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai mun, Judah khopi a mi leh sa om nawn lou a loihsa, Jerusalem kholak a mi leh sa leh tengmi om lou a loihsa, achih uah:
english: Thus says Yahweh: Yet again there shall be heard in this place, about which you say, It is waste, without man and without animal, even in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, that are desolate, without man and without inhabitant and without animal,

paite: "Sepaihte' TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un. TOUPA lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna lah tangtawn in a-om ding hi, chi mite aw leh TOUPA' inn a kipahna kithoihna hon tawi lasa mite aw leh mou awte mouneipa awte ahon za nawn ding uh, atung a a-om bang in gam ka omsak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: the voice of joy and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride, the voice of those who say, Give thanks to Yahweh of Armies, for Yahweh is good, for his loving kindness endures forever; who bring thanksgiving into the house of Yahweh. For I will cause the captivity of the land to return as at the first, says Yahweh.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai mun, mi leh sa om lou khop a loihsa leh akhopi tengteng ah, belamchingmi abelamhon uh kualsak mite tenna mun ahong om nawn ding.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Yet again shall there be in this place, which is waste, without man and without animal, and in all its cities, a habitation of shepherds causing their flocks to lie down.

paite: Tanggam khopi ah, phaigam khopi ah, simlam khopi ah, Benjamin gam ah, Jerusalem kim munte ah, Judah khopi ah, amau simmi khut nuai ah belamte apai zungzung ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: In the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the lowland, and in the cities of the South, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, shall the flocks again pass under the hands of him who numbers them, says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai in, nite ahong tung lellel hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, Israel inkote tungtang ah leh Judah inkote tungtang a thuhoihtak ka na gen pen ka tangtungsak ding.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will perform that good word which I have spoken concerning the house of Israel and concerning the house of Judah.

paite: Huai nite leh huai hun chiang in diktatna Hiang David kiang ah ka khangkhesak ding, huai gam ah diktak leh diktattak in vai ahawm ding.
english: In those days, and at that time, will I cause a Branch of righteousness to grow up to David; and he shall execute justice and righteousness in the land.

paite: Huai nite in Judah humbit in a-om ding, Jerusalem bittak in a-om ding; huan, amin put ding hiai ahi ding, "TOUPA i diktatna," chih.
english: In those days shall Judah be saved, and Jerusalem shall dwell safely; and this is the name by which she shall be called: Yahweh our righteousness.

paite: Toupa'n hichi in achi: David in Israel inkote laltutphah a tu ding mi atasam ngei kei ding;
english: For thus says Yahweh: David shall never want a man to sit on the throne of the house of Israel;

paite: Siampu Levi chite'n leng ka ma a halmang na lan ding leh buh-le-bal thil lan ding leh kithoih zel ding in mi atasam sam kei ding.
english: neither shall the priests the Levites want a man before me to offer burnt offerings, and to burn meal offerings, and to do sacrifice continually.

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: The word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Ka sun seh leh ka zan seh thu na phel theih ua, sun leh zan ahuntak ua om lou ding a na hihtheih uleh,
english: Thus says Yahweh: If you can break my covenant of the day, and my covenant of the night, so that there shall not be day and night in their season;

paite: ka nasempa David kiang a ka thukhun leng alaltutphah a tu ding tapa aneihlouhna ding a hihsiat ahi phet ding hi; Levi chite, siampute, ka nasem mite kiang ah leng.
english: then may also my covenant be broken with David my servant, that he shall not have a son to reign on his throne; and with the Levites the priests, my ministers.

paite: Van a omte sim seng louh leh tuipi a piaunel sim seng louh bang mai in ka nasempa David suan leh Levi chi kei na hon sepsak mite ka pungsak ding.
english: As the army of the sky can’t be numbered, neither the sand of the sea measured; so will I multiply the seed of David my servant, and the Levites who minister to me.

paite: TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a:
english: The word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "Inkuan nih TOUPA'N atelte apaimangta," chi a hiai mite'n agen uh na ngaihtuah ngei kei a hia? Amitmuh ua nam chih tham ahihlouhna ding un hichibang in ka mite amusit uhi.
english: Don’t consider what this people has spoken, saying, The two families which Yahweh chose, he has cast them off? thus do they despise my people, that they should be no more a nation before them.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ka sun leh zan thuseh a-omdet louh a, lei leh van omdante ka seh louh ahihleh,
english: Thus says Yahweh: If my covenant of day and night fails, if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;

paite: Jakob suante leh ka nasempa David suante ka paimang ding, Abraham, Isak leh Jakob suante tung ah vaihawmmi asuan a kipan ka la kei ding; a-omdante uh ka kiheisak in atung uah zahngaihna nei ding ka hi ngal a.
english: then will I also cast away the seed of Jacob, and of David my servant, so that I will not take of his seed to be rulers over the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: for I will cause their captivity to return, and will have mercy on them.

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzarte, asepaihhon tengteng, amah thunuai a lei a vaihawmna gam tengteng leh mipi tengteng in Jerusalem leh akhopi tengteng asual lai ua TOUPA kiang a kipan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the kingdoms of the earth that were under his dominion, and all the peoples, were fighting against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of it, saying:

paite: Israel' Pathian, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah va houpih in, hichi in achi: Ngai in, hiai khopi Babulon kumpipa khut ah ka pe ding a, mei in ahal ding;
english: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Go, and speak to Zedekiah king of Judah, and tell him, Thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire:

paite: akhut a kipan na suakta het kei ding; mat na hi ding a, akhut ah ahon pe ding ua, na mit ngei in Babulon kumpipa na mu ding a, paukam ngei in na kihoupih ding ua, Babulon gam ah na hoh ding hi.
english: and you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall surely be taken, and delivered into his hand; and your eyes shall see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and he shall speak with you mouth to mouth, and you shall go to Babylon.

paite: Himahleh, aw Judah kumpipa, Zedekiah, TOUPA thu ngaikhe zel dih; na tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Yet hear the word of Yahweh, O Zedekiah king of Judah: thus says Yahweh concerning you, You shall not die by the sword;

paite: Namsau in na si kei ding a, muangtak in ahi na sih ding; na ma a kumpipa masa, na pipute gimlim ahalsak bang un, nang leng ahon halsak ding uh; ahon suun ding ua, "Ehe heh, ka pu," chi in. Thu ka khahta hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in.
english: you shall die in peace; and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who were before you, so shall they make a burning for you; and they shall lament you, saying, Ah Lord! for I have spoken the word, says Yahweh.

paite: Zawlnei Jeremiah in hiai thu tengteng Jerusalem a Judah kumpipa Zedekiah kiang ah agen a;
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet spoke all these words to Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem,

paite: Babulon kumpipa sepaihhonte'n Jerusalem leh Judah khopi om lai tengteng, Lakish leh Azekah asual lai un; Judah khopi lak a kulh neite hiaite kia ahita uhi.
english: when the king of Babylon’s army was fighting against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that were left, against Lachish and against Azekah; for these alone remained of the cities of Judah as fortified cities.

paite: Kumpipa Zedekiah in Jerusalem a om mipi tengteng kiang ah, michih in asikhanu toh asikhapate uh, Hebru nu hiam Hebru pa hiam ahih uleh, akhah ding uh ahi;
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after that the king Zedekiah had made a covenant with all the people who were at Jerusalem, to proclaim liberty to them;

paite: Michih in Hebru pasal hiam numei hiam sal a aneih peuhmah asuahtaksak ding ahi, kuamah in ama Juda sanggampih sal a aneihlouhna ding in.
english: that every man should let his male servant, and every man his female servant, who is a Hebrew or a Hebrewess, go free; that none should make bondservants of them, of a Jew his brother.

paite: Michih in nasemnu hiam nasempa hiam akhah ding ahi, amau nna sepsak in kuamah a-om ding uh ahi kei, chih thukhun pommi heutu tengteng leh mipi tengteng in thukhun amang ua, akhahta uhi.
english: All the princes and all the people obeyed, who had entered into the covenant, that everyone should let his male servant, and everyone his female servant, go free, that none should make bondservants of them any more; they obeyed, and let them go:

paite: Himahleh huai nung in akihei ua, anasemnu uh leh anasempa uh akhahsate uh akaikik ua, athunuai uah nasemmi ding in akoih nawn uh.
english: but afterwards they turned, and caused the servants and the handmaids, whom they had let go free, to return, and brought them into subjection for servants and for handmaids.

paite: Huaiziak in Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung nawn a, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi:
english: Therefore the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: Aigupta gam, saltanna inn a kipan ka pikhiak ni in na pipute uh kiang ah thukhun ka bawl a,
english: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel: I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying,

paite: michih in a-unaupa, Hebru mi, akiang a zuaksa, kum guk a na nasemsa, akum sagihna tawp in akhah ding ahi, chi in; na pipute un bel ahon ngaikhe kei ua, abil uh adoh sam kei uh.
english: At the end of seven years you shall let go every man his brother who is a Hebrew, who has been sold to you, and has served you six years, you shall let him go free from you: but your fathers didn’t listen to me, neither inclined their ear.

paite: Tu in noute'n, na hong kihei ua, michih in a-invengpa kiang a noplenna thu puang in ka mitmuh in thil dik na hon hihta ua; ka min tam inn ah ka ma ah thukhun na hong kibawlta ua;
english: You had now turned, and had done that which is right in my eyes, in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbor; and you had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name:

paite: himahleh na kihei nawn ua, ka min na hihbuah un a-ut bangtak ua na khahsa nung uh, na sikhanu leh na sikhapa uh na pikik nawn ua, na thunuai uah nasemmi ding bang sikhanute ding bang in na koih nawn uh.
english: but you turned and profaned my name, and caused every man his servant, and every man his handmaid, whom you had let go free at their pleasure, to return; and you brought them into subjection, to be to you for servants and for handmaids.

paite: "Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Michih ama unau leh ama invengte kiang a noplenna thu puang ding in ka thu na ngaikhe kei ua; ngai un, ke'n na kiang uah noplenna thu ka puang hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; namsaute, hipite, kialte in ahi ding; lei a kumpigamte tengteng lak a paihkhiak ding in ka hon bawl ding hi.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh: you have not listened to me, to proclaim liberty, every man to his brother, and every man to his neighbor: behold, I proclaim to you a liberty, says Yahweh, to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will make you to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

paite: Huan ka thukhun bohsete, ka ma a bawngnou atphel kikal a paisuak hial a thuchiam a tangtungsak lou mi.
english: I will give the men who have transgressed my covenant, who have not performed the words of the covenant which they made before me, when they cut the calf in two and passed between its parts;

paite: Judah heutute leh Jerusalem heutute, michilgehte, siampute, mipi tengteng, bawngnou atphel kikal a paite;
english: the princes of Judah, and the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, and the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed between the parts of the calf;

paite: amelmate uleh ahinna zong mite khut ah ka pe ding a; huchi in aluangte uh tung a leng vasate leh lei a gamsate an ding lel ahi ding.
english: I will even give them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life; and their dead bodies shall be for food to the birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth.

paite: Huan Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh alawite amelmate uleh ahinna zong mite leh Babulon kumpipa sepaihhon, nou hon paisansate khut ah ka pe ding hi.
english: Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life, and into the hand of the king of Babylon’s army, who have gone away from you.

paite: Ngai un, hiai khopi a hong kik nawn ding in thu ka pe ding a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, huchi in asual ding ua, ala ding ua, mei in ahal ding uh; luahmi om lou in Judah khopite ka hihgam vek ding," chi in.
english: Behold, I will command, says Yahweh, and cause them to return to this city; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire: and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

paite: Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm lai a TOUPA kiang a kipan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung in:
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

paite: "Rekab inkote kiang ah hoh in va houpih inla, TOUPA inn a dantan khat ah pilut inla, uain dawn ding pia in," achi a.
