english: Go to the house of the Rechabites, and speak to them, and bring them into the house of Yahweh, into one of the rooms, and give them wine to drink.

paite: Huan Habazziniah tapa, Jeremiah tapa, Jaazaniah leh a-unaute, atapa tengteng Rekab inkote tengteng toh ka pi a;
english: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites;

paite: Pathian mipa Igdali tapa Hanan tate dantan, TOUPA inn ah ka pilut a; huai dantan bel heutute dantan chin kongpi ngakmi Shallum tapa Maaseiah dantan tung a om ahi.
english: and I brought them into the house of Yahweh, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, the man of God, which was by the room of the princes, which was above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the threshold.

paite: Huchi in Rekab inkuante tapate ma ah belhbute, noute uain dim ka tung a, akiang uah, "Uain dawn un," ka chi hi.
english: I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, Drink wine!

paite: Amau bel, "Uain ka dawn kei hial ding uh; kou hon suangpa Rekab tapa Jonadab in, 'Noumau leh na suante un leng tangtawn a uain na dawn ding uh ahi kei;
english: But they said, We will drink no wine; for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, neither you, nor your sons, forever:

paite: inn na lam un haichi na tuh un, grephuan leng na bawl un na nei ding uh ahi sam kei hi; na damsung nite un puanin a na ten zawk ding uh ahi, na omna gam ua na damsawt theihna ding un, chi in thu ahon pia hi.'
english: neither shall you build house, nor sow seed, nor plant vineyard, nor have any; but all your days you shall dwell in tents; that you may live many days in the land in which you live.

paite: Huchi in kou hon suangpa Rekab tapa Jonadab in paukam a thu hon thukhah tengteng, ka damsung ua kou leh ka zite uh, ka tapate uleh ka tanute un uain dawn louh ding un,
english: We have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters;

paite: ka tenna inn uh lam louh ding, grephuan hiam lou hiam haichi hiam neih louh ding tan in ka zui uhi.
english: nor to build houses for us to dwell in; neither have we vineyard, nor field, nor seed:

paite: Puaninte ah ka teng zaw ua, kou hon suangpa Jonadab thupiak tengteng mang in ka zui vek uhi.
english: but we have lived in tents, and have obeyed, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in gam ahong sual lai in kou, 'Kisa un, Kaldai sepaihhonte leh Siria sepaihhonte lau ziak in Jerusalem ah i hoh ding uh,' ka chi ua, huchi in Jerusalem ah ka tengta uhi," achi uhi.
english: But it happened, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, Come, and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the army of the Syrians; so we dwell at Jerusalem.

paite: Huan TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ahong tung nawn a
english: Then came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Israel' Pathian Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Judah gam a mite leh Jerusalem a mi tengte kiang ah va gen inla, "Ka thute ngaikhe ding in sinsakna na sang kei ding uh maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Go, and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to listen to my words? says Yahweh.

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab thu, atapate kiang a apiak, uain dawn louh ding pen azui ua, tuni tan in bangmah adawn kei ua, amau suangpa thupiak azui mahmah uh hi; ke'n bel phalvak a thou in na kiang uah thu ka gen a, himahleh na hon ngaikhe kei uh.
english: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, that he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; and to this day they drink none, for they obey their father’s commandment: but I have spoken to you, rising up early and speaking; and you have not listened to me.

paite: Ka nasem zawlneite phalvak a thou in na kiang uah ka sawl a, michih na omdan gilou ua kipan hong kik vek unla, na thilhihte uh bawlhoih unla, pathian dangte zaw a-nna uh sem ding in zui kei unla; nou leh na pipute uh kiang a gam ka piak ah na teng ding uh chỉ in; himahleh na bil uh na doh kei ua, na hon ngaikhe sam kei uh.
english: I have sent also to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Return now every man from his evil way, and amend your doings, and don’t go after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers: but you have not inclined your ear, nor listened to me.

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab suante'n amau suangpa thupiak azui ua, hiai mite'n zaw ahon ngaikhe kei uh.
english: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father which he commanded them, but this people has not listened to me;

paite: Huaiziak TOUPA Israel' Pathian sepaihte' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Judah leh Jerusalem a tengte tung ah thil hoih lou atung ua hong tung ding ka gen khiaksate ka hon tun ding; akiang uah thu ka gen a, angaikhe kei ua, amau ka sam a, ahon dawng sam kei uh," chi in.
english: therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them; because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Rekab suante kiang ah, Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na pa Jonadab thupiak na zui ua, athupawt tengteng bang a na hih ziak un;
english: Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts, and done according to all that he commanded you;

paite: Rekab tapa Jonadab in tangtawn in ka ma a dingh ding mi atasam ngei kei ding," chi in Sepaihte' TOUPA Israel' Pathian in achi hi.
english: therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me forever.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm akum lina ah hiai thu TOUPA kiang a kipan Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi:
english: It happened in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, that this word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Laibuzial la inla, hiai ah na kiang a thu ka gen tengteng, Israel tungthu, Judah tungthu, nam tengteng tungthu, na kiang a thu ka gen ni a kipan, Josiah hun lai a kipan, tuni tanpha a thu gelh in.
english: Take a scroll of a book, and write therein all the words that I have spoken to you against Israel, and against Judah, and against all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, even to this day.

paite: Judah inkote'n atung ua thil hoih lou hih ka tup tengteng, angaikhia un michih in a-omdan gilou uh ahei thei khamoh kei ding uh, athulimlouhna uh leh akhelhna uh ka ngaihdam theihna ding in," achi hi.
english: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do to them; that they may return every man from his evil way; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Neriah tapa Baruk asam a, huchi in Baruk in TOUPA thu tengteng, akiang a agensa Jeremiah paukam a kipan laibuzial ah agelh hi.
english: Then Jeremiah called Baruch the son of Neriah; and Baruch wrote from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of Yahweh, which he had spoken to him, on a scroll of a book.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in Baruk kiang ah, "Khakkhum ka hi a, TOUPA' inn ah ka hoh thei kei,
english: Jeremiah commanded Baruch, saying, I am shut up; I can’t go into the house of Yahweh:

paite: huaiziak in nang hoh inla, TOUPA thu ka paukam a kipan laibuzial a na gelh an ngawl ni in, TOUPA' inn a mipite bil a zak in va simkhia in; akhopi ua kipan a hong pawt Judahte tengteng bil a zak in leng na simkhiak ding ahi.
english: therefore you go, and read in the scroll, which you have written from my mouth, the words of Yahweh in the ears of the people in Yahweh’s house on the fast day; and also you shall read them in the ears of all Judah who come out of their cities.

paite: Michih in a-omdan gilou uh hei in, TOUPA ma a hehpihna angetna uh, atun thei kha zenzen ding uam, hiai mite tung a hehna leh thangpaihna TOUPA'N agenkhiak lah athupi mahmah ngal a," chi in thu apia hi.
english: It may be they will present their supplication before Yahweh, and will return everyone from his evil way; for great is the anger and the wrath that Yahweh has pronounced against this people.

paite: Huchi in Neriah tapa Baruk in zawlnei Jeremiah thupiak tengteng bang in TOUPA' inn a TOUPA thu laibu a om asimta hi.
english: Baruch the son of Neriah did according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, reading in the book the words of Yahweh in Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim vaihawm akum ngana, akha kuana ah Jerusalem mi tengteng leh Judah khopi a kipan a Jerusalem a hong pai tengteng in an ngawl thu apuangta uhi.
english: Now it happened in the fifth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, in the ninth month, that all the people in Jerusalem, and all the people who came from the cities of Judah to Jerusalem, proclaimed a fast before Yahweh.

paite: Huan Baruk in TOUPA kongpi thak lutna ah, um sung tungnungzaw a laigelhmi Shaphan tapa Gemariah dantan, TOUPA' inn a om ah Jeremiah thu laibu a om, mi tengteng bil azak in asim hi.
english: Then read Baruch in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of Yahweh, in the room of Gemariah the son of Shaphan, the scribe, in the upper court, at the entry of the new gate of Yahweh’s house, in the ears of all the people.

paite: Huan Shaphan tapa Gemariah tapa Mikaiah in laibu a om TOUPA thu tengteng ana zak in,
english: When Micaiah the son of Gemariah, the son of Shaphan, had heard out of the book all the words of Yahweh,

paite: Kumpipa' inn ah ahohsuk a, laigelhmi dantan ah alut a, huan, ngai dih, huai ah heutu tengteng ana tu ua, laigelhmi Elishamate, Shemaiah tapa Delaiah, Akbor tapa Elnathan, Shaphan tapa Gemariah, Hananiah tapa Zedekiah leh heutu tengteng.
english: he went down into the king’s house, into the scribe’s room: and behold, all the princes were sitting there, Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan the son of Achbor, and Gemariah the son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah, and all the princes.

paite: Huan Mikaiah in mite bil a zak in Baruk in laibu asim thu ana zak tengteng ahilh hi.
english: Then Micaiah declared to them all the words that he had heard, when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people.

paite: Huan heutu tengteng in Kushi tapa, Shelemiah tapa Nethaniah tapa Jehudi Baruk kiang ah asawl ua, akiang ah, "Mite bil a zak a na sim laibu tawi in hong pai in," chi ding in. Huchi in Neriah tapa Baruk bel laibuzial tawi in akiang uah ahong hi.
english: Therefore all the princes sent Jehudi the son of Nethaniah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Cushi, to Baruch, saying, Take in your hand the scroll in which you have read in the ears of the people, and come. So Baruch the son of Neriah took the scroll in his hand, and came to them.

paite: Akiang ah, "Tu inla, ka bil ua ka zak ngei un sim dih ve leh," achi ua, huchi in Baruk in abil ua azak un asimta hi.
english: They said to him, Sit down now, and read it in our ears. So Baruch read it in their ears.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thute azak uleh lau in aki-entuah chiat ua, Baruk kiang ah, "Hiai thu tengteng kumpipa ka hilh ngeingei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Now it happened, when they had heard all the words, they turned in fear one toward another, and said to Baruch, We will surely tell the king of all these words.

paite: Baruk kiang ah, "Hiai thu tengteng na kam a kipan bangchidan a gelh na hia, hon hilh in?" chi in adong uhi.
english: They asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How did you write all these words at his mouth?

paite: Baruk in, "Hiai thu tengteng apaukam in ahon hilh a, laitui in laibu ah ka gelh mai ahi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Then Baruch answered them, He pronounced all these words to me with his mouth, and I wrote them with ink in the book.

paite: Heutute'n Baruk kiang ah, "Kuan unla, Jeremiah toh kibu un; kuamah in na omna uh thei kei hen," achi uhi.
english: Then the princes said to Baruch, Go, hide, you and Jeremiah; and let no man know where you are.

paite: Huchi in huangsung ah kumpipa kiang ah alut ua; laibuzial bel laigelhmi Elishama dantan ah akoih ua; athu tengteng paukam in kumpipa ahilh uh.
english: They went in to the king into the court; but they had laid up the scroll in the room of Elishama the scribe; and they told all the words in the ears of the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n laibuzial la ding in Jehudi asawl a, laigelhmi Elishama dantan a kipan ala uhi. Huan Jehudi in kumpipa leh kumpipa kiang a dingh heutu tengteng bil a zak in asim hi.
english: So the king sent Jehudi to get the scroll; and he took it out of the room of Elishama the scribe. Jehudi read it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the princes who stood beside the king.

paite: Akha kuana ahi a, kumpipa bel aphalbi inn ah atu a, ama a meihol thuk ah kuang a-om hi.
english: Now the king was sitting in the winter house in the ninth month: and there was a fire in the brazier burning before him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jehudi in khep thum hiam khep li hiam a sim in kumpipa in atemta in alaibuzial a-attan a, meikhuk ah pum katmang vek ding in alawnlut zel hi.
english: It happened, when Jehudi had read three or four leaves, that the king cut it with the penknife, and cast it into the fire that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was consumed in the fire that was in the brazier.

paite: Kumpipa leh anasem mite'n hiai thu tengteng ngaikhe mite kuamah alau kei ua, apuansilh uh leng abotkek sam kei uh.
english: They were not afraid, nor tore their garments, neither the king, nor any of his servants who heard all these words.

paite: Huai phet hilou in Elnathan leh Delaiah leh Gemariahte'n laibuzial hal lou ding in kumpipa kiang ah angen ua, himahleh angaikhe nuam kei.
english: Moreover Elnathan and Delaiah and Gemariah had made intercession to the king that he would not burn the scroll; but he would not hear them.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n kumpipa tapa Jerahmeel leh Azriel tapa Seraiah leh Abdeel tapa Shelemiah Baruk laigelhmi leh zawlnei Jeremiah man ding in thu apia a; himahleh TOUPA'N amau asel hi.
english: The king commanded Jerahmeel the king’s son, and Seraiah the son of Azriel, and Shelemiah the son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe and Jeremiah the prophet; but Yahweh hid them.

paite: Huan laibuzial leh Jeremiah kam a kipan Baruk in agelh tengteng thute kumpipa'n ahalmang khit in TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung hi.
english: Then the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, after that the king had burned the scroll, and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Laibuzial dang la inla, laibuzial masa a thu tengteng, Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim in ahal mangsate gelh nawn vek in.
english: Take again another scroll, and write in it all the former words that were in the first scroll, which Jehoiakim the king of Judah has burned.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tungtang thu ah huchi in na gen ding hi. TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Babilon kumpipa hong pai a, hiai gam hihsia in, hiai mi leh sa ahihmang vek ding chih, bangziak a huchibang thu gelh na hia? chi in laibuzial na halta hi.
english: Concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah you shall say, Thus says Yahweh: You have burned this scroll, saying, Why have you written therein, saying, The king of Babylon shall certainly come and destroy this land, and shall cause to cease from there man and animal?

paite: Huaiziak in Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim tungthu ah TOUPA'N hichi in achi: David tutphah a tu ding mi anei kei ding; aluang leng sun nisa ah leh zan vuk nuai ah paihkhiak ahi ding.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He shall have none to sit on the throne of David; and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat, and in the night to the frost.

paite: Athulimlouhna uh ziak in amah leh asuante leh anasem mite ka gawt ding; amau leh Jerusalem a tengte leh Judah mite tung ah atung ua ka phuansa, angaihkhiak kei uleh thil hoih lou tengteng ka hon tun ding," chi in.
english: I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity; and I will bring on them, and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and on the men of Judah, all the evil that I have pronounced against them, but they didn’t listen.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in laibuzial dang ala a, Neriah tapa Baruk laigelhmi apia a, ama'n huai ah Jeremiah kam a kipan laibu gelhsa tengteng, Jehoiakim in mei a akhulmangsa thute agelh a; huai ban ah akibatpih thu tampi abehlap lai hi.
english: Then took Jeremiah another scroll, and gave it to Baruch the scribe, the son of Neriah, who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire; and there were added besides to them many like words.

paite: Huan Josiah tapa Zedekiah, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in, Judah gam kumpipa ding a abawl Jehoiakim tapa Koniah sik in vai ahawmta hi.
english: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king, instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

paite: Himahleh amah leh anasem mite leh agam a mite'n TOUPA thu zawlnei Jeremiah kam a gen angaikhe kei uh.
english: But neither he, nor his servants, nor the people of the land, listened to the words of Yahweh, which he spoke by the prophet Jeremiah.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Shelemiah tapa Jehukal leh Maaseiah tapa siampu Zephaniah bel zawlnei Jeremiah kiang ah, "TOUPA ka Pathian kiang ah hon thumsak in," chi ding in asawl hi.
english: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to the prophet Jeremiah, saying, Pray now to Yahweh our God for us.

paite: Jeremiah bel mipite lak ah a-utut in avak thei lai a; tanin ah lah akoih ngal kei ua.
english: Now Jeremiah came in and went out among the people; for they had not put him into prison.

paite: Pharaoh sepaihhonte Aigupta a kipan ahong pawtkheta ua; huchi in Kaldaite Jerusalem um mite'n atanchin azak un Jerusalem atawpsanta uhi.
english: Pharaoh’s army had come forth out of Egypt; and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they broke up from Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA thu zawlnei Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a,
english: Then came the word of Yahweh to the prophet Jeremiah, saying,

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Judah kumpipa hon dong ding a nou hon sawl kiang ah, 'Ngai in, Pharaoh sepaihhon, nou hon panpih ding a hong paite amau gam Aigupta ah akik nawn ding uh.
english: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, You shall tell the king of Judah, who sent you to me to inquire of me: Behold, Pharaoh’s army, which has come forth to help you, shall return to Egypt into their own land.

paite: Kaldaite hong pai in, hiai khopi asual ding ua, ala ding ua, mei in ahal ding uh.
english: The Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city; and they shall take it, and burn it with fire.

paite: "Kaldaite'n ahon paisan ngei ding uh," chi in nou kikhem kei un, ahon paisan kei ding uh.
english: Thus says Yahweh, Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us; for they shall not depart.

paite: Noute hon sual Kaldai sepaihte bawl ek mah le uchin, alak ua miliam omsunte kia in leng amau puanin a kipan hong thou in hiai khopi mei in ahal thouthou ding uh, chi in na gen ding ahi,' " chi in.
english: For though you had struck the whole army of the Chaldeans who fight against you, and there remained but wounded men among them, yes would they rise up every man in his tent, and burn this city with fire.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Pharaoh sepaihhonte lau ziak a Kaldai sepaihhonte'n Jerusalem apaisan lai un,
english: It happened that, when the army of the Chaldeans was broken up from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army,

paite: Jeremiah in mite lak a atantuan la ding in Benjamin gam a lut ding in Jerusalem apawtsan hi.
english: then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the midst of the people.

paite: Benjamin kongpi atun in ngakmi heutu Hananiah tapa Shelemiah tapa amin Irijah ana om a; huai in, "Kaldaite kiang a kipia na hi," chi in zawlnei Jeremiah ana man hi.
english: When he was in the gate of Benjamin, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son of Hananiah; and he laid hold on Jeremiah the prophet, saying, You are falling away to the Chaldeans.

paite: Jeremiah in, "Zuau ahi; Kaldaite kiang ah ka kipe kei," achi a; himahleh angaikhe kei a, huchi in Irijah in Jeremiah ana man a, heutute kiang ah apia hi.
english: Then Jeremiah said, It is false; I am not falling away to the Chaldeans. But he didn’t listen to him; so Irijah laid hold on Jeremiah, and brought him to the princes.

paite: Huan heutute Jeremiah tung ah aheh mahmah ua, asat ua, laigelhmi Jonathan inn ah akhum uh; huai tan inn ding a azat him uh ahi.
english: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for they had made that the prison.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah lei nuai kokhuk ah alut a, ni tampitak a-om nung in kumpipa Zedekiah in asamkhia hi.
english: When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house, and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days;

paite: Huan kumpipa'n a-inn ah aguk in akiang ah, "TOUPA kiang a kipan thu banghiam bek a-om hia?" chi in adong hi. Jeremiah in, "Om e,” achi hi. Akiang ah, "Babilon kumpipa khut ah matsak in na om ding," achi lai hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and fetched him: and the king asked him secretly in his house, and said, Is there any word from Yahweh? Jeremiah said, There is. He said also, You shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.

paite: Jeremiah in kumpipa Zedekiah kiang ah, "Nang hiam na nasemmi hiam hiai mite tung ah bang thil ahia ka hihkhelh a na hon matsak?
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to king Zedekiah, Wherein have I sinned against you, or against your servants, or against this people, that you have put me in prison?

paite: Nang kiang a 'Babilon kumpipa nang leh hiai gam dou ding in ahong pai kei ding, chi a thugenmi na zawlneite koi a om ahita ua?'
english: Where now are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, The king of Babylon shall not come against you, nor against this land?

paite: Aw, ka pu, kumpipa ngaikhia in, ka hon ngen ahi, ka ngetna na sang in, ka hon ngen hi; laigelhmi Jonathan inn ah hon kiksak nawn ke'n, huai ah ka va si kha ding," achi hi.
english: Now please hear, my lord the king: please let my supplication be presented before you, that you not cause me to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, lest I die there.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Zedekiah in thu apia a, Jeremiah bel ngakmi huangsung ah atangsak a, tanghou bawl mite kongzing a kipan niteng in tanghou beu khat, khopi a tanghou a-om lai siah apia ua, huchibang in Jeremiah bel ngakmi huangsung ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard; and they gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers’ street, until all the bread in the city was spent. Thus Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

paite: Huan Mattan tapa Shephatiah leh Pashur tapa Gedaliah leh Shelemiah tapa Jukal leh Malkijah tapa Pashurte'n, mipi tengteng kiang ah Jeremiah in,
english: Shephatiah the son of Mattan, and Gedaliah the son of Pashhur, and Jucal the son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur the son of Malchijah, heard the words that Jeremiah spoke to all the people, saying,

paite: "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai khopi a om nilouhte zaw namsau, kial leh hipi in asi ding ua, Kaldaite kiang a kipia bel ahing ding uh, ahinna akihumbit ding a ahing ding," chi in.
english: Thus says Yahweh, He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he who goes forth to the Chaldeans shall live, and his life shall be to him for a prey, and he shall live.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Hiai khopi Babulon kumpipa sepaihhonte khut ah piak ahi ngei ding a, ala ding, chi a agen angaikhia uhi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, This city shall surely be given into the hand of the army of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it.

paite: Huchi in heutute'n kumpipa kiang ah, "Hiai mi hihlup hi hen, ka hon ngen uh; ama'n akiang ua hiai thute gen in hiai khopi a galkapmi omlaite leh mipi tengteng tha hat lousak in; hiai mi'n hiai mipite hoihna azong kei a, asiatna azong zaw,” achi uhi.
english: Then the princes said to the king, “Please let this man be put to death; because he weakens the hands of the men of war who remain in this city, and the hands of all the people, in speaking such words to them: for this man doesn’t seek the welfare of this people, but the hurt.”

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in, "Ngai un, amah na khut ua om ahi; kumpipa'n na deih louh lam uh hihthei ahi sam a," achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the king said, Behold, he is in your hand; for the king is not he who can do anything against you.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah api ua, ngakmi huangsung a om kumpipa tapa Malkijah tuibem ah apailut ua; Jeremiah bel khau in akhesuk ua, huai tuibem ah buannawi kia lou ngal tui a-om kei a; buannawi ah Jeremiah akia hi.
english: Then took they Jeremiah, and cast him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard: and they let down Jeremiah with cords. In the dungeon there was no water, but mire; and Jeremiah sank in the mire.

paite: Huan Ethiopia mi, michilgeh kumpipa' inn a om sek Ebed-melek in Jeremiah tuibem ah akoih uh chih ana za a; huchih lai in kumpipa bel Benjamin kongpi ah atu a;
english: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin),

paite: Ebed-melek bel kumpipa' inn a kipan apawt a, kumpipa kiang ah,
english: Ebedmelech went forth out of the king’s house, and spoke to the king, saying,

paite: "Ka pu, kumpipa, hiai mite'n zawlnei Jeremiah tuibem a ana paihkhiak uh thil gilou thupi mahmah hih ahi uh, gilkial ziak in a-omna mun ah si mai ding akei maw; khopi ah tanghou a-om nawn kei a," achi a.
english: My lord the king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the dungeon; and he is likely to die in the place where he is, because of the famine; for there is no more bread in the city.

paite: Huan kumpipa'n Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek thu apia a, "Hiai a kipan in mi sawmthum pi inla, tuibem a kipan in asih ma in zawlnei Jeremiah va lakhia un," chi in.
english: Then the king commanded Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Take from here thirty men with you, and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon, before he dies.

paite: Huchi in Ebed-melek in mite api a, kumpipa dangka inn nuai ah alut ua, puanak lui paihte leh puansilh siate alakhia ua, tuibem ah Jeremiah kiang ah khau in akhaikhesuk uhi.
english: So Ebedmelech took the men with him, and went into the house of the king under the treasury, and took there rags and worn-out garments, and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah.

paite: Huan Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Hiai puanak luite leh puansilh siate na lenuai ah khau in gakkhum in," achi hi. Huan Jeremiah in huchibang in ahih hi.
english: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, Put now these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords. Jeremiah did so.

paite: Huan Jeremiah bel tuibem a kipan khau in akaikhia ua; huchi in ngakmi huangsung ah Jeremiah a-om nilouh hi.
english: So they drew up Jeremiah with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah asam a, TOUPA' inn a lutna thumna ah akiang ah apilut a; huan, kumpipa'n Jeremiah kiang ah, "Thil ka hon dong ding; ka lak ah bangmah iim nei ke'n," achi hi.
english: Then Zedekiah the king sent, and took Jeremiah the prophet to him into the third entry that is in the house of Yahweh: and the king said to Jeremiah, I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.

paite: Jeremiah in Zedekiah kiang ah, "Hon hilh leng na hon that mahmah kei dia hia? Thu hon hanthawn leng lah hon ngaikhe lou ding chin a,” achi hi.
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, If I declare it to you, will you not surely put me to death? and if I give you counsel, you will not listen to me.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "TOUPA hiai ka hinna bawlpa ahin a ahin sung teng ka hon hihlum kei hial ding, na hinna zong mite khut ah leng nang ka hon pe sam kei ding," chi in asim in akichiam hi.
english: So Zedekiah the king swore secretly to Jeremiah, saying, As Yahweh lives, who made us this soul, I will not put you to death, neither will I give you into the hand of these men who seek your life.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in Zedekiah kiang ah, "TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Babilon kumpipa heutute kiang ah na kipiak leh na hinna na bitsak ding a, hiai khopi leng mei in akang kei ding, nang leh na inkote leng na hing ding uh.'
english: Then Jeremiah said to Zedekiah, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: If you will go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then your soul shall live, and this city shall not be burned with fire; and you shall live, and your house.

paite: Babulon kumpipa heutute kiang a na kipiak keileh bel hiai khopi Kaldaite khut a piak ahi ding a, ahal ding ua, akhut ua kipan na suakta het kei ding achi," achi hi.
english: But if you will not go forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they shall burn it with fire, and you shall not escape out of their hand.

paite: Huan kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Kaldai mite kiang a kipia Judate khut ah ahon mansak in nuihzat in ahon bawl kha ding uh ka lau hi,” achi hi.
english: Zedekiah the king said to Jeremiah, I am afraid of the Jews who are fallen away to the Chaldeans, lest they deliver me into their hand, and they mock me.

paite: Jeremiah in bel, “Ahon mansak kei ding uh; na kiang a ka gen TOUPA aw mang mai in. Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih ding a, hin leng na hing ding. 21 Kipiak na ut keileh bel TOUPA'N hon thu kawkmuh hiai ahi:
english: But Jeremiah said, They shall not deliver you. Obey, I beg you, the voice of Yahweh, in that which I speak to you: so it shall be well with you, and your soul shall live.

paite: Kipiak na ut keileh bel TOUPA'N hon thu kawkmuh hiai ahi:
english: But if you refuse to go forth, this is the word that Yahweh has shown me:

paite: "Ngai in, Judah kumpipa' inn a numei omlaite tengteng Babulon kumpipa heutute kiang ah pi in a-om ding ua, huai numeite'n, na lawm hoihhoihte'n ahon khem ua, ahon zouta ua, na khe buannawi a atumtak in ahon lehngatsan ua," achi ding uhi.
english: behold, all the women who are left in the king of Judah’s house shall be brought forth to the king of Babylon’s princes, and those women shall say, Your familiar friends have set you on, and have prevailed over you. Your feet are sunk in the mire, they have turned away back.

paite: "Na zite, na tanute Kaldai mite kiang ah api vek ding ua, akhut ua kipan na suakta kei ding a, Babulon kumpipa khut ah mat in na om zaw ding a, nang ziak in hiai khopi akang ding," achi hi.
english: They shall bring out all your wives and your children to the Chaldeans; and you shall not escape out of their hand, but shall be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon: and you shall cause this city to be burned with fire.

paite: Huan Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang ah, "Hiai thute kuamah in thei kei uhen, huchi in na si kei ding.
english: Then Zedekiah said to Jeremiah, Let no man know of these words, and you shall not die.

paite: Himahleh heutute'n ka hon houpih azak ua, na kiang a ahong ua, na kiang a, 'Kumpipa kiang a na gen hon hilh in; ka lak uah bangmah iim nei ke'nla, ka hon that kei ding uh; na kiang a kumpipa thugente leng, achih uleh,
english: But if the princes hear that I have talked with you, and they come to you, and tell you, Declare to us now what you have said to the king; don’t hide it from us, and we will not put you to death; also what the king said to you:

paite: nang akiang uah, 'Jonathan inn a hon kiksak lou a, huai a va si lou ding in kumpipa kiang ah ngetna ka pelut lel ahi, na chi ding hi,' "achi hi.
english: then you shall tell them, I presented my supplication before the king, that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan’s house, to die there.

paite: Jeremiah kiang ah heutu tengteng hong pai in, adongta ngei ua, kumpipa'n thu apiak tengteng bang in amau ahilh hi. Huchi in akihoupih uh atawp ua; athu theih phak ahita kei hi.
english: Then came all the princes to Jeremiah, and asked him; and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded. So they left off speaking with him; for the matter was not perceived.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah bel Jerusalem lak ni tan in ngakmi huangsung ah a-om nilouh hi.
english: So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.

paite: Huan Judah vaihawm akum kuana akha sawmna ah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh asepaihte'n Jerusalem asual ua, a-um uh.
english: It happened when Jerusalem was taken, (in the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem, and besieged it;

paite: Zedekiah vaihawm kum sawm-le-khatna akha lina, ani kuana ah khopi kulh aphu pailet uh.
english: in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, the ninth day of the month, a breach was made in the city),

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem alak un Babulon kumpipa heutute a hong lut ua, kongpi laita ah atu ua, Nergal-shar-ezar, Samgar-nebo, Sarsekim, Rab-saris mi Nergal-shar-ezar, Rab-mag mi leh Babulon kumpipa heutu dangte toh.
english: that all the princes of the king of Babylon came in, and sat in the middle gate, Nergal Sharezer, Samgarnebo, Sarsechim, Rabsaris, Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, with all the rest of the princes of the king of Babylon.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Judah kumpipa Zedekiah leh galkapmi tengteng in amau amuh un ataikek ua, khopi a kipan zan in kumpipa huai lampi lam ah kulhbaang nih kikal kongpi ah ataikhia ua, amah pen Arabah lampi lam ah apawt hi.
english: It happened that, when Zedekiah the king of Judah and all the men of war saw them, then they fled, and went forth out of the city by night, by the way of the king’s garden, through the gate between the two walls; and he went out toward the Arabah.

paite: Himahleh Kaldaite sepaihhon in amah adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah Zedekiah apha ua; huchi in amat nung un Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah, Hamath gam a Riblah ah api ua, ama'n atungthu angaihtuah hi.
english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after them, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho: and when they had taken him, they brought him up to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he gave judgment on him.

paite: Huchi in Babulon kumpipa'n Riblah ah amah mitmuh ngei in Zedekiah tapate athat a, Babulon kumpipa'n Judah mihoih teng leng athat lai hi.
english: Then the king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah in Riblah before his eyes: also the king of Babylon killed all the nobles of Judah.

paite: Huai lou leng Zedekiah mit akhelkhia a, kol abunsak a, Babulon ah apita hi.
english: Moreover he put out Zedekiah’s eyes, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

paite: Kaldaite'n kumpipa' inn leh midang inn tengteng ahal ua, Jerusalem kulhbaangte leng ahihsia uh.
english: The Chaldeans burned the king’s house, and the houses of the people, with fire, and broke down the walls of Jerusalem.

paite: Huan ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in khopi a mipi khosuaksun akiang a amau a kipiate leh mipi omlaite Babulon ah sal in api hi.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive into Babylon the residue of the people who remained in the city, the deserters also who fell away to him, and the residue of the people who remained.

paite: Himahleh ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in Judah gam migenthei bangmah neiloute anusia a, grephuan leh loute ape pah ngal hi.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poor of the people, who had nothing, in the land of Judah, and gave them vineyards and fields at the same time.

paite: Huan Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in Jeremiah tungtang thu a ngakmi Nebuzaradan kiang ah,
english: Now Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon commanded Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard concerning Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "Amah pi inla, hoihtak in bawl inla, hihna himhim ke'n, na kiang a agen bangbang in hih zel zaw in," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Take him, and look well to him, and do him no harm; but do to him even as he shall tell you.

paite: Huan ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in Rab-saris mi Nebushazban, Rab-mag mi Nergal-shar-ezar leh Babulon kumpipa sepaih heutu deuhdeuhte athukhak vek a, amau Jeremiah ngakmi huangsung a kipan asamkhia ua,
english: So Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard sent, and Nebushazban, Rabsaris, and Nergal Sharezer, Rabmag, and all the chief officers of the king of Babylon;

paite: Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah a-inn a puak ding in akemsak ua, huchi in mite lak ah a-omta hi.
english: they sent, and took Jeremiah out of the court of the guard, and committed him to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, that he should carry him home: so he lived among the people.

paite: Huan ngakmi huangsung a khakkhum a a-om lai in, Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung hi.
english: Now the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah, while he was shut up in the court of the guard, saying,

paite: Ethiopia mi Ebed-melek kiang ah, "Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai in, ahoihna ding hilou in, hiai khopi siatna ding in ka thute ka hon tun ding a, huai ni mahmah in na ma ah tangtunsak ahi ding.
english: Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring my words on this city for evil, and not for good; and they shall be accomplished before you in that day.

paite: Huai ni in nang bel ka hon hunkhe ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, na mi kihtakte khut ah piak na hi kei ding.
english: But I will deliver you in that day, says Yahweh; and you shall not be given into the hand of the men of whom you are afraid.

paite: Nang ka hon humbit ding a, namsau in na puk kei ding a, kei na hon muan ziak in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in va gen in," achi hi.
english: For I will surely save you, and you shall not fall by the sword, but your life shall be for a prey to you; because you have put your trust in me, says Yahweh.

paite: "Aw Israel, na hong kikleh, ka kiang ngel ahang kik ding ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Na kihhuainate ka mitmuh louh a na koihmang a, chihtaktak a, thugel diktak zang a diktattak a;
english: “If you will return, Israel,” says Yahweh, “if you will return to me, and if you will put away your abominations out of my sight; then you shall not be removed;

paite: TOUPA ahin lai teng, chi a na kichiamleh namte amah ah nuamsa akichi ding ua, amah asuangta ding uh.
english: and you shall swear, ‘As Yahweh lives,’ in truth, in justice, and in righteousness. The nations shall bless themselves in him, and in him shall they glory.”

paite: "Judah mite leh Jerusalem kiang ah TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: Na lei sit uh let unla, lingte lak ah chỉ theh kei un.
english: For thus says Yahweh to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.

paite: Nou Judah gam a mi leh Jerusalem a tengte aw, TOUPA a ding in na zek uh sum unla, na lungtang zek uh sum un, huchi lou in zaw na thil gilou hihte uh ziak in, ka hehna mei bang in apawtkhe ding a, kuamah phelh theih louh in akang kha ding.
english: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem; lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

paite: Judah gam ah hilh unla, Jerusalem ah puang un, Gam pumpi ah pengkul mut unla, ngaihtak in kikou un. Hong kikhawm unla, kulh nei khopite ah i lut ding uh, chi un;
english: Declare in Judah, and publish in Jerusalem; and say, ‘Blow the trumpet in the land!’ Cry aloud and say, ‘Assemble yourselves! Let us go into the fortified cities!’

paite: Zion lam ah puanzak khai unla, bitna zong in tai unla, zekai kei un, mallam a pan thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding, nakpi a siatna.
english: Set up a standard toward Zion. Flee for safety! Don’t wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction.”

paite: Gammang nuai ning kitel a kipan in humpinelkai apawt hi, namte hihse ding; amun a kipan apawtta, ahong pai lellel hi, na gam hihse ding leh na khopite teng mi nei lou khop a sugawp ding in.
english: A lion is gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations; he is on his way, he is gone forth from his place, to make your land desolate, that your cities be laid waste, without inhabitant.

paite: Huaiziak in sai-ip puan teng unla, kap un, mau vongvong un; i lak ua kipan in TOUPA hehna thupi lah akikaikhe ngal kei a."
english: For this clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn’t turned back from us.

paite: "Huai ni chiang in hichi ahong hi ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; kumpipa lungtang a lungke khin ding a, heutute lungtang leng; siampute'n gen ding athei kei ding ua, zawlneite'n lamdang asa ding uh."
english: “It shall happen at that day,” says Yahweh, “that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be astonished, and the prophets shall wonder.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Ah, Toupa PATHIAN, hiai mite leh Jerusalem nakpitak a khem na hi ve, 'Muanna na nei ding uh,' na chi a, namsau in hinna asun zawta," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Ah, Lord Yahweh! Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, ‘You shall have peace;’ whereas the sword reaches to the heart.”

paite: Huai hun chiang in hiai mite leh Jerusalem kiang ah, "Gamdai tang giau velvul a kipan huih sa, ka tanu, ka mite zapsiang ding hilou; siangsak ding hi sam lou;
english: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem, “A hot wind from the bare heights in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people, not to winnow, nor to cleanse;

paite: Huih hat lua, ka thu in ahong tung ding ahi; tu in leng atungthu uh ngaihtuahpa kei ka hi,” chih ahi ding.
english: a full wind from these shall come for me. Now I will also utter judgments against them.”

paite: Ngai dih, ahong paitou ding, meipi bang in, akangtalai pingpei bang maite; asakolte muvanlai sang in ahatzaw uh, i tung gik na e! Buluh a om i hi ve ua.
english: Behold, he shall come up as clouds, and his chariots shall be as the whirlwind: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! For we are ruined.

paite: Aw Jerusalem, thulimlouhna a kipan na lungtang silsiang inla, hotdam a na omtheihna ding in; bang tan ahia na ngaihtuahna gilou na pai ding?
english: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long shall your evil thoughts lodge within you?

paite: Dan gam a kipan aw ahong pawtkhia a, Ephraim tang a kipan in thil hoih lou apuang hi.
english: For a voice declares from Dan, and publishes evil from the hills of Ephraim:

paite: Namte hilh unla, Jerusalem ah puang un, "Ngai dih, gam gamlapi a kipan sual mite ahong tung uh, Judah khopite tung ah a-aw uh asuah uhi.
english: “Tell the nations; behold, publish against Jerusalem, ‘Watchers come from a far country, and raise their voice against the cities of Judah.

paite: Louma veng mite bang mai in akimvel in a-um ua, ka tung a ahel ziak un chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: As keepers of a field, they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,’” says Yahweh.

paite: "Na omdan leh na thilhihte'n, hiaite na tung ah atun ahi, hiai na siatna ding ahi, ana mahmah a na lungtang sun ei ve."
english: “Your way and your doings have brought these things to you. This is your wickedness; for it is bitter, for it reaches to your heart.”

paite: Ka lung ana, ka lung ana, ka lungtang mahmah ana, ka sung ah ka lungtang abuaita a, ka om maimai thei kei, aw ka hinna, pengkul ging, kidouna husa ka zak ziak in.
english: My anguish, my anguish! I am pained at my very heart; my heart is disquieted in me; I can’t hold my peace; because you have heard, O my soul, the sound of the trumpet, the alarm of war.

paite: Siatna tung ah siatna atungta, gam pumpi loh in a-omta, ka puaninte ahihse guih ua, ka puanzakte leng mitphiat kal lou in.
english: Destruction on destruction is cried; for the whole land is laid waste: suddenly are my tents destroyed, and my curtains in a moment.

paite: "Bang tan ahia kidouna puanzak ka muh ding a, pengkul ging ka zak ding?
english: How long shall I see the standard, and hear the sound of the trumpet?

paite: Ka mite ahai mahmah ua lah athei ngal kei ua, naupang haitak, theihna nei lou bang mai ahi ua, thil gilou hih asiam ua, thil hoih hihdan asiam kei uh."
english: “For my people are foolish, they don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are skillful in doing evil, but to do good they have no knowledge.”

paite: Leitung ka etleh, ngai dih, segawp leh vuak in a-om a; vante'n vakna anei kei uh.
english: I saw the earth, and, behold, it was waste and void; and the heavens, and they had no light.

paite: Tangte ka etleh, ngai in, aling uh, mual tengteng leng atang zualzual uh.
english: I saw the mountains, and behold, they trembled, and all the hills moved back and forth.

paite: Ka etleh, ngai in, mihing a-om kei ua, tungleng vasate alengmang khinta uh.
english: I saw, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky had fled.

paite: Ka etleh, ngai in, louma hoihte gamdai asuak khin a, khopite leng achim khin, TOUPA leh ahehna mahmah ah.
english: I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of Yahweh, before his fierce anger.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Gam pumpi asegawp ding, himahleh ka hihtawp tawntung kei ding."
english: For thus says Yahweh, “The whole land shall be a desolation; yet will I not make a full end.

paite: "Huaiziak in lei in asuun ding a, tunglam vante leng amial ding; thu ka genta a, ka tumta hi, ka kisik kei a, ka lunghei kei hi.
english: For this the earth will mourn, and the heavens above be black; because I have spoken it, I have purposed it, and I have not repented, neither will I turn back from it.”

paite: Sakol tung a tuang leh thalpeu zang mite husa ah, khopi pumpi ataikek ua, gammang ah alut ua, kho chih anusia ua, luahmi khat lel leng om lou in.
english: Every city flees for the noise of the horsemen and archers; they go into the thickets, and climb up on the rocks: every city is forsaken, and not a man dwells therein.

paite: "Huan nang, loh a na om hun chiang in bangchi in na hih dia? Puan san-au a kizem in, kivatna dangka-eng a kivan in, na mitte nuh mah lechin, na kihih lawm thawn ahi, na tangvalte'n ahon simmoh ding ua, na hinna lak atum uhi.
english: You, when you are made desolate, what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, though you deck you with ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with paint, in vain do you make yourself beautiful; your lovers despise you, they seek your life.

paite: Numei nauvei kikou husa ka za, tachil neinu thuak lai, Zion tanu nak ging, akhutte zak a, ka tung gik hi na mai e! Tualthat mite ma ah ka hinna abah khinta," chi in.
english: For I have heard a voice as of a woman in travail, the anguish as of her who brings forth her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands, saying, “Woe is me now! For my soul faints before the murderers.”

paite: Judah leh Jerusalem sal tengteng, Babulon sal a apite uh lak a Jeremiah khainiang len kawm a api lai a ngakmi apawtsak nung a TOUPA a kipan Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung hi.
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, after that Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah, when he had taken him being bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah, who were carried away captive to Babylon.

paite: Ngakmi heutu in Jeremiah api a, akiang ah, "TOUPA i Pathian in hiai mun a thil hoih lou tung ding ana puang khin hi.
english: The captain of the guard took Jeremiah, and said to him, Yahweh your God pronounced this evil on this place;

paite: TOUPA'N ahon tungsakta ngei a, agen bangbang in ahihta hi; TOUPA tung ah thil na hihkhial ua, apaukam na man louh ziak un hiai thil na tung ua ahong tung ahi.
english: and Yahweh has brought it, and done according as he spoke: because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed his voice, therefore this thing has come on you.

paite: Tu in, ngai in, tuni in na khut a khainiang but ka hon phelsak hi. Babulon a ka kiang a hong na utleh hong inla, na ut keileh hong dah mai in; en dih, gam tengteng na ma ah a-om hi, hong hoh pha na sakleh hoih na sak bang in pai in.
english: Now, behold, I release you this day from the chains which are on your hand. If it seems good to you to come with me into Babylon, come, and I will take care of you; but if it seems bad to you to come with me into Babylon, don’t: behold, all the land is before you; where it seems good and right to you to go, there go.

paite: Akik ma in ama'n, Judah khopite tung a ukpi dia Babulon kumpipa'n abawl Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah kik inla, mite lak ah akiang ah om in, ahihkeileh hoh pha na sakna ah va hoh mai in," achi hi. Huchi in ngakmi heutu in nek ding leh thilpiak apia a, apaisakta hi.
english: Now while he had not yet gone back, Go back then, he said, to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, whom the king of Babylon has made governor over the cities of Judah, and dwell with him among the people; or go wherever it seems right to you to go. So the captain of the guard gave him food and a present, and let him go.

paite: Jeremiah bel Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah Mizpah ah ahoh a, akiang a gam a omsun mite lak ah a-om teita hi.
english: Then went Jeremiah to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah, and lived with him among the people who were left in the land.

paite: Huan sepaih pawl heutu tengteng gamlak a omte'n, amaute leh aheute uh Babulon kumpipa'n, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah huai gam a migenthei penpen, Babulon sal a pilouhte akemsak chih azak un Mizpah khua ah;
english: Now when all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, even they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land, and had committed to him men, and women, and children, and of the poorest of the land, of those who were not carried away captive to Babylon;

paite: Gedaliah kiang ah ahong pai ua, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael, Kareah tapate Johanan leh Jonathan, Tanhumet tapa Seraiah, Netophah a Ephai tate leh Maakath mi tapa Jezaniah, amau leh amite uh toh.
english: then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

paite: Huchi in Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in amau leh aheute uh kiang ah, "Kaldaite nasep kihta kei un; gam ah om dinden unla, Babulon kumpipa na sem unla, noute a ding in ahoih mai ding hi.
english: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan swore to them and to their men, saying, Don’t be afraid to serve the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it shall be well with you.

paite: Kei zaw Mizpah ah ka om ding a, Kaldai mi ka kiang a hong dingte ma ah noute sik in ka dingh ding; noute'n ahihleh uainte, nipitheite, thaute lakhawm in na bel uah koih unla, na khopi laksate uah teng un," chi in akichiam hi.
english: As for me, behold, I will dwell at Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans who shall come to us: but you, gather wine and summer fruits and oil, and put them in your vessels, and dwell in your cities that you have taken.

paite: Huchi mah bang in Juda mi tengteng, Moab gam a tengte, Ammon mite lak a tengte leh Edom gam a tengte leh gamdang a omte'n Babulon kumpipa'n Judah khosuaksunte nusia a, atung uah Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa, Gedaliah akoih chih azak un;
english: Likewise when all the Jews who were in Moab, and among the children of Ammon, and in Edom, and who were in all the countries, heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah, and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan;

paite: Juda mi tengteng ahawlzakna gam tengteng ua kipan in ahong paikik ua, Judah gam a Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah ahong tung ua, uain leh nipithei alakhawm uhi.
english: then all the Jews returned out of all places where they were driven, and came to the land of Judah, to Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and gathered wine and summer fruits very much.

paite: Huai lou leng Kareah tapa Johanan leh sepaih pawlte heutu, gamlak a om tengteng Mizpah ah Gedaliah kiang ah,
english: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were in the fields, came to Gedaliah to Mizpah,

paite: "Ammon mite kumpipa Baalis in na hinna la ding in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael asawl chih na za hia?" achi uhi.
english: and said to him, Do you know that Baalis the king of the children of Ammon has sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to take your life? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam didn’t believe them.

paite: Huan Kareah tapa Johanan in Mizpah a Gedaliah kiang ah, "Hon paisak dih ve, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael ka va that mai ding, kuamah in athei kei ding uh; Juda mi na kiang omkhawm tengteng adalh vek ua, Judah mi khosuaksunte manthatna hih ding in bangziak a na hinna la ding ahia?" chi in asimtham in agen hi.
english: Then Johanan the son of Kareah spoke to Gedaliah in Mizpah secretly, saying, Please let me go, and I will kill Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and no man shall know it: why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are gathered to you should be scattered, and the remnant of Judah perish?

paite: Ahikam tapa Gedaliah in bel Kareah tapa Johanan kiang ah, "Hiai thil na hih ding ahi kei; Ishmael na gendan adik kei hi," achi hi.
english: But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam said to Johanan the son of Kareah, You shall not do this thing; for you speak falsely of Ishmael.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, akha sagihna ah Elishama tapa Nethaniah tapa Ishmael, kumpi chi a mi, kumpipa upate lak a khat, mi sawmkhat pi in Mizpah ah Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah ahong ua; Mizpah ah an anekhawm uhi.
english: Now it happened in the seventh month, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the seed royal and one of the chief officers of the king, and ten men with him, came to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam to Mizpah; and there they ate bread together in Mizpah.

paite: Huan Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bel amipi sawmkhatte toh adingh ua, namsau in Shaphan tapa Ahikam tapa, Babulon kumpipa'n gam ukpipa dia abawl Gedaliah athat uhi.
english: Then arose Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and the ten men who were with him, and struck Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan with the sword, and killed him, whom the king of Babylon had made governor over the land.

paite: Akiang a Juda mi om tengteng, Mizpah a Gedaliah kiang a omte leh Kaldai galkapmi om teite Ishmael in athat lai hi.
english: Ishmael also killed all the Jews who were with him, with Gedaliah, at Mizpah, and the Chaldeans who were found there, the men of war.

paite: Gedaliah athah nung ni nih in hichi ahong hi a, kuamah in atheih ma un,
english: It happened the second day after he had killed Gedaliah, and no man knew it,

paite: Shekem a kipan, Shiloh a kipan, Samaria a kipan in mi sawmgiat, akhamul uh met a, apuansilhte uh kek a, amau ki-atkeh in, tanghou latte leh gimlimte tawi in TOUPA inn ah lan ding in ahong uhi.
english: that there came men from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria, even eighty men, having their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and having cut themselves, with meal offerings and frankincense in their hand, to bring them to the house of Yahweh.

paite: Amau dawn ding in Mizpah a kipan in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael apawtkhia a, lamtawn in akapkap a; huan, hichi ahong hi a, amaute amuh in akiang uah, "Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang ah hong pai un," achi hi.
english: Ishmael the son of Nethaniah went forth from Mizpah to meet them, weeping all along as he went: and it happened, as he met them, he said to them, Come to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, khopi sung atun uleh Nethaniah tapa Ishmael leh amipite'n amau ana that ua, kokhuk ah apai uhi.
english: It was so, when they came into the midst of the city, that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah killed them, and cast them into the midst of the pit, he, and the men who were with him.

paite: Alak ua mi sawmkhatte'n bel, "Hon that kei un, gam ah buh, buhman, sathau leh khuaizu tampi ka sel ngal ua," achi uhi. Huchi in amau ahawi ua, a-unaute uh lak ah athat telta kei hi.
english: But ten men were found among those who said to Ishmael, Don’t kill us; for we have stores hidden in the field, of wheat, and of barley, and of oil, and of honey. So he stopped, and didn’t kill them among their brothers.

paite: Huan Ishmael in Gedaliah toh amithahte luang apaihna kokhuk bel kumpipa Asa in Israel kumpipa Baasha akihtak ziak a abawl ahi. Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in huai luangte in adimsak hi.
english: Now the pit in which Ishmael cast all the dead bodies of the men whom he had killed, by the side of Gedaliah (the same was who which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel), Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with those who were killed.

paite: Huchi in Ishmael in Mizpah a mihing a-omsun, kumpipa tanute, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah kiang a ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in akepsak, Mizpah a om lai tengteng toh sal in api vek a; Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in huaite sal dia pi in Ammon mite zuan in apawt hi.
english: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people who were in Mizpah, even the king’s daughters, and all the people who remained in Mizpah, whom Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam; Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive, and departed to go over to the children of Ammon.

paite: Himahleh, Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang a om sepaih pawl heutu tengteng in Nethaniah tapa Ishmael thil hoih lou hih tengteng ana zak un mi tengteng apikhia ua,
english: But when Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,

paite: Nethaniah tapa Ishmael sual ding in akuan ua, tui tampi omna mun Gibeon ah ava mu uh.
english: then they took all the men, and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Ishmael kiang a mi tengteng in, Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang a sepaih heutu tengteng ava muh un ana kipak lo mahmah uhi.
english: Now it happened that, when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, then they were glad.

paite: Huchi in Ishmael in Mizpah a kipan a sal a api tengteng akihei ua, akik nawn ua, Kareah tapa Johanan kiang ah apai diam uhi.
english: So all the people who Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned about and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah.

paite: Nethaniah tapa Ishmael bel mi giat toh Johanan a kipan ataikhe geigei ua, Ammon mite kiang ah apaita uhi.
english: But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the children of Ammon.

paite: Huan Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang a sepaih pawl heutu tengteng in, Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in Ahikam tapa Gedaliah athah nung a Mizpah a kipan Nethaniah tapa Ishmael lak a Johanan in ahutkhiaksa mi akhosuaksunte tengteng, kidou mite, numeite, naupangte, michilgehte, Gibeon a kipan a api nawnte api vek hi.
english: Then took Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, all the remnant of the people whom he had recovered from Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah, after that he had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the men of war, and the women, and the children, and the eunuchs, whom he had brought back from Gibeon:

paite: Huchi in apawt ua, Kaldaite ziak a Aigupta gam a tailut tum in Bethlehem kho kiang ah Geruth Chimham ah akhawl uhi.
english: and they departed, and lived in Geruth Chimham, which is by Bethlehem, to go to enter into Egypt,

paite: Nethaniah tapa Ishmael in, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah, Babulon kumpipa'n huai gam ukpipa dia abawl athah ziak in amau akihta mahmah uhi.
english: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.

paite: Huan sepaih pawl heutute leh Kareah tapa Johanan leh Hoshaiah tapa Jezaniah leh mipi tengteng, aneupen a kipan a alianpen tan in ahong nai ua, zawlnei Jeremiah kiang ah:
english: Then all the captains of the forces, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Jezaniah the son of Hoshaiah, and all the people from the least even to the greatest, came near,

paite: "Na ma ah ka ngetna uh pom hi henla, hiai akhosuaksun mi tengteng a ding ngei in na Pathian kiang a hon thumsak ding in ka hon ngen uhi; na hon muh bang ngei in mi tampite lak a kipan tawmchik kia nutsiat in ka omta uh.
english: and said to Jeremiah the prophet, Please let our supplication be presented before you, and pray for us to Yahweh your God, even for all this remnant; for we are left but a few of many, as your eyes do see us:

paite: TOUPA na Pathian in ka paina ding thil uh hon kawkmuh theihna ding in," achi uhi.
english: that Yahweh your God may show us the way in which we should walk, and the thing that we should do.

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Jeremiah in akiang uah, "Na thu uh ka za hi, ngai un, na thu uh bangbang in TOUPA na Pathian kiang uah ka ngen ding hi; huan, hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N nou ahon dawn peuhmah ka hon hilh zel ding; na lak uah bangmah ka iim kei ding," achi hi.
english: Then Jeremiah the prophet said to them, I have heard you; behold, I will pray to Yahweh your God according to your words; and it shall happen that whatever thing Yahweh shall answer you, I will declare it to you; I will keep nothing back from you.

paite: Amau Jeremiah kiang ah, "TOUPA na Pathian in ka kiang ua nang ahon sawlna thu tengteng bang zel a ka hih kei uleh ka lak uah TOUPA thu theipa dik leh muanhuai hi hen.
english: Then they said to Jeremiah, Yahweh be a true and faithful witness among us, if we don’t do according to all the word with which Yahweh your God shall send you to us.

paite: Asia hiam apha hiam ka hon sawlna uh TOUPA ka Pathian uh paukam suak ka mang ngeingei ding uh; TOUPA ka Pathian uh paukam suak ka man uleh kou hoihtheihna ding ahi,” achi uhi.
english: Whether it be good, or whether it be evil, we will obey the voice of Yahweh our God, to whom we send you; that it may be well with us, when we obey the voice of Yahweh our God.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, ani sawm nung in TOUPA thu Jeremiah kiang ah ahong tung a.
english: It happened after ten days, that the word of Yahweh came to Jeremiah.

paite: Huchi in Kareah tapa Johanan leh akiang asepaih heutu om tengteng leh sepaih tengteng, aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in asam a, akiang uah,
english: Then called he Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces who were with him, and all the people from the least even to the greatest,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh, ama a na ngetna uh tun dia na hon sawlna pa un hichi in achi:
english: and said to them, Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to whom you sent me to present your supplication before him:

paite: Hiai gam a na omdet uleh ka hon tungding ding a, ka hon phelzak kei ding, ka hon phutkip ding a, ka hon botkhe kei ding, na tung ua thil hoih lou ka tutte lah ka lungheita ngal a.
english: If you will still live in this land, then will I build you, and not pull you down, and I will plant you, and not pluck you up; for I grieve over the distress that I have brought on you.

paite: Babulon kumpipa na lau sek uh lau nawn kei un, amah lau kei un chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; akhut a kipan noute hondam ding leh hunkhe ding in na kiang uah ka om hi.
english: Don’t be afraid of the king of Babylon, of whom you are afraid; don’t be afraid of him, says Yahweh: for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you from his hand.

paite: Na tung ua zah angaihtheihna ding in zahngaihna nou ka hon phal ding a, na gam mah uah ka hon kiksak ding hi.
english: I will grant you mercy, that he may have mercy on you, and cause you to return to your own land.

paite: Himahleh, hiai gam ah i om kei ding uh, chi a TOUPA na Pathian uh aw na man louh ua,
english: But if you say, We will not dwell in this land; so that you don’t obey the voice of Yahweh your God,

paite: "Ahi het lou Aigupta gam ah i pai zaw ding ua, huai ah kidouna himhim i tuak kei ding a, pengkul ging leng i za kei ding a, an taksapna a-om sam kei ding, huai ah i teng zaw ding uh," na chih uleh,
english: saying, No; but we will go into the land of Egypt, where we shall see no war, nor hear the sound of the trumpet, nor have hunger of bread; and there will we dwell:

paite: Aw Judah khosuaksunte aw, TOUPA thu ngai dih ua; sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi:
english: now therefore hear the word of Yahweh, O remnant of Judah: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, If you indeed set your faces to enter into Egypt, and go to live there;

paite: Aigupta gam a lut ding leh huai a teng ding a kihei teitei na hih uleh hichi ahong hi ding a, namsau na kihtak ngei un Aigupta gam ah hon pha ding a, kial na kihtak sek un leng Aigupta gam ah nou ahon delhzui ding a, huai ah na si ding uh.
english: then it shall happen, that the sword, which you fear, shall overtake you there in the land of Egypt; and the famine, about which you are afraid, shall follow close behind you there in Egypt; and there you shall die.

paite: Aigupta gam a teng ding a kihei teiteite tengteng huchibang in a-om ding ua, namsau, kial leh hipi in na si ding uh, thil hoih lou atung ua ka tut ding a kipan kuamah asuakta un abit kei ding uh.
english: So shall it be with all the men who set their faces to go into Egypt to live there: they shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence; and none of them shall remain or escape from the evil that I will bring on them.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in huchi in achi hi, "Jerusalem a tengte tung a ka hehna ka sun mah bang in Aigupta gam na lut hun chiang un na tung uah ka hehna ka sung sam ding; hamsethuak leh lamdangsak chiat, mi kamse banna, gensiat na hi ding ua, hiai mun na mu nawn kei ding uh.
english: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: As my anger and my wrath has been poured forth on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so shall my wrath be poured forth on you, when you shall enter into Egypt; and you shall be an object of horror, and an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach; and you shall see this place no more.

paite: "Aw Judah khosuaksunte aw, TOUPA'N na tungtang uh agenta hi, Aigupta gam ah lut kei un, hiai ni in nou ka hon theichiansak ahi chih thei mahmah un. Na hinna uh,
english: Yahweh has spoken concerning you, remnant of Judah, Don’t you go into Egypt: know certainly that I have testified to you this day.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah na hon sawl ua, TOUPA ka Pathian uh kiang ah hon thumsak inla, TOUPA ka Pathian un achihchih hon hilh inla, ka hih zel ding uhi na chi ngal ua.
english: For you have dealt deceitfully against your own souls; for you sent me to Yahweh your God, saying, Pray for us to Yahweh our God; and according to all that Yahweh our God shall say, so declare to us, and we will do it:

paite: Tuni in na kiang uah ka puangta ahi; himahleh na kiang ua ahon sawlna bangmah in TOUPA na Pathian uh paukam lah na mang ngal kei ua.
english: and I have this day declared it to you; but you have not obeyed the voice of Yahweh your God in anything for which he has sent me to you.

paite: Huaiziak in tu'n zaw theita un, tenna na lunggulhna mun ngei uah namsau, kial leh hipi in na si ngeingei ding uh," chi in achi hi.
english: Now therefore know certainly that you shall die by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence, in the place where you desire to go to live there.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem mipi tengteng kiang a TOUPA a Pathian uh thu tengteng TOUPA Pathian in gen ding a asawlna thu, huai thu tengteng agen khit in;
english: It happened that, when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking to all the people all the words of Yahweh their God, with which Yahweh their God had sent him to them, even all these words,

paite: Hoshaiah tapa Azariah leh Kareah tapa Johanan leh mikiphasak tengteng in, Jeremiah ahoupih ua, akiang ah, "Zuaugen na hi, TOUPA ka Pathian un, 'Aigupta gam a teng ding in na pai ding uh ahi kei, chi a gen ding in nang ahon sawl sam a;'
english: then spoke Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men, saying to Jeremiah, You speak falsely: Yahweh our God has not sent you to say, You shall not go into Egypt to live there;

paite: Kaldaite khut a matsak a ka om ua hon thahtheihna ding un leh Babulon sal dia hon pitheihna ding in Neriah tapa Baruk in kou hon sual ding a hon sawl ahi zaw ve," achi uhi.
english: but Baruch the son of Neriah sets you on against us, to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans, that they may put us to death, and carry us away captive to Babylon.

paite: Huchi in Kareah tapa Johanan leh sepaih pawl heutu teng leh mipi tengteng in Judah gam a teng ding in TOUPA aw amang kei uh.
english: So Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, and all the people, didn’t obey the voice of Yahweh, to dwell in the land of Judah.

paite: Huchi in Kareah tapa Johanan leh sepaih pawl heutu tengteng in Judah khosuaksun tengteng, Judah gam a teng ding a hawlzak a a-omna namte uh lak a kipan a hong kik;
english: But Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the captains of the forces, took all the remnant of Judah, who were returned from all the nations where they had been driven, to live in the land of Judah;

paite: pasalte, numeite, naupangte, kumpipa tanute leh michih ngakmi heutu Nebuzaradan in Shaphan tapa, Ahikam tapa Gedaliah leh akiang a anutsiatte uh zawlnei Jeremiah leh Neriah tapa Baruk leng, apikhawm vek zawta uhi.
english: the men, and the women, and the children, and the king’s daughters, and every person who Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard had left with Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan; and Jeremiah the prophet, and Baruch the son of Neriah;

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam atungta ua, TOUPA aw amang kei ua, huchi in Tahpanhes khua ngei atung uhi.
english: and they came into the land of Egypt; for they didn’t obey the voice of Yahweh: and they came to Tahpanhes.

paite: Tahpanhes ah Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a,
english: Then came the word of Yahweh to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,

paite: Suang lianpi la inla, Tahpanhes a Pharaoh inn lutna chin a teklei lep zutna ah Judah mite mitmuh ngei in phut in.
english: Take great stones in your hand, and hide them in mortar in the brick work, which is at the entry of Pharaoh’s house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah;

paite: Akiang uah, Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Ngai un, ka nasempa Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ka thukhak ding a, ama'n hiai ka suang phumguk tung ah alaltutphah atung ding; ama'n atung uah akumpi puanin akai ding hi.
english: and tell them, Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will set his throne on these stones that I have hidden; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them.

paite: "Huan ahong ding a, Aigupta gam ahong gawt ding a, sihna a si dingte, sihna ah; saltang dingte, saltanna ah, namsau thuak dingte namsau ah.
english: He shall come, and shall strike the land of Egypt; such as are for death shall be put to death, and such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.

paite: Aigupta mite pathian innte ah meikuangte akhah ding a, akang ding, sal in api ding a; belamchingmi in puan asilh bang in Aigupta gam asilh ding, huai a kipan in galmuang in apawt ding.
english: I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt; and he shall burn them, and carry them away captive: and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt, as a shepherd puts on his garment; and he shall go forth from there in peace.

paite: Aigupta gam a Beth-shemesh khuam zeknei sang pipite achimsak ding a, Aigupta pathian innte mei in ahal ding, achi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: He shall also break the pillars of Beth Shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt; and the houses of the gods of Egypt shall he burn with fire.

paite: Aigupta gam a Juda om tengteng, Migdol khua, Tahpanhes khua, Memphis khua leh Pathros gam a tengte tungtang a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung,
english: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, who lived at Migdol, and at Tahpanhes, and at Memphis, and in the country of Pathros, saying,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Jerusalem leh Judah khopite tung a thil hoih lou ka hon tutte na muta uh; ngai dih ua, tu in ahong segawpta a, kuamah ateng kei uh,
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: You have seen all the evil that I have brought on Jerusalem, and on all the cities of Judah; and behold, this day they are a desolation, and no man dwells therein,

paite: amau nou leh na pipute un pathian dangte atheih ngei nai louh uh na sem ding leh akiang ua gimlim hal in, kei hon hehsak ding uh; aginatlouhnate uh ahih khit tak ziak un.
english: because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger, in that they went to burn incense, to serve other gods, that they didn’t know, neither they, nor you, nor your fathers.

paite: Huchi pipi in na kiang uah nasem zawlnei tengteng phalvak a thou in ka sawl a, akiang uah, "Aw, hiai thu kihhuai, ka huat lamtak hih kei un,” chi in.
english: However I sent to you all my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, Oh, don’t do this abominable thing that I hate.

paite: Himahleh angaikhe tuan kei ua, aginatlouhna uh pathian dangte kiang a gimlim hal louh ding pen angeingaih kei uh.
english: But they didn’t listen, nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness, to burn no incense to other gods.

paite: Huaiziak in ka hehna leh ka thangpaihna Judah khopite leh Jerusalem kongzingte ah ka sung a akuangta a, tuni a a-om bang in asia a, asegawpta hi.
english: Therefore my wrath and my anger was poured forth, and was kindled in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem; and they are wasted and desolate, as it is this day.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in zaw TOUPA sepaihte' Pathian, Israel' Pathian in na lak ua kipan numei pasal, naungekte leh nawi ne laite Judah lak a kipan kuamah hawi lou a gawimang vek ding in bangziak a hiai thil hoih loutak na hinna uh tung a hih na hi ua?
english: Therefore now thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, the God of Israel: Why do you commit great evil against your own souls, to cut off from yourselves man and woman, infant and nursing child out of the midst of Judah, to leave yourselves none remaining;

paite: Na va tenna uh Aigupta gam pathiante kiang a gimlim hal in leitung gam teng a nam chih lak a hamsethuak leh gensiat na hihtheihna ding uh leh gawimang na hihtheihna ding ua na khut thilhih ngei ua hon hehsak na hi uh.
english: in that you provoke me to anger with the works of your hands, burning incense to other gods in the land of Egypt, where you have gone to live; that you may be cut off, and that you may be a curse and a reproach among all the nations of the earth?

paite: Na pipute uh gitlouhnate, Judah kumpipate gitlouhnate leh na zite uh gitlouhna, Judah gam leh Jerusalem kongzing a ahih khitsate uh na mangngilhta ua hia?
english: Have you forgotten the wickedness of your fathers, and the wickedness of the kings of Judah, and the wickedness of their wives, and your own wickedness, and the wickedness of your wives which they committed in the land of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem?

paite: Tuni tan in leng akisik tuan kei ua, na pipute uh leh noumau ma a ka taklat ka dan leh ka dan thusehte na zui kei ua, na lau sam kei uh.
english: They are not humbled even to this day, neither have they feared, nor walked in my law, nor in my statutes, that I set before you and before your fathers.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Ngai un, na siatna ding un Judah tengteng gawimang vek ding in nou ka hon maituah ding hi.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Judah.

paite: Huan Judah khosuaksun, Aigupta gam a ten tum a kihei teiteite ka man ding a, achimit vek ding uh; Aigupta gam ah apuk ding ua, namsau leh kialte a hihman in a-om ding uh; aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in namsau leh kial in asi ding uh.
english: I will take the remnant of Judah, that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to live there, and they shall all be consumed; in the land of Egypt shall they fall; they shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine; they shall die, from the least even to the greatest, by the sword and by the famine; and they shall be an object of horror, an astonishment, and a curse, and a reproach.

paite: Jerusalem ka gawt bangmah in Aigupta gam a tengte namsaute, kialte leh hipite a gawt ding ka hi ngal a.
english: For I will punish those who dwell in the land of Egypt, as I have punished Jerusalem, by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence;

paite: Huchi in Aigupta gam a teng ding a kuan Judah khosuaksunte Judah gam, a-omna ding ua kik nawn a-utna mahmah gam uah kik ding in khat lel leng hingdam in asuakta kei ding uh, asim a taikhete kia lou ngal kuamah akik kei ding uh."
english: so that none of the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, shall escape or be left, to return into the land of Judah, to which they have a desire to return to dwell there: for none shall return save such as shall escape.
