paite: Huchi in mi tengteng, azite un pathian dang kiang a gimlim ahal chih theite leh numei huai a dinghte mipi tampi, Aigupta gam a teng mipi tengteng in, Pathros ah Jeremiah adawng ua, hichi in achi uh;
english: Then all the men who knew that their wives burned incense to other gods, and all the women who stood by, a great assembly, even all the people who lived in the land of Egypt, in Pathros, answered Jeremiah, saying,

paite: "TOUPA min a ka kiang ua na thugente zaw ka hon ngaihkhiaksak kei ding uh.
english: As for the word that you have spoken to us in the name of Yahweh, we will not listen to you.

paite: Kou leh ka pipute uh, ka kumpipate uh leh ka heutute un Judah khopite ah leh Jerusalem kongzingte ah ana hih zel bang un van kumpinu kiang a gimlim halte leh akiang a dawn ding thillat butkhiakte, ka paukam suak peuhmah bang un ka hih ngeingei ding uh; huchih lai in ka lamzang ua, nek-le-dawn ding atam a, siatna himhim ka mu sam ua.
english: But we will certainly perform every word that is gone forth out of our mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her, as we have done, we and our fathers, our kings and our princes, in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem; for then had we plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

paite: Van kumpinu kiang a thil hal leh akiang a dawn ding thillat butkhiakte ka tawp nungsiah uh bangpeuh ka tasam zawta ua, namsau leh kialte a hihman in ka omta uhi."
english: But since we left off burning incense to the queen of the sky, and pouring out drink offerings to her, we have wanted all things, and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine.

paite: Huan numeite'n, "Van kumpinu kiang a gimlim ka hal lai uh leh akiang a dawn ding thillatte ka butkhiak uh?" achi uhi.
english: When we burned incense to the queen of the sky, and poured out drink offerings to her, did we make her cakes to worship her, and pour out drink offerings to her, without our husbands?

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah in mipi tengteng, numei pasal amah dawng mite tengteng kiang ah,
english: Then Jeremiah said to all the people, to the men, and to the women, even to all the people who had given him an answer, saying,

paite: "Judah khopite leh Jerusalem kongzingte ah, nou leh na pipute uh, na kumpipate uh leh na heutute uh leh gam a mipite'n gimlim ahalte uh TOUPA'N atheigige in alungsim ah akhum kei maw?
english: The incense that you burned in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, you and your fathers, your kings and your princes, and the people of the land, didn’t Yahweh remember them, and didn’t it come into his mind?

paite: Na thil gilou hih ziak uleh na thilkihhuai hihte uh ziak in TOUPA'N athuak ngap nawnta kei hi; huaiziak in, na gam uh tua a-om bang in asia a, lamdangsak chiat, hamsethuak, tengmi om lou, ahong hita hi.
english: so that Yahweh could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed; therefore your land has become a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without inhabitant, as it is this day.

paite: Gimlim na hal ua, TOUPA tung ah na gilou ua, TOUPA paukam suakte na mang kei ua, adan hiam adan thusehte hiam athu theihsakte hiam na zuih sam louh ziak un hiai thil hoih lou tua a-om bang in na tung uah ahong tungta hi," achi a.
english: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against Yahweh, and have not obeyed the voice of Yahweh, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil has happened to you, as it is this day.

paite: Huai lou leng Jeremiah in mipi tengteng leh numeite kiang ah, "Aigupta gam a Judah tengteng aw, TOUPA thu za un, sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi:
english: Moreover Jeremiah said to all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of Yahweh, all Judah who are in the land of Egypt:

paite: Nou leh na zite un, van kumpinu kiang a gimlim hal leh dawn ding thillat butkhiakte ka na chiamsa bang zel in ka hih ngeingei ding, chi in na kam un na genta ua, na khut un na pichingsak lai uhi. 'Na thuchiamte uh hihkip unla, na thu tupte uh tangtungsak vanglak un.'
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, saying, You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and with your hands have fulfilled it, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to her: establish then your vows, and perform your vows.

paite: Huaiziak in nou Judah, Aigupta gam a tengte aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un: Ngai un, Toupa PATHIAN ahin bang in chi in Aigupta gam pumpi a teng, Judah mi kua kam mah ah ka min aging nawn ngei kei ding, chi in ka min thupi lou in ka kichiam ahi chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore hear the word of Yahweh, all Judah who dwell in the land of Egypt: Behold, I have sworn by my great name, says Yahweh, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, As the Lord Yahweh lives.

paite: Ngai in, ahoihna ding uh hilou in asiatna ding un amau ka tang thek ahi; huchi in Judah mi, Aigupta gam a omte tengteng, namsau leh kialte ahihman in a-om ding uh, amanthat vek matan un.
english: Behold, I watch over them for evil, and not for good; and all the men of Judah who are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until they are all gone.

paite: Namsau hihman val tawmchik Aigupta gam a kipan a pawt in Judah gam ah alut ding uh; huan, Judah mi khosuaksunte tengteng, Aigupta gam a teng ding a kuan mite'n kua thu ahia pai zaw ding, ka thu hia amau thu, athei ding uh.
english: Those who escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah, few in number; and all the remnant of Judah, who have gone into the land of Egypt to live there, shall know whose word shall stand, mine, or theirs.

paite: "Huan hiai nou a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding; na tung uah thil hoih lou lam in ka thu apai ngei ding chih na theihna ding un hiai mun ah nou ka hon gawt ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: This shall be the sign to you, says Yahweh, that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, Pharaoh Hophra, Aigupta kumpipa bel amelma, ahinna zong mite khut ah ka mangsak ding, Judah kumpipa Zedekiah, amelma, ahinna zongmi Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut a ka piak bangmah in," achi hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, Behold, I will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of those who seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Judah into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, who was his enemy, and sought his life.

paite: Judah kumpipa Jehoiakim, Josiah tapa akum lina ah Jeremiah kam a kipan, hiai thute laibu a agelh lai a, Neriah tapa Baruk kiang a zawlnei Jeremiah thugen:
english: The message that Jeremiah the prophet spoke to Baruch the son of Neriah, when he wrote these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying,

paite: Baruk aw, TOUPA Israel' Pathian in, na kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, to you, Baruch:

paite: Nang, "Ka tung gik hi na mai e, TOUPA'N ka thuakna ah lungkhamna ahon behlapta ngal a; ka mauna ka bahpih a, tawldamna ka muzou kei," na chi a.
english: You said, Woe is me now! for Yahweh has added sorrow to my pain; I am weary with my groaning, and I find no rest.

paite: Akiang ah hichi in na gen ding ahi, "TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, ka lamsa ka phel nawn ding a, gam pumpi mahmah ah ka phuhsa ka botkhe nawn ding.
english: You shall tell him, Thus says Yahweh: Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up; and this in the whole land.

paite: Huan nang a ding in thil thupi na zong hia? Zong dah mai in; sa tengteng tung ah thil hoih lou ka hon tungsak ding a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; himahleh na hinna bel mun chih a na paina ah gallak ding in ka hon pe ding,” chi in.
english: Do you seek great things for yourself? Don’t seek them; for, behold, I will bring evil on all flesh, says Yahweh; but your life will I give to you for a prey in all places where you go.

paite: Namte tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung;
english: The word of Yahweh which came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the nations.

paite: Aigupta thu, Euphrates Luipi gei a Karkhemish a om, Judah kumpipa Josiah tapa Jehoiakim, akum lina a Nebukadnezzar in anuaisiah leh Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh Neko sepaihhonte tungtang thu:
english: Of Egypt: concerning the army of Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

paite: "Lum bemte, lum zawlte mansa in om unla, gal nawt un,
english: Prepare the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle!

paite: Sakol van unla, sakol tuang mite aw, tuang un, dal lukhu khu in dingkip unla, tei tat-hiam in sik puanak silh un.
english: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, put on the coats of mail.

paite: Bangchidan a amaute lau-le- ling a taikek a mu ka hia! Agalkap mite uh avuallel uh, baksam leng zen in atai ua, nunglam nga het lou in, ning chih ah gal alang chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Why have I seen it? they are dismayed and are turned backward; and their mighty ones are beaten down, and have fled apace, and don’t look back: terror is on every side, says Yahweh.

paite: Mizuanzaang ataimang thei kei, galkapmi apawt tuan kei uh, huai a mi Euphrates Luipi gei ah ahawi ua, apuk khinta uh.
english: Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; in the north by the river Euphrates have they stumbled and fallen.

paite: Nile lui bang a khang kua ahia? Luipi tuikihot kimvel bang in?
english: Who is this who rises up like the Nile, whose waters toss themselves like the rivers?

paite: Aigupta Nile lui bang in akhang a luipi tuikihot kimvel bang mai in, ka khang ding a, leitung ka luahsuak ding, khopi leh aluahte ka hihse ding," achi hi.
english: Egypt rises up like the Nile, and his waters toss themselves like the rivers: and he says, I will rise up, I will cover the earth; I will destroy cities and its inhabitants.

paite: "Aw sakolte aw, nawk zel unla, aw kangtalai aw, nakpi in pang un; galdou mite'n ma phu uhenla, Ethiopia mi leh Put mi, lum tawi mite, Lud mi thalpeu zang siamte toh.
english: Go up, you horses; and rage, you chariots; and let the mighty men go forth: Cush and Put, who handle the shield; and the Ludim, who handle and bend the bow.

paite: Huai ni ahi, Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA ni, phulak ni, amelmate tung a phu alaktheihna, namsau in agai ding a, atai ding, asisan uh taitak in adawn ding; Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N mal gam ah Euphrates Luipi gei ah mi tampi agou phengphung mai ve.
english: For that day is of the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour and be satiate, and shall drink its fill of their blood; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

paite: Aw, Aigupta tanu siangthou, Gilead ah hohtou inla, singnai nuhchi va la in, damdawi tampi athawn in na zangta, nang a ding in damna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, virgin daughter of Egypt: in vain do you use many medicines; there is no healing for you.

paite: Namte'n na zahlakna aza ua, na kah in leitung pumpi adim hi, galhatmi leh galhatmi akiphu ua, lei ah apukkhawm uh," chi in.
english: The nations have heard of your shame, and the earth is full of your cry; for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, they are fallen both of them together.

paite: Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar hong pai a, Aigupta gam ahong bawl ekdan ding thu TOUPA'N zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a agen:
english: The word that Yahweh spoke to Jeremiah the prophet, how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon should come and strike the land of Egypt.

paite: "Aigupta gam ah gen unla, Migdol ah puang un; Memphis leh Tahpanhes ah puang unla; dingkip in kigalging un; na kim a mi namsau in agaita ngal a.
english: Declare in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes: say, Stand forth, and prepare; for the sword has devoured around you.

paite: Bangziak a na mihatte phiatmang a om ahi ua? Adingh zou kei ua, TOUPA'N apaihkhiak ziak in.
english: Why are your strong ones swept away? they didn’t stand, because Yahweh pushed them.

paite: Mi tampi akisuisak a, ahi, akiphupuk lemlum ua, Nuaisiahna namsau taisan in kisa un, i kik ding uh, i pianna gam ah i mite kiang ah, achi uhi.
english: He made many to stumble, yes, they fell one on another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our birth, from the oppressing sword.

paite: Aigupta kumpipa Pharaoh pen husa lian lel, ahun sehsa a paimangsak a om, chi in huai ah akikou uhi.
english: They cried there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has let the appointed time pass by.

paite: Ahin a ka hin sung in chih Kumpipa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi hi, tangte lak a Tabor tang bang in tuipi chin a Karmel tang bang in ahong pai ngei ding.
english: As I live, says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies, surely like Tabor among the mountains, and like Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.

paite: Aw nang, tanu, Aigupta gam a teng, saltang ding in kibawl mai in; Memphis akisegawp dek a, teng ding om lou in akangmang ding hi.
english: You daughter who dwells in Egypt, furnish yourself to go into captivity; for Memphis shall become a desolation, and shall be burnt up, without inhabitant.

paite: Aigupta bel bawngla hoihtak ahi, himahleh mal a kipan nasemmi ding hong kuan in ahong pai hi.
english: Egypt is a very beautiful heifer; but destruction out of the north has come, it has come.

paite: Alak ua sepaih goihlaite bel bawngtuai vak thau bang mai ahi ua, adek uh angat ua, ataikek ua, khawl lou in, atung uah asiatna ni uh atungta, agawtna hun ding uh;
english: Also her hired men in the midst of her are like calves of the stall; for they also are turned back, they are fled away together, they didn’t stand: for the day of their calamity has come on them, the time of their visitation.

paite: Gulpi kitholh bang mai in husa anei a, amelmate kiton in ahong pai ua, singphuk mite bang in hei toh ahong sual uh.
english: The sound of it shall go like the serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as wood cutters.

paite: Agam gammang vaksuak zoh louh ahong hihse ding uh, khaukhup sang in atamzaw ua, sim seng louh ahi uh.
english: They shall cut down her forest, says Yahweh, though it can’t be searched; because they are more than the locusts, and are innumerable.

paite: Aigupta tanu azahlak ding, mallam a mi khut a matsak in a-om ding."
english: The daughter of Egypt shall be disappointed; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Ngai un, Thebes khua a Ammon, leh Pharaoh leh Aigupta leh apathiante, akumpipate, Pharaoh ngei leh amah muang mite ka gawt ding.
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Behold, I will punish Amon of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with her gods, and her kings; even Pharaoh, and those who trust in him:

paite: Ahinna uh, zong mite khut ah leh Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh anasem mite khut ah ka mansak ding; huai hun chiang in luah in a-om ding, nidanglai nite mah bang in," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: and I will deliver them into the hand of those who seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants; and afterwards it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, says Yahweh.

paite: "Jakob aw, ka nasempa, lau ke'nla, aw Israel, lunglel sam ke'n, ngai in, gamlapi a kipan nang ka hon hunkhe ding a, na suante leng asaltanna gam ua kipan, Jakob ahong kik ding a, muangtak in a-om hiathiat ding a, kuamah in alausak nawn kei ding uh.
english: But don’t you be afraid, Jacob my servant, neither be dismayed, Israel: for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be quiet and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

paite: Jakob aw, ka nasempa, lau ke'n, ka hon ompih ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ka hon delhzakna nam tengteng ka beisak ding a, nang zaw ka hon beisak het kei ding; diktak in ka hon gawt ding a, gawt louh in ka hon khak kei ding hi.
english: Don’t you be afraid, O Jacob my servant, says Yahweh; for I am with you: for I will make a full end of all the nations where I have driven you; but I will not make a full end of you, but I will correct you in measure, and will in no way leave you unpunished.

paite: Pharaoh in Gaza agawt ma a Philistia mite tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung.
english: The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before that Pharaoh struck Gaza.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai un, mal a kipan in tui ahong khang hi, akuang dim in aluanglet ding; gam atum ding a asung a om tengteng toh, khopi leh asung a tengte leng; mite akap ding ua, gam a mi tengteng amau tuaituai ding uh.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall become an overflowing stream, and shall overflow the land and all that is therein, the city and those who dwell therein; and the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall wail.

paite: Asakol hat chinte leitot ging in kidou kangtalai ging dopdop in, akangtalai ging in, pate alunglel ua, atate uh en lou zen in.
english: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers don’t look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

paite: Philistia mi tengteng lohna ni, Tura leh Sidon a kipan apanpih mi khosuaksunte sattanna ni ziak in, TOUPA'N tuipi gei Kaphtor omlaite ahihse ding hi.
english: because of the day that comes to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper who remains: for Yahweh will destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the isle of Caphtor.

paite: Gaza mite lu ahong giauta, Ashkelon achimitta a, agam phaizang a teng khosuaksunte; bang tan kiat ding na hia?
english: Baldness has come on Gaza; Ashkelon is brought to nothing, the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut yourself?

paite: Aw TOUPA namsau, na om kinken ma bang tan a sawt ahia? Na pai ah kikhum in; khawl inla om kinken ve.
english: You sword of Yahweh, how long will it be before you be quiet? Put up yourself into your scabbard; rest, and be still.

paite: TOUPA'N Ashkelon leh tuipi gei tung a gamtang ding a, ahon seh a, hih ding ahon piak ngalleh bangchi in na om kinken thei dia?
english: How can you be quiet, since Yahweh has given you a command? Against Ashkelon, and against the seashore, there has he appointed it.

paite: Moab tungtang thu; sepaihte’ TOUPA Pathian in hichi in achi: "Nebo tung agik hi; hihgawp in a-omta; Kiriathaim zahlaksak in a- omta, laksuan ahi. Misgab bel zahlak leh hihsiat in a-omta.
english: Of Moab. Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Woe to Nebo! for it is laid waste; Kiriathaim is disappointed, it is taken; Misgab is put to shame and broken down.

paite: Moab minthanna amangta; Heshbon ah asiatna ding gen in, 'Kisa un, nam ahihna kipan i hihmang ding uh,' " achi ua. Aw Madmen khua, nang leng daihsak sipsip na hi ding a, namsau in ahon delh ding.
english: The praise of Moab is no more; in Heshbon they have devised evil against her: Come, and let us cut her off from being a nation. You also, Madmen, shall be brought to silence: the sword shall pursue you.

paite: Horonaim a kipan akikou husa, lohna leh siatna thupi mahmah.
english: The sound of a cry from Horonaim, desolation and great destruction!

paite: Moab suksiat ahi a, atate kap ging zak in a-om hi,
english: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

paite: Luhith ah kap in apaitou ua, Horonaim sul ah manthatna kikou ging lunglelhhuai aza uh.
english: For by the ascent of Luhith with continual weeping shall they go up; for at the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distress of the cry of destruction.

paite: Taimang unla, na hinna uh humbit un, gamdai gam sabiltung bang in om un.
english: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

paite: Na nasep leh na sum-le-pai na muan ziak in nang leng mat in na om ding hi, Khemosh sal a pi ahi ding; asiampute leh aheutute toh.
english: For, because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also shall be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

paite: Kho chih ah hihsemi ahong tung ding, kho khat lel in leng apel kei ding; phaizang gam leng amang ding; phaizang hihsiat ahi ding. TOUPA'N achihsa bang in.
english: The destroyer shall come on every city, and no city shall escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed; as Yahweh has spoken.

paite: Alenmang theihna ding in Moab kha pia un, tengmi om lou in, akhuate akisegawp ding.
english: Give wings to Moab, that she may fly and get her away: and her cities shall become a desolation, without any to dwell therein.

paite: Limsak loutak a Pathian nna semmi hamsethuak in om henla, sisan suah ding a anamsau zang nuamloumi hamsethuak in om hen.
english: Cursed is he who does the work of Yahweh negligently; and cursed is he who keeps back his sword from blood.

paite: Atuailai a kipan Moab in nuam asa a, a-uain abohkhum a, bel dang a teituah leng atuak kei a, sal a pi in a-om ngei sam kei hi, alim ngeingei a lim gige in, agim leng alamdang tuan kei.
english: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remains in him, and his scent is not changed.

paite: "Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, abungkhe ding mi ka hon sawl ding a, huan amau abungkhe ding uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; abelte avuaksak ding ua, a-umte ahihkek ding uh.
english: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will send to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles in pieces.

paite: Israel inkote'n amuanpi pen uh Bethel azahpih bang un Moab in Khemosh azahpihta ding hi.
english: Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel their confidence.

paite: Pasal hoih leh galdou mihangsan i hi ua, bangchidan a chi na hi ua?
english: How do you say, We are mighty men, and valiant men for the war?

paite: Moab bel hihgawp in a-om a, akhopi meikhu in azam khinta, atangval hoih teng apuk khinta chih Kumpipa, amin Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Moab is laid waste, and they are gone up into his cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Moab siatna ahong tung lellel, athuakna ding akinoh hi.
english: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hurries fast.

paite: Nou akim a mi teng in amah suun in amin thei teng in chiangkhun khauh leh chiang thupi akitanta hi, chi un.
english: All you who are around him, bemoan him, and all you who know his name; say, How is the strong staff broken, the beautiful rod!

paite: Aw nang tanu, Dibon a teng, na thupina paisan inla, dangtak in tu in; Moab lokmi'n nang ahon sual a, na kulhte ahihseta hi.
english: You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up against you, he has destroyed your strongholds.

paite: Aw Aroer a teng nu, kongbul ah dingh in, enkhia in, taikekpa, suaktanu dong inla, Bang amaizen a? chi in.
english: Inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and watch: ask him who flees, and her who escapes; say, What has been done?

paite: Moab zahlaksak in a-omta, achimgawpta ngal a, mau tuaituai in kap un, Moab hihsiat ahita! chih Arnon ah puang un.
english: Moab is disappointed; for it is broken down: wail and cry; tell it by the Arnon, that Moab is laid waste.

paite: Gam tampi tung ah; Holon, Zahjah, Mephaath,
english: Judgment has come on the plain country, on Holon, and on Jahzah, and on Mephaath,

paite: leh Dibon, Nebo, Beth-diblathaim,
english: and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth Diblathaim,

paite: leh Keriathaim, Beth-gamul, Beth-menon,
english: and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth Gamul, and on Beth Meon,

paite: leh Kerioth, Bozrah leh Moab gam a khua tengteng, agamla leh anai ah vaihawmna ahong tungta hi.
english: and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

paite: Moab ki-attan in a-om a, aban hihtan in a-omta, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says Yahweh.

paite: Amah dawnkhamsak un; TOUPA tung ah akiliansak ngal a; huan, Moab bel amah luak ah akitholh ding a, nuihsan in a-om lai ding hi.
english: Make him drunken; for he magnified himself against Yahweh: and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

paite: Israel nang ding nuihza bawlna ahita kei maw? Gutate lak ah atel a hia? Amah tungtang na gen teng in na lu na sinkhum hilou hiam?
english: For wasn’t Israel a derision to you? was he found among thieves? for as often as you speak of him, you shake your head.

paite: Moab a tengte aw, khopite taisan unla, kawl kikal ah teng un, vakhu, kohawm gei a bu bawlsek bang in om un.
english: You inhabitants of Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock; and be like the dove that makes her nest over the mouth of the abyss.

paite: Moab kisaktheihna ka zata ua, akisathei ngut ve, akikoih sandan, akisaktheihdan, aki-otsakdan leh alungtang kideihkhopdante.
english: We have heard of the pride of Moab. He is very proud; his loftiness, and his pride, and his arrogance, and the haughtiness of his heart.

paite: Ahehna bangmah ahi kei chih ka thei; aki-otsaknate'n bangmah ahih ko kei, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I know his wrath, says Yahweh, that it is nothing; his boastings have worked nothing.

paite: Huchi in Moab tung ah ka mau tuaituai ding a, ahi, Moab pumpi a ding in ka kap ding, Kir-hareseth mite suun ahi ding uh.
english: Therefore will I wail for Moab; yes, I will cry out for all Moab: for the men of Kir Heres shall they mourn.

paite: Jazer kap sang a thupi in ka hon kah ding a, aw Sibmah grep kung, na hiangte tuipi tung ah akiphalh a, Jazer tuipi leng atung hialta a, na nipithei leh grep gahte hihsemi in abawm hi.
english: With more than the weeping of Jazer will I weep for you, vine of Sibmah: your branches passed over the sea, they reached even to the sea of Jazer: on your summer fruits and on your vintage the destroyer is fallen.

paite: Nopna leh kipahna amang khin hi, theibil leh Moab gam a kipan; uain sukna khuk a ka uain ka beisakta a, kuamah in nuamsa a kikou in achil nawn kei ding uh.
english: Gladness and joy is taken away from the fruitful field and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to cease from the wine presses: none shall tread with shouting; the shouting shall be no shouting.

paite: Heshbon leh Elealeh ah akikou ua, Jahaz tan in aw asuah ua, Zoar a kipan Horonaim tan, Eglath-shelishijah tan in leng, Nimrim tui kim adai ding hi.
english: From the cry of Heshbon even to Elealeh, even to Jahaz have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even to Horonaim, to Eglath Shelishiyah: for the waters of Nimrim also shall become desolate.

paite: Huai lou in Moab mun sangte thil lanmi leh apathiante a dia gimlim halmi ka hihmang ding, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, says Yahweh, him who offers in the high place, and him who burns incense to his gods.

paite: Huchi in tamngai bang in ka lungtang Moab a ding in aging a, Kir-hareseth mite a ding in tumging bang in ka lungtang aging hi; huaiziak in niang-le-tai a thil amuhsate amangthang khinta hi.
english: Therefore my heart sounds for Moab like pipes, and my heart sounds like pipes for the men of Kir Heres: therefore the abundance that he has gotten is perished.

paite: Lu chiteng metgiau ahi a, khamul chiteng met ahi; khut tengteng at ahi a; kongte ah sai-ip puan a-om chiat hi.
english: For every head is bald, and every beard clipped: on all the hands are cuttings, and on the waist sackcloth.

paite: Moab inn tung tengteng, kongzing leh mun chih ah kahna a-om a; Moab bel phatuam nawn lou bang in ka hihkham khinta hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: On all the housetops of Moab and in its streets there is lamentation every where; for I have broken Moab like a vessel in which none delights, says Yahweh.

paite: Seta namai e! Segawp zou hi na tel e; Moab zahlak in alehngatta ve; huchi in Moab bel akimvel a mite tengteng a ding in nuihza bawlna leh mulkimhuai ahong hita hi.
english: How it is broken down! How they wail! How Moab has turned the back with shame! So shall Moab become a derision and a terror to all who are around him.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, mu bang in aleng ding a, Moab tung ah akha azak ding.
english: For thus says Yahweh: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.

paite: Kerioth lak ahi a, akulhte aphawng guih a, huai ni in Moab pasalphate lungtang numei nauvei lungtang bang mai ahi ding.
english: Kerioth is taken, and the strongholds are seized, and the heart of the mighty men of Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

paite: Moab amangthang ding, nam aching nawn kei ding; TOUPA anuaisiah zawk ziak in.
english: Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.

paite: Launa, kokhuk leh tangte, aw Moab luahmi, na tung ah atung hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are on you, inhabitant of Moab, says Yahweh.

paite: Launa taisanmi kokhuk ah ake ding a, kokhuk a pawt thang ah a-awk ding, agawtna kum ka hon tun sin ngal a, atung ah, Moab tung ah ngei, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: He who flees from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he who gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring on him, even on Moab, the year of their visitation, says Yahweh.

paite: Heshbon lim ah taikekpawl bahgawp in akhawl ding ua, Heshbon a kipan in mei apawt a, Sihon lak a kipan in meikuang, chiak vengvung mite sip a sam toh Moab baksam akang khin hi.
english: Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon; for a fire is gone forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and has devoured the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

paite: Na tung agik hi, aw Moab! Khemosh mite amangta ua; na tapate sal a pi in, na tanute sal in atangta uhi.
english: Woe to you, O Moab! the people of Chemosh is undone; for your sons are taken away captive, and your daughters into captivity.

paite: Himahleh ni nanung chiang in Moab omdan ka hei ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Hichi tan Moab tungthu ahi.
english: Yet will I bring back the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahweh. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

paite: Ammon mite thu, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel in tate anei kei a hia? Gouluahmi nei lou hia? Bang achia ahia akumpipa'n Gad atantak a, khopite a amite aten uh?
english: Of the children of Ammon. Thus says Yahweh: Has Israel no sons? has he no heir? why then does Malcam possess Gad, and his people well in its cities?

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tùng hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ammon tate Rabbah ah kidou husa ging ka kizasak ding, thil sia omkhawm lel ahong hi ding hi, atanute mei in akang ding a, huchi in Israel in amah neimi anei thuk ding, TOUPA'N achi.
english: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the children of Ammon; and it shall become a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Israel possess those who possessed him, says Yahweh.

paite: Aw Heshbon, mau tuaituai inla, Ai alok khinta ua; Rabbah tate aw, kap un, kap unla, umna sungte ah vialtai un. Kumpipa, siampu leh amiliante toh sal a pi in a-om ding uhi.
english: Wail, Heshbon, for Ai is laid waste; cry, you daughters of Rabbah, clothe yourself in sackcloth: lament, and run back and forth among the fences; for Malcam shall go into captivity, his priests and his princes together.

paite: Bangziak a na phaizang hoihte suang na hia, aw muanhuailounu aneih hoihhoihte muang a, 'Kua ahia hon sual ding?' chichi nak mi.
english: Why do you glory in the valleys, your flowing valley, backsliding daughter? who trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come to me?

paite: Ngai in, na tung ah launa ka hon tun ding a, na kim a mi tengteng a kipan, chih Toupa sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi; michih delhkhiak na hi vek ding uh, kuamah in taikekpawl akaikhawm kei ding uh.
english: Behold, I will bring a fear on you, says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, from all who are around you; and you shall be driven out every man right forth, and there shall be none to gather together the fugitives.

paite: "Huai khit chiang in bel Ammon tate omdan ka kiheisak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But afterward I will bring back the captivity of the children of Ammon, says Yahweh.

paite: Edom thu, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Teman a pilna om nawn lou ahi maw? Lemthei lemtheihna amang khinta a hia? Apilna uh mang khin hia?
english: Of Edom. Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

paite: Aw Dedan a tengte aw, taikek unla, lehngat unla, tummang vengveng un; amah ka gawt hun chiang in, Esau siatna atung ah ka hon tun ding hi.
english: Flee, turn back, dwell in the depths, inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau on him, the time that I shall visit him.

paite: Grep lou mite na kiang a ahong pai un, maih anei kei ding ua hia? Zan a guta mite'n adeihzah uh angah masiah un alok zel kei ding ua hia?
english: If grape gatherers came to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, wouldn’t they destroy until they had enough?

paite: Esau ka vuaktang sakta a, agukkhuhte ka hongta, abu thei nawn kei ding. Asuante hihsiat ahi ua, a-unaute, a-invengte toh a-omta kei.
english: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is destroyed, and his brothers, and his neighbors; and he is no more.

paite: Na tagahte limsak ke'n, ke'n ka hum ding, na meithaite'n kei hon muang uhen."
english: Leave your fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let your widows trust in me.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Nou dawn lou dingte'n leng adawn mawk uleh, nang gawt louh hial in na suakta ding a hia? Gawt louh in na pawt kei ding, na dawn mahmah ding hi.
english: For thus says Yahweh: Behold, they to whom it didn’t pertain to drink of the cup shall certainly drink; and are you he who shall altogether go unpunished? You shall not go unpunished, but you shall surely drink.

paite: TOUPA'N keimah kilou in ka kichiamta ngal a, Bozrah lamdangsak chiat, gensiat, hihgawp, hamsethuak ahi ding, akhua tengteng leng asegawp tawntung ding," achi hi.
english: For I have sworn by myself, says Yahweh, that Bozrah shall become an astonishment, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all its cities shall be perpetual wastes.

paite: TOUPA kiang a kipan thupuan ka zata, namte kiang ah sawltak sawl ahita, "Kikaikhawm unla, amah sual unla, kidou ding in kuan un!
english: I have heard news from Yahweh, and an ambassador is sent among the nations, saying, Gather yourselves together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

paite: Ngai in, mihingte muhsit in namte lak ah nang ka hon neusakta hi.
english: For, behold, I have made you small among the nations, and despised among men.

paite: Na kihih mulkimhuaina tak na lungtang kisathei in ahon khemna ahi, aw nang kawl suangkal a, mualvum a teng zel, mu bang in, sangpi ah bu sep mah lechin, huai a kipan in ka hon lakhesuk ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: As for your terror, the pride of your heart has deceived you, O you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, who hold the height of the hill: though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from there, says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Edom bel lamdang asak uh ahong hi ding a, mi vialvak peuh in lamdang asa ding ua, asiat luat ziak in atekkhum ding uh.
english: Edom shall become an astonishment: everyone who passes by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all its plagues.

paite: Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akim a khopite hihsiat a om mah bang in, kuamah ateng nawn kei ding ua, mihing ta kuamah huai ah a-om ngei nawn kei ding uh.
english: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities of it, says Yahweh, no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man live therein.

paite: Ngai un, Jordan gam gammang a kipan a humpinelkai, gan khahna mun ah ahong tou ding a; amah a kipan amau ka taimangsak pah ding a, atung a thunei ding in ka ut-ut ka sep ding. Keimah bang kua ahia om? Kua'n ahia hunbi hon bikhiahsak ding? Belamchingmi kua ahia ka ma a dingh ding pen?
english: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoever is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd who will stand before me?

paite: Huaiziak in Edom tung a TOUPA thuhilh leh Teman mite tung a athilseh, hih atuppente ngaikhia un; ganhon nou neute ngei kaihmang in a-om ding ua; atenna uh ahihgawp ding hi.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely they shall drag them away, the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.

paite: Apuksiatna husa uah lei akising a; akah husa uh Tuipi san ah leng zak ahi ding.
english: The earth trembles at the noise of their fall; there is a cry, the noise which is heard in the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds .

paite: Ngai un, muvanlai bang in ahong lengtou ding a; Bozrah tung ah kha azak ding; huai ni in Edom mihangsante lungtang numei nauvei lungtang bang lel ahi ding hi.
english: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread out his wings against Bozrah: and the heart of the mighty men of Edom at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

paite: Damaskas thu: Hamath zumta, Arpad toh, thuhoih lou azata ngal ua, azulta uh; tuipi kihot om kinken thei lou bang in abuai uh.
english: Of Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad; for they have heard evil news, they are melted away: there is sorrow on the sea; it can’t be quiet.

paite: Damaskas athazaw, taikek atum a, linna in alap a, lungkhamna leh natna in numei nauvei bang mai in alenta hi.
english: Damascus has grown feeble, she turns herself to flee, and trembling has seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken hold of her, as of a woman in travail.

paite: Ka nopsakna khopi, khopi minthang bangziak a nutsiat a om lou ahia?
english: How is the city of praise not forsaken, the city of my joy?

paite: Huchi in huai ni in atangval honte kongtual ah apuk ding ua, galdoumi tengteng amangthang ding uh, chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be brought to silence in that day, says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Damaskas kulhbaang ah mei ka khah ding a, Ben-hadad kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.
english: I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben Hadad.

paite: Kedar leh Hazor gamte Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in agawtna thu; TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Thou unla, Kedar sual unla, suahlam tate bawl ek un.
english: Of Kedar, and of the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon struck. Thus says Yahweh: Arise, go up to Kedar, and destroy the children of the east.

paite: Apuaninte uh, aganhonte uh alaksak ding ua, apuanzakte uh, atui-um belsuan tengteng uh, asangawngsaute uh apaimangpih ding uh, ning chih ah launa a-om a, chi in mite'n akikoukhum ding uh.
english: Their tents and their flocks shall they take; they shall carry away for themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry to them, Terror on every side!

paite: Taikek unla, vakmang vengveng un, tummang vengveng unla, Hazor a tengte aw, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in nang ahon sawm a, na tung ah hihtup aneita hi.
english: Flee, wander far off, dwell in the depths, you inhabitants of Hazor, says Yahweh; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.

paite: Thou unla, lungmuangtak a om, amah a khosa, kulh kongkhak leng nei lou, kalhna siktawn leng nei lou nam sual un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Arise, go up to a nation that is at ease, that dwells without care, says Yahweh; that have neither gates nor bars, that dwell alone.

paite: Asangawngsaute uh gal in ala ding ua, abawnghonte uh alok ding uh. Baksam metgiau honte ning chih ah ka dalhsak ding, asiatna ding uh ning chih a kipan in ka hon tun ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their livestock a spoil: and I will scatter to all winds those who have the corners of their beards cut off; and I will bring their calamity from every side of them, says Yahweh.

paite: Huan Hazor bel sihna tenna mun ahi ding a, asegawp tawntung ding, huai ah kuamah ateng nawn kei ding uh, mihing tate a-omta kei ding uh.
english: Hazor shall be a dwelling place of jackals, a desolation forever: no man shall dwell there, neither shall any son of man live therein.

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah vaihawm pat tungna Elam tungtang a TOUPA thu, zawlnei Jeremiah kiang a hong tung;
english: The word of Yahweh that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning Elam, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, saying,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, Elam thalpeu, ahatna bulpi pen uh, ka kitansak ding;
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies: Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

paite: Kawlmong li a kipan in huih lite ka hon tun ding, Elam tung ah ka dalhsak ding, kawlmong chih ah, Elam delhkhiak mite phak louh nam a-om kei ding uh.
english: On Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of the sky, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation where the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

paite: Amelma uh, ahinna uh zong mite ma ah, Elamte ka lunglelsak ding, atung uah siatna ka hon tun ding, ka hehna thupitak, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Amau ka hihman vek masiah namsau ka delhsak ding hi.
english: I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before those who seek their life; and I will bring evil on them, even my fierce anger, says Yahweh; and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them;

paite: Akumpipate uleh aheutute uh hihmang in Elam ah ka laltutphah ka tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: and I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from there king and princes, says Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh ni nanungte ah hichi ahi ding, Elam omdan ka kiheisak ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: But it shall happen in the latter days, that I will bring back the captivity of Elam, says Yahweh.

paite: Jerusalem kholakte ah vialtai unla, chiamteh un! Amual tamte zong unla, mi khat bek diktattak a hih a, thutak zong mahmah na muh theih uleh, Jerusalem ka ngaidam ding.
english: “Run back and forth through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and know, and seek in the broad places of it, if you can find a man, if there are any who does justly, who seeks truth; and I will pardon her.

paite: "TOUPA ahin a ahin sung, chi mah le uh, zuau in akichiam lel uh ahi.
english: Though they say, ‘As Yahweh lives;’ surely they swear falsely.”

paite: Aw TOUPA, thutak na muhnop ahi kei a hia? Amau na sat a, himahleh alungkham tuan kei uh, amau na hihmang a, na thuzohna apom nuam tuan kei uh, suangpi sang a tak in atal uh ataksak ua, akilehhei nuam kei bikbek uhi.
english: O Yahweh, don’t your eyes look on truth? You have stricken them, but they were not grieved. You have consumed them, but they have refused to receive correction. They have made their faces harder than a rock. They have refused to return.

paite: "Ke'n, hiaite miphalou, ahai lai ua, TOUPA dan, a Pathian uh thugel athei kei uhi.
english: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the way of Yahweh, nor the law of their God.

paite: Miliante kiang ah ka hohta ding a, ka houpih ding a, amau zaw TOUPA dan leh Pathian thugelte athei uh," achi a. Himahleh hiai mite'n thukhat sat in, hakkol ahihtan ua, henna khau ahihtat uhi.
english: I will go to the great men, and will speak to them; for they know the way of Yahweh, and the law of their God.” But these with one accord have broken the yoke, and burst the bonds.

paite: Huaiziak in gammang nuai a humpinelkai in amaute akei ding a, gamdai ngia in amaute ane bei ding a, gialbem in akhopite a tang in, huai a hong pawt peuhmah abotzan ding; atatleknate uh atam a, anungkinnate uh athupi mahmah ziak in.
english: Therefore a lion out of the forest shall kill them, a wolf of the evenings shall destroy them, a leopard shall watch against their cities; everyone who goes out there shall be torn in pieces; because their transgressions are many, and their backsliding is increased.

paite: "Bangchi in ka hon ngaidam thei dia? Na tate'n ahon paisan ua, Pathian hiloupite sam in akichiam ua, taitak a ka vak nung in ang a kawm ua, kizuak innte ah akivel hehu uh.
english: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full, they committed adultery, and assembled themselves in troops at the prostitutes’ houses.

paite: Amaute zingsang a sakol vakvah bang mai ahi ua, michih ama invengpa zi enlah in aham hi.
english: They were as fed horses roaming at large: everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.

paite: Hiai thilte ziak in ka gawt kei ding maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Hichibang nam tung ah phu ka kilaksak kei ding a hia?
english: Shouldn’t I punish them for these things?” says Yahweh; “and shouldn’t my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

paite: Abaangte ah kaltou unla, hihsia un, himahleh hihse khin vek kei un, ahiangte lamang un, TOUPA a lah ahi ngal kei hi.
english: “Go up on her walls, and destroy; but don’t make a full end. Take away her branches; for they are not Yahweh’s.

paite: Israel inkote leh Judah inkote'n ka tung ah lepchiahtak in ahih uh," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have dealt very treacherously against me,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA bel zuauthei dia sep in, "Bangmah ahihthei sam kei ding, siatna i tung uah atung kei ding, kial hiam namsau hiam i thuak kei ding.
english: They have denied Yahweh, and said, “It is not he; neither shall evil come on us; neither shall we see sword nor famine.

paite: Zawlneite leng huihzam lel ahi ding ua, amau ah thu a-om kei a; atung uah hichibang a hih ahi ding,” achi uhi.
english: The prophets shall become wind, and the word is not in them. Thus shall it be done to them.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA, Sepaihte Pathian in achi: "Huchibang thu na gen ziak un, ngai in, na kam a ka thute mei ka suaksak ding a, hiai mipi singte akang khin ding.”
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh, the God of Armies, “Because you speak this word, behold, I will make my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them.

paite: Ngai un, aw Israel inkote aw, gamlapi a kipan, nam khat na kiang ah ka hon pi ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Nam hattak, nidanglai a kipan a, apau uh na theih louh, athugen uh na theih louh namte.
english: Behold, I will bring a nation on you from far, house of Israel,” says Yahweh. “It is a mighty nation. It is an ancient nation, a nation whose language you don’t know, neither understand what they say.

paite: Athalbawm uh han kihong ahi a, avek un mihattak ahi khin uh.
english: Their quiver is an open tomb, they are all mighty men.

paite: Na buhlaksa leh na nek ding ane khin vek ding uh; na tanute na tapate nek ding mahmah; na ganhonte, na belamhonte ane ding ua, na grep guite, na theipi kungte ane ding ua, na khopi kulh nei, na muanpi pente mahmah namsau in ahihse ding uhi.
english: They shall eat up your harvest, and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They shall eat up your flocks and your herds. They shall eat up your vines and your fig trees. They shall beat down your fortified cities, in which you trust, with the sword.

paite: "Himahleh huai nite ah leng ka hon hihchimit kei ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end with you.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, "Bangziak a ToUPA i Pathian un hiai thil tengteng i tung ua hih ahia?" Na mite un achih hun chiang un, "N'on paisan ua, na gam ua pathian dangte nna na sep bang un, na gam lou uah, paudang mite nna na sem ding uh, akiang uah na chi ding ahi."
english: It will happen, when you say, ‘Why has Yahweh our God done all these things to us?’ Then you shall say to them, ‘Just like you have forsaken me, and served foreign gods in your land, so you shall serve strangers in a land that is not yours.’

paite: "Jakob inkote lak ah hiai genkhia unla, Judah gam ah puang un.
english: “Declare this in the house of Jacob, and publish it in Judah, saying,

paite: Aw theihtheihna nei lou, mihaite aw, mit nei a lah mu lou, bil nei a lah zaloute aw, hiai ngaikhia un.
english: ‘Hear now this, foolish people, and without understanding; who have eyes, and don’t see; who have ears, and don’t hear:

paite: N'on kihta kei uh maw? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Ka ma ah na ling kei ding uh maw? Kei, tuipi huap chiang a dia piautak, tangtawn a aletlouhna ding a daikaihna, tuipi kihot zou mahleh alet tuan theih louh a, ging honhon mahleh akhen theih louh ding bawlpa ka hi.
english: Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea, by a perpetual decree, that it can’t pass it? and though its waves toss themselves, yet they can’t prevail; though they roar, yet they can’t pass over it.’

paite: Himahleh hiai mite'n genhakna leh helhat lungtang apu ua, ahel ua, ataimangta uh.
english: “But this people has a revolting and a rebellious heart; they have revolted and gone.

paite: Alungtang un leng, TOUPA i Pathian, ahuntak a vuah masa leh vuah nanung zusakpa, buh leh hunbi hon sehsakpa laudan i siam ding uh, achi sam kei uh.
english: Neither do they say in their heart, ‘Let us now fear Yahweh our God, who gives rain, both the former and the latter, in its season; who preserves to us the appointed weeks of the harvest.’

paite: Hiai thilte na thulimlouhnate un ahihmang a, na khelhnate un thil hoih nou ahon tansak ahi.
english: “Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withheld good from you.

paite: "Ka mite lak ah migilou a-om ngal ua, vasa gemmi in atan bang in atang gige ua, thang akam ua, mite aman uh.
english: For among my people are found wicked men. They watch, as fowlers lie in wait. They set a trap. They catch men.

paite: Bawm vasa a dim bang mai in, a-innte uh khemna in adim a, huaiziak in ahong lian ua, ahong hauhsak lohta uhi.
english: As a cage is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit. Therefore they have become great, and grew rich.

paite: Ahong thau ua, ahong zol ua, ahi, agitlouhna thilhihte un hun chiang anei kei, pa neiloute lamzanna ding in amau lam ah apang kei uhi.
english: They have grown fat. They shine; yes, they excell in deeds of wickedness. They don’t plead the cause, the cause of the fatherless, that they may prosper; and they don’t judge the right of the needy.

paite: "Hiai thilte ziak in ka gawt kei dia hia?" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. "Hichibang nam tung ah ka hinna in phu ala kei ding a hia?
english: “Shall I not punish for these things?” says Yahweh. “Shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

paite: Huai gam ah thillamdangtak leh mulkimhuaitak ahong tung hi.
english: “An astonishing and horrible thing has happened in the land.

paite: Zawlneite'n zuauthu agen ua, siampute'n lah amau thuthu in vai ahawm ua, ka mite'n lah huchibang hih a-ut uhi, atawp ah bangchi in na hih ding ua le?”
english: The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests rule by their own authority; and my people love to have it so. What will you do in the end of it?

paite: Babulon tungtang, Kaldai mite gam tungtang a zawlnei Jeremiah kam a TOUPA thugen:
english: The word that Yahweh spoke concerning Babylon, concerning the land of the Chaldeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.

paite: Namte lak ah gen unla, puang un, puanzak khai in, puang un, sel kei un, Babulon lak ahita. Bel azahlak a, Merodak mulkimna in adim a, milimte ase khinta.
english: Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is disappointed, Merodach is dismayed; her images are disappointed, her idols are dismayed.

paite: Mallam a kipan amah nam khat in ahon sual a, huai in agam ahihgawp ding a, huai ah kuamah ateng nawn kei ding ua; ataikek ua, mi leh sate leng amang khinta uhi.
english: For out of the north there comes up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they are fled, they are gone, both man and animal.

paite: Huai nite in leh huai hun chiang in Israel suante ahong pai ding ua, amau leh Judah tate toh; kap kawm in ahong pai ding ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh azong ding uh; chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: In those days, and in that time, says Yahweh, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Judah together; they shall go on their way weeping, and shall seek Yahweh their God.

paite: Zion lam nga in akalsuanna ding uh adong ding ua, "Kisa un, tangtawn thukhun mangngilh nawn lou ding in TOUPA hong len un," achi ding uh.
english: They shall inquire concerning Zion with their faces turned toward it, saying, Come, and join yourselves to Yahweh in an everlasting covenant that shall not be forgotten.

paite: Ka mite zaw belam mang ahi ua; amau ching mite'n apimang ua, mualte ah apaimangsak ua, tang a pan mual dungte ah apai ua, ahuang uh amangngilh khinta uhi.
english: My people have been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray; they have turned them away on the mountains; they have gone from mountain to hill; they have forgotten their resting place.

paite: Amu peuh in ane zel ua, amelmate un, i gilou kei, TOUPA dikna omna apipute uh lamet TOUPA hilhial tung a thil ahihkhelh ziak ahi, achi uhi.
english: All who found them have devoured them; and their adversaries said, We are not guilty, because they have sinned against Yahweh, the habitation of righteousness, even Yahweh, the hope of their fathers.

paite: Babulon sung a kipan in taikhia unla, Kaldaite gam a kipan paikhia un, kelhon lak a keltalte bang in om un.
english: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.

paite: Ngai dih ua, Babulon hong sual ding in mal gam a kipan nam honpi thupitak kikaikhawm ka tokthou ding a, amah dou ding in akisa ding ua; huai a kipan in lak ahi ding uh; athalte uh lah galbawl siamtak vuaksuak ngei lou bang ahi ding uh.
english: For, behold, I will stir up and cause to come up against Babylon a company of great nations from the north country; and they shall set themselves in array against her; from there she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of an expert mighty man; none shall return in vain.

paite: Huan Kaldai loh in a-om ding, alok mite atai ngial ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Chaldea shall be a prey: all who prey on her shall be satisfied, says Yahweh.

paite: Kipak mah le uchin, nuamsa mah le uchin, aw ka goutan lok mite aw, lou lak a bawngla takhialkhial bang leh sakoltal ham ngekngek bang himah le uchin;
english: Because you are glad, because you rejoice, O you who plunder my heritage, because you are wanton as a heifer that treads out the grain, and neigh as strong horses;

paite: Na nu uh ahong zum mahmah ding a, nou hon suangnu ahong zahlak ding hi. Ngai un, namte lak a nuainungpen, gamdai, gamkeu, gamvuak ahi ding.
english: your mother shall be utterly disappointed; she who bore you shall be confounded: behold, she shall be the least of the nations, a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

paite: TOUPA hehna ziak in luahmi a-om kei ding a, ase vek zaw ding hi, Babulon hoh peuhmah amulkimsak ding a, asiatna tengteng ziak in atek ding uhi.
english: Because of the wrath of Yahweh she shall not be inhabited, but she shall be wholly desolate: everyone who goes by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

paite: Thalpeu tawimi tengteng aw, Babulon umsuak in kivual unla, kap unla, thalte chil kei un, TOUPA tung ah akhialta uhi.
english: Set yourselves in array against Babylon all around, all you who bend the bow; shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she has sinned against Yahweh.

paite: Akimvel in awng unla, amah-le-amah akipeta, akulhte apukta a, abaangte achimta, TOUPA phulakna ahi ngal a, atung ah phu la unla, ahih bangbang in atung ah hih un.
english: Shout against her all around: she has submitted herself; her bulwarks are fallen, her walls are thrown down; for it is the vengeance of Yahweh: take vengeance on her; as she has done, do to her.

paite: Babulon a kipan chi thehmi attan unla, buhlak lai a kawite tawimi toh, nuaisiahna namsau lau in amau mite lam azuan chiat ding ua, amau gam chiat ah atai ding uh.
english: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him who handles the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn everyone to his people, and they shall flee everyone to his own land.

paite: Israel bel belam dalhzak ahi a; humpinelkaite'n adelhmang ua; Assuria kumpipa'n amah ane phot a, atawp in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in aguhte ahaizanta hi.
english: Israel is a hunted sheep; the lions have driven him away: first, the king of Assyria devoured him; and now at last Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, Assuria kumpipa ka gawt bang in Babulon kumpipa leh agam ka gawt ding.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

paite: Huan Israel agantatna ah ka pi nawn ding a, Karmel leh Bashan ah ata ding a, Ephraim tang ah leh Gilead ah amah ata ding hi.
english: I will bring Israel again to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.

paite: Huai nite leh huai hun chiang in Israel thulimlouhnate azong ding ua, muh ding a-om kei ding; Judah thilhihkhelhte leng muh ding a-om sam kei ding; omsun ding a ka koihte ngaidam ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: In those days, and in that time, says Yahweh, the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Judah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I leave as a remnant.

paite: Merathim gam sual un, agam leh Pekod luah mite mahmah that unla, hihgam sipsip un, thu ka hon piak bangbang in hih un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: kill and utterly destroy after them, says Yahweh, and do according to all that I have commanded you.

paite: Huai gam ah gal husa a-om, siatna thupi mahmah husa toh.
english: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

paite: Khovel pumpi sek kitam in, nak keknen hi na tel e; namte lak ah Babulon kinaksiat hi na mai e!
english: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut apart and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

paite: Aw Babilon, nang ding in thang na kam a, thei lou a awk na hita ve; muhkhiak leh mat in na omta, TOUPA na sual ziak in.
english: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, Babylon, and you weren’t aware: you are found, and also caught, because you have striven against Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N agalvan bawm ahongta, ahehna vanzatte alakhia a, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Kaldaite gam ah hih ding anei hi.
english: Yahweh has opened his armory, and has brought forth the weapons of his indignation; for the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldeans.

paite: Gamgi tawp pek a kipan in hon sual unla, athil koihkhawmna innte hong vek unla, paikhawm un, hihse vek unla, abangmah hawi kei un.
english: Come against her from the utmost border; open her storehouses; cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly; let nothing of her be left.

paite: Abawngtal tuaite that vek unla, goh in om uhen. Atung uh gik hi na tel e! Ani uh, amaute gawtna ni mahmah ahong tungta hi.
english: Kill all her bulls; let them go down to the slaughter: woe to them! for their day has come, the time of their visitation.

paite: TOUPA i Pathian phulak, atempul phulakna ngei Zion a gen ding a Babulon a kipan a taikhete leh taimangte husa ngei.
english: The voice of those who flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahweh our God, the vengeance of his temple.

paite: Babulon sual ding in thalkap siam, thalpeu zangmi tengteng samkhawm un; akimvel in buk bawl unla, kuamah suakta kei uhen. Athilhih bangbang in thuk un, ahihsa bang tengteng amah tung ah hih un; TOUPA, Israel Mi Siangthou lah achou ngam hi.
english: Call together the archers against Babylon, all those who bend the bow; encamp against her all around; let none of it escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she has done, do to her; for she has been proud against Yahweh, against the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Huaiziak in akholakte ah tangvalte apuk ding ua, galkapmi tengteng huai ni in amangthang ding uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Therefore her young men will fall in her streets, and all her men of war will be brought to silence in that day, says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai in, nang mikisathei, ka hon dou ahi, Toupa, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi hi. Na ni ahong tungta, na gawtna ding ni mah,
english: Behold, I am against you, you proud one, says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies; for your day has come, the time that I will visit you.

paite: Huan mikisathei akisui in apuk ding a, kuamah in aphong kei ding ua, akhopite ah mei ka khah ding a, akimvel a om tengteng ka kangsiangsak vek ding.
english: The proud one shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up; and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all who are around him.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Israel suante leh Judah tate nuaisiah in a-om khawmta ua; sal a amaute pi mite tengteng in amau alen tinten ua, akhah nuam kei uhi. Amaute tanpa bel ahat a; amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies: The children of Israel and the children of Judah are oppressed together; and all who took them captive hold them fast; they refuse to let them go.

paite: Amah amau lam ah apang a, Babulon a tengte hihbuai in, leitung a khawlna atuttheihna ding in.
english: Their Redeemer is strong; Yahweh of Armies is his name: he will thoroughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the earth, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

paite: Kaldai mite tung ah namsau aleng hi, Babulon a tengte, aheutute uh leh amipilte uh tung ah leng, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: A sword is on the Chaldeans, says Yahweh, and on the inhabitants of Babylon, and on her princes, and on her wise men.

paite: Mizuautheite tung ah namsau, mihai ahong suak ding uh; agalkapmi tung ah namsau, alunglel khin ding uh.
english: A sword is on the boasters, and they shall become fools; a sword is on her mighty men, and they shall be dismayed.

paite: Asakolte uh leh kangtalaite uh tung ah namsau, asung a mi kilak hel tengtengte tung ah leng, numei bang phet ahong hi ding uh; agou thil tung ah namsau lok in a-om maimai ding uhi.
english: A sword is on their horses, and on their chariots, and on all the mixed people who are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is on her treasures, and they shall be robbed.

paite: Atuite kang in akeu khin a, milimte gam lah ahi ngal a, milimte lah ahailoh uhi.
english: A drought is on her waters, and they shall be dried up; for it is a land of engraved images, and they are mad over idols.

paite: Huaiziak in gamdai gam sahangte, ngiate toh huai ah ateng ding ua, ostrikte leng huai ah ateng ding uh; luah in a-om ngei nawn kei ding; suan tengteng pha in leng luah in a-om kei ding hi.
english: Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves shall dwell there, and the ostriches shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited forever; neither shall it be lived in from generation to generation.

paite: Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah leh akho invengte ahihsiat bangbang in; huai ah kuamah atengta kei ding ua, mihing tapa kuamah in aveh nawnta kei ding uh, TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: As when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbor cities of it, says Yahweh, so shall no man dwell there, neither shall any son of man live therein.

paite: Ngai un, mallam gam a pan mite ahong ua, mun tawp a kipan nam thupitak leh kumpipa tampi ahong kuan uhi.
english: Behold, a people comes from the north; and a great nation and many kings shall be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

paite: Thalpeu leh tei atawi ua, hiamgamtak, zahngaihna nei lou ahi uh. Ahusa uh tuipi ging huhu bang ahi a, sakol tung ah atuang ua, michih galkapmi bang a kivan in, Babulon tanu aw, nang ahong sual ding uhi.
english: They lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roars like the sea; and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.

paite: Ahusa uh za in Babulon kumpipa khut azawgawpta a, numei nauvei lai natna bang in, natna thupitak in amanta hi.
english: The king of Babylon has heard the news of them, and his hands wax feeble: anguish has taken hold of him, pains as of a woman in labor.

paite: Ngai un, Jordan gammang a kipan humpinelkai, kahna mun a ahong tou bang in ahong paitou ding a; amah a kipan in amaute ka taimangsak pah ding; atung a thunei ding ka ut-ut ka sep ding. Kei bang kua a-om a! Kua'n sep ding. Kei bang kuakua a-om a? Kua'n ahia hunbi hon sehsak ding? Belamchingmi kua ahia ka ma a dingh ding?
english: Behold, the enemy shall come up like a lion from the pride of the Jordan against the strong habitation: for I will suddenly make them run away from it; and whoever is chosen, him will I appoint over it: for who is like me? and who will appoint me a time? and who is the shepherd who can stand before me?

paite: Huaiziak in Babulon tung ah TOUPA thuhilh, Kaldai mite tung a athilseh ngaikhia un. Ganhon noute ngei kaihmang in a-om ding ua, gan khahna mun a mite amulkimsak ding.
english: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahweh, that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely they shall drag them away, even the little ones of the flock; surely he shall make their habitation desolate over them.

paite: Babulon lakna husa ah lei aling ding a, akahna husa namte lak a zak ahi ding hi.
english: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth trembles, and the cry is heard among the nations.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai dih, Babulon leh Kaldai mite tung ah, hihse ding huihpi ka sawl ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against those who dwell in Lebkamai, a destroying wind.

paite: Zapsiangmi ka sawl ding, Babulon tung ah, amah zap in agam azapsiang ding ua, siatna ni a um a sual ding ahi ngal ua.
english: I will send to Babylon strangers, who shall winnow her; and they shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her around.

paite: Thalpeu zangmi in thalpeu lai a, sik puanak silh in, dingh heh, tangvalhon khat leng hawi lou in, asepaih tengteng nuaimang un.
english: Against him who bends let the archer bend his bow, and against him who lifts himself up in his coat of mail: and don’t spare her young men; utterly destroy all her army.

paite: Kaldai gam ah thah in apuk ding ua, akholakte uah sut pailet in a-om ding uhi.
english: They shall fall down slain in the land of the Chaldeans, and thrust through in her streets.

paite: Israel leh Judah, agam uah Israel Mi Siangthou tung ah khelhna in adim na ua, a Pathian uh sepaihte' TOUPA'N amangngilh kei hi.
english: For Israel is not forsaken, nor Judah, of his God, of Yahweh of Armies; though their land is full of guilt against the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Taimang unla, Babulon khosung a kipan, michih in amah hinna humbit hen; athulimlouhna manloh kei un, TOUPA phulak hun ahi ngal a, ama'n athuk ngeigngei ding hi.
english: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and save every man his life; don’t be cut off in her iniquity: for it is the time of Yahweh’s vengeance; he will render to her a recompense.

paite: Babulon bel TOUPA khut a dangka-eng nou, leitung pumpi hihkhamna ahi a, namte'n kham in alung uh amawl khinta hi.
english: Babylon has been a golden cup in Yahweh’s hand, who made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunk of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

paite: Babulon apuk guih a, amangta, amah kah ekek un, hihdam theihdan ding ahihleh singnai damdawi nuhchi laksak un.
english: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: wail for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

paite: Babulon hihdam ka tum a, adam tuan kei, amah nusia in eimah gam chiat uah pai ni, amohna in van asun a, van dum pha a dopkang ahi.
english: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go everyone into his own country; for her judgment reaches to heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

paite: "TOUPA'N ka dikna apuangta; kisa un, TOUPA i Pathian thilhih, Zion ah i puang ding uh.
english: Yahweh has brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of Yahweh our God.

paite: "Thalte tat-hiam unla, lumte len un, Media kumpipate lungsim TOUPA'N atokthouta a, athiltup Babulon hihsiat ahi. Huai TOUPA'N atempul ziak a phulakna ahi.
english: Make sharp the arrows; hold firm the shields: Yahweh has stirred up the spirit of the kings of the Medes; because his purpose is against Babylon, to destroy it: for it is the vengeance of Yahweh, the vengeance of his temple.

paite: Babulon kulh bul ah kidouna puangzak thak un, venna hihhat in, galvilmi koih un, galbuknate bawl unla, Babulon mite tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N agen tak, angaihtuah in ahih khinta hi.
english: Set up a standard against the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set the watchmen, prepare the ambushes; for Yahweh has both purposed and done that which he spoke concerning the inhabitants of Babylon.

paite: Aw nang, tui tamna mun a tengmi, sum-le-pai hau mahmah, na tawpna atungta, na hinna khau akitanta hi.
english: You who dwell on many waters, abundant in treasures, your end has come, the measure of your covetousness.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA amah kilou in achiamta hi, khaupete bang mai in mihing in ka hon dimsak ngeingei ding, nakpi in ahon otkhum ding uh."
english: Yahweh of Armies has sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill you with men, as with the canker worm; and they shall lift up a shout against you.

paite: Athilhihtheihna in lei abawl a, apilna in khovel adingkhesak a, alemtheihna in van aphalhsak.
english: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he stretched out the heavens:

paite: A-aw asuah a, van a tui aging hawhaw a, kawlmong a kipan meipi apaitousak a, vuah zukna ding in khua aphesak a, agoubawm a kipan huih anungsak hi.
english: when he utters his voice, there is a tumult of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightning for the rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasuries.

paite: Michih amual ua, theihna lou in, dangka-eng sekmichih in alimsek pen azumpih ua, amilim sun lah zuau ngen ahi a, amau ah nakna a-om kei lai hi.
english: Every man has become brutish without knowledge. Every goldsmith is disappointed by his image; for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

paite: Bangmah lou, khemna nasep lel ahi ua, agawt hun chiang in amang ding uh.
english: They are vanity, a work of delusion: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

paite: Jakob tantuan bel hichibang ahi kei, thil tengteng bul ahi ngal a; Israel agouluah nam ahi a, amin sepaihte' TOUPA ahi.
english: The portion of Jacob is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and is the tribe of his inheritance: Yahweh of Armies is his name.

paite: Nang bel ka galdouna heipi leh vanzat na hi a, nang hon zang in namte ka hihzan a, nang zang in lalna gamte ka hihmang hi.
english: You are my battle axe and weapons of war: and with you will I break in pieces the nations; and with you will I destroy kingdoms;

paite: Nang hon zang in sakol leh atung a ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in kangtalai leh atung a tuang ka hihzan a;
english: and with you will I break in pieces the horse and his rider;

paite: Nangmah zang in numei leh pasal ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in putek leh tuailai ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in nungak leh tangval ka hihzan hi.
english: and with you will I break in pieces the chariot and him who rides therein; and with you will I break in pieces man and woman; and with you will I break in pieces the old man and the youth; and with you will I break in pieces the young man and the virgin;

paite: Nangmah zang in belamching leh belamhon ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in louneimi leh bawngtal kop ka hihzan a, nangmah zang in gam ukpipate leh upate ka hihzan sek ahi.
english: and with you will I break in pieces the shepherd and his flock; and with you will I break in pieces the farmer and his yoke; and with you will I break in pieces governors and deputies.

paite: Nang mitmuh ngei in Zion tung a athil hoih lou hih tengteng uh Babulon leh Kaldai mite tung ah ka thuk ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will render to Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai in, leitung pumpi hihsia, aw hihsetu tang lian, nang ka hon dou ahi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Na tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, kawl sang a kipan ka hon khukkhe ding, tang kang mit khinsa in ka hon bawl ding.
english: Behold, I am against you, destroying mountain, says Yahweh, which destroys all the earth; and I will stretch out my hand on you, and roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burnt mountain.

paite: Nang a kipan suang ning ding leh suangphum ding lakkhiak ahi nawn kei ding; tangtawn in na segawp zaw ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: They shall not take of you a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but you shall be desolate for ever, says Yahweh.

paite: "Huai gam ah kidou puanzak tak unla, namte lak ah pengkul mut un, amah dou ding namte kisasak unla, Araratte, Minnite, Ashkenaz gamte, amah sual ding sepaih sep unla, khaupe zuanzaang bang mai in sakolte kaikhawm un.
english: Set up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz: appoint a marshal against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough canker worm.

paite: Amah dou ding namte kisasak un; Media kumpipate, ukpipate leh upate, athuneihna gam tengteng toh.
english: Prepare against her the nations, the kings of the Medes, its governors, and all its deputies, and all the land of their dominion.

paite: Huai gam nat thuak in aling a, Babulon gam, tengmi om lou a hihsiat ding in, Babulon tung a TOUPA thiltup adingh gige hi.
english: The land trembles and is in pain; for the purposes of Yahweh against Babylon do stand, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, without inhabitant.

paite: Babulon galdou mite'n galkap ding ngapta lou in, akulhpi uah aton maimah uh, apasalphatna uh akhing a, numei bang mai ahong hita ua, atenna munte akang khin a, adeidanna siktawn akitan hi.
english: The mighty men of Babylon have forborne to fight, they remain in their strongholds; their might has failed; they are become as women: her dwelling places are set on fire; her bars are broken.

paite: Thangkou tai in midang leng akituahpih a, misawl in leng midang atuak a, Babulon kumpipa kiang a akhopi ning chih ah amanta uh chih hilh ding in.
english: One runner will run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to show the king of Babylon that his city is taken on every quarter:

paite: Lui kannate aman ua, phailuangte ahal siang ua, kidou mite leng alunglelta uh.
english: and the passages are seized, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are frightened.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Babulon tanu phual sikngil lai bang ahi a, sawt lou nung in buhchil hun atung ah ahong tung ding hi."
english: For thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: The daughter of Babylon is like a threshing floor at the time when it is trodden; yet a little while, and the time of harvest shall come for her.

paite: "Hon negaita, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in, hon haizan a, bel vuak lel in ahon bawlta, gulpi bang in ahon nawmvalhta, ka thil limte'n agilpi adimsak a, ahon paikhe nawnta hi.
english: Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me, he has crushed me, he has made me an empty vessel, he has, like a monster, swallowed me up, he has filled his maw with my delicacies; he has cast me out.

paite: Kei leh ka satung a hiamgam thilhih, Babulon tung ah om hen; ka sisan Kaldai mite tung ah om hen, Jerusalem in achi ding."
english: The violence done to me and to my flesh be on Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and, My blood be on the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, nang lam ah ka pang ding a, na phu ka hon laksak ding, atuipi ka kangsak ding a, atuikhuk leng ka keugawsak ding.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh: Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you; and I will dry up her sea, and make her fountain dry.

paite: Huan Babulon bel hoih lou paihkhawm lel, sehal tenna mun, lamdangsak chiat leh enghou, tengmi om lou mun ahong hi ding.
english: Babylon shall become heaps, a dwelling place for jackals, an astonishment, and a hissing, without inhabitant.

paite: Akikou ton ding ua, humpinelkai lun lai bang in, angik tuaktuak ding uh; humpinelkai nou bang in.
english: They shall roar together like young lions; they shall growl as lions’ cubs.
