paite: Akham mahmah lai un ankuang ka luisak dia, khothei het lou in ka khamsak dia, khanglou het lou ding a a-ihmut dettheihna ding un, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: When they are heated, I will make their feast, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, says Yahweh.

paite: Ka pikhe ding a, belam goh ding bang in, belamtalte leh keltalte bang mai in."
english: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with male goats.

paite: Shesak lak ahita ve; leitung pumpi pahtawi zel mat in a-omta ve, namte lak ah Babulon asegawpta ve.
english: How is Sheshach taken! and the praise of the whole earth seized! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

paite: Babulon tuipi in atumta, akihot thupi mahmah in akhuh khinta.
english: The sea has come up on Babylon; she is covered with the multitude of its waves.

paite: Akhopi asegawpta a, gamkeu, gamdai, mihing tenlouhna mihing ta kuamah phak louh gam ahong suakta hi.
english: Her cities are become a desolation, a dry land, and a desert, a land in which no man dwells, neither does any son of man pass thereby.

paite: Babulon bel ka gawt ding, avalhkhitsa akam a kipan asuahkhe ding, namte bel akiang ah aluangkhawm nawn kei ding uh, ahi Babulon kulhpi achim ding.
english: I will execute judgment on Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up; and the nations shall not flow any more to him: yes, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

paite: Ka mite aw, asung a kipan hong pawt unla, TOUPA hehna lauhuai mahmah a kipan, michih amau kihumbit chiat un.
english: My people, go away from the midst of her, and save yourselves every man from the fierce anger of Yahweh.

paite: Na lungtang uh bah kei hen, huai gam a thuthang leng lau kei un; kum khat in thuthang ahong tung ding a, kum dang in thuthang ahong tung nawn ding ahi, kumpipa leh kumpipa kisual in gam ah hiamgamna a-om ding.
english: Don’t let your heart faint, neither fear for the news that shall be heard in the land; for news shall come one year, and after that in another year shall come news, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi. Babulon milim sektawmte tung a vai ka hawm a, agam pumpi zumna ni ding; huan, asung ah amithahte apuk ding uh.
english: Therefore behold, the days come, that I will execute judgment on the engraved images of Babylon; and her whole land shall be confounded; and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

paite: Huchi in lei leh van leh asung a om tengteng in, Babulon tung a kipak in la asa ding uh; mallam a kipan sim mite akiang a tung ding uh ahi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers shall come to her from the north, says Yahweh.

paite: Babulon in Israel mithahte apuksak bang in Babulon ah gam chih a thah a omte apuk ding uh.
english: As Babylon has caused the slain of Israel to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the land.

paite: Nou namsau pel mite aw, kuan unla, dingh maimai kei un, gamlapi a kipan in TOUPA theigige unla, na lungsim uah Jerusalem lut hen.
english: You who have escaped the sword, go, don’t stand still; remember Yahweh from afar, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

paite: Gensiatna thu ka zak ziak un ka zum ua, lungdonna in ka mai uh atuam a, TOUPA' inn a mun siangthoute ah pau theih louh mite ahong lutta uhi.
english: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach; confusion has covered our faces: for strangers have come into the sanctuaries of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, amilim sektawmte uh tung a ka vaihawmna ding leh agam pumpi tung a miliamte thumna ni ding ngei.
english: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will execute judgment on her engraved images; and through all her land the wounded shall groan.

paite: Babulon bel van sun in sang mahleh, akulh sangte hihkip mahleh, atung ah ka kiang a kipan hihsemi ahong tung ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Though Babylon should mount up to the sky, and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall destroyers come to her, says Yahweh.

paite: Babulon a kipan kah husa leh Kaldai gam a kipan siatna thupitak husa;
english: The sound of a cry from Babylon, and of great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans!

paite: TOUPA'N Babulon asim a, ahusa uh thupitak ahih daihsak hi. Agamtat husa uh tui tampi ging hawhaw bang ahi, a- awng zuazualua.
english: For Yahweh lays Babylon waste, and destroys out of her the great voice; and their waves roar like many waters; the noise of their voice is uttered:

paite: Atung ah simmi ahong tung, Babulon tung ngei ah pang ni, amihatte mat in a-om ua, athalpeute uh akitangawpta, TOUPA bel thukna Pathian ahi a, athuk ngeingei ding.
english: for the destroyer has come on her, even on Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, their bows are broken in pieces; for Yahweh is a God of recompenses, he will surely requite.

paite: Huan aheutute leh amipilte, a-ukpipate leh upate leh mihatte ka khamsak dia; alumden ding ua, akhanglou kei ding uh, chih, kumpipa, Sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will make drunk her princes and her wise men, her governors and her deputies, and her mighty men; and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake up, says the King, whose name is Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Babulon kumpipa kulhbaang sahtakte achim vek ding a, akongpi sangte akang vek ding; amite'n athawn in asem ua, namte'n meihal a ding lel a kihihgim uh ana hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies: The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly overthrown, and her high gates shall be burned with fire; and the peoples shall labor for vanity, and the nations for the fire; and they shall be weary.

paite: Judah kumpipa Zedekiah vaihawm akum lina a Babulon ahoh lai a akiang a hoh sam, Seraiah Neriah tapa, Maaseiah tapa kiang a zawlnei Jeremiah thupiak.
english: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah to Babylon in the fourth year of his reign. Now Seraiah was chief quartermaster.

paite: Seraiah bel kumpipa insung heutupen ahi a, Jeremiah in Babulon tung a siatna hong tung ding tengteng, Babulon tungtang a hiai thu gelh tengteng laibu ah agelh hi.
english: Jeremiah wrote in a book all the evil that should come on Babylon, even all these words that are written concerning Babylon.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in Seraiah kiang ah, Babulon na tun hun chiang in hiai thu tengteng sim ngeingei inla,
english: Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come to Babylon, then see that you read all these words,

paite: Aw TOUPA hiai nam tungtang ah kuamah, mi leh sa leh tenlouhna ding suksiat a om in, tangtawn a kisegawp zaw ding in thu na genta a, na chi ding.
english: and say, Yahweh, you have spoken concerning this place, to cut it off, that none shall dwell therein, neither man nor animal, but that it shall be desolate forever.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi ding a, hiai laibu na sim khit chiang in suang toh gakkhawm in Euphrates Luipi ah pailut inla,
english: It shall be, when you have made an end of reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of the Euphrates:

paite: Babulon hichibang mai in atum ding a, atung a siatna ka hon tut ding ziak in athounawn kei ding; abah mahmah ding uh, chi in na gen ding ahi, achi a. Hichi teng Jeremiah thu ahi.
english: and you shall say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.

paite: Zedekiah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawmnih leh kum khat a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum sawm-le-khat vai ahawm a; anu min Hamutal ahi a, Libnah a Jeremiah tanu ahi.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and his mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

paite: Jehoiakim hih bangbang in TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih hi.
english: He did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

paite: TOUPA aheh mahmah ziak in Jerusalem leh Judah gam ah ama a kipan a paihkhiakna khop in thil ahong tungta a; huchi in Babulon kumpipa tung ah Zedekiah ahelta hi.
english: For through the anger of Yahweh it happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

paite: Huan avaihawm akum kuana ah hichi ahong hi a, kha sawmna, huai kha ani sawm ni in Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar leh asepaihhonte Jerusalem dou ding in ahong kuan ua, buk abawlkhumta ua; akim ah kulh abawl uhi.
english: It happened in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa Zedekiah kum sawm-le-khatna tan in khopi um in a-omta hi.
english: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.

paite: Akha lina, huai kha ani kuana ah khopi ah kial ahong uang mahmah a, gam mipite a ding in nek ding a-omta kei hi.
english: In the fourth month, in the ninth day of the month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

paite: Huchi in khopi kulhbaang asunvang ua, kidoumi tengteng ataimang ua, kumpipa huan a baang nih kikal a kongpi a pawt in, zan in khopi a kipan ataikhia ua; Kaldai mite' khopi a om ahi uhi.
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled, and went forth out of the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden; (now the Chaldeans were against the city all around;) and they went toward the Arabah.

paite: Himahleh Kaldai sepaihte'n kumpipa adelh ua, Jeriko Phaizang ah Zedekiah apha ua, sepaihhonte akiang a kipan adalhzak uhi.
english: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

paite: Huchi in Zedekiah aman ua, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Hamath gam a Riblah ah apaipih ua; ama'n atung ah vai ahawmkhum hi.
english: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath; and he gave judgment on him.

paite: Babulon kumpipa'n Zedekiah tapate amitmuh ngei in athat a; Riblah ah Judah heutu tengteng leng athat lai hi.
english: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes: he killed also all the princes of Judah in Riblah.

paite: Zedekiah mit akhelkhia a, Babulon ah apaipih hi; asih ni tanpha in suangkul ah akoih hi.
english: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.

paite: Huan kumpipa vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan, amah Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar ma a dingh sek, akum sawm-le-kuana, akha ngana, huai kha ani sawmna in Jerusalem ah ahong lut hi.
english: Now in the fifth month, in the tenth day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, who stood before the king of Babylon, into Jerusalem:

paite: TOUPA’ inn leh kumpipa' inn ahal a, Jerusalem inn tengteng toh, inn thupi chitengte mei in ahal hi.
english: and he burned the house of Yahweh, and the king’s house; and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burned he with fire.

paite: Huan Kaldai sepaihhon tengteng, kumpipa vengpa pawl heutu kiang a omte'n Jerusalem kulhte akimvel in ahihchim vek uhi.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls of Jerusalem all around.

paite: Huchi in vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in mipi lak a genthei pawl khenkhat khopi a nutsiat a omte, Babulon kumpipa kiang a kipesate leh mikhutsiam omsun tengtengte toh sal in apivekta hi.
english: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the poorest of the people, and the residue of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who fell to the king of Babylon, and the residue of the multitude.

paite: Himahleh vengpa pawl heutu Nebuzaradan in gam a migenthei pen khenkhatte grephuan kemmi leh vengmi ding in anusia hi.
english: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to be vineyard keepers and farmers.

paite: TOUPA' inn a dalkhuamte leh akingaknate, dal maiphiat kuang lian TOUPA' inn a omte Kaldai mite'n ahihtamgawp ua, dal tengteng Babulon ah ala uhi.
english: The Chaldeans broke the pillars of brass that were in the house of Yahweh, and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the house of Yahweh in pieces, and carried all the of their brass to Babylon.

paite: Belte leng, vutluahte, khawnvak mihsaknate, maiphiat kuangte, sikkeute, dal tui-um belsuan tengteng a zat sekte uh ala vek uh.
english: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the spoons, and all the vessels of brass with which they ministered.

paite: Noute leng, meivu koihnate, maiphiat kuangte, belte, khawnvak koihnate, sikkeute leh belhbute; dangka-eng a bawl huai dangkasik in vengmi pawl heutu in ala vek hi.
english: The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lampstands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, in gold, and that which was of silver, in silver.

paite: Khuam nih, dal a bawl bawngtal sawm-le-nih, maiphiatna kuang kingakna, kumpipa Solomon in TOUPA' inn a dia abawl, hiai tui-um belsuan tengteng dalte tamdan teh vual ahi kei hi.
english: They took the two pillars, the one sea, and the twelve bronze bulls that were under the bases, which king Solomon had made for the house of Yahweh. The brass of all these vessels was without weight.

paite: Huan khuamte khuam khat sandan, tong sawm-le-giat ahi a, tong sawm-le-nih in akimvel zou phet ahi; asahdan zung za delh ahi a, asung ahawm hi.
english: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits; and a line of twelve cubits encircled it; and its thickness was four fingers. It was hollow.

paite: Atung ah dal lubawk a-om a, alubawk sandan tong nga ahi a, alubawk kimvel leh theibuhfai, dal ngen a zep ahi a; khuam nih in leng hichi mah bang in theibuhfai a-om hi.
english: A capital of brass was on it; and the height of the one capital was five cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital all around, all of brass: and the second pillar also had like these, and pomegranates.

paite: Asik ah theibuhfai sawmkua-le-guk a-om a, akim a azepna theibuhfai tengteng zakhat ahi.
english: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates were one hundred on the network all around.

paite: Huan vengpa pawl heutu in siampu lianpen Seraiah leh siampu nihna, Zephaniah leh kongkhak ngakmi thumte aman hi.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold:

paite: Kidou mite tung a heutu dia seh michilgeh leh mi sagih, kumpipa mel mu sekmi, khopi a omte leh sepaih heutu gelhmi, gam mite min kempa leh gam mipi lak a mi sawmguk, khopi a na omte khopi a kipan in apikhia hi.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and seven men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe of the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the midst of the city.

paite: Nebuzaradan, vengpa pawl heutu in amaute api a, Babulon kumpipa kiang ah Riblah ah atun hi.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

paite: Babulon kumpipa'n Hamath gam a Riblah ah atung ua khut kha in, athat vek hi. Huchi in Judah nam agam ua kipan in sal a pimang in a-omta.
english: The king of Babylon struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

paite: Hiaite Nebukadnezzar in mipi sal a apite ahi uh; akum sagihna ah Juda mite sangthum sawmnih-le-thum;
english: This is the people whom Nebuchadnezzar carried away captive: in the seventh year three thousand twenty-three Jews;

paite: Nebukadnezzar kum sawm-le-giatna ah Jerusalem a kipan in mi zagiat sawmthum-le-nih sal in api hi.
english: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar he carried away captive from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;

paite: Nebukadnezzar akum sawmnih-le-thumna ah Nebuzaradan vengtu pawl heutu in Juda saltang mi zasagih sawmli-le-nga api a, saltang tengteng avek un sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: in the three and twentieth year of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive of the Jews seven hundred forty-five persons: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.

paite: Kumpipa saltan kum sawmthum-le-sagihna, akha sawm-le-nihna, huai kha ani sawmnih-le-nga ni geih in hichi ahong hi a, Babulon kumpipa Evil-merodak in avaihawm akum khatna ah, Judah kumpipa Jehoiakin lutang adopkangsak a, suangkul a kipan apikhia hi.
english: It happened in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the first year of his reign, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison;

paite: Akiang ah hoihtak in apau a, Babulon a akiang a om Kumpipate tutphah sang a sang in laltutphah atunsak hi.
english: and he spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

paite: Asuangkul puansilhte akikhengsak a, adamsung teng ama ah an ane den hi.
english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life:

paite: Huan amah vakna ding adamsung ni tengteng, asih ni tan in aniteng tantuan Babulon kumpipa'n ape gige hi.
english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him by the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

paite: Benjamin tate aw, Jerusalem sung a kipan na bitna ding un taimang unla; Tekoa ah pengkul mut unla Beth-hakkerem ah theihsakna suaksak un. Mallam a kipan in siatna ahong kuan hi, hihsiatna thupi mahmah.
english: “Flee for safety, you children of Benjamin, out of the midst of Jerusalem, and blow the trumpet in Tekoa, and raise up a signal on Beth Haccherem; for evil looks forth from the north, and a great destruction.

paite: Zion tanu melhoihtak leh noutak ka hihmang ding.
english: The comely and delicate one, the daughter of Zion, will I cut off.

paite: Belampute, abelamhonte uh toh akiang ahong tung ding ua, akim ah apuaninte uh akaihkhum ding ua, amau mun chiat ah ake ding uh.
english: Shepherds with their flocks shall come to her; they shall pitch their tents against her all around; they shall feed everyone in his place.”

paite: Amah dou ding in kisa un, thou unla, sun lai in i sual ding uh, ei a ding in khawk hi na e! Ni akihekta a, nitaklam limliap ana sauta hi.
english: “Prepare war against her; arise, and let us go up at noon. Woe to us! For the day declines, for the shadows of the evening are stretched out.

paite: Thou unla, zan in i sual mai ding uh! A-inn hoihhoih uh hihsia ni.
english: Arise, and let us go up by night, and let us destroy her palaces.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Asingte phuk unla, Jerusalem sualna ding in mualvum bawl un, khopi gawt ding pen hiai ahi, asung ah nuaisiahna ngen ahi.
english: For Yahweh of Armies said, “Cut down trees, and cast up a mound against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.

paite: Tuileh in tui apawtsak bang mai in agitlouhna apawtsak sek, asung ah hiamgamna leh kilohna a-om chih zak ahi, ka ma ah natna leh kiliamsaknate a-om nilouh hi.
english: As a well casts forth its waters, so she casts forth her wickedness: violence and destruction is heard in her; before me continually is sickness and wounds.

paite: Ka lungsim in ahon nutsiat vengveng ma in aw, Jerusalem, pilvang in, huchi lou in zaw luahmi nei lou gam dia hon bawl in, ka hon hihgawp kha ding hi."
english: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you; lest I make you a desolation, a land not inhabited.”

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Israel khosuaksunte grep bang in lou siang vek unla, grep lou mi bang in ahiangte ban tuantuan un.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, “They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”

paite: "Angaihkhiak theihna ding un kua ka houpih in, kua ka theisak dia? Ngai in, bil lam zeksum louh ahi ua, angaikhe thei kei uh; ngai in, TOUPA thu amau a ding in thil simmohhuai ahi a, kipahna mahmah anei nawn kei uh.
english: To whom shall I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, the word of Yahweh has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA hehna in ka dim a, ka kidek zou nawn kei; kholak a naupang tung ah ka bungkhe dia; tangval omkhawmte tung ah leng, azi toh kiton in pasal leng lak ahi ding a, upate leh teksiate leng.
english: Therefore I am full of the wrath of Yahweh. I am weary with holding in. “Pour it out on the children in the street, and on the assembly of young men together; for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him who is full of days.

paite: A-innte uh midang kiang a piak ahi ding a, aloumate uleh azite uh toh; huai gam a tengte tung ah ka khut lik ding ka hi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Their houses shall be turned to others, their fields and their wives together; for I will stretch out my hand on the inhabitants of the land, says Yahweh.”

paite: Aneupen a kipan alianpen tan in leng michih huaihamna in adim ua; zawlneite leh siampute nangawn leng, michih azuautat mahmah uhi.
english: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.

paite: Ka mite liamna, awlmoh loutak buaipih in, muanna a-om louh laitak in Muanna, muanna, achi ua.
english: They have healed also the hurt of my people superficially, saying, ‘Peace, peace!’ when there is no peace.

paite: Thilkihhuai ahih un leng azum ua hia? Zum lou hial, azum het kei uh, amai uh leng asan sam kei; huaiziak in pukte lak ah apuk tei ding ua; amaute ka gawt hun chiang in paihkhiak in a-om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? No, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush. Therefore they shall fall among those who fall; at the time that I visit them, they shall be cast down,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Lamka thuam ah dingh unla, en un, lampi hoih omna lampi luite tawn un, huai ah pai unla, na kha uh a ding in khawlna na mu ding uh," amau bel, "Huai ah ka pai kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you will find rest for your souls. But they said, ‘We will not walk in it.’

paite: Huan nou a ding in galvil mite ka sep ding a, "Pengkul ging ngaikhia un," chi in; amau bel, “Ka ngaikhe kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: I set watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the sound of the trumpet!’ But they said, ‘We will not listen!’

paite: Huaiziak in "Aw, namte aw, ngaikhia unla, aw, kikhawmte aw, atung ua hong tung ding thei un.
english: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, congregation, what is among them.

paite: Aw, leitung, ngaikhia in, ngai in, hiai mite tung ah siatna ka hon tun ding; angaihtuahna gahte uh; ka thute angaihkhiak louh ziak un; ka dante lah apaikhe hithet ua.
english: Hear, earth! Behold, I will bring evil on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not listened to my words; and as for my law, they have rejected it.

paite: Bangziak a Sheba a kipan begaw, gamlapi a kipan kawltute ka kiang hong tung nak ahia? Na halmang kithoihnate uh kipahpihtak ahi kei a, na kithoihnate un ahon kipaksak sam kei hi.
english: To what purpose comes there to me frankincense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices pleasing to me.”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Hiai mite kiang ah puknate ka koih ding a, huai ah pate atapate uh toh apukkhawm ding ua, inveng leh alawm leng amangthang ding uh," chi in.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh, “Behold, I will lay stumbling blocks before this people. The fathers and the sons together shall stumble against them. The neighbor and his friend shall perish.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai in, mallam gam a kipan mite ahong pai uh, lei mun tawp a kipan nam thupi mahmah ahong kuankhia hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation shall be stirred up from the uttermost parts of the earth.

paite: Thalpeu leh teipi atawi ua, hiamgam mahmah, zahngaihna himhim nei lou ahi uhi, ahusa uh tuipi ging honhon bang ahia; sakol tungte ah atuang ua, michih galkapmi bang a kivan in, aw, Zion tanu, nang ahong sual dek uhi," chi in.
english: They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Zion.”

paite: "Aminthanna uh i za ua, i khutte azaw khinta, numei nauvei lunggimna bangbang lunggimna'n ahon manta hi.
english: We have heard its report; our hands become feeble: anguish has taken hold of us, and pains as of a woman in labor.

paite: Gam ah paikhe kei un, lampi ah leng pai sam kei un, huai ah lah melma namsau a-om ngal a, kil chih ah launa a-om hi."
english: Don’t go forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and terror, are on every side.

paite: "Aw, ka mi, ka tanu, sai-ip puan teng inla, vut lak ah tubial in; tapa tang khat suun bang in suun inla, kap vongvong dih, i tung uah hihsemi ahong tung guih dek ngal ua.
english: Daughter of my people, clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation; for the destroyer shall suddenly come on us.

paite: Ka mite lak a chiamtehmi ding leh ze-etmi ding in ka hon bawl a, a-omdan uh na theih a, na ze-et theihna ding in.
english: “I have made you a tester of metals and a fortress among my people; that you may know and try their way.

paite: Avek un genhaktak a helhat, gensiat ching a vialvak, dal leh sik bang ahi uh, hoihloupi in agamtang uhi.
english: They are all grievous rebels, going about with slanders; they are brass and iron: they all of them deal corruptly.

paite: Pum in azap huhu a, mei ah asuan zulbei a, hihsiangthou tupna athawn lel ahi; migiloute lah paihmang ahi ngal kei ua.
english: The bellows blow fiercely; the lead is consumed of the fire: in vain do they go on refining; for the wicked are not plucked away.

paite: Mite'n dangkasik ek hoih lou achi ding uh, TOUPA'N amaute apampaih ziak in," achi hi.
english: Men will call them rejected silver, because Yahweh has rejected them.”

paite: TOUPA a pan a Jeremiah kiang a thu hong tung:
english: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, saying,

paite: "TOUPA' inn kongpi ah dingh inla, huai ah hiai thu puang inla, hichi in chi in; Nou Judah mi tengteng, TOUPA be ding a hiai kongpi a lutte'n TOUPA thu ngaikhia un."
english: “Stand in the gate of Yahweh’s house, and proclaim there this word, and say, ‘Hear the word of Yahweh, all you of Judah, who enter in at these gates to worship Yahweh.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh bawlhoih unla, hiai mun ah ka hon tengsak ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

paite: Hiai, "TOUPA tempul, TOUPA tempul, TOUPA tempul ahi," chih zuauthute gingta kei un.
english: Don’t trust in lying words, saying, Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, Yahweh’s temple, are these.

paite: "Na omdan uleh na thilhihte uh na bawlhoih petmah ua, mi leh invengte kikal a thu diktak a na vai hawmsak ua,
english: For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings; if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;

paite: namdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite na nuaisiah louh ua, hiai mun a midiktat sisan na suah louh ua, na hoihlouhna ding ua pathian dangte na delh sam kei ualeh,
english: if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your own hurt:

paite: hiai gam, tuma lam a na pipute uh kiang a ka piak ah tangtawn in ka hon tengsak ding hi.
english: then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, from of old even forevermore.

paite: Ngai un, zuauthu, phattuamna om het lou na gingtazaw ua.
english: Behold, you trust in lying words, that can’t profit.

paite: Gukgu in, tualthat in, angkawm in, zuau a kichiam in Baal kiang a gimlim hal in, pathian dang, na theih ngeilouhte uh na delh uhi.
english: Will you steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have not known,

paite: Hiai inn, ka min mahmah a loh ah ka ma ah hong ding in, hiai thilkihhuai tengtengte hih zel kawm in, hotkhiak ka hita, na chi ding ua hia?
english: and come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered; that you may do all these abominations?

paite: Hiai inn ka min mahmah a loh, na mitmuh un suamhatte kokhuk bang lel ahi hia? Ngai un, kei, kei mahmah in ka mu hi, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, I, even I, have seen it, says Yahweh.

paite: Atung a ka min ka tensakna, ka mun Shiloh ah hoh dih ua, ka mi Israel gitlouhna ziak a ka thilhih va en un.
english: But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I caused my name to dwell at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Israel.

paite: Tu in hiai thil tengteng na hih ua, phalvak a thou a na kiang ua thu ka gengente na ngaihkhiak louh ua, nou ka hon sap a, na dawn louh ziak un;
english: Now, because you have done all these works, says Yahweh, and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you didn’t hear; and I called you, but you didn’t answer:

paite: Shiloh tung a ka hih bang in hiai ka min lohna inn, noumau leh na pipute uh kiang a ka mun piak, na muan uh tung ah ka hih dek ahi.
english: therefore will I do to the house which is called by my name, in which you trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Shiloh.

paite: Na unau tengteng uh, Ephraim nam pumpi nangawn ka paihkhiak bang in ka mitmuh a kipan nou ka hon paikhe ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brothers, even the whole seed of Ephraim.

paite: "Huaiziak in hiai mite a ding in thum ke'nla, kikoukhia in thum ke'nla, ka kiang ah leng ngetsak sam ke'n; ka hon ngaikhe kei ding hi.
english: Therefore don’t pray for this people, neither lift up a cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me; for I will not hear you.

paite: Judah khopite a leh Jerusalem kholakte a athilhih uh na mu kei a hia?
english: Don’t you see what they do in the cities of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

paite: Naupangte'n sing atom ua, apate un mei atoh ua, numeite'n van kumpinu kiang a lat ding tanghou amek ua, pathian dangte ding in dawn ding thillat atungkhia ua, ahon hehsakna lel ding un.
english: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead the dough, to make cakes to the queen of the sky, and to pour out drink offerings to other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

paite: Kei ahi maw hon hehsak uh?" chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; amau zumna ding in amau ahi zaw kei uh maw?
english: Do they provoke me to anger? says Yahweh. Don’t they provoke themselves, to the confusion of their own faces?

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Ngai dih uh, hiai mun tung ah ka hehna leh thangpaihna ka sungkhe ding a; akang dia, amit kei ding.
english: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh: Behold, my anger and my wrath shall be poured out on this place, on man, and on animal, and on the trees of the field, and on the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: "Na kithoihnate uah halmang kithoihnate behlap unla, sa ne un.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel: Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices, and eat meat.

paite: Halmang thillat hiam, kithoihnate hiam tungthu ah zaw na pipute uh kiang ah thu ka gen kei a, Aigupta gam a kipan ka pikhiak lai in leng thu ka pe sam kei.
english: For I didn’t speak to your fathers, nor command them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:

paite: Ka aw ngaikhia unla, na Pathian uh ka hi ding a, nou leng ka mite na hi ding uh; na hoihtheihna ding un na omdan ding uh ka hon hilh tengteng zui un, chi in thu ka pe zaw hi.
english: but this thing I commanded them, saying, Listen to my voice, and I will be your God, and you shall be my people; and walk in all the way that I command you, that it may be well with you.

paite: Himahleh angaikhe kei ua, bil adoh sam kei uh; alungtang gilou ua angaihtuah uh zui in a-om zaw uh, malam zot sang in anungtawn zawta uhi.
english: But they didn’t listen nor turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

paite: Na pipute uh Aigupta gam a kipan apawt ni ua kipan a tuni tan in ka nasemmi, zawlnei tengtengte phalvak a thou in na kiang uah niteng in ka sawl zel a,
english: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt to this day, I have sent to you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:

paite: himahleh ahon ngaikhe tuan kei ua, bil adoh sam kei uh; alungsim uh akhauhsak ua, apipute uh sang in agilou zawta uhi.
english: yet they didn’t listen to me, nor inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff: they did worse than their fathers.

paite: "Hiai thu tengteng akiang ua na gen ding ahi; himahleh ahon ngaikhe kei ding ua; amau na sam ding a, ahon dawng kei ding uh.
english: You shall speak all these words to them; but they will not listen to you: you shall also call to them; but they will not answer you.

paite: Akiang uah, 'Hiai nam TOUPA a Pathian uh aw ngaikhe lou a, thununna tang lou nam ei ve ua, na chi ding a; thudik amangthangta, akam ua kipan paihmang ahita.
english: You shall tell them, This is the nation that has not listened to the voice of Yahweh their God, nor received instruction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

paite: Na sam tan inla, paimang in, mun sang giaute ah kapkhia in; TOUPA'N ahehna khang paikhia in anawlkhinta hi.'
english: Cut off your hair, and throw it away, and take up a lamentation on the bare heights; for Yahweh has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

paite: "Judah tate'n lah ka mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ngal uh chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; ka min lohna inn ninsak ding in athilkihhuaite uh akoih khin uhi.
english: For the children of Judah have done that which is evil in my sight, says Yahweh: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to defile it.

paite: Atanute uh, atapate uh hal ding in Ben Hinnom Phaizang ah Taphet mun sangte abawl ua; huaite ka thupiak ahi kei a, ka lungsim ah leng alut ngei sam kei.
english: They have built the high places of Topheth, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I didn’t command, nor did it come into my mind.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai dih uh, nite ahong tung dek," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi. Huai phaizang pen Tophet, chih ahi nawn kei ding a, Ben Hinnom Phaizang, chih leng ahi sam kei ding a Kithahna Phaizang chih ahita ding; Tophet ah avui ding ua, vuina ding mun a-omta kei ding.
english: Therefore behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that it shall no more be called Topheth, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of Slaughter: for they shall bury in Topheth, until there is no place to bury.

paite: Mite luang tung a leng vasate leh gamsate an ahi ding; kuamah in adelhmang kei ding uh.
english: The dead bodies of this people shall be food for the birds of the sky, and for the animals of the earth; and none shall frighten them away.

paite: Judah khopite ah leh Jerusalem kholakte ah nuamsa husate leh kipahna gingte, mouneipa awte, mou awte leng ka daisak ding; agam segawp ding ahi ngal a.
english: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Judah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride; for the land shall become a waste.

paite: Huai hun chiang in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; Judah kumpipate guhte, aheutute guhte, siampute guhte, zawlneite guhte, Jerusalem a tengte guhte ahan ua kipan alakhe ding ua;
english: At that time, says Yahweh, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves;

paite: nite, khate, van a om tengteng, a-it ua, nna asep ua, adelh ua, azon ua, chibai abukte uh ma ah aphoukhe ding uh; lakkhawm ahi nawnta kei ding ua, vui ahi sam kei ding uh; leitung a ekvut lel ding ahi ding.
english: and they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the army of the sky, which they have loved, and which they have served, and after which they have walked, and which they have sought, and which they have worshiped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried, they shall be for dung on the surface of the earth.

paite: Hiai inkuan gilou mahmah om lai sung tengteng, ka hawlzakna mun a omlaite'n hin sang in sih atel zaw ding uh, chih sepaihte' TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue that remain of this evil family, that remain in all the places where I have driven them, says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huai lou leng akiang uah huchi in na gen ding hi, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mi apuk un athounawn kei ding ua hia? Mi avakmang in ahong kik nawn kei dia hia?
english: Moreover you shall tell them, Thus says Yahweh: Shall men fall, and not rise up again? Shall one turn away, and not return?

paite: Bang achia hiai Jerusalem mite, tangtawn a nungtawn ding a atolhpuk uh? Khemna alenkip ua, kik nawn a-ut kei uh.
english: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

paite: Ka bildoh in ka ngaikhia a, kuamah in thudik agen kei uh, kuamah in, "Bang ahia ka hih?" chi in athulimlouhna uh akisik sam kei uh; michih in amau lampi anga chiat uh; kidouna mun a sakol dianglut bang mai in.
english: I listened and heard, but they didn’t speak aright: no man repents him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? everyone turns to his course, as a horse that rushes headlong in the battle.

paite: Ahi, van a tuivapi in ahunbite athei a, vakhute, lensiamte, tuivanelkaite, ahun geihgeih in ahong tung zel uh. Ka mite'n bel TOUPA thukhendante athei kei uh.
english: Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times; and the turtledove and the swallow and the crane observe the time of their coming; but my people don’t know Yahweh’s law.

paite: Bangchi in ahia, mipil i hi ua, TOUPA dan i kiang uah a-om, na chih uh? Ngai un, laigelhmi laigelhna zuauthei in, zuau in asuaksak zaw uhi.
english: How do you say, We are wise, and the law of Yahweh is with us? But, behold, the false pen of the scribes has worked falsely.

paite: Mipilte azum un alungdong ding ua, mat in a-om ding uh; ngai un, TOUPA thu apaikhia ua, amau ah bang pilna a-om a hia?
english: The wise men are disappointed, they are dismayed and taken: behold, they have rejected the word of Yahweh; and what kind of wisdom is in them?

paite: Huaiziak in azite uh midangte kiang ah ka pe ding a, aloute uh leng ahon neimi a dingte kiang ah; michih, aneupen a kipan athupipen tan in en hat ahi uhi. Zawlnei a kipan a siampu tan in leng michih khemhat ahi uhi.
english: Therefore will I give their wives to others, and their fields to those who shall possess them: for everyone from the least even to the greatest is given to covetousness; from the prophet even to the priest every one deals falsely.

paite: Ka tanu, ka mite liam awlmoh loutak in, muanna om lou napi, "Muanna, muanna," chi in athoih uhi.
english: They have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

paite: Thilkihhuai ahih un azum uhia? Ii, azum het kei ua, amel uh leng asan kei. Huaiziak in pukte lak ah apuk tei ding ua, amaute gawt hun chiang in paihkhiak in a-om ding uh chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among those who fall; in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, says Yahweh.

paite: Amau ka hihmang vek ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; grep guite agah kei ding a, theipi kungte agah sam kei ding; anah leng avuai ding a, amaute tummang dingte ka sep khinta hi.
english: I will utterly consume them, says Yahweh: no grapes shall be on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

paite: Bangziak a tulai lai i hi ua? Kikaikhawm unla, khopi kulh neite ah lut unla, huai ah i mangthang diam ding uh; TOUPA tung a i gitlouh tak ziak in; TOUPA i Pathian un gutui dawn ding hon pia in manthatna ah ahon koih hi.
english: Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the fortified cities, and let us be silent there; for Yahweh our God has put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against Yahweh.

paite: Muanna i zong ua, hoihna bangmah ahong tung kei, hihdamna hun ding leng, ngai in, lungdonna lel!
english: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of healing, and behold, dismay!

paite: Asakol nak ging uh Dan a kipan a zak ahi a, asakol uh ham ging in gam pumpi aling a, ahong tung ua, asung a om teng, agai vek ua, khopi leh asung a tengte toh.
english: The snorting of his horses is heard from Dan: at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones the whole land trembles; for they have come, and have devoured the land and all that is in it; the city and those who dwell therein.

paite: Ngai un, na lak uah gulpi ka sawl ding a, gulgu nei, khoizual vuallouhte; huaite'n nou ahon tu ding ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For, behold, I will send serpents, adders, among you, which will not be charmed; and they shall bite you, says Yahweh.

paite: Aw lungkhamna ah kilungmuan thei leng aw! Sunggil ah ka lungtang abah khinta hi.
english: Oh that I could comfort myself against sorrow! My heart is faint within me.

paite: Ngai un, gam gamlapi a kipan, ka mite tanu kah husa, Zion ah TOUPA a-om kei a hia? Asung a akumpipa om lou ahi maw? milim bawltawmte leh namdang milimte'n bang achia hon hehsak ahi ua?
english: Behold, the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land that is very far off: isn’t Yahweh in Zion? Isn’t her King in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their engraved images, and with foreign vanities?

paite: Buh lak hun akikhelta, nipi abeita, hotdam in i om kei lailai.
english: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

paite: Ka mite, ka tanu natna ah ka na a, ka suun a, lungdonna in ahon len hi.
english: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt: I mourn; dismay has taken hold on me.

paite: Gilead a singnai damdawi om lou hia? huai ah hihdam mi a-om kei a hia? bangziak a ka mite, ka tanu damthei lou ahia?
english: Is there no balm in Gilead? is there no physician there? why then isn’t the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

paite: Ka lu tui hi in, ka mit khitui nak hileh aw, ka mi, ka tanu thahte a ding in asun-azan in ka kap ding,
english: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

paite: Gamdai ah khualbuk nei thei leng aw! Ka mite paisan in om mangsan leng aw; angkawm hatmi ahi vek ngal ua, khemhat omkhawm lel ahi uh.
english: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

paite: Alei uh thalpeu bang in zuau in azang ua, gam ah akhanglian ua, thutak a khang lou in gilou lam ah akhang ua, kei hon thei lou in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood; and they are grown strong in the land, but not for truth: for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don’t know me, says Yahweh.

paite: Noumau inveng lak ah pilvang chiat unla, na unaute himhim uh muang kei un; unaute lah khemhat ahi ngal ua; invengte leng gensiat hat ahi uh.
english: Take heed everyone of his neighbor, and don’t trust in any brother; for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go about with slanders.

paite: Amau inveng chiat akhem ding ua, thudik agen kei ding uh; alei uh zuaugen akisinsak ua, thulimlouhna sem in agim uhi.
english: They will deceive everyone his neighbor, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies; they weary themselves to commit iniquity.

paite: Khem hat lak ah na teng a, akhemna uh ziak in kei ahon thei nuam kei uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: Your habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai un, amau ka tuisuaksak ding a, ka ze-et ding; ka mi, ka tanu ziak in bang dang ahia ka hihtak ding aw?
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?

paite: Alei uh sihna thal ahi a, khemna thu agen zel, mi'n kam in invengte kiang ah kituahna thu gen mahleh, alungtang ah amah atang giugiau hi.
english: Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart he lays wait for him.

paite: Hiai thilhihte ziak in ka gawt kei dia hia? chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; nam hichibang tung ah phu ka la kei dia hia?
english: Shall I not visit them for these things? says Yahweh; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

paite: Tangte a ding in ka kap dia, ka mau vungvung ding, gamdai loupa munte ka suun ding a, kuamah pai nawnlouhna ding a akat khit tak ziak in, mite'n ganta husa aza nawnta kei ding ua, tung a leng vasate leh gamsate leng ataikek ua, apaimangta uh.
english: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none passes through; neither can men hear the voice of the livestock; both the birds of the sky and the animals are fled, they are gone.

paite: Huan Jerusalem bel thil sia omkhawm lel in ka bawl dek a, sehalte tenna mun ahi ding; Judah khopite tengmi om lou in ka hingawn ding.
english: I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

paite: Hiai theisiam ding in mipil kua ahia? Puangkhe ding a TOUPA thugen na sang mi pen kua ahia? Bangziak in ahia gam asiat khit a, kuamah pailouhna ding a gamdai bang a akat khit?
english: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? Who is he to whom the mouth of Yahweh has spoken, that he may declare it? Why is the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that none passes through?

paite: Huan TOUPA'N, "Ka dan, ama ua ka koih apaisan ua, ka paukam suak amang kei ua, azui kei uh,
english: Yahweh says, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein,

paite: alungtang khauh uh zui a, apipute un asinsak uh Baalte adelh zawk tak ziak un;
english: but have walked after the stubbornness of their own heart, and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them;

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in hichi in achi: Ngai un, amau, hiai mite mahmah gamsai in ka vak ding a, tui kha leng ka dawnsak ding.
english: therefore thus says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

paite: Nam, amau leh apipute un leng atheih ngeilouhte lak ah ka dalhsak ding a; ka hihmanthat vek mateng namsau ka delhsak ding."
english: I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers have known; and I will send the sword after them, until I have consumed them.

paite: Sepaihte' ToUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngaihtuah unla, numei kap mite hong pai ding in sam un, numei kahsiamte hong pai ding in sam lai un.
english: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for the skillful women, that they may come:

paite: Hong kin uhenla, hong kahkhum peuhmah le uh, i khitui aluan a, i mitte ua tui apawttheihna ding in.
english: and let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

paite: Zion a kipan kah husa zak ahi ngal a, i naksiat khit takdan uh; gen ding i thei mahmah kei ua, i gam i paisan ziak uleh, i tennate apaihkhiak tak ziak un.
english: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we ruined! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.

paite: Aw nou numeite aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia unla, akamsuak thu na bil uah lut henla, na tanute uh kah sinsak un; michih in a-invengnu kiang ah suunna la.
english: Yet hear the word of Yahweh, you women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters wailing, and everyone her neighbor lamentation.

paite: I tawlet uahte sihna kal lut in i kumpipa' inn uahte alutta hi; inn polam a kipan naupang hihmang ding leh, kholak a kipan tangval hihmang ding.
english: For death has come up into our windows, it is entered into our palaces; to cut off the children from outside, and the young men from the streets.

paite: TOUPA thupawt in hichi in achi: Mi luangte gamlak ah ekvut bang in apuk ding ua, buh lami buhmaih bang in; kuamah in alakhawm kei ding, chi in.
english: Speak, Thus says Yahweh, The dead bodies of men shall fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester; and none shall gather them.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Mipil in apilna suang kei henla mihat in ahatna suang sam kei hen, mihau in asum-le-pai suang kei hen.
english: Thus says Yahweh, Don’t let the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, don’t let the rich man glory in his riches;

paite: Asuang peuhmah in hiai suang hen, Kei TOUPA, zahngaihna, vaihawmdikna, diktatna lei a zangpa ka hi chih atheih a, atheihsiamnatak; hiai thilte ka kipah lam ahi ngal a, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: but let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, says Yahweh.

paite: Ngai un, nite ahong tung hi, chih Toupa thupawt ahi, zeksum hi ngal, sum louh bang zaw ka gawt ding.
english: Behold, the days come, says Yahweh, that I will punish all those who are circumcised in uncircumcision:

paite: Aigupta, Judah, Edom, Ammon leh Moab, gamdai a teng, baksam metgiaute; hiai nam tengteng zeksumlouhte ahi ngal ua, Israel inkote tengteng leng lungtang a zeksumlouhte ahi uh.
english: Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that have the corners of their hair cut off, who dwell in the wilderness; for all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.

paite: Uz gam ah mi khat a-om a, amin Job ahi; amah mihoihkim leh tang ahi a, Pathian kihta a, hoih lou mudah ahi.
english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , and turned away from evil.

paite: Ama'n tapa sagih leh tanu thum anei hi.
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

paite: Aneih-le-lam leng belam sangsagih, sangawngsau sangthum, bawngtal zanga leh sabiltungnu zanga leh inkuan thupi mahmah ahi, huchi in hiai mipa suahlam tate tengteng lak a thupipen ahi.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

paite: Huan atapate akuan ua khat chiat inn ah, ani ni in ankuangluina anei ua; huchi in mi asawl ua asanggam numei thumte uh amau kiang a ne ding leh dawn ding in asamsak uhi.
english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-ankuanglui san laitak un, Job in mi asawl a amaute ahihsiangthou a, zingsang beltak in athou a, avek ua zah dungzui in halmang thillatte alan a: Job in, "Ka tapate'n thil ahihkhial un, alungtang un Pathian ahamsiat kha ding uh," achi hi. Hichibang in Job in ahih gige hi.
english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ma a Pathian tapate ahong kilak ni uh a-om a, alak uah Setan leng ahong pai hi.
english: Now it happened on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. that Satan also came among them.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Leitung langkhat langkhat tawn a, asung a sukvak-touvak ka hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ka sikha Job na ngaihtuah ngei hia? Amah bang a hoihkim leh mitang, Pathian kihta a hoih lou mudah lei ah lah kuamah a-om ngal kei a," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is none like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

paite: Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Bangmah lou dia Job in Pathian kihta ahi maw?
english: Then Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

paite: Amah kimvel in, a-inn kimvel in leh aneih tengteng kimvel in, ning chiteng ah umna na bawl kei maw? Akhut nasep na vualzawl a, gamsung ah aneih-le-lam apung hi.
english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

paite: Himahleh tu in na khut zankhia inla, aneih tengteng khoih in, huchi in na maitang ah nang ahon gense mai ding hi,” achi hi.
english: But put forth your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ngai in, aneih tengteng nang thu ahi; amah mah tung ah kia na khut kha ke'n," achi hi. Huchi in TOUPA ma a kipan in Setan akuankhia hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t put forth your hand.” So Satan went forth from the presence of Yahweh.

paite: Huan atapate leh atanute'n a-unaupa uh upapen inn a ne a uain adawn ni uh a-om a,
english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house,

paite: Job kiang ah sawltak khat hong pai in, "Bawngtalte'n lei alet ua, sabiltungte akiang ah agamta ua,
english: that there came a messenger to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

paite: Sheba mite'n amau adelh ua, apimang uh; ahi, namsau hiam in sikhate athat ua; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

paite: Huchi a thu agen lai in midang khat leng ahong a, "Van a kipan in Pathian mei akia a, belamte leh sikhate akangmang a, amau akangtum hi; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
english: While he was still speaking, there also came another, and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

paite: Huchi a thu agen lai in, midang khat ahong lai a, "Kaldai mite'n pawl thum abawl ua, sangawngsaute adelh ua, apimang uh, huan namsau hiam in sikhate athat ua; huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

paite: Huchi a thu agen lai in, midang khat mah ahong a, "Na tapate leh na tanute'n a-unaupa upapen inn a anek ua uain adawn lai un,
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house,

paite: ngai in gamdai a kipan in huih thupi ahong nung a, huai inn ning lite ahon nuai a, tangvalte tung ah achim a, asi uh: huan nang hilh ding in kei keleu ka suakta hi," achi hi.
english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

paite: Huchi in Job athou a, apuanak- tual abotkek a, asam ametsiang a, leitual kidenna in anei a, Pathian abeta hi.
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka nu sul a kipan vuaktang in ka hong a, huan vuaktang in ka kik ding, TOUPA'N apia a, huan TOUPA'N alamangta; TOUPA min phat in om hen," achi hi.
english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away. Blessed be the name of Yahweh.”

paite: Hiai tengteng ah Job in ahihkhial kei a, haihuaitak in Pathian leng amohsa kei hi.
english: In all this, Job did not sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

paite: "Ka kha in ka hinna achimtak a, ka utdan dan in ka phun ding; ka kha thangpaihna in thu ka gen ding.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

paite: Pathian kiang ah, Hon mohpaih ke'n; bangziak a hon kinakpih na hia hon theisak in, ka chi ding hi.
english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

paite: Na nuaisiah nang a dia hoih ahi maw, na khutte thilhih na muhsit a, giloute thugen tung a na maitai?
english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

paite: Sa mitte nei na hi hia, ahihkeileh mihing muh bang amu na hi hia?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

paite: Na nite mihing nite bang hi a, ahihkeileh na kumte mihing kumte bang,
english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

paite: Ka thulimlouhna na kan a, ka khelhna na nungdelh hi.
english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

paite: Ka gilou kei chih thei napi a, na khut a kipan hon suaktasak ding a-om louh?
english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

paite: "Na khutte'n ahon sek un ahon bawl kimvel sipsip ua; tu'n kihei in na hon hihse dia hia?
english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

paite: Theigige in, ka hon ngen ahi, tungman bang a na hon mekdan; leivui hon tun nawn ding na hi hia?
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

paite: Nawitui bang in na hon sungkhia in, nawituidat bang in na hon tok kei maw?
english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

paite: Vun leh sa in na hon tuam a, guhte leh thagui in na hon phankhawm hi.
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

paite: Hinna leh deihsakna na hon phal a, huan na hon vehna in ka kha ahawi hi.
english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

paite: "Himahleh hiai thilte na lungtang sung ah na sel a; hiai bel na tup ahi chih ka thei hi.
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

paite: Thil ka hihkhelhleh na hon chiamteh a, ka thulimlouhna a kipan na hon khah kei ding hi.
english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

paite: Ka gitlouhleh, ka tung agik hi; midiktat himah leng, ka lutang ka sangsak kei ding hi. Lungbuaina in ka dim a, huaiziak in ka gimthuakna en in.
english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still shall not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

paite: Ka lutang akiletsakleh, humpinelkai bang in nang na hon beng a, ka tung a na lamdandan na hon ensak nawn hi.
english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

paite: Kei kalh in na palainate na thaksak a, ka tung a na hehna na khangsak a; hon dou ding sepaihhon thak na hon sawl hi.
english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

paite: "Bangziak a sul a pan hon lakhia na hia? Na si in kuamah muh louh na hi leng.
english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me forth out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

paite: Om lou mah bangta ding hi ing a; sul a pan a han a puak a om ding hi ing.
english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

paite: Ka nite atom kei maw? Huchi ahihleh, tawp in, hon omsak maimai in, huchi a neukha a ka lungmuan theihna ding in.
english: Aren’t my days few? Cease then. Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

paite: Ka kik nawnlouhna a ka pai ma in khomialna gam leh sihna limliap gam mahmah ah.
english: before I go where I shall not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

paite: Mialna mah bang a, mialna sahna gam a: sihna limliap gam, dan himhim omlouhna, khovak khomial bang a a- omna mun ah.”
english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

paite: Huan Naamath mi Zophar in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Thu tampite dawn louh ding ahi a hia? Mi houlimna a dim siamtansak ding hia?
english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

paite: Na khemnate'n mite daisak ding hia? na simmoh chiang in, kuamah in nang hon zahlaksak lou ding uhia?
english: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, shall no man make you ashamed?

paite: Ka thuhilh asiangthou a, na mit uah ka siang hi, na chi ngal a.
english: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

paite: Himahleh Pathian in thugen maizenleh zaw, nang dem in amukte hongleh;
english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

paite: Huchi in pilna thugukte nang ahon ensak ding a, atheihna ah thuah tampi ahi chih, huaiziak in na thulimlouhna sang a tawmzaw na lak ah Pathian in nang ahon phut chih thei in.
english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

paite: "Zon in Pathian na mu thei diam; hoihkimna ah Bangkim hihthei na mu thei diam?
english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

paite: Van bang in asang a; bang na hihthei dia? Sheol sang in athuk a; bang na theithei dia?
english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. . What can you know?

paite: Huai a tehna lei sang in asauzaw a, tuipi sang in azazaw hi.
english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

paite: Paisuak henla, man henla, vaihawmna ah samleh, huchi in kua'n amah adal thei dia?
english: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

paite: Ama'n lah mi bangmah loute athei ngal a; ngaihtuah kei mahleh, thulimlouhna leng amu hi.
english: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

paite: Mihing theihsiamna bei in theihsiamna anei ding, mihing a sabiltungnou apian chiang in.
english: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

paite: "Na lungtang na koih dik a, amah lam a na khutte na zakleh;
english: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

paite: Na khut a thulimlouhna a-om a, gamlapi a na koihkhiak a, gitlouhna na puanin a na tensak keileh;
english: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

paite: Gensiatna ding om lou in na mai na daksak ding a; ahi, na kip ding a, na lau kei ding.
english: Surely then you shall lift up your face without spot; Yes, you shall be steadfast, and shall not fear:

paite: Na haksatna na mangngilh ding ziak in; tui luangmang bang in na theigige ding hi.
english: for you shall forget your misery. You shall remember it as waters that are passed away.

paite: Sun lai sang in na hinna achiangzaw ding a; khomial om mahleh, zingsang bang in na tangkhe ding hi.
english: Life shall be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it shall be as the morning.

paite: "Lametna a-om ziak in, na kipta ding hi; ahi, ama tanchin na zong ding a, muang in na khawlta ding hi.
english: You shall be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you shall search, and shall take your rest in safety.

paite: Lup leng na lum ding a, kuamah in nang hon lausak kei ding uhi; ahi, mi tampi'n nang hon zong ding uhi.
english: Also you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid. Yes, many shall court your favor.

paite: Himahleh gilou mitte azuausuak ding a, asuakta kei ding ua, alametna uh kha khah ahi ding hi."
english: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail. They shall have no way to flee. Their hope shall be the giving up of the spirit.”

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Ginlelh vual louh in mite zaw na hi peuhmah ua, nou toh pilna asi ding hi.
english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

paite: Himahleh noute bang in theihsiamna ka nei; nou sang in ka niamzaw kei, ahi, hiaite bang thilte kuan athei kei a?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

paite: Kei zaw mi invengte a dia nuihzabuk ka hi a, kei, huai Pathian sam a, huai ama'n amah adawnpa, midik, mihoihkim, nuihzabuk ka na hi.
english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

paite: Om nuam a om ngaihtuahna ah vangsiatna muhsitna a-om a; himahleh akhe uh teute a ding in mansa in a-om hi.
english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

paite: Suamhatte puaninte alohching a, Pathian hehsakte abit ua; akhut a pathian tawite Pathian in tampi apia hi.
english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their God in their hands.

paite: "Himahleh gamsate dong in, huchi in amau nang ahon sinsak ding uh; huan huihkhua a vasate'n, nang ahon hilh ding uhi.
english: “But ask the animals, now, and they shall teach you; the birds of the sky, and they shall tell you.

paite: Ahihkeileh lei kiang ah thu gen in nang ahon sinsak ding ua; tuipi a ngasate'n na kiang ah apuang ding uhi.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach you. The fish of the sea shall declare to you.

paite: Hiai tengteng ah, TOUPA khut in ahih khin chih kua ahia thei lou?
english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the hand of Yahweh has done this,

paite: Amah khut ah thil hing chiteng kha leh, mihing tengteng hatna a-om hi.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

paite: Bil in thute enchian in, Kam in ana chiam kei maw?
english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

paite: "Mi upate kiang ah pilna a-om a nite sauna ah theihsiamna a-om hi.
english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

paite: Amah kiang ah pilna leh hatna a-om; ama'n thupha leh theihsiamna anei.
english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

paite: Ngai in, akaipuk a, akilam nawn thei kei ding; mihing akhakbing a, kuama'n ahong thei kei ding.
english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

paite: Ngai in, tui aching a a akang hi; akhahkhia a, lei atum vek hi.
english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

paite: "Akiang ah hatna leh pilna a-om a; khem a omte leh khempa amah a ahi.
english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

paite: Thuhilh mite loh sam in apimang a, huan vaihawmte mihai in abawl hi.
english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

paite: Kumpipate kolte asut a, kawnggak in akawng uh agak hi.
english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

paite: Siampute loh sam in apimang a, mihatte azou hi.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

paite: Muan mite thugen asuan a, upate theihsiamna alamang hi.
english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

paite: Lalte tung ah muhsitna abuak a mihatte kawnggak aphel hi.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

paite: "Mial a kipan in thil thukte amukhia a, sihna limliap khovak ah ahon lakhia hi.
english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

paite: Namte apungsak a, amau hihsia in, namte athehzak a, alakhawm nawn hi.
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

paite: Lei a mite hausate lungtang alamang a, gamdai a lampi omlouhna ah amau avakvaisak hi.
english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

paite: Vakna bei in khomial ah amai ua, huchi in zukhammi bang in amaute ahoisak hi.”
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

paite: Ngai in, ka mit in hiai tengteng amu a, ka bil in huai za in atheisiamta hi.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

paite: Na thei uh, huai mah ke'n leng ka thei a, nou sang in ka niamzaw kei hi.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

paite: Bangkim hihthei kiang ah thu ka gen mahmah ding, Pathian toh houlim ka ut hi.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

paite: Himahleh nou zuau phuakte na hi ua, phattuamna bei damdawisiam na hi vek uhi.
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

paite: Aw na vek un dai sipsip le uchin maw; na pilna uh hi ding hiven.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

paite: "Tu in ka thusut za un, ka mukte ngetna ngaikhia un.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

paite: Pathian a ding in dikloutak in thu na gen ding uam, amah a ding in khemhattak in na houlim ding uam?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

paite: Ami na zahtak ding uam? Pathian a ding in na sual ding uam?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

paite: Nou ahon zonkhiak ahoih hia? Ahihkeileh mi'n mi akhem bang in, amah na khem ding uam?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

paite: Nou ahon sal mahmah ding, aguk a mite na zahtak uleh.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

paite: Ahoih tungtuanna in nou ahon lausak kei dia hia, nou tung ah akihtakhuaina ake kei diam?
english: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, And his dread fall on you?

paite: Na thupilte uh vut bang lel ahi, manna bei paunak ahi a, na kidalnate uh tungman kidalnate ahi.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defenses are defenses of clay.

paite: Dai unla, thu ka gentheihna ding in, hon omsak maimai un, ka tung ah ahong tung ding hong tung hen.
english: “Be silent, leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

paite: "Bangziak a ka ha in ka sa kei a, ka khut a ka hinna koih ding ahia?
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

paite: Ama'n hon that mahleh, amah ka ngak lai ding; ama ah ka lampite ka kemhoih lailai ding hi.
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

paite: Hiai leng ka hotdamna ahi ding; Pathian limsakloumi ama a hong pai lou ding ahih ziak in.
english: This also shall be my salvation, that a godless man shall not come before him.

paite: Ka thugen thanuamtak in za un, ka thupuanna na bil sung uah om hen.
english: Hear diligently my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

paite: Ngai un, tu in ka thu ka bawlhoihta a; ka diktat ahi chih ka thei hi.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

paite: "Kei hon kiselpih ding amah kua ahia? Kei tu in ka dai dia kha ka khah ding hi.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.

paite: Ka tung ah thil nih hih kei phot le uchin, huchi in na mai a kipan ka bu kei ding hi.
english: “Only don’t do two things to me; then I will not hide myself from your face:

paite: Kei a pan gamlapi ah na khut kaikik in; na lauhuaina in hon lausak ke'n.
english: withdraw your hand far from me; and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

paite: "Huai chiang in hon sam lechin, ka hon dawng ding; ahihkeileh hon pausak inla, hon dawng in.
english: Then call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and you answer me.

paite: Ka thulimlouhnate leh khelhnate bang ahia? Ka tatlekna leh ka khelhna hon theisak in.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

paite: Bangziak a na mai sel a na melma dia hon bawl na hia?
english: Why hide you your face, and hold me for your enemy?

paite: Singnah mutleng na hihbuai dia hia? Buhpawl keu na delh dia hia?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

paite: "Nang lah kei dem in khatak in na gelh a, ka tuailai thulimlouhnate na hon luahsak hi.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:

paite: Ka khete leng kol na bunsak a, ka lampite tengteng na chiamteh hi; ka khenuai kim ah gi na khung hi.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

paite: Mihing zaw thilmuat leh nget nekgawp puansilh bang in amangthang hi."
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

paite: "Mihing, numei a pan pian nite tomchik ahi a, buaina ngen in adim hi.
english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

paite: Pak bang in ahong dawnkhia a, avuai nawn pah a, limliap bang in atai a, a-om gige kei.
english: He comes forth like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

paite: Mi huchibang tung ah na mit hak in, vaihawmna ah kei na hon pi dia hia?
english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

paite: Thilnin a kipan kua'n ahia thilsiang lakhe thei? Kuamah in.
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

paite: Anite sehsa ahi chih thei in, na kiang ah akhate simna a-om a, akan thei louh ding in agamgite na septa hi.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass;

paite: Amah en ke'n, akhawltheihna ding in, kiloh bang a, ani ahihkim matan.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he shall accomplish, as a hireling, his day.

paite: "Phukpaih in om mahleh, ahong sel nawn ding a, ahiang nou atawp kei ding, chih sing a ding in lametna lah a-om ngal a.
english: “For there is hope for a tree, If it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

paite: Lei ah azung upa mahleh, akungpi lei ah sita mahleh;
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

paite: Tuigim ziak in ahong nou thak dia, sing suan bang in bawkte ahon neikhe nawn ding hi.
english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and put forth boughs like a plant.

paite: Mihing asi a, amang zel hi; ahi, mihing in akha akhah a, huan koi ah a-om a?
english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

paite: "Tuipi a kipan tuihute alenmang bang in, luipi bel atul a, akang hi.
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

paite: Huai mah bang in mihing alum a athou kei hi, vante a-om nawn louh matan, akhanglou kei ding uh, a-ihmu uh leng ahalh khe sam kei ding uhi.
english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they shall not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

paite: "Aw Sheol ah hon sel lechin aw, na thangpaihna aman masiah hon na gukkep lechin, hun sehsa hon na pia in, kei hon theigige lechin aw;
english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. , that you would keep me secret, until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time, and remember me!

paite: Mi sileh ahing nawn diam? Ka galdouna leh nasepna ni tengteng ka ngak ding a, ka suahtakna ahong tun matan in.
