english: If a man dies, shall he live again? All the days of my warfare would I wait, until my release should come.

paite: N'on na sam dia, k'on dawng ding hi, na khut nasep na hon lunggulh ding hi.
english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire to the work of your hands.

paite: Tu in ka kalsuante na sim a: ka khelhnate na chiamteh hi.
english: But now you number my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

paite: Ip sung ah ka tatlekna bilh in ni a-om a, ka thulimlouhna na gonggak hi.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

paite: "Tang kipuk bangmah lou ahong hi taktak a, amun a kipan in suangpi suan in a-om hi;
english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place;

paite: tuite'n suang akiamsak ua; leivui a kibawl mun sangte na taimang a; huan mihing lametna na hihsia hi.
english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

paite: Tangtawn in amah na zou a, apai a; amel na lamdangsak a, na sawlmang hi.
english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

paite: Atapate zah in a-om ua, ama'n athei kei; hihniam in a-om ua, himahleh ama'n amau ahi chih athei kei hi.
english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

paite: Himahleh atung a sa in natna anei a, asung ah akha in asuun hi."
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

paite: Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Mipil in theihna bangmah lou toh dawnna abawl in, suahlam huih in agilpi adimsak diam?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

paite: Houlimna phatuam lou thu angaihtuah in, ahihkeileh hoih ahihtheihlouhna ding a thugente angaihtuah diam?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

paite: Ahi, launa na hihmang a, Pathian ma a kipiakzohna na dal lai hi.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

paite: Na kam in na thulimlouhna asinsak a, khemhatmi lei na tel ngal a.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

paite: Nang mahmah kam in siam louh ahon tangsak a, kei hilou in; ahi, nang dem in nangmah mukte mah in hon theihpih hi.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

paite: "Mihing piang masapen hi hia? Ahihkeileh mualte om ma a lakkhiak na hi maw?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought forth before the hills?

paite: Pathian thuguk na zata hia? Huan pilna na kikoih hoih hia?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

paite: Ka theih louh uh bang na thei a? kou a om lou bang na theisiam a?
english: What do you know, that we don’t know? What do you understand, which is not in us?

paite: Ka lak uah samkang leh upa mahmah a-om tuaktuak, na pa sang a nakpi a upazaw.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.

paite: "Pathian nepnate leh siamtak a hon hilhte nang a dia neu lua uhia?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

paite: Bangziak a na lungtang in nang hon pimang ahia? Bangziak a na mitte phia ahia?
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

paite: Huchi a Pathian dem a na lungsim na hei a, na kam a pan a huai thute na pawtkhiaksak.
english: That you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

paite: "Mihing bang ahia, asian ding? Numei a pan piang amah kua ahia diktat ding?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

paite: Ngai in, amisiangthoute ah muanna anga kei a; amitmuh in vante asiang kei uhi.
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

paite: Mikihhuai leh sia, tui bang a thulimlouhna dawnmi, siang kei sem na in chia.
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

paite: "K'on ensak ding, hon za in; huan ka muhsa ka puang ding.
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare:

paite: Mipil kuate in ahia apipute ua kipan na thu gen a, a-iim louh uh.
english: (Which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

paite: Amau kiang kia ah gam piak in a-om a, mikhual kuamah alak uah apai kei uh.
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

paite: "Migilou in adamsung niteng in natna athuak a, nuaisiah hatmi a dia kholkhawm kumte zah mah.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

paite: Abil ah launa ging a-om a; hauh lai in lokmi atung ah ahong pai ding hi.
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer shall come on him.

paite: Khomial a kipan ahong kik ding chih a-um kei a, namsau a ngak in a-om hi.
english: He doesn’t believe that he shall return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

paite: Tanghou zong in avakvai a, Koi a om ahia? chi in. Khomial ni akiangchin ah mansa in a-om chih athei hi.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

paite: Dahna leh haksatna in amah alausak a; kumpipa galdou dia mansa bang in, amah azou uhi.
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

paite: "Pathian dou ding a khut alikkhiak ziak in, Bangkim hihthei dou a kisatheitak in,
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty;

paite: alum, atuamna sahtak nei toh amah dou a atai teitei ziak in;
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers;

paite: athau in amaitang akhuh a, agil ah thau akholkhawm hi.
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

paite: "Khopi tulsa ah ateng a, kuamah ten tuaklouhna innte ah, segawp ngiingei dingte aluah ziak in.
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

paite: Ahau kei ding a, aneih-le-lam a-om gige kei ding a; amah lei ah zung akai kei ding.
english: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall their possessions be extended on the earth.

paite: Khomial a kipan asuakta kei ding a, meikuang in aselnoute akangkeu ding a, apaklun laite amutmang ding.
english: He shall not depart out of darkness. The flame shall dry up his branches. By the breath of God’s mouth shall he go away.

paite: Amah kikhem in, bangmah lou ah muang kei hen: bangmah lou lah athukna hi ding ahi ngal a.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness shall be his reward.

paite: "Ahun ma in hihzoh in a-om dia, huan ahiang nou kei ding hi.
english: It shall be accomplished before his time. His branch shall not be green.

paite: Grepgui bang in agah min lou asingpulh dia, olive bang in apak apaikhe ding.
english: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive tree.

paite: Pathian limsak lou kithuahkhawmna hut ding ahi a, golhna puaninte lah mei in akangmang ding hi.
english: For the company of the godless shall be barren, and fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

paite: Siatna apai ua, thulimlouhna asuakkhesak uh, alungtang un khemna a- nopkeuh uhi.
english: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Huchibang thil tampi ka zata hi: lungmuanmi chimtakhuai ngen na hi uh.
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

paite: Thu bangmah loute'n tawp hun anei ding uam? Ahihkeileh dawng ding a nang hon hihheh bang ahia?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

paite: Nou bang in kei leng ka pau thei sam hi; na kha uh ka kha mun a om hileh, noute dem a thute kaikhawm a, ka lu hon sinkhum thei ding hi veng in.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

paite: Himahleh ka kam in nou ka hon hatsak ding a, ka muk a muanna in na lungkhamna uh ka hon nem ding.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

paite: "Thu gen mah leng, ka dahna nep in a-om kei a: doh mah leng, hihnop in ka om a hia?
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

paite: Himahleh ahon chimtaksakta a; ka lawmte tengteng na hihgamta hi.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made desolate all my company.

paite: Huan kiptak in na hon len a, huai kei demna theihpihna ahi: huchi in ka gawnna kei dem in athou a, ka maitang ah atheisak hi.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

paite: "Ahehna in kei ahon botkek a, ahon sawi hi; aha ahon gawikhum a: ka tung ah ka gal in amit atat- hiam hi.
english: He has torn me in his wrath, and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

paite: Akam uh lianpi in ahon katkhum ua; simmohtak in ka biang ah ahon beng ua; kei dou ding in akikaikhawm uh.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

paite: Pathian in Pathian limsakloute kiang ah ahon pekhia a, migiloute khut ah ahon paikhia hi.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

paite: Om nuam in ka om a, himahleh ahon kitamsak a; ahi, ka ngawng in ahon man a, hon pai nen hi; amuitum ding in ahon tungtou hi.
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

paite: Athalkap mite'n ka kimvel ah ahon um ua, ka sisan guite abottan a, ahawi kei; lei ah ka sinkha asungkhia hi.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my gall on the ground.

paite: Siatna tung ah siatna in ahon sesak a; galhat bang in ka tung ah atai hi.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs on me like a giant.

paite: Ka vun tung ah sai-ip ka khui a, leivui ah ka kingata hi.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

paite: Kahna in ka mai ahoihta kei a, ka mitvunte ah sihna limliap a-om hi.
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids.

paite: Ka khut ah hiamgamna om kei mahleh, ka thumna siangthou mahleh.
english: Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

paite: "Aw leitung, ka sisan khuh ke'n, huan ka kahna in mun nei kei hen.
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

paite: Tu mahmah in, ngai in, van ah kei hon theihpihpa a-om a, tungsang ah kei hon genpihpa a-om hi.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

paite: Ka lawmte'n hon nuihsan ua, himahleh ka mit in Pathian ah khituite asungkhia hi.
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

paite: "Huchi a Pathian lak a mihing dikna aletkip theih a, invengte lak a mihing tapa dikna aletkip theihna ding in.
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

paite: Kum tawmchik ahong tun chiang in, ka kik nawnlouhna ding lampi ah ka paita ding hi."
english: For when a few years have come, I shall go the way of no return.

paite: "Ka lungsim hihgawp in a-om a, ka nite abei a, kei a ding in han mansa in a-om hi.
english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, And the grave is ready for me.

paite: Ka kiang ah musit mite a-om taktak ua, ahehna uah ka mit a-om gige hi.
english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

paite: Tu in thuchiam hon pia in, nangmah toh kei a ding in moh khu hong hi in; kei toh khutte beng ding kua a-om a?
english: “Now give a pledge, be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

paite: Theihsiamna a kipan alungtang uh na sel ngal a; huaiziak in amau na hihlian kei ding hi.
english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, Therefore you shall not exalt them.

paite: "Kuapeuh mat ding a alawmte hek a, aneih-le-lam tan tummi, atate nangawn mit azuausuak ding hi.
english: He who denounces his friends for a prey, Even the eyes of his children shall fail.

paite: Mite houlimna ding in ahon bawl lai a; huchi in tangpi kih ka hong hita hi.
english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

paite: Lungkhamna ziak in ka mit leng amial a, ka hiangte tengteng limliap bang ahi.
english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

paite: Midikte'n hiai ah lamdang asa ding ua, mihoih Pathian limsakloute dou ding in akitokthou ding.
english: Upright men shall be astonished at this. The innocent shall stir up himself against the godless.

paite: Himahleh midiktat alampi ah apang zouzou dia, kuapeuh khut siangneite ahat semsem ding uhi.
english: Yet shall the righteous hold on his way. He who has clean hands shall grow stronger and stronger.

paite: Himahleh hong kik un, na vek un, tu in hong un; huchi in na lak uah mipil ka mu kei ding.
english: But as for you all, come on now again; I shall not find a wise man among you.

paite: "Ka nite abeita, ka thiltupte asegawpta hi, ka lungtang ngaihtuahte tan in.
english: My days are past, my plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

paite: Zan, sun in akheng ua; khovak in khomial anaih, achi uh.
english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

paite: Ka inn bang in Sheol en leng: khomial ah ka lupna phah taleng:
english: If I look for Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

paite: siatna kiang ah, 'Ka pa na hi,' chi leng; tangtel kiang ah, 'Ka nu leh ka sanggamnu na hi,' chi leng;
english: If I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father;’ to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘my sister;’

paite: huchi hileh ka lametna koi a om ahia? Lamet nei hi leng kua'n ahon musak dia?
english: where then is my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

paite: Sheol mundaite ah paisuk in leivui ah ka kikkhawm ding ua adiam?"
english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. , or descend together into the dust?”

paite: Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Thute zong a bang tan thang kam ding na hi ua? Ngaihtuah in, huai zoh chiang in ka pau ding uh.
english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

paite: Bangziak a gamsa bang a sim a om a, na mitmuh ua siang lou ka hi ua?
english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

paite: Nang na hehna kipumpei ziak in lei mangngilh in a-om diam? Ahihkeileh amun a kipan in suangpi suankhiak in a-om diam?
english: You who tear yourself in your anger, shall the earth be forsaken for you? Or shall the rock be removed out of its place?

paite: "Ahi, migilou vakna mihsak in a-om ding a, amei-ek atang kei ding.
english: “Yes, the light of the wicked shall be put out, The spark of his fire shall not shine.

paite: Apuanin ah vakna amial dia, atung a khawnvak mihsak ahi ding.
english: The light shall be dark in his tent. His lamp above him shall be put out.

paite: Ahatna kalsuante hihtuailuai ahi dia, amah thupha gen in apaikhe ding hi.
english: The steps of his strength shall be shortened. His own counsel shall cast him down.

paite: Amah khe mahmah in len sung ah amah apailut ua, len ah a-awksak hi.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

paite: Thang in akhetul ah aman dia, thang in amah alen ding hi.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

paite: Lei ah amah a ding in thangkual sel in a-om a, lampi ah amah a ding in thang.
english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him in the way.

paite: "Kihtakhuaite'n ning chiteng ah amah alausak dia, A akhetul ah adelhzui ding hi.
english: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall chase him at his heels.

paite: Ahatna gilkial nek in a-om dia, akhawlna ding in mansa in tuahsiatna a-om ding.
english: His strength shall be famished. Calamity shall be ready at his side.

paite: Apumpi hiangte anegai ding a, ahi, ahiangte sihna ta masapen in anegai ding hi.
english: The members of his body shall be devoured. The firstborn of death shall devour his members.

paite: Asuan apuanin a kipan zungkalhkhiak in a-om dia lauhuainate kumpipa kiang a pi in a-om ding hi.
english: He shall be rooted out of his tent where he trusts. He shall be brought to the king of terrors.

paite: Amah a hilou puanin ah teng a-om ding, atenna ah kat thehzak in a-om ding hi.
english: There shall dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur shall be scattered on his habitation.

paite: "Nuailam ah azungte akeu dia, tunglam ah ahiang satkhiak ahi ding.
english: His roots shall be dried up beneath. Above shall his branch be cut off.

paite: Lei a kipan in atheihgige amangthang ding; kongzing ah min anei kei ding.
english: His memory shall perish from the earth. He shall have no name in the street.

paite: Khovak a kipan in khomial ah hawllut ahi ding a, khovel a kipan a delhkhiak.
english: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

paite: Amite lak ah tapa anei kei dia, tute leng atenna ah kuamah om lai a-om kei ding hi.
english: He shall have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

paite: "Amalam a omte'n ani lamdang asa ding uh; nunglam a omte hihlau a a-om bang un.
english: Those who come after shall be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

paite: Huchibang midiktatloute tennate ahi petmah a, Pathian theiloumi mun ahi hi."
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

paite: Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Bang tan ka kha hihbuai a, thute a hon hihzan gawp ding na hi ua?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

paite: Hiai sawmvei na hon kouta ua; ka tung a giloutak a na hih uh na zum kei uh.
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

paite: Ana paikhial taleng maw, keimah kiang a ka diklouhna a-om gige hi.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

paite: Kei dem in nou kiliansak petmah ve ni uchin, ka minsiatna ka tung ah na gen ding ua,
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach;

paite: Pathian in ka thu ah hon zouta chih tu in thei un, huchi in alen in ahon umsuak hi.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

paite: "Ngai un, 'Hiamgamna,' chi in ka kikoukhia a, himahleh zak in ka om kei, panpih deih in ka kikou a, himahleh vaihawmna a-om kei hi.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

paite: Ka pai theihlouhna ding in ka lampi a-um a, ka paina dingte ah khomial akoih hi.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

paite: Ka thupina hon suahsak a, ka lu a kipan lallukhu alakhia hi.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

paite: Ning chiteng ah ahon hihniam a, ka mangta hi; huchi in sing bang in ka lametna abotkhia hi.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. My hope he has plucked up like a tree.

paite: Ka tung ah ahehna leng asou a, amah a ding in agalte lak a khat bang in ahon sim hi.
english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

paite: Asepaih pawlte ahong kuankhawm ua, ka siatna ding in alampi uh abawl ua ka puanin kimvel in puanin akai uhi.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

paite: "Kei a pan in ka unaute gamlapi ah akoih a, ka meltheihte kei a pan in atuam vekta uh.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

paite: Ka tanaute'n ahon zuausan ua, ka lawm theihngeite'n ahon mangngilhta uhi.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

paite: Ka inn tengte leh, ka sikhanute'n, mikhual ahon sa ua: amitmuh un namdangmi ka hi.
english: Those who dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

paite: Ka sikha ka sam a, hon dawng kei, ka kam in amah khem mah leng.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

paite: Ka zi a ding in ka hu kihhuai ahi a, sanggamte ziak in pumpi hahsiang mah leng ka namsia hi.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

paite: Naupang neute nangawn in hon simmoh ua; ka thohleh, ka siatna ding in thu agen uhi.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

paite: Ka lawm thudotte'n kei ahon hua ua, amau ka itte ka tung ah ahel uhi.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

paite: Ka vun ah leh ka sa ah ka guh abelh bikbek a, ka ha vun toh ka suakta hi.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

paite: Hon hehpih un, hon hehpih un, Aw nou ka lawmte; Pathian khut in kei ahon khoihta ngal a.
english: “Have pity on me, have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.

paite: Bangziak a Pathian bang a nou hon sawi na hi ua, ka sa a bangziak a lungkim lou na hi ua?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

paite: "Aw ka thute tu in gelh in om le uh aw; Aw laibu ah kigelh lutleh aw.
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

paite: Sik leh ngen gelhna zum in tangtawn a ding in suangpi a gelh hi le uh aw;
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

paite: Ka Tanpa ahing chih leh, atawp chiang in leitung ah adingh nawn ding chih ka theih ziak in.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

paite: Ka vun huchibang a hihsiat a a-om khit nung in, himahleh ka sa a kipan Pathian ka mu ding hi.
english: After my skin is destroyed, then in my flesh shall I see God,

paite: Keimah a ding in amah kei mahmah in ka mu dia, ka mitte'n a-en ding, midang hilou in; ka sung ah ka lungtang asidang hial hi!
english: Whom I, even I, shall see on my side. My eyes shall see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

paite: "Amah bangchibang in i sawita phet ding uam, na chih uleh, kei ah thubul muh in a-om chih thei in.
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

paite: Namsau kihta un; hehna in lah namsau gawtnate ahon tun ngal a, huchi a vaihawmna a-om chih na theihtheihna ding un."
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

paite: TOUPA Pathian tapate ahong kilak ni uh a-om nawn a, huan TOUPA ma a kilak ding in alak uah Setan leng ahong pai hi.
english: Again it happened on the day when the God’s sons came to present themselves before Yahweh, that Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Koi a hong kipan na hia?" achi hi. Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Leitung langkhat langkhat tawn a, asung a sukvak-touvak ka hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “From going back and forth in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ka sikha Job na ngaihtuah ngei hia? Amah bang a hoihkim leh mitang, Pathian kihta a hoih lou mudah lei ah lah kuamah a-om ngal kei a; ama siatna ding in hon tangsak mah lechin, aginomna alen tinten hi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is none like him in the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

paite: Setan in TOUPA adawng a, "Vun sik in vun, ahi, mihing in aneih tengteng hinna sik in ape ding hi.
english: Satan answered Yahweh, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

paite: Himahleh tu in na khut kha inla, aguh leh asa khoih lechin, na maitang ah nang hon gense ding hi," achi hi.
english: But put forth your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

paite: TOUPA'N Setan kiang ah, "Ngai in, amah na khut ah a-om hi; ahinna lel hawi in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ma a kipan in Setan apawtkhia a, meimatum in akhepek nuai a kipan aluzang tan in Job agawt hi.
english: So Satan went forth from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

paite: Huchi in ama'n kikhuatna ding in belpei ala a; meivu lak ah atu hi.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

paite: Huai lai in azi in akiang ah, "Na ginomna len tinten lailai na hi hia? Pathian gensia inla, si in," achi hi.
english: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

paite: Himahleh akiang ah, "Numei hai thugente lak a khat bang in thu na gen a. Bang ahia? Pathian khut ah hoih i mu dia, hoih lou leng i mu kei dia hia?" achi hi. Hiai tengteng ah Job in amuk in thil ahihkhial kei hi.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

paite: Huchi a Job lawm thumte'n atung a hiai hoih lou hong tung tengteng azak un, michih ama mun a kipan in ahong ua: Teman mi Eliphaz, Shuah mi Bildad leh Naaman mi Zophar, amah kah ding leh amah lungmuan ding in hohkhawm ding in hun seh abawl uhi.
english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

paite: Huchi a gamlapi a pan adaktouh uleh, amah athei kei ua, nakpi in akikoukhia ua, akapta uhi. Apuanaktual uh michih in abotkek ua, alutang uah van lam ah leivui akibuak uhi.
english: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

paite: Huchi in akiang ah leitual ah ni sagih leh zan sagih atu ua, akiang ah kuamah in thu khat leng agen kei uh; alungkhamna anasa mahmah chih amu uhi.
english: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

paite: Huan Naamath mi Zophar in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Huaiziak in ka ngaihtuahnate'n kei dawnna ahon pia a, ka sung a om ka kinohna thu ziak mahmah in.
english: “Therefore do my thoughts give answer to me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

paite: Kei hon zahlaksak salhna ka zata a, ka theihsiamna kha in ahon dawng hi.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

paite: "Leitung a mihing a-om nungsiah, hun lui thu hiai na thei kei maw;
english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

paite: Giloute vualzohna atom a, Pathian limsakloute nopsakna mitphiat kal sung lel ahi chih?
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

paite: Ahoihkimna in vante suntou in, alu in meipite phatou mahleh;
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

paite: Himahleh amah ek bang in tangtawn in amangthang ding a, 'Koi a om ahia?' Amah mute'n achi ding uh.
english: yet he shall perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him shall say, ‘Where is he?’

paite: Mang bang in alengmang dia, muh in a-om kei ding hi; ahi, zan mengmuh bang in hawlmang in a-om ding hi.
english: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found. Yes, he shall be chased away like a vision of the night.

paite: Amah mu mit in amah amuta kei ding hi; amun in leng amah amuta kei ding hi.
english: The eye which saw him shall see him no more, neither shall his place any more see him.

paite: Atate'n gentheite deihsakna azong ding ua, akhutte'n athil hoih ape nawn ding hi.
english: His children shall seek the favor of the poor. His hands shall give back his wealth.

paite: "Atuailai hatna in aguhte dim mahleh, leivui ah amah toh alum ding uhi.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth shall lie down with him in the dust.

paite: Akam ah gitlouhna khum in alei nuai ah sel mahleh;
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

paite: Sit in, paisak kei in, akam ah kem gige zou mahleh;
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth;

paite: Agil a an akitok a, asung ah gulgu bang in akha hi.
english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

paite: Hauhsaknate anawmvalh a, alokhe nawn ding hi. Pathian in agilpi a kipan in apaikhe ding hi.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

paite: Sokval gu atawp dia, gulngan in amah athat ding.
english: He shall suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue shall kill him.

paite: Luipite, khuaizu leh nawituidat lui luangte a-en kei ding hi.
english: He shall not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

paite: Sepgim gah ape nawn dia anawmvalhsuk kei ding a; amuhsa ah kipahna anei kei ding.
english: That for which he labored he shall restore, and shall not swallow it down. According to the substance that he has gotten, he shall not rejoice.

paite: Ama'n lah gentheite anuaisiah a, amangngilh hi; alam louhpi inn hiamgamtak in alata uhi.
english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.

paite: Adeihgawlna in huntawk anei kei a akipahpih thil himhim akhol kei ding.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he shall not save anything of that in which he delights.

paite: Anekgaih louh bangmah om lai a-om kei hi; huaiziak in ahauhna in adaih sawt kei ding.
english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity shall not endure.

paite: Ahauh san lai in haksa sakna anei dia, thulimloumi khut ahong tung ding hi.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress shall overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery shall come on him.

paite: Agilpi hihdim ding a akisak lai in, Pathian in atung ah athangpaihna kihtakhuaina akhe ding a, anek lai in atung ah azusak ding hi.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

paite: Sik galvan a kipan atai dia, dal thal in amah akap pailet ding.
english: He shall flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow shall strike him through.

paite: Adokkhia a, apumpi a kipan in ahong paikhia; ahi, asinkha a pan amukzumte velvel hong paikhia a launate atung ah ahong tung hi.
english: He draws it forth, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

paite: Agou ding in mialna tengteng kholkhawm in a-om; mei mut louh in amah anegai ding; apuanin a nutsiat a om anegai ding hi.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire shall devour him. It shall consume that which is left in his tent.

paite: Vante'n abohsiatna ataklang ding ua, lei amah dou ding in athou ding.
english: The heavens shall reveal his iniquity. The earth shall rise up against him.

paite: A-inn a punna apaimang dia, aheh ni in avante aluangmang ding hi.
english: The increase of his house shall depart. They shall rush away in the day of his wrath.

paite: "Hiai Pathian a pan a migilou tantuan ahi, agouluah dia Pathian in asehsak."
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Ka thugen hoihtak in ngaikhia unla, hiai na khamuanna thu uh hi hen.
english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

paite: Hon thuak teitei unla, ka hon gen ding a, ka gen khit chiang in nuihsan na ni uteh.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.

paite: "Kei phunna mihing tung ah hia? Bangziak a kuhkal lou a om lou ding ka hia?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

paite: Hon en unla, lamdang sa unla, khut in na kam uh hum un.
english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

paite: Ka ngaihtuah in ka lung adong a, linna in ka sa aman nak.
english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

paite: "Bangziak in ahia migilou ahin a, tekkun a adam a, ahong thupikhiak?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

paite: Asuante uh akiang uah amitmuh uah ahihkip a, agil ua gahte amai ma uah.
english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

paite: A-inkuante uh lauhuai lak ah abit a, atung uah Pathian chiang ake kei hi.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

paite: Abawngtal un chi akhah a, ahut ngei kei, abawngpi un nou anei a, anou ase ngei kei.
english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

paite: Ganhon bang in ataneute uh apawtsak ua, atate uh alam uh.
english: They send forth their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

paite: Apekging uleh kaihging toh kituak in la asa ua, atamngai ging uah akipak uh.
english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

paite: Anite uh lamzangtak in azang ua, lungmuang in Sheol ah apaisuk uh.
english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. .

paite: "Pathian kiang ah, 'Hon paisan in, na lampite theih ka kilawp kei uh.
english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

paite: Bangkim hihthei bang a ahih, a-nna ka sep ding uh, akiang a ka thum un punna bang a ka muh ding uh?' achi uhi.
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

paite: Ngai in, alamzanna uh akhut ua om ahi kei a hia? Migilou lemtheihna kei a kipan a gamlapi a om ahi.
english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

paite: "Migilou meisel bangzah vei amit a, vangtahna atung ua atun a, Pathian in athangpaihna in lungkhamna apiak chiat?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

paite: Bangzah vei ahia buhpawl huih mut bang ahih ua, buhsi huihpi mutmang bang ahih uh?
english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

paite: "Pathian in gitlouhnate atate uh a ding in akholkhawm, na chi ua, amau tung ah tungsak le ake; atheihsiamna ding un.
english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

paite: Amau mit ngei in asiatna uh mu uhenla, Bangkim hihthei thangpaihna dawn uhen.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

paite: Aman nung in a-inn uh amau a ding in bang a ahih, akha zah uh hihtawp ahih nung in?
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

paite: Kua'n ahia Pathian theihna sinsak ding? ama'n sangpi a omte vai ahawmsak ngal a.
english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

paite: "Alut lai in mi asi a, nuam leh bit lai in.
english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

paite: Anawite nawizu in adim a, aguhngekte thau in adim hi.
english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

paite: Midang lungkhamtak in asi a, Nuamsa a a-an chiam ngei lou in.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

paite: Vut lak ah kibang in alum ua, than in apumtuam hi.
english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

paite: Ngai in, na ngaihtuah uh ka thei, dikloupi a ka tung a na sawmte uh.
english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the devices with which you would wrong me.

paite: 'Koi ah ahia kumpi inn a-om, migilou tenna puanin koi ah a-om a?' na chi uh.
english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

paite: "Zinzin mite na dong ngei kei ua hia? Agente uh na pom kei ua hia?
english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

paite: Migilou vangtah ni in hawi in a-om a, thangpaih ni in hotkhiak in a- om, chih.
english: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led forth to the day of wrath?

paite: Kua ahia amaitang a alampi pulak ding, kua ahia athilhih bang a amah din ding?
english: Who shall declare his way to his face? Who shall repay him what he has done?

paite: Han lam a puak ahih in, ahan ven ahi.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men shall keep watch over the tomb.

paite: Lui phaizang a leitang amah a ding in anuam a; mi tengteng in amah nung azui ua, amah ma a na paite sim seng louh ahi uh.
english: The clods of the valley shall be sweet to him. All men shall draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

paite: Bangchi in thu mumal omloupi a hon khamuan ding na hia? Na dawnnate uah zuauthu lou ngal bangmah a-om kei hi."
english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

paite: Huchi in Teman mi Eliphaz in hichi in achi:
"Pathian a ding in mihing aphatuam thei diam? Kuapeuh apil amah mah a ding in aphatuam ngei a.
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

paite: Na diktat, Bangkim hihthei a ding a kipahna ahi a hia? Ahihkeileh na lampite na hoihkimsak, amah a dia punna hia?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him, that you make your ways perfect?

paite: Nang ahon salha, vaihawmna a nang toh alut, amah na kihtak ziak hia?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

paite: Na gitlouhna alian kei maw? Na thulimlouhna ah leng tawpna a-om sam kei hi.
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

paite: "Bangmah lou ding in na unau thuchiamte na la a, vuaktangte puansilh na suahsak hi.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

paite: Bahte a ding in dawn ding tui na pe kei a, gilkial a ding in tanghou na it hi.
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

paite: Himahleh mihat in gam anei a; asung ah ami deihthoh ateng hi.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

paite: Khutvuak in meithaite na sawlmang a, pabeite khutte hihtan in a-om hi.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

paite: Huaiziak in na kim ah thangte a-om ua, lauguihna in nang ahon hihbuai hi.
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

paite: Ahihkeileh khomial, na muh theih louh, leh tui tampi in nang ahon khuh hi.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

paite: "Van sang ah Pathian a-om kei a hia? Aksite sandan en in, sang hi na tel uh e;
english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

paite: Nang, 'Pathian in bang athei a? Khomial bikbek ah vai ahawm thei dia hia?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

paite: Ama'n hon muhlouhna ding a, meipi sah in liah a, van dum khen a vak ahi,' na chi hi.
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

paite: Migiloute totsa lampi lui na kem ding hia?
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

paite: Ahun ma ua lakmang a-om a, akingakna ua tui luang bang a butkhiak a omte.
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

paite: Pathian kiang a, 'Hon paimangsan in; huan ei a ding in Bangkim hihthei in bang ahihthei a?' chite.
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

paite: Himahleh a-innte uh thil hoih in adimsak ua, himahleh migiloute thugen kei a kipan agamla hi.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

paite: Midiktatte'n amu ua, akipak uh; mihoihte'n amau anuihsan ua,
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

paite: Chihtaktak in ei dou ding a thoute satkhiak in a-om ua, amaute lak a khosuaksunte mei in ahulta," chi in.
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

paite: "Tu in amah kimeltheihpih inla, muangtak in om in. Huai ah hoih na kiang ah ahong pai ding hi.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. Thereby good shall come to you.

paite: Akam a kipan in dan sang in, ka hon ngen hi, na lungtang ah athute kholkhawm in.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

paite: Bangkim hihthei kiang a na kik nawnleh, lamkip na hi ding; na puaninte a kipan gamlapi ah diktatlouhna na koihmang ding ahi.
english: If you return to the Almighty, you shall be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

paite: Huan na gou leivui ah koih inla, luite suangte lak ah Ophir dangka-eng;
english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

paite: Bangkim hihthei na gou ahi dia, dangka manpha nang a ding in
english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

paite: Bangkim hihthei ah kipak in, Pathian kiang ah daktou ding na hih ziak in.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and shall lift up your face to God.

paite: Amah kiang ah na thum ding a, ama'n hon na za ding a, na thuchiam na tangtun ding hi.
english: You shall make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You shall pay your vows.

paite: Thil khat tung ah thupukna bawl in thu na pe dia, nang a ding in hihkip in a-om ding; huchi in na lampite ah khovak atang ding hi.
english: You shall also decree a thing, and it shall be established to you. Light shall shine on your ways.

paite: Ahon sawnpuk chiang un, 'Thohtouhna a-om,' na chi ding. Hihniam a omte ama'n ahondam ding hi.
english: When they cast down, you shall say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

paite: Ama'n ahoih lou nangawn asuaktasak ding a; ahi, na khutte sianna ziak in amah suahtaksak in a-om ding."
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he shall be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

paite: Huchi in Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
Tuni mahmah in ka phunna helhuai ahi, ka mauna sang in ka thuakna agikzaw hi.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

paite: Aw amah ka muhna mun thei leng la, atutna mahmah ah hoh thei leng aw!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

paite: Ama ah ka thu ka bawlhoih dia, thugente in ka kam dimsak ding hi veng.
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

paite: Ahon na dawnna ding thute ka thei dia, huchi in bang ahia ka kiang a agen ding ka theisiam ding.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

paite: Athilhihtheihna thupina in kei ahon sel diam? Ii, himahleh kei hon hatsak ding hi.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

paite: Huai ah midik in amah thu asutpih thei dia; huchi in ka vaihawmmi a pan suahtaksak in ka om tawntungta ding hi.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

paite: "Ngai in, mailam zuan in ka pai a, himahleh huai ah a-om kei; nunglam zuan in, himahleh amah ka mu kei hi.
english: “If I go east, he is not there; if west, I can’t find him;

paite: Veilam pang ah, na sep lai in, himahleh amah ka mu thei kei a; taklam pang ah abu, amah ka muh theihlouhna ding in.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

paite: Himahleh ka zuih lampi athei a; ahon ze-et lai in, dangka-eng bang in ka hon suakkhe ding hi.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I shall come forth like gold.

paite: Ka khe in akalsuante alenkip a; alampite ka zuita a, ka pial kei hi.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned aside.

paite: Amukte thupiak a kipan ka paikik kei a, akam a thute akiphamoh ka an sang in ka kholkhawm zaw hi.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

paite: "Himahleh amah lungsim khek lou ahi a, amah kua'n ahei thei dia? Akha in adeih, huai mah ahih zel hi.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

paite: Kei a dia sehsa ahih ngal a; thil huchibang tampi akiang ah a-om hi.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

paite: Huaiziak in a-omna ah ka buai a; ka ngaihtuah chiang in amah ka lau hi.
english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

paite: Pathian in ka lungtang abahsakta a, Bangkim hihthei in ahon hihbuaita hi.
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

paite: Khomial ma in satkhiak in ka om ngal kei a, ka mai a kipan khomial sah leng akhuh sam kei hi.”
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

paite: "Bangziak a Bangkim hihthei in vaihawmna hunte bawl lou ahia? Amah theite'n bangziak a anite mu lou uh ahia?
english: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

paite: "Gamgi suan a-om ua; hiamgamtak in ganhon alamang ua, avak uhi.
english: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

paite: Pabeite sabiltung ahawlmang ua, thuchiamna ding in meithai bawngtal ala uh.
english: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

paite: Lampi a kipan tasamte aheikhia ua; lei a gentheite akiselkhawm uhi.
english: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

paite: "Ngai in gamkeu a sabiltungte bang in athilhihna lam uah, an thanuamtak a zong in apaikhia ua, atate uh a ding in gamdai in amau an asuaksak hi.
english: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go forth to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

paite: Gam lam ah agan an a-at ua; migiloute grep gah ala uh.
english: They cut their provender in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

paite: Zankhua in puan bei in vuaktang in alum ua, khovot ah khuhna nei lou in.
english: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

paite: Tangte vuahpi in amaute akawt ua, belh ding deih man in suangpi akawi uhi.
english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

paite: "Pa neiloute nawi a kipan kaikhia a-om ua, huan, gentheite thuchiam la in.
english: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

paite: Huchi in tasamte puan bei in vuaktang in avialvak ua, buhphalte gilkial in apua uhi.
english: So that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

paite: Olive a pan sathau abawl ua; a-uain sukna uh achil ua, himahleh adangtak uhi.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

paite: Khopi a kipan mite amau ua, liamte kha akikoukhia ua; Pathian in alimsak kei hi.
english: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

paite: "Hiaite khovak tung a helte lak a ahi ua; huai lampite athei kei ua, alampite ah a-om gige sam kei uhi.
english: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

paite: Khovak tung in tualthatmi athou a, gentheite leh tasamte athat a; ahi, zan in guta bang in a-om hi.
english: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

paite: Ang kawm mi mit in leng khomui angak a, kuamah in hon mu kei ding, chi in amai abawl lamdang hi.
english: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye shall see me.’ He disguises his face.

paite: Khomial in innte avut pailet ua, sun chiang in akikhumbilh ua; khovak athei kei uh.
english: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

paite: Amaute tengteng a ding in zingsang sihna limliap bang ahi a; zan mial lauhuaite lawm in anei uhi."
english: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

paite: "Tuite tung ah kintak a taihmang in a-om ua, atantuan uh lei ah hamsiat in a-om; agrephuante sukmi in anaih kei.
english: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed in the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

paite: Khokhal leh nisa in vuk tuite atawpkang a, huai mah bang in thil hihkhialte Sheol in ahih hi.
english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. those who have sinned.

paite: Sul in amah amangngilh dia; than in limsatak in amah kivakna in anei ding uh; theihgige in a-omta kei dia, diktatlouhna sing bang a hihtan in a-om ding.
english: The womb shall forget him. The worm shall feed sweetly on him. He shall be no more remembered. Unrighteousness shall be broken as a tree.

paite: “Ta nei lou numei ching anegai a; meithai a ding in hoih ahih kei hi.
english: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

paite: Ahi a lah Pathian in athilhihtheihna in mihatte adomkang a, hinna alamet phak louh lai un adingtou uh.
english: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

paite: Bitna Pathian in amaute apia a, huchi in huai ah akhawl uh; alampite uah amitte a-om hi.
english: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

paite: "Hihlet in a-om. ua; himahleh sawt lou kal in, abei uhi; ahi, sukniam in a-om ua, midang tengteng bang in lampi a kipan lakkhiak in a-om-ua, buhvui bang in atkhiak in a-om uhi.
english: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

paite: Huchibang na hi kei taleh kua ahia zuauthei a hon chian a, ka thugen bangmah lou suah ding?"
english: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

paite: Shuah mi Bildad in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Pathian kiang ah lalna leh launa a-om; ama'n amun sangte ah muanna abawl hi.
english: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

paite: "Asepaihhonte kua'n asim seng dia? Kua tung ah ahia avakna tanlouhna a om?
english: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

paite: Huchi ahih chiang in Pathian ma ah bangchi in mihing adik thei dia? Ahihkeileh amah numei suan bangchi in asiang thei dia?
english: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

paite: Ngai in, khapi nangawn in vakna anei kei a, amitmuh in aksite asiangthou kei hi.
english: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

paite: "Mihing, tangtel sang a bangzah a neuzaw? Pathian mitmuh ah mihing bangchi phet ahi diam, mihing tapa, lungnou leltak!"
english: How much less man, who is a worm, the son of man, who is a worm!”

paite: Huan Job in adawng a, hichi in achi:
"Thilhihtheihna nei lou amah bangchi a panpih in; hatna nei lou ban bangchidan a hondam thei na hia?
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

paite: Pilna nei lou amah bangchi in na thuhilh a, nakpitak a theihna hoih na puangkheta a;
english: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

paite: Kua kiang ah ahia thute na genkhiak? Kua kha ahia nang a kipan hong paikhia?"
english: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came forth from you?

paite: "Sisate leh huai a tengte tuite nuai a kipan ahi uh.
english: “Those who are deceased tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

paite: Ama ah Sheol vuaktang in a-om a, Abaddon in kikhuhna anei kei hi.
english: Sheol Sheol is the lower world or the grave. is naked before God, and Abaddon Abaddon means Destroyer. has no covering.

paite: Ama'n mal mun awng ah aphalhkhia a, bangmah lou tung ah lei akhai hi.
english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

paite: Ameipi sah in tuite atun a; anuai ah meipi akikek kei hi.
english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

paite: Ama'n laltutphah mai akhuh a, atung ah ameipi aphalh hi.
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

paite: Tuite tung ah, khovak leh khomial kigitna ah, kawlmong akaikual hi.
english: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

paite: Asalhna ah van khuamte aling ua, lamdang asa uh.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

paite: "Athilhihtheihna in tuipi akhawlsak a, huan atheihsiamna in Rahab asat hi.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

paite: Ahu in vante bawlhoih in a-om a; akhut in gulpi kinoh tai lai abawl hi.
english: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

paite: Ngai in, hiaite a thilhih among lel ahi uh. Ngatchik a ahuau siausiau lel! Athilhihtheihna van-ging kua ahia theisiam ding?"
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

paite: Huchi in Job in agentehna thu apan nawn a, hichi in achi:
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

paite: "Pathian ahin bang in, ama'n ka dikna alamang a; Bangkim hihthei in, ama'n ka kha ahihbuaia;
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter.

paite: Ka sung a ka hinna a-om lai teng, Pathian hu ka nakvang a a-om lai teng?
english: (For the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

paite: Ka mukte'n thutak lou agen kei ding, ka lei in leng khemna thu agen kei ding.
english: surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, neither shall my tongue utter deceit.

paite: Siam ka hon tangsak kei ding a, ka sih ma kei a pan ka dikna ka koihmang kei ding.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

paite: Ka diktatna ka len tinten a, ka khah kei ding hi, ka dam lai teng ka lungtang in kei hon kou kei ding.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

paite: "Ka melma gilou bang hi henla, kei dou ding a thou midiktat lou bang hi hen.
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

paite: Punna muta mahleh, Pathian limsakloumi lametna, Pathian in akha alakmang ngal in, bang ahia?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

paite: Atung a buaina atun in, Pathian in akikou aza diam?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

paite: Bangkim hihthei ah nuam asa in, chik lai peuh in Pathian sap nuam asa diam?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

paite: "Pathian khut tungtang ah nang ka hon sinsak ding; Bangkim hihthei kiang a om ke'n ka iim kei ding hi.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

paite: Ngai un, noute tengteng in huai na muta ua; ahih ngalleh, bangziak a bangmah lou hong hi na hi ua?"
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

paite: "Hiai Pathian lak a migilou tantuan leh, nuaisiah hat mite goutan, Bangkim hihthei a pan amuh uh ahi.
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

paite: Atate apun uleh, namsau a ding ahi; huan asuan tanghou in atai kei ding hi.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

paite: Anung a omlaite hi leng in avui dia, ameithaite un kahna abawl kei ding uh.
english: Those who remain of him shall be buried in death. His widows shall make no lamentation.

paite: Leivui bang a dangka vum in, tungman bang in puansilh bawl mahleh;
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

paite: Abawl thei, himahleh midikte'n asilh ding ua, mihoihte'n dangka pen ahawm ding uh.
english: he may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

paite: Maimomlen bang in inn alam a, vengmi in abawl aidakbuk bang lel ahi.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

paite: Hausa in alum a, himahleh khop in a-om kei ding; amit ahak a, huan amah a-om kei.
english: He lies down rich, but he shall not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

paite: Tuite bang in launate'n amah apha a; zan in huihpi in amah agumang hi.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

paite: Suahlam huih in amah apomang a, apaimang hi; huchi in amun a kipan in amah amutmang hi.
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

paite: "Pathian in amah nakpi in alawn dia, adawm kei ding; akhut a pan ataimang ding hi.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

paite: Mite'n amah akhut uh abetkhum ding ua, amun a kipan in amah anuihsan ding uhi."
english: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

paite: "Chihtaktak in dangka a ding in khuk a-om a ahihsiang uh dangka-eng a ding in mun.
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

paite: Lei a pan in sik akilakhia a, suang a kipan in dal akisungkhia hi.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

paite: Mihing in khomial phak tawp aneisak a, bukimna azongkhia hi; khomial leh sihna lim phak tawp tan in.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

paite: Mite omlouhna ah kokhuk lutna hawm atouvang ua, mite a pan gamla ah akikhai ua, lehlam lehlam ah akivei uh.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

paite: Lei ahihleh, huai a kipan in tanghou ahong suak a; anuai ah mei ahih bang in akilumlet hi.
english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread; Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

paite: Huai suangte sapphir suang mun ahi a dangka-eng nen anei hi.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

paite: Huai lampi sasial ne vasa in athei kei a, mu-akla mit in leng amu ngei sam kei hi.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

paite: Gamsa kisatheite'n asik kha ngei kei ua, humpinelkai lun lai leng huai ah apai kha nai kei hi.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

paite: "Meisah suangpi tung ah akhut akoih a; azung in mualte alumlet hi.
english: He puts forth his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

paite: Suangpite lak ah tuilam ahong a; amit in thil manpha chiteng amu hi.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

paite: Atakkhiaklouhna ding un lui luangte atuam a; thil kisel khovak ah ahon lakhia hi.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings forth to light.

paite: Himahleh koi lai ah apilna akimu dia? Theihsiamna koi lai a om ahia?
english: “But where shall wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

paite: "Mihing in alampi athei kei; mihing gam ah leng muh in a-om kei.
english: Man doesn’t know its price; Neither is it found in the land of the living.

paite: Thukna in, 'Kei ah a-om kei,' achi a, tuipi in, 'Ka kiang ah a-om kei,' achi hi.
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

paite: Dangka-eng a lei theih ahi kei a, huai man ding in dangka buk theih ahi kei hi.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for its price.

paite: Ophir dangka-eng toh amanphatna teh theih ahi kei ding, Onik mantam hiam Sapphir toh hiam.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire or, lapis lazuli .

paite: Dangka-eng leh limlang in akimpih thei kei ua, huai khenna ding in dangka-eng hoih leh suangmantam leng ahi thei kei ding hi.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither shall it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

paite: Suang dum hiam suang muh paisuak theih akigen kei ding, Ahi, pilna man rubi suang sang in asangzaw hi.
english: No mention shall be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

paite: Ethiopia topaz suang in apha kei dia, dangka-engtak toh leng amanphatna teh ding ahi kei.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, Neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

paite: "Ahihleh pilna koi a kipan a hong pai ahia? Theihsiamna koi a om ahia?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

paite: Mihing tengteng mit a kipan a sel ahi chih leh, huihkhua a vasate a kipan sitsa a om ahi chih thei in.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

paite: Abaddon leh Sihna in, 'Huai a thuthang ka bil un ka za uh,' achi uhi.
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’

paite: Pathian in huai alampi atheisiam a, amun athei hi.
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

paite: Lei mong tan in a-en ngal a, van nuai thil tengteng amu hi.
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

paite: Huih a ding a gikna apiak lai in leh tuite tehna a ateh lai in;
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

paite: Vuah a ding a thupiak abawl a, vanpiging khophia a dia lampi abawl lai in;
english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder;

paite: Huai lai in ama'n amu a, apuang a; ahihkip a, ahi, azongkhia hi.
english: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

paite: "Mihing kiang ah, 'Ngai in, TOUPA kihtak, huai pilna ahi; hoih lou a kipan paimang theihsiamna ahi,' achi hi.”
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” , that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

paite: Job in agentehna thu agen nawn a, hichi in achi.
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

paite: "Aw nidanglai khate bang a om hi leng, Pathian in ahon veh lai nite bang in;
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

paite: Ka lutung a akhawnvak atan a, amah vakna a khomial a ka vak lai;
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

paite: Ka tuailai nite a ka om bang a, ka puanin tung a Pathian thuguk a-om lai in;
english: as I was in the ripeness of my days, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

paite: Ka kiang a Bangkim hihthei a-om a, ka tate ka kim a-om lai un;
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

paite: Ka kalsuante bawngnawi a sawp ahih a, suangpi in sathau luite abutkhiak lai in.
english: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

paite: Khopi a kongpi zuan a ka pai lai in, kongzing a ka tutna ka bawl lai in,
english: when I went forth to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

paite: Tangvalte'n ahon mu ua, abu ua; upate athou ua adingh uh.
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

paite: Lalte houlim akidek ua, akam uah akhut uh akoih uh.
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

paite: Miliante aw adai a, akam dangtawng uah alei uh abelh hi.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

paite: "Bil in ahon zak lai in, hampha ahon chi a; mit in ahon muh lai in, pom ahon chi a;
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it commended me:

paite: Migenthei, panpih ngai a kap, Pa nei lou, panpihtu bei ka hutkhiak ziak in.
english: Because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had none to help him,

paite: Mangthang ding a mansa a kipan vualzawlna ka tung ah ahong tung a; meithai lungtang kipah ziak a lasa ding in ka omsak hi.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

paite: Diktatna ka silh a, ahon tuam hi; ka dikna puanak thupi leh lukhum bang leh suangmantam bang ahi.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

paite: Mittaw a ding in mitte ka hi a, khebai a ding in khete ka hi.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

paite: Tasam a ding in pa ka hi a; ka theih louh thubul ka zongkhia hi.
english: I was a father to the needy. The cause of him who I didn’t know, I searched out.

paite: Diktatloumi haizek ka hihtan a, aha a kipan asamat ka khahsak.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous, and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

paite: "Huchi in ke'n, ka bu ah ka si ding a, piaunel bang in ka nite ka pungsak ding, ka chi a.
english: Then I said, ‘I shall die in my own house, I shall number my days as the sand.

paite: Ka zungte tuite pha in adalhzak a, ka hiangte ah zankhua in daitui akai.
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

paite: Kei ah ka thupina athak gige a, ka khut ah ka thalpeu athak gige.
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

paite: Mite'n ahon ngai ua, angak ua, ka thuhilh a ding in adai dide uhi.
english: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

paite: Ka thute zoh in apau nawn kei uh; ka thugen atung uah atakkhia.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

paite: Vuah ngak bang in ahon ngak ua; vuah nanungte a ding bang in lianpi in akamka uh.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

paite: Kimuanna aneih louh chiang un atung uah ka nuihmai a; huchi in ka mel tang apaikhe kei uh.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

paite: "Alampi ding uh ka telsak a, hausa bang in ka tu a; sepaih pawl lak a kumpipa bang in ka leng a, suun mite lungmuanmi bang in."
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

paite: Hiai khit in Job in akam aka a, ani ahamsiat hi.
english: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

paite: Job in adawng a, hichi in achi.
"Ka pian ni leh zan, pasal naupang pai in a-om, akichihna mangthang hen.
english: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

paite: Huai ni mialna hi hen; tunglam a kipan Pathian in ngaihsak kei hen, atung ah leng khovak tang kei hen.
english: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

paite: Khomial leh sihna lim in amau a ding in huai ngen uhen; atung ah meipi kai hen; khua nimsak tengteng in huai tuh lausak uhen.
english: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes black the day terrify it.

paite: "Zan ahihleh, mial sah bikbek atung ah tu hen; kum nite lak ah telsak kei hen; khate simna ah tel kei heh.
english: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

paite: Ngai in, huai zan hut henla; huai ah kipah aw ging kei hen.
english: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

paite: Huai ni hamsiatte amau hamsiat uhen, Leviathan tokthou ding a mansa a omte.
english: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

paite: Huai a khomui aksite mial uhen; khovak zong henla, himahleh bangmah nei kei hen; zingsang mitvunte leng mu sam kei hen.
english: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

paite: Ka nu sul kongkhakte akhak louh ziak in, ka mit a kipan abuaina asel louh ziak in.
english: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

paite: "Sul a kipan bangziak a si lou ka hia? Gil a kipan ka hong paikhiak lai a bangziak a kha khah lou ka hia?
english: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

paite: Bangziak a khukte'n kei hon dom ahia? Ahihkeileh bangziak a ka tep ding nawi na om ahia?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

paite: Tu a na lum khin a, na dai mai ding lah ka hi ngal a; ka na ihmuta dia; huchi in ka na khawlta ding hi.
english: For now should I have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

paite: Lei kumpipate leh thudot mite, amau a ding a mun sia bawlte toh.
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

paite: Ahihkeileh dangka-eng nei kumpite, a-innte uh dangka a dimsakte toh.
english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

paite: Ahihkeileh muh louh a ahun lou a piang bang na hilou ka hia, naungek khovak mu ngeiloute bang?
english: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

paite: Huai ah migiloute'n sukbuai atawpsan ua; huai ah mitawlte akhawl uhi.
english: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

paite: Huai ah salmatte nuam in a-omkhawm uh; nasem heutute aw aza kei uhi.
english: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

paite: Huai ah aneu leh alian a-om ua; apu a kipan in sikha anuamlen.
english: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

paite: "Bangziak a dah a omte kiang a khovak piak ahia, kha a haksa sa kiang ah hinna;
english: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

paite: Sihna deih a, atunlouhnate kiang ah; gou selguk zon sang a thupi a zong mite kiang ah.
english: Who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

paite: Han atun lai ua, nakpitak a kipakte kiang ah?
english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

paite: Bangziak a mi alampi sel a om kiang leh Pathian in a-umsuak kiang a khovak piak a om ahia?
english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

paite: An ka nek ma in ka thumna ahong tung a, ka maunate tui bang a leihbuak in a-om hi.
english: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

paite: Ka kihtak thil lah ka tung ah ahong tung ngal a, ka laulau ka tung ah ahong tung hi.
english: For the thing which I fear comes on me, That which I am afraid of comes to me.

paite: Nuam ka sa kei a, ka lung amuang kei, khawlna leng ka nei kei hi; himahleh buaina ahong pai hi.”
english: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; but trouble comes.”

paite: "Huan kei sang a naupang, apate uh, ka ganching uite toh koih dia ka sitte'n, kei nuihza bawlna in ahon zang uh.
english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to put with my sheep dogs.

paite: Ahi, akhutte uh hat a, kei bang ahon loh tak dia, huai ahatna uh beisate'n?
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

paite: Taksapna leh kialna in atuikang ua; lei keu leh sia akheuh uh,
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

paite: Pawn a anteh alou ua; huan lou kha zungte a-an uh ahi.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom are their food.

paite: Mite lak a kipan hawlkhiak in a-om ua; guta bang in amau nung ah akikou ua.
english: They are driven out from the midst of men. They cry after them as after a thief;

paite: Guam a hengte ah ateng ding ua, lei leh suangpi hawmte ah.
english: So that they dwell in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

paite: Pawn lak ah aham ua; lahou nuaite ah akisekhawm uh.
english: Among the bushes they bray; and under the nettles they are gathered together.

paite: Mihaite tate ahi ua, ahi, mithulim lou tate; gam a pan in delhkhiak ahi uhi.
english: They are children of fools, yes, children of base men. They were flogged out of the land.

paite: "Huan tu in kei ala uh ka hong hi ahi, amau a ding in houlimna ka hi.
english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

paite: Ahon kih ua, kei a kipan atuam ding in uh, ka mai a chilsiat akidek kei uh.
english: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

paite: Pathian in ka khau akhah a, ahon hihgim a, huan ka ma ah kamkaihna akhahkhia uh.
english: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

paite: Ka khut taklam ah tuailaite athou ua; ka khe anawlkhin ua, siatna lampi ka ma ah akoih uhi.
english: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.

paite: Ka lampi hihsiarin, ka tuahsiatna azong ua, kuama'n akham kei uh.
english: They mar my path, They set forward my calamity, without anyone’s help.

paite: Awng zapi apaisuak bang in ahong ua, siatna lak ah ka tung ah akikhuk uh.
english: As through a wide breach they come, in the midst of the ruin they roll themselves in.

paite: Ka tung ah launate ahei ua, huih bang in ka minphatna adelhmang uh; meipi bang in ka hauhna apaimang hi.
english: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

paite: "Huchi in tu in ka sung ah ka kha buakkhiak in a-om; gimthuakna nite'n kei ahon man uhi.
english: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold on me.

paite: Zan in ka guhte asawi a, kei hon sun natnate'n khawl chih anei kei uh.
english: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

paite: Ka natna hi hat mahmah ziak in ka puansilh anin a: ka puanak ngawng bang in kei ahon gak hi.
english: By great force is my garment disfigured. It binds me about as the collar of my coat.

paite: Buannawi ah ahon pailut a, leivui leh meivu bang ka hi hi.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

paite: "Na kiang ah ka kikou a, na hon dawng kei hi. Ka ding a, kei na hon en maimah a.
english: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

paite: Ka tung a gilou ding in na kilumlet a, na bantha hatna in kei na hon sawi hi.
english: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

paite: Huih ah na hon domkangtou a, huai tung ah na hon tuangsak; huchi in huih ah na hon lumlet den hi.
english: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

paite: Sihna na hon tun ding chih ka thei hi, mihing tengteng a dia sehsa inn ah.
english: For I know that you will bring me to death, To the house appointed for all living.

paite: Himahleh siatna a pukgawp mi'n aban zak lou ding hia? Atuahsiatna ah panpihna ngen in kikou lou ding hia?
english: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

paite: Buaina a ding in ka kap kei diam? tasam a ding in ka kha adah kei ding a hiam?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

paite: Hoih ka ngak chiang in, hoih lou ahong pai a; khovak ka ngak chiang in, khomial ahong pai.
english: When I looked for good, then evil came; When I waited for light, there came darkness.

paite: "Ka lungtang abuai, khawl hun amu ngei kei; gimthuakna nite ka tung ah ahong tung.
english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

paite: Hihvom a om in ka vialvak, himahleh ni hihvom hilou in; khawmpi ah ka dingh a panpih deih in ka kikou hi.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

paite: Sehalte unaupa ka hi a, simbute lawm ka hi.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

paite: Ka vun avom a, kei a kipan apilh uh, kholum in ka guhte akang hi.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

paite: Huaiziak in ka kaihging suunna asuak a, ka mutging mikapte aw."
english: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

paite: "Ka mit toh thukhun ka na bawl khinta; bangchi in nungak ka en theita dia?
english: “I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

paite: "Ahihleh tunglam Pathian a kipan in ka tantuan bang ahia, tungsang a Bangkim hihthei a kipan in ka goutan?
