english: “‘If a man takes his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness; it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

paite: Mi'n numei akha teng si neih aneih lai a, akithuahpih a, avuaktanna alemleh asi pawtna lem ahi a, ama'n leng asi pawtna lem ahi a, achipihte ua pan anih ua satkhiak ding ahi.
english: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness; he has made naked her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

paite: "Na nu sanggamnu hiam, na pa sanggamnu hiam vuaktanna na lem ding ahi kei. Asanggam nai vuaktanna lem ahi a, agitlouhna moh apo ding.
english: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister; for he has made naked his close relative: they shall bear their iniquity.

paite: Mi'n apaneu zi akithuahpihleh apaneu vuaktanna lem ahi a; akhelh moh uh apo ding ua, suan-le-pak bei in asi ding uh.
english: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

paite: Mi'n a-unaupa zi akitenpihleh thilnin ahi a, a-unaupa vuaktanna lem ahi a, suan-le-pak nei lou in a-om ding uh.
english: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity: he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka thupiak tengteng, ka vaihawm tengteng na pom ding ua, na zui ding uh ahi. Huchi in tenna ding a ka hon pina gam in nou ahon lokhe kei ding hi.
english: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my ordinances, and do them; that the land, where I am bringing you to dwell, may not vomit you out.

paite: Na ma ua ka delhkhiaksa namdangte thilhihte na zui ding uh ahi kei. Hiai thil tengteng ahih ua, huaiziak in, amau ka kih hi.
english: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I am casting out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

paite: Himahleh nou kiang ah, agam uh, nawitui leh khuaizu a luang gam, na luah ding un ka hon pe ding, ka chi khinta hi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, namdangte a pan hon hihtuampa ka hi.
english: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am Yahweh your God, who has separated you from the peoples.

paite: Huaiziak in sa siang leh siang lou leh vasa siang leh siang lou na khentuam ding ua; sa hiam, vasa hiam lei a vakthoh chi himhim hiam nou a dia siang lou dia ka sehtuamte in na hinna uh na kihhuaisak ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and you shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.

paite: Kei a ding in misiangthou na hi ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA lah ka siangthou ngal a. Kei a na hihna ding un namdangte lak a pan nou ka hon septuamta hi.
english: You shall be holy to me: for I, Yahweh, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.

paite: "Pasal leng, numei leng dawi aisan siam zawl hiam, bumsiam hiam hihlup ngeingei ding ahi a; suang a denlup ding ahi uh. Asisan moh uh atung uah a-om ding hi," achi nawn lai hi.
english: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium, or is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aaron tapa siampute houpih inla, akiang uah: Achipihte uh lak a misi ziak in kuamah akihihnit ding ahi kei.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people;

paite: Atanau nai, anu uh, apa uh, atapa uh, atanu uh, a-unau,
english: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,

paite: asanggamnu, a-ompih lai uh nungak, pasal nei nailoute ziak in ahihleh akihihnin thei ding uh.
english: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.

paite: Hiai bang ahih kei ngalleh, achipihte uh lak a intekpen ahih ziak in akihihnin ding ahi kei.
english: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

paite: "Alu uh ametgiau ding uh ahi kei. Akhamul sik tuak uh leng atantom ding uh ahi kei. Asa uh leng a-atkeh ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘They shall not shave their heads, neither shall they shave off the corners of their beards, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

paite: A Pathian uh a ding in misiangthou ahi ding ua, a Pathian min ahemsak ding ahi kei hi. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, a Pathian a dia nek ding ansiahte alat ziak in asiangthou ding ahi.
english: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God; for they offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, the bread of their God; therefore they shall be holy.

paite: Numei kizuak hiam, min hem hiam, apasal maksa hiam akitenpih ding ahi kei, a Pathian a ding in misiangthou ahi ngal a.
english: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane; neither shall they marry a woman divorced from her husband: for he is holy to his God.

paite: Huaiziak in amah na siangthousak ding ahi; ama'n na Pathian tanghou alat ziak in, nang a ding in asiangthou ding hi. Kei, TOUPA, nou hon hihsiangthoupa lah ka siangthou ngal a.
english: You shall sanctify him therefore; for he offers the bread of your God: he shall be holy to you: for I Yahweh, who sanctify you, am holy.

paite: Siampu kuapeuh tanu kizuak a, akihihthanghuai leh apa ahihthanghuai ahi a, mei a hal ding ahi.
english: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father: she shall be burned with fire.

paite: "A-unaute lak a siampu lian, alu sathau nilhsa, puansilh dia sehtuamsa in alukhuhna alakhe ding ahi kei. Apuante abotkek ding ahi kei.
english: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, nor tear his clothes;

paite: Misi luang omna ah alut ding ahi kei. Anu hiam, apa hiam ziak in akihihnin ding ahi sam kei hi.
english: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

paite: Mun siangthou a pan apawtkhe ding ahi kei. A Pathian' mun siangthou ahihthanghuai ding ahi sam kei hi. A Pathian sathau nilhna lah atung ah a-om ngal a; Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am Yahweh.

paite: Zi ding in nungak siangthou akitenpih ding ahi.
english: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

paite: Meithai hiam, maksa hiam, numei min hem hiam, kizuak hiam akitenpih ding ahi kei. Amah chipih, nungak siangthou zi ding in akitenpih ding ahi.
english: A widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute, these he shall not marry: but a virgin of his own people shall he take as a wife.

paite: Achipihte lak ah asuante ahihnin ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA'N amah ka hihsiangta ngal a, chi in,” achi hi.
english: He shall not profane his seed among his people: for I am Yahweh who sanctifies him.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron kiang ah, asuante lak a na khang ua demna ding nei peuhmah in a Pathian a dia ansiah lan ding in hon zuan kei hen.
english: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your seed throughout their generations who has a blemish, may approach to offer the bread of his God.

paite: Kuapeuh melhemna nei in ahon naih het louh ding ahi. Mittaw, khebai, nakpek ahihkeileh akan-aval a om peuhmah;
english: For whatever man he is that has a blemish, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

paite: ahihkeileh khe kitan, khut kitan,
english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

paite: ahihkeileh nungkul, mineu lua, mit sia, meima damthei lou nei ahihkeileh chiltang kitam,
english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles;

paite: siampu Aaron suan gensiatna ding nei himhim in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat lan ding in ahon naih ding ahi kei. Gensiatna ding nei ahi a, a Pathian a dia sehtuam an lan dia ahon naih het louh ding ahi.
english: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest who has a blemish, shall come near to offer the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Since he has a blemish, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

paite: A Pathian a dia an siangthou leh siangthoupen ahihleh ane thei ding hi.
english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

paite: Himahleh gensiatna ding nei ahih ziak in puanzak sung ah hiam, maitam kiangnai ah hiam ahong pai thei kei ding. Ka mun siangthoute ahihnin kha ding hi. Kei TOUPA amah hihsiangthoupa ka hi ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
english: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a blemish; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Aaron leh atapate leh Israel suante tengteng kiang ah agenta hi.
english: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron leh atapate kiang ah gen inla, Israel suante'n ka ma a thillat siangthou, kei a dia sehtuam alatte uh zahtaktak in sai uhen. Ka min siangthou ahihnin kha ding uh. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.

paite: Akiang uah, khang sawnsawn in na suante uh lak a kuapeuh siang lou a ngaih a om in TOUPA a dia sehtuam a om thillat siangthou anaihleh ka omná a pan satkhiak in a-om ding. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your seed throughout your generations approaches the holy things, which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Aaron suan kuapeuh phak hiam, thilpawt nei hiam in asian masiah thil siangthoute ne kei hen. Misi in ahihnit hiam, amah a pan chipawt peuhmah hiam;
english: “‘Whoever of the seed of Aaron is a leper or has an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;

paite: ahihkeileh amah siang lou hisak thei bokvak ganhing khatpeuh khoih kha hiam bangchibang siang lou khoih kha siang lou in a-om ding hi.
english: or whoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he has;

paite: Huchibang khoihmi nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi dia, tui a akisil keileh thil siangthoute anek louh ding ahi.
english: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his body in water.

paite: Nitum chiang in ahong siangta ding hi. Huai khit in thil siangthoute ane theita ding, anek ding an ahih ziak in.
english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

paite: Akihihnin ding in amah sih a si hiam, gamsa in abalnen hiam ane ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: That which dies of itself, or is torn by animals, he shall not eat, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka thuseh azuih ding ahi. Huchi lou in zaw akihihnitna khelh moh akipuak ding a, asihloh ding hi. Kei TOUPA, amaute hihsiang- thoupa ka hi ngal a.
english: “‘They shall therefore follow my requirements, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

paite: "Gamdangmi'n thil siangthou ane ding ahi kei. Siampu kiang a gamta hiam, kiloh hiam in thil siangthou ane ding ahi kei.
english: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

paite: Himahleh siampu in kuahiam sum a aleileh, huai mi in bel ane thei dia, a-inn a piangte'n leng ane thei sam ding uh.
english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.

paite: Siampu tanu in gamdangmi akitenpihleh thillat siangthoute ane ding ahi kei.
english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

paite: Himahleh siampu tanu in ta nei lou in meithai in hiam, mak hiam a-om a, apa inn a, akik nawnleh anungak lai mah bang in apa nek dingte ane sam ding hi. Himahleh gamdangmi in ane ding ahi kei.
english: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread: but no stranger shall eat any of it.

paite: "Mi'n thei lou a thil siangthou anekleh amun nga a khen mun khat akoih behlap dia, thil siangthou pen siampu kiang ah ape ding hi.
english: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA kiang a alat uh thil siangthou athangbawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,

paite: Ahihkeileh, hiai thil siangthoute ne in atatlekna uh moh akipuak ding uh, hiaite kei TOUPA'N ka hihsiangthouta ngal a," chi in.
english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Aaron leh atapate leh Israel inkote teng houpih inla, akiang uah, Israel lak a teng, gamdangmi hiam, kuapeuh athillat uh, halmang thillat dia TOUPA kiang a alat uh, athuchiamna uh hiam, amah ut thu a thillat hiam lan peuhmahte'n,
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering;

paite: santak na hihtheihna ding un bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam, apa gensiatbei na lat ding uh ahi.
english: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without blemish, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

paite: Gensiat kai himhim na lat ding uh ahi kei; hon pomsak theih lah ahi ngal kei a.
english: But whatever has a blemish, that you shall not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

paite: Kuapeuh thuchiam hih buching ding hiam, amah ut thu a athillat ding hiam, lemna thillat kithoihna a ganhon lak a hiam, abelamhon lak a hiam, TOUPA kiang a lan taphot in, pomtak ahihtheihna ding in gensiatbei alat ding ahi a; gensiat kaina himhim a om ding ahi kei.
english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; no blemish shall be therein.

paite: Amit taw, aguh tan, akhe bai, meima nei, chibawk leh phak nei, TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi kei, mei a thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah maitam ah na lan ding uh ahi kei.
english: Blind, injured, maimed, having a wart, festering, or having a running sore, you shall not offer these to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.

paite: Ama ut thủ a thillat ding in bawngtal hiam, belamnou hiam, akan- aval a om sahiang nei hiam, sahiang kim lou hiam bel na lan thei ding uh. Himahleh thuchiamna thillat ding in hiaite pom ahi kei ding.
english: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

paite: Achiltang dup hiam, kitam hiam, keh hiam TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uh ahi kei. Na gam uah huchibang kithoihna ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: That which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut, you shall not offer to Yahweh; neither shall you do thus in your land.

paite: "Gamdangmi a pan la in huaite lak a himhim na Pathian uh a dia sehtuam an ding in na lan ding uh ahi kei. Asiatna leh gensiat kaina a-om ziak in pomsak theih ahi kei ding hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: Neither shall you offer the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner of any of these; because their corruption is in them. There is a blemish in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam, ahong pian chiang in api kiang ah ni sagih a-om ding ahi, ani giat ni a pan anunglam in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ding in pom theih ahi ding.
english: “When a bull, or a sheep, or a goat, is born, then it shall remain seven days with its mother; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Bawngpi hiam, belampi hiam, anou toh ni khat in na gou ding uh ahi kei.
english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

paite: Kipahthu genna kithoihna dia TOUPA kiang a na kithoih chiang un pomtak na hihtheihna ding un na kithoih ding uh ahi.
english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

paite: Huai ni mah a nek bei ding ahi, azingchiang tan in bangmah na sit ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka thupiakte na pom ding ua, na zuih ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.

paite: Ka min siangthou na hemsak ding uh ahi kei. Israel suante lak ah hihsiangthou in ka om ding ahi. Kei noute hon hihsiangthoupa,
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,

paite: na Pathian uh hi dia Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa ka hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'TOUPA ankuanglui hunbi hiaite ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

paite: Ni guk sung nna na sem ding ua, ani sagih ni khawlna Sabbath ni ahi a, khawmpi siangthou ahi. Hiai ni in nna na sem ding uh ahi kei. Na tenna teng uah hiai TOUPA Sabbath ni ahi.
english: “‘Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to Yahweh in all your dwellings.

paite: TOUPA ankuanglui hunbi, khawmpi siangthou, ahun geihgeih a na puankhiak ding uh hiaite ahi,' achi hi.
english: “‘These are the set feasts of Yahweh, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

paite: "Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li nitaklam in TOUPA Paikan Ankuang akipan ding hi.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is Yahweh’s Passover.

paite: Huai kha mah ni sawm-le-nga TOUPA a dia silngou soh louh tanghou ankuang ahi a, ni sagih sung silngou soh louh tanghou na ne ding uh ahi.
english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to Yahweh. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

paite: Ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

paite: Ni sagih sung mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; ani sagih ni pen khawmpi siangthou ahi a, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei, chi in," achi hi.
english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation: you shall do no regular work.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, k'on gam piak ding na va tun ua, huai a buh na lak chiang un, na buh thak masate uh phal khat siampu kiang a na hon tawi ding uh ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its the harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest:

paite: Pomsak theih na hihna ding un, ama'n buhphal pen TOUPA ma ah hon na veisak dia; Sabbath zingchiang in siampu in avei ding ahi.
english: and he shall wave the sheaf before Yahweh, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

paite: Buhphal na vei ni un belamnoupa, gensiatbei, kum khat a upa halmang thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uh ahi.
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

paite: Tangbuang thillat bel tangbuang nel chi ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih sathau a mek, TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat ahi ding ahi. Dawn thillat ahihleh uain hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi.
english: The meal offering with it shall be two tenth parts of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

paite: Na Pathian uh a dia thillat na lat ma un, huai ma himhim in tanghou hiam, kan thoh hiam, an thak hitaleh na ne ding uh ahi kei. Hiai na tenna teng ua na suante zel uh tan a na tangtawn dan thuseh ding uh ahi.
english: You shall eat neither bread, nor roasted grain, nor fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

paite: "Sabbath zingchiang vei thillat buhphal na hon tawi ni ua pan in na sim ding ua, Sabbath sagihvei aching ding ahi.
english: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven Sabbaths shall be completed:

paite: Sabbath sagihveina zingsang a pan ni sawmnga na sim ding ua, TOUPA kiang a tangbuang thak thillat na lat ding uh ahi.
english: even to the next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall number fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to Yahweh.

paite: Na tenna mun ua pan in ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih a bawl, tanghou beu vei ding nih, tangbuang nel chi, silngou toh kan, TOUPA a dia gah masa vei thillat a lat dia na hon tawi ding uh ahi.
english: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to Yahweh.

paite: Tanghou lat toh kituak in belamnou sagih gensiatbei, kum khat a upa leh bawngtuai leh belampa nih na lan ding uh ahi. Huaite atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh toh, TOUPA a dia halmang thillat, TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat ahi ding hi.
english: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to Yahweh, with their meal offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat leh kilemna thillat kithoihna ding in belamnou apa nih kum khat a upa na lat ding uh ahi.
english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

paite: Siampu in gah masa a bawl tanghou, belamnou nih toh TOUPA ma a vei thillat in avei dia; siampu a tuam, TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ding.
english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before Yahweh, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to Yahweh for the priest.

paite: Huai ni mah na sep ding ua, nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei. Hiai na tenna teng uah na suante uh tan in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: You shall make proclamation on the same day: there shall be a holy convocation to you; you shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

paite: "Na lou ua buh na lak chiang un na lounawl zul uh la vek kei un. Asang leng na zong ding uh ahi kei. Mizawng leh gamdangmi a dia na hawisak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap into the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest: you shall leave them for the poor, and for the foreigner. I am Yahweh your God.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, akha sagihna huai kha ani khat ni, noute a ding in khawlna ni ahi dia; pengkul mut in theihgigena khawmpi siangthou ahi ding.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest to you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

paite: Nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei; TOUPA a dia mei a thillat na lan ding uh ahi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: You shall do no regular work; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Akha sagihna ani sawm ni Thoihna Ni ahi a; nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi ding. Na lungsimte uh zangsak unla, TOUPA a ding in mei a thillat lan un.
english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation to you, and you shall afflict yourselves; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Huai ni in bang nna peuh na sem ding uh ahi kei. TOUPA na Pathian uh ma a lemna bawlsak ding, Thoihna Ni lah ahi ngal a.
english: You shall do no kind of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Yahweh your God.

paite: Huai ni kigimsak lou peuhmah, amite a pan satkhiak ahi ding.
english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day; shall be cut off from his people.

paite: Kuapeuh hi hen aw, huai ni a bang nna peuh sem, achipihte uh lak a pan ka satkhe ding hi.
english: Whoever it is who does any kind of work in that same day, that person I will destroy from among his people.

paite: Bang nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei. Hiai bel na tenna peuh ua na suante zel uh tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

paite: Nou a ding in khawlna Sabbath ni ahi a; na kigimsak ding uh ahi. Huai kha ani kua ni nitaklam, huai kha nitaklam a pan nitaklam nawn tan Sabbath ni in na zang ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, akha sagihna ani sawm-le-nga ni TOUPA a ding in ni sagih sung Biakbuk Ankuang ahi ding hi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tents for seven days to Yahweh.

paite: Ani khatna pen khawmpi siangthou ahi dia, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: you shall do no regular work.

paite: Ni sagih sung in mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua, ani giat ni nou a ding in khawmpi siangthou ahi ding. Mei a thillat TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding ua; khawmpi bei ni ahi a, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you; and you shall offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

paite: "Hiaite ahi, TOUPA ankuangluina hunbi, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, halmang thillat, tangbuang thillat, kithoihna, dawn thillat, ani tuam chiat a lan dia khawmpi siangthou na zat dingte uh;
english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of Yahweh, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, and a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day;

paite: TOUPA Sabbathte, na thilpiakte uh, na thuchiam tengteng uh, amah ut thu a thillat, TOUPA kiang a na thillat zelte uh ban ah.
english: besides the Sabbaths of Yahweh, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill offerings, which you give to Yahweh.

paite: "Akha sagihna ni sawm-le-nga ni a na lou ua thilpiangte na lak khit chiang un TOUPA ankuangluina ni sagih na zang ding ua; ani khatna ni khawl kinkenna ni ahi dia, ani giat ni leng khawl kinkenna mah ahi ding hi.
english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of Yahweh seven days: on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

paite: Ani khat ni in singkung hoihte gahte, tum sing hiangte, singbawkpha hiangte, lui a muisumte na tawi ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah ni sagih sung kipak in na om ding uhi.
english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahweh your God seven days.

paite: Hiai ankuangluina bel TOUPA a dia kum chih a ni sagih sung na zat ding uh ahi. Hiai na suante uh zel tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi. Akha sagihna ana zat zel ding uh ahi.
english: You shall keep it a feast to Yahweh seven days in the year: it is a statute forever throughout your generations; you shall keep it in the seventh month.

paite: Sawlbuk ah ni sagih sung na teng ding ua, Israel mi a piang himhim aidakbuk ah na ten vek ding uh ahi.
english: You shall dwell in booths seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in booths,

paite: Huchi in na suante un Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak lai in aidakbuk ah ka tengsak, chih athei ding uh. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.’”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in TOUPA an-kuangluina hunbite Israel suante kiang ah apuangta hi.
english: Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante, Olive thau chimtak, det ding a suk, khawnvak kuansak gigena ding a na kiang a hon tawi ding in thu pia in.
english: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin a thu theihpihna puanzak polam ah nitaklam a pan zinglam tan a ding in TOUPA ma ah Aaron in koih hoih hen. Hiai na suante zel uh tan a tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

paite: TOUPA ma ah khawnvak koihna siangthoutak tung ah khawnvakte koih hoih zel hen.
english: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lampstand before Yahweh continually.

paite: "Tangbuang nel chi la inla, tanghou sawm-le-nih in bawl in. Tanghou khat a ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih zat ding ahi.
english: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenth parts of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel shall be in one cake.

paite: TOUPA ma ah dohkan siangthou tung ah vual nih in, vual khat a guk tuaktuak in na chiang ding ahi.
english: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.

paite: Tanghou tung a avual nih ah begaw chimtak na koih dia, theihgigena, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahong hihtheihna ding in.
english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Sabbath teng in TOUPA ma ah akoih hoih zel ding ahi. Hiai tangtawn thukhun, Israel suante a ding ahi.
english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is on the behalf of the children of Israel an everlasting covenant.

paite: Hiai Aaron leh atapate a tuam ahi dia, mun siangthou ah ane ding uh. Tangtawn dan thuseh ding a TOUPA a dia mei a thillatte lak a, amah a dia thil siangthoutak ahi," chi in.
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

paite: Israel numei tapa, apa Aigupta mi khat Israel suante lak ah ava hoh a; huai Israel numei tapa leh Israel mi khat giahmun ah akisual uhi.
english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

paite: Israel numei tapa in Pathian min gensia in ahamsiatkhum a; huchi in Mosi kiang ah ahon pi uhi. Anu min Shelomith ahi a, Dan chi Dibri tanu ahi,
english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

paite: TOUPA kam a pan thupawt ngakna in suangkul ah akhum uhi.
english: They put him in custody, until the will of Yahweh should be declared to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hamsiat loupa giahphual polam ah pikhia unla, atheihpihte tengteng in alu ah akhut uh nga uhenla, mipi omkhawm tengteng in suang in deng uhen.
english: “Bring out of the camp him who cursed; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

paite: Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, kuapeuh a Pathian hamsiat loh peuhmah in akhelh moh apo ding.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

paite: TOUPA min gense peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Mipi omkhawm tengteng in suang in adeng ngeingei ding uh ahi. TOUPA min agensiatleh gamdangmi leng, hiai gam a mi him leng hihlup ding ahi.
english: He who blasphemes the name of Yahweh, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: the foreigner as well as the native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.

paite: "Si khop a mi tung a khut kha peuhmah hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

paite: Si khop a ganta tung a khut kha peuhmah in adit ding ahi; ganta sik in ganta mah ahi ding hi.
english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

paite: "Mi'n a-invengte amelsiat sakleh ahih bang geih atung a hih ding ahi.
english: If anyone injures his neighbor; as he has done, so shall it be done to him:

paite: Guh kitan sik in guh kitan, mit sik in mit, ha sik in ha; mi ahih melsiat bang in atung ah leng hih ahi ding.
english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has injured someone, so shall it be done to him.

paite: Ganta that peuhmah in adit ding ahi. Mi that peuhmah hihlup ding ahi.
english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

paite: Gamdang mite a ding leh hiai gam mite a ding in dan kibang khat na nei ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi, na chi ding," chi in.
english: You shall have one kind of law, for the foreigner as well as the native-born: for I am Yahweh your God.’”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Israel suante ahoupih a, hamse loupa giahphual polam ah apikhia ua, suang in adeng uh, Israel suante'n TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in ahihta uhi.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought out him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Sinai Tang ah Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh said to Moses in Mount Sinai,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'K'on gam piak ding a na va tun chiang un, TOUPA min in agam in leng Sabbath ni atang ding ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to Yahweh.

paite: Na lou uah kum guk sung thil na ching ding ua, na grephuan kum guk sung na satnou ding ua, agahte na la ding uhi.
english: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and gather in its fruits;

paite: Akum sagih kum in gam khawl kinkenna, TOUPA min a Sabbath ni ahi dia: na lou a buh-le-bal na chin ding uh ahi kei, na grephuan na satnou ding ahi sam kei.
english: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

paite: Na buhpou na la ding ahi kei, na kep louh grep na lou ding ahi kei. Gam khawl kinkenna kum ahi ding ahi.
english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and the grapes of your undressed vine you shall not gather. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

paite: Gam khawl kum ate na nektawm ding uh ahi dia; nang, na sikha leh na sikhanu, na kiloh mi, na kiang a teng gamdangmi a ding ahi.
english: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

paite: Na bawnghon, na gam a ganta a dia nektawm ding ahi,' achi hi.
english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

paite: "Khawl kum, kum sagih na sim dia, kum sagih mun sagih ahi ding a; khawl kum, kum sagih sung kum sawmli-le-kua ahi ding hi.
english: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

paite: Huai khit akha sagihna, a ani sawm ni in pengkul ngaihtak in na vialmutsak dia; Thoihna Ni in na gam tengteng uah pengkul na vialmutsak ding uhi.
english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

paite: Akum sawmngana na kipahpih ding ua, gamsung pumpi a, huai a teng mite kiang ah noplenna thu na puang ding uhi. Noute a ding in Jubili ahi dia; michih ama neih-le-lam chiat na pekik nawn ding ua, michih ama inkuan ah akik nawn ding ahi.
english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

paite: Huai akum sawmngana pen nou a ding in Jubili ahi dia; bangmah na ching kei ding ua, apou leng na la kei ding ua, kep louh grep gah leng na lou ding uh ahi kei.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

paite: Jubili ahih ziak in nou a ding in siangthou ahi dia, na lou ua thil gahte na ne ding uhi.
english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

paite: "Hiai Jubili kum in michih kiang ah amah a mah na pekik nawn ding uh ahi.
english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

paite: Na invengte kiang a banghiam na khot a, na invengte kiang a banghiam na lei in leng kikhem in kinekna lemtang in na zang ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

paite: Jubili khit akum zah dungzui zel in na invengte thil na lei dia, buh-le-bal tun kum tamdan dungzui in na kiang ah azuak ding ahi.
english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

paite: Akum tamdan dungzui zel in ama'n na khangsak dia, akum tawm dan dungzui in ama'n na kiamsak ding ahi. Buh-le-bal tun kum tam dungzui a na kiang ah zuak lah ahi ngal a.
english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

paite: Na kikhem ding uh ahi kei. Na Pathian na lau ding uh ahi; kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a.
english: You shall not wrong one another; but you shall fear your God: for I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka dan thusehte zui in ka vaihawmte na pom ding uh ahi. Huchi in huai gam ah bittak in na teng ding uhi.
english: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

paite: Gam in gah asuah dia, niang-le-tai a ne in na ta ding ua, bittak in na va teng ding uhi.
english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

paite: Ahihleh, akum sagih kum in bang ka neta ding ua? Ngai dih, bangmah lah ka ching kei ua, ka thil tungte uh lah ka la sam kei ua, na chih uleh,
english: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase”;

paite: akum guk kum in ka vualzawlna na tung ua tung ding in thu ka pe dia, kum thum sung a ding gah asuah ding hi.
english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for the three years.

paite: Akum giat kum in buh na ching ding ua, haichi na pawi sung un buh luite na ne ding ua, akum kua kum tan, ahong thak nawn matan in aluite na ne ding uhi.
english: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

paite: "Tangtawn a dia gam pen khot det ding ahi kei, gam lah kei a ahi ngal a. Noute mikhual, akhohloh lel na hi uh.
english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

paite: "Na gam luah tengteng uh, tatkik na phal ding uh ahi.
english: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

paite: Na unau ahong gentheih a, agam khenkhat azuakleh atanau naipen ahong kuan dia, a-unau gam zuaksa atan ding ahi.
english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

paite: Mi'n tatsak ding mi nei kei mahleh ahong navak a tatna khop aneihleh,
english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it;

paite: azuak kum sut henla, azuakna pa kiang ah aval pe nawn hen; huchi in agam aluah nawn ding.
english: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

paite: Amah a dia atatkik theih nawn keileh, akhotsa pen Jubili kum tan in aleipa khut ah om hen. Jubili kum in apawt nawn dia, ama'n agam aluah nawn ding hi.
english: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee: and in the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

paite: "Mi'n kulh nei khua a tenna inn azuakleh, azuak a pan kum khat sung in atat nawn theihna hamphatna anei ding hi. Kum khat sung in atan thei nawn ding hi.
english: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

paite: Kum khat sung a atat theih keileh, kulh nei khua a a-inn pen tangtawn in asuante zel tan in leng aleimi a ahi den ding ahi, Jubili chiang in leng apawt tuan kei ding hi.
english: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

paite: Kulh nei lou khua a innte singtang gam bang a ngaih ahi dia, tat theih ahi dia, Jubili chiang in apawt ding.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be reckoned with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

paite: Himahleh Levi mite khua, atantuam khua ua innte Levi mite'n chik lai peuh in leng atan thei ding uhi.
english: “‘Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, the houses in the cities of their possession, the Levites may redeem at any time.

paite: "Levi chite lak a mi'n atat keileh zuaksa inn leh atantuan khua pen Jubili chiang in apawt ding. Levi chite khua a innte Israel suante lak a atantuan uh ahi.
english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

paite: Akho kim ua loute zuak theih ahi kei ding, tangtawn a atantuan uh ahi.
english: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

paite: "Na unau ahong gentheih a, nang ahong belhleh na kep ding ahi. Mikhual ahihkeileh khualzin bang himahleh amah na kiang ah na tengsak ding ahi.
english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support him among you; then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

paite: Amah a pan dangka hiam, thil hiam, apung la ke'n, himahleh, Pathian lau in, na unau na kiang a atentheihna ding in.
english: Take no interest from him or profit, but fear your God; that your brother may live among you.

paite: Apung delh in na sum na leitawisak ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, Kanaan gam hon pepa leh na Pathian uh hi dia Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa ka hi.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

paite: "Na unau ahong gentheih a, na kiang a ahong puklutleh sikha bang ana zat ding ahi kei.
english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you; you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

paite: Kilohmi bang leh na kiang a teng sam bang in na kiang ah ateng dia, Jubili kum tan in nangmah nna asem ding ahi.
english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee:

paite: Huai khit in na kiang a pan apawt dia, amah leh atate, amau inkuan ngei ah alut nawn ding uh, api-le-pute inn-le-lou aluah nawn ding uhi.
english: then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

paite: Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak, ka sikhate ahi ngal ua, sikha dia zuakkhiak ding ahi kei uh.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

paite: Huhamtak in atung uah gamta ke'nla; na Pathian lau zaw in.
english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

paite: Sikhanu leh sikhapa na neih dingte na kim ua namte lak a mi, sikhanu leh sikhapa dia na lei dingte ahi ding uh.
english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have; of the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

paite: Na lak ua teng gamdangmi leh na gam ua piang a-inkote uh lak a mite leng na lei thei sam ding ua; amau na thil neih asuak ding uh.
english: Moreover of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

paite: Na nung ua na tapate uh gouluah ding in, athil neih ding un na bawl ding uhi. Huai lak a mite na tangtawn sikha ding in na nei ding uh. Himahleh na unau Israel suante lak ah huhamtak in na gamtang ding uh ahi kei.
english: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them may you take your slaves forever: but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

paite: "Gamdangmi hiam, na kiang ua teng kuahiam hong hau a, akiang a na unaupa ahong gentheih a, na kiang a gamdangmi hiam, na kiang a teng kiang hiam a amah-le-amah akizuak khiakleh,
english: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family;

paite: khotsa ahih nung in leng akitankik thei ding hi; a-unaute lak a khat in amah atan thei ding hi.
english: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

paite: Apaneu in hiam, apaneu tapa in hiam atan thei ding; achipihte lak a atanau nai in hiam atan thei ding hi. Amah leng ahong hauh nawnleh akitan thei ding hi.
english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

paite: Apuklutnapa toh apuklut a pan Jubili kum nawn ding sutkhawm uhenla, apuklut man, akum omdan in ahi dia; kiloh sikha ding a goih sut bang zel a sutsak ahi ding hi.
english: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; according to the time of a hired servant shall he be with him.

paite: Kum tampi a-om laileh atatna man pen abelh sung hu toh kituak a piakkik nawn ding ahi.
english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

paite: Jubili kum tunna ding kum tawmchik kia om lai ahihleh sutkhawm uhenla; a-om kum tamdan dungzui in atat man apekik ding ahi.
english: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

paite: Kum khat bi zel a goih kilohmi bang in abel ding hi. Abelhpa atung a huhamtak a na gamtatsak louh ding ahi.
english: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him: he shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

paite: Hiai kumte a tat ahihkeileh, Jubili kum in apawt ding; amah leh atate teng toh.
english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee, he, and his children with him.

paite: Israel suante lah ka sikhate ahi ngal ua, Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak, ka sikhate ahi uh. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," achi hi.
english: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.

paite: "Milimte na kibawl ding uh ahi kei. Milim bawltawm suangphuh na dingsak ding uh ahi kei. Biak ding in na gam uah suang milim na phut ding uh ahi sam kei; kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngal a.
english: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, neither shall you raise up an engraved image or a pillar, neither shall you place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it: for I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Ka Sabbathte na tang ding ua, ka mun siangthou na zahtak ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Ka thusehte na man ua, ka thupiakte pom a na man uleh ahunhun in vuahtui ka hon zusak ding hi.
english: “‘If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

paite: Lei in thil ahon piangsak dia, gam a singte'n gah asuang ding uhi.
english: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

paite: Na phual ua buh in grep loh hun abanpha dia, na grep loh hun un thil chin hun abanpha ding hi. Na tanghou uh niang-le-tai in na ne ding ua, na gam uah bittak in na teng ding uh.
english: Your threshing shall reach to the vintage, and the vintage shall reach to the sowing time; and you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

paite: "Hiai gam ah muanna ka omsak dia, na lum ding ua, kuamah in ahon lausak kei ding. Gamsa hoihloute hiai gam a pan ka hawlmang dia, namsau in na gam uh atuansuak sam kei ding hi.
english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid; and I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

paite: Na melmate uh na delh ding ua, na ma uah namsau a thah in a-om ding uh.
english: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

paite: Mi nga in zakhat na delh ding ua, zakhat in singkhat na delh ding uh. Na melmate uh na ma uah namsau a thah in a-om ding uhi.
english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

paite: K'on deihsak dia, chi tampi ka hon suangsak ding hi. Na lak uah ka thukhun ka hihkip ding.
english: “‘I will have respect for you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

paite: Sawtpi na kepsa, aluite na ne ding ua, athak koihna ding in aluite na lakhe ding uh.
english: You shall eat old store long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

paite: Na lak uah ka biakbuk ka omsak dia; ka hinna in noute ahon kih kei ding.
english: I will set my tent among you: and my soul won’t abhor you.

paite: Na lak uah ka teng dia, na Pathian uh ka hi dia, nou leng ka mite na hi ding uh.
english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

paite: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh, asikha uh na hihlouhna ding ua Aigupta gam a pan noute hon pikhepa ka hi. Na hakkolte uh ka hihtanta a, dingtang in ka hon paisakta hi.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves; and I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you go upright.

paite: "Himahleh ka thu pom lou a, hiai thupiak tengteng na zuih kei ua, ka thusehte na deih kei ua,
english: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments;

paite: na hinna un ka vaihawmte ahuat a, ka thupiak tengteng zui lou a, ka thukhun na bohsiat uleh ke'n leng na tung uah hiai ka hih ding.
english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant;

paite: Na tung uah thil lauhuai, na hinna uh netum leh na mit uh hihsia kumzawnna leh khodam ka lengsak ding hi. Na haichite uh bangmah lou dia ching na hi ding ua, na melmate un ane zel ding uh.
english: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away; and you will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

paite: Na tung uah ka mai ka gumsak dia, na melmate uh ma ah na vuallel ding uh. Nou hon hote'n na tung uah vai ahawm ding ua, kuamah delh louh in na tai ding uhi.
english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

paite: "Huchi pipi a leng ka thu na pom kei lai uleh na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei ka hon gawt lai ding hi.
english: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

paite: Na thilhihtheihna ki-otsakna uh ka hihse dia, na tung ua van sik bang in leh na nuai ua lei sumsan bang in ka bawl ding.
english: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like brass;

paite: Na tha uh na sengthawn lel ding ua; na gam un thil apiangsak kei dia, gam a singte'n gah asuang sam kei ding uh.
english: and your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

paite: "Kei kalh lam a na om ua, ka thu na pom kei uleh na khelhna uh dungzui in amun sagih in na tung uah gawtna ka tungsak ding.
english: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

paite: Na lak uah gamsate ka hon sawl dia, huaite'n na tate uh ahon laksak ding ua, na gantate uh ahihmangthang ding ua, na hong tawm mahmah ding ua, na lampite uh nutsiat in a-om ding hi.
english: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number; and your roads will become desolate.

paite: "Hiaite tawn a ka hon bawlhoihna na pom tuan kei ua, kei kalh a na om lailai uleh,
english: “‘If by these things you won’t be reformed to me, but will walk contrary to me;

paite: ke'n leng nou ka hon kalh dia, kei mahmah in na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei ka hon gawt ding hi.
english: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

paite: Huchi in na tung uah namsau ka lengsak dia, huai in ka thukhun na palsat uh phu ala ding hi. Noumau khosung chiat a na kibawmkhawm chiang un, na lak uah hii ka lengsak dia, melma khut a piak na hi ding uh.
english: I will bring a sword upon you, that will execute the vengeance of the covenant; and you will be gathered together within your cities: and I will send the pestilence among you; and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

paite: Na muanpen uh tanghou ka beisak chiang in, numei sawm in thuk khat ah na tanghou uh a-emkhawm ding ua, na tanghou uh buk chitchiat in ahon pe ding ua; na ne ding ua, na kham tuan kei ding uh.
english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight: and you shall eat, and not be satisfied.

paite: "Huchi tengteng a leng ka thu na pom kei ua, kei kalh a na om lailai uleh hehtak in noute ka hon kalh ding hi.
english: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me;

paite: Na khelhnate uh ziak in sagihvei, kei mahmah in ka hon gawt ding hi.
english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath; and I also will chastise you seven times for your sins.

paite: Na tapate uh sa na ne ding ua, na tanute uh sa na ne nalai ding uhi.
english: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

paite: Na mun sangte uh ka chimsak dia, na milimte uh ka puksak dia, na luang uh na milimte uh luang tung ah ka pai ding. Ka hinna in nou ahon kih ding hi.
english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

paite: Na khuate uh ka gamsak dia, na mun siangthoute uh ka hawmsak dia, na gimlimte uh ka dik kei ding hi.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation, and I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

paite: Gam ka hihse ding a; huai a om na melmate un lamdang asa ding uh.
english: I will bring the land into desolation; and your enemies that dwell therein will be astonished at it.

paite: Namdangte lak ah ka hon dalhsak dia, noute hon delhzui ding in namsau ka phawi ding. Huchi in na gam uh ahawm dia, na khuate uh agam ding.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you: and your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

paite: Ahawm sung teng leh na melmate uh gam a na om sung teng uh gam in a Sabbathte atang dia, a Sabbathte ah nuam asa ding uhi.
english: Then the land will enjoy its sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its sabbaths.

paite: Ahawm sung teng in akhawl ding; asung a na ten lai ua, na Sabbath nite ua, akhawl louh ziak un.
english: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your sabbaths, when you lived on it.

paite: "Na lak ua mi omsunte, amelmate uh gam ah alungtang sung uah bahna ka omsak ding hi. Nahthel ging in leng adelh dia, namsau a pan taikek bang in ataikek ding ua, kuamah delh louh in apuk ding uh.
english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies: and the sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword; and they will fall when no one pursues.

paite: Kuamah delh louh in namsau ma a taikek bang in akipalpuk lemlum ding ua; na melmate uh dal ding in hatna himhim na nei kei ding uh.
english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues: and you will have no power to stand before your enemies.

paite: Namdangte lak ah na mangthang ding ua, na melmate gam in noute ahon negai ding.
english: You will perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies will eat you up.

paite: Na lak ua omsunte na melmate uh gam ah athulimlouhna ziak un, amuih hiaihiai ding ua; api-le-pute un athulimlouhnate uh ziak a amuihloh bang un amau leng amuihloh sam ding uhi.
english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

paite: Ka tung a akhelh ziak leh athulimlouhna uh leh api-le-pute thulimlouhna leh kei kalh a a-om ziak un,
english: “‘If they confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me, and also that, because they walked contrary to me,

paite: ke'n leng amau ka kalh a, amelmate uh gam a ka omsakdante akitheihmohbawl kei ding ua; asum louh lungtang ua akiniamkhiak ua, athulimlouhna uh ziak a ka gawtna apom uleh, Jakob kiang a ka thukhun ka theigige ding hi.
english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies: if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity;

paite: Isak leh Abraham kiang a ka thukhunte ka theigige ding hi.
english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob; and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

paite: "Agam mah leng ka theigige ding hi. Gam in leng akihepmangsan dia, amau om lou in ahawm sung in a Sabbathte ah nuam asa ding. Ka vaihawmte adeih louh ziak uh leh ahinna un ka dan thusehte amuh nop louh nak ziak in, athulimlouhna uh gawtna apom ding uhi.
english: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its sabbaths while it lies desolate without them: and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity; because, even because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

paite: Huchi pipi in leng, amelmate uh gam a a-om un amaute ka paimang kei dia, amaute hihmangthang ding leh ka thukhun bohse ding in amaute ka kih kei ding; kei TOUPA a Pathian uh lah ka hi ngal a.
english: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them; for I am Yahweh their God;

paite: A Pathian uh ka hihtheihna dia namte mitmuh a Aigupta gam a pan ka pikhiak, apipute uh thukhun amaute ziak in ka theigige zaw ding hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: but I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am Yahweh.’”

paite: Hiaite Sinai Tang a Mosi zang a amah leh Israel suante kal a TOUPA'N abawl thupiakte, vaihawmte leh dante ahi.
english: These are the statutes, ordinances and laws, which Yahweh made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'Mi khat in midangte TOUPA a tuam dia septuam alan dia thuchiam abawlleh,' achi a,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man makes a vow, the persons shall be for Yahweh by your valuation.

paite: "Pasal ahihleh na sehdan ding kum sawmnih leh kum sawmguk kikal a upa, mun siangthou a shekel buk dungzui in dangka shekel sawmnga hu ahih ding ahi.
english: Your valuation shall be of a male from twenty years old even to sixty years old, even your valuation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

paite: Numei ahihleh na sehdan ding shekel sawmthum ahih ding ahi.
english: If it is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

paite: Kum nga leh kum sawmnih kikal a upa ahihleh, na sehdan ding pasal, shekel sawmnih, numei, shekel sawm ahih ding ahi.
english: If the person is from five years old even to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

paite: Kha khat leh kum nga kikal a upa ahihleh, na sehdan ding pasal, dangka shekel nga, numei, shekel thum ahih ding ahi.
english: If the person is from a month old even to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

paite: Kum sawmguk a kipan atunglam ahihleh, na sehdan ding pasal, shekel sawm-le-nga, numei, shekel sawm ahih ding ahi.
english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if it is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

paite: "Himahleh na seh zah pe zou lou khop a mizawng ahihleh siampu kiang ah ava pai dia, siampu in anasep ding; thuchiammi zoh hun bangbang ana sep ding ahi.
english: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to the ability of him who vowed shall the priest value him.

paite: "Thillat, TOUPA kiang a alat ding uh gan ahihleh kuapeuh in TOUPA a dia huchibang apiak peuh uh siangthou ahih ding ahi.
english: “‘If it is an animal, of which men offer an offering to Yahweh, all that any man gives of such to Yahweh becomes holy.

paite: Ahihlamdang ding ahi kei, ahoih pen asia in, asia pen ahoih in akheng ding ahi sam kei. Gan pen gan mah a akhen teiteileh anih in asiangthou ding uhi.
english: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy.

paite: "Gan siang lou, TOUPA kiang a lat ngei louh chi ahihleh, gan pen siampu ma ah akoih ding ahi.
english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to Yahweh, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

paite: Siampu in ahoihdan bang in aman hun ana sep ding. Siampu in aseh bangbang ahi zel ding hi.
english: and the priest shall value it, whether it is good or bad. As you the priest values it, so shall it be.

paite: Himahleh atat nawn taktak dingleh na seh zah mun nga a khen mun khat abehlap ding ahi.
english: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

paite: "Mi'n a-inn TOUPA a tuam dia alat dingleh ahoih leh hoih louh dungzui in siampu in asep dia; siampu seh bang ahi ding.
english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to Yahweh, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad: as the priest shall evaluate it, so shall it stand.

paite: Alanmi in a-inn pen atat nawn dingleh aman ding ana seh zah mun nga a khen mun khat abehlap ding hi. Huchi in amah a ahi nawn ding hi.
english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

paite: "Mi'n agam a lou akhen TOUPA a tuam dia alat ding leh na sehdan ding achi tuh dungzui zel in ahi ding. Barli buh homer khat mun, dangka shekel sawmnga man ahi ding.
english: “‘If a man dedicates to Yahweh part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it: the sowing of a homer 1 homer is about 220 litres or 6 bushels of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

paite: Alou pen Jubili kum a pan lat ahihleh na seh bang ahitou pek ding.
english: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

paite: Jubili kum nung a lat ahihleh bel siampu in Jubili tun nawnna ding kum dungzui zel in aman asep dia, na sehdan a pan akiam hun bawl ahi ding.
english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

paite: Alanmi in atat nawn taktak ding leh aman na seh zah mun nga a khen mun khat abehlap dia, amah a ahi nawn ding hi.
english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

paite: Lou pen atat nop louh hiam, midang kiang a khot hiam ahihleh tat nawn theih ahi kei ding.
english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

paite: Jubili kum a apawt nawn hun in lou pen TOUPA a dia siangthou, amah a tuam siangthou ahi dia siampu a ahi ding hi.
english: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to Yahweh, as a field devoted; it shall be owned by the priests.

paite: "Amah lou him hilou, aleisa lou, mi'n TOUPA kiang a alatleh,
english: “‘If he dedicates to Yahweh a field which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

paite: Jubili kum tan in na sehdan bang in siampu in aman asehsak dia, na seh bang in TOUPA a dia siangthou hi ding in huai ni in ape ding hi.
english: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to Yahweh.

paite: Jubili kum in aleinapa, agamneipa mah in atang nawn ding.
english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

paite: "Na sehdan tengteng mun siangthou shekel bang zel ahi dia, gerah sawmnih shekel khat ahi ding.
english: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

paite: "Ganta lak a piang masapen, apian masakpen ziak a TOUPA a tuam dia sehsa peuhmah kuamah in alan ding ahi kei. Bawngtal leng belam leng hitaleh, TOUPA a tuam ahi.
english: “‘Only the firstborn among animals, which is made a firstborn to Yahweh, no man may dedicate it; whether an ox or sheep, it is Yahweh’s.

paite: Gan siang lou ahihleh na sehdan bang a tat ding ahi dia, amun nga a khen mun khat abehlap ding hi. Tat ahihkeileh, na sehdan bang a khot ding ahi.
english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it: or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

paite: "Mi'n aneih lak a bangpeuh, mihing hi in, ganta hiam, aneihsa lou hitaleh, TOUPA kiang a apiaksa zuak ding ahi kei a, tat ding leng ahi kei. Huai thil chih TOUPA a dia siangthoupen ahi.
english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing, that a man shall devote to Yahweh of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy to Yahweh.

paite: Kuapeuh si dia vai hawmsak, mihing lak a pan manthatsak ding, tat ding ahi kei, amah sihsak ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “‘No one devoted, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed; he shall surely be put to death.

paite: "Gamsung a sawm-a-khat peuhmah, gamsung a haichi hitaleh, singgah hitaleh, TOUPA a ahi. TOUPA a dia thil siangthou ahi.
english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is Yahweh’s. It is holy to Yahweh.

paite: Mi'n asawm-a-khat atat nopleh, mun nga a khen mun khat abehlap ding ahi.
english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

paite: Bawng leh belam sawm-a-khat thu ah, ganvulmi chiang a chiamtehsa nangawn leng, asawmna zel TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ding.
english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to Yahweh.

paite: Huai gan hoih hia, hoih lou, a-enchian ding ahi kei, akhek ding leng ahi sam kei. Akhekleh, akhek pen leh akhekna pen leng anih un siangthou ahi ding ua; tat ding ahi kei hi," achi hi.
english: He shall not search whether it is good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he changes it at all, then both it and that for which it is changed shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

paite: Hiaite Israel suante a dia TOUPA'N Sinai Tang a Mosi kiang a thupiakte ahi uhi.
english: These are the commandments which Yahweh commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

paite: “Huan a thillat, lemna thillat kithoihna ahih a, ganhon lak a alatleh, TOUPA ma ah gensiatbei alan ding ahi”.
english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings; if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before Yahweh.

paite: Athillat lutung ah akhut akoih dia, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah agou ding. Aaron tapa siampute'n maitam kimvel ah sisan atheh ding uhi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron’s sons, the priests shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

paite: Lemna thillat kithoihna, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat alan dia, asungkua, athau leh agilbom tengteng leh,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh atuamthau aphuk chin a omleh asin tuam lam, akalte toh kigawm in asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: Aaron tapate'n maitam ah mei a sing om tung a halmang thillat tung ah ahal ding uhi. Hiai TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, mei a thillat ahi.
english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: “Lemna thillat kithoihna a TOUPA a dia athillat belamhon lak ate ahihleh, anu leng hita hen aw, apa leng hitaleh, gensiatbei ahih ding ahi”.
english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh is from the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.

paite: Athillat a, belamnou alatleh TOUPA ma ah alan ding ahi.
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before Yahweh;

paite: Athillat lutung ah akhut akoih ding a, kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi ah agou ding. Aaron tapate'n maitam kimvel ah asisan atheh ding uhi.
english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting: and Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Lemna thillat kithoihnate, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat alan ding ahi. Athaute leh ameibul thau mahmah atawn in, akawngguh tan in ala vek ding a; asungkua thaute, agilbom tengtengte,
english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the inwards, and all the fat that is on the inwards,

paite: akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam alap, akalte nangawn toh asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: siampu in huai maitam ah ahal dia; hiai TOUPA a dia mei a thillat nek ding ansiah ahi.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: “Athillat kel ahihleh ToUPA ma ah alan ding ahi,
english: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before Yahweh:

paite: Alutung ah akhut akoih ding a, kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah agou ding”. Aaron tapate'n maitam kimvel in sisan atheh ding uhi.
english: and he shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

paite: Athillat pen alan dia, TOUPA a dia mei a thillat tak, asungkua thau leh agilbom tengteng leh,
english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam lam, akalte toh nangawn in asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

paite: Hiai siampu in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Gimlim dia mei a thillat nek ding ansiah ahi a; athau tengteng TOUPA a tuam ahi.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is Yahweh’s.

paite: Sathau hiam, sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei, chih na suante uh a ding in abanban in na tenna phot uah tangtawn a dan thuseh ahi ding," achi hi.
english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'TOUPA'N thilhih louh ding a thu apiakte, abangpeuh leng mi'n na hihkhial kha in, abangpeuh leng na hih taleh,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them:

paite: thaunilh siampu in thil ahihkhelh amipite tung a mohpaihna atunsakleh athilhihkhelhsa thoihna ding in TOUPA kiang ah ganhon lak a pan bawngtuai gensiatbei, khelh thoihna ding in lan hen,
english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin, which he has sinned, a young bull without blemish to Yahweh for a sin offering.

paite: Bawng pen kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah ahon kai dia, bawng lutung ah akhut akoih dia, TOUPA ma ah huai bawng agou ding ahi”.
english: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before Yahweh.

paite: Thaunilh siampu in bawng sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, kihoupihna biakbuk ah ahon tawi ding hi.
english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in sisan ah akhut adiah dia, akhenkhat TOUPA ma ah, mun siangthou puanzak bul ah sagihvei atheh ding ahi.
