english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, before the veil of the sanctuary.

paite: Siampu in TOUPA ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk a gimlimtak maitam kiite ah huai sisan bangzah hiam atat ding ahi. Bawng sisan tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kiang a halmang thillat maitam bul ah asungkhe ding ahi.
english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out all of rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawng thau tengteng, asungkua thau leh agilbom teng leng ala vek dia;
english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering off of it; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam alam, akal nihte nangawn toh asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away,

paite: Lemna thillat kithoihna bawngtal a kipan alak bang in, siampu in halmang thillat maitam ah ahal ding ahi.
english: as it is taken off of the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

paite: Bawngvunte, asa tengtengte, alu toh, akhete toh, asungkuate, a-ekte,
english: The bull’s skin, all its flesh, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung,

paite: abawng pumpi toh giahphual polam mun siang ah, vut paihna ah apaipih dia, sing tung ah ahal ding, vut paihna ahal ding ahi,' achi hi.
english: even the whole bull shall he carry forth outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. Where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.

paite: "Israel omkhawm tengteng in ahihkhelh khak ua, mipi mitmuh a sel ahih a, TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu apiakte, abang mahmah ahih ua,
english: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

paite: siam louh atan ua, athil gilou hih uh theihkhiak ahihleh, mipi in khelh thoihna ding in bawngtuai alan ding ua, kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah ahon kai ding uhi.
english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Upa omkhawmte'n TOUPA ma ah bawng lutung ah akhut uh akoih ding ua; TOUPA ma a huai bawng goh ding ahi.
english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before Yahweh; and the bull shall be killed before Yahweh.

paite: Thaunilh siampu in kihoupihna biakbuk ah bawng sisan bangzah hiam ahon tawi ding hi.
english: The anointed priest shall bring of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting:

paite: Siampu in huai sisan ah akhutzung adiah dia, puanzak bul ah TOUPA ma ah sagihvei atheh ding hi.
english: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.

paite: Sisan pen kihoupihna biakbuk a TOUPA ma ah maitam kii ah tam lou atat dia, sisan tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kiang a halmang thillat maitam bul ah asungkhe ding ahi.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before Yahweh, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Athau tengteng ala vek dia, maitam ah ahal ding.
english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

paite: Huchibang in bawng pen ahih dia; khelh thoihna bawng ahih bang geih in hiai leng ahih ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in kilemna abawl ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding uhi.
english: Thus shall he do with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so shall he do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

paite: Huai bawng giahphual pua ah apaipih dia, bawng masa ahal bang in ahal ding hi. Hiai mipi a dia khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall carry forth the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

paite: "Vaihawmtu in thil ahihkhelh a, TOUPA a Pathian in hih louh ding a thu apiakte abang pen hiam ahihkhak a, siam louh atan a,
english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which Yahweh his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty;

paite: athil gilou hih atheihleh athillat ding in kelpa gensiatbei ahon kai ding ahi.
english: if his sin, in which he has sinned, is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without blemish.

paite: Kel lutung ah akhut akoih dia, TOUPA ma ah halmang thillat agoh zelna uah agou ding hi”. Hiai khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna sisan akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, maitam kiite ah halmang thillat atat dia, halmang thillat maitam bul ah asisan asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

paite: Athau tengteng, lemna thillat kithoihna thau ahal bang in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in akhelhna tungthu ah siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Vantang lak a mi, akuamah mah in TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu apiakte abangmah hihkhial in, siam louh na tangleh,
english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and is guilty;

paite: athil gilou hih atheihleh athillat ding in kelnu gensiatbei, athilhihkhelhsa khelh thoihna ding in ahon kai ding hi”.
english: if his sin, which he has sinned, is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has sinned.

paite: "Khelh thoihna lutung ah akhut akoih dia, halmang thillatna mun ah khelh thoihna agou ding hi”.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

paite: Siampu in asisan, akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, halmang thillat maitam kiite ah atat dia, asisan tengteng maitam bul ah asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng lemna thillat kithoihna thau alak bang in ala vek ding hi. Siampu in TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from off of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Khelh thoihna dia athillat ding belamnou ahon tawileh, anu, gensiatbei ahon tawi ding ahi”.
english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish.

paite: Khelh thoihna lutung ah akhut akoih dia, halmang thillat agohna uah khelhna thoihna ding in agou ding hi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna sisan akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, halmang thillat maitam kiite ah atat dia, sisan tengteng maitam bul ah asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng, belamnou thau, lemna thillat kithoihna alak bang in ala vek ding a, siampu in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat bang in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in athilhihkhelhsa tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Huan kuapeuh athil muh hiam, athil zak hiam a dia theihpih ahih a, kichiamsakmi aw azak a leng gen nuam lou a, thil ahihkhelhleh athulimlouhna moh apo ding”.
english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears the voice of adjuration, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thilsiang lou himhim, gamsa siang lou luang hiam, gan siang lou luang hiam, avakthoh ganhing siang lou luang hiam thei lou a, akhoihkhakleh, siang lou leh mohtang ahi ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

paite: "Mihing leng asianlouhna bangpeuh hi hen aw, asianlouhna thei lou a, akhoihleh atheihkhiak hun in siam louh atang ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil hoih lou hiam, thil hoih hiam hih dia, akam a thei lou a, akichiam zialzialleh, akoi abang hitaleh, akichiam zialzialna atheihkhiak hun in siam louh atang ding hi”.
english: “‘Or if anyone swears rashly with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatever it is that a man might utter rashly with an oath, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty of one of these.

paite: "Huan hichi ahi ding a, hiai thilte khat a leng siam louh atan chiang in akhelhna apuang ding ahi.
english: It shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, he shall confess that in which he has sinned:

paite: Khelh thoihna ding in belamhon lak ah anu, belamnou hiam kel hiam, athilhihkhelhsa man ding in TOUPA kiang a lat ding in khelhna thoihna ahon tawi dia; siampu in akhelh tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak ding ahi”.
english: and he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh for his sin which he has sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin.

paite: "Aneih in belamnou achin zoh keileh TOUPA kiang a lat ding in akhelh man ding in akhelh thoihna ding in vakhu nih hiam, vapalnou hiam ahon tawi ding ahi. Khat, khelh thoihna ding in, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in.
english: “‘If he can’t afford a lamb, then he shall bring his trespass offering for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, to Yahweh; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

paite: Siampu kiang ah ahon tawi dia, ama'n khelh thoihna ding in alan masa dia, phelkhap lou in angawng ah alu ahektan ding hi.
english: He shall bring them to the priest, who shall first offer the one which is for the sin offering, and wring off its head from its neck, but shall not sever it completely.

paite: Khelh thoihna sisan maitam pang ah tam lou atheh dia, asisan om lai teng maitam bul ah atakkangsak ding hi. Hiai khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be drained out at the base of the altar. It is a sin offering.

paite: Akhat pen dan dungzui in halmang thillat ding in alan dia; siampu in athilhihkhelhsa tungthu ah lemna abawlsak dia”, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the ordinance; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin which he has sinned, and he shall be forgiven.

paite: "Himahleh vakhu nih hiam, vapalnou nih hiam aneih zoh keileh akhelh man thillat ding leh khelh thoihna ding in tangbuang nel dimdem, ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat ahon tawi ding hi. Sathau a buak ding ahi kei a, atung ah begaw akoih ding ahi kei; khelh thoihna ahih ziak in.
english: “‘But if he can’t afford two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he shall bring his offering for that in which he has sinned, the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it, neither shall he put any frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

paite: Siampu kiang ah ahon tawi dia, siampu in theihgigena ding in apham khat ala dia, maitam tung ah TOUPA a ding in mei a thillat bang in ahal ding ahi. Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi.
english: He shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it as the memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. It is a sin offering.

paite: Huai thillak a abangmah leng ahihkhelhsa tungtang thu ah siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding. A-om lai teng tangbuang thillat bangmah in siampu tantuam ahi ding," achi hi.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned in any of these things, and he will be forgiven; and the rest shall be the priest’s, as the meal offering.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelh a, TOUPA thil siangthoute tung a akhelh khakleh, akhelh thoihna, belamhon lak a belampa gensiatbei, Mun siangthou shekel bang in, dangka shekel bangzah hiam gun a ngaih, tatlek kithoihna ding in TOUPA a ding in ahon kai ding ahi.
english: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly, in the holy things of Yahweh; then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

paite: Thil siangthou tung a ana hihdiklouh khitsa pen adin dia, amun nga a khen mun khat abehlap dia, siampu ape ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in tatlek thoihna belampa in kilemna abawlsak dia”, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall make restitution for that which he has done wrong in the holy thing, and shall add a fifth part to it, and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Kuapeuh in thil ahihkhelh a, hih louh dia TOUPA'N thu apiakte khatpeuh ahihleh, thei kei mahleh siam louh atang himhim dia, athulimlouhna moh apo ding ahi.
english: “If anyone sins, and does any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done; though he didn’t know it, yet he is guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

paite: Belamhon lak a belampa gensiatbei, aman kilawm hun, tatlek thoihna ding in siampu kiang ah ahon kai ding ahi. Siampu in theiloupi a hihkhelh khak tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding.
english: He shall bring a ram without blemish from of the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning the thing in which he sinned and didn’t know it, and he will be forgiven.

paite: Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi a; TOUPA ma ah talek mah ahi," achi hi.
english: It is a trespass offering. He is certainly guilty before Yahweh.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Kuapeuh in thil hihkhial in, TOUPA thu kalh in talek taleh, sum kepsak thu ah hiam, lep thu ah hiam, guktak thu ah hiam a-invengte khem in, a-invengte zuaubawl taleh,
english: “If anyone sins, and commits a trespass against Yahweh, and deals falsely with his neighbor in a matter of deposit, or of bargain, or of robbery, or has oppressed his neighbor,

paite: ahihkeileh, vanmangte mu in, khem in, zuau in kichiam taleh, hiai thil tengteng akhatpeuh leng hihkhial taleh,
english: or has found that which was lost, and dealt falsely therein, and swearing to a lie; in any of all these things that a man does, sinning therein;

paite: hichi ahi ding a, akhial ngei ahih a, siam louh atanleh avan gukte, khem a athillakte, akiang a kepsak sumte, vanmang atopte,
english: then it shall be, if he has sinned, and is guilty, he shall restore that which he took by robbery, or the thing which he has gotten by oppression, or the deposit which was committed to him, or the lost thing which he found,

paite: zuau a kichiamna thil bangpeuh leng adit nawn ding ahi. Akim sipsip in adin nawn vek ding a, amun nga a khen mun khat val in abehlap ding. Siam louh atan ni in aneitu ape ding ahi.
english: or any thing about which he has sworn falsely; he shall restore it even in full, and shall add a fifth part more to it. To him to whom it belongs he shall give it, in the day of his being found guilty.

paite: Atatlek thoihna, belamhon lak a, aman kilawm hun, belampa gensiatbei tatlek thoihna ding in TOUPA a ding in siampu kiang ah ahon kai ding ahi.
english: He shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your estimation, for a trespass offering, to the priest.

paite: Siampu in TOUPA ma ah kilemna abawlsak ding a, siam louh tanna ding a thil ahih peuhmah tungthu ah, ngaihdam ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: The priest shall make atonement for him before Yahweh, and he will be forgiven concerning whatever he does to become guilty.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, hiai halmang thillat dan ding ahi. Haltum thillat pen maitam tung a, ahalna ah zankhua in azingchiang tan in a-om dia; maitam a mei akuang nilouh ding ahi.
english: “Command Aaron and his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the burnt offering: the burnt offering shall be on the hearth on the altar all night until the morning; and the fire of the altar shall be kept burning on it.

paite: Siampu in apuanmalngat puansilh asilh dia, asa khuhna ding in apuanmalngat khekol ateng dia; maitam a halmang thillat kangvute ala dia, maitam pang ah akoih ding ahi.
english: The priest shall put on his linen garment, and he shall put on his linen breeches upon his body; and he shall remove the ashes from where the fire has consumed the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

paite: Apuansilh siangthou asuah dia, puansilh dang asilh dia, avute giahphual pua mun siangthou ah apaipih ding ahi.
english: He shall take off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry the ashes outside the camp to a clean place.

paite: Maitam tung ah mei kuansak nilouh ahi dia, amit ding ahi kei. Siampu in zingsang teng in sing akhul dia, halmang thillat akoih hoih dia, huai ah kilemna thillatte thau ahal ding ahi.
english: The fire on the altar shall be kept burning on it, it shall not go out; and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning: and he shall lay the burnt offering in order upon it, and shall burn on it the fat of the peace offerings.

paite: Maitam ah mei akuang gige dia, amit ding ahi kei hi.
english: Fire shall be kept burning on the altar continually; it shall not go out.

paite: "Hiai tangbuang thillatdan ding ahi. Aaron tapate'n maitam bul ah, TOUPA ma ah alan ding uh ahi.
english: “‘This is the law of the meal offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before Yahweh, before the altar.

paite: Ama'n apham khat in tangbuang thillat tung a begaw tengteng alakhe dia, TOUPA a dia gimlimtak, theihgigena ding in maitam ah ahal ding hi.
english: He shall take from there his handful of the fine flour of the meal offering, and of its oil, and all the frankincense which is on the meal offering, and shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma, as its memorial, to Yahweh.

paite: Alak bangte Aaron leh atapate'n ane ding uhi. Huai mun siangthou ah silngou soh louh in ane ding ua; kihoupihna biakbuk kongtual ah ane ding uh ahi.
english: That which is left of it Aaron and his sons shall eat. It shall be eaten without yeast in a holy place. They shall eat it in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Silngou toh akan ding uh ahi kei. Mei a ka thillat atantuan ding ua ka piak ahi. Huai khelh thoihna leh tatlek thoihna bang a siangthoupen ahi.
english: It shall not be baked with yeast. I have given it as their portion of my offerings made by fire. It is most holy, as the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

paite: Aaron suan pasal tengteng in anek ding uh ahi. Hiai TOUPA a dia halmang thillat tungthu a na suante zel uh tan a tangtawn dan ahi ding. Kuapeuh hiaite khoih peuhmah asiangthou ding uh, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
english: Every male among the children of Aaron shall eat of it, as their portion forever throughout your generations, from the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. Whoever touches them shall be holy.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Thaunilh a, a-om ni ua, Aaron leh atapate'n TOUPA kiang a alat ding uh thillat hiai ahi. Tangbuang thillat dia lat zel ding, tangbuang nel dimdem ephah sawm a khen mun khat, zingsang in akim, nitak in akim.
english: “This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer to Yahweh in the day when he is anointed: the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering perpetually, half of it in the morning, and half of it in the evening.

paite: Sathau in kuangdai sung ah na kang dia, sathau a akidiah suak khit chiang in na hon lalut dia; na balnen dia, tangbuang thillat TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in na lan ding ahi.
english: It shall be made with oil in a griddle. When it is soaked, you shall bring it in. You shall offer the meal offering in baked pieces for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Atapate lak a, asik a pangmi, thaunilh siampu in alan dia; tangtawn dan thuseh ding in TOUPA a dia halmang vek ding ahi.
english: The anointed priest that will be in his place from among his sons shall offer it. By a statute forever, it shall be wholly burnt to Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in tangbuang thillat a lat peuhmah halmang vek ding ahi a, nek het louh ding ahi," achi hi.
english: Every meal offering of a priest shall be wholly burned. It shall not be eaten.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hiai khelh thoihna dan ding ahi. Haltum thillat goh zelna ah khelh thoihna leng TOUPA ma a goh ding ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is the law of the sin offering: in the place where the burnt offering is killed, the sin offering shall be killed before Yahweh. It is most holy.

paite: Khelh thoihna lantu siampu in ane dia; kihoupihna biakbuk kongtual ah, mun siangthou ah ane ding ahi.
english: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it. It shall be eaten in a holy place, in the court of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kuapeuh huai sa khoih peuhmah asiangthou ding ahi. Asisan pen bang puan peuh a theh ahihleh, abanna peuhmah mun siangthou ah na sawp ding ahi.
english: Whatever shall touch its flesh shall be holy. When there is any of its blood sprinkled on a garment, you shall wash that on which it was sprinkled in a holy place.

paite: Ahuanna leibel pen sukkhap ding ahi. Sumbel a huan ahihleh bel nawtsiang a khuahsiang ding ahi.
english: But the earthen vessel in which it is boiled shall be broken; and if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, it shall be scoured, and rinsed in water.

paite: Pasal siampu tengteng in huai ane ding uh ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: Every male among the priests shall eat of it: it is most holy.

paite: Khelh thoihna sisan, Mun Siangthou a kilemna bawlna dia kihoupihna puanin a hong kitawi pen nek ding ahi kei, mei a halmang ding ahi.
english: No sin offering, of which any of the blood is brought into the Tent of Meeting to make atonement in the Holy Place, shall be eaten: it shall be burned with fire.

paite: "Huchi mah bang in hiai tatlek thoihdan ding ahi. Thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: “‘This is the law of the trespass offering. It is most holy.

paite: Haltum thillat agoh zelna ua tatlek kithoihna leng goh ding ahi a; asisan a maitam theh kimvel ding ahi.
english: In the place where they kill the burnt offering, he shall kill the trespass offering; and its blood he shall sprinkle around on the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng alat ding ahi. Amei thautakte, asungkua thaute,
english: He shall offer all of its fat: the fat tail, and the fat that covers the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh aboh thau, aphuk kiang a thau leh asin tuam lap, akalte nangawn in asuahkhe ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, shall he take away;

paite: Siampu in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ding in maitam tung ah ahal ding ahi. Hiai tatlek thoihna ahi.
english: and the priest shall burn them on the altar for an offering made by fire to Yahweh: it is a trespass offering.

paite: Pasal siampu tengteng in ane ding ua; mun siangthou a nek ding ahi. Hiai thil siangthoupen ahi.
english: Every male among the priests may eat of it. It shall be eaten in a holy place. It is most holy.

paite: "Tatlek thoihna pen khelh thoihna mah bang ahi a, dan khat ahi. Kilepna bawltu siampu in huai atang ding hi.
english: “‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with them shall have it.

paite: Siampu, kuapeuh halmang thillat latsaktu siampu ngei in halmang thillat dia alat vun apum tan ding ahi.
english: The priest who offers any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have for himself the skin of the burnt offering which he has offered.

paite: Akanna a kan tangbuang thillat peuhmah, sikbel a kan leh kuang a kan tengteng alantu siampu atuam ding ahi.
english: Every meal offering that is baked in the oven, and all that is dressed in the pan, and on the griddle, shall be the priest’s who offers it.

paite: Tangbuang thillat tengteng sathau a mek leng, agaw leng adang mah bang in Aaron tapa tengteng akihawm dialdial ding uh ahi.
english: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.

paite: "Hiai pen mi'n TOUPA kiang a alat ding, lemna thillat a kithoihdan ding ahi.
english: “‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh.

paite: Kipahthu genna dia alatleh kipahthu genna kithoihna ding in sathau a zut, silngou soh louh tanghou leh sathau a zut silngou soh louh tanghou pa didekte leh sathau a mek tangbuang nel mahmah kidiah suak a lat tel ding ahi.
english: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mixed with oil.

paite: "Kipahthu genna dia lemna thillat kithoihna ah tanghou silngou soh alat tel ding ahi.
english: With cakes of leavened bread he shall offer his offering with the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving.

paite: Huai athillat teng a TOUPA a dia vei thillat a ding in khat chiat alan dia; lemna thillat sisan a thehtu siampu a tuam ding ahi.
english: Of it he shall offer one out of each offering for a heave offering to Yahweh. It shall be the priest’s who sprinkles the blood of the peace offerings.

paite: Kipahthu genna dia alemna thillat kithoihna sa pen thillat alat ni mah a nekgaih ding ahi. Azingchiang tan a bangmah asit ding ahi kei.
english: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall not leave any of it until the morning.

paite: "Himahleh athillat kithoihna pen thuchiam hiam, amah ut thu a thillat hiam ahihleh kithoihna alat ni mah a nek ding ahi a; nek bang azingchiang a nek ding ahi.
english: “‘But if the sacrifice of his offering is a vow, or a freewill offering, it shall be eaten on the day that he offers his sacrifice; and on the next day what remains of it shall be eaten:

paite: Himahleh kithoihna sa, ani thum ni tan a-om lailaileh hal ding ahi.
english: but what remains of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burned with fire.

paite: Alemna thillat kithoihna sa ani thum ni tan a anek uleh, pomsak ahi kei dia, alantu leng alan a sim ahi kei ding. Thilkihhuai ahi dia, kuapeuh ane in athulimlouhna moh uh apo ding hi.
english: If any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed to him who offers it. It will be an abomination, and the soul who eats any of it will bear his iniquity.

paite: Thilsiang lou himhim toh kisukha sa nek ding ahi kei, hal ding ahi. Sa siang peuhmah nek ding ahi.
english: “‘The flesh that touches any unclean thing shall not be eaten. It shall be burned with fire. As for the flesh, everyone who is clean may eat it;

paite: Himahleh lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam, siang lou nemi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: but the soul who eats of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that belongs to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from his people.

paite: Kuapeuh in thilsiang lou himhim, misiang lou hiam, gan siang lou hiam, thilkihhuai siang lou himhim akhoih a, lemna thillat kithoihna sa, TOUPA a tuam anekleh huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi, chi in Aaron leh atapate houpih in," achi hi.
english: When anyone touches any unclean thing, the uncleanness of man, or an unclean animal, or any unclean abomination, and eats some of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which belong to Yahweh, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam thau na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘You shall eat no fat, of bull, or sheep, or goat.

paite: Amah sih a si thau leh gamsa balzan thau thil dang a dia zat ding ahi. Na ne himhim ding uh ahi kei.
english: The fat of that which dies of itself, and the fat of that which is torn of animals, may be used for any other service, but you shall in no way eat of it.

paite: Kuapeuh, TOUPA a dia mi'n mei thillat alat uh sathau nemi, achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: For whoever eats the fat of the animal, of which men offer an offering made by fire to Yahweh, even the soul who eats it shall be cut off from his people.

paite: Na tenna peuh uah sisan himhim, vasa hiam, gamsa hiam sisan hiam na ne ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.

paite: Kuapeuh hitaleh, sisan ne himhim achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi, chi in Israel suante houpih in," achi hi.
english: Whoever it is who eats any blood, that soul shall be cut off from his people.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"TOUPA kiang a lemna thillat kithoihna lan peuhmah in, TOUPA a dia athillat, alemna thillat kithoihna a pan ahong lat ding ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘He who offers the sacrifice of his peace offerings to Yahweh shall bring his offering to Yahweh out of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

paite: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat amah khut mahmah in ahon tawi ding a; athau leh a-awm ahon la ding ahi; a-awm pen TOUPA ma a vei thillat ding a vei ahihtheihna ding in.
english: With his own hands he shall bring the offerings of Yahweh made by fire. He shall bring the fat with the breast, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Siampu in maitam ah athau ahal dia, a-awm bel Aaron leh atapate a tuam ding ahi.
english: The priest shall burn the fat on the altar, but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

paite: Aliang taklam pen kilemna thillat kithoihna a pan vei thillat dia siampu na piak ding uh ahi.
english: The right thigh you shall give to the priest for a heave offering out of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

paite: Aaron tapate lak a lemna thillat sisan leh thau lantu kuapeuh in atantuan ding in aliang taklam atang ding ahi.
english: He among the sons of Aaron who offers the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right thigh for a portion.

paite: A-awm leh aliang avei lel pen uh Israel suante a lemna thillat kithoihna a pan ka la tuam a, Israel suante tangtawn dan thuseh ding in siampu Aaron leh atapate ka pia ahi, chi in Israel suante kiang ah gen in," achi hi.
english: For the waved breast and the heaved thigh I have taken from the children of Israel out of the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as their portion forever from the children of Israel.’”

paite: Hiai ahi, siampu nasem dia TOUPA kiang a lat ahih nungsiah TOUPA a dia mei a thillat a pan Aaron tantuan leh atapate tantuan ding,
english: This is the anointing portion of Aaron, and the anointing portion of his sons, out of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister to Yahweh in the priest’s office;

paite: amau thau anilh ni a Israel suante'n dan thuseh a apiak gige ding ua TOUPA'N thu apiak. Hiai tangtawn a asuan hong om zel dingte tan a ahihdan ding uh ahi.
english: which Yahweh commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them. It is their portion forever throughout their generations.

paite: Hiai ahi halmang thillat, tang- buang thillat, khelh thoihna leh tatlek kithoihna dan.
english: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meal offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecration, and of the sacrifice of peace offerings;

paite: Sinai gamdai a Israel suante'n thillat TOUPA kiang a alat ding ua thu apiak ni a Sinai Tang a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak ahi.
english: which Yahweh commanded Moses in Mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their offerings to Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron atapate toh pi inla, puansilhte, nilhchi sathau, khelh thoihna bawngtalte, belampa nihte, tanghou silngou soh louh bawm khat toh tawi inla,
english: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

paite: Omkhawmte tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kim ah paikhawmsak in," achi hi.
english: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

paite: TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Mosi in ahih a; omkhawmte tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kim ah a-omkhawm uhi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Mosi in omkhawmte kiang ah, "Hiai ahi, TOUPA'N hih dia ahon thupiak pen," achi hi.
english: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”

paite: Mosi in Aaron leh atapate ahon pi a, tui in amaute asil hi.
english: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

paite: Puanak asilhsak a, kawnggakna in agak a, puanaktual asilhsak a, siampu puanak in atuam a, siampu puanak gakna siamtak a gat in agak a, huai in agakbelh hi.
english: He put the coat on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him, and fastened it to him with it.

paite: Awmtuamna athuah a, awmtuamna ah Urim leh Thummim akoih hi.
english: He placed the breastplate on him; and in the breastplate he put the Urim and the Thummim.

paite: Dial akhimsak a, dial tung ah dangka-eng sikpek abulh a, huai mailam ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in siampu lukhu siangthou akilhbelh hi.
english: He set the turban on his head; and on the turban, in front, he set the golden plate, the holy crown; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Mosi in nilhchi sathau ala a, biakbuk leh asung a thil om teng-teng anilh a, asiangthousak chiat hi.
english: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

paite: Huai mah in sagihvei maitam atheh a, maitam leh atui-um belsuan tengteng, maiphiatna kuang leh atunna siangthousak ding in anilh hi.
english: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

paite: Huai sathau Aaron lu ah abuak a asianthouna ding in anilh hi.
english: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

paite: Mosi in Aaron tapate ahon pi a, puanak sungsilh tualte asilhsak a, kawnggakna in agak a, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in dial akhimsak hi.
english: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with coats, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawngtal ahon kai a, Aaron leh atapate'n khelh thoihna ding bawngtal lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

paite: Agou a; Mosi in asisan ala a, huai maitam a dia kilemna bawlna ding in akhutzung in maitam kii ah akimvel in atat a, maitam asiangsak a, maitam bul ah sisan sung in asiangthousak hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

paite: Agilbom tengteng, asin, alap, akal nihte leh athau ala a, maitam tung ah Mosi in ahal hi.
english: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

paite: Bawngtal pen avun toh, asa toh, a-ek toh giahphual pua ah ahal hi; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: But the bull, and its skin, and its flesh, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Haltum thillat belampa pen alan a, Aaron leh atapate'n belampa lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He presented the ram of the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Agou a, Mosi in maitam sisan in akimvel in atheh hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

paite: Belampa asem a, alu, asemnente leh athau ahal hi.
english: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

paite: Asungkua leh akhete asil a; belampa pen maitam ah avek in ahal hi. Huai gimlim dia halmang thillat ahi a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Belampa dang, hihtuamna belampa pen ahon la nawn a, Aaron leh atapate'n belampa lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Mosi in agou a, asisan ala a, Aaron bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi anuh hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

paite: Mosi in Aaron tapate api a, abil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi, akhe taklam khepi anuh a, maitam sisan in akimvel ah atheh hi.
english: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

paite: Athaute, amei thau, agilbom tengteng asin tuam pen alapte, akal nih leh athau leh aliang taklam ala hi:
english: He took the fat, and the fat tail, and all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right thigh;

paite: TOUPA ma a tanghou silngou soh louh bawm a pan tanghou silngou soh louh khat leh sathau a mek tanghou pei khat leh tanghou peipa'n khat ala a, thau tung leh aliang taklam tung ah akoih hi.
english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat, and on the right thigh.

paite: Avek in Aaron khutpek tung ah leh atapate khutpek tung ah akoih a, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in avei hi.
english: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in akhut a pan ala a, halmang thillat tung ah maitam ah ahal hi. Huai gimlim dia ahihtuamna ahi. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in a-awm ala a, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in avei a; hihtuamna belampa Mosi tantuam ahi, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Mosi in nilhchi sathau a pan tam lou leh maitam asisan tam lou ala a, huai in Aaron leh apuansilhte atheh a; atapate leh atapate puansilhte leng atheh hi. Aaron leh apuansilh ahihsiangthou a, atapate leh atapate puansilhte leng ahihsiangthou hi.
english: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

paite: Mosi in Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, "Kihoupihna puanin kongpi bul ah sa huan unla, Aaron leh atapate'n anek ding uh ahi, chi a thu ka piak bang in, huai ah hihtuamna bawm a tanghou toh ne uhen.
english: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the flesh at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

paite: Sa leh tanghou nekbangte na hal ding uh ahi.
english: What remains of the flesh and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

paite: Na kihihtuamna ni uh achin masiah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi pawtsan lou in ni sagih na om ding uh ahi. Ni sagih sung nou hon hihtuam ding ahi ngal a.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

paite: Tuni a ahihsa bang in, nou a dia kilemna hon bawlsak ding in TOUPA'N thu apeta hi.
english: What has been done this day, so Yahweh has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

paite: Huaiziak in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah ni sagih, sun leh zan in na om nilouh ding ua, na sihlouhna ding ua TOUPA thupiak na zuih ding uh ahi; huchibang ding a thu piak ahi,” achi hi.
english: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi zang a ahih ding ua thu apiak tengteng Aaron leh atapate'n ahih uhi.
english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani giat ni in Mosi in Aaron leh atapate leh Israel upate asam hi.
english: It happened on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

paite: Aaron kiang ah, "Khelh thoihna ding in bawngnoupa leh halmang thillat ding in belampa gensiatbei tuaktuak kai inla, TOUPA ma ah lan in," achi hi.
english: and he said to Aaron, “Take a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before Yahweh.

paite: "Israel suante kiang ah, 'Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa, halmang thillat ding in bawngnou leh belamnou kum khat a upa tuaktuak gensiatbei tuak
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Take a male goat for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both a year old, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

paite: leh bawngtal leh belampa, sathau a mek tangbuang thillat toh TOUPA ma a lemna thillat a lat ding in hon kai un.' Tuni in na kiang uah TOUPA ahong kilang ding hi, chi in hilh in,” achi hi.
english: and a bull and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before Yahweh; and a meal offering mixed with oil: for today Yahweh appears to you.’”

paite: Mosi in thu apiak bang in kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah ahon kai ua; TOUPA ma ah omkhawmte tengteng in ava naih ua, ava dingh uhi.
english: They brought what Moses commanded before the Tent of Meeting: and all the congregation drew near and stood before Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in, “Hiai ahi na hih ding ua Toupa'n thu ahon piak, na lak uah TOUPA thupina ahong kilang ding," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “This is the thing which Yahweh commanded that you should do: and the glory of Yahweh shall appear to you.”

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Maitam hon naih inla, na khelh thoihna leh na halmang thillat lan inla, nang a ding leh mipite a ding in kilemna bawl in. Mipite thillat pen lan inla, amau a ding in kilemna bawl in, TOUPA thupiak bang in,” achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Draw near to the altar, and offer your sin offering, and your burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself, and for the people; and offer the offering of the people, and make atonement for them; as Yahweh commanded.”

paite: Aaron in maitam ava naih a, amah a tuam khelh thoihna bawngnou agou hi.
english: So Aaron drew near to the altar, and killed the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

paite: Aaron tapate'n akiang ah sisan ahon tawi ua, huai sisan ah akhutzung adiah a, maitam kiite ah atat a, sisan pen maitam bul ah asung hi.
english: The sons of Aaron presented the blood to him; and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar:

paite: Himahleh, khelh thoihna thau, akalte leh asin tuam pen lapte, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in maitam tung ah ahal hi.
english: but the fat, and the kidneys, and the cover from the liver of the sin offering, he burned upon the altar; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Asa leh avun giahphual pua ah ahal hi.
english: The flesh and the skin he burned with fire outside the camp.

paite: Haltum thillat pen agou a; Aaron tapate'n asisan apia ua, ama'n maitam kimvel in atheh hi.
english: He killed the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons delivered the blood to him, and he sprinkled it around on the altar.

paite: Haltum thillat sabakte leh alu apia ua, ama'n maitam ah ana hal hi.
english: They delivered the burnt offering to him, piece by piece, and the head: and he burned them upon the altar.

paite: Asungkuate leh akhete asil a, maitam ah halmang thillat tung ah ahal hi.
english: He washed the innards and the legs, and burned them on the burnt offering on the altar.

paite: Mipite thillat pen alan a, mipite khelh thoihna kel akai a, agou a, ama a mah bang in khelh thoihna ding in alan hi.
english: He presented the people’s offering, and took the goat of the sin offering which was for the people, and killed it, and offered it for sin, like the first.

paite: Haltum thillat alan a, adan bang in alan hi.
english: He presented the burnt offering, and offered it according to the ordinance.

paite: Tangbuang thillat alan a, huai a pan pham khat ala a, zingsang a halmang thillat chih louh leng maitam ah ahal lai hi.
english: He presented the meal offering, and filled his hand from there, and burned it upon the altar, besides the burnt offering of the morning.

paite: Mipite atuam dia lemna thillat kithoihna bawngtal leh belampa leng agou a, Aaron tapate'n asisan apia ua, maitam kimvel ah atheh hi.
english: He also killed the bull and the ram, the sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons delivered to him the blood, which he sprinkled around on the altar,

paite: Bawngtal thau leh belampa thau, amei thau, agilbomte, akalte, asin tuam pen alapte leng apia uhi.
english: and the fat of the bull and of the ram, the fat tail, and that which covers the innards, and the kidneys, and the cover of the liver:

paite: Athau pen a-awmte tung ah akoih a, ama'n athau pen maitam ah ahal hi.
english: and they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burned the fat on the altar:

paite: A-awm leh aliang taklam pen, Mosi thupiak bang in Aaron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in avei hi.
english: and the breasts and the right thigh Aaron waved for a wave offering before Yahweh, as Moses commanded.

paite: Aaron in mipi lam ah aban azak a, avek un avualzawl hi. Khelh thoihna, halmang thillat leh lemna thillat alat zoh in ahong paisuk hi.
english: Aaron lifted up his hands toward the people, and blessed them; and he came down from offering the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and the peace offerings.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin ah Mosi leh Aaron ava lut ua, ahong pawtkhe nawn ua, mipite avualzawl uhi. TOUPA thupina mi tengteng kiang ah ahong kilang hi.
english: Moses and Aaron went into the Tent of Meeting, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to all the people.

paite: TOUPA ma a pan mei ahong pawtkhia a, halmang thillat leh thaute maitam ah akangtumta hi. Mipi tengteng in huai amuh un akikou zuazua ua, lei si in abokkhup uhi.
english: There came forth fire from before Yahweh, and consumed the burnt offering and the fat upon the altar: and when all the people saw it, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

paite: Israel kiang a TOUPA kilakna Malaki in amuh.
english: An oracle: the word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. to Israel by Malachi.

paite: "Ka hon itta," TOUPA'N achi. Nou bel, "Koi lai ah ahia nang kou na hon it tak?" na chi uhi, "Esau, Jakob unaupa ahi kei maw? Hinapi in, Jakob ka it hi."
english: “I have loved you,” says Yahweh. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says Yahweh, “Yet I loved Jacob;

paite: Himahleh Esau ka hua a, atang sangte ka hihgawp a, gamdai sehalte kiang ah agoutan ka peta hi, TOUPA'N achi.
english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

paite: Edom in, "Suk zawngkhal in i om ua, himahleh i kik nawn ding ua mun kisegawpsate i lam ding uh," chi mahleh, hichibang in sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Alam nawn ding ua, himahleh ka chimsak ding; mite'n amaute gitlouhna gam leh mipi atung ua tangtawn a TOUPA hehna nam," achi ding uhi.
english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places”; thus says Yahweh of Armies, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom Yahweh shows wrath forever.”

paite: Huchi in na mitte un amu dia, "Israel gamgi khen ah TOUPA letsak in om hen," na chi ding uhi.
english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “Yahweh is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”

paite: "Tapa in apa azahtak a, sikha in apu; huchi apa ka hihleh, kei zahtakna koi a om ahia? Huchi a pu ka hihleh, kei kihtakna koi a om ahia? Sepaihte' TOUPA'N na kiang uah achi, siampu ka min musitte aw. Nou koi lai ah ahia na min ka muhsit uh? na chi uhi.
english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me? Says Yahweh of Armies to you, priests, who despise my name. You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

paite: Ka maitam tung ah tanghou sesa na lan ua, nou koi lai ah ahia ka hon hihnit uh? na chi uh. TOUPA dohkan asimmohhuai, na chihna uah.
english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table contemptible.’

paite: Kithoihna ding a mittaw na lat un, gilou ahi kei maw? Khebai leh damlou na lat un, gilou ahi kei maw? Tu in na ukpipa kiang ah pe mah dih ua, ama'n apom in na tung ah alungdam diam? Ahihkeileh nou ahon deihsak diam?" sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huchi in tu in ka hon ngen hi, i tung a azahngaihna na theihna ding un Pathian deihsakna ngen un. Hiai na khut ua kipan thilpiak toh nou hon deihsak diam? sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” , that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Athawn a ka maitam tung a mei na tohlouhna ding un, na lak ua mi khat kongkhakte khak ding omleh aw; Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Nou ah kipahna ka nei kei a, na khut ua kipan in thillat leng ka sang sam kei ding.
english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

paite: Nisuahna a kipan nitumna lam pha hial in leng namte lak ah ka min athupi hi, mun chih ah ka min a ding in gimlim akilan a, thillat siangthou; namte lak a ka min alet ziak in, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: For from the rising of the sun even to the going down of the same, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering: for my name is great among the nations,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Himahleh nou na hihnin ua, TOUPA dohkan anin a, huai a agah toh an nangawn azahpihhuai na chihna uah.
english: “But you profane it, in that you say, ‘Yahweh’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

paite: 'Ngai un, nak chimtakhuai hina e; na chi lai ua, huan na hahchhiai khum uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, hiamgamtak a lak hiam ahihkeileh khebaite leh damloute huchibang thillat na hon tawi uh; na khut ua kipan in hiaite sang peuhmah ding ka diam?' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ and you have sniffed at it,” says Yahweh of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh aganhon lak a apa nei a, thuchiam a TOUPA lak a thil demkai a kithoih, mikhempa hamsiat in om heh; Kumpipa thupi ka hi a, namte lak ah ka min alauhuai ngal a," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “But the deceiver is cursed, who has in his flock a male, and vows, and sacrifices to the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” a blemished thing; for I am a great King,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”

paite: Tu in, nou siampute aw, “Hiai thupiak noute a ding ahi.
english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

paite: Ka min pahtawi ding a, na ngaihkhiak louh ua, na lungtang ua na koih kei uleh, huchi in na tung uah hamsia ka tungsak ding a, na vualzawlnate uh ka hamsiatkhum ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi, ahi, lungtang a na koih louh ziak un, ka hamsiat khinta hi.
english: If you will not listen, and if you will not lay it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says Yahweh of Armies, “then will I send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not lay it to heart.

paite: Ngai un, noute ziak in na chi tuh ka sal ding a, na mai uah ek ka thehthang ding a, na kithoihna ek ngei uh; huchi in huai toh lakmang in na om ding uhi.
english: Behold, I will rebuke your seed, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

paite: Hiai thupiak, Levi toh ka thukhun a-omtheihna ding in, na kiang uah ka hon sawlta chih na thei ding uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Hinna leh lungmuanna ka thukhun amah toh a-om hi, akihtak theihna ding in akiang ah amaute ka peta a, kei ahon kihta a, ka min azahtak mahmah hi.
english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.

paite: Akamsung ah thutak dan a-om a, diktatlouhna amuk ah akimu kei; lungmuanna leh tanna ah ka thu azui a, gitlouhna a kipan in mi tampi aheimangsak hi.
english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

paite: Siampu mukte'n theihna akem un, akam uah dan azong ding uh ahi him hi; amah lah sepaihte' TOUPA sawltak ahi ngal a.
english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Himahleh lampi a kipan pialsak in na om ua; tampi dan ah na kisuipuksak uhi; Levi thukhun na suseta uhi.
english: But you have turned aside out of the way. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huaiziak in ka lampite na zuih louh dungzui un, dan a mite deihsak tuam na neih zawk ziak un, ke'n leng mipite tengteng ma ah zahpihhuai leh dai in ka hon bawlta hi," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and base before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.

paite: I vek un pa khat i nei kei ua hia? Pathian khat in hon siam kei a hia? Bangziak a lepchiahtak a michih in i pipute uh thukhun hihnin a-unau siatna ding a hih i hi ua?
english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

paite: Judah in lepchiahtak in ahihta a, Israel ah leh Jerusalem ah kihhuai hih in a-om hi, Judah in Pathian' mun siangthou it ahihninta a, theih louh pathian tanu akitenpihta hi.
english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of Yahweh which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

paite: TOUPA'N hiai thilhihpa, sinsakpa leh sinsak a ompa, Jakob puanin a kipan leh sepaihte' TOUPA kiang a thillat lanpa asatkhe ding hi.
english: Yahweh will cut off, to the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob, and him who offers an offering to Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huan hiai na hih nawn uh; TOUPA maitam khitui, kah leh thumna in na khuh ua, thillat alimsak nawn louh a, na khut ua kipan deihsakna toh san leng asan nawn louh tanpha in.
english: This again you do: you cover the altar of Yahweh with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.

paite: Hinapi in lah, "Bangziak in maw?" achi uhi. Na tuailai zi, lepchiahtak a na bawl, na kithuahpihnu, na thukhun zi hinapi in, amah leh nang kikal ah TOUPA theihpihpa ahih khit tak ziak in.
english: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because Yahweh has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion, and the wife of your covenant.

paite: Pathian in nihte sa khat in hon bawl kei maw? Khat in na kha hon bawlsak in, ahingsak kei maw? Bang achia khat? Pathian limsak chi azong ahi. Huaiziak in michih in atuailai zi lepchiahtak a hih lou ding in na kha thu uah pilvang un.
english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought a godly seed. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

paite: TOUPA Israel' Pathian in achi, koihmangna ka hua a, hiamgamna a puansilh khuh mipa ka mudah hi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Huaiziak in michih in atuailai zi lepchiahtak a hih lou ding in, na kha thu uah pilvang un.
english: For I hate divorce,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel, “and him who covers his garment with violence!” says Yahweh of Armies. “Therefore take heed to your spirit, that you don’t deal treacherously.

paite: Na thu un TOUPA na hihgimta uh, koi ah ka hon hihgim ua ahia, na chi lai uhi; michih gilou hih TOUPA mitmuh in ahoih a, huaite ah amah akipak hi na chihna uah leh vaihawmna Pathian koi a om hiam na chih nakna uah.
english: You have wearied Yahweh with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in the sight of Yahweh, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

paite: "Ngai in, ka sawltak ka sawl a, ama'n ka ma ah lampi abawlkhol ding a TOUPA, na zon uh, atempul ah thakhat in ahong pai ding; na kipahna uh, thukhun sawltak, ngai un, ahong hi," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me; and the Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple; and the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, behold, he comes!” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Himahleh ahong paina ni kua'n athuakzou thei dia? Ahong lat chiang in kua adingzou dia? Amah hihsiangthou meikuang leh puansawptu sahbon bang ahi ngal a.
english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderer’s soap;

paite: Huchi in dangka hihsiangthoumi leh siangsakmi bang in atu ding a Levi tapate ahihsiang ding hi, dangka-eng leh dangka bang in amau akhuahsiang ding a, huchi in diktatna in TOUPA kiang ah thillatte alan ding uhi.
english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to Yahweh offerings in righteousness.

paite: Huai chiang in Judah leh Jerusalem thillatte nidanglai bang leh tang a kumte bang in TOUPA a ding in namtui ahi ding hi.
english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to Yahweh, as in the days of old, and as in ancient years.

paite: "Huan vaihawmna ah aisan mite kalh in, angkawmte kalh in, zuau a kichiamte kalh in theihpihpa kin ka hi ding a, loh thu a migoih, meithai, pabei, nuaisiah, athuneihna a kipan mikhual kaiheipa, kei hon kihtaloute kalh in, na kiang uah ka hong ding sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Kei TOUPA ka zulhzau kei a; huaiziak in Jakob tapate aw, haltum in na om kei uhi.
english: “For I, Yahweh, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

paite: Na pipute uh dam lai a kipan ka dan thupiakte na kilehheisan ua, na zui kei uhi. Ka kiang ah hong kik unla, na kiang uah ka hong kik ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Himahleh nou, koi ah i kik ding ua? na chi uhi.
english: From the days of your fathers you have turned aside from my ordinances, and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says Yahweh of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

paite: Mi'n Pathian alok diam? Hinapi in noute'n na hon lok uh. Himahleh bangchidan in ka hon lok ua eita? na chi uhi. Sawm-a-khatte ah leh thillatte ah.
english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

paite: Hiai nam pumpi in, kei na hon loh ziak un hamsiatna a hamsiat na hi uhi.
english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

paite: Ka insung a an ahong omtheihna ding in koihkhawmna inn ah sawm-a-khat avek in hon lalut unla, huai in kei hon entel un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Akoihna ding dantan kiching om lou khop in van tohlette hong in, vualzawlna ka hon buakkhe kei na hiam!
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says Yahweh of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough for.

paite: Huan negaimi pen nou ziak in ka sal ding a, na leigahte uh ahihse kei ding hi; na grepgui uh leng lou ah ahun tun ma in agah akesak kei ding hi, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huchi in nam tengteng in nang nuamsa ahon chi ding ua; gam deihhuai na hih ding ziak un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Kei dem a na thute uh akhauh hi," TOUPA'N achi, "Nou koi ah nang dem in thu ka gen ua eita," na chi uh.
english: “Your words have been stout against me,” says Yahweh. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

paite: "Pathian nasep athawn ahi, athupiak i zuih ua, suunna puan silh a sepaihte' TOUPA ma a i om uh bang ahia aphattuamna, na chi uh.
english: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God;’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions, and that we have walked mournfully before Yahweh of Armies?

paite: Tu in kisatheite nuamsa chi in agitlouhna nasemte tunding in a-om uh; ahi; Pathian khemte hotkhiak in a-om uh," i chi uhi.
english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

paite: TOUPA kihtate akihoupih ua; huchi in TOUPA'N angaikhia a, aza a, TOUPA kihta a, amin ngaihtuahte ama ah, theihgigena laibuzial ah gelh ahi.
english: Then those who feared Yahweh spoke one with another; and Yahweh listened, and heard, and a book of memory was written before him, for those who feared Yahweh, and who honored his name.

paite: "Huan amau kei a ahi ding ua, gou lamdangtak ka bawl ni chiang in," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi. Mi'n ama nasem atapa ahawi bang in huchi in amau ka hawi ding hi.
english: They shall be mine,” says Yahweh of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make, and I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na hong kihei ding ua, diktatte leh giloute, Pathian nasem leh ama nna semloute kal na khenchian thei ding uhi.
english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

paite: "Ngai in, ani ahong tun ziak in, meiphualpi bang in akuang a; huchi in kisatheite tengteng, gilou nasemte tengteng, buhpawl ahi ding uh; huan ahong tung huai ni in amaute zung leh hiang nuse lou hial in akangmang ding uh," sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: “For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble; and the day that comes will burn them up,” says Yahweh of Armies, “that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

paite: Himahleh nou ka min kihtate kiang ah diktatna ni, akhate ahihdamna toh ahong suak ding; huchi in na pawtkhe ding ua, huangsung bawngnoute bang in na diang velhvelh ding uhi.
english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap like calves of the stall.

paite: Huan giloute na sikden ding ua; ka gamtat ni chiang in na khepek nuai uah meivu hi ding ahih ziak un, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: "Horeb a Israel tengteng a ding a ka sikha Mosi Dan, amah thupiak, dan thusehte leh vaihawmte ngei, theigige un.
english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

paite: Ngai un, TOUPA ni thupi leh mulkimhuai ahong tun ma in na kiang uah zawlnei Elijah ka hon sawl ding hi.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.

paite: Pate lungtang tate lam ah, tate lungtang apate uh lam ah angasak ding; huchi lou in zaw hamsia in lei ka gawt kha ding hi.”
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

paite: Judah kumpipa Jotham, Ahaz leh Hezekiah vaihawm lai a Moreseth mi Mikah kiang a TOUPA thu hong tung, Samaria khua leh Jerusalem kho tungtang amuh thu.
english: The word of Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

paite: Nou, mite aw, na vek un za unla; Aw lei leh asung a om tengteng aw, ngaikhia un; Toupa PATHIAN, Toupa atempul siangthou a kipan, nou dem in na tungthu uh theihpihpa hi hen.
english: Hear, you peoples, all of you. Listen, O earth, and all that is therein: and let the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” Yahweh be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

paite: Ngai dih ua, TOUPA amun a kipan in ahong pawt a, ahong paisuk ding a, lei mun sangte achil ngal ding hi.
english: For, behold, Yahweh comes forth out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

paite: Mei kiangchin a khuainun bang leh munken a tui kikhohkhia bang mai in, tangte anuai ah azul ding a, munzangte akhangkham ding.
english: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart, like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.

paite: Hiai tengteng Jakobte tatlekna ziak leh Israel inkote khelhna ziak ahi. Jakobte tatlekna bang ahia oi? Samaria ahi kei maw? Judah mun sangte bang ahia? Jerusalem ahi kei maw?
english: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?

paite: Huaiziak in Samaria gam a thil sia omkhawm bang in ka bawl ding a, grephuan mun bang mai in; huai mun a suangte lui phaizang ah ka khukkhe ding a, asuangphumte ka dawksak ding hi.
english: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

paite: Amilim bawltawm tengteng sukkhap vek ahi ding a, akizuakna mante mei a halmang ahi ding a, amilim tengteng ka hihgawp ding; kizuakna man ding in ala vek ngal a, kizuakna man mah in apang nawn ding uhi.
english: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, and all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and all her images I will destroy; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”

paite: Hiai ziak in ka kap ding a, ka mau tuaituai ding a, kisuah leh vuaktang in ka om ding; sehalte bang in ka kikou ding a, vangawngsaute bang in ka thum ding hi.
english: For this I will lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will howl like the jackals, and moan like the daughters of owls.

paite: Aliamna hihdam theih ahi kei; Judah gam atungta ngal a; ka mite kongpi, Jerusalem hial atungta hi.
english: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

paite: Gath ah gen kei unla kap het kei un; Beth-le-aphrah ah leivui lak ah kikhuk un.
english: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah Beth Ophrah means literally “House of Dust.” I have rolled myself in the dust.

paite: Aw Saphir mi, vuaktang leh zumtak in paimang in; Zaanan mite Beth-ezel kahna ziak in ahong pawtkhe kei ding ua; huai a bitna mun a-om louh ziak in.
english: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.

paite: Maroth mi in tanhoih tan angaklah tuntun hi; TOUPA kiang a kipan thil hoih lou Jerusalem kongpi tan a ahong tunsuk ziak in.
english: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from Yahweh to the gate of Jerusalem.

paite: Aw Lakish mi, kangtalai sakol hattak henden in; amah pen Zion tanu khelhna kipatna ahi. Israelte tatlekna nang a muh ahi.
english: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; For the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

paite: Huaiziak in Moreseth-gath kiang ah kikhakna thilpiak na piak ding ahi; Akzib innte Israel gam kumpipate a ding in khemna ahi ding hi.
english: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.

paite: Aw Maresa mi, nang hon zoutu na kiang ah ka hon pi ding; Israelte thupina Adullam pha in ahong pai ding hi.
english: I will yet bring to you, inhabitant of Mareshah. He who is the glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

paite: Kimetgiau inla, na ta deihtakte ziak in kimetgiau in; musane bang in kihihgiau semsem in; na kiang a kipan sal a pi in a-omta uhi.
english: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture; for they have gone into captivity from you!

paite: Alupna tung ua thulimlouhna gelmi leh thil hoih lou ngaihtuahkhemi tung agik hi; zingsang a khua avak in huai ahih zel uhi.
english: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

paite: Miloute eng in alaksak ua; innte a-eng ua, alaksak zel uhi; mi leh a-inkote uh mi leh agoutan un anuaisiah uhi.
english: They covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'n hichi in achi: “Ngai dih, hiai inko tung ah thil hoih lou ka gel ahi, huai a kipan in na ngawng uh na suan kei ding ua, kisatheitak in apai nawn kei ding uh; hun hoih lou ahih ding ziak in.
english: Therefore thus says Yahweh: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily; for it is an evil time.

paite: Huai ni chiang in noute dem in gentehna abawl ding ua, kahla khasiathuai a sam in; "Suksiat in i om vekta ua, ka mite thil tan akilamdangta; kei kipan gam lakmang ahi a; helhatmi kiang ah i lou uh hawmzak ahita," achi ding uhi.
english: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA mite kikhawmte lak ah aisan a khau a tehsak mi kuamah na nei kei ding uhi.
english: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the assembly of Yahweh.

paite: Thu gen kei un, chi in agen zel ua, hiai mite kiang ah thu agen kei ding uh; gensiatna adai kei ding hi.
english: “Don’t prophesy!” They prophesy. “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

paite: Aw Jakob inkote aw, TOUPA kha nehden in a-om a hia? Hiaite athilhih chih ding ahi maw? Diktak a om zel mi tung ah ka thute'n thil hoih ahih kei maw?
english: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob: “Is the Spirit of Yahweh angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”

paite: Himahleh ka mite tunai chin in melma bang in ahong dingkhia uhi; kidou ding lungsim a nei lou, muangtak a vialvakte lak a kipan in apuansilh puanaktualte uh na suahsak uhi.
english: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.

paite: Ka mi numeite a-inn nuamtak ua kipan na delhkhia ua; anaupang neute a kipan ka thupina alamang den uhi.
english: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.

paite: Thou unla, paimang un; hiai khawlna mun ding ahi kei a; siatna thupitak tan ahi, buahna a-om ziak in.
english: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.

paite: Mi kuahiam in kha a om chi a zuauthu gen in, "Uain leh zu na taina ding uh ahi," chi in hong gen taleh huai mi, mipite zaknop lel thugen zawlnei ahi ding hi.
english: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies: “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink”; he would be the prophet of this people.

paite: Aw Jakobte, na vek un ka hon samkhawm ding a; Israel khosuak-sunte ka pikhawm ding a; Bozrah khua belam bang a koihkhawm ding; ganhonte aloupa mun ua om bang in, mipi ahih ziak un achiak zuazua ding uh.
english: I will surely assemble, Jacob, all of you; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the midst of their pasture; they will swarm with people.

paite: Ama uah lampi phuvangpa apai a; aphu pailet ua, kongkhak pha in apai zel ua, huai ah apaikhia uhi; akumpipa uh ama uah apai a, TOUPA'N ama uh akai hi.
english: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. And their king passes on before them, with Yahweh at their head.

paite: Aw nou Jakob heutute leh Israel inkote vaihawmte aw: Ngaikhia unla, ka hon ngen hi ka chi ahi; vaihawmdan na theih ding uh hilou hia?
english: I said, “Please listen, you heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Isn’t it for you to know justice?

paite: Thil hoih na hua ua, thil hoih lou na it ua, avun uh na hawksak ua, aguh ua kipan in sa na leukhia uh.
english: You who hate the good, and love the evil; who tear off their skin, and their flesh from off their bones;

paite: Ka mite sa ne in; avun uh na lip ua, aguh uh na hihtansak ua; ahi, sa uina bel sung a sa atnen bang in huan ding in na atnen uhi.
english: who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones, and chop them in pieces, as for the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.

paite: Huai hun chiang in TOUPA asam ding ua, himahleh amau adawng kei ding; ahi, huai hun chiang in athilhih ua ahihhoih louhdan bang un, amau a kipan amai asel ding hi.
english: Then they will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them. Yes, he will hide his face from them at that time, because they made their deeds evil.”

paite: Ka mite thil hihkhialsak mi, nek ding banghiam piak a a-om chiang ua, "Muanna" chi a kikou a, huai bang peloute peuhmah kidouna thu a vaulau zawlneite tungtang thu TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Thus says Yahweh concerning the prophets who lead my people astray; for those who feed their teeth, they proclaim, “Peace!” and whoever doesn’t provide for their mouths, they prepare war against him:

paite: "Huaiziak in kilakna na neihlouhna ding un noute kiang zan hong tung hi; aisan na bawl theihlouhna ding un na kiang uah mialna ahong om ding a; zawlneite a ding in ni atum ding a, amau tung ah sun amial ding hi.
