english: “Therefore night is over you, with no vision, and it is dark to you, that you may not divine; and the sun will go down on the prophets, and the day will be black over them.

paite: Mutheite azum ding ua, aisan siamte azahlak ding uh, avek un amuk uh ahum ding uh; Pathian in adawn louh ziak in."
english: The seers shall be disappointed, and the diviners confounded. Yes, they shall all cover their lips; for there is no answer from God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” .”

paite: Himahleh Jakob kiang ah atatlekna uh theisak ding leh Israelte kiang ah akhelhna uh theisak ding in TOUPA kha ziak athilhihtheihnate, vaihawmnate, hatnate in ka dim hi.
english: But as for me, I am full of power by the Spirit of Yahweh, and of judgment, and of might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience, and to Israel his sin.

paite: Nou Jakob inkote heutute leh Israel inkote vaihawmmi, vaihawmna kih a, dikna chiteng lumlet mite aw, hiai ngaikhia un, ka hon ngen ahi.
english: Please listen to this, you heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, who abhor justice, and pervert all equity.

paite: Sisan in Zion leh ginatlouhna in Jerusalem alam uh.
english: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

paite: Huai ah heutute'n kipahman lamen in vai ahawm ua, siampute'n loh lamen in asinsak ua, azawlneite'n dangka lamen in ai asan uhi; huchi in leng, TOUPA alak uah a-om kei a hia? I tung uah thil hoih lou ahong tung kei ding, chi in TOUPA tung ah akinga uhi.
english: Her leaders judge for bribes, and her priests teach for a price, and her prophets of it tell fortunes for money: yet they lean on Yahweh, and say, “Isn’t Yahweh in the midst of us? No disaster will come on us.”

paite: Huaiziak in Zion, noute ziak in, lou bang a leileh ahi ding a, Jerusalem thilsia omkhawm ahi ding a, tang a inn omna gammang bang ahi ding.
english: Therefore Zion for your sake will be plowed like a field, and Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple like the high places of a forest.

paite: Himahleh ni nanung chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA' inn omna tang, tang lian tungte hihkip in a-om ding a, mualte tung ah tawisang in a-om ding; huai ah tawisang in a-om ding; huai ah chichihte apai zungzung ding uh.
english: But in the latter days, it will happen that the mountain of Yahweh’s temple will be established on the top of the mountains, and it will be exalted above the hills; and peoples will stream to it.

paite: Nam tampite apai ding ua, hong unla, TOUPA tang ah, Jakob' Pathian inn ah i hohtou ding uh; huchi in ama'n alampi tanchinte hon sinsak ding a, alampite ah i pai ding ua, achi ding uh; Zion a kipan dan thu ahong pawt ding a. TOUPA thu bel Jerusalem a kipan in ahong pawt ding hi.
english: Many nations will go and say, “Come, and let us go up to the mountain of Yahweh, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths.” For out of Zion will go forth the law, and the word of Yahweh from Jerusalem;

paite: Ama'n chi tampi lak ah vai ahawm ding a, gamlapi a nam hattak leng asal ding; anamsaute uh leilehna mukzum ding in asek ding ua, ateipite uh theikung attanna temkawi ding in asek ding uh; namdang in namdang tung ah namsau alikta kei ding a, kidoudan leng asinsakta kei ding uh.
english: and he will judge between many peoples, and will decide concerning strong nations afar off. They will beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning hooks. Nation will not lift up sword against nation, neither will they learn war any more.

paite: Michihte agrepgui nuai uah leh atheipi kung nuai uah atu ding ua; kuamah in alausak kei ding uh; Sepaihte' TOUPA kam in agenta ngal a.
english: But they will sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree; and no one will make them afraid: For the mouth of Yahweh of Armies has spoken.

paite: Mi chih amau pathian min chiat in a-om ding ua, ei leng TOUPA i Pathian min in tangtawn tangtawn in i om ding hi.
english: Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods; but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and ever.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Huai ni chiang in khebaite ka kaikhawm ding a, delhmang a om leh sukgim a omte ka kaikhawm ding," chi in.
english: “In that day,” says Yahweh, “I will assemble that which is lame, and I will gather that which is driven away, and that which I have afflicted;

paite: Akhosuaksunte ka khosuaksak ding a, gamlapi a delhmang a omte bel nam hattak in ka bawl ding; tuban siah Zion tang ah tangtawn in TOUPA'N atung uah vai ahawmta ding hi.
english: and I will make that which was lame a remnant, and that which was cast far off a strong nation: and Yahweh will reign over them on Mount Zion from then on, even forever.”

paite: Aw nang, ganchinna insang, Zion tanu tenna bitna tang, na kiang ah lalgam masa ahong tung ding; ahi, Jerusalem tanu kiang ngei ah lalgam ahong tung ding hi.
english: You, tower of the flock, the hill of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come, yes, the former dominion will come, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.

paite: Bang achia hichi nak kah na hia? Na sung ah kumpipa a-om kei a hia, nang hon gensakpa amangthangta a hia, numei nauvei bang a lunggimna in nang ahon mat?
english: Now why do you cry out aloud? Is there no king in you? Has your counselor perished, that pains have taken hold of you as of a woman in travail?

paite: Aw Zion tanu, numei nauvei suak ding bang in natna thuak in vei in; khopi a kipan in na pawtkhe ding a, gam ah na teng ding a, Babulon tanpha a pai ding na hi ngal a, huai ah hotkhiak in na om ding a, huai ah na melmate khut a kipan TOUPA'N nang ahon hunkhe ding hi.
english: Be in pain, and labor to bring forth, daughter of Zion, like a woman in travail; for now you will go forth out of the city, and will dwell in the field, and will come even to Babylon. There you will be rescued. There Yahweh will redeem you from the hand of your enemies.

paite: Tu in tampi nang hon dou in akikhawm ua, hihbuai in om henla, i mit in Zion tung a alunggulhpen mu hen, achi uhi.
english: Now many nations have assembled against you, that say, “Let her be defiled, and let our eye gloat over Zion.”

paite: Himahleh TOUPA ngaihtuahnate athei kei ua, aphatsakna leng atheisiam sam kei uh; phual a buhphal koihkhawm bang in amau akaikhawmta ngal a.
english: But they don’t know the thoughts of Yahweh, neither do they understand his counsel; for he has gathered them like the sheaves to the threshing floor.

paite: Aw Zion tanu, thou inla chil in; sik bang in na kii ka bawl ding a, dal bang in na khepek ka bawl ding; huan mi tampite na satnen ding a; athil neihte uh TOUPA a dia na koihtuam ding ahi, asum uh lei kumpi TOUPA a ding in akoihtuam ding uhi.
english: Arise and thresh, daughter of Zion; for I will make your horn iron, and I will make your hoofs brass; and you will beat in pieces many peoples: and I will devote their gain to Yahweh, and their substance to the Lord of the whole earth.

paite: Aw sepaihhonte' tanu, tu in sepaih hon kaikhawm inla; amau ahon umsuakta ua; Israelte vaihawmpa abiang ah sikchiang in asun ding uhi.
english: Now you shall gather yourself in troops, daughter of troops. He has laid siege against us. They will strike the judge of Israel with a rod on the cheek.

paite: Himahleh nang, Bethlehem Ephratha aw, Judah gam a sang tampi lak a tel ding in neu tawk lechin leng, nang a kipan in Israelte vaihawmpa ding kei a ding in ahong pawt ding; ahong pawtna sawtpi, tang lai nite a kipan ahi.
english: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come forth to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings forth are from of old, from everlasting.

paite: Huaiziak in nauveimi'n asuahsak mateng amau alehngatsan ding; huchi in a-unau khosuaksunte Israel suante kiang ah akik nawn ding uhi.
english: Therefore he will abandon them until the time that she who is in labor gives birth. Then the rest of his brothers will return to the children of Israel.

paite: Amah adingh dia, TOUPA a Pathian min thupina ngei in; amaute a-omta ding ua; amah lah lei tawp pha in athupi ding hi.
english: He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they will live, for then he will be great to the ends of the earth.

paite: Huan hiai mi kilemna ahi ding; Assuria mi agam ua ahong a, i kumpipa uh innte ahon sik chiang in, amah dou ding in belampu sagih leh mithupi giat i kitelkhe ding uhi.
english: He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land, and when he marches through our fortresses, then we will raise against him seven shepherds, and eight leaders of men.

paite: Assuria gam namsau in ahihse ding ua, Nimrod gam a lutna ahihse lai ding uh; huan ama'n, i gam ua Assuria mi hong pai a, i gam chiang uh ahong sik hun chiang in, amah a kipan in ahon hunkhe ding hi.
english: They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod in its gates. He will deliver us from the Assyrian, when he invades our land, and when he marches within our border.

paite: Jakob mi khosuaksunte chi tampi lak ah TOUPA a kipan a daitui kia bang leh loupa tung a vuahzu bang in a-om ding uh; huai in mihing angak kei a, mihing tapate angak sam kei hi.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples, like dew from Yahweh, like showers on the grass, that don’t wait for man, nor wait for the sons of men.

paite: Jakob khosuaksunte namte lak ah leh chi tampite lak ah gamnuai sate lak a humpinelkai bang leh belamhon lak a humpinelkai lun lai bang in a-om ding; ama'n apaisuak peuhmahte asikden a, abotnen a, humbit ding leng kuamah a-om kei uh.
english: The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the animals of the forest, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep; who, if he goes through, treads down and tears in pieces, and there is no one to deliver.

paite: Na khut nang hon doute tung ah lik in om henla, na melma tengteng hihman in om hen.
english: Let your hand be lifted up above your adversaries, and let all of your enemies be cut off.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA'N achi, nang a kipan in na sakolte ka hihmang ding a, na kangtalaite ka hihse ding;
english: “It will happen in that day,” says Yahweh, “That I will cut off your horses out of the midst of you, and will destroy your chariots.

paite: na khopite ka hihmang ding a, na kulhhat tengteng ka hihchim ding;
english: I will cut off the cities of your land, and will tear down all your strongholds.

paite: na khut a kipan bumsiamte ka hihmang ding a; aisan siamte ka hihmang ding; aisan siamte na nei nawnta kei ding hi;
english: I will destroy witchcraft from your hand; and you shall have no soothsayers.

paite: nang a kipan na milim bawltawmte leh na suangphuhte ka hihmang ding a; na khutsuakte na be nawn kei ding hi.
english: I will cut off your engraved images and your pillars out of your midst; and you shall no more worship the work of your hands.

paite: Nang a kipan Asherahte ka botkhe ding a; na khopite ka hihse ding hi.
english: I will uproot your Asherim out of your midst; and I will destroy your cities.

paite: Huan thu ngaikhe lou namte tung ah hehna leh thangpaihna in phulakna ka pichingsak ding hi.
english: I will execute vengeance in anger, and wrath on the nations that didn’t listen.”

paite: Tu in TOUPA thugen ngaikhia un: Thou inla, tangte ma ah lang in, mualte'n na aw ngaikhia uhen,
english: Listen now to what Yahweh says: “Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear what you have to say.

paite: Aw tangte aw, TOUPA hon hekna ngaikhia unla, nou leitung kingaknate aw, ngaikhia un; TOUPA amite toh akilang a, Israelte ahekna agen ding hi.
english: Hear, you mountains, Yahweh’s controversy, and you enduring foundations of the earth; for Yahweh has a controversy with his people, and he will contend with Israel.

paite: Aw ka mite aw, na tung uah bang ka hihta a ahia? Bang lam in ahia ka hon hihgim? Hon gen dih ua.
english: My people, what have I done to you? How have I burdened you? Answer me!

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan in nou ka hon pikhia a, saltanna inn a pan nou ka hon tankhia a; na ma uah Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam ka sawl hi.
english: For I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage. I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.

paite: Aw ka mite aw, TOUPA thilhih diktat na theihna ding un, Moab kumpipa Balak thusawm leh Boer tapa Balaam in adawndan, Sittim a kipan a Gilgal pha a thil omdante khawng tu in theigige un.
english: My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim to Gilgal, that you may know the righteous acts of Yahweh.”

paite: Bang toh ahia TOUPA ma a ka hong pai ding a, Pathian tungnung ma a ka kun ding? Haltum thillatte, bawngnou kum khat a upate toh ama ah ka hong pai dia hia?
english: How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old?

paite: TOUPA belamtal sang tampi hiam sathau lui singkhatte hiam ah alungkim dia hia? Ka tatlekna ziak in ka tachil pia in, ka khelhna ziak in pumpi gah ka pe dia hia?
english: Will Yahweh be pleased with thousands of rams? With tens of thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my firstborn for my disobedience? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?

paite: Aw mihing, ahoih nang ahon ensakta hi; TOUPA'N nang ahon phut bang ahia? Diktak a hih leh zahngaihna it leh na Pathian toh kiniamkhiaktak a tonkhawm ahi kei maw?
english: He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

paite: TOUPA'N khopi asam hi, pilna nei mi'n na min laudan asiam ding; khetbuk leh aseppa limsak un.
english: Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.

paite: Migilou insung ah gitlouhna a kaihkhawm goubawmte leh tehna diklou kihhuaitak a-om lai hia?
english: Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah An ephah is a measure of volume (about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel), and a short ephah is made smaller than a full ephah for the purpose of cheating customers. that is accursed?

paite: Bukna diklou zangte leh khemna dia gikdan tehna diklou zangte siangthou ka chi ding a hia?
english: Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?

paite: Huai a mihausate lah hiamgamna in adim ua, huai a tengte'n zuau agen ua, akamsung ua alei uh khemhat ahi.
english: Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n leng nakpi a hon limsak in ka hon khen a; na khelhna ziak in ka hon hihgam hi.
english: Therefore I also have struck you with a grievous wound. I have made you desolate because of your sins.

paite: Na ne ding a, himahleh na tai kei ding; na kiang ah na daina a-om ding a; na khol ding a, himahleh abit kei ding; na kholsate namsau kiang ah paimangpih ding in ka pe ding hi.
english: You shall eat, but not be satisfied. Your humiliation will be in your midst. You will store up, but not save; and that which you save I will give up to the sword.

paite: Na tuh ding a, himahleh na la kei ding; olive gahte na chil ding a, himahleh athau na nilh kei ding; grep chil mah lechin, a-uain na dawn kei ding.
english: You will sow, but won’t reap. You will tread the olives, but won’t anoint yourself with oil; and crush grapes, but won’t drink the wine.

paite: Omri dan thusehte lah na vom gige ngal a, Ahab inkuan thuhilhna tengteng zui in amau lemtheihna ah na pai uhi; huchi in mun gamgawp in ka hon bawl sinta, na sung a tengte simmoh thuak in soisak in a-om ding uhi.
english: For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of the house of Ahab. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and her inhabitants a hissing; And you will bear the reproach of my people.”

paite: Ka tung gik hina mai e! Nipithei sekkhawm hun lai a om bang leh grep loh hun lai a grep maih loh ding bang ka hi ngal a; gahbom nek ding a-om kei; ka hinna in theipi min masa alunggulh hi.
english: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard: There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

paite: Pathian limsakmi lei a kipan amang ua, mihing lak ah midiktak a-om kei uh; sisan suah ding in atang vek ua; michih in amau unau len in agem uhi.
english: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

paite: Akhutte uh thil hoih lou tung a thanuamtak a hih ding in anga ua; kumpipa'n thilpiak angiat a, vaihawmpa'n anegu a; milian in alungsim thilhihkhelhna agenkhia a; huai in akithutuak uhi.
english: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

paite: Alak ua mihoihpen loulingnei bang ahi a; midikpen leng dailing nei sang in ahoih kei zaw; nang veng mite ni, veh a na om ni ngei ahong tung hi; huai tuh amangbat ni uh ahi ding hi.
english: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

paite: Lawm ah muang kei unla, makaimi ah ginna koih kei un; na angsung a omnu a kipan in na kam kongkhakte veng in.
english: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

paite: Tapa in pa min ahihsia a, tanu in anu adou a, mou in api adou ngal a; mihing melmate zaw amah inkote mah ahi uh.
english: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

paite: Huaiziak in ke'n zaw TOUPA lam ka en ding a; ka hotdamna Pathian ka ngak ding; ka Pathian in ahon ngaikhe ding hi.
english: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

paite: Aw ka melma, ka puk hun chiang in hon awi ke'n; ka thounawn ding; mial a ka tut in leng TOUPA kei a ding in vak ahi ding hi.
english: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.

paite: TOUPA tung a thil ka hihkhelh ziak in, alung hihlouhna mahmah ka po ding, ka tungthu ahon genpih a, kei a dia vaihawmna atangtun masiah; vak ah ahon pikhe ding a, huan diktatna ka mu ding hi.
english: I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes judgment for me. He will bring me forth to the light. I will see his righteousness.

paite: Huchi in ka melma ka kiang a, TOUPA na Pathian koi ah, chipa'n huai amu ding a, zahlakna'n amah atuam ding hi. Ka mite'n amah a-en ding ua; tu'n zaw kongzing buannawi bang a sikden ahita ding hi.
english: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me and will cover her shame. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

paite: Na kulhbaangte bawlna ni ding leh na gamgi kekletna ni ahong tung ding hi.
english: A day to build your walls— In that day, he will extend your boundary.

paite: Huai ni chiang in Assuria gam leh Aigupta khopi a kipan, Aigupta leh Lui pha hial a kipan, tuipi leh tuipi kikal a kipan leh tang leh tang kikal a kipan na kiang ah ahong pai ding uhi.
english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

paite: Huchipi in gam, asung a tengte ziak leh athilhih uh gah ziak in hihgam ahi ding hi.
english: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

paite: Karmel tangkal a gamnuai a lungzuangtak a om na goutan belamhon, na mite na khetbuk zang in vak inla; nidanglai bang in Bashan leh Gilead ah vak in om chiat uhen.
english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest, in the midst of fertile pasture land, let them feed; in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan a na paikhiak lai bang in akiang ah thillamdang mahmahte ka ensak ding hi.
english: “As in the days of your coming forth out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

paite: Namte'n huai amu ding ua, athilhihtheihna tengteng uh azumpih ding uh; amuk uh ahum ding ua, abil uh angong ding hi.
english: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

paite: Gul bang in leivui aliak ding ua; bokkhup a vakte bang in a-omna kua ua kipan in ling kawm in ahong pai ding uh; TOUPA i Pathian kiang ah laudan siam kawm in ahong pai ding ua, nang ziak in alau ding uhi.
english: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to Yahweh our God, and will be afraid because of you.

paite: Nang bang a thulimlouhna ngaidampa leh agoutan khosuaksun tatlekna nelhsiah Pathian kua a-om a? Ahehna tangtawn in avom gige kei; zahngaihna a akipah mahmah ziak in.
english: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

paite: Akiheikik nawn ding a, i tung ah hehpihna anei ding; akhenuai ah i thulimlouhnate asikden ding a; nang amaute khelhna tengteng tuipi taw thukpi ah na pailut ding hi.
english: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot; and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

paite: Nidanglai a ka pu leh pate kiang a na kichiamsa, Jakob kiang ah thutak leh Abraham kiang ah zahngaihna na tangtun ding hi.
english: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.

paite: Nineveh kho puakgik. Elkosh mi Nahum kilakna bu,
english: An oracle about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

paite: TOUPA zaw mullit hat Pathian leh phulak ching ahi; TOUPA'N phu ala a, hehna in adim hi; TOUPA'N amah dou mite tung ah phu ala a, amelmate a ding in hehna akholkhawm hi.
english: Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. is a jealous God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” and avenges. Yahweh avenges and is full of wrath. Yahweh takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

paite: TOUPA alungnel a, nakpi a thilhihthei ahi, mimohte siam atangsak mahmah kei ding; TOUPA'N pingpei leh huihpi ah alampi anei a, meipite akhe a leivui ahi.
english: Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

paite: Tuipi asal a, akangtatsak a, lui tengteng leng akangsak khin a; Bashan gam abah a, Karmel tang leh Lebanon tang paklunte avuai uhi.
english: He rebukes the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan languishes, and Carmel; and the flower of Lebanon languishes.

paite: Amah ziak in tangte aling ua, mualte azulmang ua; ama ah lei avuak a, ahi leitung leh asung a om tengteng toh in.
english: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

paite: Alung hihlouhna mai ah kua ahia dingh thei a, ahehna thupitak ah kua ahia om thei ding? Ahehna mei bang a sunbuak ahi a, suangpite akekzaksak vek hi.
english: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

paite: TOUPA zaw ahoih a, mangbat ni a kulhkip ahi; amah a aginna uh koih mite athei hi.
english: Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

paite: Himahleh tui khang luanglet zang in huai mun manthat vekna atungsak ding a, khomial a amelmate delhlut ding in.
english: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

paite: TOUPA kalh in bang na gel ua? Bei sipsipna atungsak ahi, haksa nihveina atung kei ding hi.
english: What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

paite: Lingnok bang a om in a-uain dawn un diahkawt dimdem bang in om mahleh, buhpawl keu bang mai a hihman vek in a-om ding uhi.
english: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

paite: Nang a pawt mi khat TOUPA kalh a thil gilou ngaihtuahmi, gitlouhna thuhilhmi a-om hi.
english: There is one gone forth out of you, who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ahat theihtawp un hat mah le uh, tam leng tampi himah le uh, huchipi in leng vatpuk in a-om ding ua, amangthang ding uhi. Hon na hihgim khin mah leng ka hon hihgim nawnta kei ding hi.
english: Thus says Yahweh: “Though they be in full strength, and likewise many, even so they will be cut down, and he shall pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

paite: Tu'n zaw na kiang a kipan ahakkol ka kitansak ding a, nang gakna khaute ka kitatsak vek ding.
english: Now will I break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

paite: "TOUPA'N na tungtang thu ah thu apia hi, na min chi bang a tuh ahi nawnta kei ding a; na pathiante inn a kipan milim bawltawm leh milim sunte ka hihmangthang ding a; na han ka bawl ding; na gilou ngal a," chi in.
english: Yahweh has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, will I cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

paite: Tangte a tanchinhoih tun a, lemna thu tangkoupihte khe en dih; Aw Judah, na ankuang lui inla, na thuchiamte tangtun in; mi thugina lou in ahon pal paisuak nawn kei ding a; hihmanthat vek ahita hi.
english: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

paite: Kitamgawpsakpa doutu na mai ah ahong pawt hi; kigalthuam inla, na lampi veng in, na kawng khauhsak inla na thilhihtheihna hattak in bawlhoih in.
english: He who dashes in pieces has come up against you. Keep the fortress! Watch the way! Strengthen your waist! Fortify your power mightily!

paite: Hihse mite'n Israel thupina hihsia in agrep guite hihtan mah le uh, TOUPA Jakobte thupina ama a bang in atungding nawn ngal ding ahi.
english: For Yahweh restores the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Israel; for the destroyers have destroyed them, and ruined their vine branches.

paite: Amihatte lum sansak ahi a, mihangsante asan-au in akivan ua; akisakna ni in kangtalaite kahpasik tet in ate kelkel ua, teipite mulkimhuaitak in aphe zolzol hi.
english: The shield of his mighty men is made red. The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots flash with steel in the day of his preparation, and the pine spears are brandished.

paite: Kangtalaite kongzing ah atai gomgom a; lamlian zate ah akiphu noknok ua; meisel bang in alang ua, khophia bang in atai zualzual uhi.
english: The chariots rage in the streets. They rush back and forth in the broad ways. Their appearance is like torches. They run like the lightnings.

paite: Amiliante atheigige a; apai lai un akisuipai ua; baang lam zuan in akinoh ua, kihumbitna ding abawl uhi.
english: He summons his picked troops. They stumble on their way. They dash to its wall, and the protective shield is put in place.

paite: Lui kongkhakte hon ahi a, kumpipa' inn hihsiat in a-om hi.
english: The gates of the rivers are opened, and the palace is dissolved.

paite: Huan Huzzab salmat in apaimangpih ua, asikhanute'n a-awm uh tum in vakhu bang a ham in akah uhi.
english: It is decreed: she is uncovered, she is carried away; and her handmaids moan as with the voice of doves, beating on their breasts.

paite: Nidanglai a kipan Nineveh khua zaw dil a tui luangkhia bang ahi; himahleh ami tampi ataikhe ding ua, khawl in, khawl in, chi in kikou mah le uh kuamah akihei kei ding uh.
english: But Nineveh has been from of old like a pool of water, yet they flee away. “Stop! Stop!” they cry, but no one looks back.

paite: Dangkasik gallak in laksak unla unla, dangka-eng leng gallak in laksak un; gou manpha a dim ahih ziak in thil kisekkhawm leh vanhoihte tawi bei ni anei kei ding hi.
english: Take the spoil of silver. Take the spoil of gold, for there is no end of the store, the glory of all goodly furniture.

paite: Sukvuak in a-om a, avuak keuhkeuh a, asiang sipsip; lungtang azulmang a, khukte akihot ua, kawng tengteng ana tuntun a, amelte amual khin vek hi.
english: She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.

paite: Humpinelkai khosakna mun, humpinelkai pite leh anoute nek ding abalnenna leh alausak ding om lou a humpinelkai leh humpinelkai tekte pai vialvialna koi mun hita ahia?
english: Where is the den of the lions, and the feeding place of the young lions, where the lion and the lioness walked, the lion’s cubs, and no one made them afraid?

paite: Humpinelkai tal in anoute kham khop abotnen a, humpinelkai pite a ding in akeilum a, akokhukte uh sa keih in adimsak a, a-omna kokhuk samatte in adimsak hi.
english: The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his caves with the kill, and his dens with prey.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Ngai dih, ka hon dou ahi, akangtalaite ka halkhu vungvung ding a, na humpinelkai noute namsau in ahihmang ding; lei a na sa keih ka sutawp ding a, na palaite aw zak ahi nawnta kei ding," achi hi.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”

paite: Sisan suah hat khopi tung agik hi! Zuau leh kilohna in adim khin a; asa keih uh tatlak lou ahi.
english: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and robbery. The prey doesn’t depart.

paite: Zepna ging, kangtalai khe ging, sakol tawmte, kangtalai tai gopgopte toh.
english: The noise of the whip, the noise of the rattling of wheels, prancing horses, and bounding chariots,

paite: Sakol tungtuangmi sakol a tuangte, namsau te zolzolte, teipi te zualzual toh; mi thah om lemlumte, luang om ziazuate toh; luang in bei chih mahmah anei kei; siluangte pal in akisuipuk uhi;
english: the horseman mounting, and the flashing sword, the glittering spear, and a multitude of slain, and a great heap of corpses, and there is no end of the bodies. They stumble on their bodies,

paite: Huai kizuak melhoih, bumsiamnu, a-angkawmna ziak a nam zuak a, abumhatna ziak a inkuan zuaknu angkawmna thupi mahmah ziak a hon gawm ahi.
english: because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, ka hon dou ahi; na mai ah na puan ka lem ding a; na vuaktanna namte kiang ah leh na zahlakna kumpipa gamte kiang ah ka ensak ding.
english: “Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will lift your skirts over your face. I will show the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

paite: Nin kihhuai mahmah in ka hon theh ding a, zumhuai mahmah in ka hon bawl dia, muhnop a ding in ka hon koih ding.
english: I will throw abominable filth on you, and make you vile, and will set you a spectacle.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, nang hon mu peuhmah nang a kipan ataimang ding ua, Nineveh khua ahong segawpta hi; kua'n amah suun dia, ahehnemtu ding koi a zong ding ka hia?
english: It will happen that all those who look at you will flee from you, and say, ‘Nineveh is laid waste! Who will mourn for her?’ Where will I seek comforters for you?”

paite: Nile Luite kikal a om Thebes, akim a tui in a-um, akulh ding a tuipi zang a kulhbaang ding a tuipi nei sang in na hoihzaw a hia?
english: Are you better than No-Amon, or, Thebes who was situated among the rivers, who had the waters around her; whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was of the sea?

paite: Ethiopia leh Aigupta ahatna ahi a, huai tuh tawp hun nei lou ahi; Put leh Libiate ahihleh nang hon panpihte ahi uh.
english: Cush and Egypt were her boundless strength. Put and Libya were her helpers.

paite: Huchipi in leng lakmang in a-om a, sal in atang a; kongzing teng tawp ah anaupang neute apaihnensak uh; amithahte uh a ding in ai asan ua, amiliante tengteng khainiang a gak ahi uh.
english: Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the streets, and they cast lots for her honorable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

paite: Nang leng na kham sam ding a, sel in na om ding; melma ziak in kulh kip na zong lai ding hi.
english: You also will be drunken. You will be hidden. You also will seek a stronghold because of the enemy.

paite: Na kulh tengteng theipi kung, gah min masa pulh bang ahi ding ua; alin peuhmah uleh nemi kam ah akelut zel uhi.
english: All your fortresses will be like fig trees with the first-ripe figs: if they are shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.

paite: Ngai in, na sung a na mipite numei ahi ua; na melmate a ding in na kongpi akihong heuhou a; na kikalhna siktawnte mei in akangtum hi.
english: Behold, your troops in your midst are women. The gates of your land are set wide open to your enemies. The fire has devoured your bars.

paite: Umkimvel a na om sung a ding in tui tawi inla, ka kulhte hihkip in; tungman omna ah hoh in, belhkipna chil in, lei haltakna thuk hihkip in.
english: Draw water for the siege. Strengthen your fortresses. Go into the clay, and tread the mortar. Make the brick kiln strong.

paite: Huai ah mei in ahong kangtum ding a, namsau in ahon satlum ding a, singnget bang in ahon hihmangthang ding hi. Singnget bang in kipungsak inla, khaukhup bang in kihihpung in.
english: There the fire will devour you. The sword will cut you off. It will devour you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the locust.

paite: Na sumsin mite van aksi sang a tam in na khangsak a; singnget in ahihsia a, alengmang mai uhi.
english: You have increased your merchants more than the stars of the skies. The grasshopper strips, and flees away.

paite: Kumpi lukhu khu na mite lah khaukhup bang ahi ua, na sepaihte khovot ni a huandai a khaupehon bokkhawm bang ahi uh, himahleh ni ahong suak a, alengmang ua, a-omna mun uh theih ahi kei hi.
english: Your guards are like the locusts, and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the walls on a cold day, but when the sun appears, they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

paite: Assuria kumpipa aw, na belamching mite alusu uhi; na miliante akhawl ua; na mipite tangte ah adalh ua, pikhawmmi kuamah a-om kei uhi.
english: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria. Your nobles lie down. Your people are scattered on the mountains, and there is no one to gather them.

paite: Na natna damna ding a-om kei; na liamna athupi mahmah hi; na husa za peuh in khut ahon betkhum ua; na gitlouhna thuak kha lou kua a-om a?
english: There is no healing your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who hear the report of you clap their hands over you; for who hasn’t felt your endless cruelty?

paite: Hakaliah tapa Nehemiah thute: Kisleu kha, akum sawmnihna kum a, Susa Inpi a ka om lai in hichi ahong hi a,
english: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now it happened in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the palace,

paite: Hananiah, ka unaute lak a khat ahong a, amah leh Judah a kipan mi kuate hiam; amaute kiang ah saltanna a kipan a nutsiat a omte, Juda suaktate tanchin leh Jerusalem thu ka dong hi.
english: that Hanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men out of Judah; and I asked them concerning the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem.

paite: Amau ka kiang ah, "Huai lai bial a saltanna a kipan omlaite gimthuakna thupi thuak leh simmoh in a-om uh: Jerusalem kulhbaangte leng achim a, akongpite leng mei in akang," achi uhi.
english: They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach. The wall of Jerusalem also is broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, hiai thute ka zak lai in, ka tu a ka kap a, ni bangzah hiam ka suun a; van Pathian ma ah an ngawl in ka thum hi.
english: It happened, when I heard these words, that I sat down and wept, and mourned certain days; and I fasted and prayed before the God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” of heaven,

paite: "AW TOUPA, van Pathian, Pathian thupi leh lauhuai, amah it a, athupiakte zuite tung a thukhun theigige leh zahngaihna nei gige.
english: and said, “I beg you, Yahweh, “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. the God of heaven, the great and awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness with those who love him and keep his commandments:

paite: "Tu in na bil in hon ngeingaih henla, na mitte hong kihong hen, huchi a na sikha thumna, huai hun a, sun leh zan a, na sikhate Israel suante a dia, nangmah tung a ka hihkhelh uh, Israel suante khelhna thupha tawi a, ka thumna na hon ngaihkhiaksakna ding in: Ahi, kei leh ka pa inkote ka khialta uhi.
english: Let your ear now be attentive, and your eyes open, that you may listen to the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel your servants while I confess the sins of the children of Israel, which we have sinned against you. Yes, I and my father’s house have sinned.

paite: "Thanghuaitak in na tung ah ka na gamtata ua, na thupiakte ka zuita kei ua, na sikha Mosi kiang a na thupiak, dan thusehte leh vaihawmte.
english: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances, which you commanded your servant Moses.

paite: Theigige in, ka hon ngen ahi, na sikha Mosi kiang a thu na piak, na tatlek uh leh mite lak ah ka hon thehzak ding.
english: “Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you abroad among the peoples;

paite: Himahleh ka kiang a na hong kik ua, ka thupiakte na zuih ua na hih uleh, delhkhiak a na omna uh van tawp mun ah himahleh, huai a kipan in amaute ka kaikhawm ding a, ka min omna dia ka mun telsa ah amaute ka pikhawm ding, chi in.
english: but if you return to me, and keep my commandments and do them, though your outcasts were in the uttermost part of the heavens, yet will I gather them from there, and will bring them to the place that I have chosen, to cause my name to dwell there.’

paite: Tu in hiaite, na thilhihtheihna thupi leh na banhat a na tatsa, na sikhate leh na mite ahi uh.
english: “Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have redeemed by your great power, and by your strong hand.

paite: "AW TOUPA, ka hon ngen ahi, na min laudan siam nuamsa, na sikha thumna leh na sikhate thumna na bil in ngeingaih hen: ka hon ngen ahi, tuni in na sikha lohchingsak inla, hiai mi mitmuh in akiang ah zahngaihna pia in," achi hi. Kei bel kumpipa nou dompa ka hi.
english: Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” , I beg you, let your ear be attentive now to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants, who delight to fear your name; and please prosper your servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man.” Now I was cup bearer to the king.

paite: Suaikaite hiaite ahi uh Nehemiah Tirshatha, Hakaliah tapa leh Zedekiah;
english: Now those who sealed were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,

paite: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah;
Pashur, Amariah, Malkijah;
Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluk;
Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah;
Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruk;
Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin;
Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah: hiaite siampute ahi uh.
english: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah; these were the priests.

paite: Levi mite: huaite, Jeshua, Azaniah tapa, Henadad tapa Binnui Kadmiel;
english: The Levites: namely, Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;

paite: A-unaute uh, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan;
english: and their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,

paite: Mika, Rehob, Hashabiah;
Zakkur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah;
Hodiah, Bani, Beninu.
Mite hausate: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani;
english: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,

paite: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai;
Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin;
Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur;
Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai;
Hariph, Anathot, Nebai;
Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir;
Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua;
Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah;
Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasub;
Hallohesh, Pileha, Shobek;
Rehum, Hasabnah, Maaseiah;
Huan Ahijah, Hanan, Anan;
Malluk, Harim, Baanah.

Huan mipi lak a adangte, siampute, Levi mite, Kongkhak ngakte, Lasa mite, Nethinim mite leh gamte a mite lak a kipan amau leh amau Pathian dan lam a kituamsehte tengteng, azite uh, atapate uh, atanute uh, michih theihna leh theihtheihna neite.
english: The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinim, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, everyone who had knowledge, and understanding—

paite: A-unaute uh, amiliante uh lam ah abelh tinten ua, Mosi Pathian sikha in apiak Pathian Dan a om ding leh TOUPA I TOUPA uh thupiak tengteng zui ding leh hih ding a, avaihawmte leh adan thusehte hih ding in hamsia leh kichiamna abawl uhi.
english: they joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in God’s law, which was given by Moses the servant of God, and to observe and do all the commandments of Yahweh our Lord, and his ordinances and his statutes;

paite: Huan i tanute gam a mite pe lou ding leh i tapate a dia atanute uh la lou ding in.
english: and that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons;

paite: Gam a mite'n Sabbath ni a van hiam an nek hiam zuak ding ahon tawi uleh, Sabbath hiam, ni sianthou ni hiam in huaite i lei kei ding uh; huchi in akum sagihna louhaite lak leh leiba chiteng sik i kidek ding uh.
english: and if the peoples of the land bring wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not buy of them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.

paite: Huai lou leng i Pathian uh inn a nasepna ding a kum teng a shekel seh thumna kibasak ding in, thupiakte i kibawl uhi.
english: Also we made ordinances for ourselves, to charge ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the service of the house of our God;

paite: Tanghou koihna ding, anpiak thillat gige a ding, halmang thillat gige a ding, Sabbathte, kha thakte, sehsa ankuangte a ding, thil siangthoute a ding, Israel a dia lemna kithoihna bawlna dia khelhna thillatte a ding leh i Pathian inn ua nasepna tengteng a ding in.
english: for the show bread, and for the continual meal offering, and for the continual burnt offering, for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.

paite: Ai i san ua, siampute, Levi mite leh mite, sing thillat a ding in, dan a kigelh bang a, i Pathian uh TOUPA maitam tung a khul ding, kum teng a, hun sehsa, i pipute inkote dungzui a, i Pathian inn ua laklut ding in.
english: We cast lots, the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood offering, to bring it into the house of our God, according to our fathers’ houses, at times appointed, year by year, to burn on the altar of Yahweh our God, as it is written in the law;

paite: TOUPA' inn a, kum teng a, i lei theigah masapente, sing chiteng a gah tengteng a kipan gah masapente, tawi ding in.
english: and to bring the first fruits of our ground, and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of trees, year by year, to the house of Yahweh;

paite: Dan a kigelh bang in, i tapate lak a piang masapen leh i gantate lak a leng, i bawnghonte lak leh i belamhonte lak a nou masapente, i Pathian inn ua nasem siampute kiang a i Pathian inn ua tawi ding in.
english: also the firstborn of our sons, and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bring to the house of our God, to the priests who minister in the house of our God;

paite: I tangbuang mek masakpen uleh, i vei thillatte uleh, sing chiteng gah, uain leh thau, i Pathian uh inn a dantante ah, siampute kiang ah i tawi ding uh; huan i louma a sawm-a-khatte Levi mite kiang ah; amau, Levi mite'n, singtang khopi tengteng uah sawm-a-khat ala uhi.
english: and that we should bring the first fruits of our dough, and our wave offerings, and the fruit of all kinds of trees, the new wine and the oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tithes of our ground to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

paite: Aaron tapa siampu, Levi mite'n sawm-a-khat alak chiang un, Levi mite kiang ah a-om ding: huchi in Levi mite'n sawm-a-khatte' sawm-a-khat i Pathian inn uah, dantante ah, sumbawm inn ah atawitou ding uhi.
english: The priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites, when the Levites take tithes: and the Levites shall bring up the tithe of the tithes to the house of our God, to the rooms, into the treasure house.

paite: Israel suante leh Levi tate'n buh-le-bal, uain, thau, thillat mun siang tui-um belsuan nasem siampute, kongkhak ngakte leh lasa mite omna, mun siangthou a atawi ding uh ahi. Huchi in i Pathian inn i nuse kei ding uhi.
english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall bring the wave offering of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the priests who minister, and the porters, and the singers. We will not forsake the house of our God.

paite: Huchi in mite vaihawmte Jerusalem ah ateng ua: midangte'n leng, khopi siangthou Jerusalem a teng ding sawm lak a khat leh khopi dangte a teng dia seh kuate theihna ding in ai asan uhi.
english: The princes of the people lived in Jerusalem: the rest of the people also cast lots, to bring one of ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.

paite: Mite'n Jerusalem a teng ding a uttak a amau leh amau kipete tengteng avualzawlta uhi.
english: The people blessed all the men who willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem a teng bial sung a hausate hiaite ahi uh; himahleh Judah khopite ah michih amau khopite uah michih atan chiat uah amau ateng ua, huaite, Israel siampute, Levi mite leh Nethinim mite leh Solomon sikhate tate.
english: Now these are the chiefs of the province who lived in Jerusalem; but in the cities of Judah everyone lived in his possession in their cities: Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants.

paite: Jerusalem ah Judah tate lak a leh Benjamin tate lak a kuate hiam ateng uhi. Judah tate lak ah: Athaiah Uzziah tapa, Zekariah tapa, Amariah tapa, Shephatiah tapa, Mahalalel tapa, Perez tate lak ah;
english: In Jerusalem lived certain of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;

paite: Maaseiah Baruk tapa, Kolhozeh tapa, Hazaiah tapa, Adaiah tapa, Joiarib tapa, Zekariah tapa, Shiloni tapa.
english: and Maaseiah the son of Baruch, the son of Colhozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.

paite: Jerusalem a teng Perez tapate tengteng pasal hangsan ngen zali sawmguk-le-giat ahi uh.
english: All the sons of Perez who lived in Jerusalem were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men.

paite: Hiaite Benjamin tapate ahi uh: Sallu, Meshullam tapa, Joed tapa, Pedaiah tapa, Kolaiah tapa, Maaseiah tapa, Ithiel tapa, Jeshaiah tapa.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.

paite: Huai nung in Gabbai, Sallai, zakua sawmnih-le-giat.
english: After him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Huan Zikri tapa Joel aheutu uh ahi: huan Senuah tapa Judah khopi tung a nihna ahi.
english: Joel the son of Zichri was their overseer; and Judah the son of Hassenuah was second over the city.

paite: Siampute lak ah: Joiarib tapa Jedaiah, Jakin tapa,
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah the son of Joiarib, Jachin,

paite: Hilkiah tapa Seraiah, Meshullam tapa, Zadok tapa, Meraioth tapa, Ahitub tapa, Pathian inn a vaihawm,
english: Seraiah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house,

paite: leh a-unaute uh huai inn a nasep sem, zagiat sawmnih-le-nih: huan Jeroham tapa Adaiah, Pelaliah tapa, Amzi tapa, Zekariah tapa, Pashur tapa, Malkijah tapa,
english: and their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred twenty-two; and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,

paite: leh a-unaute, pipute inkote hausate, zanih sawmli-le-nih: huan Azarel tapa Amashai, Ahzai tapa, Mesillemoth tapa, Immer tapa,
english: and his brothers, chiefs of fathers’ households, two hundred forty-two; and Amashsai the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,

paite: leh a-unaute uh, mihat hangsante, za-le-sawmnih-le-giat: huan aheutu uh Zabdiel, Haggedolim tapa ahi.
english: and their brothers, mighty men of valor, one hundred twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.

paite: Levi mite lak ah: Hassub tapa Shemaiah, Azrikam tapa, Hashabiah tapa, Bunni tapa;
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni;

paite: Shabbethai leh Jozabad, Levi mite hausate lak a, Pathian inn polam nasep a heutu;
english: and Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who had the oversight of the outward business of God’s house;

paite: Mika tapa Mattaniah, Zabdi tapa, Asaph tapa, thumna a kipahthu genna pankhe pipen ahi. Huan Bakbukiah, a-unaute lak a nihna; huan Shammua tapa Abda, Galal tapa, Jeduthun tapa.
english: and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who was the chief to begin the thanksgiving in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers; and Abda the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.

paite: Khopi siangthou sung a Levi mite tengteng zanih sawmgiat-le-li.
english: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.

paite: Huai ban ah kongkhak ngakte, Akkub, Talmon leh a-unaute uh kongpite ngakte, za sawmsagih-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: Moreover the porters, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers, who kept watch at the gates, were one hundred seventy-two.

paite: Huan Israel lak a omlaite, siampute lak a Levi mite, Judah khopite tengteng ah a-om ua, michih agouluahna chiat uah.
english: The residue of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the cities of Judah, everyone in his inheritance.

paite: Himahleh Ophel ah Nethinim mite ateng uh; huan mite tung ah Ziha leh Gispa Nethinim a-om uhi.
english: But the Nethinim lived in Ophel: and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.

paite: Jerusalem a Levi mite heutu leng Bani tapa Uzzi ahi, Hashabiah tapa, Mattaniah tapa, Mika tapa, Asaph tapate, Pathian inn a nasepna a lasa mite;
english: The overseer also of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the singers, over the business of God’s house.

paite: amau tungtang thu ah kumpipa a kipan a thupiak, niteng a akiphamoh bang in; lasa mite a ding a dan kipsa lah a-om ngal a.
english: For there was a commandment from the king concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every day required.

paite: Huan Pethahiah, Meshezabel tapa, Judah tapa Zerah tate lak a mipite tungtang thu tengteng amah kumpipa khut ah a-om hi.
english: Pethahiah the son of Meshezabel, of the children of Zerah the son of Judah, was at the king’s hand in all matters concerning the people.

paite: Khuate, aloute uh toh ahihleh, Judah tate lak a akhenkhatte Kiriatharba leh akhotate ah, Dibon leh akhotate ah, Jekabzeel leh akhotate ah ateng ua;
english: As for the villages, with their fields, some of the children of Judah lived in Kiriath Arba and its towns, and in Dibon and its towns, and in Jekabzeel and its villages,

paite: Jeshua leh Moladah leh Bethphelet ah;
english: and in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and Beth Pelet,

paite: Hazar-shual leh Beer-sheba leh akhotate ah;
english: and in Hazar Shual, and in Beersheba and its towns,

paite: Ziklag leh Mekonah leh akhotate ah;
english: and in Ziklag, and in Meconah and in its towns,

paite: Enrimmon leh Zariah leh Jarmuth ah;
english: and in En Rimmon, and in Zorah, and in Jarmuth,

paite: Zanoah, Adullam leh akhotate uah, Lakish leh huai aloute, Azekah leh akhotate. Huchi in Beer-sheba a kipan Hinnom Phaizang tan in giahbuk abawl uhi.
english: Zanoah, Adullam, and their villages, Lachish and its fields, Azekah and its towns. So they encamped from Beersheba to the valley of Hinnom.

paite: Benjamin tate leng Geba a kipan in atengtou zel ua, Mikmash leh Aija ah, Bethel leh akhotate ah;
english: The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,

paite: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah ah;
Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim;
Hadid, Zeboim. Neballat;
Lod leh Ono, khutsiamte phaizang ah.
english: Lod, and Ono, the valley of craftsmen.

paite: Huan Judah a Levi mite sehkhen bangzah hiam Benjamin toh akizom uhi.
english: Of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah settled in Benjamin’s territory.

paite: Huan hiaite Joshua leh Shealtiel tapa Zerubbabel toh tontou siampute leh Levi mite ahi uh.
english: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,

paite: Siampute: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra, Amariah, Malluk, Hattush;
Shekaniah, Rehum, Meremoth;
Iddo, Ginnetho, Abijah;
Miamin, Maadiah, Bilgah;
Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah;
Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. Hiaite siampute lak leh a- unaute uh lak a Jeshua dam lai a makai lianpente uh ahi.
english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.

paite: Levi mite mah leng: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, Mattaniah, kipahthu genna tung a om, amah leh a-unaute.
english: Moreover the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the thanksgiving, he and his brothers.

paite: Bakbukiah leh Unni leng, a-unaute uh toh venbuk sung ah a-om uh.
english: Also Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were over against them according to their offices.

paite: Huan Joshua in Joiakim asuang, Joiakim in Eliashib asuang, Eliashib in Joiada asuang,
english: Jeshua became the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim became the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib became the father of Joiada,

paite: Joiada in Jonathan asuang, Jonathan in Jaddua asuang hi.
english: and Joiada became the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan became the father of Jaddua.

paite: Huan Joiakim dam lai in siampute a-om ua, pipute' inkuan a lupente: Seraiah a pan Meraiah; Jeremiah a pan Hananiah;
english: In the days of Joiakim were priests, heads of fathers’ households: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;

paite: Ezra a pan Meshullam; Amariah a pan Jehohanan;
english: of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;

paite: Meliku a pan Jonathan; Shebaniah a pan Joseph;
english: of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;

paite: Harim a pan Adna; Meraioth a pan Helkai;
english: of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;

paite: Iddo a pan Zekariah; Ginnethon a pan Meshullam;
english: of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;

paite: Abijah a pan Zikri; Miniamin lak ah, Moadiah a pan Piltai;
english: of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;

paite: Bilgah a pan Shammua; Shemaiah a pan Jehonathan;
english: of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;

paite: Joiarib a pan Mattenai; Jedaiah a pan Uzzi;
english: and of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;

paite: Sallai a pan Kallai; Amok a pan Eber;
english: of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;

paite: Hilkiah a pan Hashabiah; Jedaiah a pan Nethaneel.
english: of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.

paite: Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, Jaddua dam lai in Levi mite, pipute inkote vaihawm makai a gelh ahi uh: Persia mi Darias vaihawm lai a, siampute toh in.
english: As for the Levites, in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, there were recorded the heads of fathers’ households; also the priests, in the reign of Darius the Persian.

paite: Levi tapate, pipute inkuan a lupente, khangthubu ah, Eliashib tapa Johanan dam lai tan a gelh ahi.
english: The sons of Levi, heads of fathers’ households, were written in the book of the chronicles, even until the days of Johanan the son of Eliashib.

paite: Huan Levi mite hausate: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Kadmiel tapa Jeshua, a-unaute uh toh amau hunbi chiat ah Pathian mipa David thupiak dungzui a kipahthu gen ding in kimaituah in adingh uhi.
english: The chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers over against them, to praise and give thanks, according to the commandment of David the man of God, watch next to watch.

paite: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkubte kongnite yankoihna dantan kem kongkhak ngakte ahi uhi.
english: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were porters keeping the watch at the storehouses of the gates.

paite: Hiaite Jozadak tapa, Jeshua tapa, Joiakim hun lai a damte ahi ua, huan huai tuh ukpipa Nehemiah leh laigelhmi, siampu Ezra hun lai ahi.
english: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest the scribe.

paite: Huan Jerusalem kulhbaang latna a ding in a-omna tengteng uah Levi mite azongkhia ua, kipahna toh, kipahthu genna leh lasak, dakkhutbet, tumgingte leh kaihgingte toh Jerusalem a amaute hon pi ding a, kipahna bawl ding in.
english: At the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem, to keep the dedication with gladness, both with giving thanks, and with singing, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and with harps.

paite: Huchi in lasa mite tapate akikaikhawm ua, Jerusalem kimvel a phaizang a kipan leh Netophah mite khotate a kipan in;
english: The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem, and from the villages of the Netophathites;

paite: Beth-gilgal a kipan in leng, Geba leh Azmaveth loute a kipan in; lasa mite'n lah Jerusalem kimvel in khotate ana bawlta ngal ua.
english: also from Beth Gilgal, and out of the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singers had built them villages around Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in siampute leh Levi mite akihihsiangthou ua, mite leh kongpite leh kulhbaangte ahihsiangthou uhi.
english: The priests and the Levites purified themselves; and they purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.

paite: Huchih lai in kulhbaang tung ah Judah vaihawmte ka pitou a, kipahthugen leh ahon a pai pawlpi nih ka sep a; huai ah pawl khat kulhbaang tung ah Ekvum Kongpi lam ah apai uhi.
english: Then I brought up the princes of Judah on the wall, and appointed two great companies who gave thanks and went in procession. One went on the right hand on the wall toward the dung gate;

paite: Amaute nung in Hoshaiah leh Judah vaihawmte lak a kimkhat,
english: and after them went Hoshaiah, and half of the princes of Judah,

paite: Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, Jeremiah,
english: Judah, and Benjamin, and Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,

paite: leh siampute tapate lak a kuate hiam pengkulte toh, Zekariah Jonathan tapa, Shemaiah tapa, Mattaniah tapa, Mikaiah tapa, Zakkur tapa, Asaph tapa;
english: and certain of the priests’ sons with trumpets: Zechariah the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph;

paite: a-unaute, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethaneel, Judah, Hanani Pathian mipa David tumging theihte toh; ama uah Ezra laigelhmi a-om hi.
english: and his brothers, Shemaiah, and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, and Judah, Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was before them.

paite: Tuikhuk kongpi kiang ah, amazawntak uah, David khopi dohkang ah apaitou ua, kulhbaang toupaina ah, David inn tunglam ah, suahlam pang a Tui Kongpi pha in.
english: By the spring gate, and straight before them, they went up by the stairs of the city of David, at the ascent of the wall, above the house of David, even to the water gate eastward.

paite: Huan alak ua pawl dang kipahthugente amaute tuak ding in apai ua, kei amau nung ah, kulhbaang tung a, meipi insang tunglam ah, kulhbaang lian tanpha in;
english: The other company of those who gave thanks went to meet them, and I after them, with the half of the people, on the wall, above the tower of the furnaces, even to the broad wall,

paite: Ephraim kongpi tung ah, kongpi lui kiang, ngasa kongpi kiang a Hananel insang, Meah insang, Belam Kongpi tanpha in Venna Kongpi ah adingh den uhi.
english: and above the gate of Ephraim, and by the old gate, and by the fish gate, and the tower of Hananel, and the tower of Hammeah, even to the sheep gate: and they stood still in the gate of the guard.

paite: Huchi in Pathian insung a kipahthugen pawl nihte leh kei leh ka kiang a vaihawmte lak a akimkhatte adingh ua:
english: So stood the two companies of those who gave thanks in God’s house, and I, and the half of the rulers with me;

paite: Siampute, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Mikaiah, Elioenai, Zekariah, Hananiah, pengkulte toh;
english: and the priests, Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with trumpets;

paite: huan Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malkijah, Elam leh Ezer. Huchi in lasa mite'n ngaihtak in, aheutupa uh Jezrahiah toh la asa uhi.
english: and Maaseiah, and Shemaiah, and Eleazar, and Uzzi, and Jehohanan, and Malchijah, and Elam, and Ezer. The singers sang loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.

paite: Huai ni in kithoihna thupite alan ua, nuam asa uhi; Pathian in lah nopsakna thupi in amau nuam asasak hi; numeite leh naupangte toh akipak uhi: huchi in Jerusalem kipahna husa gamlapi tan ah leng zak in a-om hi.
english: They offered great sacrifices that day, and rejoiced; for God had made them rejoice with great joy; and the women also and the children rejoiced: so that the joy of Jerusalem was heard even afar off.

paite: Huai ni in thilpiakte, vei thillatte, haithak masapente, sawm-a-khatte koihkhawmna dantante a heutu, Dan in aseh bang a, siampu leh Levite tantuan kho chih in ana hihzoh bang zel ua lakhawm ding mite asep uhi. Judahte bel nasemmi siampute leh Levite ziak in akipak mahmah uhi.
english: On that day were men appointed over the rooms for the treasures, for the wave offerings, for the first fruits, and for the tithes, to gather into them, according to the fields of the cities, the portions appointed by the law for the priests and Levites: for Judah rejoiced for the priests and for the Levites who waited.

paite: A Pathian uh indan leh siansakna indan akem ua, huchibang in lasa mite leh kongkhak ngak mite'n David leh atapa Solomon thupiak bang in ahihta uhi.
english: They performed the duty of their God, and the duty of the purification, and so did the singers and the porters, according to the commandment of David, and of Solomon his son.

paite: David leh nidanglai a Asaph dam lai in lasami heutupen leh Pathian kiang a phatna leh kipahthu genna lasate lah a-om ngal a,
english: For in the days of David and Asaph of old there was a chief of the singers, and songs of praise and thanksgiving to God.

paite: Huan Zerubbabel dam lai leh Nehemiah dam lai in Israel tengteng in, niteng a akul bang in lasa mite leh kongkhak ngak mite tantuan ape zel uhi: Levi mite a ding in thilsiangte asepsiang ua; Levi mite'n Aaron tapate a ding in asepsiangthou uhi.
english: All Israel in the days of Zerubbabel, and in the days of Nehemiah, gave the portions of the singers and the porters, as every day required: and they set apart that which was for the Levites; and the Levites set apart that which was for the sons of Aaron.

paite: Huai ni in mite zak in Mosi laibu asim ua; Ammon mi leh Moab mi tangtawn in Pathian khawmpi sung a alut ding uh ahi kei chih, huai sung a kigelh amu uhi.
english: On that day they read in the book of Moses in the audience of the people; and therein was found written, that an Ammonite and a Moabite should not enter into the assembly of God forever,

paite: Tanghou leh tui a Israel suante dawn lou a, amaute hamsiat ding a, amaute siatna ding a Balaam alak ziak un: himahleh i Pathian in hamsia vualzawlna asuaksakta hi.
english: because they didn’t meet the children of Israel with bread and with water, but hired Balaam against them, to curse them: however our God turned the curse into a blessing.

paite: Dan azak lai un, hichi ahong hi a, gamdangmi suante a pan Israel mite akikhenkhe tuamta uhi.
english: It came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude.

paite: Huan hiai ma in, siampu Eliashib i Pathian inn ua dantante tung a seh a ompa, Tobiah toh kizom in,
english: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who was appointed over the rooms of the house of our God, being allied to Tobiah,

paite: ama a ding in dantan thupi abawlkhol a, huai ah amalam in anpiak thillatte, begaw leh tui-um belsuante leh buh-le-bal, uain leh thaute sawm-a-khatte akoih ua, huaite bel Levi mite leh lasa mite leh kongkhak ngak mite kiang a thupiak a piak ahi a; huan vei thillatte siampute a ding in.
english: had prepared for him a great room, where before they laid the meal offerings, the frankincense, and the vessels, and the tithes of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, which were given by commandment to the Levites, and the singers, and the porters; and the wave offerings for the priests.

paite: Himahleh hiai hunte in, Jerusalem ah ka om kei: Babulon kumpipa Artaksarses kum sawmthum-le-nih kum in kumpipa kiang ah ka hoh a, ni bangzah hiam nung in kumpipa phalna ka ngen hi.
english: But in all this, I was not at Jerusalem; for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I went to the king: and after certain days asked I leave of the king,

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem ah ka hong a, Pathian inn pisate sung dantan amah a dia abawlsakna ah, Eliashib in Tobiah a dia gilou ahihdan ka theisiam hi.
english: and I came to Jerusalem, and understood the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing him a room in the courts of God’s house.

paite: Huchi in kei hon dahsak mahmah a: huaiziak in dantan a kipan in Tobiah inn van tengteng ka lawnkhia hi.
english: It grieved me severely: therefore I cast forth all the household stuff of Tobiah out of the room.

paite: Huan thu ka pia a, dantante ahihsiang ua: huai ah anpiak thillatte leh begaw toh, Pathian inn a tui-um belsuan ka hon la nawn hi.
english: Then I commanded, and they cleansed the rooms: and there brought I again the vessels of God’s house, with the meal offerings and the frankincense.

paite: Levi mite tante amau kiang ah piak nai louh in a-om chih ka thei a; huchi in Levi mite leh lasa mite, nasep semte michih aloulam ah ataizak uhi.
english: I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them; so that the Levites and the singers, who did the work, had fled everyone to his field.

paite: Kei tuh vaihawmte toh ka kiselta ua, bang ding a Pathian inn mangngilh a om ahia? ka chi hi. Amau ka kaikhawm a, amun uah ka koih hi.
english: Then I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is God’s house forsaken?” I gathered them together, and set them in their place.

paite: Judah tengteng in buh-le-bal leh uain leh thau sawm-a-khat sumbawm ah ahon tawi uhi.
english: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the oil to the treasuries.

paite: Sumbawm a ding in sumkem mite ka bawl a, Shelemiah siampute, Zadok laigelhmite leh Levi mite lak ah Pedaiah. Huan amaute zom in Zakkur tapa Hanan, Mattaniah tapa: muanhuai a sim ahi ngal ua, anasep uh a-unaute uh kiang a hawm ding ahi.
english: I made treasurers over the treasuries, Shelemiah the priest, and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were counted faithful, and their business was to distribute to their brothers.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, hiai thu ah hon theigige inla, ka Pathian inn a ding a ka nasep hoih ka hihte leh huai a zuih dingte nulmang ke'n.
english: Remember me, my God, concerning this, and don’t wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its observances.

paite: Huai lai in Judah ah Sabbath ni a kuate hiam uain suknate chil a, buhphalte hon tawi a, huaite toh asabiltungte van guang ka mu a; uain, grep gahte, theipite van puakgik chi chih, Sabbath ni a Jerusalem a hon tawilutte leng; huan an nekte azuak ni uh huai ni in amaute dem in thu ka gen hi.
english: In those days saw I in Judah some men treading winepresses on the Sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys; as also wine, grapes, and figs, and all kinds of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day: and I testified against them in the day in which they sold food.

paite: Huai ah Tura mite leng a-om ua, ngasa ahon tawi ua, van chi tuamtuam toh, Judah tate kiang leh Jerusalem ah Sabbath ni in azuak uhi.
english: There lived men of Tyre also therein, who brought in fish, and all kinds of wares, and sold on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.

paite: Huchi in ke'n Judahte miliante ka kiselpih a, akiang uah, "Bang thil gilou ahia hiai na hih ua, Sabbath na hihnit uh?
english: Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, and profane the Sabbath day?

paite: Na pipute un huchibang in ahih ngei ua hia, i Pathian in eite tung leh hiai khopi tung ah hiai hoih lou tengteng hon tun ahi kei maw? Hinapi in nou Sabbath hihnin in Israel tung ah thangpaihna tamsem na tun ua," ka chi hi.
english: Didn’t your fathers do thus, and didn’t our God bring all this evil on us, and on this city? Yet you bring more wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”

paite: Huan Jerusalem kongpite Sabbath ni ma a khua amial pat in, hichi ahong hi a, kongkhakte khak ding in thu ka pia a, Sabbath ni abei matan kihong lou ding in thu ka pia a, ka sikhate lak a akhen kongpi tung ah ka pangsak a, huchi a Sabbath ni a puakgik ahong kilaklutlouhna ding in.
english: It came to pass that, when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the Sabbath, I commanded that the doors should be shut, and commanded that they should not be opened until after the Sabbath. I set some of my servants over the gates, that no burden should be brought in on the Sabbath day.

paite: Huchi in khatvei hiam nihvei hiam sumsin mite leh van chiteng zuak mite Jerusalem polam ah agiak uhi.
english: So the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares lodged outside of Jerusalem once or twice.

paite: Amaute dem in thu ka gen a, akiang uah, "Bangziak a kulhbaang kim a giak na hi ua? Na hih nawn uleh, na tung uah khut ka kha ding," ka chi lai hi. Huai hun a kipan in Sabbath ni in ahong pai nawnta kei uhi.
english: Then I testified against them, and said to them, “Why do you stay around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you.” From that time on, they didn’t come on the Sabbath.

paite: Kihihsiangthou ding leh hong kuan a kongpite ngak ding, Sabbath ni siangsak ding in, Levi mite thu ka pia hi. Aw ka Pathian, hiai ah leng kei hon theigige in, na zahngaihna letdan dungzui in kei hon hawi in.
english: I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember to me, my God, this also, and spare me according to the greatness of your loving kindness.

paite: Huai lai in Judate Ashdod, Ammon leh Moab numeite kitenpihte leng ka mu hi:
english: In those days also saw I the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab:

paite: Huchi in atate'n Ashdod pau kimkhat leh namdangte pau azang ua, Judate pau in apau thei kei uhi.
english: and their children spoke half in the speech of Ashdod, and could not speak in the Jews’ language, but according to the language of each people.

paite: Amaute ka kiselpih a, ka hamsiatkhum a, alak ua kuate hiam ka khen a, amul uh ka bohkhiaksak a, Pathian min lou in ka kichiamsak a, "Na tanute uh atapate uh a ding in na pe kei ding ua, na tapate uh a ding hiam, noumau a ding hiam in leng atanute uh na la ding uh ahi kei chi in.
english: I contended with them, and cursed them, and struck certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by God, “You shall not give your daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons, or for yourselves.

paite: Israel kumpipa Solomon hiaite in akhial kei maw? Hinapi in lah nam tampite lak ah amah bang kumpipa a-om kei a, a Pathian it in a-om a, Israel tengteng tung ah Pathian in kumpipa in abawl hi. Himahleh amah nangawn numei lamdangte'n akhialsak uhi.
english: Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations was there no king like him, and he was beloved of his God, and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless foreign women caused even him to sin.

paite: Ahihleh hiai gilou mahmah hih ding in, numei lamdangte kitenpih a i Pathian tung a talek ding in, na thu hon zui ding ka hi uh maw?"
english: Shall we then listen to you to do all this great evil, to trespass against our God in marrying foreign women?”

paite: Joiada tapate lak a khat, siampu lianpen Eliashib tapa, Horon mi Sanballat tanu' pasal ahi a; huaiziak in kei a kipan ka delhkhia hi.
english: One of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite: therefore I chased him from me.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, siamputna, siamputna thukhun leh Levi mite ahihnit ziak un, amaute theigige in.
english: Remember them, my God, because they have defiled the priesthood, and the covenant of the priesthood, and of the Levites.

paite: Huchi in mikhualte tengteng a kipan in amaute ka hihsiang a, siampute a ding leh Levi mite a ding in, michih anasep uah, nasepdante ka sehsak a;
english: Thus I cleansed them from all foreigners, and appointed duties for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;

paite: hun sehsa a sing thillat a ding leh gah masa a ding in. Aw ka Pathian, hoihna ding in kei hon theigige in.
english: and for the wood offering, at times appointed, and for the first fruits. Remember me, my God, for good.

paite: Kumpipa Artaksarses vaihawm akum sawmnih, Nisan kha in, ama a uain a-om lai in hichi ahong hi a, uain ka la a, kumpipa kiang ah ka pia hi. Ama ah nidang in dahmel ka pu ngei nai kei hi.
english: It happened in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, that I took up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been sad before in his presence.

paite: Kumpipa'n ka kiang ah, "Na chi lah ana kei a, bangchi a dahmel pu mawk na hia? Hiai zaw bangmah dang ahi kei, lungtang dahna ahi," achi hi. Huchi in ka lauta mahmah a.
english: The king said to me, “Why is your face sad, since you are not sick? This is nothing else but sorrow of heart.” Then I was very much afraid.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa tangtawn in dam hen: ka pipute hante omna, khopi kisegawp a om a, huai a kongpite mei in kangtum hiven bangchi in ka mel adah lou dia?" ka chi hi.
english: I said to the king, “Let the king live forever! Why shouldn’t my face be sad, when the city, the place of my fathers’ tombs, lies waste, and its gates have been consumed with fire?”

paite: Kumpipa'n ka kiang ah, "Ahihleh bang ahia na nget?" achi hi. Huchi in van Pathian kiang ah ka thumta hi.
english: Then the king said to me, “For what do you make request?” So I prayed to the God of heaven.

paite: Kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa kipah lam ahih a, na mitmuh a na sikha in deihsakna atanleh, Judah gam ah, ka pipute han omna khopi ka bawltheihna ding in kei hon sawl in," ka chi hi.
english: I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, and if your servant has found favor in your sight, that you would send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers’ tombs, that I may build it.”

paite: Kumpipa'n ka kiang ah, (kumpinu leng akiang a tu ahi a), "Na khualzinna bang tan a sawt ahi dia? Chikchiang in na hong kik nawn dia?" ahon chita hi. Huchi in kei hon sawl ding kumpipa kipah lam ahi a; amah hun ka pia hi.
english: The king said to me (the queen was also sitting by him), “For how long shall your journey be? And when will you return?” So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.

paite: Huai lou in kumpipa kiang ah, "Kumpipa kipah lam ahih a, Judah gam tan ka tun mateng a kei ahon paisak zel theihna ding un, luipi khen a ukpipate kiang a piak ding laikhakte hon pe lechin.
english: Moreover I said to the king, “If it pleases the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the River, that they may let me pass through until I come to Judah;

paite: Inn toh kizom kulh kongpite a ding leh khopi kulhbaangte a ding leh ka lutna ding inn a dia bawl ding inkamte bawlna dia sing ahon piakna ding in, kumpipa gammang kempa Asaph kiang ah laikhak hon khaksak lechin, ka chi hi. Huchi in kumpipa'n ka tung a ka Pathian khut hoih a-om bang in hon phalsak hi.
english: and a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the citadel by the temple, for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into.” The king granted my requests, because of the good hand of my God on me.
