paite: "Huchi in luipi khen a ukpipate kiang ka hong tung a, akiang uah kumpipa laikhakte ka pia hi. Huchi in kumpipa'n hon zui ding in sepaih pawl heutute leh sakol tungtuang mite asawl hi.
english: Then I came to the governors beyond the River, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent with me captains of the army and horsemen.

paite: Horon mi, Sanballat leh sikha Tobiah, Ammon mi in azaktak un, Israel suante hoihna zongmi kuahiam khat ahong pai ziak in nakpitak in alungkim kei mahmah uhi.
english: When Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, heard of it, it grieved them exceedingly, because a man had come to seek the welfare of the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Jerusalem ah ka hong a, huai ah ni thum ka omta hi.
english: So I came to Jerusalem, and was there three days.

paite: "Zan in ka thou a, kei leh ka kiang a om mi tawmchikte; Jerusalem a dia hih ding ka lungtang sung a ka Pathian in bang ahia a koihmi kuamah ka hilh kei a: atung a ka tuanna ganta chih louh ngal ka kiang ah ganta a-om kei hi.
english: I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; neither told I any man what my God put into my heart to do for Jerusalem; neither was there any animal with me, except the animal that I rode on.

paite: "Zan in Gulpi Tuileh lam, Ekvum Kongpi lam ah, Phaizang Kongpi a pai in ka pawtkhia a, achimsa, Jerusalem kulhbaangte leh mei a kangsa kongpite ka velta hi.
english: I went out by night by the valley gate, even toward the jackal’s well, and to the dung gate, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and its gates were consumed with fire.

paite: "Tuikhuk Kongpi leh Kumpipa Dil ah ka hoh a: himahleh ka nuai a om ganta paina ding mun a-om kei hi.
english: Then I went on to the spring gate and to the king’s pool: but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass.

paite: "Luita zui in zan in ka paitou a, kulhbaang ka vel a; ka kik nawn a, Phaizang Kongpi ah ka lut a, huchi in ka kik nawnta hi.
english: Then went I up in the night by the brook, and viewed the wall; and I turned back, and entered by the valley gate, and so returned.

paite: "Huchi in ka paina lam hiam, ka hih hiam vaihawm mite'n athei kei uh; Judate kiang ah leng, siampute hiam, miliante hiam, vaihawmte hiam leh nasep sem midangte kiang ah leng ka gen nai kei hi.
english: The rulers didn’t know where I went, or what I did; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews, nor to the priests, nor to the nobles, nor to the rulers, nor to the rest who did the work.

paite: Huan akiang uah, 'I dinmun uh hoihlouhdan na mu ua, Jerusalem asiat khitdan, huai a kongpite mei a akat khitdan: simmoh a i om nawnlouhna ding in, kisa un Jerusalem baang i lam nawn ding uh,' ka chi hi.
english: Then I said to them, “You see the evil case that we are in, how Jerusalem lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire. Come, let us build up the wall of Jerusalem, that we won’t be disgraced.”

paite: "Huchi in ka tung a hoih ka Pathian' khut tanchin ka kiang a agen kumpipa thute leng amau ka hilh a; huchi in amau, 'Thou ni in lam ni,' achi uhi. Huchi in nasep hoih sem ding in akhutte uh ahatsakta uhi.
english: I told them of the hand of my God which was good on me, as also of the king’s words that he had spoken to me. They said, “Let’s rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.

paite: Himahleh Horon mi Sanballat leh Ammon mi sikha Tobiah leh Arabia mi Geshem in azak un, ahon nuihsan ua, ahon simmohbawl ua, 'Bang thil ahia na hih uh? Kumpipa tung a hel sawm na hi uhia?' achi uhi.
english: But when Sanballat the Horonite, and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, heard it, they ridiculed us, and despised us, and said, “What is this thing that you are doing? Will you rebel against the king?”

paite: "Amau ka dawng a, akiang uah, 'Van Pathian in koute ahon lohchingsak ding, huaiziak in kou asikhate ka thou ding ua ka lam ding uh: himahleh nou Jerusalem ah thuneihna, theihgigena leh tan na nei kei uhi,' " ka chi hi.
english: Then answered I them, and said to them, “The God of heaven will prosper us. Therefore we, his servants, will arise and build; but you have no portion, nor right, nor memorial, in Jerusalem.”

paite: Huchi in siampu lianpen Eliashib a-unau siampute toh athou ua, Belam Kongpi abawl ua; ahihsiangthou ua, akongkhakte atung ua; Hameah insang tan in ahihsiangthou ua, Hananel insang tan in.
english: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brothers the priests, and they built the sheep gate; they sanctified it, and set up its doors; even to the tower of Hammeah they sanctified it, to the tower of Hananel.

paite: Amah zom in Jeriko mite'n alam uhi. Amau zom in Imri tapa Zakkur in alam hi.
english: Next to him built the men of Jericho. Next to them built Zaccur the son of Imri.

paite: Hassenaah tapate'n Ngasa Kongpi ahih ua; a-inkamte akhung ua, akongkhakte atung ua, akalhnate leh akalhna tawnte.
english: The sons of Hassenaah built the fish gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

paite: Amau zom in Uriah tapa, Hakkoz tapa, Meremoth in abawlhoih hi. Amaute zom in Berekiah tapa Meshullam, Meshezabel tapa in abawlhoih hi. Amaute zom in Baana tapa Zadok in abawlhoih hi.
english: Next to them, Meremoth the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz made repairs. Next to them, Meshullam the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel made repairs. Next to them, Zadok the son of Baana made repairs.

paite: Amaute zom in Tekoa mite'n abawlhoih ua; himahleh amiliante un a TOUPA uh nasepna ah anak pan nuam kei uhi.
english: Next to them, the Tekoites made repairs; but their nobles didn’t put their necks to the work of their lord.

paite: Kongpi lui pen Paseah tapa Jehoiada leh Besodeiah tapa Meshullam in abawlhoih ua, a-inkamte akhung ua, akongkhakte atung ua, akalhnate leh akalhna tawnte toh.
english: Joiada the son of Paseah and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah repaired the old gate. They laid its beams, and set up its doors, and its bolts, and its bars.

paite: Amaute zom in Gibeon mi Melatiah leh Meronoth mi, Jadon, Gibeon mite, Mizpah mite, luipi khen a ukpipa laltutphah toh kizomte'n abawlhoih uhi.
english: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon, and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.

paite: Amah zom in Harhaiah, dangka-eng sek mite tapa Uzziel in abawlhoih hi. Amah zom in gimlim bawl mite tapa Hananiah in abawlhoih a, kulhbaang za tanpha in Jerusalem abubitsak uhi.
english: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah one of the perfumers made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the broad wall.

paite: Amaute zom in Jerusalem seh kimkhat a vaihawmpa, Hur tapa Rephaiah in abawlhoih hi.
english: Next to them, Rephaiah the son of Hur, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, made repairs.

paite: Amaute zom in Harumaph tapa Jedaiah in, ama inn sun hial in abawlhoih hi. Huan amah zom in Hashabneiah tapa Hattush in abawlhoih hi.
english: Next to them, Jedaiah the son of Harumaph made repairs across from his house. Next to him, Hattush the son of Hashabneiah made repairs.

paite: Malkijah, Harim tapa leh Pahath-moab tapa Hasub in amun dang leh meipi insang abawlhoih uhi.
english: Malchijah the son of Harim, and Hasshub the son of Pahathmoab, repaired another portion, and the tower of the furnaces.

paite: Amah zom in Jerusalem seh kimkhat a vaihawmpa, Hallohesh tapa Shallum in, amah leh atanute toh abawlhoih uhi.
english: Next to him, Shallum the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half the district of Jerusalem, he and his daughters, made repairs.

paite: Guam Kongpi pen Hanun leh Zanoah a tengte'n abawlhoih ua, alam ua, akongkhakte atung ua, akalhnate leh akalhna tawnte leh Ekvum Kongpi lam a kulhbaang tong sangkhat toh.
english: Hanun and the inhabitants of Zanoah repaired the valley gate. They built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and one thousand cubits of the wall to the dung gate.

paite: Huchi in Beth-hakkerem seh a vaihawmpa, Rekab tapa Malkijah in Ekvum Kongpi abawlhoih a, akongkhakte, akalhnate leh atung a akalhna tawnte alam hi.
english: Malchijah the son of Rechab, the ruler of the district of Beth Haccherem repaired the dung gate. He built it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars.

paite: Mizpah seh a vaihawmpa, Kol-hozeh tapa Shallum in tuikhuk kongpi abawlhoih a; alam a, avuk a, kongkhakte, kalhnate leh kalhna tawnte leh kumpipa huan kiang a Shiloah Dil baang, David Khopi a kipan a sukpai leichial tan in abawl hi.
english: Shallun the son of Colhozeh, the ruler of the district of Mizpah repaired the spring gate. He built it, and covered it, and set up its doors, its bolts, and its bars, and the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king’s garden, even to the stairs that go down from the city of David.

paite: Amah nung in Azbuk tapa Nehemiah, Beth-zur gam kimkhat a vaihawmpa'n, David han toh kimatuah mun leh dil bawltawm chiang leh mihatte inn tan in abawlhoih hi.
english: After him, Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of half the district of Beth Zur, made repairs to the place opposite the tombs of David, and to the pool that was made, and to the house of the mighty men.

paite: Amah nung in, Levite, Bani tapa Rehumte'n abawlhoih uhi. Huan amah zom in Keilah seh kimkhat a vaihawmpa Hashabiah in ama seh ding in abawlhoih hi.
english: After him, the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of Keilah, made repairs for his district.

paite: Amah nung in a-unaute uh, Keilah seh kimkhat a vaihawmpa, Henadad tapa Bavai in abawlhoih hi.
english: After him, their brothers, Bavvai the son of Henadad, the ruler of half the district of Keilah made repairs.

paite: Amah zom in Mizpah vaihawmpa, Jeshua tapa Ezer in seh dang, kulhbaang kawina tak a galvan koihkhawmna tan a paitouhna sun in abawlhoih hi.
english: Next to him, Ezer the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another portion, across from the ascent to the armory at the turning of the wall.

paite: Amah nung in Zabbai tapa Baruk in seh dang, kulhbaang kawina a kipan siampu lianpen Eliashib inn kongkhak chiang abawlhoih hi.
english: After him, Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired another portion, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest.

paite: Amah nung in Hakkoz tapa Uriah tapa Meremoth in seh dang, Eliashib in kongkhak a kipan Eliashib inn tawpna chiang abawlhoih hi.
english: After him, Meremoth the son of Uriah the son of Hakkoz repaired another portion, from the door of the house of Eliashib even to the end of the house of Eliashib.

paite: Amah nung in, phaizang mite, siampute'n abawlhoih uhi.
english: After him, the priests, the men of the Plain made repairs.

paite: Amaute nung in Benjamin leh Hasub in a-inn pha un abawlhoih ua. Amau nung in Ananiah tapa Maaseiah tapa Azariah in amah inn sik ah abawlhoih hi.
english: After them, Benjamin and Hasshub made repairs across from their house. After them, Azariah the son of Maaseiah the son of Ananiah made repairs beside his own house.

paite: Amah nung in Henadad tapa Binui in seh dang, Azariah inn a kipan kulhbaang kawina tan leh aning chiang abawlhoih hi.
english: After him, Binnui the son of Henadad repaired another portion, from the house of Azariah to the turning of the wall, and to the corner.

paite: Uzai tapa Palal in kulhbaang kawina sun chiang abawlhoih a, kumpipa' inn tungnungzaw a kipan a hong dingkhetou insang, venna pisa kiang a om toh, amah nung in Parosh tapa Pedaiah,
english: Palal the son of Uzai made repairs opposite the turning of the wall, and the tower that stands out from the upper house of the king, which is by the court of the guard. After him Pedaiah the son of Parosh made repairs.

paite: leh tempul nasem Ophel a tengteng suahlam pang Tui Kongpi leh insang lawkkhia zawn tan abawlhoih uhi.
english: (Now the Nethinim lived in Ophel, to the place over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stands out.)

paite: Amah khit in Tekoa mite'n seh dang, Ophel kulhbaang chiang pha, insang thupi dingkhetou sun in abawlhoih uhi.
english: After him the Tekoites repaired another portion, over against the great tower that stands out, and to the wall of Ophel.

paite: Siampute'n Sakol Kongpi tunglam, michih in ama inn tung sun chiat in abawlhoih uhi.
english: Above the horse gate, the priests made repairs, everyone across from his own house.

paite: Amaute nung in Immer tapa Zadok in ama inn tung suntou chiang abawlhoih hi. Amah nung in suahlam kongpi ngakpa Shekaniah tapa Shemaiah in abawlhoih hi.
english: After them, Zadok the son of Immer made repairs across from his own house. After him, Shemaiah the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east gate made repairs.

paite: Amah nung in Shelemiah tapa Hananiah leh Zalaph tapa gukna Hanun in seh dang abawlhoih uhi. Amah nung in Berekiah tapa Meshullam in adantan tung zawn abawlhoih hi.
english: After him, Hananiah the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another portion. After him, Meshullam the son of Berechiah made repairs across from his room.

paite: Amah nung in dangka-eng sek mite tapa Malkijah in Nethinimte inn leh sumsin mite inn chiang, Hammipkad Kongpi zawn chiang leh aning a kahtouhna chiang abawlhoih hi.
english: After him, Malchijah one of the goldsmiths to the house of the Nethinim, and of the merchants, made repairs over against the gate of Hammiphkad, and to the ascent of the corner.

paite: Huan aning a kahtouhna leh Belam Kongpi kikal dangka-eng sek mite leh sumsin mite'n abawlhoih uhi.
english: Between the ascent of the corner and the sheep gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants made repairs.

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang i lam uh chih Sanballat in azak in, ahehta a, nakpitak in athangpai a, Judate akouta hi.
english: But it happened that when Sanballat heard that we were building the wall, he was angry, and took great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

paite: Huchi in a-unaute leh Samari sepaih pawl ma ah thu agen a, "Hiai Juda zawngkhalte'n bang ahia ahih uh? Kihihhat ding uhia? Kithoih ding uh hia? Ni khat a zoh sawm uhia? Akangsa ahi chih mu napi in, ninneng sunvum a kipan a suangte bawl thak ding uhia?" achi hi.
english: He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, “What are these feeble Jews doing? Will they fortify themselves? Will they sacrifice? Will they finish in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?”

paite: Huai lai in Ammon mi Tobiah akiang ah a-om a, "Ama'n, a-inn lam uh, sihal nangawn va kaltouleh, asuang baang uh alaichim ding," achi hi.
english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, “What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall.”

paite: Za in aw ka Pathian; simmoh in lah ka om ngal ua: ahon kouna uh amau lutung ah kiksak inla, saltanna gam a loh ding in amau pia in:
english: “Hear, our God; for we are despised; and turn back their reproach on their own head, give them up for a spoil in a land of captivity;

paite: Aginatlouhna uh khuh ke'nla, na ma a kipan akhelhna uh nulmang in omsak ke'n: inn lamte ma ah nang ahon hehsakta uhi.
english: don’t cover their iniquity, and don’t let their sin be blotted out from before you; for they have insulted the builders.”

paite: Huchi in baang ka bawl ua; baang tengteng, asandan kim chiang in akizom ta hi: mite'n lah nna sem ding in lungsim anei ngal ua.
english: So we built the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height: for the people had a mind to work.

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, Sanballat, Tobiah, Arab mite, Ammon mite leh Ashdod mite'n Jerusalem kulhbaangte bawlphatna in ma asawntou zel a, akichipsiatna akibawlpha, chih azak un, athangpai mahmah uhi.
english: But it happened that when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, then they were very angry;

paite: Huchi in avek ua hong kuan a Jerusalem dou ding leh huai a buaina omsak ding in akikumkhawmta uhi.
english: and they conspired all of them together to come and fight against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion therein.

paite: Himahleh i Pathian kiang ah i thum ua, amau ziak in sun leh zan in amaute vil ding i koih uhi.
english: But we made our prayer to our God, and set a watch against them day and night, because of them.

paite: Judah in, "Puakgik pote hatna abahta a, ninneng tampi a-om; huchi in kulhbaang bawl thei lou i hi uh," achi hi.
english: Judah said, “The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall.”

paite: I melmate un, "Alak uh i hong tun ua, amaute i thah ua, nasep i khawlsak matan athei kei ding ua, muh leng amu kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Our adversaries said, “They shall not know, neither see, until we come into their midst, and kill them, and cause the work to cease.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, amau kiang a teng Judate ahong pai lai un, "Sawmvei i kiang uah mun tengteng a kipan hon dou ding uh ahi," ahon chi uhi.
english: It happened that when the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten times from all places, “Wherever you turn, they will attack us.”

paite: Huaiziak in kulhbaang nunglam mun a mun niam penpen, mun awngthawlte ah, ka koih a, mite a-inkuankuan uh dungzui in anamsaute uh toh, ateipite uh toh, athalpeute uh toh ka koih hi.
english: Therefore set I in the lowest parts of the space behind the wall, in the open places, I set the people after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

paite: Huchi in ka en a, ka thou a, miliante leh vaihawmte leh mipi dangte kiang ah, "Amau lau kei un: TOUPA thupi leh lauhuai theigige unla, na unaute uh, na tapate uh leh na tanute uh a ding in gal dou un, na zite uh leh na innte uh a ding in," ka chi hi.
english: I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, “Don’t be afraid of them! Remember the Lord, who is great and awesome, and fight for your brothers, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, i melmate thil sawm i na theita ua, Pathian in athusawm uh bangmah lou asuaksak a, kulhbaang bawl ding in i vek un michih anasepna mun ah i kileh nawnta uh chih aza lai uhi.
english: It happened, when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and God had brought their counsel to nothing, that we returned all of us to the wall, everyone to his work.

paite: Huchi in hichi ahong hi a, huai hun a kipan in, ka sikhate lak a kimkhat nasepna ah apang ua, alak ua kimkhat in lum, teipi leh thalpeu leh sik puanakte alen ua; vaihawmte Judah inkote nung ah a-om vek uhi.
english: It happened from that time forth, that half of my servants worked in the work, and half of them held the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.

paite: Kulhbaang bawlte leh van-gik pote'n apuak lai un, michih in akhutte uh khat nasepna a nna sem in, akhut khat lam a galvan tawi in.
english: They all built the wall and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands worked in the work, and with the other held his weapon;

paite: Inn lam mite'n, michih in anamsau apang ah khaisa a nei in, huchi in alamtou zel uhi. Pengkul mutpa ka kiang ah a-om hi.
english: and the builders, everyone wore his sword at his side, and so built. He who sounded the trumpet was by me.

paite: Huchi in miliante kiang leh vaihawmte kiang ah leh mite lak a adangdangte kiang ah, "Nasep athupi in, atam a, kulhbaang tung ah i kikhenzak ua, kigamlattak in:
english: I said to the nobles, and to the rulers and to the rest of the people, “The work is great and large, and we are separated on the wall, one far from another.

paite: Koi lai mun peuh a pengkul ging na zakna uah, i kiang uah huai lam ah kuan un; i Pathian un gal hon dousak ding ahi," ka chi hi.
english: Wherever you hear the sound of the trumpet, rally there to us. Our God will fight for us.”

paite: Nna i sem ua: alak ua akimkhat in zingsang kipat a kipan aksite ahong kilat matan teipi atawi uhi.
english: So we worked in the work: and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning until the stars appeared.

paite: Huchi mah bang in huai lai in mite kiang ah, michih asikha toh Jerusalem sung ah giak hen, zan chiang a eite a dia galvil ahih a, sun chiang a nna aseptheihna ding un, ka chi hi.
english: Likewise at the same time said I to the people, “Let everyone with his servant lodge within Jerusalem, that in the night they may be a guard to us, and may labor in the day.”

paite: Huchi in kei hiam, ka unaute hiam, ka sikhate hiam, kei hong zui galvil mite, i lak ua kuamah in i puante uh sawp ding nasan in i suah man kei uhi.
english: So neither I, nor my brothers, nor my servants, nor the men of the guard who followed me, none of us took off our clothes. Everyone took his weapon to the water.

paite: Huai lai in a-unaute uh Judate dem a nakpitak a kikouna, mite leh azite ua kipan ahong omta hi.
english: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.

paite: Kou, ka tapate leh ka tanute uh, tampi ka hi ua: "Ka nek ua ka hintheihna ding un, buh-le-bal hon pia un," chi pawl ahong om uhi.
english: For there were that said, “We, our sons and our daughters, are many. Let us get grain, that we may eat and live.”

paite: "Ka loute uh, ka grephuante uh, ka innte uh ka zuak ua; kial ziak in, buh-le-bal hon pia un," chi kuate hiam leng a-om uhi.
english: Some also there were that said, “We are mortgaging our fields, and our vineyards, and our houses. Let us get grain, because of the famine.”

paite: "Ka loute uh leh ka grephuante ua dit ding in kumpipa siah ding in sum ka leitawi uh, chimi khenkhat leng a-om uhi.
english: There were also some who said, “We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute using our fields and our vineyards as collateral.

paite: Hinapi in ka sa uh ka unaute uh sa bang ahi a, ka tate uh lah amau tate bang: Ngai un, ka tapate uh leh ka tanute uh sikhate hi ding in tanna ah ka pi ua, ka tanute uh lak a akhente tanna a pi in a-om khin man hial ua, panpih theihna ka nei kei ua; midangte'n lah ka loute uh leh ka grephuante uh anei ngal ua," chi in.
english: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brothers, our children as their children. Behold, we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants, and some of our daughters have been brought into bondage. Neither is it in our power to help it; for other men have our fields and our vineyards.”

paite: Huchi a akikouna uleh hiai thute ka zak in ka heh mahmah hi.
english: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.

paite: Huchih lai in ka kingaihtuah a, miliante leh vaihawmte ka sal a, akiang uah, "Michih in a-unau lak ah apung na phut uh," ka chi hi. Huchi in amaute demna kikhawmpi thupi ka nei hi.
english: Then I consulted with myself, and contended with the nobles and the rulers, and said to them, “You exact usury, everyone of his brother.” I held a great assembly against them.

paite: Akiang uah, "Khovel mite kiang a zuak a omsa, i unau Judate i theih bang un i tanta ua; nou na unaute uh zuak in, i lak ua khot a om ding uh ahi maw?" ka chi hi. Amau adai dide ua, thu khat leng anei kei uhi.
english: I said to them, “We, after our ability, have redeemed our brothers the Jews that were sold to the nations; and would you even sell your brothers, and should they be sold to us?” Then they held their peace, and found never a word.

paite: "Na thilhih uh ahoih kei; i melmate khovel mite'n hon simmohna ziak un, i Pathian laudan siam a na om ding uh hilou hia? ka chih behlap hi.
english: Also I said, “The thing that you do is not good. Ought you not to walk in the fear of our God, because of the reproach of the nations our enemies?

paite: Huchi mah bang in, 'ka unaute leh ka sikhate leh ke'n amau kiang ah sum leh buh-le-bal ka leitawisak uhi. K'on ngen ahi, apung omsak kei ni.'
english: I likewise, my brothers and my servants, lend them money and grain. Please let us stop this usury.

paite: 'Pe nawn un, ka hon ngen ahi, akiang uah, tuni mahmah in, aloute uh, agrephuante uh, a-olive huante uleh a-innte uh, asum uh aseh zakhatna leng, buh-le-bal, uain,' leh sathau, amau a kipan na phutkhia uhi," ka chi hi.
english: Please restore to them, even this day, their fields, their vineyards, their olive groves, and their houses, also the hundredth part of the money, and of the grain, the new wine, and the oil, that you are charging them.”

paite: Huchi in amau, "Ka pe nawn ding ua, amau a kipan bangmah ka phut kei ding uh; huchibang in ka hih ding ua, na chih mah bang in," achi uhi. Ke'n siampute ka sam a, akichiamna uh ka la a, huchi a hiai thuchiam bang a ahihna ding un.
english: Then they said, “We will restore them, and will require nothing of them; so will we do, even as you say.” Then I called the priests, and took an oath of them, that they would do according to this promise.

paite: Ke'n leng ka pheipi ka vuangsak a, "Hiai thuchiam bawl lou peuhmah, a-inn a kipan, anasepna a kipan Pathian in hichibang in vuangsak hen; hichibangtak a vuankhiak ahi ding a, ahawm ding," ka chi hi. Huan khawmpite tengteng in, "Amen, TOUPA phat in om hen," achi uhi. Huchi in mite'n hiai thuchiam dungzui in ahih uhi.
english: Also I shook out my lap, and said, “So may God shake out every man from his house, and from his labor, that doesn’t perform this promise; even thus be he shaken out, and emptied.” All the assembly said, “Amen,” and praised Yahweh. The people did according to this promise.

paite: Huai lou in Judah gam a a-ukpipa ding ua seh a ka om lai a kipan, kumpipa Artaksarses akum sawmnihna leh akum sawmthum-le-nihna chiang, huai bel, kum sawm-le-nih ahi a, kei leh ka unaute'n ukpipa tanghou ka ne kei uhi.
english: Moreover from the time that I was appointed to be their governor in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year even to the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, that is, twelve years, I and my brothers have not eaten the bread of the governor.

paite: Himahleh kei ma a ukpipa masate mite tung a mohsak theih ahi ua, amau a kipan in tanghou leh uain ala uh, dangka shekel sawmli sim louh in; ahi, asikhate uh nangawn in mite tung ah vai ahawm uhi. Himahleh ke'n Pathian ka kihtak ziak in huchibang in ka hih kei hi.
english: But the former governors who were before me were supported by the people, and took bread and wine from them, besides forty shekels of silver; yes, even their servants ruled over the people: but I didn’t do so, because of the fear of God.

paite: Ahi, huai lou leng hiai kulhbaang nasepna ah ka pang nilouh a, gam himhim leng i lei kei uh: ka sikhate tengteng huai lam ah nasepna ah kaihkhawm in a-om uhi.
english: Yes, also I continued in the work of this wall, neither bought we any land: and all my servants were gathered there to the work.

paite: Huai ban ah ka dohkan ah Judate leh vaihawmte lak a mi za-le-sawmnga, i kim i vel ua om khovel mite lak a pan i kiang ua hong paite chih louh, a-om uhi.
english: Moreover there were at my table, of the Jews and the rulers, one hundred fifty men, besides those who came to us from among the nations that were around us.

paite: Ni khat a ding a bawlkholhsa bawngtal khat leh belam hoih ngenta guk ahi ua; vasate leng kei dia bawlkholhsa in a-om ua, huan ni sawm sung a khatvei uain chi chih a kipan koih hoih: hinapi in hiai mite tung a tanna agik ziak in, ukpipa tanghou hiaite tengteng ziak in ka phut kei hi.
english: Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this I didn’t demand the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy on this people.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, hoihna ding in, hiai mite a dia ka hih tengteng kei lam hon theigige in.
english: Remember to me, my God, for good, all that I have done for this people.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang ka lam khin a, huai ah khangkham a-om nawnta kei chih, Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem Arabia mi leh i melma dangdangte kiang a akitut lai in; huai hun tan in kongpi kongkhakte tung nai kei mah leng;
english: Now it happened, when it was reported to Sanballat and Tobiah, and to Geshem the Arabian, and to the rest of our enemies, that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left therein; (though even to that time I had not set up the doors in the gates;)

paite: Sanballat leh Geshem in ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl ua, "Hong pai in, Ono Phaizang a khuate lak a khat ah i va kimu ding," chi in. Himahleh ka tung ah gilou hih angaihtuah uhi.
english: that Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying, “Come, let us meet together in the villages in the plain of Ono.” But they intended to harm me.

paite: Huchi in akiang uah sawltakte ka sawl a, "Nna thupitak sem ka hi, ka hong paisuk thei kei; bangziak a ka nna nusia a, na kiang úa ka hong suk ziak a, nasep khawl ding ahia oi?" ka chi hi.
english: I sent messengers to them, saying, “I am doing a great work, so that I can’t come down. Why should the work cease, while I leave it, and come down to you?”

paite: Huan hichibang ngen in livei ka kiang ah mi ahon sawl ua; angeingei in amaute ka dawng zel hi.
english: They sent to me four times after this sort; and I answered them the same way.

paite: Huchi in Sanballat in ka kiang ah hichibang in angaveina ding in asikha akhut a laikhak honsa toh ahon sawl a;
english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me the same way the fifth time with an open letter in his hand,

paite: huai ah, "Namte lak ah akigen a, Gasmu in achi a, nang leh Judate'n hel na tum uh; huai a ding in kulhbaang na lam hi: huchi in nang akumpipa uh hi ding in, hiai thute dungzui in,
english: in which was written, “It is reported among the nations, and Gashmu says it, that you and the Jews intend to rebel. Because of that, you are building the wall. You would be their king, according to these words.

paite: Jerusalem a nang tanchin gen ding in zawlneite leng na sep a, Judah ah kumpipa a-om chi in. Huchi in tu in hiai thute dungzui in kumpipa kiang a tut ding ahi; huaiziak in hong kuan inla, kihouna i nei ding," chi in.
english: You have also appointed prophets to preach of you at Jerusalem, saying, ‘There is a king in Judah!’ Now it will be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel together.”

paite: Akiang ah mi ka sawl a, "Na gen bang a huchibang thilhih a-om kei a, himahleh na lungtang a kipan na phuahtawm ahi," chi in.
english: Then I sent to him, saying, “There are no such things done as you say, but you imagine them out of your own heart.”

paite: Amau lah, hih louh ahihna ding in, "Nasepna a kipan akhutte uh hatsak louh in a-om ding," chi a hon lauhsak a-ut ngal ua. Himahleh tu in, Aw Pathian, nang ka khutte hatsak in.
english: For they all would have made us afraid, saying, “Their hands will be weakened from the work, that it not be done. But now, strengthen my hands.”

paite: Khum a om, Mehetabel tapa Delaiah tapa Shemaiah inn ah ka hoh a, ama'n, "Tempul sung ah, Pathian inn ah i kikhawm dia, huchi in tempul kongkhakte i khak ding, nang that dia hong ding uh lah ahi ngal ua; ahi, zan in nang that ding a hong ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: I went to the house of Shemaiah the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabel, who was shut in at his home; and he said, “Let us meet together in God’s house, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple; for they will come to kill you; yes, in the night will they come to kill you.”

paite: Ke'n bel, "Kei bang mi, taise ding hon sa maw? Huan kua ahia, huchi a kei bang a om a, ahinna humbitna ding a tempul sung a hoh nuam ding? Ka lut kei ding," ka chi hi.
english: I said, “Should such a man as I flee? Who is there that, being such as I, would go into the temple to save his life? I will not go in.”

paite: Ka ngaihtuah a, huchi in ngai in, Pathian in amah asawl kei a; himahleh ka siatna ding in hiai genkholhna agenkheta hi: Tobiah leh Sanballat in amah aguai uhi.
english: I discerned, and behold, God had not sent him; but he pronounced this prophecy against me. Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.

paite: Hiai a ding a goih ahi, ka launa ding leh huchibang a hih a, khial a, thutut gilou ding a thubuai aneihtheihna ding ua, kei ahon simmoh theihna ding un.
english: He hired so that I would be afraid, do so, and sin, and that they might have material for an evil report, that they might reproach me.

paite: Aw ka Pathian, Tobiah leh Sanballat anasepte uh bang zel leh zawlneinu Noadiah leh zawlnei dangte, lausak hon tumte, theigige in.
english: “Remember, my God, Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works, and also the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets, that would have put me in fear.”

paite: Huchi in Elul kha ani sawmnih-le-nga ni, ani sawmnga-le-nih sung in, kulhbaang zoh in a-omta hi.
english: So the wall was finished in the twenty-fifth day of Elul, in fifty-two days.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, i melmate tengteng in huai azak un, i kim i vel ua om namte teng in alauta ua, amitmuh ngei uah nakpitak in alunglelta uhi; hiai nasep i Pathian hih ahi chih athei ngal ua.
english: It happened, when all our enemies heard of it, that all the nations that were about us were afraid, and were much cast down in their own eyes; for they perceived that this work was worked of our God.

paite: Huai lou in huai lai in Judah miliante'n laikhak tampi Tobiah kiang ah akhak ua, amau kiang ah Tobiah laikhakte ahong tung hi.
english: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah, and Tobiah’s letters came to them.

paite: Amah Arah tapa Shekaniah tanu pasal ahih ziak in, Judah ah mi tampi amah lam a kichiam lah a-om ngal ua; atapa Jehohanan in Berekiah tapa Meshullam tanu zi in anei hi.
english: For there were many in Judah sworn to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah as wife.

paite: Huai lou leng ka ma ah athil hoih hihte agen ua, amah kiang ah ka thute atun zel uhi. Huchi in Tobiah in kei hon hihlau ding in laikhakte akhak hi.
english: Also they spoke of his good deeds before me, and reported my words to him. Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, kulhbaang lam khit ahih a, kongkhakte ka tun khit a, kongkhak ngak mite leh lasa mite leh Levi mite seh ahih khit nung un,
english: Now it happened, when the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and the porters and the singers and the Levites were appointed,

paite: ka unau Hanani leh Hananiah kulh ukpa kiang ah Jerusalem kepna ka pia a: amah miginom ahi a, tampi sang a Pathian laudan siam ahih ziak in.
english: that I put my brother Hanani, and Hananiah the governor of the castle, in charge of Jerusalem; for he was a faithful man, and feared God above many.

paite: Akiang ah, "Ni asat mateng Jerusalem kongpite hon hi kei hen; galvilmi adin lai un, kongkhakte khak uhenla, amaute kalhkhum un; Jerusalem a tengte vengmi sep inla, michih ama dinmun ah, michih ama inn zawn chiat ah," chi in.
english: I said to them, “Don’t let the gates of Jerusalem be opened until the sun is hot; and while they stand guard, let them shut the doors, and you bar them: and appoint watches of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, everyone in his watch, with everyone near his house.”

paite: Khopi aza in alian a: himahleh huai ah mite atawm ua, innte lah lam ahi kei uhi.
english: Now the city was wide and large; but the people were few therein, and the houses were not built.

paite: Huchi in ka Pathian in ka lungtang miliante, vaihawm mite, mipite, khangsutna a sim ahihtheihna ding ua kaikhawm ding in akoih hi. Huan amasapen a hong lang amaute khangsutna laibu ka muta a, huai ah gelh a om ka mu hi.
english: My God put into my heart to gather together the nobles, and the rulers, and the people, that they might be reckoned by genealogy. I found the book of the genealogy of those who came up at the first, and I found written therein:

paite: Hiaite bial naupangte ahi ua, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in apimangte, huai pimang a omte lak a saltanna kipan a paitoute, Jerusalem leh Judah akik nawn, michih amah khopi a kik;
english: These are the children of the province, who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned to Jerusalem and to Judah, everyone to his city;

paite: Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah toh hong paite.
english: who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

paite: Israel mite lak a pasal zah: Parosh suante, sangnih zakhat sawmsagih-le-nih.
english: The children of Parosh, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.

paite: Shephatiah suante, zathum sawmsagih-le-nih.
english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy-two.

paite: Arah suante, zaguk sawmnga-le-nih.
english: The children of Arah, six hundred fifty-two.

paite: Pahath-moab suante, Jeshua leh Joab tate, sangnih zagiat sawmkhat-le-giat.
english: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred eighteen.

paite: Elam suan sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

paite: Zattu suan zagiat sawmli-le-nga.
english: The children of Zattu, eight hundred forty-five.

paite: Zakkai suan zasagih-le-sawmguk.
english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred sixty.

paite: Binnui suan zaguk sawmli-le-giat.
english: The children of Binnui, six hundred forty-eight.

paite: Bebai suan zaguk sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Azgad suan sangnih zathum sawmnih-le-nih.
english: The children of Azgad, two thousand three hundred twenty-two.

paite: Adonikam suan zaguk sawmguk-le-sagih.
english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty-seven.

paite: Bigvai suan sangnih sawmguk-le-sagih.
english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand sixty-seven.

paite: Adin suan zaguk sawmnga-le-nga.
english: The children of Adin, six hundred fifty-five.

paite: Ater, Hezekiah suan sawmkua-le-giat.
english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.

paite: Hashum suan zathum sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The children of Hashum, three hundred Twenty-eight.

paite: Bezai suan zathum sawmnih-le-li.
english: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty-four.

paite: Hariph suan zakhat sawmkhat-le-nih.
english: The children of Hariph, one hundred twelve.

paite: Gibeon suan sawmkua-le-nga.
Bethlehem leh Netophah suan zakhat sawmgiat-le-giat.
english: The men of Bethlehem and Netophah, one hundred eighty-eight.

paite: Anathoth mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-giat.
english: The men of Anathoth, one hundred twenty-eight.

paite: Beth-azmaveth, mite sawmli-le-nih.
english: The men of Beth Azmaveth, forty-two.

paite: Kiriath-jearim, Kephirah, Beeroth suante, zasagih sawmli-le-thum.
english: The men of Kiriath Jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred forty-three.

paite: Ramah leh Geba mite, zaguk sawmnih-le-khat.
english: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred twenty-one.

paite: Mikmas suante, zakhat sawmnih-le-nih.
english: The men of Michmas, one hundred and twenty-two.

paite: Bethel leh Ai mite, zakhat sawmnih-le-thum.
english: The men of Bethel and Ai, a hundred twenty-three.

paite: Nebo dang mite, sawmnga-le-nih.
english: The men of the other Nebo, fifty-two.

paite: Elam dang suan sangkhat zanih sawmnga-le-li.
english: The children of the other Elam, one thousand two hundred fifty-four.

paite: Harim suan zathum-le-sawmnih.
english: The children of Harim, three hundred twenty.

paite: Jeriko suan zathum sawmli-le-nga.
english: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty-five.

paite: Lod, Hadid leh Ono suante, zasagih sawmnih-le-khat.
english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty-one.

paite: Senaah suan sangthum zakua-le-sawmthum.
english: The children of Senaah, three thousand nine hundred thirty.

paite: Siampute: Jedaiah suante, Jeshua inkuan a kipan, zakua sawmsagih-le-thum.
english: The priests: The children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy-three.

paite: Imer suante, sangkhat sawmnga-le-nih.
english: The children of Immer, one thousand fifty-two.

paite: Pashur suante, sangkhat zanih sawmli-le-sagih.
english: The children of Pashhur, one thousand two hundred forty-seven.

paite: Harim suante, sangkhat sawm-le-sagih.
english: The children of Harim, one thousand seventeen.

paite: Levi mite: Jeshua, Kadmiel suante, Hodevah suante, sawmsagih-le-li.
english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah, seventy-four.

paite: Lasa mite: Asaph suante, zakhat sawmli-le-giat.
english: The singers: the children of Asaph, one hundred forty-eight.

paite: Kongkhak ngakte: Shallum, Ater, Talmon, Akkub, Hatita leh Shobai suante, zakhat sawmthum-le-giat.
english: The porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, one hundred thirty-eight.

paite: Tempul nasem, Nethinim mite: Ziha, Hasupha, Tabbaoth;
english: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

paite: Keros, Sia, Padon;
english: the children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,

paite: Lebana, Hagabah, Shalmai;
english: the children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,

paite: Hanan, Giddel, Gahar;
english: the children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,

paite: Reaiah, Rezin, Nekoda;
english: the children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,

paite: Gazzam, Uzza, Paseah;
english: the children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah.

paite: Besai, Meunim, Nephishesim;
english: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,

paite: Bakbuk, Hakupha, Harhur;
english: the children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

paite: Bazlith, Mehida, Harsha;
english: the children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

paite: Barkos, Sisera, Tamah;
english: the children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,

paite: Neziah leh Hatipha suante.
english: the children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

paite: Solomon sikhate tate: Sotai, Sophereth, Perida;
english: The children of Solomon’s servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,

paite: Jaala, Darkon, Giddel;
english: the children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

paite: Shephatiah, Hattil, Zebaim mi Pokereth leh Ammon suante.
english: the children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth Hazzebaim, the children of Amon.

paite: Nethinim mite tengteng leh Solomon sikhate' suante, zathum sawmkua-le-nih.
english: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon’s servants, were three hundred ninety-two.

paite: uan hiaite Telmelah, Tel-harsha, Kerub, Addon leh Immer a kipan paitoute ahi uh, himahleh apipute uh inkote, Israel a kipan ahi hiam chih bel a-ensak thei kei uhi:
english: These were those who went up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but they could not show their fathers’ houses, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel:

paite: Delaiah, Tobiah leh Nekoda suante, zaguk sawmli-le-nih.
english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred forty-two.

paite: Siampute a kipan: Habaiah, Koz leh Barzillai suan Gilead mi Barzillai tanute lak a zi neipa min atamsak uhi.
english: Of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name.

paite: Hiaite'n khangthu suina a sim a omte lak ah amin gelhna uh azong ua, himahleh muh in a-om kei; huaiziak in nin a sim ahi ua siamputna a kipan koihkhiak ahi uhi.
english: These searched for their geneological records, but couldn’t find them. Therefore were they deemed polluted and put from the priesthood.

paite: Ukpipa in akiang uah, siampu khat Urim leh Thummim toh ahong suah mateng thil siangthoupente lak a nek louh ding chih agen hi.
english: The governor said to them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, until there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.

paite: Omkhawm tengteng avek un singli sangnih zathum-le-sawmguk,
english: The whole assembly together was forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,

paite: Apasal sikhate uh leh anungak sikhate uh, sangsagih zathum sawmthum-le-sagihte sim louh in: pasal lasa leh numei lasa zanih sawmli-le-nga anei uhi.
english: besides their male servants and their female servants, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven: and they had two hundred forty-five singing men and singing women.

paite: Asakolte uh zasagih sawmthum-le-guk; asakolneute uh, zanih sawmli-le-nga;
english: Their horses were seven hundred thirty-six; their mules, two hundred forty-five;

paite: Asangawngsaute, zali sawmthum-le-nga; asabiltungte uh sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnih.
english: their camels, four hundred thirty-five; their donkeys, six thousand seven hundred twenty.

paite: Pipute inkote lak a lupente lak a kipan khenkhatte nasem ding in akipia uhi. Ukpipa'n sumbawm ah dangka- eng darik sangkhat, maiphiat kuang sawmnga, siampute puan zanga-le- sawmthum apia hi.
english: Some from among the heads of fathers’ households gave to the work. The governor gave to the treasury one thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, and five hundred thirty priests’ garments.

paite: Huan pipute inkote lak a lupente lak a khenkhatte'n dangka-eng darik singnih leh, dangka paun sangnih-le-zanih apia uhi.
english: Some of the heads of fathers’ households gave into the treasury of the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand two hundred minas of silver.

paite: Mipite lak a adangdangte piak dangka-eng darik singnih leh dangka paun sangnih leh, siampute puan sawmguk-le- sagih ahi.
english: That which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand minas of silver, and sixty-seven priests’ garments.

paite: Huchi in siampute, Levi mite, kongkhak ngakte leh lasa mite, mite lak a akhente leh Nethinim mite leh Israel tengteng a khopite uah atengta uhi. Akha sagihna ahong tun in, Israel suante akhopite uah a-om uhi.
english: So the priests, and the Levites, and the porters, and the singers, and some of the people, and the Nethinim, and all Israel, lived in their cities. When the seventh month had come, the children of Israel were in their cities.

paite: Huchi in mite tengteng Tui Kongpi mai a om mun lian ah mi khat bang in akikhawmkhawmta ua; TOUPA'N Israel kiang a apiak, Mosi Dan laibu hon tawi ding in laigelhmi Ezra kiang ah thu ahilh uhi.
english: All the people gathered themselves together as one man into the broad place that was before the water gate; and they spoke to Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses, which Yahweh had commanded to Israel.

paite: Siampu Ezra in omkhawmte, pasal leh numei, theihsiamna toh za thei ding tengteng ma ah akha sagihna ani khat ni in dan thu ahon lata hi.
english: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.

paite: Pasal leh numeite leh theisiam thei dingte ma ah, zingkhang a kipan sun lai tanpha in Tui Kongpi mai a om mun lian ma ah asimta hi; huchi in mite tengteng in Dan Laibu abildoh chiat uhi.
english: He read therein before the broad place that was before the water gate from early morning until midday, in the presence of the men and the women, and of those who could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive to the book of the law.

paite: Huai ding mah a abawl uh, sing dohkang tung ah laigelhmi Ezra adingh a; asik ah Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah leh Maaseiah, ataklam pang ah adingh ua; aveilam pang ah, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malkijah, Hashum, Hashbaddana, Zekariah leh Meshullam.
english: Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, and Shema, and Anaiah, and Uriah, and Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, and Mishael, and Malchijah, and Hashum, and Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

paite: Huchi in Ezra in mite mitmuh in laibu ahong a; mite tunglam ah a-om ngal a; huan ahongta a, mite tengteng adingh uhi:
english: Ezra opened the book in the sight of all the people; (for he was above all the people;) and when he opened it, all the people stood up:

paite: Ezra in TOUPA, Pathian thupi avualzawl hi. Huchi in mipi tengteng in adawng ua, "Amen, Amen," chi a akhutte uh lik kawm in alute uh akunsak ua amai ua lei si in TOUPA abia uhi.
english: and Ezra blessed Yahweh, the great God. All the people answered, “Amen, Amen,” with the lifting up of their hands. They bowed their heads, and worshiped Yahweh with their faces to the ground.

paite: Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah leh Levi mite'n mipite dan theisiam ding in abawl ua: huchi in mite amau mun ah adingh uhi.
english: Also Jeshua, and Bani, and Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites, caused the people to understand the law: and the people stayed in their place.

paite: Huchi in teltak in laibu ah, Pathian dan sung ah asim ua; a-omdan ataklang ua, huchi a lai simkhiak atheihsiamna ding un.
english: They read in the book, in the law of God, distinctly; and they gave the sense, so that they understood the reading.

paite: Huan Nehemiah, amah Tirshatha ahi a, huan siampu leh laigelhmi Ezra, leh Levite mite sinsakte'n, mite tengteng kiang ah, "Tuni TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia ni siangthou ahi; dah kei unla kap kei un," achi ua. Dan thute azak un lah mite tengteng akap ngal ua.
english: Nehemiah, who was the governor, and Ezra the priest the scribe, and the Levites who taught the people, said to all the people, “This day is holy to Yahweh your God. Don’t mourn, nor weep.” For all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.

paite: Akiang uah, "Pai unla, thaute ne unla, akhumkhum dawn un, amah a dia bangmah bawlkhol a om lou kiang ah tantuante khak un: tuni lah i TOUPA uh a dia ni siangthou ahi ngal a. Dah kei unla; TOUPA a kipahna na hatna uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared; for this day is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved; for the joy of Yahweh is your strength.”

paite: Huchi in Levite'n mite tengteng adaisak ua, "Tuni siangthou ahih ziak in, dai sipsip unla; dah kei un," chi in.
english: So the Levites stilled all the people, saying, “Hold your peace, for the day is holy; neither be grieved.”

paite: Huan mite tengteng ne ding leh dawn ding leh vualnopna thupi bawl ding in apaita ua, akiang ua phuankhiak a om thute atheisiamta uhi.
english: All the people went their way to eat, and to drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth, because they had understood the words that were declared to them.

paite: Ani nih ni in mite tengteng pipute inko lupente, siampute leh Levi mite, laigelhmi Ezra kiang ah, Dan thute ngaikhe ding in akikhawmkhawm uhi.
english: On the second day were gathered together the heads of fathers’ households of all the people, the priests, and the Levites, to Ezra the scribe, even to give attention to the words of the law.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Israel suante akha sagihna ankuangluina a aidakbuk a atendan ding ua thu apiakdan dan a kigelh amu uhi:
english: They found written in the law, how that Yahweh had commanded by Moses, that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month;

paite: "Tang ah kuankhia unla, olive hiang, gam olive leh muising hiang, tum hiang, sing vunsah hiang, akigelh bang a, aidakbuk bawlna ding in va la un, akhopi tengteng uh leh Jerusalem a apuankhiak theihna ding un," achi hi.
english: and that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities, and in Jerusalem, saying, “Go out to the mountain, and get olive branches, and branches of wild olive, and myrtle branches, and palm branches, and branches of thick trees, to make booths, as it is written.”

paite: Huchi in mite akuankhia ua, ava la ua, michih in a-inn tung ah, ahuangsungte uah, Pathian huangsungte ah, Tui Kongpi a mun lian ah leh Ephraim Kongpi a mun lian ah aidakbukte akibawlta uhi.
english: So the people went out, and brought them, and made themselves booths, everyone on the roof of his house, and in their courts, and in the courts of God’s house, and in the broad place of the water gate, and in the broad place of the gate of Ephraim.

paite: Huan saltanna a kipan hong pai nawn omkhawmte tengteng in aidakbukte abawl ua, aidakbuk ah ateng uhi. Nun tapa Joshua dam lai a kipan huai ni tanpha in Israel suante'n lah huchibang in ahih nai kei uhi. Huchi in nakpi a kipahna mahmah a-omta hi.
english: All the assembly of those who had come again out of the captivity made booths, and lived in the booths; for since the days of Jeshua the son of Nun to that day the children of Israel had not done so. There was very great gladness.

paite: Huai lou in niteng in ani masapen a kipan ani tawp ni tan in Pathian Dan laibu sung ah asim hi. Huan ankuangluina ni sagih anei ua; ani giat ni in paidan dungzui in kikhopna thupi a-omta hi.
english: Also day by day, from the first day to the last day, he read in the book of the law of God. They kept the feast seven days; and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly, according to the ordinance.

paite: Hiai kha ani sawmnih-le-li ni in Israel suante an ngawl kawm leh sai-ip puansilh kawm leh atung ua lei kibuak kawm in akikhawm ua.
english: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackcloth, and earth on them.

paite: Huchi in Israel chite mikhual tengteng a kipan in akikoihtuam ua, adingh ua akhelhnate uleh, apipute uh thulimlouhnate thupha atawi uhi.
english: The seed of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.

paite: Amun uah adingh ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh Dan laibu sung ah ni khat a aseh lina teng asim ua; aseh lina teng thupha atawi ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh abeta uhi.
english: They stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of Yahweh their God a fourth part of the day; and a fourth part they confessed, and worshiped Yahweh their God.

paite: Huchih lai in Levi mite, Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani leh Kenanite dohkan tung ah adingh ua, TOUPA a Pathian kiang uah aw ngaihtak in akikou uhi.
english: Then Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani of the Levites stood up on the stairs, and cried with a loud voice to Yahweh their God.

paite: Huai lai in Levi mite, Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah leh Pethahiahte'n, "Dingh unla tangtawn a kipan tangtawn pha in TOUPA na Pathian uh vualzawl un: huchi in vualzawlna leh phatna tengteng tunglam a tawisang a om, na min thupi vualzawl in om hen.”
english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up and bless Yahweh your God from everlasting to everlasting! Bessed be your glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise!

paite: "Nang, nang kia mahmah TOUPA na hi; van, vante' van a, sepaihte tengteng, lei leh asung a thil om tengteng, tuipite leh asung ua om tengteng na bawl a, avek un na hawi a; van sepaihte'n nang ahon bia uhi.
english: You are Yahweh, even you alone. You have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their army, the earth and all things that are on it, the seas and all that is in them, and you preserve them all. The army of heaven worships you.

paite: Abram tel a, Kaldaite Ur a kipan a amah pikhia a, akiang a Abraham min pepa, TOUPA Pathian na hi;
english: You are Yahweh, the God who chose Abram, and brought him out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gave him the name of Abraham,

paite: Na ma a lungtang ginom na mu a, Kanaan mite, Hit mite, Amor mite, Jebus mite leh Girgas mite gam pe ding a amah toh thukhun bawlpa, achite kiang a pe ding in, na thute bawl piching a; nang lah na diktat ngal a.
english: and found his heart faithful before you, and made a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Perizzite, and the Jebusite, and the Girgashite, to give it to his seed, and have performed your words; for you are righteous.

paite: Aigupta a ka pipute uh gimthuakna na mu a, Tuipi San a akah uh na za a;
english: “You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds ,

paite: Pharaoh tung leh, asikhate tengteng tung leh, agam a mite tengteng tung ah chiamtehna leh thillamdangte na ensak a; amaute siatna ding in kisatheitak in agamtang uh chih lah na thei ngal hi; tuni a bang in, min na kimuh hi.
english: and showed signs and wonders against Pharaoh, and against all his servants, and against all the people of his land; for you knew that they dealt proudly against them, and made a name for yourself, as it is this day.

paite: Ama uah tuipi na khen a, huchi in gam hul tung ah tuipi lak ah apaisuak ua; amau delhte nang tui thuk sung ah, tui hattak sung a suang bang in na pailut hi.
english: You divided the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and you cast their pursuers into the depths, as a stone into the mighty waters.

paite: Huai lou in sun in meipi kitung in amaute na pi a; zan in meikuang dingh in, apaina ding lampi ua vakna amaute kiang a pe ding in.
english: Moreover, in a pillar of cloud you led them by day; and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light in the way in which they should go.

paite: Sinai Tang ah leng na hohsuk a, van a kipan in amau na houpih a, vaihawmna dikte leh dan dikte, dan thuseh leh thupiak hoihte na pia hi.
english: “You came down also on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good statutes and commandments,

paite: Amau kiang ah na Sabbath siangthou na theisak a, na sikha Mosi khut in, thupiakte leh dan thusehte leh dan amaute na thupiak in na pia hi.
english: and made known to them your holy Sabbath, and commanded them commandments, and statutes, and a law, by Moses your servant,

paite: Agilkial un van a kipan tanghou na pia a, adangtak un suangpi a kipan amaute a ding in tui na pawtkhesak a, amaute pe ding a na khut na lik a, gam luah ding a kuan ding in amaute thu na pia hi.
english: and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and commanded them that they should go in to possess the land which you had sworn to give them.

paite: Himahleh amaute leh apipute un kisatheitak in ahih ua, apaupeng ua, na thupiakte angaikhe kei uhi,
english: “But they and our fathers dealt proudly and hardened their neck, didn’t listen to your commandments,

paite: Thu amang nuam kei ua, alak ua na hih na thillamdangte leng alimsak sam kei uh; himahleh aki-uangsak ua, ahelna uah atanna ua kik nawn ding in heutu khat asep uhi; himahleh nang ngaidam dia mansa, lainatna a dim leh hehpihsiam, heh mengmeng lou, zahngaihna hau, amaute lehngatsan lou Pathian na hi.
english: and refused to obey, neither were they mindful of your wonders that you did among them, but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage. But you are a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and didn’t forsake them.

paite: Ahi, bawngnou sun abawl lai un, Aigupta a kipan a nang hon pikhepa hiai na Pathian ahi, achi ua, nakpitak a thangpaihnate abawl lai un.
english: Yes, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, ‘This is your God who brought you up out of Egypt,’ and had committed awful blasphemies;

paite: Huchi napi in na zahngaihna tampite ziak in amaute gamdai ah na lehngatsan kei hi: sun in atung ua kipan meipi dingh apaimang kei a, vakna amau pe ding, zan a meikuang dingh leng, apaina lampi uah amaute pi ding in.
english: yet you in your manifold mercies didn’t forsake them in the wilderness: the pillar of cloud didn’t depart from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way in which they should go.

paite: Amaute chil ding in na kha hoih na pia a, akam uah na Manna na phal lou kei a, amaute adangtak un tui na pia hi.
english: You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water for their thirst.

paite: Ahi, gamdai ah kum sawmli amaute na vak a, bangmah atasam kei ua; apuansilhte uh atul kei a, akhepekte uh abawk kei hi.
english: “Yes, forty years you sustained them in the wilderness. They lacked nothing. Their clothes didn’t grow old, and their feet didn’t swell.

paite: Huai ban ah lalgamte leh mite amau na pia a, atantuante uh dungzui a na piakkhiakte: Sihon gam, Heshbon kumpipa gam leh Bashan kumpipa Og gam alata uhi.
english: Moreover you gave them kingdoms and peoples, which you allotted according to their portions. So they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

paite: Van aksite bang in atate uh na pungsak a, nei ding in alut ding uh chi a, api-le-pute kiang a na gen bang in, gamsung ah na pilut hi.
english: You also multiplied their children as the stars of the sky, and brought them into the land concerning which you said to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.

paite: Huchi in tate alut ua gam aneita ua, ama uah gam a tengte na satpuka, Kanaante, akumpite leh, gam a mite, amau khut ah na pia a, huchi a a-utdan ua atung ua ahihtheihna ding un.
english: “So the children went in and possessed the land, and you subdued before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them into their hands, with their kings, and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they pleased.

paite: Khopi hatte, gam hoihte ala ua, thil hoih tengteng a dim innte anei ua, tuibel sekte, grephuante, olive huante, atam a tam theikungte: huchi in ane ua, avah ua, ahong thau ua, na hoihna thupi ziak in akipak mahmah uhi.
english: They took fortified cities, and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards, and olive groves, and fruit trees in abundance. So they ate, were filled, became fat, and delighted themselves in your great goodness.

paite: Hinapi'n lah thu amang kei ua, na tung ah ahel ua, na dan anunglam uah apai ua, na kiang lam amaute ngasak nawn ding a, amaute dem a thugen na zawlneite athat ua, thangpaihna thupi mahmah abawl uhi.
english: “Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against you, and cast your law behind their back, and killed your prophets that testified against them to turn them again to you, and they committed awful blasphemies.

paite: Huaiziak in amelmate uh khut ah amau na pia a, amau ahihgenthei uh: abuai ni ua na kiang a ahong kah lai un, van a kipan in na za a; na zahngaihna tampi dungzui in amelmate uh khut a kipan a amaute hondam ding in akiang uah hondam mite na pia hi.
english: Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble, when they cried to you, you heard from heaven; and according to your manifold mercies you gave them saviors who saved them out of the hand of their adversaries.

paite: Himahleh atawldam nung un na ma ah gilou ahih nawn zel ua; huaiziak in amelmate uh khut ah amau na nusia a, huchi in amau atung uah thu anei ua: hinapi in ahong kihei ua, na kiang a akah un, van a kipan na za a; na zahngaihnate dungzui in amaute tamveipi na hunkhia hi.
english: But after they had rest, they did evil again before you; therefore left you them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned, and cried to you, you heard from heaven; and many times you delivered them according to your mercies,

paite: Na dan a na pilut theih nawnna ding in, amau na dem a: himahleh kisatheitak in ahih ua, na thupiakte alimsak kei ua, na vaihawmte tung ah akhial zosop uhi, huai mi'n ahihleh, huai ah ahing ding, liang asawisak ua, aki-uangsak ua, aza nuam kei uhi.
english: and testified against them, that you might bring them again to your law. Yet they dealt proudly, and didn’t listen to your commandments, but sinned against your ordinances, (which if a man does, he shall live in them), turned their backs, stiffened their neck, and would not hear.

paite: Himahleh kum tampi amau na thuakzou a, na zawlneite in na kha zang in amaute na dem a, himahleh angaikhe nuam kei ua; huaiziak in gam mite khut ah amaute na peta hi.
english: Yet many years you put up with them, and testified against them by your Spirit through your prophets. Yet would they not give ear. Therefore you gave them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

paite: Huchi napi in na zahngaihna tampite ziak in amaute na hihbei keuhkeuh kei a, na lehngatsan kei; nang lah hehpih thei leh chingthei Pathian na hi ngal a.
english: “Nevertheless in your manifold mercies you did not make a full end of them, nor forsake them; for you are a gracious and merciful God.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka Pathian uh, thupi Pathian hat leh kihtakhuai, thukhun leh zahngaihna vompa, na ma ah, ka tung uh, ka kumpipate uh tung, ka vaihawmte uh tung, ka siampute uh tung, ka zawlneite uh tung, ka pipute uh tung, na mite, Assuria kumpipate dam lai a kipan a tuni tan, na mite tung a, nauveina bangmah tham lou bang in kilang kei hen.
english: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awesome God, who keeps covenant and loving kindness, don’t let all the travail seem little before you, that has come on us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all your people, since the time of the kings of Assyria to this day.

paite: Akoi abang hitaleh ka tung ua hong tung tengteng ah nang na diktat a; nang lah diktak in na hih ngal a, kou bel giloutak in ka hih uhi.
english: However you are just in all that has come on us; for you have dealt truly, but we have done wickedly;

paite: Kumpipate leh ka vaihawmte uh hiam, siampute uh hiam, ka pipute uh hiam in na dan azui kei ua, na thupiakte leh na thu theihpihnate, amaute dem a na theihpihnate lah angaikhe nuam sam kei uhi.
english: neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept your law, nor listened to your commandments and your testimonies with which you testified against them.

paite: Agam uah nang nna asem kei ua, na hoih mahmahna ziak a amau na piak, ama ua na piak gam lian leh hoih, anasep gilou ua kipan akilehhei sam kei uhi.
english: For they have not served you in their kingdom, and in your great goodness that you gave them, and in the large and rich land which you gave before them, neither did they turn from their wicked works.

paite: Ngai in, tuni in sikhate ka hi ua, agah nekna ding leh huai ahoihte neihna dia ka pipute uh kiang a na piak gam ahihleh, ngai in, asung ah sikhate ka hi uhi.
english: “Behold, we are servants this day, and as for the land that you gave to our fathers to eat its fruit and its good, behold, we are servants in it.

paite: Ka khelhna ziak ua ka tung ua na koih kumpipate a ding in anak pun mahmah a, athuthu un, ka pumpite uleh, ka gantate uh tung athilhihtheihna anei ua, kou ka nak gim mahmah uhi."
english: It yields much increase to the kings whom you have set over us because of our sins: also they have power over our bodies, and over our livestock, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.

paite: Huan hiaite tengteng huchibang hita mahleh thukhun muanhuai ka bawl ua, ka gelh ua; ka vaihawmte uh, ka Levi mite uleh ka siampute un, huai ah suai akai uhi.
english: Yet for all this, we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, our Levites, and our priests, seal it.”

paite: Aigupta gam a kipan ahong pawt uh akum nihna, akha nihna, ani khat ni in Sinai gamdai ah kihoupihna biakbuk ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

paite: "Israel suan omkhawm tengteng, a-inkuankuan un amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal tengteng sim vek in," achi hi.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one;

paite: "Kum sawmnih a pan atunglam Israel lak a galdou thei chiang peuhmah nang leh Aaron in apawlpawl in na sim vek ding uh ahi.
english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall number them by their divisions.

paite: Na kiang ah nam chih lak a khat, inkuan a vaihawm makai a-om ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe; everyone head of his fathers’ house.

paite: Hiaite na kiang a om dingte min ahi: Reuben nam a kipan Shedeur tapa Elizur,
english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

paite: Simeon nam a kipan Zurishaddai tapa Shelumiel.
english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

paite: Judah nam a kipan Amminadab tapa Nahson.
english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Issakar nam a kipan Zuar tapa Nethaneel.
english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

paite: Zebulun nam a kipan Helon tapa Eliab.
english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Joseph tapate a kipan: Ephraim nam a kipan Ammihud tapa Elishama; Manasseh nam a kipan Pedazur tapa Gamaliel.
english: Of the children of Joseph: Of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud. Of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Benjamin nam a kipan Gideoni tapa Abidan.
english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Dan nam a kipan Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer.
english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Asher nam a kipan Okran tapa Pagiel.
english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Gad nam a kipan Deuel tapa Eliasaph.
english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

paite: Naphtali nam a kipan Enan tapa Ahira.
english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

paite: Hiaite omkhawm mipite' tel, api-le-pute uh nam a vaihawm makai Israel inkuan a lupente ahi uh, chi in.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron in huai mi amin ua lohte api uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

paite: Mipi omkhawm tengteng akha nihna, ani khat ni in asamkhawm vek ua; a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam teng apipute uh min ataklang uhi.
english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Sinai gamdai ah asimta uhi.
english: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Israel tapa upapen Reuben tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Reuben nam, asimte uh singli sangguk-le-zanga ahi.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

paite: Simeon tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were numbered of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Simeon nam, asimte uh singnga sangkua-le-zathum ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

paite: Gad tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in pasal kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Gad nam a asimte uh singli sangnga zaguk-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

paite: Judah tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Judah nam a asimte uh singsagih sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Judah, were sixty-four thousand six hundred.

paite: Issakar tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Issakar nam a asimte uh singnga sangli-le-zali ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: Zebulun tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh kizomdan dungzui zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Zebulun nam a asimte uh singnga sangsagih-le-zali ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

paite: Joseph tate lak a Ephraim tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Joseph, of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Ephraim nam a asimte uh singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

paite: Manasseh tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Manasseh nam a asimte uh singthum sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: Benjamin tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war;

paite: Benjamin nam a asimte uh, singthum sangnga-le-zali ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Dan tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

paite: Dan nam a asimte uh, singguk sangnih- le-zasagih ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Asher tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

paite: Asher nam a asimte uh, singli sangkhat-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

paite: Naphtali tate suante achichi in a-inkuankuan in amin uh tamdan bang zel in kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng asim uhi.
english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go forth to war;

paite: Naphtali nam a asimte uh, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi uh.
english: those who were numbered of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

paite: Hiaite Mosi leh Aaron in Israel vaihawm makai sawm-le-nih, inkuan a lupente toh asimte uh ahi.
english: These are those who were numbered, whom Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: they were each one for his fathers’ house.

paite: Huchi in Israel suan a-inkuankuan ua kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, galdou thei teng, Israel gam ate sim ahi uhi.
english: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel;

paite: Asim teng uh nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: even all those who were numbered were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

paite: Levite pipute asimtel kei uh.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: For Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Levi chi na simtel ding ahi kei, Israel mite lak ah na simtel ding ahi sam kei.
