english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not number, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

paite: "Levite theihpihna biakbuk kem mite leh van tengteng kem mite dia seh zawk ding ahi. Biakbuk a van tengteng azawng ding ua, akem ding ua, biakbuk akimvel in a-omkhum ding uhi.
english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle, and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

paite: Biakbuk malam a apai chiang in Levite'n aphel ding ua; biakbuk kaih ding chiang in Levite mah in akai nawn ding uh. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah hihlup ding ahi.
english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

paite: "Israel suante'n amau mun chiat ah, apawlpawl in atamdan uh dungzui zel in apuaninte uh akai ding uh.
english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

paite: Himahleh Levite'n Israel suan omkhawmte tung a hehna a-omlouhna ding in theihpihna biakbuk kimvel ah akai ding uhi. Levite'n theihpihna biakbuk akep ding uh," achi hi.
english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante'n TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a thu apiak tengteng bang in ahihta uhi.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they did.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Dangka pengkul nih bawl inla; sekthoh in bawl in. Mipi omkhawmte sapkhawmna ding leh pawtsakna dia na zat ding ahi.
english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.

paite: Huai akimut chiang in mipi omkhawmte tengteng na kiang ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak bul a ahong kikhop vek ding uh ahi.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Khat lel amut uleh Israel mipite heutu intekpente kia na kiang a ahong paikhawm ding uh ahi.
english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

paite: Gallau mut a na mut uleh suahlam pang a omte apawt ding uhi.
english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

paite: Gallau mut a na mut nawn uleh simlam pang a omte apawt ding uhi. Apawtna ding un gallau mut bang a amut ding uh ahi.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

paite: Himahleh mipite hong paikhawmna ding in na mut peuhmah ding ua, gallau mut a bel mut lou in.
english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

paite: Aaron tapa siampute'n pengkul amut ding uh ahi. Huai nou a ding in na suante uh tan a tangtawn dan ahi ding hi.
english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

paite: Na gam ua melma, nou hon nuaisiahte dou dia na kuan chiang un gallau mut in pengkulte na mut ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian ma uah theihgigena ahi ding ua, na melmate ua pan humbit na hi ding uh.
english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

paite: Nuam na sak nite un, ahunbi a na ankuangluinate uah, na kha thakte uah, na halmang thillat uahte leh na kilemna thillat kithoihnate uah pengkul na mut ding uh ahi. Huchi in na Pathian ma uah nou a ding in theihgigena ahi ding. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi," chi in.
english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”

paite: Akum nihna, akha nihna, huai kha ani sawmnih ni in, hichi ahong hi a, meipi in theihsakna biakbuk tung atungkah santa hi.
english: It happened in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante apaidan dungzui in Sinai gamdai a pan apawt ua; Paran gamdai ah meipi akhawlta hi.
english: The children of Israel went forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

paite: Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang in apawt uhi.
english: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Amasapen in Judah pawlte, apawl uh tamdan dungzui zel in apawt ua; aheutu uh Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

paite: Issakarte heutu Zuar tapa Nethaneel;
english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

paite: Zebulunte heutu Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

paite: Biakbuk aphel ua, Gershon tapa leh Merari tapa biakbuk zawng mite apawt uhi.
english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

paite: Reubente apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

paite: Simeonte heutu Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel ahi.
english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

paite: Gadte heutu Deuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

paite: Kohathte'n mun siangthou azawng ua, apawt ua; adangte'n atun ma un biakbuk ana lam uh.
english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

paite: Ephraimte apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Emihud tapa Elishama ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

paite: Manassehte heutu Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

paite: Benjaminte heutu Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

paite: Ananungpen in Dante apawl uh tamdan dungzui in apawt ua; aheutu uh Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

paite: Asherte heutu Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

paite: Naphtalite heutu Enan tapa Ahira ahi.
english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

paite: Hiai bang ahi Israel suante pawl atamdan dungzui ua apaidan uh, hiai bang in apai zom zel uhi.
english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

paite: Mosi sunghpa Midian mi Reuel tapa Hobab kiang ah, Mosi in, "K'on pe ding, TOUPA'N achihna mun ah ka pai ding ua, ka kiang uah hong sam inla, hoihtak in na tung ah ka hih ding uh. TOUPA'N Israel suante tungtang thu lah hoih in agenta ngal a," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Ka hong dah mai ding, ka gam uah ka tanaute kiang ah ka pai zaw mai ding," achi hi.
english: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

paite: Ama'n, "Hon paisan mahmah ke'n, gamdai ah lah giahphual satna ding na thei zaw ngal a, kou a ding in mit na hong hi ding hi.
english: He said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

paite: Hichi ahi dia, ka kiang ua na hong samleh, ahi, hichi ahi ding. TOUPA'N thil hoih hon hihsak bang in ka hon hihsak sam zel ding uhi," achi hi.
english: It shall be, if you go with us, yes, it shall be, that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA tang a pan ni thum lam ah apai ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm amau a dia kingakna mun zong in ama uah ni thum lam ah ana pai masa hi.
english: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of the covenant of Yahweh went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

paite: Abuk ua pan apawt un TOUPA meipi sun in atung uah a-om hi.
english: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai bawm apawt ding peuhmah chiang in Mosi in, "TOUPA aw, hong kisa inla, na melmate hawlzak in, nang hon hote na ma ah taikek uhen," achi zel hi.
english: It happened, when the ark went forward, that Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

paite: Akingakna peuh ah, TOUPA aw, Israel mipi sang tampite kiang ah hong kik nawn in, achi zel hi.
english: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

paite: Huan mipite'n TOUPA zak a phun in thil hoih lou pipi agen ua; TOUPA'N huai azak in ahehta hi. Huchi in TOUPA mei alak uah ahong kuang a, giahphual ponungpen a omte akangta hi.
english: The people were complaining in the ears of Yahweh. When Yahweh heard it, his anger was kindled; and Yahweh’s fire burnt among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

paite: Huchi in mipite'n Mosi asam ua; TOUPA kiang ah Mosi athum a, huai mei amitta hi.
english: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to Yahweh, and the fire abated.

paite: TOUPA mei alak ua ahong kat ziak in, huai mun min Taberah asa hi.
english: The name of that place was called Taberah Taberah means “burning” , because Yahweh’s fire burnt among them.

paite: Alak ua mikihel pawl khat in sa lunggulhna ahon neita ua; Israel suante leng akap nawn ua, "Kua'n ahia nek ding sa hon pe ding?
english: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us flesh to eat?

paite: Ut leh dah a Aigupta gam a ngasa i nek zelte i theigige ua, tangmaite, mazelte, phulun sialnek chite, vaiphulunte, phulun ngou leng.
english: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

paite: Himahleh tu in i guhngek uh akeu khinta, bangmah lamet ding a-om kei, manna lel lou ngal," achi uhi.
english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

paite: Manna bel koriandar tang bang, alatdan in bedeli suang bang ahi.
english: The manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance like the appearance of bdellium.

paite: Mite'n atomkhawm ua, gawinelna in agawinel ua, sum in asu ua, belte ah ahuan ua, tanghou in abawl uhi. Nek in sathau a kan tanghou abang hi.
english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

paite: Giahphual a zan a dai akiak in manna leng ahong kia hi.
english: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

paite: Mipite a-inkuankuan un apuanin kongkhak chiat uah akap uh, chih Mosi in ana za hi. TOUPA aheh mahmah a; Mosi leng alungkim kei hi.
english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the anger of Yahweh was kindled greatly; and Moses was displeased.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Bangziak in ahia na sikha na hon sukgim a, bang ahia na mit ka tunlouhna, hiai mite tengteng puakgik ka tung a na ngak?
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Why have you treated with your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

paite: Hiai mipite tengteng ka suan ahi ua hia? Api-le-pute uh kiang a kichiam a piak na chiam gam a pilut ding in. Naupommi in nawitui ne lai a pom bang in na angsung ah pom in, na hon chih dia ka pikhiak?
english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them forth, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers?’

paite: Hiai mipi tengteng piak ding sa koi a pan ka nei dia? 'Ka nek ding un sa hon pia in,' chi in akap ngal ua.
english: Where could I get meat to give to all this people? For they weep to me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

paite: Hiai mipi tengteng keimah kia in ka po zou kei. Kei a ding in agik lua hi.
english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

paite: Hichibang a hon hih ding na hihleh, hon sisak vanglak in, na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tanleh, ka gentheihna hon musak nawn mahmah ke'n," achi hi.
english: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Israelte Upa, mipite Upa leh aheutute uh hi a na theih mi sawmsagih ka kiang ah hon pikhawm inla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah nangmah toh dingkhawm ding in hon pi in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

paite: Huchi in ka hong pawt dia, huai ah ka hong houpih ding. Na tung a om kha om pen atung uah ka koih ding. Nang kia'n po lou in mipite puakgik ahon puakpih ding uhi.
english: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you not bear it yourself alone.

paite: Nang mipite kiang ah, zingchiang a ding in kihihsiangthou vek unla; huchi in sa na ne ding uh. Sa nek ding kuan ahia hon pe ding? Aigupta gam a nuam i saksak uh toh, chi in TOUPA zak in na kap ua; huaiziak in, TOUPA'N noute sa ahon pe dia, huchi in na ne ding uhi.
english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves against tomorrow, and you will eat flesh; for you have wept in the ears of Yahweh, saying, “Who will give us flesh to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore Yahweh will give you flesh, and you will eat.

paite: Ni khat kia, ni nih kia, ni sawm kia, ni sawmnih kia leng na ne kei ding ua;
english: You will not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days,

paite: himahleh kha khat pumlum, na nakvang ua ahong pawtkhiak a nou a dia kihhuai ahong hih masiah na ne ding uh. Na lak ua om TOUPA na deih louh ua, Aigupta gam a pan bangziak a paikhia i hi ua? chi a, ama a na kah ziak un," achi hi.
english: but a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because that you have rejected Yahweh who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

paite: Mosi in, "Ka ompih mipite khe a pai thei kia leng nuaiguk ahi ua; kha khat pumlum nek ding in sa ka pe ding, na chi hi.
english: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.’

paite: Belamhon leh ganhon leng gohsak lehang leng, akham ding ua hia? Tuipi a ngasa tengteng leng matsak vek lehang leng, akhamzou ding ua hia?" achi hi.
english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

paite: TOUPA'N, Mosi kiang ah, "TOUPA khut tomsak ahi a hia? Na tung ah ka thu bang a, atun leh tun louh na thei mai ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Has Yahweh’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

paite: Mosi apawt a, TOUPA thu mipite ahilh hi. Mipite Upa sawmsagihte asamkhawm a, puanin kim ah adingsak hi.
english: Moses went out, and told the people the words of Yahweh; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

paite: Meipi ah TOUPA ahong suk a, ahong houpih a, ama tung a om Kha pen Upa sawmsagihte tung ah akoih hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, atung ua kha akoihtak in thu agen ua; agen zom sawt kei uhi.
english: Yahweh came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders: and it happened that when the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

paite: Himahleh giahphual ah mi nih a-om lai ua, khat min Eldad ahi, akhat pen min Medad ahi. Atung uah kha a-om a, upate lak a min khum ahi ua, himahleh kihoupihna biakbuk ah bel ahoh kei uhi. Giahphual ah thu agen uhi.
english: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the Spirit rested on them; and they were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

paite: Huchi in tangval khat ava tai a, Mosi ava hilh a, "Eldad leh Medad in giahphual ah thu agen uh," achi hi.
english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

paite: Nun tapa Joshua, atuailai a pan Mosi nasempa'n adawng a, "Ka toupa Mosi, kham ve,” achi hi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

paite: Mosi in akiang ah, "Kei gum a na thikthu sia hia? Pathian mi tengteng zawlnei hi vek le uh, TOUPA'N atung uah tua Kha koihchiatleh chi zomah lai ka hi!" achi hi.
english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all Yahweh’s people were prophets, that Yahweh would put his Spirit on them!”

paite: Huchi in Mosi leh Israel Upa tengteng giahphual ah alut nawn uhi.
english: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

paite: TOUPA a pan huih ahong nung a, tuipi a pan vengkeng ahon mutleng a, giahphual lehlam sang ni khat lam, alehlam ni khat lamtuak dimsuak in giahphual kim ah tong nih ding a sang in akesak hi.
english: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

paite: Mipite'n huai ni nitum leh zankhua leh azing nitum tan in vengkeng ava tomkhawm ua; atom tawmpen in leng homer sawm atom hi. Giahphual kim ah amau a chiat aphou uhi.
english: The people rose up all that day, and all the night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; 1 homer is about 220 litres or 6 bushels and they spread them all abroad for themselves around the camp.

paite: Huai sa anek lai un, anek khit ma un, mipite tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, TOUPA'N hipi nasatak in mipite agawtta hi.
english: While the flesh was yet between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of Yahweh was kindled against the people, and Yahweh struck the people with a very great plague.

paite: Hiai mun min Kibroth-hattaavah asa a; huai a saduhte avui ziak un.
english: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, Kibroth Hattaavah means “graves of lust.” because there they buried the people who lusted.

paite: Kibroth-hattaavah a pan mipite Hazeroth ah apai ua; Hazeroth ah agiahphual uh asat uhi.
english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

paite: Huan Miriam leh Aaron in Mosi in Kus numei zi a, aneih ziak in agensia ua; Kus numei bel anei ngei hi.
english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

paite: Amau, "Mosi kiang kia ah hia TOUPA'N thu agen tuam? Ei kiang ah leng agen sam kei a hia?" achi uh. TOUPA'N huai ana za hi.
english: They said, “Has Yahweh indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And Yahweh heard it.

paite: Mosi bel leitung a mihing tengteng sang in amigi mahmah hi.
english: Now the man Moses was very humble, above all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

paite: Thakhat in TOUPA'N Mosi, Aaron leh Miriam kiang ah, "Na thum un hong paisuk unla, kihoupihna biakbuk ah hong pai un," achi hi. Huchi in athum un ava hoh uhi.
english: Yahweh spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

paite: TOUPA meipi dingh ah ahong paisuk a, puanin kongkhak ah ahong dingh a, Aaron leh Miriam asam a; anih un ahong paisuk uhi.
english: Yahweh came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

paite: Ama'n, "Ka thu ngaikhia un. Na lak ua zawlnei na om uleh amah kiang ah kei TOUPA kilakna in ka kihil dia, manglam in ka houpih ding.
english: He said, “Hear now my words. If there is a prophet among you, I Yahweh will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

paite: Ka sikha Mosi bel huchibang ahi kei. Ka inko tengteng ah amuanhuai hi.
english: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

paite: Amah toh paukam in thuguk om lou in teltak in ka kihou ding ua; TOUPA mel leng amu ding. Huaiziak in ka sikha Mosi bangchidan a gense ngam na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: With him I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see Yahweh’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA atung uah aheh mahmah a, apai nawnta hi.
english: The anger of Yahweh was kindled against them; and he departed.

paite: Puanin tung ah meipi akikhinta hi. Ngai in, Miriam vuk bang a ngou in ahong phakta a; Aaron in Miriam a-en a, ngai in, phak ana hita maimah hi,
english: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

paite: Huchi in Aaron in Mosi kiang ah, "Ka toupa aw, ka tung uah khelhna nga mahmah ke'n. Haihuaitak in ka na hihta ua, ka na khialta uhi.
english: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

paite: Anu sul a pan sisa phial mahmah a ahong pawt bang in amah omsak ke'n," achi hi.
english: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in, "Pathian aw, damsak nawn dih ve," chi in TOUPA angen hi.
english: Moses cried to Yahweh, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Apa'n amai chilsiat hilhial taleh ni sagih azakta kei ding maw? Giahphual pua ah ni sagih kibu henla; huai khit chiang in pilut nawn hi hen," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

paite: Huchi in giahphual pua ah ni sagih sung Miriam khumtuam in a-om hi. Miriam apilut nawn ma un mipite akisuan kei uhi.
english: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

paite: Huai khit in mipite Hazeroth a pan apawt ua, Paran gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante ka piak, Kanaan gam va enkhe ding in mi sawl in. Anam inko chih ua mi, a-intekpa pen lak a mi khat chiat na sawl ding,” achi hi.
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

paite: Mosi in Paran gamdai a pan TOUPA thupiak bang in akuansakta a; avek un Israel suante lak a intekpa pen chiat ahi uhi.
english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of Yahweh: all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.

paite: Hiaite amin uh ahi: Reuben nam lak a mi Zakkur tapa Shammua.
english: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

paite: Simeon nam lak a mi Hori tapa Shaphat.
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

paite: Judah nam lak a mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb.
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

paite: Issakar nam lak a mi Joseph tapa Igal.
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

paite: Ephraim nam lak a mi Nun tapa Hoshea.
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

paite: Benjamin nam lak a mi Raphu tapa Palti.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

paite: Zebulun nam lak a mi Sodi tapa Gaddiel.
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

paite: Joseph nam, Manasseh nam achih uh, lak a mi Susi tapa Gaddi.
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

paite: Dan nam lak a mi Gemalli tapa Ammiel.
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

paite: Asher nam lak a mi Mikael tapa Sethur.
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

paite: Naphtali nam lak a mi Vophsi tapa Nahbi.
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

paite: Gad nam lak a mi Maki tapa Geuel.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

paite: Hiaite gam enkhe dia Mosi in asawlte min ahi. Mosi in Nun tapa Hoshea, Joshua achi hi.
english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Kanaan gam enkhe ding in amaute asawl a, akiang uah, "Simlam lampi ah pai phot unla, tangte ah kahtou un.
english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country:

paite: Huai gam bangchibang ahia, huai a teng mipite ahat uh hia, hat lou, atawm uh leh atam uh;
english: and see the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

paite: atenna gam uh ahoih hia hoih lou, a-omna khuate uh bangchibang ahia, puanin maimah hia, kulh nei;
english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

paite: huai gam lei thau ahi hia, lei gawng, gammang om hia om lou chih va enkhia un. Hangsantak in om unla, huai gam theigahte hon pua un," achi hi. Tu grep gah masa gah hun laitak ahi.
english: and what the land is, whether it is fat or lean, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.”

paite: Huchi in akuantouta ua, huai gam Zin gamdai a pan Hamath lutna Rehob tan in a-enkhe vek uhi.
english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

paite: Simlam ah ahohtou phot ua, Hebron ava tung ua, huai ah Anak suan Ahiman, Sheshai leh Talmai a-om uhi. Hebron bel Aigupta gam a Zoan kilam ma kum sagih a kilam khinta ahi.
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

paite: Eshkol Phaizang ava tung ua, huai ah grep gahbom khat ahiang toh asattan ua, chiang in mi nih in azawng uhi. Theibuhfai leh theipite leng apua uhi.
english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

paite: Israel suante'n huai a grep bom asatkhiak ziak un, huai mun Eshkol Phaizang asa uhi.
english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

paite: Ni sawmli zoh in gam etkhiakna a pan ahong kik nawn uhi.
english: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

paite: Huchi in Paran gamdai a Kadesh ah Mosi leh Aaron leh Israel suan mipi omkhawmte tengteng kiang ahong tung ua, akiang uah leh mipi omkhawmte tengteng kiang ah thu ahon tun ua, huai gam theite a-ensak uhi.
english: They went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them, and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.

paite: Akiang ah, "N'on sawlna gam ah ka va hoh ua, bawngnawi leh khuaizu luanna ana hi ngei ngut a; hiai agam thei ahi.
english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us; and surely it flows with milk and honey; and this is its fruit.

paite: Himahleh agam a mi tengte mihat pipi ahi ua, khuate leng kulh nei, thupi taktak ahi. Anak suante leng ka va mu uh.
english: However the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

paite: Simlam gam ah Amalekte ateng ua; tanggam ah Hitte, Jebuste, Amorte ateng uh. Tuipi gei leh Jordan luidung ah Kanaante ateng uh," chi in ahilh uhi.
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South: and the Hittite, and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, dwell in the hill country; and the Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along by the side of the Jordan.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi ma ah Kaleb in mipite adaisak khipkhep a, "Kisa tou zok ni in, va latou zok ni, i zou ngeingei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.”

paite: Himahleh ahohpihte'n, "I va zou vek thei kei ding e, ei sang in lah ahatzaw ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante kiang ah, "Ka va gam etkhiak uh gam, enkhe dia ka va vakna uh, asung a mi tengte nek khit hatmi ahi ua; ami om ka muhte uh mi awmkhauh pipi ahi uh.
english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

paite: Huai ah Anak suante, miliante, awmkhauh pipi ka va mu ua; koute lah khaupe bang lel in ka va kimu ua, amau leng khaupe ek bang lel in ahon mu uh," chi in ahoih lou lam in agen uhi.
english: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

paite: Huan omkhawm tengteng aw suah in akap ua; huai zan in mite akap uhi.
english: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

paite: Israel suan tengteng Mosi tung leh Aaron tung ah aphun ua; omkhawm tengteng in akiang uah, "Aigupta gam ah Pathian in hon that geih hileh aw! Ahihkeileh gamdai ah hon na that geih hileh aw!
english: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said to them, “Would that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would that we had died in this wilderness!

paite: Bang achia namsau a si maimah dia Pathian in hiai gam a hon pi ahi diam aw? I zi leh i tate lah mat maimah ding ahi ngal ua. Aigupta gam a kik nawn ei a dia hoihzaw lou ding hia? achi uhi.
english: Why does Yahweh bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be a prey: wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

paite: Huchi in akihoukhawm ua, heutu bawl ni e, Aigupta gam ah kik nawn ni," achi uhi.
english: They said one to another, “Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng ma ah Mosi leh Aaron abokkhup uhi.
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

paite: Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb, gam va enkhete lak a telte'n apuan uh abotkek uh.
english: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes:

paite: Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kiang ah, "Enkhe dia ka va vakna gam uh gam hoihtak ahi.
english: and they spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceeding good land.

paite: I tung ua TOUPA akipahleh huai gam ah ahon pilut ngei ding. Huai nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ahon pe ding hi.
english: If Yahweh delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us; a land which flows with milk and honey.

paite: TOUPA tung ah hel kei phot le uchin. Huai gam a mite leng lau sam kei un. I an ding uh ahi ua, akihumbitna uh bangmah ahi kei. TOUPA i kiang uah a-om hi, amau lau kei un," chi in agen uhi.
english: Only don’t rebel against Yahweh, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defense is removed from over them, and Yahweh is with us. Don’t fear them.”

paite: Himahleh omkhawm tengteng in suang a den asawm ua; huchi in kihoupihna biakbuk, Israel suan tengteng ma ah TOUPA thupina ahong kilangta hi.
english: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The glory of Yahweh appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n bang tan hon thusim lou ding ahi ua; alak ua chiamtehna ka hih zel nangawn a leng bang tan ahia hon taksan louh lai ding uh?
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? and how long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

paite: Hipi in ka gawt dia, ka in-gamsak dia, nangmah ah amau sang a thupi leh thilhihtheizaw nam ka bawlkhe zaw mai ding,” achi hi.
english: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Aigupta mite'n aza kha ding uh. Hiai mite lah alak ua pan na thilhihtheihna a na pikhiakte ahi ngal ua.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them;

paite: Hiai gam a teng mite ahilh ding uh. Hiai mite lak ah nang TOUPA na om chih azata uh. Kimaituah hial a muh in na om a, atung uah na meipi a-om a; sun in meipi dingh, zan in meikuang in ama uh lah na pi zel hi.
english: and they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you Yahweh are in the midst of this people; for you Yahweh are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

paite: Hiai mite na thahgamleh na minthanna za namte'n,
english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N hiai mite kichiam a, achiam gam a api theih louh ziak in gamdai ah athatta, achi ding uh.
english: ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

paite: Tu in ka hon ngen ahi, ka TOUPA thilhihtheihna hih thupi in om hen, thu a na gen tak dungzui in;
english: Now please let the power of the Lord The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

paite: TOUPA lungneltak, migitna hau, thulimlouhnate, tatleknate ngaidam zel; moh a asehte khah ngei loupa, pate thulimlouhna tate, tate tasawnte, suan thumna leh suan lina tan a gawt zel ahi, na chi hi.
english: ‘Yahweh is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and that will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

paite: Na migitna athupi bang ngei leh Aigupta gam a pan tutan a na ngaihdam bang in mipite thulimlouhna ngaidam in," achi hi.
english: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and according as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

paite: TOUPA'N, "Na thu bang in ka ngaidam hi.
english: Yahweh said, “I have pardoned according to your word:

paite: Himahleh kei ka hin bang in TOUPA thupina in leitung pumpi adimsak ding.
english: but in very deed, as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the glory of Yahweh;

paite: Aigupta gam leh gamdai a ka thupina leh ka thillamdang hihte mu a, huchi pipi a leng sawmveitak hon ze-et lailai a, ka thu zui lou lai mi tengteng in;
english: because all those men who have seen my glory, and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

paite: apipute uh kiang a kichiam a ka chiam huai gam amu kei hial ding uh. Alak ua kei hon ngaineute mawngmawng in leng amu sam kei ding uh.
english: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it:

paite: Ka sikha Kaleb in bel lungsim dang aput a, ahon zuih taktak ziak in, amah zaw ava hohna gam ah ka pilut dia, asuante'n huai aluah ding uh.
english: but my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him will I bring into the land into which he went; and his seed shall possess it.

paite: Phaizang a Amalekte leh Kanaante teng ahih ziak un, zingchiang in kihei unla, Tuipi San lampi lam gamdai ah lut un," achi hi.
english: Now the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley: tomorrow turn, and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds .”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai mithulim lou omkhawmte, ka tung a phunphunte bang tan ahia ka dohzoh ding? Israel suante phunna, ka tung a aphunnate uh ka za hi.
english: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, that murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

paite: Akiang uah, ka hin bang in ka gen ahi, ka bilbuk ngei a na gen bang un na tung uah ka hih ding hi.
english: Tell them, ‘As I live, says Yahweh, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so will I do to you:

paite: Na luang uh gamdai ah apuk dia; na lak ua simsa mi tengteng, kum sawmnih a pan atunglam ka tung a phun teng,
english: your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have murmured against me,

paite: ban zak hial a, ka hon omsak ding, ka chih gam ah Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua kia lou ngal na lut kei ding uh,
english: surely you shall not come into the land, concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: Himahleh mat ding lel ahi ding uh, na chih uh na tate uh ka pilut dia, na ngaihneu uh gam athei ding uhi.
english: But your little ones, that you said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

paite: "Nou bel na luang uh hiai gamdai ah apuk ding hi.
english: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

paite: Na tate uh gamdai ah kum sawmli sung avakvai ding ua, gamdai a na luangte uh amawk man masiah na kizuakna uh amau athuakloh ding uhi.
english: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies be consumed in the wilderness.

paite: Gam na va etkhiak ni zah uh, ni sawmli, ni khat tang in kum khat zel, kum sawmli sung na tatlekna uh na thuakloh ding ua, huchi in ka thuchiam ka hihlamdan dan na thei ding uhi.
english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

paite: Kei TOUPA'N migilou omkhawm, kei hon kalh a omkhawmte tung ah hiai ka hih ngei ding ka na chi khinta hi. Hiai gamdai ah amangthang ding ua. Huai ah asi ding uh," achi hi.
english: I, Yahweh, have spoken, surely this will I do to all this evil congregation, who are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

paite: Gam enkhe dia Mosi misawl hong kik nawnte'n, gam omdan ahoih lou lam agen un amah tung ah omkhawmte aphunsak hi.
english: The men, whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up an evil report against the land,

paite: Huai gam omdan ahoih lou lam agente ngei TOUPA ma ah hipi in asita uhi.
english: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before Yahweh.

paite: Gam enkhe dia hohte lak a Nun tapa Joshua leh Jephunneh tapa Kaleb bel asi kei uhi.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

paite: Mosi in huai thute Israel suan tengteng ahilh a; huchi in mipite'n nakpitak in asuun uhi.
english: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

paite: Huchi in zingsangpi in athou ua, tang vum ah ahohtou ua, "Ngai in, hiai ah ka hong pai uh. TOUPA'N ahon chiamna mun ah ka hoh ding uh, ka na khialta uhi," achi uhi.
english: They rose up early in the morning, and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which Yahweh has promised: for we have sinned.”

paite: Mosi in, "Tu a bangziak a TOUPA thupiak palsat na hi ua? Hiai alohching kei ding.
english: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of Yahweh, since it shall not prosper?

paite: Na kiang ua TOUPA a-om louh ziak in hohtou kei un; melmate thah a na omlouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Don’t go up, for Yahweh isn’t among you; that you not be struck down before your enemies.

paite: "Na ma uah Amalekte leh Kanaante a-om uhi. Namsau a thah na hi phet ding uh. TOUPA na lehngatsan tak ziak un na kiang uah TOUPA a-om kei ding," achi hi.
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you shall fall by the sword: because you are turned back from following Yahweh, therefore Yahweh will not be with you.”

paite: Himahleh mualvum a hoh atum ua; himahleh TOUPA thukhun bawm leh Mosi giahphual a pan apawtkhe kei uhi.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of Yahweh, and Moses, didn’t depart out of the camp.

paite: Huchi in huai mual a om Amalekte leh Kanaante hong kuansuk in, ahong dou ua, Hormah tanpha in asatpuk phengphung uhi.
english: Then the Amalekite came down, and the Canaanite who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down, even to Hormah.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, tenna ding a gam ka hon piakna na tun chiang un,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

paite: TOUPA kiang a mei a thillat ahihkeileh halmang thillat, ahihkeileh thuchiam tangtun dia kithoihna, ahihkeileh noumau ut thu a thillat, ahihkeileh ankuanglui hunbi, ahihkeileh ganhon lak, ahihkeileh belamhon lak, ahihkeileh TOUPA a dia gimlim bawl ding a na lat chiang un,
english: and will make an offering by fire to Yahweh, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a freewill offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, of the herd, or of the flock;

paite: TOUPA kiang a thillat lanmi peuhmah in tangbuang thillat, tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat, sathau hin mun li a khen mun khat a mek alat ding ahi.
english: then he who offers his offering shall offer to Yahweh a meal offering of a tenth part of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the fourth part of a hin of oil:

paite: Dawn thillat dia uain hin mun li a khen mun khat halmang thillat, ahihkeileh kithoihna belamnou khat a dia na bawl ding uh ahi.
english: and wine for the drink offering, the fourth part of a hin, you shall prepare with the burnt offering, or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

paite: Belamtal a tangbuang thillat, tangbuang nelte, ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih, sathau hin mun thum a khen mun khat mek na bawl ding uh ahi.
english: “‘Or for a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil:

paite: Dawn thillat dia TOUPA a ding a gimlim ding uain hin mun thum a khen mun khat na lat ding uh ahi.
english: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Haltum thillat ding, ahihkeileh thuchiam tangtun dia kithoihna, ahihkeileh TOUPA kiang a lemna thillat a bawngtal na lat chiang un;
english: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh;

paite: Bawngtal lat toh kiton in tangbuang thillat tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum sathau hin kimkhat a mek na lat ding uh ahi.
english: then shall he offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil:

paite: Dawn thillat dia uain hin kimkhat, TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat na lat ding uh ahi.
english: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: "Huchibang in bawngtal, ahihkeileh belampa, ahihkeileh belamnou, ahihkeileh kelnou ahi ding ahi.
english: Thus shall it be done for each bull, or for each ram, or for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

paite: Atamdan uh dungzui zel in na bawl ding ua, atamdan uh dungzui zel in na lan ding uhi.
english: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

paite: Huai gam a piang tengteng in hichibang zel in TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat alat chiang un ahih ding uhi.
english: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Namdangmi na kiang ua tengsa him ahihkeileh kuapeuh na kiang ua teng zelzel ding hiamte'n leng TOUPA a dia gimlim mei a thillat lan nuam peuhmah in na hih bang ua ahih sam ding uh ahi.
english: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; as you do, so he shall do.

paite: Na suante uh leh mipite leh namdang na kiang ua omte a dia leng dan khat kia a-om ding ahi. TOUPA ma ah namdangte noumau bang ahi ding uh.
english: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations: as you are, so shall the foreigner be before Yahweh.

paite: Nou a ding leh na kiang ua namdang omte a ding in dan khat leh hihdan kibang khat kia a-om ding," achi hi.
english: One law and one ordinance shall be for you, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, hichi ahi ding a, ka hon pina ding gam na va tun ua,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

paite: huai gam tanghou na nek chiang un, TOUPA kiang ah vei thillat na lan ding uh ahi.
english: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to Yahweh.

paite: Na tanghou mek masakpen lak ua beu khatvei thillat dia na lat ding uh ahi. Buhphual a vei thillat dia na vei bang un na vei ding uhi.
english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering: as the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

paite: Na suante uh tan in na tanghou mek masakpen uh TOUPA kiang a vei thillat dia na lat zel ding uh ahi.
english: Of the first of your dough you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.

paite: "Hiai thupiak tengteng, TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a agen, tup mawng hilou a zuih khak louh na neih uleh,
english: “‘When you shall err, and not observe all these commandments, which Yahweh has spoken to Moses,

paite: TOUPA'N thu apiak tung a pan na suante uh tan a dia Mosi zang a thu apiak tengteng chihna ahi.
english: even all that Yahweh has commanded you by Moses, from the day that Yahweh gave commandment, and onward throughout your generations;

paite: Hichi ahi dia, omkhawmte'n thei lou a, ahih khak uh ahihleh, omkhawm tengteng in halmang thillat TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in bawngtuai khat alan ding ua, adan ngeina bang in tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat toh, khelhna kithoihna ding in keltal khat leng alan tel ding uh ahi.
english: then it shall be, if it be done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh, with the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

paite: Siampu in Israel suan omkhawm tengteng a ding in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding uh. Thei lou a hihkhak ahih ziak leh athillat uh TOUPA a dia mei a thillat leh ahihkhelh uh sik a khelhna kithoihna alat tak ziak un.
english: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to Yahweh, and their sin offering before Yahweh, for their error:

paite: Israel suante omkhawm tengteng ngaihdam ahi ding ua, alak ua namdang omte leng; mipi tengteng in ahih khak uh ahih ziak in.
english: and all the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, and the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for in respect of all the people it was done unwittingly.

paite: "Mi'n thei lou a thil ahihkhelhleh khelhna kithoihna ding in kelnu khat kum khat a upa alat ding ahi.
english: “‘If one person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

paite: Thei lou a TOUPA ma a hihkhialmi a ding in siampu in kilemna abawl ding hi; huchi in ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs, when he sins unwittingly, before Yahweh, to make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

paite: Thei lou a hihkhialmi a ding in, Israel suante, huai gam a piangte a ding leh namdangmi na lak ua omte a ding in leng dan khat na neih ding uh ahi.
english: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

paite: "Himahleh tup mawng a hihkhial ahihleh, huai gam a piang hiam, namdang hiam leng hitaleh TOUPA gensia ahi a; huai mi achipihte lak a pan satkhiak ding ahi.
english: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, the same blasphemes Yahweh; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

paite: TOUPA thu musit a, athupiak abohsiat ziak in, huai mi satkhiak ding ahi, athulimlouhna moh ama'n apo ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: Because he has despised the word of Yahweh, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be on him.’”

paite: Israel suante gamdai a a-om lai un mi khat Sabbath ni a sing tom amu uhi.
english: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

paite: Asing tom mu mite'n amah Mosi leh Aaron leh mipi omkhawmte kiang ah ahon pi uhi.
english: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

paite: Bangchi a hih ding ahia chih genkhiak nai louh ahih ziak in tanna inn ah akhum uhi.
english: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Hiai mi hihlup ngeingei ding ahi, giahphual pua ah mipi omkhawm tengteng in suang in adeng ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in mipi omkhawm tengteng in giahphual pua ah api ua, suang in adenglumta uhi.
english: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah, asuante uh tanpha a, apuan mong ua agei bawl ding leh among teng gei a adum khak ding in gen in.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes or, tassels (Hebrew tzitzit) in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe or, tassel of each border a cord of blue:

paite: Huai among na et ua, TOUPA thupiak tengteng na theihgige ua na zuihna ding un leh; kizuak a na om zel bang ua na lungtang uh deih leh na mit uh la lam peuh deih a na omlouhna ding un.
english: and it shall be to you for a fringe or, tassel , that you may look on it, and remember all the commandments of Yahweh, and do them; and that you not follow after your own heart and your own eyes, after which you use to play the prostitute;

paite: Ka thupiak tengteng na theihgige ua na zuih ua, na Pathian uh a dia na sianthou theihna ding uh ahi.
english: that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

paite: Na Pathian uh hi ding a Aigupta gam a pan nou hon pikhepa TOUPA, na Pathian uh ka hi. Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi,” achi hi.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Yahweh your God.”

paite: Levi tapa Kohath, huai tapa Izhar, huai tapa Korah pen Eliab tapate, Dathan leh Abiram leh Peleth tapa On leh Reuben tapate'n mite api ua;
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

paite: Israel suante, mi tallang deuhdeuh mipi omkhawmte lak a heutu vaihawmmi dia telte lak a mi zanih-le-sawmnga toh Mosi ma ah ava kisa uhi.
english: and they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown;

paite: Mosi leh Aaron kalh in akikhawm ua, akiang uah, "Na uang lua uh, na uang lua uh, omkhawm mipite lah asiangthou chiat ngal ua, TOUPA alak uah a-om chih mu zenpi a, bangziak a TOUPA mipi omkhawmte tung a kikoih na hi ua?" achi uh.
english: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and Yahweh is among them: why then lift yourselves up above the assembly of Yahweh?”

paite: Mosi in huai azak in amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
english: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face:

paite: Korah leh apawlte tengteng kiang ah, "Zingchiang in TOUPA'N amah ate kuate ahi ua, kuate ahia siangthou, chih ataklang ding a, akiang ah ahon pai naisak ding. Ama'n amitel ngei tan in akiangnai ah apaisak ding hi.
english: and he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, “In the morning Yahweh will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him: even him whom he shall choose he will cause to come near to him.

paite: Hichi in hih un, Korah leh apawlte tengteng aw, zingchiang in mei laknate tawi unla;
english: Do this: take censers, Korah, and all his company;

paite: huai ah mei koih unla, TOUPA ma ah gimlim buak un. TOUPA'N atel peuhmah asiangthou ding. Levi tapate, na uang lua uh," chi in agen hi.
english: and put fire in them, and put incense on them before Yahweh tomorrow: and it shall be that the man whom Yahweh chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

paite: Mosi in Korah kiang ah, "Nou Levi tapate aw, ngaikhia unla,
english: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

paite: TOUPA biakbuk nasep sem ding leh khawmpi nna sem dia khawmpite ma a dingh a, amah kiang a hon om naisak ding a, Israel Pathian in Israel omkhawmte a pan noute ahon omsak, nou a dia thil neuchik phet a kilang hia?
english: Is it a small thing to you, that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the tabernacle of Yahweh, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

paite: Amah kiang ah ahon om naisakta a, na kiang a na unau Levi tapa tengteng, siamputna leng na zong ua hia?
english: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? and do you seek the priesthood also?

paite: Huaiziak in nang leh na pawl tengteng TOUPA kalh in na kikhawm uh ahi. Aaron in bang ahih a ahia, atung a na phun uh?" achi hi.
english: Therefore you and all your company are gathered together against Yahweh: and Aaron, what is he that you murmur against him?”

paite: Mosi in Eliab tapa Dathan leh Abiram asamsak a, "Amau ka hong paitou kei ding uh.
english: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up:

paite: Gamdai a hon that dia nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam a pan na hon pikhiak thil neuchik ahi hia? Ka tung uah na kilalsak nawn ngal a.
english: is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

paite: Nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ah na hon pilut kei a, lou ding leh grephuan gou ding lah na hon pe kei a; hiai mite mitte na mialsak ding maw? Ka hong paitou kei hial ding uh," achi uh.
english: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi aheh mahmah a, "TOUPA kiang ah, athillat uh sang ke'n. Asabiltung uh khat lel leng ka la kei, kuamah ka hih na kei," achi hi.
english: Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering: I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

paite: Mosi in Korah kiang ah, "Zingchiang in nang, na mi kikhawmte leh Aaron TOUPA ma ah ana om un.
english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before Yahweh, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow:

paite: Amei lakna uh tawi chiat uhenla, gimlim buak uhen. TOUPA ma ah amei lakna uh hon tawi uhenla, mei lakna zanih-le-sawmnga hon tawi uhen. Nang leh Aaron in leng na mei lakna uh tawi tuaktuak un," achi hi.
english: and each man take his censer, and put incense on them, and each man bring before Yahweh his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each his censer.”

paite: Huchi in michih in amei lakna uh atawi chiat ua, mei akoih ua, gimlim abuak ua, Mosi leh Aaron toh kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ava dingh uhi.
english: They each took his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

paite: Korah in mipi tengteng ama ah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah a-omkhawmsak a; mipi tengteng kiang ah TOUPA thupina ahong langta hi.
english: Korah assembled all the congregation against them to the door of the Tent of Meeting: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to all the congregation.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai mipi omkhawmte a pan kihuikhia un, amau ka hihmang guihtheihna ding in," achi hi.
english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

paite: Amau abokkhup ua, "Pathian aw, sa tengteng kha Pathian, mi khat khelh ziak in mipi omkhawm tengteng tung ah na heh dia hia?" achi uhi.
english: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Mipite kiang ah, Korah, Dathan leh Abiram puanin a pan kihemkhia un, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

paite: Mosi athoutou a, Dathan leh Abiram kiang ah ava hoh a; Israelte upate'n azui uhi.
english: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

paite: Omkhawmte kiang ah, "Hiai migiloute puanin a pan pawtkhia un. Abangmah uh khoih kei un, huchi lou in zaw akhelhna tengteng uah na pangkha ding uh," chi in agen hi.
english: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

paite: Huchi in Korah, Dathan leh Abiram puanin a pan apawtkhe duamduam ua; Dathan leh Abiram ahong pawtkhia ua, apuanin kongkhak uah azite, atapate leh atanu neu chikchikte uh toh adingh uhi.
english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little ones.

paite: Mosi in, "Keimah lungsim a pawtkhia ahi kei a, hiai thilhih ding in TOUPA'N ahon sawl ahi, chih hiai ah na thei ding uh.
english: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that Yahweh has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

paite: Hiai mi tengteng dan bang lel a asih ua, mi tengteng gawt bang lel a gawt ahih uleh Pathian in kei hon sawl lou ahi ding.
english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then Yahweh hasn’t sent me.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N thil thak abawl a, lei in akam akat a, amau leh amau a tengteng avalh a, ahing a Sheol alut uleh bel hiai mite'n TOUPA ana hehsak uh, chih na thei ding uh," achi hi.
english: But if Yahweh make a new thing, and the ground open its mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain to them, and they go down alive into Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. ; then you shall understand that these men have despised Yahweh.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai thu tengteng agen khit in anuai ua lei ahong khangkham phok hi.
english: It happened, as he made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground split apart that was under them;

paite: Lei in akam aka a, a-inkuan un Korah mi tengteng, aneih tengteng uh toh avalh khin vekta hi.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and all the men who appertained to Korah, and all their goods.

paite: Huchi in amau leh amau a tengteng Sheol ah ahing in atum vek ua, lei in akam achihkhum a, omkhawmte lak a pan amangthangta uhi.
english: So they, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. : and the earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

paite: Huchi in akim ua Israel tengteng akikou husa uah ataizak ua, lei in ei leng ahon valh kha ding, achi uhi.
english: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

paite: TOUPA a pan meikuang ahong pawtkhia a, gimlim lanmi zanih-le-sawmnga ahong kanglumta hi.
english: Fire came forth from Yahweh, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron tapa siampu Eleazar kiang ah thu gen inla, ama'n meikuang a pan mei laknate lakhe ding in hilh in, siangthou lah ahita ngal ua.
english: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire yonder; for they are holy,

paite: Ahinna tung mah a hiai mikhialte mei laknate maitam khuhna kuang ding in sek hi uhen, TOUPA ma a lat ahi ngal a. Huaiziak in asiangthou hi, huai Israel suante a ding in chiamtehna ahi ding," achi hi.
english: even the censers of these sinners against their own lives; and let them be made beaten plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before Yahweh; therefore they are holy; and they shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

paite: Siampu Eleazar in mi kangte dal mei laknate ala a; maitam khuhna ding in asekta hi.
english: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, which those who were burnt had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

paite: Israel suante a dia theihgigena hi ding in huchi a Aaron tate hilou namdang himhim, TOUPA ma a gimlim hal dia ahong pai nailouhna ding un. Mosi zang a akiang a TOUPA'Nagen bang a, Korah leh apawlte bang ahong hihlouhna ding in.
english: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger, who isn’t of the seed of Aaron, comes near to burn incense before Yahweh; that he not be as Korah, and as his company: as Yahweh spoke to him by Moses.

paite: Himahleh azingsang in, TOUPA mite na that uh, chi in Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Mosi leh Aaron tung ah aphun uhi.
english: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Mosi leh Aaron tung mipi apunkhawm lai un, kihoupihna biakbuk lam a-en ua; ngai in, meipi in ahon khuh a, TOUPA thupina ahong kilang hi.
english: It happened, when the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the Tent of Meeting: and behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of Yahweh appeared.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ahoh uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hiai mipi omkhawmte lak a pan kihemkhia un, amau ka hihmang guihtheihna ding in," achi hi. Amau amai ua lei si in abokkhup uhi.
english: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

paite: Mosi in Aaron kiang ah, "Na mei lakna tawi inla, maitam a pan mei koih inla; gimlim buak inla, mipi omkhawmte kiang ah paipih meng inla, amaute a ding in kilemna bawl in. TOUPA hehna ahong suak hi; hipi aleng panta," achi hi.
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, and put fire from off the altar in it, and lay incense on it, and carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from Yahweh! The plague has begun.”

paite: Aaron in Mosi gen bang in atawi a, omkhawmte lak ah atailut a, ngai in, mipi lak ah huai hipi ahong leng pan a; gimlim abuak a, mipi a ding in kilemna abawl hi.
english: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the midst of the assembly; and behold, the plague has begun among the people: and he put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

paite: Misi leh mihing kikal ah adingh a, hipi akhawlta hi.
english: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

paite: Huchi in Korah tungtang thu a site sim louh, hipi a si tengteng singkhat sangli-le-zasagih ahi uh.
english: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, besides those who died about the matter of Korah.

paite: Aaron kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a Mosi kiang ah akik nawn a, huchi in hipi akhawlta hi.
english: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting: and the plague was stayed.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, a-inkuan chih a tuam ding in chiang khat chiat, a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a a-intekpen tengteng zah, chiang sawm-le-nih la inla; achiang uah amin uh gelh in.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take of them rods, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods: write every man’s name on his rod.

paite: Levi chiang ah Aaron min gelh inla; a-inkuan chih uh a ding in chiang khat zel ahi ding ahi.
english: You shall write Aaron’s name on the rod of Levi; for there shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin thu theihsakna ma ah na koih dia, huai ah i kimu ding.
english: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, ka tel ding mi chiang asel ding; huchi in Israel suante na tung a aphunna uh ka daisak ding,” achi hi.
english: It shall happen, that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you.”

paite: Mosi in Israel suante ahoupih a, a-intekpen tengteng in amau inkuan chih a tuam a ding, intekpen chih in chiang khat zel, chiang sawm-le-nih apia uhi. Huaite lak ah Aaron chiang leng atel sam hi.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

paite: Mosi in theihpihna biakbuk ah TOUPA ma ah huai chiangte akoih hi.
english: Moses laid up the rods before Yahweh in the tent of the testimony.

paite: Azing in hichi ahong hi a, theihpihna puanin ah Mosi ava hoh a; ngai in, Levi inkuante a dia Aaron chiang ana sel a, pakmum asuah a, apakpalh a, vaisuaklu min asuang hi.
english: It happened on the next day, that Moses went into the tent of the testimony; and behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and put forth buds, and produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ma a pan chiang tengteng Israel tengteng kiang ah alakhia a; ana en ua, amau chiang chiat ala uhi.
english: Moses brought out all the rods from before Yahweh to all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Helhat tate ahi uh chih theihsak zelna ding in Aaron chiang theihpihna bul ah koih nawn in. Huchi in ka tung a ahelna uh na daisak thei ding, asihlouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their murmurings against me, that they not die.”

paite: Huchibang in Mosi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in ahih hi.
english: Moses did so. As Yahweh commanded him, so he did.

paite: Israel suante'n Mosi kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka si ua, ka mangthang uh, ka vek un ka mangthang uh.
english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

paite: TOUPA biakbuk kiangnai a hong pai peuhmah asi ding uh. Kou leng si in ka mangthang ding uh maw?" achi uhi.
english: Everyone who comes near, who comes near to the tabernacle of Yahweh, dies! Will we all perish?”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Nang leh na tapate leh na inkuan un mun siangthou tung a khelhna toh kisai mohpuakna na la ding uh ahi. Nang leh na tapate kia in siampu hihna toh kisai thilhihkhelhte a mohpuakna na puak ding uh ahi.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

paite: Na unaute, Levi suante leh na pa inkote hon tawnpih in, huchi a amau mun siangthou tung a khelhna toh kisai a mohpuakna alaktheihna ding un. Nang leh na tapate'n bel siampu hihna toh kisai thilhihkhelhte ah mohpuakna na lak ding uh ahi.
english: Your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, bring near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you: but you and your sons with you shall be before the tent of the testimony.

paite: Nna nasep ahon huh ding ua, puanin nasep tengteng atang ding ua, himahleh mun siangthou tui-um belsuan leh maitam pen hon naih kei uhen, asihlouhna ding un, amau hiam, nang hiam in leng.
english: They shall keep your commands, and the duty of all the Tent: only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they, nor you.

paite: Puanin nasepna tengteng ah kihoupihna biakbuk nna pen atang ding uh. Namdangte'n nou ahon naih ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: They shall be joined to you, and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent: and a stranger shall not come near to you.

paite: Nang mun siangthou nasep leh maitam nasep pen na tang ding, Israel suante tung a hehna a-om nawnlouhna ding in.
english: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary, and the duty of the altar; that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

paite: Ngai in, ke'n na unau Levite, Israel suante lak a pan ka telkhia a, kihoupihna biakbuk ah asem ding uh. TOUPA'N nang a hon thilthawnpiak ahi uh.
english: I, behold, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are a gift, given to Yahweh, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Nang leh na tapate'n maitam leh puanzak sunglam thu ah na siampu nasep uh na sem ding uh. Nang na sem dia; siampu nasep na sep ding in ka hon pia hi. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah thah ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil; and you shall serve: I give you the priesthood as a service of gift: and the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron ahoupih a, "Ngai in, Israelte thil siangthou teng lak a kei a dia vei thillat teng leng ka hon pia hi. Thaunilh na hih ziak leh na tapate tangtawn dan ding ahih ziak in huaite ka hon pia hi.
english: Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “I, behold, I have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel; to you have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

paite: Mei a dia keptuam, thillat siangthoupente nang a ahi ding uh. Athillat teng uh, tangbuang thillat hiam khelhna thillat hiam mohna thillat hiam tantuan thillat tengteng nang leh na tapate tantuan ahi uh.
english: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

paite: Mun siangthoupen ah na ne ding ua; pasal teng in ane ding ua, nou a ding in hiai thil siangthou ahi.
english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

paite: "Hiaite kei a tuam ahi; athilpiak uh tangbuang thillat, Israel suante vei thillat tengteng tan in. Nang, na tapate leh tanute a dia tangtawn a na tantuam ding ua ka hon piak ahi. Na inn a misiang tengteng in ane thei ding uh.
english: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

paite: Sathau hoihpen, grep hoihpen, buh hoihpen leh gah masapen TOUPA a dia apiak teng uh ka hon pia hi.
english: “All the best of the oil, and all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to Yahweh, to you have I given them.

paite: Alou ua gah min masapen TOUPA a dia ahon tawi uh nang a ahi dia; na inn a misiang teng in ane thei ding uh.
english: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to Yahweh, shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

paite: Israelte thillat tengteng nang a ahi ding.
english: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

paite: "TOUPA a dia apiak uh sul hong masapen peuhmah mihing leng gan leng nang a ahi ding. Himahleh tapa masapen zaw na tan ngeingei dia, gan siang lou nou suakkhe masapen leng na tat ding ahi.
english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to Yahweh, both of man and animal shall be yours: nevertheless you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

paite: "Kha khat ahih in tat dingte tatna man na sehdan bang in, mun siangthou a shekel hihdan bang a shekel nga a na tat ding ahi, shekel tuh gerah sawmnih ahi.
english: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, after the shekel of the sanctuary (the same is twenty gerahs).

paite: Himahleh bawng suakkhe masapen hiam, belam suakkhe masapen hiam, kel suakkhe masapen hiam, na tat ding ahi kei; asiangthou uhi. Asisan uh maitam ah na theh dia, TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in athaute mei a thillat in na hal ding ahi.
english: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Asa uh nang a ahi dia, vei thillat leh aliang taklam pang nang a ahih bang in.
english: Their flesh shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

paite: "Thil siangthou vei thillat, Israel suante'n TOUPA a dia alatte uh tangtawn a na tantuam ding un ka hon pia hi. TOUPA ma a nang, na tapate leh na tanute a dia tangtawn thukhun ahi," achi hi.
english: All the wave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer to Yahweh, have I given you, and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever: it is a covenant of salt forever before Yahweh to you and to your seed with you.”

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Agam uah goutan na nei kei dia, alak uah leng tantuan na nei sam kei ding. Israel suante lak a na tantuan leh na goutan, Keimah ka hi.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

paite: "Ngai in, anasep, puanin a asep man ding un, Israel gam a sawm-a-khat tengteng Levi suante kiang ah ka pia ahi.
english: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Tu a pan Israel suante'n kihoupihna biakbuk ahon naih het louh ding uh ahi; khelhna pua in asi kha ding uh.
english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.
