paite: Himahleh Levite'n bel kihoupihna biakbuk nasep asem ding ua; Israelte khelhna toh kisai mohpuakna ala ding uh. Hiai asuante tan a ding in dan thusehsa hi dia; Israel suante lak ah goutan anei kei ding uh.
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations; and among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

paite: Israel suante'n sawm-a-khat TOUPA a dia vei thillat alat uh Levite goutan ding in ka pia hi. Huaiziak in akiang uah, Israel suante lak ah goutan anei kei ding uh, ka na chita him ahi," achi hi.
english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to Yahweh, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance: therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levite houpih inla, akiang uah, na goutan ding ua Israel suante sawm- a-khat ka hon piak na lak chiang un, huai sawm-a-khat a pan sawm-a-khat TOUPA kiang ah vei thillat ding in na lan ding uh ahi.
english: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for Yahweh, a tithe of the tithe.

paite: Na vei thillat uh buhphual a buh leh uain tung masapen dia sim ahi ding.
english: Your wave offering shall be reckoned to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the winepress.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante lak a sawm-a-khat na lak tengteng uah leng TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan zui zel ding uhi; huai TOUPA vei thillat pen siampu Aaron na piak ding uh ahi.
english: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to Yahweh of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give Yahweh’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

paite: Na thillat tengteng lak ua ahoihpen, asiangthoupen TOUPA vei thillat ding in na lan ding uhi.
english: Out of all your gifts you shall offer every wave offering of Yahweh, of all its best, even the holy part of it out of it.’

paite: Huaiziak in akiang uah, ahoihpen na vei chiang un Levite buhphual a tung leh grep sukna a pan tung bang a sim ahi ding.
english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the winepress.

paite: Koi lai peuh ah leng na ne thei ding uh, nou leh na inkuanpihte un leng; kihoupihna biakbuk a na sep man uh ahi ngal a.
english: You shall eat it in every place, you and your households: for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Ahoihpen na vei uleh akhelh moh na po kei ding uh. Israel suante thil siangthou na hihthanghuai kei ding ua, na si kei ding uhi, chi in," achi hi.
english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best: and you shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Hiai TOUPA thupiak dan ahi. Israel suante bawngla san, dembei, gensiatbei, hakkol bulhsak ngei het louh na kiang a hon kai ding in hilh un.
english: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded: Speak to the children of Israel, that they bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no blemish, and which was never yoked.

paite: Siampu Eleazar na pe ding a, ama'n giahphual pua ah apikhe dia, ama ah mi khat in agou ding hi.
english: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her forth outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face:

paite: Siampu Eleazar in akhut in asisan ala dia, kihoupihna biakbuk ma ah asisan sagihvei atheh ding.
english: and Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

paite: Mi khat in huai bawngla amitmuh in ahal dia; avun, asa, asisan leh a-ek ahalmang ding hi.
english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

paite: Siampu in sidar sing, hissop leh khau san ala dia, abawngla hal uah apailut ding ahi.
english: and the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

paite: Siampu in apuansilhte sawp in, akisil dia, huai khit in giahphual ah ahoh dia, nitaklam tan in siampu siang lou ahi ding.
english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Ahal mi in apuansilhte sawp in, akisil dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

paite: Mi asiang khat in bawngla vu alakhawm dia, giahphual pua a mun siang a ngaih ah akoih dia, Israel suan mipi omkhawmte kisiansakna tui dia zat ding ahi. Hiai khelh siansakna ahi.
english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water for impurity: it is a sin offering.

paite: Bawngla vu lakhawm mi in apuansilhte asawp dia, nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding. Hiai Israel suante leh namdang akiang ua omte a ding in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi.
english: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening: and it shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

paite: "Kuapeuh siluang khoih peuhmah ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding.
english: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days:

paite: Amah ani thum ni in akisiangsak dia, ani sagih ni in asiang ding. Himahleh, ani thum ni a akisiansak keileh ani sagih ni in leng asiang kei ding hi.
english: the same shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

paite: Kuapeuh siluang khoihmi, akisiansak keileh TOUPA biakbuk ahihnin ahi. Huai mi Israel mite a pan satkhiak ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui atung a atheh louh ziak in asiang kei dia, atung ah asianlouhna a-om lai hi.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles the tabernacle of Yahweh; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet on him.

paite: "Puanin a mi asihleh hiai adan ding ahi. Puanin a lut peuhmah leh puanin sung a om peuhmahte ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding uh.
english: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

paite: Tui-um belsuan kihong, sit louh peuhmah siang lou ahi uh.
english: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

paite: Gamlak a namsau a thah hiam, misi luang hiam, mihing guh hiam, han hiam mi'n akhoihleh ni sagih sung siang lou ahi ding.
english: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

paite: "Asiangloute a tuam ding in khelh thoihna vu ala ding ua, bel ah tuikhuk tui toh asung ding uhi.
english: “For the unclean they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

paite: Misiang in, hissop ala dia, tui ah adiah dia, puanin tung, tui-um belsuan tengteng, huai a om mi tengteng, guh hiam, thah siluang hiam, misi luang hiam, han hiam khoih mite tung ah atheh ding.
english: and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, and on all the vessels, and on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave:

paite: Misiang in ani thum ni leh ani sagih ni in misiang lou atheh dia, ani sagih ni in ahihsiang dia; apuansilhte asawp dia, akisil dia, nitaklam in ahong siangta ding hi.
english: and the clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify him; and he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

paite: "Misiang lou kisiangsak lou in TOUPA mun siangthou ahihnit ziak in huai mi omkhawmte a pan satkhiak ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui a theh louh ahi a, siang lou ahi.
english: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahweh: the water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.

paite: Hiai amau a ding in tangtawn dan thuseh ding ahi. Kisiansakna tui a theh peuhmah in apuansilhte asawp dia; akisiansakna tui khoih peuhmah nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding.
english: It shall be a perpetual statute to them: and he who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

paite: Misiang lou in akhoih peuhmah siang lou ahi zel dia; huai khoihmi kuapeuh nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi ding," achi hi.
english: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupiha,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: “Israel suante’n a inkuan chiamtehna uh bang chiat in apawl uh hihdan bang in apuanin uh akai ding uhi. Kihoupihna puanin a pan bangtan hiam kihal in akai ding uhi.
english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses: at a distance from the Tent of Meeting shall they encamp around it.”

paite: "Nisuahna lam suahlam pang ah apawl uh tamdan dungzui zel a puanin kai dingte Judah pawlte ahi ding ua; Judah tate lak a vaihawmbmakai ding Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
english: Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

paite: Sim a om pawlte tamdan, singsagih sangli-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

paite: Amah zom a puanin kai dingte Issakar chi ahi ding a; Issakar tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Zuar tapa Nethaneel ahi.
english: Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and the prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

paite: Sim a om pawlte tamdan singnga sangli-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: Zebulun chite, Zebulun tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Helon tapa Eliab ahi.
english: The tribe of Zebulun: and the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangsagih-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

paite: Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in sim a om Judah inkuante nuaikhat singgiat sangguk-le-zali ahi uh. Amaute'n ma akai zel ding uhi.
english: All who were numbered of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

paite: "Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in asimlam pang ah Reubente pawl a-om ding ua; Reuben tate lak a vaihawm makai Shedeur tapa Elizur ahi.
english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli sangguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

paite: Azom a dingte Simeon chi ahi ding ua; Simeon tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Zurishaddai tapa Selumiel ahi.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangkua-le-zathum ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

paite: Huai khit in Gad chite ahi ding ua, Gad tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Reuel tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: “The tribe of Gad: and the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli sangnga zaguk-le-sawmnga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

paite: Reubente tamdan nuaikhat singnga sangkhat zali-le-sawmnga ahi uh; apawl uh dungzui in. Azom in amaute apawtkhe ding uhi.
english: “All who were numbered of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

paite: "Kihoupihna puanin ah akipankhe ding ua, Levite alai ah a-om ding ua, a-omna thu zil bang zel in apawlpawl in apai chiat ding uhi.
english: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

paite: "Apawl tamdan thu in atumlam pang ah Ephraimte a-om ding ua, Ephraim tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Ammihud tapa Elishama ahi.
english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

paite: Azom in Manasseh chi ahi ding a; Manasseh tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Pedazur tapa Gamaliel ahi.
english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singthum sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: Azom nawn in Benjamin chite, Benjamin tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Gideoni tapa Abidan ahi.
english: “The tribe of Benjamin: and the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singthum sangnga-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His army, and those who were numbered of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Ephraimte tamdan nuaikhat sanggiat-le-zakhat ahi. Azom nawn in apaikhe ding uhi.
english: “All who were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

paite: "Apawl uh tamdan bang zel in Dante amallam pang ah a-om ding ua; Dan tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Ammishaddai tapa Ahiezer ahi.
english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions: and the prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singguk leh sangnih leh zasagih ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Azom a puanin kai dingte Asher chi ahi ding a; Asher tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Okran tapa Pagiel ahi.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singli leh sangkhat leh zanga ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were forty-one thousand and five hundred.

paite: Azom nawn in Naphtali chite; Naphtali tate lak a vaihawm makai ding Enan tapa Ahira ahi,
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: and the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

paite: Sim a om, apawlte tamdan, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi uh.
english: His division, and those who were numbered of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

paite: Dante tamdan nuaikhat singnga sangsagih-le-zaguk ahi ua; amau apawlpawl a pawtkhia in ananungpen ahi ding uhi."
english: “All who were numbered of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

paite: Hiai Israel suante inkuan teng a mi asimte uh, tamdan ahi a, nuaiguk sangthum zanga-le-sawmnga apha uhi.
english: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were numbered of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

paite: Levite Israel suante lak a simtel ahi kei uh; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante'n ahih ua; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang zel in apawlpawl in puanin akai uhi. Huchi mah bang in achichi in a-inkuankuan zel un akipankhe zel uhi.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

paite: Huan Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng huai kha khatna in Zin gamdai alut ua; mipite'n Kadesh ah giahphual asat ua; huai ah Miriam asi a, huai ah avui uhi.
english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month: and the people stayed in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

paite: Omkhawmte a ding in tui a-om kei a; Mosi leh Aaron kalh in akikhawm uh.
english: There was no water for the congregation: and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

paite: Mite'n, "TOUPA ma a i unaute asih lai un Pathian in hon that geih maileh aw!
english: The people strove with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before Yahweh!

paite: Kou leh ka gante uh toh bangziak a TOUPA mipite si ding a gamdai a pilut na hia?
english: Why have you brought the assembly of Yahweh into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

paite: Bangziak in ahia hiai gam hoihloupi a hon pilut dia Aigupta gam a pan na hon pawtkhiaksak mahmah? Buh-le-balte, theipite, grepkungte, theibuhfaite omlouhna mun ahi, tui dawn ding mahmah leng a-om sam kei hi,” achi uhi.
english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi leh Aaron mipi a pan kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ahoh ua, abokkhup ua; TOUPA thupina akiang uah ahong kilang hi.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces: and the glory of Yahweh appeared to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,

"Chiang la inla, mipite omkhawmsak inla, nang leh na sanggampa Aaron toh, huai suangpi in amitmuh ua tui pawtsak ding in thu pia in. Suangpi a pan tui na lakkhiaksak dia, mipi omkhawmte leh agante uh na dawnsak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it give forth its water; and you shall bring forth to them water out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ma a pan chiang, athupiak bang in ala hi.
english: Moses took the rod from before Yahweh, as he commanded him.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron in mipite suangpi bul ah a-omkhawmsak ua, Mosi in akiang uah, "Nou mihelte aw, ngai un, hiai suangpi a pan tui ka hon lakkhiaksak ding ua hia?" achi uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels; shall we bring you water out of this rock for you?”

paite: Mosi in aban azak a, achiang in suangpi nihvei asat a; huchi in tui tamtak ahong pawt a, mipi omkhawmte leh agante un adawn uhi.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice: and water came forth abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their livestock.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "N'on gintak louh ua, Israel suante mitmuh a na hon pahtawi louh ziak un hiai omkhawmte ka piak gam ah na pilut kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

paite: Hiai Meribah tui ahi. Israel suante'n TOUPA akinakpih ua, amaute lak a amah pahtawi a a-om ziak in.
english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh, and he was sanctified in them.

paite: Mosi in Kadesh a pan Edom kumpipa kiang ah mi asawl a, "Na unaupa Israel in hichi in achi, ka tung ua thuakna hong tung tengteng na thei hi.
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Thus says your brother Israel: You know all the travail that has happened to us:

paite: Ka pipute uh Aigupta gam ah ahohsuk ua, sawtpi Aigupta gam a ka om uh, Aigupta mite'n kou leh ka pipute hoih loutak in ahon bawl uh.
english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians dealt ill with us, and our fathers:

paite: Huchi in TOUPA ka sam ua, ka aw uh ana za a, angel ahon sawl a, Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhia a, ngai in, na gam naihpen khua Kadesh ah ka om uhi.
english: and when we cried to Yahweh, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and brought us forth out of Egypt: and behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of your border.

paite: Hehpih in na gam ka tawn paisuak ding uh aw. Lou hiam, grephuan hiam ka tawn kei ding ua, tuileh tuite leng ka dawn kei ding uh. Kumpipa lamlian ah ka pai ding ua, na gam ka khen masiah uh taklam hiam, veilam hiam ah ka pial kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: “Please let us pass through your land: we will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go along the king’s highway; we will not turn aside to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

paite: Edom in akiang ah, "N'on palsuak ding ahi kei. N'on palleh hon dou ding in namsau toh ka hong kuan ding," achi hi.
english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

paite: Israel suante'n akiang ah, "Lamlian ah ka paitou ding ua; kou leh ka ganta un na tui ka dawn uleh aman ka hon pe ding uh. Thil dang bangmah hih lou in apai in ka paisuak mai ding uh," achi uhi.
english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink of your water, I and my livestock, then will I give its price: let me only, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

paite: Ama'n, "Paisuak lou ding," achi hi. Huchi in Edom mipi tampi leh mihat taktakte toh amau dou ding in ahong kuanta uhi.
english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

paite: Hiai bang in Edom in Israel mite agam a apaisuak uh aphal kei a, Israel mite'n akiksan nawnta uhi.
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

paite: Huchi in Kadesh a pan apawt ua; Israel suan mipi omkhawm tengteng Hor tang ahong tung uh.
english: They traveled from Kadesh: and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron, Edom gam naih Hor tang ah ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

paite: "Achipihte kiang ah Aaron pi ahita ding. Meribah tui a ka thu kalh a, ahel ziak in Israel suante ka piak gam ah alut kei ding.
english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

paite: Aaron leh atapa Eleazar Hor tang ah hon pitou in.
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

paite: Aaron puansilhte suahsak inla, atapa Eleazar silhsak in. Aaron achipihte kiang a pi ahi ding, huai ah asi ding," achi hi.
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be taken, and shall die there.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in ahih a; mipi omkhawm tengteng mitmuh in Hor tang ah apaitou uhi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded: and they went up into Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Aaron puansilh asuahsak a, Eleazar asilhsak hi. Aaron tang vum ah asita a, tang a pan Mosi leh Eleazar ahong paikhesuk uhi.
english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

paite: Mipi omkhawm tengteng in Aaron si ahi chih atheih un, Israel inkote'n ni sawmthum sung Aaron asuun uhi.
english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

paite: Huan Kanaan mi, kumpipa Arad simlam a om in, Atharim lampi ah Israel mite ahong pai uh chi a kigen ana za a; huchi in Israel mite ana dou a, galmat khenkhat anei hi.
english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard tell that Israel came by the way of Atharim; and he fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

paite: Israel mite'n TOUPA kiang ah thu achiam ua, "Ka khut ua hiai mite na hon piakleh akhuate uh ka hihmang ding uh," achi uh.
english: Israel vowed a vow to Yahweh, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

paite: TOUPA'N Israel mite thu apom a, akiang uah Kanaan mite apia a, amau leh akhuate ahihmang uhi. Huai mun min Hormah asa uhi.
english: Yahweh listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and the name of the place was called Hormah.

paite: Hor tang a pan Tuipi San lam ah Edom gam kualkhum in apai ua; alampi ziak in mipi alunglel mahmah uhi.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds , to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

paite: Mipite'n Pathian leh Mosi kalh in, "Gamdai a si dia bang ding a Aigupta a pan hon pikhia na hia? Tanghou lah om lou, tui lah om lou. Hiai tanghou kihhuai lah ka hinna un akih hi,” achi uh.
english: The people spoke against God, and against Moses, “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, and there is no water; and our soul loathes this light bread.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N mipi lak ah gul gukhahte asawl a, mite atu ua, Israel mite tampi asi uhi.
english: Yahweh sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and many people of Israel died.

paite: Huaiziak in mite Mosi kiang ah ahong pai ua, "TOUPA leh nang kalh a ka na pau uh ka khialta uh, i lak ua gulte lamang ding in TOUPA kiang ah thum dih ve," achi uhi. Huchi in mite a ding in Mosi athum hi.
english: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh, and against you. Pray to Yahweh, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Gul gukhah lim bawl inla, khuam lek ah khai in. Huan hichi ahi ding a, gultukmi peuhmah in huai a-et uleh adam ding uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Make a fiery serpent, and set it on a standard: and it shall happen, that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in dal gul abawl a, khuam lek ah akhai a; huan hichi ahong hi a, gultukmi peuhmah in huai dal gul a-et uleh adam uhi.
english: Moses made a serpent of brass, and set it on the standard: and it happened, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked to the serpent of brass, he lived.

paite: Israel suante apai zel ua, Oboth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

paite: Oboth a pan apai nawn ua, nisuahna lam Moab gamdai bul Ije-abarim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

paite: Huai a pan apai nawn ua, Zered Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

paite: Huai a pan apai nawn ua, Amorte gamgi a pan hong dawktuam gamdai a Arnon lehlam ah giahphual asat uhi. Arnon bel Moab gamgi, Moab leh Amorte kikal a om ahi.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness, that comes out of the border of the Amorites: for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA kidounate laibu ah, Tuipi San leh Arnon luitate a;
english: Therefore it is said in the book of the Wars of Yahweh, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

paite: Ar tenna a luangkhia luite leh Moab gamgi a omte ah athilhihte, achih.
english: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

paite: Huai a pan Beer ah apai nawn ua; huai bel TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a mipite samkhawm inla, tui ka pe ding, achihna tuileh ahi.
english: From there they traveled to Beer: that is the well of which Yahweh said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

paite: Huchi in Israelte'n hiai la asa uh. "Aw tuikhuk, hong kikhohkhia inla, athu la in sa un.
english: Then sang Israel this song: “Spring up, well; sing to it:

paite: Dan petu in akawkmuh bang a miliante uleh mipite heutute'n akhetbuk uh toh alaih uh tuikhuk," chi in. Huchi in gamdai a pan Mattanah tan;
english: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;

paite: Mattanah a pan Nahaliel ah; Nahaliel a pan Bamoth ah;
english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

paite: Bamoth a pan Moab lou a phaizang leh gamdai sunsuk Jeshimon lam nga Pisgah vum ah apai uhi.
english: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

paite: Israel mite'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon kiang ah mi asawl ua,
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

paite: "Na gam ah hon paisuaksak ve; lou ah hiam, grephuan ah hiam ka pial kei ding ua; tuileh tuite ka dawn kei ding uh. Na gam ka khen masiah uh Kumpipa Lamlian ah ka pai zel ding uh," chi in.
english: “Let me pass through your land: we will not turn aside into field, or into vineyard; we will not drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

paite: Himahleh Sihon in Israel mite agam a apaisuak uh aphal kei hi. Sihon in amite tengteng akaikhawm vek a, Israel mite dou ding in gamdai ah akisazawta hi. Jahaz ava tung ua; huai ah Israel mite adou uh.
english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz; and he fought against Israel.

paite: Israel mite'n namsau in amah athat ua, agam Arnon a pan Jabok tan in, Ammon suante tan in alazou uhi. Ammon suante gamgi kulh nei ahih ziak in agam chiang lel alazou uhi.
english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

paite: Israel mite'n huai khua tengteng ala ua; Israel mite'n Amorte khua tengteng aluah uhi. Heshbon leh akhopel tengteng ah leng ateng uhi.
english: Israel took all these cities: and Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its towns.

paite: Heshbon khua bel Amorte kumpipa Sihon khua ahi. Amah huai ma a Moab kumpipa asual a akhut a pan gam tengteng, Arnon tan alaksakpa ahi.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

paite: Huaiziak in paunak gente'n, "Heshbon ah hong pai in, kilam thak hen, Sihon khopi kilam thak hen, achi uhi.
english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

paite: Heshbon a pan mei ahong pawt a, Sihon khopi a pan meikuang. Moab a Ar akang khin a, Arnon a mun sang a toupate toh.
english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

paite: Aw, Moab, na tung agik hi. Na mangthangta, Aw Kemosh mi! Ama'n Amorte kumpipa Sihon kiang ah tapate galtaite bang in leh atanute saltangte bang in apia hi.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

paite: Himahleh amau ka kap ua, Dibon tan in Heshbon amangthangta. Huchi in Nophah tan in ka hihmang uh, huai in Medeba tan apha hi."
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

paite: Huchibang in, Amorte gam ah Israel mite ateng uhi,
english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

paite: Mosi in Jazer enkhe ding in mi asawl a, akhuate ala ua, huai a teng Amorte ahawlkhia uhi.
english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer; and they took its towns, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

paite: Akik nawn ua, Bashan lampi ah apaitou uh. Bashan kumpipa Og, amau dou ding in, amah leh amite tengteng, Edrei ah akisakhia uhi.
english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Amah lau ke'n. Amah, amite tengteng leh agam na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi. Heshbon a om Amorte kumpipa Sihon tung a na hih bang in na hih ding ahi,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Don’t fear him: for I have delivered him into your hand, and all his people, and his land; and you shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

paite: Huchi in amah leh tapate hawi himhim nei lou in amite tengteng toh athat ua; agam aluahsakta uhi.
english: So they struck him, and his sons and all his people, until there was none left him remaining: and they possessed his land.

paite: Huan Israel suante apai zel ua, Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Zippor tapa Balak in Israel mite'n Amorte abawldan tengteng uh ana thei hi.
english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

paite: Moabte'n mite alau mahmah ua, atam ngal ua. Israel suante ziak in Moabte alungkham uhi.
english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

paite: Moabte'n Midian upate kiang ah, "Hiai mipite'n bawng in loupa anekgaih bang in i kim ua mi tengteng anegai ding uh," achi uhi. Huai lai in Zippor tapa Balak Moab kumpipa ahi.
english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

paite: Huaiziak in Beor tapa Balaam, Pethor a om kiang ah mi asawl hi. Huai bel amite suante gam a lui kiang a om ahi. Amah ava sam ua, "Ngai in, Aigupta gam a pan hong paikhia mipi a-om ua; ngai in, leitung maikaih atuamdim ua, ka kiangchin ah a-om uhi.
english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out from Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

paite: Hehpih in hong pai inla, hiai mite hong hamsiat dih ve. Kei a ding in ahat lua ua, ka zoh theih ua ka gam a pan ka delhkhiak theih zenzen khak uleh. Na vualzawl peuhmah vualzawl in a-om a, na hamsiat peuhmah lah hamsiat in a-om, chih ka thei," ava chisak hi.
english: Please come now therefore curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

paite: Huchi in Moab upate leh Midian upate aisanna ding tawi in apawtkhia ua; Balaam kiang ava tung ua, Balak thukhah ahilh uhi.
english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Tuzan hiai ah giak unla, TOUPA'N hon hilh bangbang thu na kiang ua ka hon tun ding," achi hi. Huchi in Moab miliante Balaam kiang ah agiakta uhi.
english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahweh shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

paite: Balaam kiang ah Pathian ahong a, na kiang a mite kuate ahi ua? achi hi.
english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

paite: Balaam in Pathian kiang ah, "Zippor tapa Moab kumpipa Balak in ka kiang ah,
english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

paite: 'Ngai in, Aigupta gam a pan a hong pai mipite'n leitung maikaih aluahdim uh. Hong pai inla, hong hamsiat in, ka zoh theih a, ka delhkhiak theih khakleh,' " chi in mi ahon sawl hi, achi hi.
english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt, it covers the surface of the earth: now, come curse me them; perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

paite: Pathian in Balaam kiang ah, "Akiang ua na hoh ding ahi kei. Huai mite na hamsiat ding ahi kei; mihampha ahi uh," achi hi.
english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people; for they are blessed.”

paite: Zingsang in Balaam athou a, Balak miliante kiang ah, "Na gam uah pai nawnta un. TOUPA'N na kiang ua hoh dia ka pawt aphal kei,” achi hi.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for Yahweh refuses to permit me to go with you.”

paite: Huchi in Moab miliante athou ua, Balak kiang ah apai ua, "Balaam in ahon zui ut kei," achi uhi.
english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

paite: Balak in milian tamsem, asang ua zahtakhuaizaw asawl nawn hi.
english: Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honorable than they.

paite: Balaam kiang ava tung ua, akiang ah, "Zippor tapa Balak in hichi in achi, 'Ka kiang a na hong hoh ding bangmah in dal kei hen.
english: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me:

paite: Mithupitak in ka hon bawl dia, ka kiang a na gen peuhmah ka hih zel ding. Huaiziak in hong pai teitei inla, hiai mite hong hamsiatsak mahmah mai in,' " achi uhi.
english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

paite: Balaam in Balak mite adawng a, akiang uah, "Balak in a-inn dim dangka leh dangka-eng hon pe ding himahleh, abangmah TOUPA ka Pathian thu pel in ka hihthei kei.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh my God, to do less or more.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N ka kiang ah bangchi in ahia agen nawn ding, tuzan hiai lai ah giak peuhmah phot un," achi hi.
english: Now therefore, please wait also here this night, that I may know what Yahweh will speak to me more.”

paite: Zan in Balaam kiang ah Pathian ahong a, akiang ah, "Hiai mite nang hong sam a hong ahih uleh, thou inla, akiang uah hoh in. Himahleh na kiang a ka gen kia na hih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

paite: Huchi in zingsang in Balaam athou a, asabiltung tung ah tutphah aphah a, Moab miliante azuita hi.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

paite: Huchi in ahoh ziak in Pathian aheh mahmah a, amah na lamdal ding in lampi ah TOUPA angel ana dingh hi. Asabiltung tung a tuang ahi a, asikhate nih leng akiang ah a-om uhi.
english: God’s anger was kindled because he went; and the angel of Yahweh placed himself in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel, namsau tawi a lampi a dingh amu hi. Huchi in lampi a pan sabiltung apialkhia a, gamlak ah apai a, Balaam in lampi a kiksak tum in sabiltung asat hi.
english: The donkey saw the angel of Yahweh standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the way.

paite: Grephuan umna kikal kuak ah TOUPA angel adingh hi.
english: Then the angel of Yahweh stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel amu a, grephuan umna ava ngai a, dai umna toh Balaam khe anehden hi. Balaam in asabiltung asat nawn hi.
english: The donkey saw the angel of Yahweh, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he struck her again.

paite: Apam deuh ah TOUPA angel apai a, mun kochik laitak, taklam hiam, veilam hiam a leng pialna omlouhna laitak ah adingh hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

paite: Sabiltung in TOUPA angel amu a, Balaam akualpihta hi. Balaam aheh mahmah a, achiangkhun in sabiltung asat hi.
english: The donkey saw the angel of Yahweh, and she lay down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

paite: TOUPA'N sabiltung apausak a, Balaam kiang ah, "Bang ka hon chih a ahia? Thumveitak na hon huchi sat?" achi hi.
english: Yahweh opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

paite: Balaam in sabiltung kiang ah, "N'on simmoh ziak in ahi. Namsau tawi hi leng, ka hon that khin hialta ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

paite: Sabiltung in Balaam kiang ah, "Tutan a na tuanna gige na sabiltung ka hi kei a hia? Hichibang in ka hon hih ngei a hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hih ngei lou e,” achi hi.
english: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long to this day? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam mit avaksak a, TOUPA angel namsau tawi alampi a dingh amuta a; akun a, amai a lei si in abokkhup hi.
english: Then Yahweh opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Yahweh standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

paite: TOUPA angel in akiang ah, "Bang achia hichibang a na sabiltung thumvei sat na hia? Ngai in, na gamtatdan ka mitmuh a asiat ziak in hon na lamdal dia hong pawtkhia ka hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come forth as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me:

paite: Sabiltung in ahon mu a, ka ma a thumvei pial ahi. Pial keileh amah that lou a, nang hon that khin ding ka hi,” achi hi.
english: and the donkey saw me, and turned aside before me these three times. Unless she had turned aside from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

paite: Balaam in TOUPA angel kiang ah, "Ka na khialta hi. Hon na lamdal ding in lampi ah na dingh chih ka thei kei hi," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to the angel of Yahweh, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

paite: TOUPA angel in Balaam kiang ah, "Hiai mite kiang ah hoh inla; himahleh na kiang a ka thugen ding kia na gen ding ahi," achi hi. Huchi in Balaam in Balak miliante azuita hi.
english: The angel of Yahweh said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but only the word that I shall speak to you, that you shall speak.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

paite: Balak in Balaam ahong chih azak in Arnon lam a gamgi chiang ah Moab khopi pha in ava dawn a, huai tuh gamgi tawpna ahi.
english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Phatuamngaitak a nang hong sam dia mi ka hon sawl ahi kei maw? Bangziak a ka kiang a hong nuam lou na hia? Mithupitak in ka hon bawl thei ka hia?" achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send to you to call you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Ngai in, ka hong hi. Bangmah gentheihna mawngmawng ka nei a hia? Pathian in ka kam a thu akoih kia ka gen ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you: have I now any power at all to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that shall I speak.”

paite: Huchi in Balak kiang ah Balaam ahohta a, Kiriath-huzot ava tung uhi.
english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

paite: Balak in bawng leh belam alan a, khenkhat Balaam leh akiang a om miliante kiang ah akhak hi.
english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, azingsang in Balak in Balaam api a, Baal mun sangte ah ahohtouhpih a, huai a pan mite omna chiang amupha hi.
english: It happened in the morning, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there the utmost part of the people.

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Hiai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belampa sagih hon suktuahsak in," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bulls and seven rams.”

paite: Balak in Balaam gen bang in ahih a; Balak leh Balaam in maitam chin ah bawngtal khat leh belam khat alan uhi.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Na halmang thillat bul ah ana dingh gige inla, kei ka va paituam ding. Kei hon houpih ding in TOUPA ahong pai kha thei hi. Ama'n hon hilh peuhmah ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go: perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me; and whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

paite: Huchi in mual giau velvul ah ahohtou hi. Pathian in Balaam ana kituahpih hi. Balaam in akiang ah, "Maitam sagih ka bawl khin a; maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat ka lan chiat," achi hi.
english: God met Balaam: and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam kam ah thu akoih a, "Balak kiang ah kik nawn inla, va gensawn in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

paite: Huchi in akiang ah akik nawnta a; ngai in, ahalmang thillat bul ah amah leh Moab milian tengteng leng ana dingh lai uhi.
english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

paite: Ama'n thu agenta a, "Aram a pan Balak in ahon pi a, suahlam tang a Moab kumpipa'n, 'Hong inla, Jakobte hon hamsiatsak in, hong inla, Israelte hong dalsak in!' achi a.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

paite: Bangchi in Pathian hamsiat louh ka hamsiat dia? Bangchi in Pathian dal louh ka dal dia?
english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?

paite: Amau lah suangpi tung a pan ka mu ngal a, mualte a pan amau ka mu a, ngai in, mite atuam in ateng ding ua, namte lak a simtel louh ding ahi uh.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

paite: Jakobte leivui kua'n asim thei dia, Israelte mun li a khen, mun khat kua'n ahia sim thei ding? Midiktat sih in si sam ning, ka tawpna amah a bang hi hen!" achi hi.
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

paite: Balaam kiang ah Balak in, "N'on bawldan bangchidan ahia? Ka melmate hamsiat ding in ka hon pi a, na vualzawl zaw mawk ngal a!" achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

paite: Ama'n adawng a, "TOUPA'N ka kam a akoih ka gen ding mah hilou ding maw?" achi hi.
english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”

paite: Balak in akiang ah, "Mun dang ah hoh nawn dih ni e, huai a pan na thei vek ding. A-omna chiang uh na mu ding, avek un zaw na mu vek khol kei ding. Huai a pan hon hamsiatsak in," achi hi.
english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them; you shall see but the utmost part of them, and shall not see them all: and curse me them from there.”

paite: Huchi in Zophimte tenna Pisgah vum ah apitou a, maitam sagih adoh a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat alan hi.
english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

paite: Balak kiang ah, "Pam a TOUPA ka va houpih sung in na halmang thillat bul ah ana dingh lai in," achi hi.
english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet over there.”

paite: TOUPA'N Balaam ana kituahpih a, akam ah thu akoih a, "Balak kiang ah kik nawnta inla, akiang ah va gensawn in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

paite: Akiang ah ava hoh a, ngai in, ahalmang thillat bul ah ana dingh nilouh hi. Moab miliante leng akiang ah a-om uh. Balak in akiang ah, "TOUPA'N bang ana gen a?" achi hi.
english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”

paite: Ama'n thu agenta hi: "Thou inla, Balak, ngaikhia in. Zippor tapa, ka thu ngai in.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

paite: Pathian zaw Zuauhat mihing ahi kei. Kisik hat mihing tapa leng ahi sam kei. Agensa ahih kei dia hia? Ana gensa ahih piching kei dia hia?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor the son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?

paite: Ngai in, vualzawl ding in thupiak ka mu a, ama'n avualzawl khin a, ke'n ka hihlamdang thei kei.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

paite: Jakobte ah thulimlouhna amu kei a, Israelte ah phengphitna amu sam kei. TOUPA a Pathian uh akiang uah a-om a, alak uah kumpipa kikou husa a-om hi.
english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

paite: Aigupta a pan Pathian in apikhia a, gam bawngtal tha bang anei uhi.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

paite: Jakobte tung ah bumhaina a-om kei a; Israelte tung ah leng khimhaina a-om sam kei hi. Jakobte leh Israelte kiang ah Pathian thilhih hihlat ahi!
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What has God done!

paite: Ngai in, humpinelkai lian bang in mipite athou ua, humpinelkai dawng bang in adingtou ua; asamat uh anek ma un akual kei ding uh, amat uh sisan adawn ma un," achi hi.
english: Behold, the people rises up as a lioness, As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Hamsiat ke'nla, vualzawl leng vualzawl het ke'n," achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

paite: Himahleh Balaam in adawng a, Balak kiang ah, "TOUPA'N agen tengteng ka hih ngeingei ding ahi chi in ka hon hilh khin ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’”

paite: Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Hong dih, mun dang ah ka hon pi nawn dia, huai a pan na hon hamsiatsak Pathian in phal kha zenzen hiam," achi hi.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse me them from there.”

paite: Huchi in Jeshimon lam nga Peor vum ah Balak in Balaam apitouta hi.
english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Hiai ah maitam sagih hon bawlsak inla, bawngtal sagih leh belampa sagih hon suktuahsak in," achi hi.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bulls and seven rams.”

paite: Balak in Balaam gen bang in ahih a, maitam chih ah bawngtal khat leh belampa khat alan hi.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

paite: Israelte vualzawl ding TOUPA deihlam ahi chih Balaam in atheih in nidang a ahih bang in bumna zat tum lou in gamdai lam anga zawta hi.
english: When Balaam saw that it pleased Yahweh to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to meet with enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

paite: Balaam avandak a, Israel mite anam dungzui zel a om amu a; atung ah Pathian Kha ahong tung hi.
english: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

paite: Huchi in hiai thu agen a, "Beor tapa Balaam in agen a, amit a kichiantak a mupa'n agen hi.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eye was closed says;

paite: Pathian thute za a, Bangkim hihtheipa kilakna mu, akhup a puk a, amitte hong vakpa'n agen hi.
english: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

paite: Jakob aw, na puaninte hoih hi na e, Israel aw, na biakbukte uh!
english: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your tents, Israel!

paite: Phaizang bang in akiphah a, luidung a huante bang in, TOUPA suan tosaw bang in, luidung a sidar singte bang ahi uh.
english: As valleys they are spread forth, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which Yahweh has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

paite: Abaltinte a pan tui asungkhe dia, tui tampite ah ahaichi a-om dia, akumpipa Agag sang in asangzaw dia, alalgam tawisang in a-om ding hi.
english: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

paite: "Aigupta a pan Pathian in apikhia a, gam bawngtal hatna bang anei a, Amelma uh namdangte anegai dia, aguhte uh atansak dia, athaltangte in akap pailet ding hi.
english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall eat up the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

paite: Akun a, humpinelkai bang in akual a, humpinelkai bang mai in; kua'n atokthou dia? Hon vualzawl peuhmah vualzawl in om uhenla, hon hamsiat peuhmah hamsiat in om hen," achi hi.
english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

paite: Balaam tung ah Balak aheh mahmah a; akhutte nuaituah in Balak in Balaam kiang ah, "Ka melmate hamsiat ding in ka hon sam a, tu in, thumveitak amau na vualzawlta.
english: Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he struck his hands together; and Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

paite: Huaiziak in na mun ah taimang in. Thupitak a hon tawisang ding ka hon chih na hi a; himahleh, ngai in, TOUPA'N nang ka hon tawisang ding adal," achi hi.
english: Therefore now flee you to your place! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, Yahweh has kept you back from honor.”

paite: Balaam in Balak kiang ah, "Na misawlte kiang ah ka gen kei maw?
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers who you sent to me, saying,

paite: 'Balak in a-inn dangka leh dangka- eng a dim hon pe ding himahleh, ahoih lam hiam, aselam hiam TOUPA thu khen lam ah keimah lungsim a suak in bangmah ka hihthei kei. TOUPA'N agen peuhmah ka gen ding,' chi in.
english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of Yahweh, to do either good or bad of my own mind. I will say what Yahweh says’?

paite: "Ngai in, ka mite kiang ah ka paita ding. Huaiziak in hong hoh in, tunung a na mite tung a hiai mite'n ahih ding uh ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Now, behold, I go to my people: come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

paite: Hiai thu agen a, Beor tapa Balaam mitvaktak amu in agen hi.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eye was closed says;

paite: "Pathian thute za a, Tungnungpen theihna thei, Bangkim hihthei kilakna mu, akhup a puk a mit hong vakta in;
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, Falling down, and having his eyes open:

paite: Amah ka mu, himahleh tu in hilou in; Amah ka en a, naichik ah hilou in. Jakob a pan aksi khat ahong suakkhe dia, Israel a pan lalchiang ahong dingkhe dia, Moab gam nawlte adou dia, Seth tapate ahihse ding hi.
english: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and break down all the sons of Sheth.

paite: Amelma Edom leh Seirte lak zoh in a-om ding ua; Israel in hattak in ahih ding hi.
english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemies, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

paite: Jakob a pan ukmi khat ahong paikhe dia, khopi a omsunte ahihmang ding," achi hi.
english: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

paite: Amalek lam anga a, thu agen a, "Amalek bel namte bulpen ahi na a, adawn lam tangtawn a amanthatna ahi," achi hi.
english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, But his latter end shall come to destruction.”

paite: Kente lam anga a, thu agen a, "Na tenna mun akip a, suangpi ah na bu na sep hi.
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

paite: "Asshurte'n sal a hon pimang masiah, Kente hihmanthat in na om ding uh," achi hi.
english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

paite: Thu agen nawn a, "Pathian in hiai ahih, kua ahing zou dia?
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

paite: Himahleh Kittim gam a pan longte ahong tung ding ua, Asshur ahihgim dia, Eber ahihgim ding ua, Amah leng amangthang ding," achi hi.
english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

paite: Huchi in Balaam adingkhia a, akhua ah apaita. Huchi in Balak leng apai samta hi.
english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

paite: Huan Shittim a Israelte ataam sung un, pasalte'n Moab numeite akithuahpih uhi.
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab:

paite: Apathiante uh ma a kithoihnate ah achial ua; huchi in ane ua, apathiante ma ah akun uhi.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods; and the people ate, and bowed down to their gods.

paite: Israelte'n Peor Baal abe samta uhi. Huchi in Israelte tung ah TOUPA hehna akuangta hi.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor: and the anger of Yahweh was kindled against Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Mipite heutu tengteng pi inla, TOUPA hehna lauhuaitak mai Israelte tung a pan akikhinmang theihna ding in sun khovak ah amaute that in," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to Yahweh before the sun, that the fierce anger of Yahweh may turn away from Israel.”

paite: Mosi in Israelte vaihawmte kiang ah, "Peor Baal biakna a tel peuhmahte that vek un," achi hi.
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

paite: Ngai in, puanin kongkhak a mite kap a a-om laitak un, Mosi leh Israel omkhawmte mitmuh in Israel mi khat in Midian numei khat a-unaute kiang ah ahon pi hi.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in amuhtak in omkhawmte a pan athou a, teipi khat alata hi.
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the midst of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand;

paite: Israel mi apuanin sung ah adelhlut a, Israel mi toh anih un asun pailet a, numei pen agil ah asun pailet hi. Huchi in Israel suante tung a hipi adaita hi.
english: and he went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

paite: Himahleh huai hipi a site singnih-le-sangli ahi uh.
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar tapa Phinehas in alak ua kei a dia phatuam angaih ziak in Israel suante a pan ka hehna aheimang a, huchi in ka thikthusiat ziak in Israel suante ka hihmangthang kei hi.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, ka lemna thukhun amah ka pe ding hi.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace:

paite: Amah leh anung a asuante a ding in tangtawn siamputna thukhun ahi dia; a Pathian a dia phatuam ngai a Israel suante a dia kilemna abawlsak ziak in, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: and it shall be to him, and to his seed after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

paite: Midian numei toh athah uh Israel mi min Jimri ahi a, amah Simeonte lak a inkuan a vaihawm makai Salu tapa ahi.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

paite: Athah uh Midian numei min Kozbi ahi. Amah Zur tanu ahi a, Midiante inkuan lak a heutu ahi.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Midiante hihlungzing unla, that un.
Amau Peor tungtang thu leh a-unaunu uh Midiante heutu tanu Kozbi toh kisai a noute ahon khem lai un, melma bang a hon sai uh ahi. Peor ziak a hipi ahong tun in Kozbi thah a om ahi,” achi hi.
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, with which they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

paite: Huan hipi adaih nung in hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N Mosi leh siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar ahoupih a,
english: It happened after the plague, that Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

paite: "Israel suan omkhawm tengteng, kum sawmnih a pan atunglam, a-inkuan dungzui un Israel gam a galdou thei chiang teng sim vek un," achi hi.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go forth to war in Israel.”

paite: Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang ah amaute ahoupih a,
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Mipite kum sawmnih a pan atunglamte sim un," TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aigupta gam a pan Israel suante kiang a thu apiak bang in, achi uhi.
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward; as Yahweh commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those that came out of the land of Egypt.

paite: Israel ta upapen Reuben: Reuben tapate: Hanok suan Hanok inkote, Pallu suan Pallu inkote.
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

paite: Hezron suan Hezron inkote, Karmi suan Karmi inkote.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

paite: Hiaite Reubente inkuante ahi uh. Sim a om tengteng singli sangthum zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were numbered of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

paite: Pallu suan Eliab.
Eliab suante: Neumuel, Dathan leh Ahiram ahi uh. Hiai Dathan leh Abiram ahi ua, TOUPA ahehsak lai ua Mosi leh Aaron kalh a Korah pawl a tel omkhawmte.
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram, who were called of the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against Yahweh,

paite: Huai pawl asih lai un lei in akam aka a, Korahte toh avalhkhawm a; mei in mi zanih-le-sawmnga akattum lai in, huchi in chiamtehna ana hita uhi.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died; what time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

paite: Himahleh Korah tapate asi kei uh.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

paite: Simeon tapate inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a asuante uh: Nemuel suan Nemuel inkote, Jamin suan Jamin inkote, Jakin suan Jakin inkote,
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

paite: Zerah suan Zerah inkote, Shaul suan Shaul inkote ahi uh.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

paite: Hiaite Simeon suante ahi ua, singnih sangnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Gad tapate: Zephon suan Zephon inkote, Haggi suan Haggi inkote leh Shuni suan Shuni inkote,
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

paite: Ozni suan Ozni inkote, Eri suan Eri inkote;
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

paite: Arod suan Arod inkote leh Areli suan Areli inkote.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Gad tapate suante ahi ua, singli-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

paite: Judah tapate: Er leh Onan ahi a, huan Kanaan gam ah Er leh Onan asi uhi.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

paite: Judah suante inkuan paidan hichibang ahi: Shelah suan Shelah inkote,
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

paite: leh Perez suan Perez inkote: Zer suan Zer inkote, Hezron suan Hezron inkote; Hamul suan Hamul inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel un Judah tapate suante ahi ua, singsagih sangguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were numbered of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Issakar suante: Tola suan Tola inkote, Puah suan Puah inkote,
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

paite: Jashub suan Jashub inkote, Shimron suan Shimron inkote ahi uh.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Issakar tapate suante ahi ua, singguk sangli-le-zathum ahi.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were numbered of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Zebulun suante: Sered suan Sered inkote, Elon suan Elon inkote, Jahleel suan Jahleel inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel ua Zebulunte suante ahi ua, singguk-le-zanga ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were numbered of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan dungzui zel a Joseph suante: Manasseh leh Ephraim.
english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

paite: Manasseh suante: Makir suan Makir inkote; Makir in Gilead asuang a, Gilead suan Gilead inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

paite: Hiaite Gilead suante ahi ua: Iezer suan Iezer inkote, Helek suan Helek inkote,
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

paite: Asriel suan Asriel inkote, Shekem suan Shekem inkote,
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

paite: Shemida suan Shemida inkote; Hepher suan Hepher inkote ahi uh.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

paite: Hepher tapa Zelophehad in tapa nei lou in tanute anei a: Zelophehad tanute min Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi uh.
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Hiaite Manasseh suante ahi uh. Asim teng uh singnga sangnih-le-zasagih ahi.
english: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

paite: Hiai a-inkuan uh kizomdan dungzui zel a Ephraim suante ahi ua: Shuthelah suan Suthelah inkote, Beker suan Beker inkote, Tahan suan Tahan inkote ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

paite: Hiaite Shuthelah suante ahi ua: Eran suan Eran inkote ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

paite: Hiaite asimdan bang zel un Ephraim suante inkuan ahi ua, singthum sangnih-le-zanga ahi. Hiai a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Joseph suante ahi uh.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were numbered of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Benjamin suante: Bela suan Bela inkote, Ashbel suan Ashbel inkote, Ahiram suan Ahiram inkote,
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

paite: Shupham suan Shupham inkote, Hupham suan Hupham inkote ahi uh.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

paite: Bela suante Ard leh Naaman ahi uh: Ard suan Ard inkote, Naaman suan Naaman inkote ahi uh.
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel in Benjamin suante ahi uh. Asim teng uh singli sangnga-le-zaguk ahi.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi ua: Shuham suan Shuham inkote ahi uh. Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Dan suante ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

paite: Saham suante tengteng asimdan bang zel un singguk sangli-le-zali ahi.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were numbered of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Asher suante ahi ua: Jimna suan a pan Jimna inkote, Ishvi suan a pan Ishvi inkote; Beriah suan a pan Beriah inkote.
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

paite: Beriah suan Beriah inkote: Heber suan a pan Heber inkote; Malkiel suan a pan Malkiel inkote ahi uh.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

paite: Asher tanu min Serah ahi.
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

paite: Hiaite Asher tapate suan asim teng uh ahi ua, singnga sangthum-le-zali ahi.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were numbered of them, fifty-three thousand and four hundred.

paite: A-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante: Jahzeel suan a pan Jahzeel inkote; Guni suan a pan Guni inkote;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

paite: Jezer suan a pan Jezer inkote; Silem suan a pan Silem inkote ahi uh.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuan uh kizomdan bang zel a Naphtali suante ahi ua; asim teng uh singli sangnga-le-zali ahi.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

paite: Hiaite Israel suante asim teng uh ahi ua, nuaiguk sangkhat zasagih-le-sawmthum ahi.
english: These are those who were numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Hiaite amin zah zel ua gam hawmsak ding ahi.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

paite: Atam deuhte gam na pe tam dia, atawm deuhte gam na pe tawm deuh ding ahi. Asimdan bang in gam piak chiat ding ahi.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: to everyone according to those who were numbered of him shall his inheritance be given.

paite: Himahleh aisan a gam hawm ding ahi: Apute nam min kizomdan bang zel in gam atang ding uhi.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

paite: Aisan bang zel in atam leh atawmte kiang ah gam hawm ahi ding hi,” achi hi.
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

paite: Hiai Levite, a-inkuan kizomdan bang zel ua simte ahi uh: Gershon suan a pan Gershon inkote; Kohath suan a pan Kohath inkote; Merari suan a pan Merari inkote ahi uh.
english: These are those who were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

paite: Hiaite Levi suante ahi uh: Libni inkote, Hebron inkote, Mahli inkote, Mushi inkote, Korah inkote ahi uhi.
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

paite: Kohath in Amram asuang a, Amram zi min Jokebed, Levi tanu, Aigupta gam a Levi a pan a piang ahi a, ama'n Amram lak ah Aaron leh Mosi leh asanggamnu Miriam asuang hi.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt: and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

paite: Aaron in Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar asuang hi.
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

paite: Nadab leh Abihu in TOUPA zat louh chi meikuang azat lai un asi uhi.
english: Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before Yahweh.

paite: Sim tengteng pasal kha khat chiang tunglam teng singnih-le-sangthum ahi. Israel mite lak ah gam hawm tang ding ahih louh ziak un Israel mite lak ah sim ahi kei uh.
english: Those who were numbered of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

paite: Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang a Israel suante Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in asim uh hiaite ahi uh.
