english: These are those who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Himahleh hiaite lak ah Sinai gamdai a Israel mite Mosi leh siampu Aaron in asimte, khat lel leng a-omta kei hi.
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: TOUPA'N gamdai ah asi ngeingei ding uh, ana chi khinta ngal a. Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua lou ngal kuamah dam a-om kei uhi.
english: For Yahweh had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. There was not left a man of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: oseph tapa Manasseh suan a Manasseh tapa Makir, huai mi tapa Gilead, huai mi tapa Hepher tapa Jelophehad tanute ahong pai ua, atanute min, Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi uh.
english: Then drew near the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh miliante leh omkhawmte tengteng ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ava dingh uhi.
english: They stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

paite: "Gamdai ah ka pu uh asi a, TOUPA kalh a kikhawm, Korah pawl ah atel kei. Himahleh amah khelh ziak in asi a, tapa anei kei hi.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah: but he died in his own sin; and he had no sons.

paite: Tapa aneih louh ziak lel in bangziak a ka pa uh min, asuante a pan mang ding ahia? Ka pa unaute lak ah tantuan hon pia un," achi uhi.
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

paite: Mosi in athu uh TOUPA ma ah atun hi.
english: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Jelophehad tanute'n ahihdik uhi. Apa uh unaute lak ah tantuan na bawlsak ding ahi. Apa uh tantuan na piak ding ahi.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: you shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers; and you shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah mi tapa nei lou a asihleh agou atanute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

paite: Tanu aneih keileh agou a-unaute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

paite: "Sanggam pasalte aneih keileh agou apa sanggam pasalte na piak ding uh ahi.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

paite: Apa'n sanggam pasalte aneih keileh agou atanau na pe ding ua, ama'n aluah ding hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a Israel suante a ding in vaihawmna dan thuseh kip ahi ding, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be to the children of Israel a statute and ordinance, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Abarim tang ah hohtou inla, Israel suante ka piak ding gam va en in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

paite: Na muh khit chiang in na sanggampa Aaron achipihte kiang a pi ahih mah bang in nang leng pi na hita ding hi!
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

paite: Zin gamdai a omkhawmte aphun lai ua amitmuh ua tui a kei hon pahtawi dia ka hon thupiak kalh a na hel ziak in," achi hi. Huaite Zin gamdai a Kadesh a Meribah tuite ahi.
english: because you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ahoupih a,
"Omkhawm mipite tung a om ding mi khat, sa tengteng khate Pathian, TOUPA'N sep hen.
english: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

paite: TOUPA mi omkhawmte chingtu nei lou belam bang a a-omlouhna ding un, ama uh kai ding, amaute pikhia a, pilut ding in," achi hi.
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in; that the congregation of Yahweh not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Huai Kha omnapa Nun tapa Joshua pi inla, atung ah na khut nga in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him;

paite: Siampu Eleazar leh omkhawm mipite ma ah dingsak inla, amitmuh un amah nna guan in.
english: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

paite: Israel suante mipi omkhawm tengteng in athu aman theihna ding un atung ah na zahtakhuaina nga in.
english: You shall put of your honor on him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

paite: Huchi in amah siampu Eleazar ma ah adingh dia, ama'n TOUPA ma ah Urim thu alaksak dia; athu in apawt ding ua, athu in alut ding uh; amah leh Israel suan tengteng, omkhawmte toh," achi hi.
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in ahih a, Joshua api a, Eleazar leh omkhawmte ma ah adingsak hi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

paite: Huchi in atung ah akhut anga a, Mosi zang a TOUPA'N agen bang in nna aguanta hi.
english: and he laid his hands on him, and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante thu pia inla, akiang uah, kei a dia gimlim mei a thillat, ka kiang a thillat pen ahun geih in na lan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘My offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to me, you shall observe to offer to me in their due season.’

paite: Akiang uah, hiai mei a thillat TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi. Belamnoupa, kum khat a upa, gensiatbei, niteng in nih, halmang thillat alat gige ding ahi.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to Yahweh: male lambs a year old without blemish, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

paite: Belamnou khat zingsang in na lan ding ua, nitaklam in khat na lan ding uh.
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening;

paite: Tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat sathau suk, hin mun li a khen mun khat a hel toh.
english: with the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

paite: TOUPA a dia mei a thillat, gimlim dia Sinai Tang a sehsa halmang thillat lat gige ding ahi.
english: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Belamnou khat latna a dawn thillat, hin mun li a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi. TOUPA a dia uain, dawn thillat mun siangthou ah na sungkhe ding ahi.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for the one lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to Yahweh in the holy place.

paite: Belamnou khat nitaklam in na lan dia: zingsang lam a tangbuang thillat bang in leh dawn thillat bang in TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mei a thillat na lan ding ahi.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening: as the meal offering of the morning, and as the drink offering of it, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.

paite: Sabbath ni in belamnoupa kum khat a upa, gensiatbei nih leh tangbuang thillat a ding in tangbuang nelte ephah mun sawm a khen mun nih sathau a helkhawm leh dawn thillat toh na lat ding ahi.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day two male lambs a year old without blemish, and two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, and the drink offering of it:

paite: Hiai Sabbath niteng a halmang thillat lat gige leh dawn thillat sim louh a halmang thillat lat ding ahi.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Na kha thak teng un TOUPA a dia halmang thil na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Bawngtal chih ah tangbuang thillat ding in tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm ephah mun sawm a khen mun thum; belam khat a tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and three tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;

paite: Belamnou chih ah tangbuang thillat ah tangbuang nelte, sathau a helkhawm mun sawm a khen mun khat. Hiai halmang thillat gimlim TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: and a tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb; for a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Adawn thillat uh bawngtal khat ah uain hin kimkhat ahi dia, belampa khat ah hin mun thum a khen mun khat, belamnou khat ah hin mun li a khen mun khat. Hiai kumtawn a kha teng a halmang thillat ahi.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, and the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

paite: TOUPA kiang a khelh thoihna dia kelpa khat na lat ding uh ahi; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: One male goat for a sin offering to Yahweh; it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni TOUPA Paikan ahi.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is Yahweh’s Passover.

paite: Huai kha ani sawm-le-nga ni ankuanglui ni ahi dia; ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh nek ding ahi.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

paite: Ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou a-om dia; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation: you shall do no servile work;

paite: Mei a thillat bel TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to Yahweh: two young bulls, and one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without blemish;

paite: Tangbuang nelte, sathau helkhawm, atangbuang thillat uh toh, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: you shall offer three tenth parts for a bull, and two tenth parts for the ram.

paite: Belamnou sagih bel belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat ahi ding ahi.
english: You shall offer a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

paite: Hiaite zingsang a halmang thillat dawn thillat sim louh a lat gige ding ahi.
english: You shall offer these besides the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

paite: Hichibang in TOUPA a dia gimlim, mei a thillat nek ding niteng in, ni sagih sung na lan ding uh ahi; halmang thillat lat gige leh dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: it shall be offered besides the continual burnt offering, and the drink offering of it.

paite: Ani sagih ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua, nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation: you shall do no servile work.

paite: Na Nipikal Ankuangluina, na buh thak tung ankuangluina TOUPA a dia thil thak tangbuang thillat na lat ni un leng khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to Yahweh in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi; ganhopn a pan bawngtal nih, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for each bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,

paite: Belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih, belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding kelpa khat toh.
english: one male goat, to make atonement for you.

paite: Haltum thillat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, huaite dawn thillat toh na lat ding uh ahi, na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahi ding ahi.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, you shall offer them (they shall be to you without blemish), and their drink offerings.

paite: "Huan akha sagihna, ani khat ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei; nou a ding in pengkul mut ni ahi ding ahi.
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat na lan ding uh ahi: Ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the ram,

paite: belamnou sagih, khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: and one tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs;

paite: Nou a dia kilemna bawlna ding in khelh thoihna kelpa khat toh.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

paite: Kha thak halmang thillat leh huai tangbuang thillatte, halmang thillat lat gige leh huai a tangbuang thillat, dawn thillat, ahihdan ngeina uh TOUPA a dia gimlim ding a mei a thillatte sim louh in.
english: besides the burnt offering of the new moon, and the meal offering of it, and the continual burnt offering and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: "Hiai akha sagihna, ani sawm ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding uh. Na hinna uh zangsak in nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; and you shall afflict your souls: you shall do no kind of work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat na lan ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtal khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sagih; na ngaihtuah ua gensiatbei ahih ding ahi.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to Yahweh for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old; they shall be to you without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh, tangbuang nelte sathau a helkhawm, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for the bull, two tenth parts for the one ram,

paite: Belamnou sagih, belamnou khat chiat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: a tenth part for every lamb of the seven lambs:

paite: Khelh thoihna ding in kelpa khat toh; kilemna dia khelh thoihna, halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat uh sim louh in.
english: one male goat for a sin offering; besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings.

paite: "Akha sagihna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in khawmpi siangthou na nei ding ua; bang nna mahmah na sem ding uh ahi kei, TOUPA a ding in ni sagih sung ankuang na lui ding uh ahi.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no servile work, and you shall keep a feast to Yahweh seven days:

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in mei a thillat, halmang thillat na lat ding uh ahi. Ganhon a pan bawngtaltuai sawm-le-thum, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawm-le-li, huaite gensiatbei chiat ahih ding uh ahi:
english: and you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old; they shall be without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh sathau toh helkhawm bawngtal sawm-le-thum, bawngtal khat ah mun sawm a khen mun thum, belampa nih, belampa khat ah mun sawm a khen mun nih.
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenth parts for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth parts for each ram of the two rams,

paite: Belamnou sawm-le-li, belamnou khat ah mun sawm a khen mun khat.
english: and a tenth part for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani nih ni in bawngtaltuai sawm-le-nih, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li na lat ding uh ahi.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat a dan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat gige, huai atangbuang thillat, dawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and their drink offerings.

paite: "Ani thum ni in bawngtal sawm-le-khat, belampa nih, belamnou kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the third day eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai atangbuang thillat leh huai adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani li ni in bawngtal sawm, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani nga ni in bawngtal kua, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the fifth day nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh dawn thillat uh, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: Khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn ding thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani guk ni in bawngtal giat, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the sixth day eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un bawngtal a ding;
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offerings of it.

paite: "Ani sagih ni in bawngtal sagih, belampa nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sawm-le-li.
english: “‘On the seventh day seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding,
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige, huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; besides the continual burnt offering, the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Ani giat ni in khawmpi siangthoutak na nei ding ua; nna himhim na sem ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly: you shall do no servile work;

paite: TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in halmang thillat bel na lat ding uh ahi. Bawngtal khat, belampa khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa gensiatbei sagih.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without blemish;

paite: "Atangbuang thillat uh leh adawn thillat uh, bawngtal a ding, belampa a ding leh belamnou a ding, adan bangtak in atamdan bang zel un,
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance:

paite: khelh thoihna ding kelpa khat toh; halmang thillat lat gige leh huai atangbuang thillat leh adawn ding thillat sim louh in.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, and the meal offering of it, and the drink offering of it.

paite: "Na thuchiamte uh, ut thu a thillatte, na halmang thillatte uh, na tangbuang thillatte uh, na dawn thillatte uh, na kilemna thillatte uh sim louh in hiaite ankuangluina hunbi nei a na neihte uh ni in TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uhi, chi in,” achi hi.
english: “‘You shall offer these to Yahweh in your set feasts, besides your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meal offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng Mosi in Israel suante ahilh hi.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: TOUPA'N Sinai Tang a Mosi ahouph la a Aaron leh Mosi suan hiaite ahi uh.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

paite: Aaron tapate min, a-upapen Nadab, huan Abihu, Eleazar leh Ithamar ahi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

paite: Hiaite siampu dia thaunilh, siampu nasem ding a sehtuam, Aaron tapate min ahi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

paite: Nadab leh Abihu ahihleh Sinai gamdai a mei zat louh ding achih, TOUPA ma a alat lai un TOUPA ma ah asita ua, ta anei kei uhi. Eleazar leh Ithamar in apa uh Aaron dam lai in siampu nna asem uhi.
english: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh, when they offered strange fire before Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levi chite, siampu Aaron kiang ah pi inla, nna aseptheihna ding un akiang ah omsak in.
english: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

paite: Amau biakbuk a nasem in kihoupihna biakbuk chin ah amah leh omkhawm mipi tengteng a ding in nna asem ding uhi.
english: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin van tengteng akem ding ua, Israel suante a ding in biakbuk ah asem ding uh.
english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

paite: Levite Aaron leh atapate kiang ah na pe ding a; Israel suante lak a kipan amah kiang a piak ahi uhi.
english: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

paite: Aaron leh atapate na sep ding a, asiampu hihna nna asem nilouh ding uh. Midang hong kigolh a-omleh hihlup ding ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Ngai in, Levite Israel suante lak a pan Israel suante tachil sul hong masapen sik-le-tang a keimah ngei in ka lak ahi uh. Huaiziak in Levite kei a ahi ding uhi.
english: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:

paite: Piang masa ta tengteng kei a ahi. Aigupta gam a piang masa tengteng ka thah ni in Israelte lak a piang masa tengteng, amihing leh ganta tan in kei a tuam ding a ka kham ahi. Kei a ahi ding uh. Kei, TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
english: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”

paite: Sinai gamdai ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

paite: "Levi tate a-inkuankuan un, akhang-akhang un sim inla; pasal peuhmah kha khat a pan atunglam teng na sim ding ahi," achi hi.
english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

paite: Mosi in ahih ding a thupiak bang in TOUPA thu bang in asim chiatta hi.
english: Moses numbered them according to the word of Yahweh, as he was commanded.

paite: Levi tapate min: Gershon, Kohath leh Merari ahi.
english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

paite: Amaute suangpa Gershon tapate min Libni leh Shimei ahi.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

paite: Amaute suangpa Kohath tapate min Amram, Izhar, Hebron leh Uzziel ahi.
english: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

paite: Amaute suangpa Merari tapate min Mahli leh Mushi ahi. Hiaite a-inkuan uh dungzui zel a Levi suante ahi uh.
english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

paite: Gershon, Libnite leh Simeite suangpa ahi a, hiaite Gershonte suante ahi uhi,
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

paite: Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimte uh sangsagih-le-zanga ahi uhi.
english: Those who were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those who were numbered of them were seven thousand five hundred.

paite: Gershonte suante'n apuanin uh biakbuk tumlam pang ah akai ding uhi.
english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

paite: Gershonte inkuan a vaihawm makai Lael tapa Eliasaph ahi.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

paite: Gershon tapate'n kihoupihna biakbuk a asep ding uh ahihleh biakbuk leh puanin, atung, kihoupihna biakbuk leh akongkhak puanzak kep ahi ding a;
english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

paite: a-intual puanzakte, biakbuk chin a, a-intual kongkhak puanzak leh maitam kim a zat ding khau tengteng toh leng ahi lai ding hi.
english: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

paite: Kohath bel Amramte, Izharte, Hebronte leh Uzzielte suangpa ahi a; hiai teng Kohath suante ahi uhi.
english: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

paite: Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimdan bang zel un sanggiat-le-zaguk ahi ua, mun siangthou akem ding uhi.
english: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

paite: Kohath tapate suante'n biakbuk simlam pang ah apuanin akai ding uhi.
english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

paite: Kohathte suante inkuan a vaihawm makai ding Uzziel tapa Eliazaphan ahi.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

paite: Akep dingte: bawm, dohkan, sathau, khawnvak koihna, maitam, mun siangthou a nasepna tui-um belsuan tengteng, puanzak leh huai a nasepna thil tengteng ahi.
english: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the screen, and all its service.

paite: Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar, Levi makaite vaihawm makai ahi ding a, mun siangthou kem mite amakaih ding hi.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

paite: Merari, Mahlite leh Mushite suangpa ahi. Hiai Merari suante ahi uh.
english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

paite: Pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam asimdan bang zel un sangguk-le-zanih ahi uh.
english: Those who were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

paite: Merari suante inkuan a vaihawm makai Abihail tapa Zuriel ahi a; biakbuk mallam pang ah apuanin akai ding uhi.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

paite: Merari tapate kep ding a sehte biakbuk khuam lepkhawm, baangkal, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuak, avanzat tengteng leh nasepna vanzat tengteng ahi uh.
english: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

paite: Akongpi umna khuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, akilhbelhna leh akhaute toh leng ahi lai ding hi.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

paite: Biakbuk suahlam pang kihoupihna biakbuk chin a, nisuahna lam a puanin kai ding ahihleh Mosi leh Aaron leh atapa ahi ding ua, mun siangthou ah Israel suante a tuam ding in akul peuhpeuh asem ding uh. Namdang hong kigolh peuhmah thah ding ahi.
english: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

paite: TOUPA thupiak a Levite a-inkuankuan ua pasal tengteng kha khat a pan atunglam Mosi leh Aaron in asim teng uh singnih-le-sangnih ahi uh.
english: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Israel suante lak a piang masa, pasal kha khat a pan atunglam teng sim inla, azah uh thei in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Number all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

paite: Israel suante lak a piang masa teng sik in kei a ding in Levite na hon laksak dia, Israel suante gan tengteng apiang masapen sik in Levite gante, na hon laksak ding ahi, kei TOUPA ka hi," achi hi.
english: You shall take the Levites for me (I am Yahweh) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Israel suante lak a piang masa teng asim hi.
english: Moses numbered, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

paite: Amin uh kizom bang zel in kha khat a pan atunglam piang masa pasal teng asim a, singnih sangnih zanih sawmsagih-le-thum ahi uh.
english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those who were numbered of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante lak a piang masa teng sik in Levite la inla, agan uh sik in Levite gan; Levite kei a ahi ding ua; kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.

paite: Levite sang a tamzawte lak ah tat ding in Israel suante piang masa zanih sawmsagih-le-thum la in.
english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, who exceed the number of the Levites,

paite: Shekel nga chiat na la ding ahi; mun siangthou a shekel bang in na la ding, shekel bel gerah sawmnih ahi:
english: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; after the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):

paite: Atatna sum val Aaron leh atapate na piak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

paite: Levite tatte ban ah atatna sum uh Mosi in ala hi.
english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

paite: Israel suante piang masate lak a pan sum ala a; sum siangthou shekel bang in sangkhat zathum sawmguk-le-nga ala hi.
english: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak, TOUPA thu bang in Mosi in tatna sum Aaron leh atapate apia hi.
english: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan Mosi in Israel suan Intekpente ahoupih a, "TOUPA'N thu apiak pentak hiai ahi.
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.

paite: Mi'n TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a ahihkeileh athuchiam a kihenleh athuchiam abohse ding ahi kei. Akam a pawt bangbang ahih ding ahi.
english: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

paite: "Numei in leng anungak lai a, apa inn a a-om lai a, TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a, athuchiam a akihen a;
english: “Also when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh, and binds herself by a bond, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

paite: athuchiam leh athuchiam a akihenna apa'n azak a, apa'n adaihsan maimahleh athuchiam tengteng apaisuak ding ahi. Athuchiam a akihenna a-om gige ding ahi.
english: and her father hears her vow, and her bond with which she has bound her soul, and her father holds his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apa'n azak ni a aphal keileh athuchiam a akihenna thuchiamte akoi mahmah apaisuak kei ding. Apa'n aphal louh ziak in TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding hi.
english: But if her father disallow her in the day that he hears, none of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul, shall stand: and Yahweh will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

paite: "Thuchiam min thu khual lou a, ahenna a-om lai a pasal aneih a;
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul,

paite: apasal in azak a, azak ni a, adaih dideleh athuchiam a-om gige dia, thuchiam a ahenna leng a-om gige ding.
english: and her husband hears it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a aphal keileh atung a thuchiam leh khual lou a akihenna amang dia, TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding.
english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he shall make void her vow which is on her, and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul: and Yahweh will forgive her.

paite: "Himahleh meithai hiam, mak a omnu hiam thuchiam zaw, ahenna tengteng in adelh gige ding.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul, shall stand against her.

paite: "Inn a thu achiam a, kichiam a akihenleh,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

paite: apasal in azak a leng adaih dide a, aphal louh keileh athuchiam a-om gige dia, kichiam a akihenna leng a-om gige ding hi.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and didn’t disallow her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a bangmah lou a bawl a, ahihmangleh athuchiam hiam, kichiam a akihenna a kam a thupawt peuhmah a-om nawn kei ding. Apasal in ahihmang khinta ahi. TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband has made them void; and Yahweh will forgive her.

paite: Thuchiam tengteng leh hinna hihgim dia hen akichiamna tengteng apasal in akipsak thei in ahihmang thei hi.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a pan adeihdan leh athuchiam tengteng leh atung ahenna om tengteng kipsak ahi a; azak ni a pan adaihsan ziak in akipsak ahi.
english: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows, or all her bonds, which are on her: he has established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

paite: Himahleh azak khit nung a bangmah lou a bawl a, ahihmanleh athulimlouhna moh apuak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: But if he shall make them null and void after that he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

paite: Hiaite pasal leh azi kal leh apa inn a a-om gige lai a, akikal ua dan ding a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiakte ahi uh.
english: These are the statutes, which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Midiante tung ah Israel suante phu la in. Huai khit chiang in na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding," achi hi.
english: “Avenge the children of Israel for the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

paite: Mosi in mipite ahoupih a, "Midiante tung a TOUPA phulakna tangtun dia Midiante dou ding in na lak ua mi kigalthuam uhen.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for the war, that they may go against Midian, to execute Yahweh’s vengeance on Midian.

paite: Israel nam tengteng lak a nam chih a mi sangkhat zel kidouna a na kuan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: Of every tribe one thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, you shall send to the war.”

paite: Huchi in Israelte sang tamtak lak a pan, nam chih a pan sangkhat chiat, kidouna a kuan ding in sepaih singkhat-le-sangnih apekhia uhi.
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

paite: Huchi in Mosi in chi chih lak a mi sangkhat chiat leh siampu Eleazar tapa Phinehas mun siangthou a tui-um belsuante, thupiakna dia pengkulte tawi in kidouna ah akuansak hi.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Midiante adou ua; pasal teng athat uhi.
english: They warred against Midian, as Yahweh commanded Moses; and they killed every male.

paite: Amithahte lak ah Midiante kumpipate leng atel uh. Huai Midiante kumpipa ngate Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur leh Reba ahi a, Beor tapa Balaam leng namsau in athat uhi.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they killed with the sword.

paite: Israel suante'n Midiante numei teng leh atate uh sal in api ua; aganta tengteng uh, abelamhon tengteng uh leh avan tengteng uh gallak in ala uhi.
english: The children of Israel took captive the women of Midian and their little ones; and all their livestock, and all their flocks, and all their goods, they took for a prey.

paite: A-omna khuate leh agiahna tengteng uh ahal vek uhi.
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burnt with fire.

paite: Gallak tengteng, mihing leh gan tan in apaipih vek uhi.
english: They took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of man and of animal.

paite: Salte, matte leh gallakte, Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh Israel suan omkhawmte kiang, Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab Phaizang a agiahphual uh ahon tun uhi.
english: They brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawmte intek penpente'n giahphual pua ah ana dawn uhi.
english: Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them outside of the camp.

paite: Sepaih heutu, sangkhatte tung a heutute leh zakhatte tung a heutute, kidouna a pan hong tungte tung ah Mosi aheh hi.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Numei tengteng na hinghawi vek uh maw?
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

paite: Ngai un, Balaam lemtheih a Peor tungtang thu ah Israelte TOUPA tung a taleksak mite hiaite ahi uh. TOUPA mi omkhawmte lak ah hipi ahong leng hi.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against Yahweh in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in naupangte lak a pasal tengteng that unla, pasal kithuahpihsa numei teng leng that un.
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

paite: Numei naupang pasal kithuahpih nai louh tengteng nou a ding in hinghawi un.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

paite: Giahphual pua ah ni sagih sung giak unla; kuapeuh mi that leh thah a om misi khoih peuhmah ani thum ni leh ani sagih ni in kisiangsak un; noumau leh na salte uh leng.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp seven days: whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

paite: Van himhim leh savun a thilbawl tengteng, kel mul a thilbawl tengteng, sing a thilbawl tengteng thu ah na kisiangsak ding uh," achi hi.
english: As to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood, you shall purify yourselves.”

paite: Siampu Eleazar in kidouna a hoh kidou mite kiang ah, "Hiai TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak, dan thuseh ahi.
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded Moses:

paite: Bangpeuh dangka-eng, dangkasik, dal, sik, langva leh ngen,
english: however the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

paite: mei a hal a se thei lou teng mei ah na tholh paisuak ding ua, huchi in ahong siangthou ding uh. Bangpeuh, silsianna tui a hihsiangthou ding ahi. Mei a hal thuak thei lou peuhmah tui a na tholh paisuak ding uh ahi.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity: and all that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

paite: Ani sagih ni in na puan uh na sawp ding ua, na hong siang ding uh. Huai khit in giahphual ah na hong lut ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean; and afterward you shall come into the camp.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Nang, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawmte inkuan lupente'n gallak a, alak uh mihing leh gante sim vek un.
english: “Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

paite: Gallak mun nih ah khen un; kidouna a kuan kidou mite a ding leh omkhawmte a ding in.
english: and divide the prey into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

paite: Kidouna a kuan galdoumi a pan TOUPA a dia siah piak ding in mihing zanga zel ah khat, mihing a pan, bawng a pan, sabiltung a pan leh belamhon a pan sepkhia un.
english: Levy a tribute to Yahweh of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

paite: Huaite a tan kimkhat ua pan la unla, TOUPA a dia vei thillat ding in siampu Eleazar pia un.
english: Take it of their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for Yahweh’s wave offering.

paite: Israel suante tan sawmnga a pan khat, mihing a pan, bawng a pan, sabiltung a pan, belamhon a pan leh ganhon a pan sepkhia inla, huaite TOUPA biakbuk kemmi Levite pia in," achi hi.
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the tabernacle of Yahweh.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in ahih uhi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Sepaihte'n amat uh gallak sim louh alak uh belam nuaiguk singsagih-le-sangnga,
english: Now the prey, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,

paite: Bawng singsagih-le-sangnga,
english: and seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

paite: sabiltung singguk-le-sangkhat,
pasal kithuahpih nai louh numei singthum-le-sangnih ahi uh.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

paite: Akimkhat, kidouna a kuante tantuan, belam nuaithum singthum sangsagih-le-zanga ahi,
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep:

paite: TOUPA siah belam zaguk sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
english: and Yahweh’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

paite: Bawng singthum-le-sangguk ahi a; huai a TOURA siah sawmguk-le-khat ahi.
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand; of which Yahweh’s tribute was seventy-two.

paite: Sabiltung singthum-le-zanga ahi; huai a TOUPA siah sawmguk-le-khat ahi.
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred; of which Yahweh’s tribute was sixty-one.

paite: Mihing singkhat-le-sangguk ahi ua; huai a TOUPA siah mi sawmthum-le-nih ahi.
english: The persons were sixteen thousand; of whom Yahweh’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in siah, TOUPA vei thillat Mosi in siampu Eleazar apia hi.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was Yahweh’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Mosi in galdou mite a pan ahawm Israel mite tantuan kimkhat galdou a kuante lak ah ahawm hi.
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who warred

paite: Omkhawmte' tantuan kimkhat belam nuaithum singthum sangsagih-le-zanga,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,

paite: Bawng singthum-le-sangguk,
english: and thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

paite: Sabiltung singthum-le-zanga,
english: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

paite: Mihing singkhat-le-sangguk ahi.
Israel tantuan kimkhat a pan Mosi in mihing leh gan sawmnga zel ah khat ala a, TOUPA thupiak bang in TOUPA biakbuk kemmi Levite apia hi.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the tabernacle of Yahweh; as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Sepaihte tung a heutu, sang-khatte tung a heutute, zakhatte tung a heutute'n Mosi ava naih uhi.
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses;

paite: Mosi kiang ah, "Na sikhate'n ka khut ua om kidou mite ka sim ua, kuamah kim lou ka om kei uhi.
english: and they said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

paite: Ka hinna ua dia TOUPA ma a kilemna bawlna dia TOUPA a dia thillat mi'n aneih lam uh, dangka-eng a bawl zephoih van, khengawng a bulhte, khutngawng a bulhte, minsawnna zungbuhte, bilbahte, khite ka hon tawi uh," achi uhi.
english: We have brought Yahweh’s offering, what every man has gotten, of jewels of gold, armlets, and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before Yahweh.”

paite: Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in dangka-eng a bawl van tengteng ana sang uhi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

paite: Sangte tung a heutute leh zate tung a heutute'n dangka-eng TOUPA kiang a vei thillat dia alat tengteng uh shekel singkhat sangguk zasagih-le-sawmnga ahi.
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to Yahweh, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

paite: Galdou mite'n agallak uh amau a chiat ding in ala ngal ua.
english: (The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.)

paite: Mosi leh siampu Eleazar in sangkhatte tung a heutu leh zakhatte tung a heutute dangka-eng ala ua, Israel suante theihgigena ding in kihoupihna biakbuk ah TOUPA ma ah ahon tawi uhi.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting, for a memorial for the children of Israel before Yahweh.

paite: Reuben leh Gad tate'n ganta ahau mahmah ua; Jazer gam leh Gilead gam amuh un, amun ganta a dia hoihtak hi in athei uhi.
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for livestock;

paite: Huchi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh omkhawm mipite ava houpih ua,
english: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

paite: "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Shebam, Nebo leh Beon,
english: “Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

paite: Israel omkhawmte ma a TOUPA'N azoh gam, gante a ding in ahoih a, na sikhate'n ganhonte ka nei uhi.
english: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

paite: Na mitmuh a deihsakna ka tan uleh, na sikhate kiang ah ka luah ding un hiai gam hon pia inla, Jordan lui hon pi galkai dah mai ve," achi uhi.
english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession; don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

paite: Mosi in Gad tate leh Reuben tate kiang ah, "Na unaute uh kidouna ah akuan ding ua, nou bel hiai ah na om maimah ding uh maw?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to the war, and shall you sit here?

paite: Bangziak a TOUPA'N apiak gam a lut lou dia Israel suante lungtang lunglelsak na hi ua?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?

paite: Kadesh-barnea a pan gam va enkhe dia ka sawl in na pate un hichi mah bang in ahih uhi.
english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

paite: Eshkol Phaizang atuntouh un gam ava mu ua, TOUPA'N gam apiak a alut noplouhna ding un Israel suante lungtang alunglelsak uhi.
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.

paite: Huai ni in TOUPA aheh mahmah a, akichiam a,
english: Yahweh’s anger was kindled in that day, and he swore, saying,

paite: Aigupta gam a pan hong pawt, kum sawmnih chiang tunglam mi himhim in Abraham, Isak leh Jakob, kiang a kichiam a, ka piak gam kuamah in amu kei ding uh; ahon zuih taktak louh ziak un.
english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

paite: 'Keniz mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb leh Nun tapa Joshua kia lou ngal, amau bel TOUPA azuih taktak ziak un,' achi hi.
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have followed Yahweh completely.’

paite: Israelte tung ah TOUPA aheh mahmah a, TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hihmi suan tengteng amanthat vek masiah uh gamdai ah kum sawmli avakvaisak hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, who had done evil in the sight of Yahweh, was consumed.

paite: Ngai un, Israelte tung a TOUPA hehna lauhuaitak behlap in nou gilou in na pute uh sik in na dinghta uhi,
english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.

paite: TOUPA zui lou a, na om himhim uleh ama'n amaute gamdai ah a-omsak nawn ding hi. Hiai mi tengteng na hihmang mai kei ding uh maw?" achi hi.
english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all this people.”

paite: Ava naih ua, akiang ah, "Hiai ah ka gante uh a ding in belam huangte leh ka tate uh a ding in khua ka sat ding uh.
english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones:

paite: Kou bel amun ding uh ka tut masiah uh Israel suante ma a pai ding in ka kigalthuam ding uhi. Hiai gam a mite ziak in ka tate uh kulh nei khuate ah ateng ding uh.
english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

paite: Israel suante michih in amun luah ding aluah chiat ma un ka inn uah ka paikik kei ding uh.
english: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

paite: Ka luah ding uh bel hiai lam gal Jordan suahlam ahih ziak in Jordan gal khat lam leh akhen lam zaw ka luahpih kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Huchibang na chih ua, galdou dia TOUPA ma a kuan dia na kigalvat ua,
english: Moses said to them, “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,

paite: TOUPA ma a gam zoh ahih masiah na lak ua kigalthuam tengteng TOUPA ma a Jordan na galkah vek ua, ama a melmate adelhkhiak mateng leh
english: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh, until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

paite: TOUPA ma a gam lak a om a, huai khit chiang a na kik nawn ding uleh TOUPA leh Israelte ma ah na mohpuakna ua pan na siangta ding ua, TOUPA ma ah hiai gam na luah ding uhi.
english: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless towards Yahweh, and towards Israel; and this land shall be to you for a possession before Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh huchibang a na hih kei uleh, ngai un, TOUPA tung ah na khial uh ahi dia, na khelhna un hon mukhe ngeingei ding chih thei un.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.

paite: Na tate uh a ding in khuate sat unla, na belamte uh a ding in leng huangte bawl unla, na gen bangbang un hih un,” achi hi.
english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

paite: Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n Mosi kiang ah, "Na sikhate'n ka toupa uh thupiak bang in ka hih ding uh.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

paite: Ka zi, ka tate uh, ka belamhonte uh leh ka ganhon tengteng uh Gilead gam khuate ah ana om ding uh.
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

paite: Himahleh na sikha, kidou dia kigalthuam tengteng in ka toupa uh gen bang in TOUPA ma ah ka va galkah ding uh," chi in agen uhi.
english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in, atungtang thu uah siampu Eleazar, Nun tapa Joshua leh Israel nam inkuan lupente thu apia hi.
english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Gad tate, Reuben tate leh galdou dia kigalthuam tengteng in TOUPA ma a Jordan lui ahong galkahpih ua, huai gam na zoh uleh Gilead gam pen aluah ding ua na piak ding uh ahi.
english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle, before Yahweh, and the land shall be subdued before you; then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

paite: Himahleh kigalthuam a ahong galkahpih kei uleh Kanaan gam ah na lak uah atel mai ding uh," achi hi.
english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

paite: Gad tate leh Reuben tate'n, "Asikha kiang a TOUPA'N agen bang in ka hih ding uh.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.

paite: Kigalvan a TOUPA ma a galkah in Kanaan gam ah ka lut ding ua, ka gam luah ding uh Jordan lui khen lam ah ahi lai ding," chỉ in adawng uhi.
english: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

paite: Mosi in Gad tate, Reuben tate leh Joseph tapa Manasseh suan nam kimkhatte Amor kumpipa Sihon gam, Bashan Kumpipa Og gam, huai gamte a khua tengteng toh, akim gam a khuate nangawn toh apia hi.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

paite: Gad tate'n Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer;
english: The children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

paite: Atroth leh Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah;
english: and Atrothshophan, and Jazer, and Jogbehah,

paite: Beth-nimrah leh Beth- haran alam ua, khopi kulh neite, belam huangte toh.
english: and Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.

paite: Reuben tate'n Heshbon, Elealeh, Kirjathaim,
english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kiriathaim,

paite: Nebo leh Baal-meon, aminte khek khit ahi, huan Sibmah alam ua; akhosatte uh min dang aphuak zel uhi.
english: and Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah: and they gave other names to the cities which they built.

paite: Manasseh tapa Makir tapate Gilead gam ah ahoh ua, ala ua, huai a teng Amorte ahawlkhia uhi.
english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

paite: Mosi in Gilead gam Manasseh tapa Makir apia a; huai ah ateng hi.
english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

paite: Manasseh tapa Jair in akhotate ava la a, Havothjair asa hi.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its towns, and called them Havvoth Jair.

paite: Nobah in Kenath ava la a, akhotate toh, ama min tam in Nobah asa hi.
english: Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron makaih a Aigupta gam a pan apawlpawl a pawt a, apai zeldan uh hiải bang ahi.
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went forth out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in apaikhia ua, apai zelnate uh Mosi in agelh a; apaikhiak ua apainate uh hiaite ahi.
english: Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Yahweh: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

paite: Akha khatna, ani sawm-le-nga ni in Rameses a pan apawt ua; Paikan Ankuanglui ni zing in Aigupta mi teng muh in hangsantak in Israel suante apawtkhia uhi.
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

paite: Aigupta mite'n ata masapen teng uh TOUPA'N athahsakte avui ua, apathiante uh leng TOUPA'N athukhen khumta hi.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom Yahweh had struck among them: on their gods also Yahweh executed judgments.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante Rameses a pan apawt ua, Sukot ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

paite: Sukot a pan apawt ua, gamdai phak tung Etham ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

paite: Etham a pan apawt ua, Baal-zephon bul a Pi-hahiroth lam ah akinung khin ua, Migdol chin ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon: and they encamped before Migdol.

paite: Pi-hahiroth chin a pan apawt ua, tuipi apaltan ua, gamdai ah alut uhi. Etham gamdai ah ni thum lam apai ua, Marah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness: and they went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

paite: Marah a pan apawt ua, Elim atung uh. Elim ah tui nak nei sawm-le-nih leh tum sing sawmsagih a-om a; huai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim: and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there.

paite: Elim a pan apawt ua, Tupi San ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds .

paite: Tuipi San a pan apawt ua, Sin gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea or, Sea of Reeds , and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

paite: Sin gamdai a pan apawt ua, Dophkah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

paite: Dophkah a pan apawt ua, Alush ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

paite: Alush a pan apawt ua, Rephidim ah giahphual asat ua, huai ah mipite dawn ding tui a-om kei hi.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

paite: Rephidim a pan apawt ua, Sinai gamdai ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

paite: Sinai gamdai a pan apawt ua, Kibroth- hattaavah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

paite: Kibroth-hattaavah a pan apawt ua, Hazeroth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

paite: Hazeroth a pan apawt ua, Rithmah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

paite: Rithmah a pan apawt ua, Rimmon-parez ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

paite: Rimmon-parez a pan apawt ua, Libnah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

paite: Libnah a pan apawt ua, Rissah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

paite: Rissah a pan apawt ua, Kehelathah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

paite: Kehelathah a pan apawt ua, Shepher tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

paite: Shepher tang a pan apawt ua, Haradah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

paite: Haradah a pan apawt ua, Makheloth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

paite: Makheloth a pan apawt ua, Tahath ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

paite: Tahath a pan apawt ua, Terah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

paite: Terah a pan apawt ua, Mithkah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

paite: Mithkah a pan apawt ua, Hashmonah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

paite: Hashmonah a pan apawt ua, Moseroth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

paite: Moseroth a pan in apawt ua, Bene-jaakan ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

paite: Bene-jaakan a pan apawt ua, Hor-hagidgad ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

paite: Hor-hagidgad a pan apawt ua, Jotbathah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

paite: Jotbathah a pan apawt ua, Abronah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

paite: Abronah a pan apawt ua, Ezion-geber ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

paite: Ezion-geber a pan apawt ua, Zin gamdai ah giahphual asat uh huai tuh Kadesh leng achi uhi.
english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped in the wilderness of Zin (the same is Kadesh).

paite: Kadesh a pan apawt ua, Edom gam chin a Hor tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in Hor tang ah Siampu Aaron ahohtou a, Israel suante Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt uh akum sawmlina, akha ngana, ani khat ni in huai ah asita hi.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of Yahweh, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

paite: Aaron Hor tang a asih in kum zakhat sawmnih-le-thum ahi.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

paite: Kanaan mi, Kanaan gam simlam a om Arad kumpipa'n Israel suante ahong pai uh ana za hi.
english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

paite: Hor tang a pan apawt ua, Zalmonah ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

paite: Zalmonah a pan apawt ua, Punon ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

paite: Punon a pan apawt ua, Oboth ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

paite: Oboth a pan apawt ua, Moab gam naih Ije-abarim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

paite: Ije-abarim a pan apawt ua, Dibon-gad ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

paite: Dibon-gad a pan apawt ua, Almon-diblathaim ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

paite: Almon-diblathaim a pan apawt ua, Nebo chin a Abarim tang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

paite: Abarim tang a pan apawt ua, Jeriko zawn, Jordan gei Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Jordan gei Beth-jeshimoth a pan Abel-shittim pha in Moab Phaizang ah giahphual asat uhi.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

paite: Jeriko zawn Jordan gei Moab Phaizang ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah Jordan lui na kan ua, Kanaan gam na lut chiang un,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

paite: huai gam a om tengteng na delhkhe vek ding ua, asuang milim tengteng uh na hihse vek ding ua, amilim sunte uh na hihse vek ding ua, amun sangte uh na hihchim vek ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

paite: Gam na luah ding ua, huai ah na teng ding uh. Na luah ding ua gam ka hon piaksa na hi uh.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given given the land to you to possess it.

paite: Achi dungzui bang zel in aisan in gam na luah ding ua, a-inbul deuhte gam za deuh na pe ding ua, a-inbul lou deuhte gam neu deuh na pe ding uh. Aisan apukna peuh michih a tuam ahi dia; na pi-le-pute uh chi paidan bang zel in na luah ding uhi.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

paite: Himahleh huai gam a omte na delhkhiak kei uleh na omsakte uh na mit ua ding in sutna zum leh na sa ua ding in ling bang ahi ding ua, na omna gam uah buaina ahon tun ding uhi.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides, and they will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, atung ua hih ka tup bang na tung uah ka hih ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so will I do to you.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante thu pia inla, akiang uah, Kanaan gam na tun chiang un, Kanaan gam, agamgi dan dungzui zel a na luah ding gam uh,
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

paite: simlam na luah ding chiang uh Zin gamdai a pan Edom gam zulzul ahi dia, simlam gamgi Chi Tuipi tawp a pan suahlam pang ahi ding.
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;

paite: Na gamgi uh Akrabbim tungkahna simlam pang ah akawi dia, ahong pawtna Kadesh-barnea simlam ah ahi dia, Hazaraddar ah apai dia, Azmon ah apai zel ding.
english: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out of it shall be southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon;

paite: Gamgi Azmon a pan Aigupta lui tan in akawi dia, atawpna Tuipi ah ahi ding.
english: and the border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

paite: "Tumlam pang ah Tuipi Lian agamgi ding in na tang ding ua, hiai tumlam a na gamgi uh ahi ding.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border: this shall be your west border.

paite: "Hiai mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding. Tuipi Lian a pan Hor tang huap in na bawl ding uh.
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for you Mount Hor;

paite: Hor tang a pan Hamath lutna tan in na bawl dia, gamgi tunna bel Zedad ah ahi ding hi.
english: from Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;

paite: Gamgi Jiphron ah apai zel dia, atunna Hazar-enan ah ahi ding. Hiai mallam a na gamgi uh ahi ding hi.
english: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar Enan: this shall be your north border.

paite: "Suahlam a na gamgi uh Hazar-enan a pan Shepham tan in na bawl ding uhi.
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham;

paite: Gamgi Shepham a pan Riblah tan in Ain suahlam pang ah asukpai dia; huchi in gamgi apai suksuk dia, Kinereth tuipi suahlam pang asun ding hi.
english: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;

paite: Gamgi Jordan ah apaisuk dia, atunna Chi Tuipi ah ahi dia hiai akimvel a gamgi paidan bang in na gam uh ahi ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: and the border shall go down to the Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

paite: Mosi in Israel suante thu apia a, "Hiai TOUPA'N nam kua-le-akimte piak dia thu apiak aisan a na luah ding gam uh ahi.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahweh has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

paite: Reuben tate nam in a-inkuan uh dungzui zel leh Gad tate nam in a-inkuan uh dungzui zel leh Manasseh nam kimkhat in leng agam luah ding uh atangta ngal ua.
