english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received, their inheritance:

paite: Nam nih leh nam kimkhatte'n agam luah ding uh nisuahna lam Jeriko zawn Jordan gal suahlam ah atangta uh," achi hi.
english: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Luah dia gam hon khennenpihte min hiaite ahi. Siampu Eleazar leh Nun tapa Joshua.
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: Gam luah dia khennen ding in nam chih a pan a-intekpen khat chiat na tel ding ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

paite: Huai mite min bel hiaite ahi. Judah nam a mi Jephunneh tapa Kaleb.
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

paite: Simeon tate nam a mi Ammihud tapa Semuel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

paite: Benjamin nam a mi Kislon tapa Elidad.
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

paite: Dan tate nam lak a intekpen Jogli tapa Bukki.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

paite: Joseph tate lak a mi, Manasseh tate nam intekpen Ephod tapa Hanniel.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

paite: Ephraim tate nam lak a intekpen Sitan tapa Kemuel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

paite: Zebulun tate nam lak a intekpen Parnak tapa Elizaphan.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

paite: Issakar tate nam lak a intekpen Azan tapa Paltiel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

paite: Asher tate nam lak a intekpen Selo mi tapa Ahihud.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

paite: Naphtali tate nam lak a intekpen Ammihud tapa Padahel.
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

paite: Hiaite Kanaan gam a Israel suante gam luah ding hawm dia TOUPA'N thu apiakte ahi uhi.
english: These are they whom Yahweh commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

paite: Huan Jeriko zawn Jordan gei, Moab Phaizang ah TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

paite: "Israel suante thu pia inla, agam uah Levite tenna ding khuate bawlsak uhen. Agante uh tatna ding in kho dainawl kim Levite na piak ding uh ahi.
english: “Command the children of Israel that they give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and you shall give suburbs for the cities around them to the Levites.

paite: Khuate atenna ding uh ahi dia, akimte bel bawng leh agante leh aganvulh tengteng a ding ahi.
english: The cities shall they have to dwell in; and their suburbs shall be for their livestock, and for their substance, and for all their animals.

paite: Levite na piak ding dainawl khokulh a pan tong sangkhat a sau ahih ding ahi.
english: “The suburbs of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

paite: Kulh polam a pan na teh dia, suahlam pang ah tong sangnih, mallam pang ah tong sangnih, khopi bel alaitak ah a-om ding ahi. Hiai amau dainawl tuam ahi ding.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the midst. This shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

paite: Levite na piak ding khuate lak ah tualthatte taina ding kihumbitna khopi guk ahi dia; huaite lou khua sawmli-le-nih na piak lai ding uh ahi.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the manslayer to flee to: and besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

paite: Levite na piak ding khua tengteng khua sawmli-le-giat ahi ding. Dainawl toh na piak ding uh ahi.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their suburbs.

paite: Israel suante luah khua na piakdan ding, mi tamte na pe tam dia, atawmte na pe tawm ding ahi. Michih in aluah uh gam tamdan dungzui a khua Levite na piak ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many; and from the few you shall take few: everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give of his cities to the Levites.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

paite: Jordan lui na galkah ua Kanaan gam na lut chiang un kihumbitna khua na sep ding uh ahi, tup mawng hilou a tual thatkhami taina ding in.
english: then you shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the manslayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

paite: Huai khuate, phulami a pan na kihumbitna khua uh, omkhawmte ma a vai hawmsak dia adin ma a tualthatmi asihlouhna ding ahi.
english: The cities shall be to you for refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer not die, until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

paite: Nou a dia kihumbitna ding na sehte uh khopi guk ahi ding.
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

paite: Jordan gal ah khopi thum na sep dingua, Kanaan gam ah khopi thum na sep ding ua, kihumbitna khopite ahi ding uh.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan; they shall be cities of refuge.

paite: Israel suante leh namdang leh akiang ua tengte a ding in hiai khopi gukte kihumbitna ahi dia, huai ah kuapeuh mi that kha atailut ding ahi.
english: For the children of Israel, and for the stranger and for the foreigner living among them, shall these six cities be for refuge; that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

paite: "Himahleh mi kuahiam in sik a mi asat a, asihleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Si khop a suang a mi aden a, asihleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Ahihkeileh mi khat in mi khat sing zang in sat henla, si taleh tualthat ahi a, tualthat bel hihlup ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

paite: Sisan phulami'n tualthatmi athat dia, amuh peuh chiang in athat ding ahi.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death: when he meets him, he shall put him to death.

paite: "Mi khatpeuh in huatna toh tupkholhna nei in midang khat sawn henla, ahihkeileh tup mawng in banghiam in deng henla, huai mi si taleh;
english: If he thrust him of hatred, or hurled at him, lying in wait, so that he died,

paite: ahihkeileh kimelmakna nei in akhuttum in tum henla, huai mi si taleh ahihlumpa hihlup ngeingei ding ahi. Amah tualthat ahi a, sisan phulami in athah ding ahi.
english: or in enmity struck him with his hand, so that he died; he who struck him shall surely be put to death; he is a murderer: the avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death, when he meets him.

paite: "Himahleh kimelmakna nei hilou a, kuahiam khat in midang asawn khak ahihkeileh tup mawng hilou a amah aden khak a,
english: “‘But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

paite: ahihkeileh amah mu lou a, amah that thei suang atung a akhiak a, amah asihleh amelma leng hilou a, hihnat tum leng hilou ahih ziak in.
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him, so that he died, and he was not his enemy, neither sought his harm;

paite: Omkhawmte'n hiai vaihawmna dan bang in ahihlum mi leh sisan phulami vai ahawmsak ding uh ahi:
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances;

paite: Omkhawmte'n tualthatmi sisan phulami a pan ahumbit ding ua, omkhawmte'n ataina, akihumbitna khua ah atengsak ding ua, sathau siangthou nilh a om siampu lianpen asih mateng huai lai khua ah ateng ding hi.
english: and the congregation shall deliver the manslayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he was fled: and he shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

paite: Himahleh chik lai peuh in tualthatmi ataina, a kihumbitna kho gamgi polam apai a;
english: “‘But if the manslayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge, where he flees,

paite: sisan phulami in akihumbitna kho polam a amuh a, sisan phulami in athahleh asisan ah moh apo kei ding.
english: and the avenger of blood find him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kill the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of blood,

paite: Siampu lian asih mateng akihumbitna khua ah ateng gige ding a, himahleh siampu asih in bel tualthatmi atenna gam ah apaikik ding ahi.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the manslayer shall return into the land of his possession.

paite: Hiai thilte na suante uh tan a na tenna peuh ua na vaihawmna dan thuseh ding uh ahi.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

paite: "Kuapeuh in mi athahleh tualthatmi pen theihpihte kam a pan thupawt a hihlup ding ahi. Himahleh theihpih khat kia mi hihlupna ding in ahun kei.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain at the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person that he die.

paite: Tualthatmi na tan ding uh ahi kei. Sihna khop a moh ahi a, hihlup ngeingei ding ahi zaw.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death; but he shall surely be put to death.

paite: Siampu sih ma in, kihumbitna khua a tailut kuapeuh agam a sawlkik nawn dia tatna sum na lak ding uh ahi kei.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who is fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

paite: Huchi in na tenna gam uh na hihthanghuai kei ding ua, sisan in gam ahihthanghuaileh sisan suahna gam hihthanghuai silna ding in asuahmi sisan kia lou lah zattheih ahi ngal kei a.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land in which you are: for blood, it pollutes the land; and no expiation can be made for the land for the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him who shed it.

paite: Na tenna gam uh, ka omna na hihthanghuai ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA lah Israel suante lak ah ka om ngal a, chi in," achi hi.
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, in the midst of which I dwell: for I, Yahweh, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.’”

paite: Huan Joseph inkuanpihte lak a mi, Manasseh tapa Makir tapa Gilead tate inkuan lupente lak a mite'n ahon naih ua, Mosi leh heutu, Israel suante intekpente ma ah thu agen uhi.
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spoke before Moses, and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel:

paite: "TOUPA'N ka toupa Israel suante aisan a, aluah ding uh gam pe ding in thu apia hi. TOUPA'N ka toupa, ka unaupa uh Jelophehad gam a tanute pe ding in nang thu ahon pia hi.
english: and they said, “Yahweh commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by Yahweh to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

paite: Amau Israel suante lak a mi, namdang kuapeuh tate ava kitenpih uleh, ka pi-le-pute uh gam aluah uh laksak a, akitenpih uh namte gam toh gawm ding ahi dia; huchibang in ka gam tantuan ua kipan lakkhiak ahi ding hi.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

paite: Israel suante Jubili ahong tun chiang in agam uh ava kitenpih uh namte gam toh gawm ding ahi dia; huchi in ka pi-le-pute uh gam a pan amau gam lak hek ahong hi ding hi," achi uh.
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be, then will their inheritance be added to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they shall belong: so will their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

paite: Mosi in, TOUPA thu bang in Israel suante thu apia a, "Joseph tate nam in agen dik uhi.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of Yahweh, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks right.

paite: Jelophehad tanute tungtang thu a TOUPA'N thu apiak pen hiai ahi. 'Hoih asaksak uh kitenpih uhenla, himahleh apate uh nampih lak a mi ngei akitenpih ding uh ahi.
english: This is the thing which Yahweh does command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them be married to whom they think best; only into the family of the tribe of their father shall they be married.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante gam pen namdang kiang a suan ahi kei ding. Israel suante'n api-le-pute uh nam gam aneih gige ding uh ahi.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

paite: Israel suante lak a gouluah ding tanu peuhmah Israel suante'n api-le-pute uh gam aluah chiat zel theihna ding un apa nampih lak a mi zi ahih ngeingei ding ahi.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may possess every man the inheritance of his fathers.

paite: Huchi in gam bel namdang kiang a suan ahi kei ding hi. Israel suante'n amau gam chiat atang gige ding uh ahi ngal a, " achi hi.
english: So shall no inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in Jelophehad tanute'n ahih uhi.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as Yahweh commanded Moses:

paite: Jelophehad tanu Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Noahte'n apa uh unau tapate akitenpih uhi.
english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

paite: Joseph tapa Manasseh tapate akitenpih ua, agam uh apa uh nam ah a-om gige hi.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph; and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

paite: Hiaite TOUPA'N Mosi zang a Jeriko zawn Jordan gal a Moab Phaizang a Israel suante apiak, thupiakte leh vaihawmdante ahi uhi.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which Yahweh commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Levi tapate lak a Kohath tapate, akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un, sim vek in.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

paite: kum sawmthum a pan atunglam, kum sawmnga tan in nasepna, kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding teng.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin mun siangthoupen a Kohath tapate nasep ding hiaite ahi.
english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, the most holy things.

paite: "Giahphual a suan ding teng un Aaron, atapate toh alut ding ua, dantan puanzak ahawkkhe ding ua, huai in thukhun bawm akhuh ding uh.
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in, and his sons, and they shall take down the veil of the screen, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

paite: Huai pen ngalvang vun in akhuh ding ua, puandum buang in leng akhuh ding ua, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
english: and shall put a covering of sealskin on it, and shall spread over it a cloth all of blue, and shall put in its poles.

paite: "Etsakna tanghou dohkan tung ah puandum buang aphah ding ua, huai ah kuangte, keute, belhbute leh noute butkhiakna ding akoih ding uhi. Tatlak lou in tanghou koih huai ah a-om ding ahi.
english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

paite: Huai pen puansan in akhuh ding ua; akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding uh, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover the same with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

paite: "Vaksak khawnvak koihna leh huai a dia azat ding ua khawnvakte, ataitehte, avu koihnate, thau bing tengteng puandum buang in akhuh ding uhi.
english: “They shall take a blue cloth, and cover the lampstand of the light, and its lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

paite: Huai leh avanzat tengteng akhuhna ngalvang vun a khuh in azawnna ah akoih ding uhi.
english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

paite: "Dangka-eng maitam puandum buang in akhuh ding ua, akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh nawn ding uh, azawnna chiang athuah ding uhi.
english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

paite: Mun siangthou a vanzat leh tui- um belsuan tengteng ala vek ding ua, puandum buang in atun ding ua, akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding uh, azawnna ah akoih ding uhi.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry, with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, and cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

paite: Maitam a meivu alamang ding ua, atung ah puan sandup aphah ding uhi.
english: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

paite: Atung ah anasep vialvialna uh tui-um belsuan tengteng, mei laknate, sa thukna sikkhutte vutluahnate, tuikuangte leh maitam tui-um belsuan tengteng akoih ding uhi. Akhuhna ngalvang vun in akhuh ding ua, azawnna abulh ding uh.
english: They shall put on it all its vessels, with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the flesh hooks, the shovels, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

paite: Aaron leh atapate'n mun siangthou leh mun siangthou van tengteng om mun suan dia akhuh khit chiang un; huai khit chiang in azawng ding in Kohath tapate ahong pai ding uhi. Himahleh thil siangthou himhim akhoih ding uh ahi kei, huchi lou in zaw asi kha ding uh. Hiaite kihoupihna biakbuk a Kohath tapate nasep ding ahi.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary, and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it: but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: "Siampu Aaron tapa Eleazar sep ding, det ding thau, gimnamtui, niteng a tangbuang thillat, nilhchi thau, biakbuk, huai a thil om tengteng, mun siangthou leh avante ngaihtuah ahi,” achi hi.
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

paite: "Kohath suan inkuan zaw Levite lak a pan satkhe kei un.
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

paite: Himahleh thil siangthoute khoih lou a, si lou a a-omtheihna ding uh hichibang ahi. Aaron leh atapate lut uhenla, asep ding uh leh atantuam ding chiat uh sehsak uhen.
english: but thus do to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach to the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them everyone to his service and to his burden;

paite: Himahleh akikhuh lai teng thil siangthoute en ding in lut kei uhen, alut uleh asi ding uh," achi hi.
english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Gershon tapate leng a-inkuankuan un, akhang-akhang un sim vek in.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

paite: Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan in nasepna kihoupihna biakbuk a sem thei ding teng zah sim vek in.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old; all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Gershon suante tantuam nasep lam leh puak lam hiai ahi.
english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

paite: Biakbuk puanzakte, kihoupihna biakbuk, akhuhnate, atung khuhna ngalvang vun, kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak puanzak;
english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, and the covering of sealskin that is above on it, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

paite: intual puanzakte, intual kongkhak puanzakte, abiakbuk leh maitam bul a, akhaute leh avanzat tengteng uh toh apo ding ua, sep dia kiphamoh Reuhmah asem ding uhi.
english: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. Therein shall they serve.

paite: Gershon suante nasep, asep lam leh puak lam ah atantuan tengteng uh Aaron leh atapate'n asep ding ua; ahih ding uh banghiam nengneng tan a sehsak in huaite asem ding uhi.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden, and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

paite: Huaite kihoupihna biakbuk a Gershon suante nasep ahi. Ahih ding uh siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar seh ding ahi.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting: and their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: "Merari tapate, akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un na sim ding ahi.
english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall number them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

paite: Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan in kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding zah na sim vek ding ahi.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin a anasep uh, atantuam ding uh hiaite ahi. Biakbuk khuam lepkhawmte, abaangkalte, akhuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte;
english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

paite: a-intual umna khuamte, akingakna khuakkuakte, akilhbelhnate, akhaute, avanzat tengteng leh avanzat dang tengteng puakte, amin uh lou chiat in atantuam ding uh na sehsak ding ahi.
english: and the pillars of the court around it, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name you shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden.

paite: Huaite siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar heu a kihoupihna biakbuk a Merari tapate suante'n ahih ding uh banghiam nengneng tan a anasepdan ding uh ahi," achi hi.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi leh Aaron leh omkhawmte lak a lupente'n Kohathte tapate akhang-akhang un, a-inkuankuan un asimta uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Kihoupihna puanin a nasepna a ding in michih nasem dia kisate, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Huaite akhang-akhang a asim uh sangnih zasagih-le-sawmnga ahi uhi.
english: Those who were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

paite: Hiaite ahi uh, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem Kohathte suan Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte.
english: These are those who were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Hiaite a-inkuankuan a, akhang-akhang ua kisim, Gershon tapate ahi uh.
english: Those who were numbered of the sons of Gershon, their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa tan kihoupihna biakbuk nasepna a dia michih nasem dia kisate.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Akhang akhang a, a-inkuankuan ua asimte uh sangnih zaguk-le-sawmthum ahi uh.
english: even those who were numbered of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

paite: Huaite ahi uh, Gershon tapate suante, kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem teng, TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte uh.
english: These are those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh.

paite: Huaite a-inkuankuan ua, akhang- akhang ua, Merari tapate asimte uh ahi,
english: Those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

paite: kihoupihna biakbuk a sem ding a nasem zah ding, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service, for work in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Huai akhang-akhang a, a-inkuankuan ua asimte uh sangthum leh zanih ahi uh.
english: even those who were numbered of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

paite: Hiaite Merari tapate suante asim uh, Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a Mosi leh Aaron in asimte ahi uhi.
english: These are those who were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron leh Israelte lupente'n akhang-akhang a, a-inkuankuan a, asimte uh avek un huai teng ahi uh.
english: All those who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel numbered, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

paite: Nasem ding leh kihoupihna biakbuk a puakchi pomi ding zah, kum sawmthum a pan atunglam kum sawmnga a upa chiang.
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service, and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

paite: Asimte uh sanggiat zanga-le-sawmgiat ahi uh.
english: even those who were numbered of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

paite: Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak bang a michih asep ding leh atantuam ding dungzui zel a sim ahi. Hichibang in TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a sim ahi uhi.
english: According to the commandment of Yahweh they were numbered by Moses, everyone according to his service, and according to his burden. Thus were they numbered by him, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante agiahna mun ua kipan phak tengteng leh sipawt tengteng leh misi ziak a buah peuhmahte pawtkhesak vek ding in thu pia in.
english: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, and everyone who has an issue, and whoever is unclean by the dead.

paite: Numei leh pasal pawtkhesak in giahphual pua ah na koih ding ahi. Alaitak a ka omna giahna mun abuahsaklouhna ding un," achi hi.
english: Both you shall put male and female outside of the camp; that they not defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

paite: Huchi in Israel suante'n huchibang in ahih uhi, dainawl ah akoihkhia ua; TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a agen bang in Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
english: The children of Israel did so, and put them out outside of the camp; as Yahweh spoke to Moses, so did the children of Israel.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, pasal hiam, numei hiam in TOUPA tung ah thil bangpeuh na hihkhial in moh taleh;
english: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against Yahweh, and that soul is guilty;

paite: ahihkhelhna ah thupha atawi ding ahi. Ahihkhelh man pen kimtak in adin dia, amun nga a khen mun khat ahihkhelhnapa apiak behlap ding ahi.
english: then he shall confess his sin which he has done, and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, and add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

paite: Himahleh huai mi in khelh man piakna ding tanau nai aneih keileh, khelh man pen TOUPA a tuam ahi dia, akhelh man leh akhialpa a dia kilemna bawlsakna belampa pen siampu kiang a piak ding ahi.
english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to Yahweh shall be the priest’s; besides the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

paite: Israel suante thil siangthou vei thillat tengteng, siampu kiang a lat peuhmah siampu a tuam ding ahi.
english: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

paite: Michih thil siangthou siampu a tuam ahi dia, mite'n siampu apiak peuhmah ama a tuam ahi ding, chi in," achi hi.
english: Every man’s holy things shall be his: whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, akiang uah, Mi, azi in alampialsan a, mi'n amah kithuahpih henla, apasal in thei kei henla,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray, and is unfaithful to him,

paite: huchibang a a-om nilouh a, kihihthanghuai pipi a kigenkhe nai lou hi in, athei kuamah om lou, mat louh hitaleh;
english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and is kept close, and she is defiled, and there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

paite: apasal thikthu hong sia a, azi muangmoh a, siangthou lou mah ana hihleh, ahihkeileh apasal thikthu hong sia a, azi muangmoh a, azi siangthou ana hihleh:
english: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, and she is defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife, and she isn’t defiled:

paite: huai mi in azi a dia thillat barli buh tangbuang ephah mun sawm a khen mun khat tawi in siampu kiang ah azi api ding hi. Athillat ding sathau abuak ding ahi kei a, begaw leng anuh ding ahi sam kei. Thikthusiatna tangbuang thillat, theihgigena thillat, thulimlouhna theihgigena ahi.
english: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: the tenth part of an ephah 1 ephah is about 22 litres or about 2/3 of a bushel of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

paite: "Siampu in azi api dia, TOUPA ma ah adingsak dia:
english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before Yahweh;

paite: Siampu in leibel in tui siangthou ala dia, biakbuk pialkhang a leivui ala dia, tui ah akhe ding hi.
english: and the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water.

paite: Siampu in huai numei TOUPA ma ah adingsak dia, asam akhahkhiaksak dia, theihgigena tangbuang thillat atawisak dia; siampu in hamsia tungsak tui kha akhut in atawi ding,
english: The priest shall set the woman before Yahweh, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

paite: Siampu in huai numei akichiamsak dia, numei kiang ah, 'Na pasal hilou midang kuamah in hon kithuahpih louh a, nitna lam a na lampial keileh hamsia tungsak hiai tui kha a pan na hul ding.
english: The priest shall cause her to swear, and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

paite: Himahleh lampialsan a na kihihnit a, na pasal lou mi kuahiam in ahon kithuahpihleh na hul kei ding,' achi ding.
english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband:”

paite: Siampu in numei avau dia, akichiamsak ding. Numei kiang ah siampu in, 'TOUPA'N na pheipi azawtsak a, na gil apuaksakleh, TOUPA'N na chipihte lak ah hamsethuak in nang hon bawl hen.
english: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “Yahweh make you a curse and an oath among your people, when Yahweh allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

paite: Hamsia tungsak hiai tui na gil ah alut dia, na gil apuaksak dia, na pheipi azawsak ding. Numei in, Amen, Amen,' achi ding.
english: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

paite: "Siampu in huai hamsia thute laibu ah agelh dia, tui kha ah adiah ding hi.
english: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out into the water of bitterness.

paite: Hamsia tungsak tui kha numei adawnsak ding ahi. Huchi in hamsia tungsak tui kha agilsung ah alut dia, ahong kha ding hi.
english: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

paite: Siampu in thikthusiatna thillat tangbuang numei khut a pan ala dia; TOUPA ma ah tangbuang thillat avei dia, maitam ah apaipih ding hi.
english: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before Yahweh, and bring it to the altar.

paite: Siampu in tangbuang thillat theihgigena pham khat ala dia, maitam ah ahal dia, huai khit in tui numei adawnsak ding ahi.
english: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

paite: Tui adawnsakleh hichi ahi dia; ahong nit a, apasal tung a thil hihkhial ana hihleh hamsia tungsak huai tui agilsung ah alut dia, ahong kha dia, agil ahong puak dia, apheipi ahong zaw dia; huchi in numei achipihte lak a hamsia thuaknu ahong hi ding hi.
english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled, and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away: and the woman will be a curse among her people.

paite: Himahleh numei anit louh a, asianthouleh ahul dia, nau apai thei ding.
english: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

paite: "Hiai zi lampial a, apasal hilou midang toh kihihnin hiam,
english: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled;

paite: ahihkeileh apasal thikthu hong siat a azi ahazat chiang a vaihawmdan ding ahi. Huchi in TOUPA ma ah api dia, siampu in hiai dan tengteng bang in atung ah ahih ding.
english: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before Yahweh, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

paite: Huchi in pasal pen thulimlouhna ah ahul dia, numei in akhelhna moh apo ding hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah gen inla, akiang uah, pasal hiam, numei hiam in leng banghiam thuchiam tuam, TOUPA a dia akipiakna Nazarit thuchiam achiam lai in uain leh zu angawl ding ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to Yahweh,

paite: Uain thuk, zu thuk leh grep tui adawn ding ahi kei a, grep mindup hiam, minvuai hiam leng ane ding ahi sam kei hi.
english: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

paite: Akihihtuam sung teng grepgui a pan atang leng, ahawng leng ane ding ahi kei.
english: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

paite: "Kihihtuamna thu achiam sung teng alu leng amet louh hial ding ahi. TOUPA a dia akihihtuam sung ni akim mateng hihtuam ahi dia, asam ahawi ding ahi.
english: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled, in which he separates himself to Yahweh. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

paite: TOUPA a dia akihihtuam sung teng misi luang anaih ding ahi kei.
english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to Yahweh he shall not go near a dead body.

paite: Apa, anu, a-unaupa, a-unaunu hiam sih thu ah leng akihihnin ding ahi kei hi; Pathian a dia akihihtuamna in amah agak ziak in.
english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die; because his separation to God The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “Elohim.” is on his head.

paite: Akihihtuam sung teng TOUPA a tuam ahi.
english: All the days of his separation he is holy to Yahweh.

paite: "Akiang ah mi hong siguih in, akihihtuamna lutang hon hihnin kha taleh, akisiansak ni, ani sagih ni in alu amet ding ahi.
english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

paite: Ani giat ni in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a siampu kiang ah vakhu kop khat hiam, vapalnou kop khat hiam ahon tawi ding ahi.
english: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in khat khelh thoihna ding in alan dia, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in, misi ziak a ahihkhelhna ah kilemna abawlsak ding. Huai ni mah in alu ahihsiangthou ding ahi.
english: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

paite: Akihihtuamna nite TOUPA kiang a pia in khelh thoihna ding in belamnoupa kum khat a upa ahon tawi ding hi. Himahleh akihihtuamna hihnit ahih tak ziak in amangta ding uhi.
english: He shall separate to Yahweh the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

paite: "Hiai Nazarit mi dan ahi: Akihihtuamna ni abukim chiang in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak a pi ahi ding.
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

paite: TOUPA a dia thillat ding in belampa kum khat a upa gensiatbei halmang thillat ding in khat, khelh thoihna ding in belamnounu kum khat a upa gensiatbei khat, lemna thillat ding in belampa gensiatbei khat,
english: and he shall offer his offering to Yahweh, one male lamb a year old without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb a year old without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

paite: silngou soh louh tanghou loh khat, tangbuang nel mahmah thau a mek tanghou leh tangbuang nel mahmah thau a mek tanghou beu, thau a zut tanghou pek silngou soh louh leh nek thillat ding uleh dawn ding thillatte toh alan ding ahi.
english: and a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and their meal offering, and their drink offerings.

paite: "Siampu in huaite TOUPA ma ah alan dia, akhelh kithoihna leh ahalmang thillat alan ding ahi.
english: The priest shall present them before Yahweh, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering.

paite: Belampa pen palbawm a tanghou silngou soh louh toh lemna kithoih thillat TOUPA kiang ah alan dia; siampu in tangbuang thillat leh dawn thillat mah leng alan tel ding ahi.
english: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering, and its drink offering.

paite: Nazarit mi in kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah akihihtuamna lu amet dia, akihihtuamna sam ala dia, lemna kithoihna thillat nuai a mei ah ahalmang ding hi.
english: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

paite: Siampu in belampa liang huanmin leh bawm a silngou soh louh tanghou khat leh silngou soh louh tanghou pek khat ala dia, Nazarit mi in akihihtuamna lu amet khit in atawisak ding hi.
english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite, after he has shaved the head of his separation;

paite: Siampu in vei thillat ding in TOUPA ma ah avei ding ahi. Hiai siampu a tuam ahi ding, awm vei leh liang vei toh. Huai khit in Nazarit mi in uain adawn theita ding hi.
english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahweh. This is holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

paite: "Hiai ahi Nazarit mi thuchiam dan leh TOUPA ma a thillatdan. Ama ut thu a lat sim louh in akihihtuamna thuchiam dungzui zel in ahih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows, and of his offering to Yahweh for his separation, besides that which he is able to get. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, hichi- bang in Israel suante na vualzawl ding ahi. Akiang uah,
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

paite: "TOUPA'N nou hon vualzawl in hon veng hen.
TOUPA'N na tung uah amel vaksak henla, hon hehpih hen.
english: Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

paite: TOUPA'N nou lam hong nga henla, lungmuanna noute hon pia hen, chi in gen un, chi in agen hi.
english: Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

paite: "Huchibang a hih in Israel suante tung ah ka min tuansak ahi dia, amau ka vualzawl ding," achi hi.
english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

paite: Mosi in biakbuk alam khit a, thau anilh khit a, ahihsiangthou khit a, van tengteng leh maitam leh tui-um belsuan tengteng thaunilh a, ahihsiangthou ni in hichi ahi a,
english: It happened on the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it, with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

paite: Israel intekpen, a-inkuan ua intekpente'n thillat alan ua, huaite anam ua intekpente, asimte uh tung a omte ahi uh.
english: that the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, offered. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were numbered:

paite: Athillatte uh kangtalai tung nei guk leh bawngtal sawm-le-nih, intekpen nih in kangtalai khat zel, khat in bawngtal khat zel TOUPA ma ah ahon paipih ua, biakbuk ah ahong lan uhi.
english: and they brought their offering before Yahweh, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they presented them before the tabernacle.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Biakbuk nasepna ding in aphatuam kha ding, na la chiat un; Levite, anasep uh dungzui zel in na pe chiat ding hi," achi hi.
english: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in kangtalaite leh bawngtalte ala a, Levite khut ah apia hi.
english: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

paite: Kangtalai nih leh bawngtal li Gershon tapate anasep uh dungzui zel in apia hi.
english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

paite: Kangtalai li leh bawngtal giat, siampu Aaron tapa Ithamar, Merari tapate anasep uh dungzui in apia hi.
english: and he gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

paite: Kohath tapate bel mun siangthou a nasep amau a tuam hi a, anasep uh azawnthoh ahih ziak in ape kei hi.
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

paite: Intekpente'n thaunilh ni in maitam latna dia athillatte uh maitam bul ah alan uhi.
english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes gave their offerings before the altar.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Intekpen chih in maitam latna dia athillat, athillat uh amau tan hi zel ding in alan ding uhi," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

paite: Ni khat ni a thillat lan ding mi Judah chi Amminadab tapa Nashon ahi.
english: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik, dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding in thau helsa tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: Shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding in bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding in keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoihna thillat ding in bawngtal nih, belamtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga leh belamnoupa kum khat a upa nga ahi a, hiaite Amminadab tapa Nashon thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

english: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

paite: Ani sawm-le-nih ni in Naphtali tate intekpen Enan tapa Ahira in alan hi.
english: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali

paite: Athillat dangkasik kuang khat, agikdan shekel za-le-sawmthum, mun siangthou a shekel sawmsagih toh kikim a gik dangkasik belhbu khat, tangbuang thillat ding thau toh hel tangbuang toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah a dim tuak;
english: gave his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

paite: shekel sawm toh kikim a gik gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu khat;
english: one golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense;

paite: halmang thillat ding bawngtaltuai khat, belamtal khat, belamnoupa kum khat a upa khat;
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

paite: khelh thoihna ding keltal khat;
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

paite: lemna kithoih thillat ding bawngtal nih, belamtal nga, keltal nga, belamnoupa kum khat a upa ngate Enan tapa Ahira thillatte ahi uh.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

paite: Maitam thau nilh ni a Israel intekpente thillatte dangkasik kuang sawm-le-nih, dangkasik belhbu sawm-le-nih leh dangka-eng keu sawm-le-nih ahi.
english: This was the dedication of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

paite: Dangkasik kuang shekel za-le-sawmthum toh kikim a gik chiat ahi a, belhbu sawmsagih chiat ahi. Dangkasik tui-um belsuan tengteng mun siangthou a shekel sangnih-le-zali toh kikim a gik ahi.
english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary;

paite: Gimlim a dim dangka-eng keu sawm-le-nih mun siangthou a shekel sawm toh kikim a gik chiat ahi. Dangka-eng keu tengteng shekel za-le-sawmnih toh kikim a gik ahi.
english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

paite: Haltum thillat ding bawngtal tengteng sawm-le-nih ahi a, belamtal sawm-le-nih, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawm-le-nih; atangbuang thillatte uh toh, Khelh thoihna ding keltal sawm-le-nih.
english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and the male goats for a sin offering twelve;

paite: Lemna kithoihna thillat ding bawngtal sawmnih-le-li ahi a, belamtal bel sawmguk, keltal sawmguk, belamnoupa kum khat a upa sawmguk ahi. Hiai thau nilh khit a maitam latna dia thilpiakte ahi uh.
english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the male lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after it was anointed.

paite: Huchi in biakbuk a amah be dia Mosi alut in thukhun bawm tung a zahngaihna tutphah tunglam a cherub nihte kikal a pan amah ahoupihna aw aza hi.
english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with Yahweh, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim: and he spoke to him.

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Aaron houpih inla, akiang ah, khawnvak na det chiang in khawnvak sagihte'n sathau khawnvak koihna malam atatvak ding uh ahi," chi in.
english: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.’”

paite: Aaron in huchibang in ahih a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in khawnvak koihna malam ah khawnvakte ade hi.
english: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lampstand, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Hiai khawnvak koihna ahihleh dangka-eng a sekthoh chi ahi a; amung bul a kipan apak tan a sekthoh ahi. Alim TOUPA'N Mosi a-etsak bang geih a khawnvak koihna bawl ahi.
english: This was the workmanship of the lampstand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work: according to the pattern which Yahweh had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levite, Israel suante lak a pan hihtuam inla, hihsiangthou in.
english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

paite: Amaute hihsiangthou ding in hichibang in na hih ding ahi. Atung uah sawpsianna tui sung inla, apumpi tengteng uh metsak inla, apuante uh sawpsak inla, kihihsiangthousak in.
english: You shall do this to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

paite: Bawngtaltuai khat tangbuang thillat thau toh hel tangbuang nel mahmah toh lasak inla, khelh thoihna ding in bawngtaltuai khat dang leng na kaisak ding ahi.
english: Then let them take a young bull, and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

paite: Levite kihoupihna biakbuk bul ah pi inla, Israel suan omkhawm tengteng kigawmkhawmsak vek in.
english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

paite: Levite TOUPA kiang ah na lan dia; Israel suante'n Levite tung ah akhut uh anga ding uhi.
english: You shall present the Levites before Yahweh. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

paite: Huchi in Aaron in Levite, TOUPA nna aseptheihna ding un Israel suante min in vei thillat TOUPA kiang ah alan ding.
english: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before Yahweh for a wave offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of Yahweh.

paite: Levite'n bawngtalte lutung ah akhut uh anga ding ua; Levite a dia kilemna bawlna ding in, khat, khelh thoihna ding in, akhat pen halmang thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah alan ding ahi.
english: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering to Yahweh, to make atonement for the Levites.

paite: "Levite Aaron leh atapate ma ah na omsak dia, TOUPA a ding in vei thillat ding in na lan ding ahi.
english: You shall set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to Yahweh.

paite: Huchibang in Israel suante lak a pan Levite na hihtuam dia, huchi in Levite kei a ahi ding uh.
english: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

paite: Huai khit in Levite kihoupihna biakbuk nasem ding in alut ding ua, nang amaute na hihsiangthou ding, vei thillat ding in na lan ding ahi.
english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting: and you shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

paite: Israel suante lak a pan kei a tuam dia seh ahi ngal ua. Sul hong tengteng, Israel suante ta masapen teng tang in kei a ding in ka neita hi.
english: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

paite: Israel suante lak a ta masapente, mihing toh ganta toh kei a ahi him uhi. Aigupta gam a ta masapente ka sihsak lai in kei a tuam dia ka sehsa ahi.
english: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante lak a ta masapente tang in Levite ka nei khinta ahi.
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

paite: Huchi in Israel suante tang a kihoupihna biakbuk a nasem ding leh Israel suante'n mun siangthou ahon naih ua leng Israel suante lak a hii alenlouhna dia lemna bawl ding in Israel suante lak a pan Levite Aaron leh atapate ka pia ahi," achi hi.
english: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

paite: Huchibang in Mosi, Aaron leh Israel suan omkhawm tengteng in Levite tung ah ahihta uhi. Levite tungtang thu a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng bang in atung uah Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

paite: Huchi in Levite siansak ahi ua, apuante uh asawp ua; Aaron in TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in alan hi. Amau hihsianthouna ding in Aaron in kilemna abawlsak hi.
english: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before Yahweh; and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

paite: Huai zoh in Levite Aaron leh atapate nuai a, anasep uh sem ding in kihoupihna biakbuk sung ah alut uhi. Levite tungtang thu a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in atung uah ahihta hi.
english: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron, and before his sons: as Yahweh had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Levite tantuam hiaite ahi. Kum sawmnih-le-nga chiang tunglam in kihoupihna biakbuk a nasep asem ding uh.
english: “This is that which belongs to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

paite: Kum sawmnga a upate'n anasep uh akhawlsan ding ua, nna asem nawn kei ding uh.
english: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting on the work, and shall serve no more,

paite: Himahleh khawmpite biakbuk kep thu ah a-unaute uh ahuh zel ding ua, nasep zaw asem nawn kei ding uh. Hichibang in Levite nasep na gelsak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall do no service. You shall do thus to the Levites concerning their duties.”

paite: Huan TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawt nung uh akum nihna, akha khatna in Sinai gamdai ah Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

paite: "Israel suante'n Paikan Ankuangluina ahunbi zel in nei uhen.
english: “Moreover let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

paite: Ahunbi in, hiai kha, ani sawm-le-li nitaklam in na nei ding uhi. Huai a hih dia seh tengteng leh dan bang in na nei ding uhi," achi hi.
english: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season—according to all its statutes, and according to all its ordinances, you shall keep it.”

paite: Huchi in Mosi in Israel suante Paikan Ankuangluina nei ding in ahilh hi.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel, that they should keep the Passover.

paite: Huchi in Sinai gamdai ah akha khatna, ani sawm-le-li ni nitaklam in Paikan Ankuangluina anei uhi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang zel in Israel suante'n ahih uhi.
english: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

paite: Kuate hiam misi luang ziak a siang lou ana om ua, huai ni in Paikan Ankuangluina ah atel thei kei ua, huchi in huai ni in Mosi leh Aaron ma ah ahoh uhi.
english: There were certain men, who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day.

paite: Huaite'n akiang ah, "Misi luang ziak in siang lou ka hi ua; huaiziak in hia, Israel suante lak a ahunbi a TOUPA kiang a thillat ka lat sam uh kham ka hih uh?" achi uhi.
english: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

paite: Mosi in akiang uah, "Na pau kei phot dih uh. Na tungtang thu uah TOUPA'N bangchi in ahia thu ahon piak ka hon za masa phot ding," achi hi.
english: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what Yahweh will command concerning you.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
"Israel suante kiang ah, na lak ua kuapeuh, na suante uh lak a kuapeuh, misi luang ziak a siang lou hiam, ana zinmang hiam a-om zenzen uleh TOUPA a ding in Paikan Ankuangluina neih himhim ding ahi.
english: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to Yahweh.

paite: Akha nihna, ani sawm-le-li ni nitaklam in anei ding ua; tanghou silngou soh louh lou kha toh anek ding uh ahi.
english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

paite: Azing a ding in bangmah akoih ding uh ahi kei. Aguh leng ahihtan ding uh ahi kei. Paikan Ankuangluina a hih dia seh bang zel a ahih ding uh ahi.
english: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

paite: Himahleh, siang ngal a, zinmangna nei lou, Paikan Ankuangluina a tel lou mawkmawk ahihleh achipihte lak a pan huai mi satkhiak ding ahi. Ahunbi a TOUPA kiang a thillat alat louh ziak in huai mi in akhelh moh akipuak ding hi.
english: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of Yahweh in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

paite: "Namdangmi na kiang ua om in TOUPA a dia ankuangluina a tel sam a-utleh Paikan Ankuangluina a hih dia seh leh adan bang in ahih ding ahi. Hiai gam a mi mawng leh namdang mite a dia dan kikhat na neih ding uh ahi, chi in gen in,” achi hi.
english: “‘If a foreigner lives among you, and desires to keep the Passover to Yahweh; according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance, so shall he do. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner, and for him who is born in the land.’”

paite: Huchi in biakbuk lam khit ni in biakbuk, theihpihna puanin pen meipi in atuam liiliai hi. Nitaklam in biakbuk tung ah meikuang bangbang azingsang tan in a-om hi.
english: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony: and at evening it was over the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

paite: Huchibang in a-om nilouh a; meipi in atuam nilouh a, zan chiang in mei bang in akilang hi.
english: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

paite: Meipi in puanin akikhinsan teng in Israel suante'n pai ding vai ahawm zel ua; meipi khawlna mun peuh ah Israel suante'n giahphual asat zel uhi.
english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in Israel suante apai zel ua, TOUPA thupiak mah in giahphual asat uhi. Biakbuk tung a meipi a-om sung teng giahphual ah a-om nilouh uh.
english: At the commandment of Yahweh, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of Yahweh they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

paite: Biakbuk tung a meipi sawtpi a-omleh Israel suante'n TOUPA thu azui ua, apai kei uhi.
english: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept Yahweh’s command, and didn’t travel.

paite: Biakbuk tung a ni tam lou sung meipi a-om chiang in giahphual asat ua, TOUPA thupiak bang in, huchi in apai zel uhi.
english: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of Yahweh they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of Yahweh they traveled.

paite: Akalkal in meipi nitaklam a pan azingsang pha in a-om a; zingsang a meipi in atungkahsanleh apai zel uhi. Ni khat lel hiam, zan khat lel hiam om a meipi in atungkahsanleh apai zel uhi.
english: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled: or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

paite: Biakbuk tung a meipi ni nih hiam, kha khat hiam, kum khat hiam a-om a, huai a a-om nilouh leh Israel suante giahphual ah a-om nilouh ua, apai kei uh. Atungkahsanleh bel apai zel uhi.
english: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

paite: TOUPA thupiak in giahphual asat zel ua, TOUPA thupiak in apai zel uh. Mosi zang a TOUPA thupiak in TOUPA thu azui uhi.
english: At the commandment of Yahweh they encamped, and at the commandment of Yahweh they traveled. They kept Yahweh’s command, at the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.

paite: Jesu Khrist kilakna, Pathian in asikhate kiang a lahkhiak ding a amah apiak, thil hong om pah mahmah dingte. Huan ama'n asikha Johan kiang ah a-angel sawl in chiamtehna in atheisak hi.
english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel or, messenger (here and wherever angel is mentioned) to his servant, John,

paite: Johan in Pathian thu leh Jesu Khrist tungtang a athil muhte tengteng atheisakta hi.
english: who testified to God’s word, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

paite: Hiai genkholhna thute sim a, athute za a, huai a thil kigelhte zuite ahampha uhi; ahun anai tak ziak in.
english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.

paite: Johan in Asia gam a om saptuam sagihte kiang ah, amah omlel, omsa leh hong pai ngei dingpa a kipan leh alaltutphah ma a om, Kha sagihte a kipan in hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen;
english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

paite: huan Jesu Khrist, theihpihpa ginom, misite lak a piang masapen leh leitung a kumpipate vaihawmpa a kipan. Eite hon it a i khelhna a kipan a asisan a hon sawppa amah kiang ngei ah;
english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood;

paite: leh lalgam hi ding a hon bawl, Pathian leh a Pa kiang a siampute hi ding a hon bawl, amah kiang ah thupina leh vaihawmna, tangtawn tangtawn in om hen, Amen.
english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests Exodus 19:6; Isaiah 61:6 to his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

paite: Ngai in, meipi toh ahong pai hi; mit teng in amah amu ding ua, amah sunte'n leng; leitung a nam tengteng in amah asuun ding uh, huai bang hi hen, Amen.
english: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

paite: "Kei Alpha leh Omega, abul leh atawp," Toupa Pathian, omsa, omlel leh hong pai ding Bangkim hihthei in achi hi.
english: “I am the Alpha and the Omega, TR adds “the Beginning and the End” ” says the Lord God, TR omits “God” “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

paite: Kei, Johan, na unau uleh Jesu a om haksa thuakna leh lalgam leh kuhkalna a na tanpihpa uh, Pathian thu ziak leh Jesu theihpihna ziak in tuikulh gam Patmos kichi ah ka om hi.
english: I John, your brother and partner with you in oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

paite: Toupa ni in Kha in ka om a, ka nunglam ah aw ngaihtak in pengkul ging bang mai ka za hi.
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

paite: Aw in, "Kei Alpha leh Omega, abul leh atawp ka hi, na thil muhte laibu ah gelh inla, Asia gam a saptuam sagih, Ephesa, Smarna, Pergamos, Thiatira, Sardis, Philadelphia leh Laodisia kiang ah khak in," achih ka za hi.
english: saying, “ TR adds “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last.” What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies TR adds “which are in Asia” : to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

paite: Huan kei hon houpih huai aw muh tum in ka kihei hi. Huchi a ka kiheileh dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagih ka mu hi.
english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.

paite: Huai khawnvak koihna lai ah kuahiam Mihing Tapa toh kibang, akhepek tuampha puansilh, a-awm kimvel dangka-eng gakna a kigak ka mu hi.
english: And among the lampstands was one like a son of man, Daniel 7:13 clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

paite: Alu leh asamte samul ngou leh vuk bang in angou a; amitte meikuang bang ahi.
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

paite: Akhepekte sumsan nawttet meipi a halsiangsa abang a, huan a-aw tui tampi ging bang ahi.
english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

paite: Huan akhut taklam in aksi sagih atawi a; akam a kipan in namsau hiamtuah asuakkhia a; huan amel nisa asat san lai bang ahi.
english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

paite: Huchi a amah ka muhtak in, misi bang in akhebul ah ka puk hi. Huan ama'n ka tung a akhut taklam koih in, "Lau ke'n, amasapen leh ananungpen ka hi.
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

paite: Huai ahingpa ka hi; ka sita a, ngai in tangtawn in ka hing hi, sihna leh misi kho chabi ka nei hi.
english: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades or, Hell .

paite: Huaiziak in na thil muhsate, thil omlelte leh tunung a thil hong om dingte gelh in.
english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter;

paite: Ka khut taklam a aksi sagih na muhte leh dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagihte thuguk hiai ahi: Aksi sagihte saptuam sagihte angelte ahi ua; khawnvak koihna sagihte saptuam sagihte ahi uh," achi hi.
english: the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the angels or, messengers (here and wherever angels are mentioned) of the seven assemblies. The seven lampstands are seven assemblies.

paite: Huan meipi puansilh a kizem van a kipan angel hat dang hong paikhesuk ka mu hi; alutung ah sakhituihup a-om a, amai nisa mah abang a, akhete mei khuamte bang mai ahi.
english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

paite: Akhut a laibuzial neuchik honsa atawi a; akhe taklam a tuipi tung sik in akhe veilam leitung ah anga hi.
english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

paite: Humpinelkai humham bang in aw ngaihtak in akikou a; akikou khit in vanpiging sagihte'n a-aw uh asuah uhi.
english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

paite: Huan vanpiging sagihte'n a-aw uh asuahtak un gelh ding in ka kisa hi; van a kipan aw in, "Vanpiging sagihte' thugen iim bikbek inla gelhkhe ke'n,” achih ka za hi.
english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

paite: Huan tuipi tung leh leitung a angel dingh ka muh in van lam ah akhut taklam aliktou a;
english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky,

paite: huchi in huai tangtawn a hing van leh leitung leh asung a om tengteng leh tuipi leh asung a om tengteng siampa min lou in azekai nawnlouhna ding chi in akichiam hi.
english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

paite: Himahleh angel sagihna in amut ding pengkulpi agin chiang in, huai hun chiang in, "Pathian thuguk, asikha zawlneite kiang a agenkhiak tak hihkim in a-omta ding," chi in.
english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants, the prophets.

paite: Van a kipan a ka aw zak in kei hon houpih a, "Kuan inla, tuipi tung leh leitung a angel dingh khut a laibuzial neuchik honsa va la in,” achih ka za nawn hi.
english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

paite: Kei, angel kiang ah ka va hoh a, laibuzial neu hon pe ding in akiang ah ka va gen hi. Ama'n ka kiang ah, "La inla, ne zou vek in; huai in na gil hihkha in chin himahleh na kam ah khuaizu bang in akhum ding," achi hi.
english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it, and eat it up. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

paite: Huan angel khut a kipan in laibuzial neuchik ka la a, ka ne zou vek a; ka kam ah khuaizu bang in akhum a; huan ka nekzohtak in ka gil hihkhat in ahong om hi.
english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

paite: Huan ka kiang ah, "Mi tampite leh namte leh paute leh kumpipate kiang ah Pathian thusuak na genkholh nawn ngeingei ding ahi," ahon chi hi.
english: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

paite: Huan sialluang chiang bang tehna chiang khat piak in ka om a; angel in, "Thou inla, Pathian tempul leh maitam leh huai a bete teh in;
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise, and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

paite: tempul huangsung polam ahihleh nusia inla, teh ke'n; Zentelte kiang a piaksa ahih tak ziak in; huan kho siangthou akhenuai un kha sawmli-le-nih sung asikden ding uhi.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

paite: Huan ka theihpihtu nihte kiang ah thilhihtheihna ka pe dia, amau sai-ip puan silh in ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmguk thu agenkhol ding uh achi hi."
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

paite: Hiaite olive sing nihte leh khawnvak koihna nihte, leitung a Toupa ma a dinghte ahi uhi.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

paite: Mi kuapeuh in amau suknat atup ualeh, akam ua kipan a mei hong suakkhia in amelmate akangtum vek dia; kuapeuh in amau hihnat atup ualeh huchibang a thah in a-om ding uhi.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

paite: Hiai mite'n athugenkholh sung ua vuah azuklouhna ding in, van khaktheihna anei ua; huan a-ut hunhun ua sisan suaksak ding in tuite tung ah thu anei ua, leitung leng gawtna chiteng a gawt ding in thu anei uhi.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

paite: Huan atheihpihna nasep uh azoh chiang un, kokhuk taw nei lou a kipan a hong pawtkhia huai gamsa in amau akidoupih ding a, amau azou dia, athat ding hi.
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

paite: Asiluang uh khopi thupi kongzing ah akisial a, huai khalam thu ah Sodom leh Aigupta kichi, kros a Toupa kilhlup a a-omna mah ahi.
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

paite: Mite leh chite leh paute leh namte lak a kipan mite aluang uh ni thum-le-akim a-en ua, aluang uh han a vui aphal kei uhi.
