english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

paite: Huchi in leitung a tengte amaute tung a kisial in akipak ua, kipahna abawl ua; thilpiakte akikhaktuah ua; hiai zawlnei nihte'n amau leitung a tengte athuakgimsak khit tak ziak un.
english: Those who dwell on the earth rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

paite: Huan ni thum-le-akim nung in, Pathian a kipan in hinna hatna amau ah ahong lut a, akhe un adingh uhi; amau mu tengteng tung ah nakpi a launa ahong omta hi.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

paite: Van a kipan in aw thupitak aza ua, "Hiai ah hong paitou un," chi in. Huan amau meipi lak ah van ah apaitou uhi; amelmate un amau amu chiat uhi.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies saw them.

paite: Huai dak in zinling thupitak ahong om a, khopi mun sawm a khen mun khat achim hi. Huai zinling ah mi sangsagih thah in a-om ua; adangte'n alau ua, van a Pathian kiang ah thupina apia uhi.
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

paite: Tunggikna nihna abeita a; ngai in, tunggikna thumna ahong tung pah ding hi.
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

paite: Huan angel sagihna in apengkul amut a; van ah aw thupitak in, "Khovel lalgam tuh i Toupa leh a Khrist a ahong hita hi; ama'n tangtawn in vai ahawm ding," achi uhi.
english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

paite: Upa sawmnih-le-li, laltutphah tung a Pathian ma a tute'n amai ua lei si in Pathian abia uhi.
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

paite: "Na tung ah ka kipak uhi, Toupa Pathian Bangkim hihthei, omlel leh omsa leh hong om ding; na thilhihtheihna thupi na lak tak ziak in leh vai na hawm tak ziak in,
english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was TR adds “and who is coming” ; because you have taken your great power, and reigned.

paite: Namte aheh ua, tu in nang thangpaihna ni ahong tung hi, misite vai na hawmsak hun leh na sikha zawlneite leh misiangthoute kiang leh na min kihtate milian leh mineute kiang a kipahman na piakna hun leh leitung hihsete hihsiat a a-om sam hun uh ahong tungta hi," achi uhi.
english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints, and those who fear your name, to the small and the great; and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

paite: Huan van a om Pathian tempul hon in a-om a; atempul sung ah thukhun bawm ahong kimu hi; huchi in khophiate, awte, van-gingte, zinlingte leh gial thupitak in azui ngal hi.
english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

paite: Van ah chiamtehna thupi leh lamdangtak; numei khat ni a kizem, akhenuai a khapi sikden leh alutung a lallukhu aksi sawm-le-nih khu hong kimu hi.
english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

paite: Ama'n nau apai a, nauvei leh suakkhe ding natna in akapkhia hi.
english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

paite: Huan van ah chiamtehna dang khat ahong kilang a; ngai in, dragon san lianpi, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei, alutung a lallukhu sagih khu hong kilang hi.
english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

paite: Amei in van a aksite mun thum a khen mun khat akaikhia a, leitung ah apaikhia a; dragon in huai numei nau nei ding a kisa, aneih chiang a anau nek zoh tum in ama ah adingh hi.
english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

paite: Ta pasal naupang, sikchiang a nam tengteng tung a vaihawm ding anei a; atapa pen Pathian leh alaltutphah ah laktouh in a-om a,
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God, and to his throne.

paite: numei pen gamdai ah, Pathian in amah a dia amun bawlsak ah, huai ah ni sangkhat zanih-le-sawmguk khoi a om ding in atai hi.
english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

paite: Huan van ah kidouna a-om a; Mikael leh a-angelte dragon toh kidou ding in akuankhia ua; dragon leh a-angelte'n leng adouthuk uhi.
english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

paite: Huan azou kei ua, van ah amun himhim uh muh in a-omta kei hi.
english: They didn’t prevail, neither was a place found for him any more in heaven.

paite: Dragon lian, gulpi tek, diabol leh Setan chih a ompa, khovel pumpi khempa leh amah nasem angelte toh van a kipan paihkhiaksuk in a-om uhi.
english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

paite: Huan van ah aw ngaihtak mai ka za hi, "Tu'n ah i Pathian hotdamna ahong tungta, thilhihtheihna leh Khrist thuneihna; i unaute hekpa, i Pathian ma a sun leh zan a amau hekpa, paihkhiaksuk a a-om ziak in.
english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

paite: Belamnou sisan ziak leh atheihpih uh thu ziak in amah tung ah avualzouta ua; sih tanpha in leng ahinna uh a-it kei uhi.
english: They overcame him because of the Lamb’s blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn’t love their life, even to death.

paite: Huaiziak in kipak un, aw van leh nou asung a tengte, leitung leh tuipi a ding in atung uh agik; diabol in hun tomchik phet anei chih akitheih ziak in, aheh mahmah a na kiang uah ahong paisuk hi," chi in.
english: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.”

paite: Leitung a dragon paihkhiak ahita chih akitheihtak in, huai numei nau pasal neinu agawt hi.
english: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

paite: Himahleh huai numei kiang ah muvanlai thupitak kha nih piak in a-om a, gulpi mai a kipan gamdai mun a alenlut theihna ding in, huai ah hun khat sung leh hunte leh hun kimkhat sung vak in a-om hi.
english: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

paite: Gulpi in akam a kipan in tuipi bang tui luang a numei ataihmangsak theihna ding in numei nung ah asekhia hi.
english: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

paite: Lei in numei apanpih a, lei in akam aka a, dragon in akam a kipan a atui siatkhiak ana valhzohsak vekta hi.
english: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

paite: Numei tung ah dragon aheh mahmah a, asuan omsun, Pathian thupiak zuite leh Jesu thu theihpihte kidoupih ding in akuankhia hi.
english: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, who keep God’s commandments and hold Jesus’ testimony.

paite: Tuipi piau a ka dinleh tuipi a kipan gamsa khat, kii sawm leh lu sagih nei, akiite tung a lallukhu sawm om chiat, alutungte a Pathian gensiatna om, hong paikhetou ka mu hi.
english: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

paite: Ka gamsa muh gialbem abang a, akhe vompi khe abang a, akam humpinelkai kam abang hi; dragon in athuneihna thupi leh alaltutphah leh athilhihtheihnate amah apia hi.
english: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

paite: Alute lak a khat sihpih khop hial dia liam hileh kilawm in ka mu hi; sihpih khop hial dia liam pen hihdam in a-om a; huchi in leitung pumpi in huai gamsa lamdang sa in azuita uhi.
english: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

paite: Dragon, gamsa kiang a athuneihna petu abia ua; huchi in hiai gamsa abiak kawm in, "Hiai gamsa bang kua a-om a, amah kidoupih thei kua om ahia?" achi uhi.
english: They worshiped the dragon, because he gave his authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, “Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?”

paite: Huan gamsa kiang ah thil thupite leh Pathian gensiatnate genna ding kam piak in a-om a, huan akiang ah thuneihna piak in a-om hi; kha sawmli-le-nih thilhihtheihna piak ahi.
english: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

paite: Pathian gensiatna ding, amin gense ding leh a-omna, van a tengte ngei gensia in akamkata hi.
english: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his dwelling, those who dwell in heaven.

paite: Huan dragon in gamsa kiang ah misiangthoute kidoupih ding leh amaute zou ding in phalna apia a; chi chih, pau chih leh nam chih tung a thuneihna leng apia hi.
english: It was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

paite: Huan khovel om tung a pan thahsa Belamnou' hinna laibu a amin tuangloute tengteng leh leitung a teng tengteng in amah abe ding uhi.
english: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

paite: "Kuapeuh zakna ding bil nei in, za hen!"
english: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

paite: Kuapeuh sal a pi dingte sal a pi in a-om ding; kuapeuh namsau a thah dingte namsau a thah in a-om ding. Hiai ah misiangthoute kuhkalna leh ginna nei ding a chial ahi uh.
english: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. TR reads “If anyone leads into captivity, into captivity he goes. If anyone will kill with the sword, he must be killed with a sword.” instead of “If anyone has captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is with the sword, he must be killed.” Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

paite: Huan gamsa dang khat leitung a kipat a hong pawtkhetou ka mu a; belamnou bang in kii nih anei a, dragon bang in thu agen hi.
english: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.

paite: Gamsa masapen thuneihna tengteng amitmuh in azang hi. Leitung leh asung a teng tengteng gamsa masapen, si khop hial a liam hihdam a om, be ding in asawl hi.
english: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

paite: Huan mite mitmuh in van a kipan in leitung a mei kesuk thei khop in thillamdang pipi ahih hi.
english: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

paite: Huan gamsa sik leh amitmuh a thillamdang hihtheihna piak a a-omna in ama'n leitung a tengte akhem a; huai gamsa namsau a satliam leh dam nawn lim bawl ding in lei a tengte thu apia hi.
english: He deceives my own NU omits “my own” people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast; saying to those who dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

paite: Gamsa masa lim a nakna pe ding leh tua gamsa apau theihna ding in dragon in amah kiang ah thilhihtheihna apia a, huchi a gamsa lim be nuam lou tengteng leng athahsak theihna ding in.
english: It was given to him to give breath to it, to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn’t worship the image of the beast to be killed.

paite: Mi tengteng, aneu leh alian, azawng ahau, sikha leh sikha lou, akhut taklam uh hiam, atal uh hiam ah chiamtehna piak in a-om chiat uhi;
english: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands, or on their foreheads;

paite: huchi a kuamah in huai chiamtehna hiam, gamsa min hiam, ahihkeileh amin nambat neiloute'n lei thei lou hiam, zuak thei lou a a-omna ding in.
english: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell, unless he has that mark, the name of the beast or the number of his name.

paite: Hiai ah pilna a-om hi. Kuapeuh theihsiamna nei in, gamsa nambat sutkhia hen; huai lah mihing nambat ahi ngal a; huan ama nambat tuh zaguk sawmguk-le-guk ahi.
english: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

paite: Huai nung in ka etleh ngai in, Zion tang tung a Belamnou dingh ka mu a, akiang ah mipi nuaikhat singli-le-sangli, atal ua a Pa min kigelh chiatte toh adingkhawm uhi.
english: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

paite: Tui tampi leh vanpiging bang a ging van a kipan in aw ka za a; ka aw zak gosem tumte'n agosem uh atumging uh abang a;
english: I heard a sound from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

paite: laltutphah leh thil hing lite ma leh upate ma ah la thak hileh kilawm khat asa ua; leitung a kipat a huai leikhiaksate, nuaikhat singli-le-sanglite lou ngal kuamah in huai la atheithei kei uhi.
english: They sing a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

paite: Hiaite numei lak a kihihninloute ahi ua; nungak siangthou bang ahi uhi. Hiaite apaina lamlam ua Belamnou zuite ahi uhi. Pathian a ding leh Belamnou a ding a gah masapen hi ding a mite lak a kipan a leisate ahi uhi.
english: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

paite: Huan akam uah zuau a-om kei a; amaute lah Pathian laltutphah ma ah gensiatbei ahi ngal ua.
english: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless. TR adds “before the throne of God”

paite: Huan angel dang van laizawl a leng ka mu a, ama'n tangtawn tanchinhoih, leitung a tengte kiang leh nam chih leh chi chih leh pau chih leh michihte kiang a genkhiak ding anei hi.
english: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

paite: Aw ngaihtak in, "Pathian kihta unla, amah thupina pia un; avaihawmna hun ahong tungta ngal a; van leh lei leh tuipi leh tuikhukte siampa amah bia un," achi hi.
english: He said with a loud voice, “Fear the Lord, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!”

paite: Huan angel nihna in ahon zui a, "Pukta, pukta Babulon kho thupi, nam tengteng a mingaihhatna, hehna uain dawnsaknu,” achi hi.
english: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.”

paite: Angel thumna in amau ahon zui a, aw ngaihtak in, "Kuapeuh gamsa leh alim bia, atal hiam akhut hiam a chiamtehna neite'n
english: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, “If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead, or on his hand,

paite: Pathian thangpaihna uain adawn ding ua, huai uain thangpaihna nou, bangmah toh hel louh hial a bawl ahi; angel siangthoute leh Belamnou muh in amah mei leh kaat in hihnat in om in teh.
english: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb.

paite: Huan ahihnatna meikhu uh tangtawn tangtawn in azamtou dia; huai gamsa leh alim bete leh kuapeuh amin chiamtehna nei taphot in sun leh zan in tawlngakna anei kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

paite: Hiai ah misiangthou, Pathian thupiakte leh Jesu ginna zuite kuhkalna nei ding a chialna a-om hi.
english: Here is the patience of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”

paite: Huan van a kipan aw in hichibang in, "Gelh in, tua kipan in misite, Toupa a site ahampha uh," Kha in, "Ahi, asepgimna uh akhawlsanta ding ua, athilhihte un hon zui ding ahih ziak in," achih uh ka za hi.
english: I heard the voice from heaven saying, “Write, ‘Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.’” “Yes,” says the Spirit, “that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.”

paite: Huan ka etleh ngai in, meipi ngou ka mu a; huai mei tung ah mi khat Mihing Tapa toh kibang, alu a dangka-eng lallukhu khu, akhut a kawite hiamtak tawi ka mu hi.
english: I looked, and behold, a white cloud; and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, Daniel 7:13 having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

paite: Angel dang tempul a kipan ahong paikhia a, meipi tung a tupa kiang ah ngaihtak in, "Na kawite lik inla, at in; at hun atungta; leitung buh amingawpta," chi in akikou hi.
english: Another angel came out from the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, “Send forth your sickle, and reap; for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!”

paite: Huai mei tung a tupa'n leitung ah akawite alik a; leitung at in a-omta hi.
english: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

paite: Huan van a om tempul a kipan in angel dang ahong paikhia a, ama'n leng kawite hiamtak atawi hi.
english: Another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

paite: Huan meikuang tung a thilhihtheihna nei, angel dang maitam ma a kipan in ahong paikhia a; ama'n aw ngaihtak in, huai kawite tawipa sam in, "Na kawite hiamtak lik inla, leitung a grep gahbomte lakhawm in; grepte amin mahmahta hi,” achi hi.
english: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, “Send forth your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth’s grapes are fully ripe!”

paite: Huai angel in leitung ah akawite alik a, leitung a grep gahte alakhawm a, Pathian thangpaihna, uain sukna thupi, uain sukna ah apailut hi.
english: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

paite: Kho polam ah uain sukna chil in a-om a, uain sukna a kipan sakol kamkaihna tanpha louching sangkhat-le-zaguk pha in sisan aluangkhia hi.
english: The winepress was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out from the winepress, even to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia. 1600 stadia = 296 kilometers or 184 miles

paite: Huan chiamtehna thupi leh lamdang, angel sagih, hii nanung sagih, ananungpente, Pathian hehna toh kidim tawi, van ah ka mu hi.
english: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God’s wrath is finished.

paite: Huan limlang tuipi hileh kilawm, mei toh kihel leh gamsa leh alim leh amin nambat tung a vualzoute, akhut ua Pathian gosem tawi a, limlang tuipi kiang a dingh ka mu a,
english: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, TR adds “his mark,” and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

paite: amau Pathian sikha, Mosi la leh Belamnou la asa uhi. "Na thilhihte thupi in alamdang hi. Aw Toupa Pathian, Bangkim hihthei! Na lampite adik in atang uhi, Misiangthoute Kumpipa, chi in.
english: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, “Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

paite: Toupa aw, kua'n ahia na min hih thupi a lau lou ding? Nang kia lah siangthou na hi ngal a. Namte tengteng hong pai in na ma ah ahong be ding uh, na thilhih diktatte lah hihlat in omta ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: Who wouldn’t fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.”

paite: Hiai thilte ka muh nung in, van a theihsakna biakbuk dantan sungnung hon in a-om a;
english: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

paite: huan hiai dantan sungnung a kipan in angel sagih, gawtna sagih nei, puanmalngat siangthou leh vak a kizem a, dangka-eng kawnggak a a-awm ua kigakte ahong paikhia uhi.
english: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their breasts.

paite: Thil hing lite lak a khat in angel sagihte kiang ah tangtawn tangtawn a hing Pathian hehna a dim dangka-eng belhbu sagihte apia hi.
english: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

paite: Huchi in Pathian thupina athilhihtheihna a kipan meikhu in tempul hihdim in a-om hi; angel sagihte gawtna sagihte atunkim masiah asung ah kuamah alut theita kei uhi.
english: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

paite: Huan tempul dantan sungnung a kipan hong suak aw thupi in, angel sagihte kiang ah, "Kuan unla, leitung ah Pathian thangpaihna belhbu sagihte va sungkhia un," achih ka za hi.
english: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, “Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!”

paite: Amasapen akuan a, leitung ah abelhbu asungkhia a, huai gamsa chiamtehna nei, alim bemite tung ah meima sia leh nai in ahong suak hi.
english: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and evil sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

paite: Anihna in tuipi tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; misite si bang in sisan ahong suak a; tuipi sung a thil omte tanpha in hinna nei peuhmah asita uhi.
english: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

paite: Athumna pen in luite leh tui nakte tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; sisan ahong suak uhi.
english: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

paite: Tuite angel in, "Nang omsa leh omlel, nang Siangthoupa aw, hichibang a vai na hawm tak ziak in na diktat hi.
english: I heard the angel of the waters saying, “You are righteous, who are and who were, you Holy One, because you have judged these things.

paite: Amau misiangthoute leh zawlneite sisan asuah ua, nang adawn ding ua sisan na piak, aphu tawk him uh ahi,” achih ka za hi.
english: For they poured out the blood of the saints and the prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”

paite: Huan maitam in, “Ahi, Toupa Pathian aw, Bangkim hihthei, na vaihawmte adik in adiktathuai hi!" achih ka za hi.
english: I heard the altar saying, “Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.”

paite: Alina pen in nisa tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; amah kiang ah mite meikuang a hainat theihna piak in a-om hi.
english: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

paite: Asat a sa a mite hainat in a-om ua; hichibang natnate tung a thilhihtheihna nei, Pathian min agensia ua; Pathian kiang a thupina pe ding in akisik tuan kei uhi.
english: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn’t repent and give him glory.

paite: Angana in gamsa tutphah tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; huan alalgam hihmial in a-om a; amau na sa in alei uh akei ua,
english: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

paite: anatna uh leh ameimate uh ziak in amau tuh van a Pathian agensia ua; athilhihte uah akisik tuan kei uhi.
english: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn’t repent of their works.

paite: Agukna in Euphrates Luipi thupi tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; huai tui akang vek hi, huchi a suahlam a kipan kumpipate lampi ding bawlsa a a-omtheihna ding in.
english: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

paite: Dragon kam a kipan leh gamsa kam a kipan leh zawlnei taklou kam a kipan in kha nin thum, ukeng bang mai hong paikhia ka mu hi.
english: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

paite: Amaute ahih uleh dawite kha, thillamdang hihte; khovel pumpi leh lei kumpipate kiang a hong a, Pathian Bangkim hihtheipa Ni thupi a kidouna a dia amaute pikhawmte ahi uhi.
english: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go forth to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God, the Almighty.

paite: "Ngai in, guta bang in ka hong pai hi! Kiveng leh puan tengsa a ommi ahampha hi, huchi lou in zaw vuaktang in a-om dia; azumhuaina amu kha ding uhi."
english: “Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn’t walk naked, and they see his shame.”

paite: Huchi in amaute mun khat, Hebru pau a "Armageddon" kichi ah apikhawm uhi.
english: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, Megiddo.

paite: Asagihna in huihkhua tung ah abelhbu asungkhia a; huan laltutphah a kipan in dantan sungnung ah aw ngaihtak ahong suakkhia a, "Zoh ahita!" achi hi.
english: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came forth out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, “It is done!”

paite: Huchi in khophiate, awte, van-gingte, leh zinling thupi ahong om a, huchibang a thupi leh hat leitung a mihing om nungsiah om ngei nai lou zinling thupi ahi.
english: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since there were men on the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.

paite: Khopi thupi mun thum in akikhen a, namte' khopite achim ua; Babulon khopi thupi Pathian mitmuh in theihgige in a-om a, adawn ding in ahehna kihtakhuai uain nou piak in a-om hi.
english: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

paite: Tuikulh gam chiteng ataimang ua, tang sangte muh phak in a-omta kei hi.
english: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

paite: Huan van a kipan in gial lian pipi, talent khat a gik mite tung ah ahong kesuk hi; mite'n huai gial a gawtna ziak in Pathian agensia ua; huai gawtna athupi mahmah hi.
english: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, 1 talent is about 34 kilograms or 75 pounds came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague is exceedingly severe.

paite: Huai thil nung in belhbu sagih tawi angel sagihte lak a khat hong pai in kei ahong houpih a, "Hong pai in, tui tampite tung a tu kizuaknu thupi tung a vaihawmna ka hon ensak ding.
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

paite: Leitung kumpipate amah toh akingai ua, huan amingaihna uain in leitung a tengte khamsak in a-om uh," achi hi.
english: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.”

paite: Ama'n Kha in gamdai ah hon pomang a; huan gamsa san-au, Pathian gensiatna min a pumdim, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei tung a numei khat tu ka mu hi.
english: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored animal, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

paite: Huai numei in puan sandup leh puan sandang asilh a, dangka-eng leh suangmantam leh tuikepsuang in akizem hi; akhut in dangka-eng nou, thilkihhuaite leh angkawm nitna a dim atawi hi.
english: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

paite: Huan ataltang ah, "Babilon thupi, kizuakte leh leitung a kihhuaite nu," chih min khat akigelh hi.
english: And on her forehead a name was written, “MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.”

paite: Huan huai numei, misiangthoute sisan leh Jesu martarte sisan dawnkham in ka mu hi. Huai minu ka muhtak in lamdang ka sa mahmah hi.
english: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

paite: Huan angel in ka kiang ah, "Bangziak a lamdang sa na hia? Huai numei leh amah pua gamsa, lu sagih leh kii sawm nei, thuguk ka hon hilh ding, achi hi.
english: The angel said to me, “Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

paite: Huai na gamsa muh a-om khin a, huan a-om kei a; kokhuk taw nei lou a kipan a hong paikhe ding ahi, manthatna a pai ding ahi. Huan leitung a tengte, khovel siam tung a kipan a hinna laibu a min gelhlouhte'n tua gamsa om khin a, om lou leh hong om ding ahihdan amuh chiang un lamdang asa ding uhi.
english: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present. TR reads “yet is” instead of “shall be present”

paite: "Hiai ah pilna lungsim neih akul hi. Lu sagihte numei tutna tang sang sagihte ahi uhi.
english: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.

paite: Huan kumpipa sagihte a-om ua; nga apuk khin ua, khat a-om lel a, khat ahong tung nai kei hi. Ahong tun chiang in, hun tomchik sung a-om ding hi.
english: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

paite: Huai gamsa na om khinsa, tua om lou pen kumpi giatna ahi. Amah sagihte lak a tel ahi; huan manthatna ah apai ding hi.
english: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

paite: "Huan kii sawm na muhte, lalgam nei nai lou, kumpipa sawmte ahi ua; himahleh dakkal khat lel, huai gamsa toh amau kumpipate bang in thuneihna anei ding uhi.
english: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.

paite: Hiaite'n lungsim khat nei in, gamsa kiang ah athilhihtheihna leh athuneihna uh apia uhi.
english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

paite: Hiaite'n Belamnou akidoupih ding ua, Belamnou in amau azou dia, amah toupate' Toupa leh kumpipate' Kumpipa ahih ziak in; amah toh omkhawmte bel sapte, telte leh muanhuaite ahi uhi.”
english: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings. They also will overcome who are with him, called and chosen and faithful.”

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Kizuaknu tutna tui na muhte mite leh mipite leh namte leh paute ahi uhi.
english: He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

paite: Kii sawm na muhte leh na gamsa muhte'n kizuaknu amudah ding ua, suanbei leh vuaktang asuaksak ding uhi, asa ane ding ua, amah mei in ahaltum vek ding uhi.
english: The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, and will make her desolate, and will make her naked, and will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

paite: Pathian thu hihkim a a-om mateng, amah deihlam ahihna ding uleh, lungsim khat aneihna ding uleh, alalgam uh gamsa kiang a apiakna ding un, Pathian in amau ah ngaihtuahna akoih hi.
english: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, and to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

paite: "Huan na numei muh khopi thupi, leitung kumpipate tung a vaihawmnu ahi,” achi lai hi.
english: The woman whom you saw is the great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.”

paite: Hiai thil nung in van a kipan angel dang, thuneihna liantak nei, van a kipan hong paikhesuk ka mu a; athupina in leitung avaksak hi.
english: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

paite: Aw ngaihtak in akikou a, "Chimta, chimta Babulon khopi thupi, dawite omna leh kha nin tengteng kulh leh vasa nin leh huathuai teng kulh ahong hita hi.
english: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hateful bird!

paite: Nam tengteng in amingaihna hehna uain a nam tengteng dawnkhamsak a-om ua, leitung Kumpipate'n amah akingaihpih ua, leitung sumsinte noptal luatna a ahong hauh tak ziak un," achi hi.
english: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.”

paite: Huan van a kipan in aw dang in hichibang in agen hi: "Ka mite akhelhna ua na pan khaklouhna ding uh leh ahii na kailouhna ding un, amah a kipan in hong paikhia un, achih ka za hi.
english: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don’t receive of her plagues,

paite: Akhelhna van atungta a, Pathian in akhelhnate atheigige hi.
english: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

paite: Ama'n hon piak bangmah akiang ah pia unla, amah gamtatna aleh nih in thukkik un; ahelna nou ah amah a ding in aleh nih in helsak un,
english: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

paite: Akithupisakna zahzah leh anoptalna zah in amah bawlgim un, hihlungkham un; ama'n alungsim a, 'Kumpinu in ka tu a, meithai ka hi kei, bangchi mah in ka lungkham ngei kei ding,' achih ziak in.
english: However much she glorified herself, and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, ‘I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.’

paite: Huaiziak in ni khat sung in hipi a gawtna, sihna, lungkhamna leh kialna ahong tung ding hi; huan amah mei in halmang vek in om in teh; atung a vaihawm Toupa Pathian ahat ziak in."
english: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

paite: Huan leitung a kumpipate amah kingaihpih leh nuamtat a omte'n, amah haltumna meikhu amuh chiang un, amah kah in amau ding uhi.
english: The kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her, will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

paite: Athuakna a hihnat a om ding lau in gamlapi a dingh in, "Maizen! Maizen! Khopi thupi Babilon! Dakkal khat sung a na tung a vaihawmna ahong tung ngal a," achi ding uhi.
english: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.’

paite: Huan leitung a sumsinte'n, asumsinna van uh kuamah in alei louh ziak un, kap in asuun ding uhi.
english: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more;

paite: Huan asumsinna vante uh dangka-eng leh dangka a sumsinna van, suangmantam, tuikepsuang, puanmalngat hoih, puansan, maimom puan, puan eng, singnamtui, saiha a bawl van, sing mantampen chi a van bawl tengteng, sumsan leh sik leh marbul suang a belsuan bawl tengteng;
english: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

paite: leh singguithak, namtui, namtui haichi, thaunamtui, chim, uain, thau, buhnel, buh, belam, huan sakol kangtalai leh sal, huai tuh mite hinna ahi.
english: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, sheep, horses, chariots, and people’s bodies and souls.

paite: "Huan na lungsim a na deih gahte'n nang hon taimangsan ua, thil limchi leh hoih teng in nang ahon manthatsan ua, muh nawn ahi ngei kei ding," achi uhi.
english: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

paite: Hiai thilte a sumsinte, amah ziak a hau a bawlte'n, amah hihnat a a-omna lau in gamlapi a dingh in, kap in asuun ding uhi.
english: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;

paite: “Maizen! Maizen! Khopi thupi, puanmalngat hoih, asan leh a-eng a kizem a, dangka-eng, suangmantam leh tuikepsuang a kivannu!
english: saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

paite: Dakkal khat in hichi tel a hauhna thupi bangmah lou a bawl a a-om ziak in,” achi ding uhi. Huan longpute leh akoilam lam a long a hong tungte leh long mite leh tuipi a nek zong tengteng gamlapi ah adingh uhi.
english: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.’ Every shipmaster, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

paite: Amau khopi kang leh halna meikhu amuh chiang un, "Hiai bang kho thupi a-om ngei hiam," chi in akikou uhi.
english: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, ‘What is like the great city?’

paite: Huan alutung ua leivui kibuak in akikou ua, kap leh suun in, "Maizen! Maizen! Kho thupi huai a tuipi a mi longnei tengteng ama hauhsakna ziak a hauhsak in a-om uhi! Dakkal khat sung a amah bangmah lou ahong hih tak mai, achi ding uhi.
english: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, ‘Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!’ For in one hour is she made desolate.

paite: "Aw nang van, amah tung ah kipak unla, Aw nou misiangthoute leh nou sawltakte leh nou zawlneite; na tung ua avaihawmna Pathian in ama tung a vai ahawm tak ziak in kipak un!" achi uhi.
english: “Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”

paite: Huan angel hat khat in buhgawina suang lianpi hileh kilawm suang khat adom a, tuipi ah apailut a, "Hichibang in khopi thupi, Babulon nakpi a hihchip in om in chin, muhkhiak nawn louh hial in a-om ding.
english: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

paite: Gosem tumte leh lasiamte leh tamngai tumte leh pengkul tumte, na sung ah akiza nawn kei hial ding hi. Khutsiam siamna nei himhim, na sung ah muhkhiak in om nawn kei hial un chin; na sung ah khawl ging akiza nawn sam kei ding hi.
english: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of whatever craft, will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

paite: Na sung ah meivak avak nawn kei ding a; mouneipa aw leh mou aw na sung ah akiza nawn kei ding; na sumsinte lah leitung kumpipate ahi ngal ua; na bumsiamna in nam tengteng khem in a-omta uhi!
english: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you; for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

paite: "Amah sung ah zawlneite sisan leh misiangthoute sisan leh leitung a thah a omte tengteng sisan akimukhia hi," achi hi.
english: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

paite: Hiai thilte nung in van ah mipi aw hileh kilawm in, "Hallelujah! Hotdamna leh thupina leh thilhihtheihna i Pathian a ahi;
english: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God:

paite: avaihawmna adik in akizen hi; kizuaknu thupi leitung a, amingaihna a hihsenu tung a vai ahawm tak ziak in, ama'n asikhate sisan ama tung ah athukta," achih ka za hi.
english: for true and righteous are his judgments. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.”

paite: "Hallelujah! Huai khopi halna meikhu tangtawn tangtawn in azamtou hi," chi in akikou nawn uhi.
english: A second said, “Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.”

paite: Upa sawmnih-le-lite leh thil hing lite abokkhup ua, Pathian laltutphah a tupa, "Amen, Hallelujah!" chi in abia uhi.
english: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, “Amen! Hallelujah!”

paite: Huan laltutphah a kipan in aw ahong pawtkhia a, "Nou asikhate aw, na vek un, aneu leh alian, nou amah laute, Pathian phatna pia un," chi in.
english: A voice came forth from the throne, saying, “Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!”

paite: Mipi tampi aw hileh kilawm tui tampi ging bang leh vanpiging bang aw in, “Hallelujah! Toupa i Pathian Bangkim hihthei in vai ahawm ziak in,
english: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

paite: nuam ni, nakpitak in kipak ni, amah kiang ah thupina pia in; Belamnou zineih hun ahong tungta hi. Azi leng akisak khit tak ziak in;
english: Let us rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let us give the glory to him. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.”

paite: amah puanmalngat hoih leh siangthou a kizepna ding in piak in a-omta, achih ka za hi, tua puanmalngat hoih misiangthoute nasep diktatte ahi."
english: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen: for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

paite: Huan angel in ka kiang ah, "Gelh in, Belamnou zineihna nitak ankuang um ding a chial a omte ahampha uhi," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “Write, ‘Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.’” He said to me, “These are true words of God.”

paite: Huan amah be ding in akhebul ah ka puk hi. Huan ka kiang ah, "Hon be kei hial in; Jesu thu theihpihna kem nangmah unau leh sikha hihpih ka hi; Pathian be zaw in, Jesu thu theihpihna genkholhna kha ahih ziak in," achi hi.
english: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, “Look! Don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.”

paite: Huan van kihong ka mu a; ngai in, sakol kang leh atung a tuang Ginom leh Dik kichi leng ka mu hi; ama'n dikna a vaihawm in kidouna abawl hi.
english: I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

paite: Amit meikuang bang ahi a, alutung ah lallukhu tampi a-om a, min khat amah lou ngal kuamah theih louh kigelh anei hi.
english: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

paite: Amah puan sisan a diah in akizem a; amin, "Pathian Thu,” chih ahi.
english: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called “The Word of God.”

paite: Amah van a om sepaihhon puanmalngat hoih, ngou leh siangthou silh a sakol kang tung a tuang in ahon zui uhi.
english: The armies which are in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in white, pure, fine linen.

paite: Akam a kipan in namte asatna ding, namsau hiam khat ahong suakkhia a; amau tung ah sikchiang in vai ahawm dia; Pathian Bangkim hihthei hehna lauhuaina uain sukna achil hi.
english: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. Psalm 2:9 He treads the winepress of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

paite: Apuan tung leh aphei tung ah min, "KUMPIPATE' KUMPIPA, LEH TOUPATE' TOUPA," chih akigelh hi.
english: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, “KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

paite: Huan angel khat ni a dingh ka mu a; amah aw ngaihtak a kikou in, van laizawl a vasa leng tengteng kiang ah, "Hong unla, Pathian nitak an thupi ah hong kikhawm vek un;
english: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, “Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God, TR reads “supper of the great God” instead of “great supper of God”

paite: Kumpipate sa, sepaih heutute sa, mihatte sa, sakolte sa, atung a tute sa, mi tengteng sa, sikha leh sikhaloute sa leh milian leh mineu sa na nektheihna ding un," achi hi.
english: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, and small and great.”

paite: Huai gamsa leh leitung a kumpipate leh asepaihte uh, huai sakol tung a tuangpa leh asepaihte kidoupih ding in ahong kikhawm uhi.
english: I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse, and against his army.

paite: Gamsa mat in a-om a, zawlnei tak lou, ama a chiamtehna hih a gamsa chiamtehna neite leh amah limbete akhempa toh amankhawm a; anih tuak un ahing in meidil, kaat a kang sung ah paihlut in a-om uhi.
english: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

paite: Huan adangte huai sakol tung a tupa kam a kipan a hong suak namsau a thah in a-om uhi; vasa tengteng amau sa in gilvah in a-om uhi.
english: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came forth out of his mouth. All the birds were filled with their flesh.

paite: "Ephesa saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Akhut taklam a aksi sagih tawi dangka-eng khawnvak koihna sagih lai a vialvakpa'n hiai thilte agen hi.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lampstands says these things:

paite: "Na thilhihte, na sepgimdan leh na kuhkaldan, migiloute na ngaihmohdan leh hiloupi a amau sawltak kichite na ze-et a, amaute zuauthei ahi uh chih na muhkhiakdan ka thei hi.
english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

paite: Huan thuakzohna na nei a, ka min ziak in na thuak teitei a, huchi in leng na bah kei hi.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have TR adds “have labored and” not grown weary.

paite: Himahleh na hon itna masapen na tawpsan thu ah ka hon dem hi.
english: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

paite: Huaiziak in na pukna laitak theigige inla, kisik in, na thilhih masapente hih nawn in; huchi lou in zaw na kiang ah ka hong pai dia, na kisik keileh a-omna a kipan in na khawnvak koihna ka suan ding hi.
english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lampstand out of its place, unless you repent.

paite: Himahleh hiai thu ah na hoih, Nikol pawlte thilhihte na hua a, ke'n leng huaite ka hua hi.
english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa kiang ah Pathian Paradis a om, anek ding in hinna sing ka pe ding achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

paite: "Huan Smarna a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Amasapen leh ananungpen, huai si a hing nawnta in hiai thilte agen hi.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

paite: "Na thilhihte, na gimthuakdan leh na zawndan, himahleh na hau hi, Judate hilou napi, ahi a kigen Setan sinagogte Pathian gensiatna ka thei hi.
english: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

paite: Na thuak pah ding thilte kihta ke'n; ngai in, ze-et a na omtheihna ding un diabol in na lak ua akhente suangkul ah ahon khum pah ding; ni sawm sung gimthuakna na nei ding uhi. Sihpha in ginom in om in, huchi in hinna lallukhu ka hon pe ding hi.
english: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa sih nihna hihnat in a-om kei ding achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

paite: "Huan Pergamom a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Namsau hiamtak hiamtuah nei in hiai thilte agen hi.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

paite: "Na tenna leh Setan laltutphah omna leng ka thei; ka min kiptak in na lenden a, Setan tenna mun a ka palai ginom, Antipas thah a a-om lai in leng na ginna na tawpsan tuan kei hi.
english: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

paite: Himahleh demna zek ka hon nei, huai lai a mi khenkhat Balaam sinsakna zuite na ompih ziak in, Israel suante ma a kipukna koih ding leh milimte kiang a kithoihna thilte ne ding leh kingaihna khelhna hih ding in ama'n tuh Balak athuhilh hi.
english: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

paite: Huchibang mah in Nikol pawlte sinsakna zui, mi khenkhat mah na ompih hi.
english: So you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans likewise TR reads “which I hate” instead of “likewise” .

paite: Huaiziak in kisik in; huchi lou in zaw na kiang ah ka hong pai pah dia, amau ka kam a namsau in ka dou ding hi.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly, and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen. Avualzoupa kiang ah manna selguk ka pe ding, huan suangpek ka pe dia, huai suang tung ah min thak, aneipa lou ngal kuamah in atheih louh a kigelh achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, Manna is supernatural food, named after the Hebrew for “What is it?”. See Exodus 11:7-9. and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no one knows but he who receives it.

paite: "Huan Thiatira a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Pathian Tapa, meikuang bang mit nei a, sumsan nawttet bang khe neipa'n, hiai thilte agen hi.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

paite: Na thilhihte leh na itna leh na ginna leh na nasepna leh na thuakzohna ka thei hi, amasapen sang in na thilhih nanungte atamzaw hi.
english: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

paite: Himahleh hiai thu ah demna ka hon nei hi, huai numei Jezebel, zawlnei kichinu khawk na sak louh ziak in; ama'n ka sikhate kingaihna khelhna hih ding leh milimte kiang a kithoihna thilte ne ding a khem in ahilh hi.
english: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your TR, NU read “that” instead of “your” woman, Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality, and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

paite: Huchi in amah akisikna ding in hun ka pia hi; huan amingaihna khelhna ah akisik tuan kei hi.
english: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

paite: Ngai in, amah damlou lupna ah ka pai ding a, athilhihte akisik tuan keileh amah angkawm teng leng gimthuakna thupi ah ka pai ding hi.
english: Behold, I will throw her into a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

paite: Huan hipi in atate ka that dia; saptuamte tengteng in lungsim kiheinate leh lungtang theipa kei ka hi chih athei ding uh; na thilhihte bangbang un na lak ua mi tengteng ka pe ding hi.
english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

paite: "Himahleh, nou, Thiatira a om midangte hiai thuhilh nei lou a, 'Setan thil thukte' thei lou tengteng kiang ah tunggikna dang na tung uah ka hon behlap kei ding, ka chi hi.
english: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira, as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan,’ to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

paite: Himahleh ka hong mateng na neih pen uh lenkip un.
english: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

paite: Huan avualzoupa leh atawp pha a ka nnate kempa kiang ah, namte tung a thuneihna ka pe ding hi;
english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

paite: ama'n sikchiang in amau tung ah vai ahawm ding a, leibel bang in amaute akhentam ding hi, hiai thuneihna ka Pa a pan ka muh ahi.
english: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots; Psalm 2:9 as I also have received of my Father:

paite: Huan amah zingsol aksi ka pe ding hi.
english: and I will give him the morning star.

paite: Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

paite: Huan angel khat van a kipan a hong paikhesuk, akhut a kokhuk taw nei lou honna chabi leh khainiang lianpi tawi ka mu hi.
english: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

paite: Ama'n dragon, gulpi tek, diabol leh Setan aman a, kum sangkhat sung a ding in amah ahen hi.
english: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

paite: Kum sangkhat achin ma a namte akhem nawnlouhna ding in amah kokhuk taw nei lou ah paihlut in a-om a, akhakkhum a, amah akilhkhum hi; tunung in sawt lou kal amah khah nawn a om ding ahi.
english: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it, and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

paite: Huan laltutphahte leh atung a tute ka mu a, amaute kiang ah vaihawmna piak in a-om hi; Jesu thu theihsakna ziak leh Pathian thu ziak a angawng uh sattan a omte kha ka mu a, huaite gamsa leh alim beloute, atal ua leh akhut ua achiamtehna neiloute ahi ua; amaute ahong hing ua, Khrist toh kum sangkhat vai ahawm uhi.
english: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus, and for the word of God, and such as didn’t worship the beast nor his image, and didn’t receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived, and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

paite: Hiai pen thohnawnna masapen ahi. Misi dangte bel kum sangkhat abei mateng ahingkik kei uhi.
english: The rest of the dead didn’t live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

paite: Thohnawnna masapen a pangte ahampha un asiangthou uhi; amaute tung a sih nihna in hihtheih aneih louh ziak in; himahleh amau Pathian leh Khrist siampute ahong hi ding ua, kum sangkhat sung amah toh vai ahawm ding uhi.
english: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

paite: Huan kum sangkhat abei chiang in, atanna suangkul a kipan Setan khahkhiak in a-om dia,
english: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison,

paite: leitung kil li a om namte, Gog leh Magog khem a amau kidouna mun a pikhawm ding in amah ahong paikhe pah dia; atamdan uh tuipi piaunel bang ahi uhi.
english: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war; the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

paite: Huan amau leitung vailam khaksuak in apaitou ua, misiangthoute giahphual leh khopi it, akimvel in a-um uhi. Huan van a kipan in mei ahong kesuk a, amaute akangtum vek hi.
english: They went up over the breadth of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God, and devoured them.

paite: Huan amaute khempa diabol gamsa leh zawlnei taklou omna, mei leh kaat dil ah paihlut in a-om uhi; tangtawn tangtawn in sun leh zan in hihnat in a-omta ding uhi.
english: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

paite: Huan laltutphah ngou thupi leh atung a tu ka mu a; amai a kipan lei leh van ataimang a, amaute a ding in mun himhim a-om kei hi.
english: I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found no place for them.

paite: Misite, aneu leh alian, huai laltutphah ma a dinghte ka mu a; laibute akihong a; laibu dang, hinna laibu leng akihong a; misite huai laibute a thil kigelhte a kipan in athilhih bang ua vai hawmsak in a-om uhi.
english: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

paite: Tuipi in asung a om misite ahon pawtsak a; sihna leh misikhua in asung ua misi omte ahon pawtsak ua; mi chiteng athilhih bangbang ua vai hawmsak in a-om uhi.
english: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades or, Hell gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

paite: Sihna leh misikhua meidil ah paihlut in a-om uhi. Hiai meidil pen sih nihna ahi.
english: Death and Hades or, Hell were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

paite: Kuapeuh hinna laibu a kigelh amuh louh uh, meidil ah paihlut in a-om uhi.
english: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

paite: Huan van masapen leh lei masapen abei tak ziak un van thak leh lei thak ka mu a; tuipi leng a-om nawnta kei hi.
english: I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

paite: Khopi siangthou, Jerusalem thak, mou apasal a ding a kizem bang a bawlzohsa a om, Pathian a kipan van ahong paikhesuk ka mu hi.
english: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

paite: Huan laltutphah a kipan aw thupitak ka zak in, "Ngai in, mihingte lak ah Pathian biakbuk a-om a, amau lak ah ateng dia amau amite ahi ding ua, Pathian mahmah in amaute a-ompih dia, a Pathian uh ahi ding hi.
english: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, “Behold, God’s dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

paite: Huan amit ua kipan in khitui tengteng anulhul dia; sihna a-om nawn kei dia; lusuun leh kah leh natna himhim leng a-om nawn kei ding hi,” achi hi.
english: He will wipe away from them every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”

paite: Huan laltutphah tung a tupa'n, "Ngai in, thil tengteng ka siam thakta," achi hi. "Gelh in, hiai thute amuanhuai in adik uhi,” achi hi.
english: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Sep zoh ahita. Kei Alpha leh Omega, abul leh atawp ka hi. Dangtakte kiang ah aman bei in hinna tuikhuk a tui amau ka pe ding hi.
english: He said to me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

paite: Kuapeuh avualzoupa'n hiai thilte aluah ding; a Pathian ka hi dia, amah ka tapa ahi ding hi.
english: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

paite: Himahleh dawilokte leh gingtaloute leh kihhuaite leh tualthatte leh mingaihhatte leh bumhatte leh milim bete leh zuautheite tengteng tan tuh dil, mei leh kaat a kang, sih nihna ahi," achi hi.
english: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, The word for “sorcerers” here also includes users of potions and drugs. idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.”

paite: Huan angel sagih belhbu sagih leh gawtna sagih nanungpen tawite lak a khat ahong pai a; kei ahon houpih a, "Hiai ah hong pai in, mou, Belamnou zi ka hon ensak ding," achi hi.
english: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, who were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, “Come here. I will show you the wife, the Lamb’s bride.”

paite: Ama'n Kha in tang lian leh sangpi ah ahon pomang a, huchi in khopi siangthou Jerusalem, Pathian a kipan a van a hong paikhesuk ahon ensak a,
english: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

paite: Pathian thupina anei a; avakna suangmantam pen, jasper suang, kristal bang in asiang hi.
english: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, as if it were a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

paite: Kulhbaang thupi leh sangpi anei a; kong sawm-le-nih anei a, huai kongte ah angel sawm-le-nih a-om ua; huai kongtungte ah Israel suan nam sawm-le-nihte min akigelh hi:
english: having a great and high wall; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

paite: asuahlam ah kongpi thum a-om a; amallam ah kongpi thum, asimlam ah kongpi thum; atumlam ah kongpi thum a-om hi.
english: On the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

paite: Huan khopi kulhbaang in nuaiphah sawm-le-nih anei a, huaite tung ah Belamnou sawltak sawm-le-nihte minte atuang hi.
english: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

paite: Huan kei hon houpihpa'n khopi leh kongpite leh kulhbaangte tehna ding in tehna dangka-eng sialluang atawi hi.
english: He who spoke with me had for a measure, a golden reed, to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

paite: Huai khua in ning li anei a, adunglam availam chiachia in alian a; asialluang in khopi ateh a, lou chiing singkhat-le-sangnih ahi a, dunglam leh vailam leh asanlam akikim uhi.
english: The city lies foursquare, and its length is as great as its breadth. He measured the city with the reed, Twelve thousand twelve stadia 12,012 stadia = or 2,221 kilometers or 1,380 miles. TR reads 12,000 stadia instead of 12,012 stadia. . Its length, breadth, and height are equal.

paite: Huan angel in huai kulhbaang mihing tehna dan in ateh a, tong za-le-sawmli-le-li a sah ahi.
english: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, 144 cubits is about 65.8 meters or 216 feet by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

paite: Huan akhopi kulhbaang jasper suang a kibawl ahi a; huan akhopi dangka-eng siang, limlang siang bang ahi.
english: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

paite: Huai khopi kulhbaang suang-phum suangmantam chiteng a zep ahi. Asuangphum khatna jasper suang ahi a; anihna sapphir suang, athumna kalsedoni suang; alina emerald suang;
english: The foundations of the city’s wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire or, lapis lazuli ; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

paite: angana sardonik suang; agukna sardi suang; asagihna kristolait suang; agiatna beril suang; akuana topaz suang; asawmna krisopras suang; asawm-le-khatna zasinth suang; asawm-le-nihna amethis suang ahi uhi.
english: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprasus; the eleventh, jacinth; and the twelfth, amethyst.

paite: Huan kongpi sawm-le-nihte tuikepsuang sawm-le-nihte ahi ua; akongpite tuikepsuang khat chiat a bawl ahi a; khopi kholak dangka-eng siang ahi a, limlang muh paisuak theih bang ahi.
english: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

paite: Toupa Pathian Bangkim hihthei leh Belamnou atempul ahih ziak in, huai khopi ah tempul ka mu kei hi.
english: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God, the Almighty, and the Lamb, are its temple.

paite: Huan atung a tanvak ding in huai khopi in ni hiam, kha hiam leng apoimoh kei a, Pathian thupina in atanvak a, Belamnou ameivak uh ahi.
english: The city has no need for the sun, neither of the moon, to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

paite: Huai vak ah hotdam namte akhosa ding ua; leitung kumpipate athupina uh toh ahong lut ding uhi.
english: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

paite: Bangchi mah in huai kongpite sun a khak in a-om kei ding hi, huai lai a zan a-om louh ding ziak in.
english: Its gates will in no way be shut by day (for there will be no night there),

paite: Huai mun ah namte thupina leh zahtakhuaina laklut ahi ding hi.
english: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

paite: Bangchi mah in huai ah thilnin hiam, ahihkeileh kihhuai leh zuaubawl himhim leng alut kei ding a; himahleh Belamnou hinna laibu a min gelhte kia alut ding uhi.
english: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

paite: Huan hinna tui siang luanna lui ahon ensak a, huai lui bel kristal bang a siang, Pathian leh Belamnou laltutphah a pan hong luangkhia ahi.
english: He showed me a TR adds “pure” river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

paite: Huai a kongzing lai, alui lang tuaktuak ah hinna singgah chi sawm-le-nih nei, kha teng a gah a-om a; huai singnahte namte hihdamna ding ahi.
english: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

paite: Huan hamsia himhim a-om nawnta kei dia; huai ah Pathian leh Belamnou laltutphah a-omta ding hi; asikhate'n a-nna asem ding uhi.
english: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants serve him.

paite: Amaute'n amel amu ding ua; atal uah ama min a-om ding hi.
english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

paite: Huan zan himhim a-om nawn kei dia; khawnvak vak leh nisa vak hiam leng apoimoh nawn kei ding uh; Toupa Pathian in amau vakna apiak ding ziak in; amau tangtawn tangtawn in vai ahawmta ding uhi.
english: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

paite: Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, hiai thute amuanhuai un adik uhi; Toupa zawlnei siangthoute Pathian in thil hong om pah mahmah dingte asikhate kiang ah musak ding in a-angel asawl hi.
english: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

paite: "Ngai in, Ka hong pai pah ding. Hiai laibu a genkholhna thute zui peuhmah ahampha hi," achi hi.
english: “Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”

paite: Huan kei Johan, hiai thilte zapa leh mupa ka hi. Huchi a ka zak leh ka muhtak in, hiai thilte hon musakpa angel khebul ah be ding in ka puk hi.
english: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hon be kei hial in, hiai laibu thute kem, na unau zawlneite leh nang sikha hihpih ka hi; Pathian be zaw in," achi hi.
english: He said to me, “See you don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

paite: Ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai laibu a genkholhnate bilhkhum ke'n, ahun anai tak ziak in.
english: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

paite: Kuapeuh midiklou in diklouhna hih nalai henla, kuapeuh minin, nin nalai hen; kuapeuh midiktat, diktat nalai henla; kuapeuh Mi Siangthou, siangthou nalai hen," achi hi.
english: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

paite: "Ngai in, ka hong pai pah ding hi; michih athilhih bang zel ua piak ding in ka kiang ah ka kipahman a-om hi.
english: “Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

paite: Kei Alpha leh Omega, amasapen leh ananungpen, abul leh atawp ka hi."
english: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

paite: Hinna sing ahon zottheihna ding uleh, khopi kongpi a aluttheihna ding ua apuan uh sawpsiangte ahampha uhi.
english: Blessed are those who do his commandments, NU reads “wash their robes” instead of “do his commandments”. that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.

paite: Apolam ah uite, bumhatte, mingaihhatte, tualthatte, milim bete leh kuapeuh zuauthu deih a, zuauthu bawlte a-om uhi.
english: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

paite: "Kei, Jesu in saptuamte a ding a hiai thilte na kiang ua hon theisak ding in ka angel ka hon sawl hi. David zung leh asuan zingsol aksi vak ka hi," achi hi.
english: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David; the Bright and Morning Star.”

paite: Kha leh Mou in, "Hong pai in," achi uhi. Aza peuh in, "Hong pai in," chi hen. Kuapeuh a-ut in hinna tui aman bei in dawn hen.
english: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

paite: Hiai laibu a genkholhna thute za peuh kiang ah ka theisak hi: Mi kuapeuh in hiai thute abehlapleh Pathian in ama tung ah hiai laibu a kigelh gawtnate abehlap ding hi;
english: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book, if anyone adds to them, may God add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

paite: huan kuapeuh in hiai genkholhna laibu a thute lakmang aneihleh Pathian in atan ding hiai laibu a kigelh, hinna sing leh khopi siangthou a kipan alamang ding hi.
english: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, may God take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

paite: Hiai thilte theisakpa'n, "Ahi, ka hong pai pah ding hi,” achi hi. Amen! Hong pai in, Toupa Jesu.
english: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

paite: Toupa Jesu hehpihna noute tengteng tung ah om hen, Amen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.

paite: "Huan Sardis a saptuamte angel kiang an hichibang in gelh in: Pathian Kha sagih leh aksi sagih neipa'n hiai thilte agen hi. "Na thilhihte ka thei, si napi in hingmin na pu hi.
english: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God, and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

paite: Kiveng in, thil omsunte, si dia kisate, tungding nawn in; ka Pathian ma ah na thilhih zohsa set theih ka mu kei hi.
english: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

paite: Huaiziak in na muhdan leh na zakdan theigige in; kem inla, kisik in. Huchi a na kiven keileh guta bang in ka hong pai dia, bangchik hun in ahia nang ka hong phawn ding chih na thei kei hi.
english: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

paite: Himahleh Sardis ah min tawmchik apuante uh hihnit louh na nei hi; amaute puanngou silh a kei toh tonkhawm ding a kilawm him ahi uhi.
english: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

paite: Avualzoupa huchibang in puanngou in akizem dia, bangchi mah in hinna laibu a kipat amin ka hihmang kei ding, ka Pa ma leh a-angelte ma ah amin ka gum ding hi.
english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi, chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

paite: "Philadelphia a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Huai siangthoupa, dikpa leh David chabi neipa, amah hon kuamah in akhak theih louh leh amah khak kuamah in ahon theih louhpa'n hiai thilte agen hi.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:
