paite: "Na thilhihte ka thei, ngai in, na ma ah kuamah khak theih louh kong honsa ka koih hi; thilhihtheihna neuchik na nei a, ka thu na kem a, ka min na pai kei hi.
english: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

paite: Ngai in, zuau lel gen a Judate hilou napi, ahi a kigen Setan sinagogte ka hon pia hi; ngai in, amau ka hon paisak dia, na khebul ah ka kunsak ding; nang ka hon itdan atheihna ding un.
english: Behold, I give of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie. Behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

paite: Ka dohzohna thu na kep ziak in, ze-et a na om chiang in ke'n leng ka hon kem ding, huai hun khovel pumpi tung a hong tung ding ahi; leitung a om tengteng leng ze-et ding in.
english: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing, which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

paite: Ka hong pai pah ding. Kuamah in na lallukhu alaklouhna ding in, na neih pen kem kinken in.
english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

paite: Avualzoupa ka tempul ah khuam in ka pangsak dia, huai a kipan in apaikhe nawn kei ding, amah tung ah ka Pathian min leh ka Pathian khopi Jerusalem thak, ka Pathian a kipan van a hong paikhesuk min leh keimah min thak ka gelh ding hi.
english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

paite: "Huan Laodisia a saptuamte angel kiang ah hichibang in gelh in: Theihpihpa ginom leh dik, Pathian thilsiam bul Amen in hiai thilte agen hi.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Head of God’s creation, says these things:

paite: "Na thilhihte ka thei, lum lah lum lou, vot lah vot lou in na om a; na lumleh lum inla na votleh vot vanglak in!
english: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

paite: Lum lah lum lou, vot lah vot lou a na om pelhpulh ziak in, ka kam a kipan in ka hon sekhe ding hi.
english: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

paite: Migenthei nuamsa lou, zawng, mitdel leh vuaktang na hih lam kithei lou a, 'ka hausa, hauhsaknate ka neita, bangmah ka kitasam kei,' na chih ziak in.
english: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

paite: Kei a kipan in dangka-eng mei a hihsiangthousa lei ding in ka hon thuhilh ahi, na hong hauhsak theihna ding in; puanngoute na hon silh a, na vuaktang zumhuaina adawklouhna ding in; huan na muhtheihna ding in na mit a nuh ding mitlou lei in.
english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

paite: Ka itte ka thuhilh in ka sawi a; huaiziak in phatuamngai inla, kisik in.
english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

paite: Ngai in kongkhak a dingh in ka kiu hi; mi kuapeuh in ka aw azak a kong ahonleh akiang ah ka lut dia amah toh nitak an ka ne dia, ama'n leng kei toh ane ding hi.
english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.

paite: Avualzoupa ka laltutphah tung ah ka kiang ah ka tusak ding, kei leng ka vualzou a, laltutphah tung a ka Pa toh ka tut bang in.
english: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father on his throne.

paite: "Saptuamte kiang a Kha thugen bil nei peuh in za hen achi," chi in achi hi.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

paite: Hiai thilte nung a ka etleh, ngai in, van ah kongkhak akihong a; ka aw zak masakpen pengkul aw ging bang in kei ahon houpih hi, "Hiai ah hong paitou in, huan tunung chiang a thil hong om dingte ka hon musak ding," achi hi.
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

paite: Thakhat in Kha in ka om pah ngal a; ngai in, van ah laltutphah ahong kitungta a, laltutphah tung ah mi khat atu hi.
english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

paite: Huai mi jasper leh karnelia suang bang in akimu a; huai laltutphah kimvel ah sakhituihup, emerald suang bang mai a kimu in azam hi.
english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

paite: Huan huai laltutphah kimvel ah laltutphah dang sawmnih-le-li a-om a; huai laltutphahte tung ah upa sawmnih-le-li, puanngou a kizem a tu ka mu a, amaute'n dangka-eng lallukhu akhu chiat uhi.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

paite: Huai laltutphah a kipan in khophiate, awte leh vanpigingte ahong suakkhia hi. Huan mei khawnvak sagih, laltutphah ma ah akuang a, huaite Pathian Kha sagihte ahi uhi.
english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

paite: Huai laltutphah ma ah kristal bang a siang limlang tuipi a-om hi. Huai laltutphah kimvel ah thil hing nunglam leh malam mit a dim a-om uhi.
english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the midst of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

paite: Thil hing khatna humpinelkai bang ahi a, thil hing nihna bawngnou bang ahi a, thil hing thumna in mihing mai bang anei hi, thil hing lina muvanlai leng lai bang ahi.
english: The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

paite: Huai thil hing lite'n kha guk anei chiat ua, akimvel leh asunglam mit ngen a dim ahi a; amaute'n sun leh zan khawl lou in: "Siangthou, Siangthou, Siangthou, Toupa Pathian, Bangkim hihthei, omsa leh omlel leh hong om ding," achi uhi.
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy Hodges/Farstad MT reads “holy” 9 times instead of 3. is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

paite: Huan huai amah laltutphah tung a tupa leh huai amah tangtawn tangtawn a hingpa kiang a thil hingte'n, thupina leh zahhuaina leh kipahna thu apiak chiang un,
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

paite: amah laltutphah tung a tupa ma ah upa sawmnih-le-lite abokkhup uhi, huai laltutphah ma a alallukhute uh koih in, amah tangtawn tangtawn a hingpa abia uhi.
english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

paite: "Nang ka Toupa leh ka Pathian uh, thupina, zahhuaina, thilhihtheihna mu tak na hi; thil tengteng nang na siam a, nang thu ziak a om leh siam ahi uhi," achi uhi.
english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, TR omits “and God, the Holy One,” to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!”

paite: Huai laltutphah tung a tupa khut taklam ah laibuzial, asunglam leh apolam kigelh chiamtehna sagih a kichiamteh ka mu hi.
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

paite: Angel hat khat in aw ngaihtak in, "Kua ahia laibuzial hong a, huai a chiamtehnate phel tham?" chi a puangkhia ka mu hi.
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

paite: Huan van tung hi in, leitung hiam, ahihkeileh lei nuai ah leng huai laibuzial hong thei hiam, ahihkeileh atung en thei kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look in it.

paite: Huchi in huai laibuzial hong a sim tak hiam, ahihkeileh atung en tak kuamah a-om louh ziak in ka kapkap hi.
english: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look in it.

paite: Huan upate lak a khat in ka kiang ah, "Kap ke'nla ngai in, humpinelkai, Judah nam a, David Zung in, laibuzial hong thei ding leh huai a chiamtehna sagihte phel thei ding in avualzouta," achi hi.
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome; he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

paite: Huan huai laltutphah leh huai thil hing lite leh huai upate lai ah thahsa hileh kilawm, Belamnou, kii sagih leh mit sagih nei dingh ka mu a, huai mit sagihte Pathian kha sagih leitung tengteng a sawlkhiakte ahi uhi.
english: I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

paite: Amah ahong pai a, laltutphah tung a tupa khut taklam a kipan laibuzial ala hi.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

paite: Huai laibuzial alaktak in, thil hing lite leh upa sawmnih-le-lite, gosem khat chiat leh dangka-eng belhbute gimnamtui a dim chiat tawi in, Belamnou ma ah abokkhup ua, huaite gimnamtui misiangthoute thumna ahi.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

paite: Huan la thak khat asa uhi: "Laibuzial la a, huai a chiamtehnate phel tham na hi; thah in na omta a, chi chih leh pau chih leh michih leh nam chih a mite Pathian a ding a na sisan a na lei tak ziak in.
english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood, out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

paite: Ka Pathian kiang uah amau lalgam leh siampute hi ding in na bawl a; amaute'n leitung ah vai ahawm ding uh," chi in.
english: and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign on earth.”

paite: Huan ka etleh, laltutphah leh thil hingte leh upate kimvel ah, angel tampi aw ka za hi. Atamdan uh singkhat mun singkhat leh asang mun sang tampi ahi uh;
english: I saw, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands;

paite: Amau aw ngaihtak in: "Thah a om, Belamnou in hatnate, leh hauhsaknate, leh thilhihtheihnate, leh zahtakhuainate, leh thupinate, leh vualzawlnate mu tham na hi,' chi in akikou uhi.
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

paite: Huan thilsiam khempeuh van a omte, leitung a omte, lei nuai a omte, tuipi tung a omte leh amau a thil omte tengteng in, "Laltutphah tung a tupa leh Belamnou kiang ah; Vualzawlnate, zahtakhuainate, thupinate leh vaihawmnate, tangtawn tangtawn in om hen," achih uh ka za hi.
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen! TR omits “Amen!” ”

paite: Huan thil hing lite'n, "Amen!" achi ua, huan upate abokkhup ua, abia uhi.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” The TR adds “twenty-four” elders fell down and worshiped. TR adds “the one living forever and ever”

paite: Belamnou in chiamtehna sagihte lak a khat aphel lai ka mu a, thil hing lite lak a khat aw in, vanpiging bang mai in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi.
english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

paite: Huan ka etleh ngai in, sakol kang leh atung a tupa thalpeu tawi ka mu a; amah kiang ah lallukhu piak in a-om a; amah vualzou a vualzou zou zel ding in ahong paikhia hi.
english: And behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came forth conquering, and to conquer.

paite: Huan chiamtehna nihna aphel lai in, thil hing nihna in, "Hong pai in,” achih ka za hi.
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

paite: Sakol dang asan khat ahong paikhia a; huai tung a tupa kiang ah leitung a kipan lemna lakhe ding a thupiak ahi a, huchi a amau akithahtuahna ding un; amah kiang a namsau thupi piak ahita hi.
english: Another came forth, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

paite: Huan chiamtehna thumna aphel lai in thil hing thumna in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi. Ka etleh ngai in, sakol vom ka mu hi; atung a tupa'n akhut in bukna atawi hi.
english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

paite: Huan thil hing lite lai ah aw hileh kilawm in, "Huit buh tehna dan khat dinari khat, huan barli buh tehna dan thum in dinari khat, huan thau leh uain zaw hihse ke'n," achih ka za hi.
english: I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix A choenix is a dry volume measure that is a little more than a litre (a little more than a quart). of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

paite: Chiamtehna lina aphel lai in, thil hing lina aw in, "Hong pai in," achih ka za hi.
english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

paite: Ka etleh ngai in, sakol daang ka mu hi; atung a tupa min Sihna ahi a, Misikhua toh akizui uhi. Namsau, kial leh sihna leh leitung a gam sahangte thah ding in amau kiang ah leitung seh li suah seh khat tung a thuneihna piak ahita hi.
english: And behold, a pale horse, and he who sat on it, his name was Death. Hades or, Hell followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

paite: Chiamtehna ngana aphel lai in, Pathian thu ziak leh azuih uh theihsakna ziak a amau thah a omte maitam nuai ah ka mu hi.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

paite: Amaute aw ngaihtak a kikou in, "Toupa Tungnungpen aw, siangthou leh dik bang tan ka sisan man uh amau leitung a tengte tung a thuk lou leh vaihawm lou ding na hia?" achi uhi.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

paite: Amaute kiang ah puanngou thupi piak in a-om chiat ua; amau asikha hihpihte uleh a-unaute uh amau bang a thah a om dingte akim mateng uh na khawl tadih un chi a hilh in a-om uhi.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

paite: Chiamtehna gukna aphel lai ka mu a, zinling thupitak a-om hi. Nisa tuh samul sai-ip puan bang in ahong vom a, kha leng apum in sisan bang in asan hi.
english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

paite: Van aksite theipi kung huihpi in amutling a, ahutte apulh bang in leitung ah apulh uhi.
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

paite: Van laibuzial bang a kizial zou in suanmang in a-omta; tang sangte leh tuikulh gam teng amun ua pat suanmang in a-omta uhi.
english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

paite: Huchi in leitung kumpipate, miliante, heutute leh ahat leh ahaute, salte leh sal lou teng leng tang sangte leh suangpi heng leh kokhukte ah akisel uhi.
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

paite: Tang sangte kiang leh suangpite kiang ah, "Hon delhlum unla, amah laltutphah tung a tupa leh Belamnou thangpaihna mai a kipan hon sel un;
english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

paite: athangpaihna ni thupi hong tung hi; kua adingh zou dia?” achi uhi.
english: for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”

paite: Hiai thilte zoh in angel li, lei kil li a dinghte'n leitung a huih lite leitung a nung lou ding leh tuipi tung hiam, ahihkeileh sing tung hiam a nung lou ding in akhawlsak uhi.
english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

paite: Huan amau chiamtehna a pan angel dang kuantou ka mu hi, Pathian hing chiamtehna anei ua; ama'n huai angel lite leitung leh tuipi hihse ding a piak a omte kiang ah aw ngaihtak a kikou in.
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

paite: "Pathian sikhate atal ua i chiamteh zoh ma in leitung leh tuipi leh singte hihse kei un," achi hi.
english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

paite: Huai chiamteh a omte lak a tampi, nuaikhat singli-le-sangli, Israel suan chiteng a kipan chiamteh zah ka za hi.
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

paite: Judah chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih chiamteh in a-om ua. Reuben chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Gad chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
english: of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

paite: Asher chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Naphtali chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Manasseh chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

paite: Simeon chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Levi chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih; Issakar chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih;
english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

paite: Zebulun chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih, Joseph chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih, Benjamin chi a kipan singkhat-le-sangnih.
english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, of the tribe of Benjamin were sealed twelve thousand.

paite: Hiai thil teng zoh in ka etleh ngai in, mipi tampi kuamah sim seng louh, nam chih leh chi chih leh mi tengteng leh pau tengteng a kipan laltutphah leh Belamnou ma a dingh a, puanngou thupi a kizem a tumnah tawi ka mu a,
english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

paite: huan amau aw ngaihtak in, "Laltutphah a tu i Pathian leh Belamnou kiang ah hotdamna," chi in akikou uhi.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

paite: Angel tengteng laltutphah leh upate leh thil hing lite kimvel in adingh ua; laltutphah ma a bokkhup in, Pathian abia uhi:
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

paite: "Amen! Vualzawlnate, leh thupinate, leh pilnate, leh zahtakhuainate, leh thilhihtheihnate, leh hatnate, tangtawn tangtawn in i Pathian kiang ah om hen,” achi uhi.
english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

paite: Huan upate lak a khat in ka kiang ah, "Hiai puanngou thupi a kizemte kuate ahi ua, koi a kipan a hong pai ahi ua?” chi in ahon houpih a,
english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in white robes, who are they, and from where did they come?”

paite: ke'n akiang ah, "Ka Toupa, nang na thei hi," ka chi hi. Huan ama'n ka kiang ah, "Hiai mite gimthuakna thupi a kipan hong paite ahi ua, apuan thupi uh sawp in, Belamnou sisan in ahihngou uhi."
english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes, and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

paite: "Huaiziak in Pathian laltutphah ma ah a-om ua, sun leh zan in atempul uah amah asepsak uhi; amah laltutphah tung a tupa'n amau tung ah apuanin azak ding hi.
english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

paite: Agil uh kial nawn ke'n chin, adang uh tak nawn himhim ke'n teh, amau ni in kang ke'n chin, satna in leng ahihgim kei ding hi.
english: They will never be hungry, neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on them, nor any heat;

paite: Belamnou huai laltutphah lak a om abelamchingpa uh ahih ding ziak in, amau hinna tuikhuk ah api ding a; Pathian in amit ua kipan khitui anulhul ding," achi hi.
english: for the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne shepherds them, and leads them to springs of waters of life. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

paite: Chiamtehna sagihna aphel lai in dakkal kimkhat sung van adai sipsip hi.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

paite: Huchi in Pathian ma a angel sagih dinghte ka mu a, amaute kiang ah pengkul sagih piak in a-om hi.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

paite: Huan angel dang khat ahong pai a, gimnamtui halna dangka-eng bel tawi in, maitam kiang ah adingh hi, akiang ah gimnamtui tampi laltutphah ma a om dangka-eng maitam teng a misiangthou tengteng thumna toh hel ding in, piak in a-om hi.
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

paite: Huai gimnamtui khu leh misiangthoute thumna angel khut a kipan Pathian ma ah azamtou hi.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

paite: Angel in gimnamtui halna dangka-eng bel ala a; huai maitam amei in ahihdim a, leitung ah apaikhia a; huan awgingte, van-gingte leh khophiate leh zinlingte ahong om hi.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it on the earth. There followed thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake.

paite: Huan angel sagih pengkul sagih tawite mut ding in ahong kisa uhi.
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

paite: Angel masapen in amut a, sisan toh kihel gial leh mei ahong om hi, huaite leitung a paihkhiak in a-om ua; leitung mun thum a khen mun khat akangbei hi, huan sing mun thum a khen mun khat akangbei a; loupa hing tengteng akangbei hi.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burnt up, TR omits “One third of the earth was burnt up” and one third of the trees were burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

paite: Huan angel nihna in amut a, tang lianpi mei a kang bang a kang hileh kilawm tuipi ah paihkhiak in ahong om a; tuipi mun thum a khen mun khat sisan asuak hi.
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

paite: Huai tuipi a thil hingte hinna neite mun thum a khen mun khat asi ua; long mun thum a khen mun khat hihsiat in a-om hi.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

paite: Huan angel thumna in amut a, van a kipan in aksi lianpi, meisel bang a kuang ahong kesuk a, lui mun thum a khen mun khat leh tui tuikhukte tung adeng hi.
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of the waters.

paite: Huai aksi min Gamsai ahi; tui mun thum a khen mun khat gamsai asuak hi; tuite hihkhaat a a-om ziak un mi tampi asi uhi.
english: The name of the star is called “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

paite: Huan angel lina in amut a, huan ni mun thum a khen mun khat leh kha mun thum a khen mun khat leh aksi mun thum a khen mun khat hihsiat ahong hi a; huchi in avaknate uh mun thum a khen mun khat hihmial in a-om a; sun hun seh thum suah seh khat leh zan hun seh thum suah seh khat beisak in a-om hi.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars; so that one third of them would be darkened, and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

paite: Huan ka etleh, angel khat van laizawl a leng in aw ngaihtak in, "Tunggik, tunggik, angel thum pengkul mut lai dingte leh huai ging hong om lai dingte ziak in leitung a omte tung agik," achih ka za hi.
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, TR reads “angel” instead of “eagle” flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth, because of the other voices of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

paite: Angel ngana in amut a, van a kipan leitung a aksi kia ka mu a; amah kiang ah kokhuk taw nei lou honna chabi piak in a-om hi.
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

paite: Ama'n kokhuk taw nei lou ahong a; huai kokhuk a kipan in meikhu, meipi khu bang mai ahong pawttou a, huai kokhuk a meikhu ziak in ni leh huihkhua hihmial in a-omta hi.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a TR adds “great” burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

paite: Huan meikhu a kipan in leitung ah khaupete ahong suak ua; aikamte'n thilhihtheihna aneih bang un amau thilhihtheihna piak in a-om uhi.
english: Then out of the smoke came forth locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

paite: Amau leitung a loupate, thil hing himhimte leh sing peuhmahte, hihse lou a, mi kuapeuh atal ua Pathian chiamtehna neiloute kia hihse dia hilh in a-om uhi.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

paite: Amau that lou ding a, kha nga sung amau hihgenthei zaw ding a hilh in a-om ua; huai a hihgentheihna tuh aikam in mi kuahiam ateh a ahihgentheih bang ahi.
english: They were given power not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion, when it strikes a person.

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi'n sihna azong ding ua, bangchi mah in amu kei ding uh; sih a-ut ding ua, himahleh sihna in amau ataimangsan ding hi.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

paite: Huan khaupete kilatdan sakol kidouna a pang dia bawl bang ahi ua; alutung uah dangka-eng lallukhu hileh kilawm a-om a, amai uh mihingte mai bang ahi.
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

paite: Numei sam bang sam anei ua, aha uh humpinelkai ha bang ahi.
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

paite: A-awm uah sik awmphawte bang anei ua; akhazap ging uh kidouna lam a sakol tampi tai dupdup, kidouna kangtalai tampi ging bang ahi.
english: They had breastplates, like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, or of many horses rushing to war.

paite: Huan aikam bang in meigu nei anei ua, mihingte kha nga sung hihnatna ding in amei uah thilhihtheihna anei uhi.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

paite: Amaute'n kokhuk taw nei lou neitu angel atung ua kumpipa in anei uhi; ama min Hebru pau in Abaddon ahi a, Grik pau in Appolion ahi.
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon,” “Abaddon” is a Hebrew word that means ruin, destruction, or the place of destruction but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon.” “Apollyon” means “Destroyer.”

paite: Tunggikna masapen abeita a, ngai in, tunggikna nih tunung chiang in ahong tung lai ding hi.
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

paite: Huan angel gukna in amut a, Pathian ma a om dangka-eng maitam kii a kipan in aw ka za a;
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

paite: huai aw in angel gukna pengkul nei kiang ah, "Euphrates luipi lianpi a angel li hen a omte phel in," achi hi.
english: saying to the sixth angel who had one trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

paite: Huan mi mun thum a khen mun khat athahtheihna ding ua dak khat, ni khat, kha khat leh kum khat sung kisa a na om, angel lite phel in a-om uhi.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

paite: Huan sakol tungtuang sepaih atamdan uh sing ngen mun singnih ahi chi a atamdan uh kigen ka za hi.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million literally, “ten thousands of ten thousands” . I heard the number of them.

paite: Huchibang in kilakna in sakolte leh atung ua tuangte, mei bang a san, engdup leh kaat bang a eng, awmphaw neite ka mu hi; sakolte lu humpinelkai lu bang ahi ua; akam ua kipan in mei leh meikhu leh kaat asuakkhia hi.
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the heads of lions. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

paite: Huan akamsung ua kipan a hong pawtkhia huai hipi thum, mei, meikhu leh kaat in mihing mun thum a khen mun khat thah in a-om uhi.
english: By these three plagues were one third of mankind killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

paite: Huai sakolte thilhihtheihna akam uh leh amei ua om ahi a; amei uh gulpi mei toh akibang ua, lu leng anei ua, huaite in mi ahih na uhi.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths, and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads, and with them they harm.

paite: Huan midang huai gawtna a siloute akhut ua sepkhiakte ah akisik tuan kei ua; dawite, dangka-engte, milimte, dangka milimte, suang milimte leh sing milimte; mu theiloute, za thei lou leh tang theiloute be nawn lou ding in akisik tuan kei uhi.
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk.

paite: Huan atualthahna uh, ami bumna uh leh akingaihna khelhna uh leh aguktakna uh akisik tuan kei uhi.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, nor of their sorceries, The word for “sorceries” (pharmakeia) also implies the use of potions, poisons, and drugs nor of their sexual immorality, nor of their thefts.

paite: Paul, Jesu Khrist sikha, sawltak hi ding a sap, Pathian tanchinhoih lam a khenkhiak,
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

paite: Pathian in tuma lam a Laisiangthou a azawlneite a achiamsa,
english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

paite: atapa, salam a David suan a piang tungtang thu,
english: concerning his Son, who was born of the seed of David according to the flesh,

paite: amah Pathian Tapa hihna bel misi lak a kipan thilhihtheihna toh athohnawnna ziak a sianthouna Kha in Jesu Khrist, Toupa chi a apuankhiak ahi.
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

paite: Amin ziak a ginna nam chih lak a mi gingtasak ding in, amah ziak in hehpihna leh sawltak hihna i tangta hi;
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship, for obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name’s sake;

paite: huai lak ah nou leng Jesu Khrist sapte na hi uh;
english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

paite: Rome khua Pathian deihtak, misiangthou a om ding a sapte tengteng kiang ah, Pathian i Pa leh Toupa Jesu Khrist kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Amasa in khovel tengteng ah na ginna uh athan ziak in na vek ua tung ah ka kipahthu Jesu Khrist ziak in ka Pathian kiang ah ka gen hi.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

paite: Ka thumnate ah tawp lou in na min uh ka lou nilouh ahi, chih kei hon theihpihpa Pathian ahi a, amah ahi a Tapa tanchinhoih gen a ka kha a, a-nna ka sep gige pa pen;
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

paite: tu bek a na kiang ua ka hong theihna ding in Pathian thuthu a zin hun lemtang ka muh teitei theihna ding ka ngen hi.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

paite: Na kipna ding ua khalam thilpiak banghiam nou ka hon piaktheihna ding in nou hon muh ka ut thei mahmah ngal a;
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

paite: huai na ginna uh leh ka ginna a i kikhamuantuah theihna ding un ka chihna ahi.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

paite: Unaute aw, Zentel dangte kiang a ka sepgim gah ka muhtak bangmah in, noumau lak ah leng gahte ka muhtheihna ding in na kiang uah tamveipi hong ka tumta chih na theih louh uh ka deih kei hi; himahleh tu tanpha dal in ka om nilouh hi.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

paite: Grik mite leh melmak mite kiang ah bat ka nei a; mipil leh mipilloute kiang ah leng.
english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

paite: Huchi in nou Rome a omte kiang ah leng tanchinhoih gen ka ut mahmah hi.
english: So, as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

paite: Tanchinhoih tuh ka zahpih kei a; kuapeuh agingta phot a ding in hotdamna ding a Pathian thilhihtheihna ahi ngal a; atung in Juda mi a ding in ahi a, huan Grik mi a ding in leng ahong hi nawn hi.
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, for it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes; for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

paite: Huai ah tuh gin semsemna ding in ginna in Pathian diktatna latsak in a-om hi, "Midiktat tuh ginna in ahing ding," chi a gelh ahih bang in.
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.” Habakkuk 2:4

paite: Dik loutak a thutak dalte leh Pathian limsaklouhna leh diktatlouhna tengteng tung ah van a kipan in Pathian thangpaihna ahong kilangta hi.
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

paite: Pathian in atheihsak tak ziak in Pathian tanchin theihtheih ding tuh alungsim uah chiangtak a theihsak in a-omta ngal a.
english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

paite: Khovel siam tung a kipan a pianken muh theih louh, atangtawn thilhihtheihna leh a Pathianna, thilsiamte ah chiantak a muh theih ahi; huaiziak in paulam ding anei kei uhi.
english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse.

paite: Pathian thei ngal in Pathian bang in apahtawi kei ua; kipahthu leng agen sam kei uh; himahleh thil thulim lou angaihtuah zaw ua, alungtang hai uh ahong mialta hi.
english: Because, knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, neither gave thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

paite: Pil kisa khem in mihai ahong suak ua,
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

paite: asithei lou Pathian thupina sithei mihingte leh vasate, gamsate leh bokvak ganhingte lim asuaksak uhi.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed animals, and creeping things.

paite: Huaiziak in asa uh zumhuaipi a kibawltuah ding in alungtang uh duhgawlna bang a thilnin hihphal in Pathian in alehngatsan hi.
english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves,

paite: Pathian thutak tuh zuau tangsak in, abawlpa biak sang in abawl bia in a-nna asem uhi. Abawlpa tuh tangtawn a phat tuak ahi, Amen.
english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian in zumhuaipi a huk phal in lehlam angatsanta hi; anumeite nangawn un leng a-omdan pianpih uh dan lou bang a om ding in akibawl lamdang ua;
english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

paite: pasalte'n leng numei zatdan ngeina tawpsan in, huk in aki-enlahtuah ua, pasal leh pasal zummoh thilhih in a-om uh; agitlouh man muh ding uh asa tung ua mu in.
english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

paite: Huan Pathian theih a-ut louh ziak un, thil kilawmloute hih ding a adeih louh lam lungsim neih phal in Pathian in alehngatsanta hi.
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

paite: Huchi in diktatlouhna, gitlouhna, huaihamna, huatna in adim ua; hazatna, tualthahna, kiselna, khemna, nundan hoih lou in adim ua;
english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

paite: gensiatnate, migennate, Pathian huat lamte, kisaktheihnate, kisathei mite, thil gilou bawlkhete,
english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

paite: nu leh pa thu mangloute, theihna beite, thuchiam susete, itna pianpih neiloute, hehpihna neiloute ahi uhi.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

paite: Huchibang hihte tuh si tak him ahi uh chih Pathian dan tuh theigige in, amau kia a hih leng hilou in, midang hih zelte tung ah leng akipak uhi.
english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

paite: Unaute aw, ka lungtang deihlam leh amau a dia Pathian kiang a ka thumna pen zaw, hotdam ahong hihtheihna ding uh ahi.
english: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

paite: Pathian lam ah phatuam angai uh chih ka theihpih ahi, himahleh theihna ahihvak in zaw ahi kei uh.
english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

paite: Pathian diktatna thei lou in, amau diktatna lamkhiak atum ua, Pathian diktatna ah akipelut sam kei uhi.
english: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

paite: Khrist bel agingta peuhmahte a ding in diktatna amuhtheihna ding un dan tawpna ahi.
english: For Christ is the fulfillment or, completion, or end of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

paite: Mosi in, "Dan a diktatna zui zaw, huai mi diktatna ziak in ahing ding," chi in agelh hi.
english: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.” Leviticus 18:5

paite: Ginna a diktatna in bel huchi in agen: "Na lungsim in, kua ahia van a kah ding? (huai lah 'tunglam a kipan Khrist va pisuk ding,' chihna ahi ngal a).
english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ Deuteronomy 30:12 (that is, to bring Christ down);

paite: Ahihkeileh, kua ahia khukthuk a hohsuk ding? Huai lah 'misi lak a kipan Khrist pitou nawn ding,' chihna ahi, chi ke'n," chi in.
english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ Deuteronomy 30:13 (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

paite: Ahihleh, bang ahia agen? "Thu in ahon naih hi, na kam leh na lungtang ah a-om," chi in agen ahi; (huai ahi ginna thu ka tangkoupih pen uh).
english: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth, and in your heart”; Deuteronomy 30:14 that is, the word of faith, which we preach:

paite: Na kam a Jesu, Toupa ahi chih na gup a, misi lak a kipan Pathian in akaithou chih na lungtang a na gintakleh hotdam in na om ding, chih.
english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

paite: Mi'n lungtang in agingta ua, diktatna amu uh; kam in agum ua, hotdamna leng amu nak uh ahi.
english: For with the heart, one believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

paite: Laisiangthou in, "Kuapeuh amah gingta azahlak kei ding,” achi hi.
english: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.” Isaiah 28:16

paite: Juda leh Grik mite bangmah ah alamdang tuan kei ua, Toupa khat avek ua tung ah Toupa ahi a, amin lou peuhmahte tung ah hoihna ahau ngal a.
english: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

paite: "Kuapeuh Toupa min lou tuh hotdam in a-om ding," chih ahi.
english: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.” Joel 2:32

paite: Ahihleh, agintak louhpi uh bangchi in alou ding ua? Athu azak louhpi uh bangchi in agingta ding ua? Thuhilhmi om lou in bangchi in aza ding ua?
english: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

paite: Sawl ahih kei uleh bangchi in thu ahilh ding ua? "Thil hoih tanchin kipahhuai tunte khe kilawm hi na tel e!" chih gelh bang in.
english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!” Isaiah 52:7

paite: Himahleh tanchinhoih azui vek kei uh. Isai in, "Toupa, ka thugen uh kua'n ahia gingta?" achih bang in.
english: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?” Isaiah 53:1

paite: Huchi in ginna tuh zakna ziak in ahong om a, zakna tuh Khrist thu kigen ziak in ahong om hi.
english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

paite: Ahihleh abil un aza kei ua hia? Za na ke, "Ahusa uh gam chih ah athang a, athu uh kawlmong pha in athangsuakta," chih ahi.
english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.” Psalm 19:4

paite: Ahihleh, Israel mite'n aza kei ua hia? "Mipi dia gen thamlouhte ka hon hazasak dia; nam pilloute zang in ka hon hehsak ding," chi in Mosi in agen masapen hi.
english: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry.” Deuteronomy 32:31

paite: Huan Isai in hangsantak in, "Hon zongloute muh in ka omta; hon kanloute ka kimusakta," achi hi.
english: Isaiah is very bold, and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.” Isaiah 65:1

paite: Himahleh Israel mite thu ah, "Michihmoh leh selhatte a ding in sun nilouh in ka ban ka zak hi,” achi hi.
english: But as to Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.” Isaiah 65:2

paite: Ahihleh Pathian in amite apaikhia a hia? Paikhe lou hial! Kei leng Israel mi, Abraham suan Benjamin nam ka hi ngal a.
english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

paite: Pathian in ami a theihkholhte apaikhe kei hi. Laisiangthou in Elijah thu agen na thei kei ua hia? Ama'n Israel mite tungthu Pathian kiang ah atun a,
english: God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

paite: "Toupa na zawlneite athat ua, na maitamte ahihchim ua; keimah kia nutsiat in ka om, kei leng hihlup ahon tum uhi," achih.
english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.” 1 Kings 19:10,14

paite: Himahleh Pathian in bangchi in adawng a? "Baal ma a khukdin ngeiloumi sangsagih keimah a ding in ka hawi hi,” chi in adawng hi.
english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.” 1 Kings 19:18

paite: Huchibang in tulai in leng akhosuaksun, hehpihna a tel a-om uhi.
english: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

paite: Hehpihna ziak ahihleh, nasep ziak ahita kei, huchi hi keileh, hehpihna tuh hehpihna ahita kei ding.
english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

paite: Bangchi ahita dia le? Israel mite'n azon uh amu kei uh. Telte'n bel amu ua, adangte tengteng ananggawpta uhi.
english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

paite: "Pathian in tuni tan in akiang uah lusukna kha apia a, muh theihlouhna mitte, zak theihlouhna bilte toh," chih gelh bang in.
english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.” Deuteronomy 29:4; Isaiah 29:10

paite: David in, "Adohkan uh amau a ding in thang leh pial, pukna leh phulakna hong hi hen;
english: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

paite: Amuh theihlouhna ding un amitte uh hong mial hen, nang anungzang uh kunsak gige in," achi hi.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always.” Psalm 69:22,23

paite: Ahihleh akisuih uh akipukdetna ding uhia? Hilou hial! Apuk ziak un Zentelte kiang ah hotdamna ahong tung zawta hi; Israel mite hazatsakna ding in.
english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

paite: Huchi in apukna uh bawn khovel hih hauhsakna ahih a, akiamna uh leng Zentelte hauhsakna ahihleh, abuchin nawnna uh bangchi phet a hamphatna lianzaw in azui diam aw!
english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?

paite: Huchi in nou Zentelte kiang ah ka gen ahi. Kei Zentelte kiang a sawltak ka hih ziak in, ka nasepna pen ka pahtawi ahi.
english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;

paite: Huchi a ka chipihte ka hazatsak theih teiteina ding leh alak ua khenkhatte ka hotdam theihna ding in.
english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

paite: Amau paihkhiakna bawn khovel toh kituah nawnna ahihleh, amau deih nawnna ding sihna a kipan hin nawnna lou ngal bang ahi dia?
english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

paite: Huan gah masa thillat, tangbuang mekthem asianthouleh huchi mah bang in abeupi asiangthou hi; azungpi asianthouleh ahiangte leng huchi mah bang ahi uhi.
english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

paite: Hiang khenkhatte hihtan a a-om in, nang, olive tak lou, amaute lak a phuhlut a na om a, olive sing a hauhna zung kikoppih sam na hihman in,
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree;

paite: hiang dangte lak ah kisathei ke'n. Kisathei mah lechin nang azung vakpa na hi kei a, huai azung pen nang hon vakpa ahi zaw hi.
english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

paite: Huan nang, "Phuhlut a ka omtheihna ding in hiangte hihtan in a-om khinta vo oi," na chi dia.
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

paite: Ahi agintaklouhna ziak un hihtan in a-om ua, nang na ginna ziak in na dingh ahi, uang ke'nla, lau zaw in.
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

paite: Pathian in hiangtakte pen bawn ahawi kei ngalleh nang leng ahon hawi tuan kei ding hi.
english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

paite: Huchi in Pathian hoihna leh athukhauhna ngaihtuah in; apukte a ding a athukhauhna; nang a ding in bel ahoihna, hoihna a na om gigeleh; huchi ahihkeileh nang leng satkhiak in na om sam ding.
english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

paite: Huan amau leng gingta lou a a-om nilouh kei uleh, phuhlut in a-om nawn ding uh; Pathian in amaute aphutlut nawn thei hi.
english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

paite: Nang piandan a olive tak lou a kipan a satsup bawn, piandan lou bang a olive sing hoih a phuhlut a na omleh, tua ahiangtakte, amau olive sing ngei ah phuhlut hi na tel un chia!
english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

paite: Unaute aw, hiai thuguk na theih louh uh ka ut kei a, huchi lou in zaw na kipilsak ding uh; Zentelte buchinna ahong tun masiah Israel mi khenkhatte tung ah siatna ahong tung tadih hi.
english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

paite: Huchi in Israel mi tengteng hotdam in a-om ding uh: "Zion a kipan in Hondampa ahong suak ding a, Jakob kiang a kipan Pathian limsaklouhna ahihmang ding,"
english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

paite: "Akiang ua ka thukhun ding hiai ahi, akhelhnate uh ka lakmang chiang in," chih gelh bang in.
english: This is my covenant to them, when I will take away their sins.” Isaiah 59:20-21; 27:9; Jeremiah 31:33-34

paite: Tanchinhoih lam ngaihtuah in, nou ziak in melma ahi ua; tel thu lam ngaihtuah in bel apipute uh ziak in deihtakte ahi uhi.
english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

paite: Pathian in athilthawnpiak ah leh asapna ah alungsim akhel ngei kei hi.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

paite: Nidanglai in Pathian thu na gingta kei ua, himahleh tu in amau agin louh ziak un zahngaihna na mu ngal ua.
english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

paite: Huchi mah bang in tu in, Pathian in nou ahon hehpihna ziak a, zahngaihna amuhtheihna ding un amau leng ging lou ahita ve ua.
english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

paite: Pathian in azahngaih vek theihna ding in ginlouhna ah mi tengteng akhumvekta hi.
english: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

paite: Pathian pilna leh theihna hauhdan thuk hi na tel e! Avaihawm-nate theihtheih vual leh alampite sui zoh vual hi kei na tel e!
english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

paite: "Toupa lungsim kua'n ahia thei? ahihkeileh kua ahia ama thuhilhmi?
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?” Isaiah 40:13

paite: Ahihkeileh adit nawn ding a leng akiang ah kua'n ahia thil pe masa?"
english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?” Job 41:11

paite: Amah a kipan leh amah ziak leh amah a ding a thil tengteng ahong om ahi ngal a; amah kiang ah tangtawn in thupina om hen. Amen.
english: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

paite: Huchi in unaute aw, Pathian zahngaihna ziak in, kithoihna hing, siangthou leh Pathian lung tuak ding in na pumpi uh lan ding in ka hon ngen ahi; huai na biakna dan ding him uh ahi.
english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

paite: Hiai khovel dan bang in om kei unla; Pathian deihlam a hoih leh lungtuahhuaitak leh hoih bukim na theihtel theihna ding un, na lungsim uh athak a om in hong kikheng lamdang zawta un.
english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

paite: Na lak uah kuamah na kiletsak ding hun val ua kiliansak lou in, Pathian in michih kiang a ginna hun apiak bang zel a diktak a ngaihtuah zaw ding in Pathian in ahon piak hehpihna ziak in ka hon chi chiat ahi.
english: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

paite: Pumpi khat ah hiang tampi i nei ua, hiang tengteng nasep bel akibang kei hi,
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

paite: huchi mah bang in, eite tampi himah lehang Khrist ah pumpi khat i hi ua; atuamtuam in i kihiangtuah chiat uhi.
english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.

paite: Hehpihna ahon piakdan bang zel in thilthawnpiak tuamtuam i nei chiat uhi; thugen ding ahihleh i ginna toh kihun in i gen ding uhi;
english: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

paite: Nasepna ahihleh tua anasepna mah ah sem hen; sinsakmi'n asinsakna ah sinsak hen;
english: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

paite: Hanthawn mi in ahanthawnna mah sem hen; thilpemi'n phaltak in pia hen; makaimi'n phatuamngaihna toh ma kai hen; zahngaihna nasemmi in kipaktak in sem hen.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with liberality; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

paite: Itna ahihleh lepchiahna tel lou in hi hen. Gilou hua unla, ahoih lam len tinten un.
english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

paite: Unaute itna lam ah ittak in kilainattuah chiat un; pahtawi lam ah, kideihsaktuah chiat un.
english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate one to another; in honor preferring one another;

paite: Thanop lam ah, thadah kei un; Kha a vakna toh phatuamngai in Toupa nna sem un.
english: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

paite: Lametna ah kipak unla; gimthuakna ah kuhkal un; thumna ah thum teitei un;
english: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;

paite: Misiangthoute taksapna ah taksap awng hu unla; mikhualte kipahpih in om nilouh un.
english: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.

paite: Hon sawite vualzawl un, vualzawl unla, hamsiat kei un.
english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

paite: Kipakte kipahpih unla, kapte kahpih un.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

paite: Ngaihtuah kibang in om chiat un, kingaihtuah sang lo kei unla, mi neuneu kithuahpih zaw un. Kipilsak kei un.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

paite: Kua gitlouh leng gilou in thuk kei un. Mi tengteng muh in thil kilawm ngaihtuah un.
english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

paite: Ahihtheih liaileh noumau lam bek, mi tengteng toh kituak in om un.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

paite: Deihtakte aw, phu kila kei un, Pathian hehna awn zaw un, "Phulak himhim keimah lak ding ahi, ke'n ka thuk na ding, Toupa'n achi," chih gelh ahi.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.” Deuteronomy 32:35

paite: Huaiziak in "Na melma agil akialleh nek ding pia inla; adang atakleh dawn ding pia in; huchibang a na hihleh alutung ah mei-am sekkhawm na hi ding hi."
english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.” Proverbs 25:21-22

paite: Gitlouh zoh in om ke'nla, hoihna in gilou zou zaw in.
english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

paite: Michih atung ua vaihawm thuneite thuthu in om hen. Pathian thu lou in kuamah thunei a-om ngal kei ua; vaihawm thunei mite zaw Pathian seh ahi uh.
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

paite: Huaiziak in kuapeuh vaihawmmi sel Pathian sehkalh ahi a, aselte'n amau tung ah vaihawmna akimuh ding uhi.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority, withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

paite: Vaihawmte thil hoih hihte ding in kihtakhuai ahi kei ua; thil hoih lou hihte a ding in bel kihtakhuai ahi uhi. Ahihleh vaihawmmi kihta lou a om na ut uhia? Thil hoih hih le uchin phat na loh ding uh.
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the same,

paite: Amah tuh na hoihna ding ua Pathian nasemmi ahi ngal a. Himahleh kihta un, namsau lah amawk tawi ngal kei a; amah Pathian nasemmi, thil hihkhialmi tung a heh a phulami ahi.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian hehna kihtakna ziak kia hilou in, na sia-le-pha theihna ziak lel ua leng na kituklut ding uh ahi.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

paite: Hiai ziak in siah leng na liau zel ve ua le; huchibang thil ngei hih teitei ding in Pathian nasem mite ahi uhi.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, attending continually on this very thing.

paite: Mi tengteng kiang ah piak ding peuhmah pia un; leiman piakna ding kiang ah leiman pia unla, siah liauna dingpa kiang ah siah liau unla; kihtak dingpa leng kihta unla; zahtak dingpa leng zahtak un.
english: Give therefore to everyone what you owe: taxes to whom taxes are due; customs to whom customs; respect to whom respect; honor to whom honor.

paite: Ki-ittuahna lou ngal kuamah bangmah ba kei un; amau mihinpih itpa'n dan azuikimta hi.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

paite: Hiaite, "Ang kawm ke'n, Tualthat ke'n, Gu ke'n, Eng ke'n," chih leh thupiak dang om lai himhimte, "Nangmah na ki-it bang in na invengte na it ding ahi,” chih in akhaikhawm vek hi.
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not give false testimony,” “You shall not covet,” TR adds “You shall not give false testimony,” Exodus 20:13-15,17; Deuteronomy 5:17-19,21 and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Leviticus 19:18

paite: Itna in a-invengte ahihse ngei kei a; huaiziak in itna zaw dan zuihkimna ahi.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

paite: Huai lou in, tu bang hun ahia chih na thei ua, ihmu khanloh a hun mahmahta chih na thei uhi. Tu'n zaw i gintak tung lai sang in i hotdamna anai zawta ngal a.
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

paite: Zan abei dekdekta a, khua avak dekta hi; huaiziak in mial a thilhihte paikhia in vak thuam in i kithuam ding uh.
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the works of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

paite: Sun a om bang in kilawmtak in i om ding uh, zu dawn buai leh zu kham a om lou in, huk leh kingaihhat a om lou in, kilai leh kihaza a om lou in.
english: Let us walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

paite: Toupa Jesu Khrist in kithuam zaw unla, na sa duhgawlna uh pichin ding in bangmah kibawl kei un.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

paite: Huan ginna hat lou mi, angaihdante gense lou in ngai un.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

paite: Mi khat in thil bangkim ne thei ding in akigingta a, mihat lou in bel anteh-louhing kia ane hi.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

paite: Ane mite'n nelou a kidekte simmoh kei henla; nelou a kidekte'n leng anete soisel tuan kei hen; Pathian in amah akipahpih khinta ngal a.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

paite: Midang sikha tung a soiselpa nang kua na hia? Apu a ding in ahi adin hiam ahihkeileh apuk. Himahleh amah zaw dinsak in a-om ding, Toupa'n adingsak thei hi.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

paite: Mi khat in ni khat nidang sang in athupi ngaih tuam a, midang in ni tengteng kibang chiat in angai. Michih amah lungsim ah kitheichian hen aw.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

paite: Ni tangpa'n Toupa pahtawina ding in atang hi. Huan bangkim nepa'n, Pathian kiang a kipahthu agen ziak in, Toupa pahtawina ding in ane a; aneloupa'n leng Toupa pahtawina ding in ane kei a, Pathian kiang ah kipahthu agen hi.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

paite: Kuamah eimah a dia hing i hi kei ua, kuamah eimah a dia si leng i hi sam kei.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

paite: I hinleh Toupa a ding in i hing a; i sih in leng Toupa a dia si i hi ngal a; huaiziak in i hin in leng, i sih in leng Toupa a i hi uhi.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

paite: Khrist sihna leh ahin nawnna pen, mihing leh misi Toupa ahihtheihna ding ahi.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

paite: Himahleh nang bang achia na unau soisel na hia oi? Ahihkeileh nang bang achia na unau simmoh na hia oi? Pathian' thukhenna tutphah ma a dingh vek ding lah i hi ngal ua.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

paite: "Toupa'n, kei ka hin bang in, mi tengteng ka ma ah akun ding ua, lei tengteng leng Pathian kiang ah akipulak ding uh chi in ka chiam ahi," achi, chih gelh ahi.
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’” Isaiah 45:23

paite: Huchi in i vek un Pathian kiang ah eimah tanchin i gen chiat ding uhi.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

paite: Huaiziak in kisoisel nawn kei ni, kuapeuh in a-unau lampi ah kisuihna hiam dalna hiam koih louh tum zaw hen.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

paite: Amah mawngmawng a siang lou bangmah himhim a-om kei chih Toupa Jesu ah ka thei mahmah hi; thil khatpeuh siang lou a seh pen bel aseppa a ding in siang lou ahi mai hi.
english: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

paite: Na banghiam nek ziak a na unau lungsim anatleh itna dan in na gamta kei' a ahi. Asih sik a Khrist in asihsakpa na thil nek in hihmang kei hen.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

paite: Huchi in nou a dia hoihna, gilou lam a gen in om kei hen.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

paite: Pathian lalgam nek-le-dawn thu hilou in Kha Siangthou a diktatna, kituahna leh kipahna ahi zaw hi.
english: for the Kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thu ah Khrist nasem Pathian kipahpih leh mihing phat in a-om hi.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

paite: Huchi in kituahna ding leh kihihhat tuahna ding thilte i delh ding uh.
english: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

paite: Na thil nek ziak in Pathian nasep hihse ke'n. Thil tengteng asiangthou ngei a, himahleh banghiam anek in mi ahihpukleh anepa a ding in gilou ahi.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

paite: Na unau pukna ding ahihleh, sa neklouhte, uain dawnlouhte, thil bangpeuh hih louh ahoih ahi.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

paite: Ginna na neih Pathian ma ah nangmah kia theih in nei mai in. Ama hoihsak lam a siam louh kitan lou tuh mihampha ahi.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

paite: Himahleh ginglelpa'n anekleh, ginna a anek louh ziak in, siam louh atang hi; bangpeuh ginna lou a hih zaw khelhna ahi.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

paite: Huchi in ei ahatte'n, eimah kipahna zong lou in, ahatlouhnate hatlouhna i thuakpih ding uh ahi.
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

paite: Eimah invengte chiat tunding leh ahoihna ding ua kipahsak i tum chiat ding uh.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

paite: Khrist in leng amah kipahna azong ngal kei a, "Nang hon taite taina ka tung ah atuta," chih gelh bang in ahi zaw.
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.” Psalm 69:9

paite: Laisiangthou a kuhkalna leh khamuanna mu a lametna i neihtheihna ding un, nidanglai a gelh peuhmahte eite hon hilhna ding a gelh ahi uhi.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through patience and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

paite: Tu in kuhkalna leh khamuanna Pathian in, Khrist Jesu ah noute lungsim leh ngaihtuahna mun khat pu in hon omsak hen;
english: Now the God of patience and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,

paite: Huchi a, lungsim mun khat leh kituaktak a Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa leh Pathian na pahtawi theihna ding uh ahi.
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Huaiziak in Khrist in Pathian thupina ding a noute ahon kipahpih mah bang in, khat-le-khat kipahpihtuah chiat un.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, TR reads “us” instead of “you” to the glory of God.

paite: Tu in, pipute kiang a thuchiamte hihkipna ding in Khrist tuh Pathian thutakdan theihsakna ding in zeksumte nasempa ahong hita chih na kiang uah ka gen hi.
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

paite: Azahngaihna ziak a Zentelte'n Pathian apahtawi theihna ding un, "Huaiziak in Zentelte lak ah ka hon phat ding a, na min pahtawina ding in la ka sa ding," chih gelh bang in.
english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.” 2 Samuel 22:50; Psalm 18:49

paite: "Huan nou Zentel tengtengte aw, amite toh kipak un," achi nawn hi.
english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.” Deuteronomy 32:43

paite: "Nou Zentel tengtengte aw, Toupa phat un, mi tengteng in amah phat uhen," achi nawn hi.
english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.” Psalm 117:1

paite: Isai in: "Jesse zungzam ahong khang ding a, Zentelte tung a vaihawm dingpa ahong dingkhe ding hi; amah ah Zentelte'n alametna uh akoih ding uhi," achi lai hi.
english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.” Isaiah 11:10

paite: Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna ziak a lametna na hauhtheihna ding un, lametna Pathian, na gintak ziak un, kipahna leh kituahna chiteng in hon hihdim hen.
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huan ka unaute aw, nou tungthu zaw noumau mah hoihna in na dim ua, na kihanthawntuah thei uh chih keimah ngei in leng diktak in ka thei hi.
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.” , that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

paite: Himahleh Pathian in ahon piak hehpihna ziak in nou hon theihpih ding in koi kalkal hiam ah hangsantak in ka gelh hi.
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

paite: Zentelte kiang a Khrist Jesu nasempa a ka omtheihna ding in, Zentelte Kha Siangthou a hihsiangthou ahih ua, pomtak ahihtheihna ding un Pathian tanchinhoih lam ah siampu nna ka sem ahi.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

paite: Huchi in Pathian nna ka sep lam thu ah Khrist Jesu ah kisaktheihna ding ka nei ahi.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

paite: Khrist in Zentelte thumangsak ding a ka thugen leh nasepnate zang a asepkhiakte lou ngal bangmah ka gen ngam ngal kei a,
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

paite: chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte, thilhihtheihna ah, Kha Siangthou thilhihtheihna in Jerusalem khua leh akim gam a kipan in, Illirikum gam pha in, Khrist tanchinhoih gam chih ah ka hilh kimta; keimah hon zang a athilhih tuh huchi tel ahi.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

paite: Ahi, midang suangphum tung a lem ka hihlouhna ding in, tanchinhoih Khrist min loh khitna mun a gen lou in.
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

paite: "Atanchin gen ngeilouhnate'n amu ding ua, za ngei nailoute'n aza ding uh," chih gelh bang in, gen ka tum zaw ahi.
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.” Isaiah 52:15

paite: Huaiziak in ahi, na kiang ua hong ka kikhelsak naknak.
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

paite: Tu in bel hiai gam kim ah sepna mun himhim ka neita kei a, kum tampi na kiang ua hong ut in leng ka omta hi.
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

paite: Spain gam a ka hoh chiang in ka pai kawm a nou hon muh ka kilamen ngal a, noumau toh kithuahkhawm phot in, maban ka paina ding ah noute'n na hon va khaksuk uh leng ka lamen ahi.
english: whenever I journey to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

paite: Tu in bel, misiangthoute nasem ding in Jerusalem ah ka hoh tadih ding hi.
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

paite: Masidonia leh Akhaia gam a mite'n kipaktak in Jerusalem a misiangthoute lak a gentheite a ding in thilpiakte ape chiat uhi.
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

paite: Hiai thilpiak in amau nakpi in akipaksak hi; amaute ding in leng bat ahi him hi; Zentelte'n Judate khalam vualzawlna akikoppih ualeh salam thil a amaute taksap awng ahuksak sam uh akilawm him ahi.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.

paite: Huaiziak in huai ka hih a, gah leng amaute diktak a ka muhsak nung in, noute hon tawn in, Spain gam ah ka pai zel ding hi.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

paite: Huan na kiang ua ka hong chiang in, Khrist tanchinhoih vualzawlna kim pu in ka hong ding chih ka thei hi.
